verses.name: Psalms 1:1
verses.text: MEID pai ol o, me sota alialu ni padak en me doo sang Kot akan, o me so duki ong me dipan akan, o me so mondi ren me malaun akan,<l eID="gen3" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen4"/>A me kin peren kida kapung en Ieowa o madamadaua duen a kapung ni ran o ni pong!<l eID="gen4" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen5"/>A rasong tuka pot, me padedier ni kailan pilap akan, me kin kapareda wa ni a ansau, o ta kan sota kin mongala, a karos a wiawia pwaida.<l eID="gen5" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen6"/>Me doo sang Kot akan sota kin dueta, a re rasong dip me ang kin iririp sili.<l eID="gen6" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen7"/>I me doo sang Kot akan sota pan pwai kida nan kadeik, o me dipan akan nan momod en me pung kan.<l eID="gen7" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen8"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin mangi al en me pung kan; a al en ir, me doo sang Kot akan, pan soredi.<chapter eID="Ps.1"/> <l eID="gen8" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:1
verses.text: DA me men liki kan lingaringarki, o da me wei kan lamelam eki me mal akan?<l eID="gen10" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen11"/>Nanmarki en sappa kan kin kangudi o saupeidi kan kapukapung pena, en kaokaoe dodok en Ieowa o Sapwilim a me keidier.<l eID="gen11" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen12"/>Kitail en kawela ara men saliedi o kase sang kitail ara sal akan!<l eID="gen12" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen13"/>A me kotikot nanlang, kotin kiparamateki, o Kaun o kotin mamale kin irail.<l eID="gen13" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen14"/>Eu ran a pan kotin kapung ong ir ni a ongiong; o ni a ongiong lapalap a pan kotin kamasak irail.<l eID="gen14" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen15"/>A ngai kasapwilada ai Nanmarki pon dol en Sion saraui.<l eID="gen15" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen16"/>A ngai pan padaki wei duen aude pan kapung en Ieowa! A kotin masani ong ia er: Koe nai Ol, ran wet I kaipwi uk adar!<l eID="gen16" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen17"/>Poeki re i, I ap pan ki ong uk, en sosoki men liki kan, o en aneki imwin sappa kan.<l eID="gen17" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen18"/>Koe pan kawe irail ekidi sokon mata, o kamor irail pasang rasong dal akan.<l eID="gen18" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen19"/>Ari, komail nanmarki kan en dukidi, o komail saunkapung en sappa kan en lolekongala!<l eID="gen19" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen20"/>Papang Ieowa ni lan o pereperen ni masak!<l eID="gen20" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen21"/>Metik sapwilim a Ol, pwe a der ongiong, o komail ap lokidokila pon al o, pwe a ongiong kak madang tapida. A meid pai ir karos, me liki i.<chapter eID="Ps.2"/> <l eID="gen21" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:1
verses.text: O IEOWA, ai imwintiti me toto, o ir me toto, me kangudi ong ia!<l eID="gen23" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen24"/>Me toto kin inda duen ngen i, me dene sota sauas pa i ren Kot. Sela.<l eID="gen24" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen25"/>A komui Ieowa pere pa i, o komui pan kotin kalingana ia da, o kamait ia la.<l eID="gen25" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen26"/>I kin likwiri ong Ieowa ki ngil laud; o a kotin mangi ai ngidingid sang ni sapwilim a dol saraui. Sela.<l eID="gen26" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen27"/>I kin wonon, o mamair, o pirida, pwe Ieowa kin kotin kolekol ia.<l eID="gen27" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen28"/>I sota kin masak saunpei nen pak toto, me kin kapil ia pena.<l eID="gen28" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen29"/>Kom kotida Maing, Ieowa o sauasa ia, ai Kot! Pwe kom kotin pikir ai imwintiti karos, o kawelar ngi en me sapung kan.<l eID="gen29" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen30"/>Ieowa me sauas patail. Kom kotin kamauiada sapwilim omui aramas akan! Sela.<chapter eID="Ps.3"/> <l eID="gen30" level="1"/><lg eID="gen22"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:1
verses.text: KOT kapung pa i, kom kotin mangi ia ni ai likelikwir. Pwe kom kin kotin kamait ia la ni ai ansau apwal. Kom kotin maki ong ia o mangi ai kapakap.<l eID="gen32" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen33"/>Komail saumas akan! Arai da mar ai pan susued? Arai da omail pok ong me mal kot, o omail perenki likam? Sela.<l eID="gen33" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen34"/>Komail lolekongala, ap asa, me Ieowa kotin piladar sapwilim a lelapok o. Ieowa kin kotin mangi ia ni ai likelikwir ong i.<l eID="gen34" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen35"/>Ni omail makar, komail der wia dip. Komail madamadauaki mongiong omail ni omail wendi pon los o ap auiaui. Sela.<l eID="gen35" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen36"/>Komail mairongki mairong pung o liki Ieowa.<l eID="gen36" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen37"/>Me toto kin inda: Is me pan kasale ong kitail me mau kan? A Ieowa, kom kotin kamaraine kin kit marain en silang omui!<l eID="gen37" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen38"/>Komui kotin kaperenda mongiong i laud sang ansaun arail wain o korn me toto.<l eID="gen38" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen39"/>I kin wonon o mamair ni popol; pwe komui ta Maing, me kotin sauasa ia da, pwe i en kak moleilei.<chapter eID="Ps.4"/> <l eID="gen39" level="1"/><lg eID="gen31"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:1
verses.text: IEOWA kom kotin ereki ai lokaia o kotin mangi ai madamadaua.<l eID="gen41" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen42"/>O kotin mangi ai likelikwir, ai Nanmarki o ai Kot, pwe i pan potoan kapakap ong komui.<l eID="gen42" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen43"/>Maing Ieowa, kotin mangi ngil ai nin soran, nin soran i men tu ong komui o masamasan.<l eID="gen43" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen44"/>Pwe komui kaidin Kot amen, me kin mauki tiak sapung, me morsued sota pan mimieta mo ’mui.<l eID="gen44" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen45"/>Me aklapalap akan sota pan pwaida mon silang omui, kom kin kotin suede ki me sapung kan.<l eID="gen45" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen46"/>Kom pan kotin kamela me likam kan; Ieowa kin kotin tataki me kamela o kotaue aramas akan.<l eID="gen46" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen47"/>A i pan pedelong ong nan tanpas omui, pweki omui kalangan lapalap, o kaudok ni lan inen wong sapwilim omui im en kaudok o.<l eID="gen47" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen48"/>Maing kom kotin kalua ia ni omui pung, pweki ai imwintiti kan; kom kotin kaineneta al omui mo i.<l eID="gen48" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen49"/>Pwe sota me melel kot ni au arail; o lol arail rokeki kaopa. Kapinwor arail rasong sousou me so ser pena; o re kin aksansale mauki lo arail.<l eID="gen49" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen50"/>Kom kotin kadeik irail da, Maing Kot, pwe ren pup kidi pein arail inong. Sikin ir wei, pweki arail dip lapalap, pwe re kin kangudi ong komui.<l eID="gen50" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen51"/>Karos, me liki komui ap pan peren kida, re pan pereperen kokolata, pwe kom kin kotin sinsila irail. Irail pan pereperen, me kin pok ong mar omui.<l eID="gen51" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen52"/>Pwe komui Maing kin kapaiada me pung kan. Komui kin kotin nekid ir ala ki omui kalangan dueta pere eu.<chapter eID="Ps.5"/> <l eID="gen52" level="1"/><lg eID="gen40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:1
verses.text: MAING, kom der kotin kaloke kin ia omui ongiong, o der kame kin ia omui ongiong lapala!<l eID="gen54" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen55"/>Maing, kom kotin maki ong ia, pwe ngai me luet. Maing, kom kotin kamau ia la, Maing Ieowa, pwe ti kan me luetalar.<l eID="gen55" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen56"/>O ngen i waponda melel. O Maing, arai da?<l eID="gen56" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen57"/>Maing, kom kotin saupei dong ia, dorela ngen i. Kom kotin sauasa ia ni omui kalangan!<l eID="gen57" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen58"/>Pwe murin melar solar me pan tamanda komui; o is me pan kapinga komui wasan mela?<l eID="gen58" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen59"/>I panga kida ai sangesang sang sautik lel mansang; i kawisokisokela ai los pil en mas ai.<l eID="gen59" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen60"/>Mom ai suede kilar ai insensued, o i malar, pweki kamakamasak pai me toto.<l eID="gen60" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen61"/>Komail aramas morsued akan karos kaiwei sang ia, pwe Ieowa kotin mangi ai sangesang.<l eID="gen61" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen62"/>Ieowa kotin mangi ai ngidingid, o Ieowa kotin mangier ai kapakap.<l eID="gen62" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen63"/>Ai imwintiti karos pan namenokela o masakada melel, re pan tangwei o madang sarodi.<chapter eID="Ps.6"/> <l eID="gen63" level="1"/><lg eID="gen53"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:1
verses.text: MAING, i kin liki komui Ieowa, ai Kot. Kom kotin sauasa ia ong ai imwintiti kan karos, o kotin dore ia la,<l eID="gen65" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen66"/>Pwe ren der dueta laien amen kol ia di o tapeng ia pasang, pwe sota pil amen saundor.<l eID="gen66" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen67"/>Maing, ai Kot, ma i wiadar mepukat, o ma pa i kat wiadar sapung,<l eID="gen67" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen68"/>O ma i depukki mesued en akai ar wiawia mau ong ia, pwe i dorelar, me imwintiti ong ia, ap sota karepa,<l eID="gen68" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen69"/>A ma so due, ai imwintiti en kaloke ia, o kol ia di, o tiakedi maur i nani pwel, o kawela mar ai. Sela.<l eID="gen69" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen70"/>Maing, kom kotida ni omui ongiong o kotin palian makar en ai imwintiti kan, o kotin opadang ia, pwe re kotin inau kidar kapung,<l eID="gen70" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen71"/>Pwe wei kan pan pokon dong ir; o re kotin purodala pweki irail.<l eID="gen71" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen72"/>Ieowa iei saunkapung en wei kan. Maing, kotin sauasa ia, duen ai pung o duen ai lelapok!<l eID="gen72" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen73"/>Re kotin kadukiedi mesued en me doo sang Kot akan, ap kotin katengedi me pung kan. Pwe komui Kot pung, kin kotin kasaui mongiong o mudilik kan.<l eID="gen73" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen74"/>Kot iei pere pa i, me kin kotin sauasa me melel ni mongiong arail.<l eID="gen74" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen75"/>Kot saunkapung pung amen, me kotin ongiongada ni ran karos.<l eID="gen75" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen76"/>Ma meamen sota pan wukila, a ap kotin ada sapwilim a kodlas o onopada kasik katieu o kainene wong i,<l eID="gen76" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen77"/>O kotin pwil poa kanangan kasik katieu men kamela. A kotin kaonopada sapwilim a kanangan kasik katieu, pwe men karongala.<l eID="gen77" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen78"/>Kilang, a lamelam me dir en sued, a lisenaneki men kaokaoe o pan naitikedi likam.<l eID="gen78" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen79"/>A weiradar por eu o wiadar lolia, ap pein pupedi ong lole, me a weiradar.<l eID="gen79" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen80"/>A men kamela pan sapale dong pein mong a, o a dodok sued pan pupedi ong pein a al en wel.<l eID="gen80" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen81"/>I pan kapinga Ieowa, pweki a pung, o i pan kauleki mar en Ieowa me lapalapia.<chapter eID="Ps.7"/> <l eID="gen81" level="1"/><lg eID="gen64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:1
verses.text: MAING at Kaun, mar omui meid lingan nan sap karos! Irail kin kapinga komui nanlang!<l eID="gen83" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen84"/>Sang nan au en seri pwelel, o ir me kin kangkang didi, re kotin wia kidar manaman eu ong omui imwintiti kan, pwe komui en kamela me imwintiti o, o me aktuau o.<l eID="gen84" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen85"/>Ma i kilekilang lang, dodok en lim omui, saunipong o usu kan, me re kotin wiadar:<l eID="gen85" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen86"/>Dakot aramas o, pwe komui kin kotin kupkupura i, de nain aramas, pwe komui kin kotin apapwali i?<l eID="gen86" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen87"/>Re kotin kasapwilidier i ansau kis pan tounlang kan, a re kalinganadar i, o kawauialar i.<l eID="gen87" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen88"/>Re kasapwiladanger i wiawia en lim omui kan. Kom kotin kaloedier karos pan nä a kan:<l eID="gen88" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen89"/>Sip o kau kan, o pil man en sap akan,<l eID="gen89" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen90"/>O manpir en pan lang, o mam en nan sed, karos me kin memaureki nan madau.<l eID="gen90" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen91"/>Ieowa at Kaun, mar omui meid lingan nan sap karos!<chapter eID="Ps.8"/> <l eID="gen91" level="1"/><lg eID="gen82"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:1
verses.text: I MEN kapinga Ieowa sang nan mongiong i meler, o kasokasoiia duen sapwilim omui dodok kapuriamui kan karos.<l eID="gen93" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen94"/>I men pereperen o polauleki komui o kauleki mar omui; komui me lapalapia,<l eID="gen94" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen95"/>Pwe re kotin kaloedier ai imwintiti kan, irail pupedier o melar.<l eID="gen95" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen96"/>Pwe re kotin apwali ia ni ai pung o ai dodok. Komui kaipokedi pon mol omui duen saunkapung pung amen.<l eID="gen96" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen97"/>Kom kotin kapung ong men liki kan o kotin kamela me sapung kan, kom kotin kawelar mar arail kokolata.<l eID="gen97" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen98"/>Imwintiti o soredier, a namenokalar melel. Komui kotin wuketedi kanim akan; o solar, me pan taman irail ada o tou ar akan.<l eID="gen98" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen99"/>A Ieowa pan kotin kaunda kokolata. A kotin kaonopada mol a, pwen kadeikada.<l eID="gen99" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen100"/>O a pan kotin kadeikada sappa ni pung, o kakaunda wei kan pung.<l eID="gen100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen101"/>Ieowa sile pan me samama kan, silepa ni ansau apwal.<l eID="gen101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen102"/>I me irail, me asa mar omui kin liki komui, pwe komui sota kin muei sang irail, me kin rapaki komui, Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen103"/>Kauleki Ieowa, me kin kaunda nan Sion. Komail padaki ong wei kan a wiawia!<l eID="gen103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen104"/>Pwe a kotin taman irail ada o kotin kainoma nta ’rail. A sota kin kotin maliela likwir en me samama kan.<l eID="gen104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen105"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin maki ong ia. Re kotin mangi ai apwal ren ai imwintiti kan, kom kotin dore ia la sang nan wanim en mela.<l eID="gen105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen106"/>Pwe i en kasokasoiia duen omui dodok kapuriamui pan wanim en nain Sion, perenki sauas pa om.<l eID="gen106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen107"/>Men liki kan pupedi ong nan por o, me pein irail weiradar, o nä ’rail lodi ong insar, me pein irail wiadar.<l eID="gen107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen108"/>I me kitail asaki, Ieowa me kotin kapung pung. Me sapung kan salidi ong pein ar dodok en pa ar akan. Sela.<l eID="gen108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen109"/>Me sapung kan en lokidokila nan wasan mela, o men liki kan karos, me kin monokela Kot.<l eID="gen109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen110"/>Pwe me samama o sota pan monokinokla kokolata, o me luet akan sota pan kaporoporeki mal kokolata.<l eID="gen110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen111"/>Maing, kom kotida! Pwe aramas ender pwaida, a men liki kan karos en pakadeikada mo omui.<l eID="gen111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen112"/>Maing, kotiki ong ir men kamasak, pwe men liki kan en dedeki, me re udan aramas eta. Sela.<chapter eID="Ps.9"/> <l eID="gen112" level="1"/><lg eID="gen92"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:1
verses.text: MAING, da me kom kotin doo sang ia, o da me kom kotin rir sang ia ni ansau apwal?<l eID="gen114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen115"/>Me sapung kan ni ar aklapalap re kin kaloke me samama o; re kin pokon pena o madamadaua duen ar morsued.<l eID="gen115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen116"/>Pwe me sapung o kin suaiki a tiak sued, o me norok moni, kin muei sang Ieowa, lalaue i.<l eID="gen116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen117"/>Me sapung o kin lamelame ni a aklapalap, me a sota kotin mangi duen mepukat. Ni song en a tiak sued karos, a kin lamelame me sota Kot.<l eID="gen117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen118"/>A kin pwaida ni a dodok kan. A sapwilim omui kapung me doo sang i; a kin lalaue a imwintiti kan karos.<l eID="gen118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen119"/>A kin indinda nan mongiong i: I sota pan lodi; i sota pan diar ai apwal kot kokolata.<l eID="gen119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen120"/>Au a me dir en lalaue, o malaun, o kotaue, o pan lo a kin me sued o me apwal.<l eID="gen120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen121"/>A wonon o masamasan nan kanim akan, a kin rir kamela me makelekel o, o por en mas a kin masamasan me sapai o.<l eID="gen121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen122"/>A kin masamasan wasa rir dueta laien amen nan deu a, a kin auiaui, pwen koledi me luet o, a kin saikidi me luet o ni a insar.<l eID="gen122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen123"/>A kin dairukorokedi o karakarakedi, o me sapai kan pan lodi ong ni kiki kong kelail akan.<l eID="gen123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen124"/>A kin indinda nan mongiong i: Kot pan monokela, a kin karirila silang i, a sota man mangi.<l eID="gen124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen125"/>Re kotida Maing Kot, kotin pokada lim ar, kom der kotin maliela me luet akan.<l eID="gen125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen126"/>Menda me doo sang Kot o kin mamaleki Kot, o a kin indinda nan mongiong i, me dene kom sota pan kotin mangi.<l eID="gen126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen127"/>Ari so, kom kotin mangi, pwe kom kotin irerong me luet o kankangeranger akan, pwen sauasa ir. Me sapai o kin mueid ong komui pein i, o komui me sauas pa en me sapoupou o.<l eID="gen127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen128"/>Kom kotin katip pasang pa en me sapung o, o kotin depuk ong mesued o a tiak sued lao solar pan diarokada.<l eID="gen128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen129"/>Ieowa me Nanmarki kokolata; men liki kan en nikilar sang nan sap we.<l eID="gen129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen130"/>Maing, kom kotin mangier inong en me luet akan; kom kotin kamanada mongiong arail, karong omui mamangi mepukat,<l eID="gen130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen131"/>Pwen sauasa me sapoupou o samama o, pwe aramas en sappa en solar kangudi.<chapter eID="Ps.10"/> <l eID="gen131" level="1"/><lg eID="gen113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:1
verses.text: I LIKI Ieowa, a menda komail indang ngen i: Piridalang pon omail nana dueta manpir amen?<l eID="gen133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen134"/>Pwe kilang, me doo sang Kot akan kaonopadar kasik katieu o pwilikidi ar kanang en kasik katieu pon sal o, pwen rir kasikiedi me melel ni mongiong arail.<l eID="gen134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen135"/>Pwe ma ur akan rongk pasang, da me aramas pung en wiada?<l eID="gen135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen136"/>Ieowa kotikot nan tanpas a saraui, mol en Ieowa mimi nanlang, silang i kin mamasani sili, kil en silang i kin sosong aramas akan.<l eID="gen136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen137"/>Ieowa kotin song me pung, ap kotin tataki me sapung o morsued.<l eID="gen137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen138"/>A pan kotin kamoredi ong me doo sang Kot akan liol, o kisiniai, o swepel, o a pan katinge kin irail melimel.<l eID="gen138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen139"/>Ieowa me pung o a kotin pok ong me pung. Silang i irerong ong me melel o.<chapter eID="Ps.11"/> <l eID="gen139" level="1"/><lg eID="gen132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:1
verses.text: MAING kom kotin sauasa, pwe me lelapok kan malaulaular, o me melel akan me malaulau ren aramas akan.<l eID="gen141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen142"/>Irail kin lokaia likam, amen amen ong men impa, re lokaiaki lol riapot.<l eID="gen142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen143"/>Ieowa pan kotin usada kil en au karos me lingkaping o lo, me kin lokaia wei ni aklapalap.<l eID="gen143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen144"/>Me kin indinda: Lo atail, me kit pan pwai kida, o kil en au at me kit keleki; is at kaun?<l eID="gen144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen145"/>Ieowa kotin masani: I pan uda, pweki kankangeranger en me luet akan o sangesang en me samama kan: I pan sauasa i, me kin inong iong.<l eID="gen145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen146"/>Masan en Ieowa me makelekeleta silper, me kamakelekel kidar nan dal pwel en kisiniai pan pak isu.<l eID="gen146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen147"/>Komui Maing, pan kotin pera irail, o sinsila mon di wet kokolata.<l eID="gen147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen148"/>Pwe me sapung kan pan totolar wasa karos, ma aramas sued pukat kin kaunda aramas akan.<chapter eID="Ps.12"/> <l eID="gen148" level="1"/><lg eID="gen140"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:1
verses.text: MAING arai da kom pan kotin malie ia la? Arai da komui pan kotin karirila silang omui mo i?<l eID="gen150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen151"/>Arai da i en perki nan lol ai o salo mi nan mongiong i ran karos? Arai da ai imwintiti en kaurur kin ia?<l eID="gen151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen152"/>Maing ai Kot, kom kotin masan dong ia o sapeng ia. Kom kotin kamaraini mas ai, pwe i ender mela.<l eID="gen152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen153"/>Pwe ai imwintiti ender inda: I kaloedier i. O me palian ia ender perenki ai pupedier.<l eID="gen153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen154"/>A i kin liki omui kalangan; mongiong i en peren kida omui kotin sauasa ia. I pan kauleki Ieowa duen a kotin wiawia mau ong ia.<chapter eID="Ps.13"/> <l eID="gen154" level="1"/><lg eID="gen149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:1
verses.text: ME pweipwei o kin indinda nan mongiong i: Sota Kot. Sota katepa ’rail, o arail tiak meid sued; sota amen mia, me kin wia me mau.<l eID="gen156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen157"/>Ieowa kin irerong aramas akan sang nanlang, pwen masani, ma amen mia, me lolekong o rapaki Kot.<l eID="gen157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen158"/>A ir karos suedelar o karos sota kon ong, sota me kin wiada me mau, sota amen.<l eID="gen158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen159"/>Irail karos me kin wiada mesued, sota ar lolekong, o me kin kawela nai aramas akan, lao medi kila, a re sota kin likwir ong Ieowa?<l eID="gen159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen160"/>I wasa re kin masak, pwe Kot kotikot ren kadaudok en me pung kan.<l eID="gen160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen161"/>Komail kin kawela inong en me luet; aki Ieowa, me a kin kaporoporeki.<l eID="gen161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen162"/>O i men, sauas pan Israel en kodo sang nan Sion, o Ieowa en kotin lapwada sapwilim a salidi kan! I me Iakop pan insenemauki o Israel pan pereperenki.<chapter eID="Ps.14"/> <l eID="gen162" level="1"/><lg eID="gen155"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:1
verses.text: MAING, is me pan kaukauson nan tanpas omui? Is me pan mimieta pon sapwilim omui dol saraui?<l eID="gen164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen165"/>Me kin kekeitwei ni makelekel, o me kin wia me pung, o me kin lokaia melel sang nan mongiong;<l eID="gen165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen166"/>Me sota karaun mal ki lo a, o me sota kin wia mesued ong men imp a;<l eID="gen166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen167"/>Me kin mamaleki me lokidokilar o, ap kakaki me masak Ieowa kan, o me kin kaula melel, menda ma a suedi ong pein i;<l eID="gen167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen168"/>Me sota pan piti sang en amen na moni, o me sota pan ale kisakis, pwen kawela me pung amen. Ari, me kin apwali mepukat, sota pan luetala kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.15"/> <l eID="gen168" level="1"/><lg eID="gen163"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin sinsila ia, pwe i liki komui.<l eID="gen170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen171"/>Ngai potoan ong Ieowa: Komui ta ai Kaun, sota eu pai, me i asa, pwe komui eta.<l eID="gen171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen172"/>O I kin indang saraui kan, me kin mi nan sappa: Met akan pwin isou, me I kin pokepoke sang ni mongiong i.<l eID="gen172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen173"/>A irail me kin idedauen amen, pan lodi ong apwal toto. I sota mauki arail mairong, me doleki nta, de mar arail I sota pan inda.<l eID="gen173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen174"/>A Ieowa ai pai o ai peren; Komui kin kolekol ai soso.<l eID="gen174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen175"/>I diaradar ai pwais en sap kaselel eu, ei pai kaselel eu, me i sosokier.<l eID="gen175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen176"/>I kapinga Ieowa, me kotin kalolekong ia; pil ni pong mudilik i kan kin padaki ong ia.<l eID="gen176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen177"/>I kin ariri Ieowa ansau karos, pwe a kotikot ni pali maun i, i ap sota pan luetala.<l eID="gen177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen178"/>I me mongiong i kin peren kida, o ngen i kin popol, pwe pil pali uduk ai pan moleilei.<l eID="gen178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen179"/>Pwe kom sota pan kotin mauki, ngen i en mimieta nan wasan mela, o kom sota pan mueid ong, me sapwilim omui saraui men pan mor pasang.<l eID="gen179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen180"/>Kom kin kotin kaasa kin ia al maur; peren lapalap mi mon silang omui, o meid lingan ni pali maun en lim omui kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.16"/> <l eID="gen180" level="1"/><lg eID="gen169"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:1
verses.text: MAING kom kotin ereki me pung o kotin mangi ai likwir o kotin kupura ai kapakap, me sota kin kowei sang nan kil en au likam eu.<l eID="gen182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen183"/>Ai pung en pwili sang re omui, o kom kotin masan dong me pung.<l eID="gen183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen184"/>Kom kotin kasaui mongiong i ni pong, o komui kotin sosong ia, ap sota me kom kotin diar. I inaukidi, me i sota pan sapung ni ai lokaia.<l eID="gen184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen185"/>I kin rukila pan masan en silang omui sang mon tiak en aramas o al en men kamela.<l eID="gen185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen186"/>Ni ai alialu wei i sota muei sang nan lip en aluwilu omui, ai kakawei sota katia sang.<l eID="gen186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen187"/>I likwiri ong komui, Maing Kot, kom kotin mangi ia, o kapaike dong ia karong omui, o kotin ereki ai kapakap.<l eID="gen187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen188"/>Kom kotin kasaleda omui kalangan kapuriamui, pwe pali maun omui sauas pan ir, me kin liki komui, ong ir me palian ir.<l eID="gen188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen189"/>Sinsila ia dueta por en mas eu, o kotin pera kin ia mot en lim omui,<l eID="gen189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen190"/>Mon me sapung kan, me men kawe ia la, mon ai imwintiti, me kin kapil ia pena.<l eID="gen190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen191"/>Re kin kapiridi mongiong arail; o sang nan au arail re kin lokaia aklapalap.<l eID="gen191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen192"/>Wasa se kin kola ia, re kin kapil kit pena, mas arail kin masamasan, pwen kase kit di ong nan pwel.<l eID="gen192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen193"/>Dueta laien amen, me inong iong manga, o dueta laien pul amen, me wonon nan wasa rir.<l eID="gen193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen194"/>Maing, kom kotida, kaloedi o kanamenokla i; dorela maur i sang me sapung kan ki omui kodlas,<l eID="gen194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen195"/>Sang ren aramas akan ki lim omui, Maing Ieowa, sang ren aramas en sappa wet, me pwais arail ni maur et; kom kotin kadire kila kaped arail omui dipiso kan, me nairail seri ol me toto, o nairail akan me pan sosoki luan arail kapwa.<l eID="gen195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen196"/>A i pan ariri silang omui ni ai pung, o i pan medikila mom omui ni ai pan pirida.<chapter eID="Ps.17"/> <l eID="gen196" level="1"/><lg eID="gen181"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:1
verses.text: I KIN pok ong komui Maing, ai kel.<l eID="gen198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen199"/>Ieowa ai paip, ai kel, ai saundor ai Kot, ai paipalap, me i kin liki, pere pa i, menkamaur pa i o sile pa i!<l eID="gen199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen200"/>I kin ngidingid ong Ieowa, me kaping en ko ong, o i pan dorela sang ai imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen201"/>I lodi onger sal en mela kan, o pilap en Pileam akan kamasak ia er.<l eID="gen201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen202"/>Sal en wasan mela kol ia dier, o sal en mela kaloe ia dier.<l eID="gen202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen203"/>Ni ai masak i likwir ong Ieowa o weriwer ong ai Kot; I ap kotin ereki ngil ai sang nan tanpas a, o ai likwir lel ong karong a kan.<l eID="gen203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen204"/>Sappa rerer o mokidedar, o pason en nana kan ititekok o rerer, ni a kotin ongiongidar.<l eID="gen204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen205"/>Atiniai koda sang nan silang i, o kisiniai kelail sang nan au a, ap kareda liol.<l eID="gen205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen206"/>O a kotikidier nanlang o kotidido, o rotorot impan aluwilu a kan.<l eID="gen206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen207"/>O a kotikot pon Kerup amen o kotin pirwei, o a kotin dake pa en ang.<l eID="gen207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen208"/>Tanpas a im pwal iei rotorot, o katau laud, o tapok rotorot, kapil pena i.<l eID="gen208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen209"/>Lingan me mi mo a, kamueit pasang tapok kan iang akel o liol.<l eID="gen209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen210"/>O Ieowa kotin wiadar nansapwe nanlang, o me Lapalapia kotin poronelar kapit i iang akel o liol.<l eID="gen210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen211"/>A kotin kasik wei sapwilim a kanang en kasik katieu, o kotin kamueit irail pasang. A kotin wiadar liol toto o kamasak irail adar.<l eID="gen211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen212"/>Al en pil akan ap sansaladar, o pason en sappa weiweidar ki ar ongiong Maing, mon ang en silang omui.<l eID="gen212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen213"/>A kotikidier lim a sang nan wasa ileile, a kotin kol ia di o kotin api ia dar sang nan pil kalaimun akan.<l eID="gen213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen214"/>A kotin dore ia la sang ai imwintiti kelail akan, sang ir, me kailong kin ia, ir me i sota itar ong.<l eID="gen214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen215"/>Irail kaloe ia dier ni ai ran apwal, a Ieowa kotin wialar sauas pa i.<l eID="gen215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen216"/>O a kotin kalua ia wasan saladok, a kotin kamaio ia da, aki a kotin kupukupura ia.<l eID="gen216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen217"/>Ieowa kin kotin sauasa ia duen ai pung, a kotin katingi ong ia duen makelekel en pa i kan.<l eID="gen217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen218"/>Pwe i kin weweid nani al en Ieowa, o i sota kin katiwo ong ai Kot.<l eID="gen218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen219"/>Pwe a masan akan mi mo i, o i sota pan kase sang ia a kusoned akan.<l eID="gen219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen220"/>Pwe ngai unsokalar mon silang i o suedeki ai sapung.<l eID="gen220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen221"/>O Ieowa kotin katingi ong ia duen ai pung, o duen makelekel en pa i kan mon silang i.<l eID="gen221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen222"/>Komui me kalangan ong me mau kan, o lelapok ong me lelapok kan,<l eID="gen222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen223"/>O makelekel ren me makelekel akan, o sapung ren me sapung kan.<l eID="gen223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen224"/>Pwe kom kin kotin dorela aramas luet akan, ap kadukiedi mas en me aklapalap akan.<l eID="gen224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen225"/>Pwe kom kin kotin kamaraini ai lamp, Ieowa ai Kot kin kamaraini ai rotorot.<l eID="gen225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen226"/>Pwe ni ai iang komui i kak kaloedi karis en saunpei kan, o ni ai iang ai Kot, i kak luswei pon kel takai.<l eID="gen226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen227"/>Al en Kot me unsokala; masan en Ieowa me makelekel. I pere pan karos, me liki i.<l eID="gen227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen228"/>Pwe ia amen Kot impan Ieowa, de ia paip eu impan atail Kot?<l eID="gen228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen229"/>Iei Kot, me kotin aude kin ia manaman, o kaunsokala al ai.<l eID="gen229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen230"/>A kin kotin wiai ong nä i kan dueta nä en tia, o kotin kasapwil ia dang wasa ileile.<l eID="gen230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen231"/>A kotin padaki ong pa i kan tiak en mauin o, pwen kak ong kaonopada kasik katieu mata.<l eID="gen231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen232"/>Kom kotiki ong ia pere pan maur omui, o lim omui pali maun kamana ia da, o omui opampap me kasapwil ia da.<l eID="gen232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen233"/>Kom kotin kaonopadar al, me i pan weweid ia, pwe nä i kan ender krisedi.<l eID="gen233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen234"/>I pan tang wong ai imwintiti kan o kono irail edi, o i sota pan puredo, lao karos lodier.<l eID="gen234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen235"/>I pan kamor irail pasang, re sota pan kak palian ia, o re pan pupedi ong pan nä i kan.<l eID="gen235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen236"/>Kom kak kamana kin ia omui manaman ong ni pei; Kom kak kasedi ong pan nä i kan karos me palian ia.<l eID="gen236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen237"/>Kom kin kotin kaloedi ong ia ai imwintiti kan, pwen kawela, me kailong kin ia.<l eID="gen237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen238"/>Re kin likelikwir, a sota sauas parail ren Ieowa, a sota kotin sapeng ir.<l eID="gen238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen239"/>I pan suk irail pasang dueta pwel par nan kisiniang; i pan kase ir ala dueta pwel samin sang nani al o.<l eID="gen239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen240"/>Kom kin kotin dore ia sang ren akamai en aramas, o kom kotin kasapwil ia dang men liki kan; o wei eu me i sasa kin upa ong ia.<l eID="gen240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen241"/>Ni ar ronger, re peiki ong ia er, o nain men wai kan peikiong ia ni lingkaping.<l eID="gen241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen242"/>Nain men wai kan poridier o rerer o pwarado sang nan ar im kalaimun akan.<l eID="gen242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:46
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen243"/>Ieowa kotin ieias; kaping ong ai paipalap; o kaping ong Kot ai saundor.<l eID="gen243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:47
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen244"/>Kot me kotin depuk ong ai imwintiti kan, o a kotin kaloedi ong ia ai imwintiti kan;<l eID="gen244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:48
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen245"/>Kom kotin dore ia la sang ai imwintiti kan, o kom kotin kasapwil ia dang ir, me palian ia. Kom kin kotin sauasa ia ong me morsued ong ia.<l eID="gen245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:49
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen246"/>I me i men danke komui, Maing Ieowa, nan pung en men liki kan o kauleki duen mar omui,<l eID="gen246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:50
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen247"/>Komui me kotin kamaurada melel sapwilim a nanmarki o a kotin sauasa mau sapwilim a Dawid keiedier o kadaudok a kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.18"/> <l eID="gen247" level="1"/><lg eID="gen197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: LANG pokon kin kasokasoi duen lingan en Kot o aude pan lang kin katitiki dodok en lim a kan.<l eID="gen249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen250"/>Ran eu kin kasokasoi ong eu ran o pong eu kin padaki ong eu pong.<l eID="gen250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen251"/>Sota kaparok o sota lepen lokaia, ari so, ngil a kin peido.<l eID="gen251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen252"/>O a loua padak lel ong sap karos, o a kaparok lel imwin sappa. A kotin wiai ong katipin im pwal eu pan lang;<l eID="gen252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen253"/>O a kin pedoi sang nan a pera dueta ol kamod amen, o kin pereperen dueta ol kamod amen ni a tangwei pon al o.<l eID="gen253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen254"/>A dakada ni eu imwin lang ap tangalang imwin teio, o sota me kak rir sang mon karakar a.<l eID="gen254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen255"/>Kapung en Ieowa me unsok o kin kainsenemauiala ngen en aramas akan. Kadede en Ieowa me melel o kin kalolekongla me lolepon.<l eID="gen255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen256"/>Kusoned en Ieowa me pung o kin kaperenda mongiong en aramas. Kusoned en Ieowa me makelekel o kamarainiada mas en aramas.<l eID="gen256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen257"/>Lomwin Ieowa me min o kin duedueta. Masan en Ieowa kan me melel, o pung kaualap.<l eID="gen257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen258"/>Irail me kasampwal sang kold o kold lingan toto, o iau sang onik o onik kasampwal.<l eID="gen258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen259"/>Ir me pil kin katamanda sapwilim omui ladu, o me kin kapwai ir ada, ar kating me lapalap.<l eID="gen259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen260"/>Is me kak asa duen toto en a sapung? Kom kotin lapwada dip ai me rir akan.<l eID="gen260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen261"/>Pil perewei sang sapwilim omui ladu me aklapalap, pwe ren der kaloe ia di, i ap pan pungala, o pan makelekel sang dip lapalap kokolata.<l eID="gen261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen262"/>Kom kotin kupura kaparok en au ai o lokolokaia en mongiong i mo ’mui, Ieowa ai paipalap o ai saundor.<chapter eID="Ps.19"/> <l eID="gen262" level="1"/><lg eID="gen248"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:1
verses.text: IEOWA en kotin mangi om kapakap ni ran apwal o; mar en Kot en Iakop en pera uk!<l eID="gen264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen265"/>A en kotin porone dong uk sauas pam sang nan tanpas saraui o kamana uk ada sang nan Sion.<l eID="gen265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen266"/>A en kotin kupura om mairong karos, o om mairong isis en konkon re a. Sela.<l eID="gen266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen267"/>A en kotiki ong uk, me mongiong om anane, o kotin kapaiada om inong karos.<l eID="gen267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen268"/>Se pan ngisingiski omui sauasa kit, o ni mar en atail Kot kit pan kida at plak. Ieowa en kotin kapwaiada om poekipoek karos!<l eID="gen268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen269"/>I ap asaer, me Ieowa kin kotin dorela sapwilim a me keiedier, o a pan mangi i sang nan sapwilim a lang saraui, lim a pali maun kin sauasa kaualap.<l eID="gen269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen270"/>Mo kan kin kaporoporeki war o os akan; a kit kin keleki mar en Ieowa atail Kot.<l eID="gen270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen271"/>Irail lodier o pupedier, a kit uda o kasinenda.<l eID="gen271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen272"/>Maing kom kotin sauasa nanmarki o, o kotin mangi at likwir ong komui!<chapter eID="Ps.20"/> <l eID="gen272" level="1"/><lg eID="gen263"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, nanmarki o kin peren kida omui manaman, o a polauleki melel omui sauasa i!<l eID="gen274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen275"/>Kom kotiki ong i, me mongiong i inong iong, o kom sota kin sopeiwei sang, me kilin aua poekipoki. Sela.<l eID="gen275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen276"/>Pwe kom kin wudokedi ong poa me mau kan; kom kotin kalisorop kidi i nin kold kasampwal eu.<l eID="gen276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen277"/>A kin poeki re omui maur, komui ap kotiki ong i maur warai kokolata.<l eID="gen277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen278"/>A lingan me lapalap ki omui kotin sauasa i. Kom kin kotin kapwataki i manaman o lingan.<l eID="gen278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen279"/>Kom kotin kasapwilada i, pwen wia kamau men kokolata; kom kaperenda i mon silang omui.<l eID="gen279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen280"/>Pwe nanmarki kin liki Ieowa, o a pan dadaurata ki kalangan en me lapalapia.<l eID="gen280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen281"/>Lim omui pan diar omui imwintiti kan karos, o lim omui maun pan diar me kailong kin komui.<l eID="gen281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen282"/>Kom pan wia kin ir ala stop en kisiniai eu, ni omui pan kotin pwarado. Ieowa pan kotin kawe ir ala ni a ongiong, o kisiniai pan kang ir ala.<l eID="gen282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen283"/>Kom pan kotin karosela kadaudok arail sang nan sappa, o wa ’rail sang nan pung en aramas akan.<l eID="gen283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen284"/>Pwe irail inau kidar, me re pan wia sued ong komui a re sota pan itar ong.<l eID="gen284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen285"/>Pwe komui pan kotin kasaloe ir ada, pwe ren tang; kom pan kotin padok wong ir omui sal en kasik katieu.<l eID="gen285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen286"/>Maing kom kotida ni omui rosong kit ap kauleki o kapinga omui manaman.<chapter eID="Ps.21"/> <l eID="gen286" level="1"/><lg eID="gen273"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: A I Kot, ai Kot da me komui likidmalie kin ia la? I likelikwir, a sauas pa i me doo.<l eID="gen288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen289"/>Ai Kot, nin ran i kin likwir, a kom sota kin sapeng, o ni pong i pil sota kin nenenla.<l eID="gen289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen290"/>Ari so, komui ta me saraui, komui me kotikot pan kaul en kaping en Israel.<l eID="gen290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen291"/>Sam at akan liki komui, o ni ar liki, kom kotin sauasa irail er.<l eID="gen291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen292"/>Irail likwir ong komui, rap dorelar, re liki komui, rap sota namenokala.<l eID="gen292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen293"/>A ngai dueta kamatol amen, a kaidin ol amen, me aramas akan kin lalaue o mamaleki.<l eID="gen293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen294"/>Karos me kilang ia, kin lalaue, ia, sara pasang au arail o tuetuäl mong arail:<l eID="gen294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen295"/>A kin liki Ieowa, i en dorela i, o kamaioda i, pwe a kin kupura i.<l eID="gen295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen296"/>Pwe komui kotin kaipwi ia sang nan kaped en in ai; komui ta, me i liki sang ni ansaun ai mi ni maramaran in ai.<l eID="gen296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen297"/>Sang nan kaped en in ai i lokidokilang komui; komui ta ai Kot sang ni ansaun ai mi pon kopan in ai.<l eID="gen297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen298"/>Kom der kotin doo sang ia, pwe ansaun kalokolok korendor, ap solar sauas pa i.<l eID="gen298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen299"/>Kau ol kalaimun kan kapil ia penaer, o kau ol en Pasan kele ia pena.<l eID="gen299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen300"/>Irail sara dong ia dueta laien weriwer o laualo amen.<l eID="gen300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen301"/>Ngai wudokilar dueta pil, ai kokon akan karos muei pasanger, o mongiong i pei pasanger nan kaped i dueta wi.<l eID="gen301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen302"/>Ai kelail ngalangal lar dueta diper en dal eu, o lo i pasadang pan ngatangat ai, o komui kin wia kin ia me melar amen.<l eID="gen302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen303"/>Pwe kidi kan kapil ia pena, o pwin aramas sued eu kele ia pena, irail kapore pasang pa i o nä i kat.<l eID="gen303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen304"/>I kak wadok kokon ai kan karos; a irail kin kilekilang ap peren kida.<l eID="gen304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen305"/>Re kin nek pasang ai likau kan nan pung arail, o re doropweki ai likau pup.<l eID="gen305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen306"/>A komui Maing ender doo sang ia! Ai kel madangdo o sauasa ia!<l eID="gen306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen307"/>Dorela maur i sang kodlas, pwe me ta ieu, o sang nan kel en kidi!<l eID="gen307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen308"/>Sauasa ia sang nan au en laien, o dore ia la sang ose en man laualo!<l eID="gen308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen309"/>I pan padaki ong ri ai kan duen mar omui, o i pan kapinga komui nan momodisou.<l eID="gen309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen310"/>Kapinga Ieowa komail me masak i, o kadaudok en Iakop en kalinganada i, o wan Israel karos masak i.<l eID="gen310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen311"/>Pwe a sota kotin mamaleki de suedeki me luet akan; o a sota kotin karirila silang i sang irail; o ni a likwir ong i, a kotin erekier.<l eID="gen311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen312"/>I pan kapinga komui nan momodisou kalaimun; i pan kapwaiada ai inau mon ir me lan i.<l eID="gen312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen313"/>Me luet akan en manga o medila, o me idok Ieowa, pan kapinga i; ngen omail pan memaureta kokolata.<l eID="gen313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen314"/>Ni imwin sap karos re pan tamanda Ieowa, ap wuki ong i, o di en men liki karos pan kaudoki ong i.<l eID="gen314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen315"/>Pwe wein Ieowa, o a kotin kaunda men liki kan.<l eID="gen315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen316"/>Me wi kan karos nin sappa pan mangamanga o kelepuki; karos, me pan wiala pwel o sota kak kolekol maur ar, pan pongi i.<l eID="gen316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen317"/>Kadaudok eu mia, me pan papa i, re pan padaki ong seri o seri en seri kan duen Ieowa.<l eID="gen317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen318"/>Re pan pwarado o padaki ong aramas akan, me pan ipwidi mur duen a pung, o duen me a kotin wiadar.<chapter eID="Ps.22"/> <l eID="gen318" level="1"/><lg eID="gen287"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: IEOWA sile pa i, i sota pan anane meakot.<l eID="gen320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen321"/>A kotin kamanga ia nan mos kaselel o kalua ia wong ni pil lamelamur.<l eID="gen321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen322"/>A kotin kamanada ngen i, a kalua ia pon al pung pweki mar a.<l eID="gen322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen323"/>I lao weid nan mot en mela, i sota pan masak mesued kot, pwe kom kotin ieiang ia, omui irar o lepin saipali kamait ia la.<l eID="gen323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen324"/>Kom kotin kaonop dang ia tepel eu salong ai imwintiti kan. Kom kotin keiekidi mong ai le, o ai dal kin wudewudok.<l eID="gen324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen325"/>Pai o kalangan pan idauen ia arain ai maur, o i pan mimieta nan tanpas en Ieowa kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.23"/> <l eID="gen325" level="1"/><lg eID="gen319"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: SAPWILIM en Ieowa sappa o audepa kan, sap o meakaros me kauson poa.<l eID="gen327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen328"/>Pwe a kotin pasonedier ni kailan madau, o a kotin wiadar pon pil akan.<l eID="gen328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen329"/>Is me pan kodalang pon dol en Ieowa? O is me pan kak uda ni mol en Ieowa saraui?<l eID="gen329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen330"/>Me pa a kan sota sapung o mongiong i makelekel; me sota kin mauki padak sapung, o me sota kin kaula likam.<l eID="gen330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen331"/>I me pan kamaula ren Ieowa, o a pan pung kila ren Kot a saunkamaur.<l eID="gen331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen332"/>I kainok, me kin peiki ong Kot, me kin rapaki silang omui, Kot en Iakop. Sela.<l eID="gen332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen333"/>Komail ritingada wanim laud o langada wanim nin sappa, pwe Nammarki lingan en kotilong!<l eID="gen333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen334"/>Is Nanmarki lingan men et? I Ieowa roson o manaman, Ieowa me rasong nan mauin.<l eID="gen334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen335"/>Komail ritingada wanim laud o langada wanim nin sappa, pwe Nanmarki lingan en kotilong!<l eID="gen335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen336"/>Is Nanmarki lingan men et? I Ieowa Sepaot; I Nanmarki lingan. Sela.<chapter eID="Ps.24"/> <l eID="gen336" level="1"/><lg eID="gen326"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:1
verses.text: MAING, i kin inong iong komui.<l eID="gen338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen339"/>Ai Kot, i liki komui, sauasa ia, pwe i ender sarodi, o ai imwintiti kan ender peren kida.<l eID="gen339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen340"/>Pwe karos me liki komui, sota pan sarodi, a me pan muei sang komui pan sarodi.<l eID="gen340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen341"/>Maing, kom kotin kasale ong ia al omui kan, o kotin padaki ong ia omui tiak kan;<l eID="gen341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen342"/>Kalua ia ni omui melel o kalolekong ia! Pwe komui ta ai Kot, me kin sausa ia, ran karos, i kin auiaui komui.<l eID="gen342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen343"/>Maing, kom kotin tamanda omui kalangan o omui kapunglol, me tapidar mon kaua.<l eID="gen343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen344"/>Re der kotin kupura dip en ai tikitik o ai sopeik; a kupura ia ni ar kapunglol o kalangan! Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen345"/>Ieowa me mau o lelapok, i me a kotin padaki ong me dipan akan pon al o.<l eID="gen345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen346"/>A kin kalua pung me luet akan, o a kotin padaki ong me luet akan al a.<l eID="gen346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen347"/>Al en Ieowa kan me dir en kalangan o melel ong ir, me kin kolekol a inau o masan akan.<l eID="gen347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen348"/>Maing, kom kotin maki ong ia ai sapung kan me lapalap, pweki mar omui.<l eID="gen348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen349"/>Is ol, me kin lan Ieowa? A pan kotin padaki ong i duen al o, me a en pilada.<l eID="gen349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen350"/>Ngen e pan mi wasa mau o kaudaudok a pan aneki sap o.<l eID="gen350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen351"/>Ieowa kompoke pan me kin lan i, a pan kotin padaki ong i duen a inau.<l eID="gen351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen352"/>Mas ai kin ariri Ieowa ansau karos, pwe a pan kotin lapwada nä i kat sang nan insar.<l eID="gen352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen353"/>Kom kotin masan dong ia o maki ong ia, pwe ngai sapoupou o luet.<l eID="gen353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen354"/>Masak en mongiong i lalaudalar; kotin kalua ia sang nan ai apwal akan!<l eID="gen354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen355"/>Kom kotin mangi ai luet o ai kankangeranger, o kotin maki ong ia dip ai kan karos!<l eID="gen355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen356"/>Kom kotin mangi duen ai imwintiti kan, pwe re me toto, o re kin kailong kin ia ni ar aklapalap.<l eID="gen356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen357"/>Kom kotin sinsila ai maur o dore ia la, kom kotin apwali ia, pwe i der namenokala, pwe i kin liki komui.<l eID="gen357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen358"/>Melel o pung en sinsila ia, pwe i auiaui komui.<l eID="gen358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen359"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin dorela Israel sang nan ar apwal akan karos!<chapter eID="Ps.25"/> <l eID="gen359" level="1"/><lg eID="gen337"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:1
verses.text: IEOWA kom kotin sauasa ia, pwe i kekeit wei ni melel. I kin liki Ieowa, i sota pan luetala.<l eID="gen361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen362"/>Maing kom kotin kasaui ia da o kasongesong ia, o kamakelekele mudilik i kan o mongiong i.<l eID="gen362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen363"/>Pwe i asa duen omui kalangan, o i kin weweid ni omui melel.<l eID="gen363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen364"/>I sota kin mondi ren aramas aklapalap akan, o i sota kin waroki ong me morsued akan.<l eID="gen364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen365"/>I kin tataki pokon en mesued akan, o i sota kin mondi ren me sapung kan.<l eID="gen365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen366"/>I omiomi ki makelekel o i kin pok ong sapwilim omui pei saraui, Maing, Ieowa,<l eID="gen366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen367"/>Wasa i pan kapikapinga, ngil laudeta o padak duen omui manaman akan karos.<l eID="gen367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen368"/>Maing Ieowa, i kin pok ong wasan tanpas omui, o wasan ar lingan.<l eID="gen368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen369"/>Kom der kotin kasapoke ia la iangaki me dipan akan, de maur i iangaki me kamela aramas akan.<l eID="gen369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen370"/>Pwe pa arail me dir en morsued o re ki men ale kisakis.<l eID="gen370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen371"/>A ngai kin weweid ni makelekel. Dore ia la o kotin maki ong ia!<l eID="gen371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen372"/>Nä i kin aluwei pung. I pan kapinga Ieowa nan momodisou kan.<chapter eID="Ps.26"/> <l eID="gen372" level="1"/><lg eID="gen360"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: IEOWA kamarain pa i o kamaur pa i, is me i en masak? Ieowa kel pan maur i, is me i en lomwinki?<l eID="gen374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen375"/>Ma mesued akan pan tanga dong ia, pwen kawela uduk ai o ai imwintiti kan, re pan dipikelekel o pupedi.<l eID="gen375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen376"/>Ma pwin saunpei pan kapil ia pena, i sota pan masapwekada, o ma mauin pan wiaui ong ia, i pan liki i.<l eID="gen376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen377"/>Iet eta, me i inong iong o men poeki ren Ieowa, i en mimieta nan tanpas en Ieowa arain ai maur, pwen kilekilang saraui kaselel en Ieowa kan, o ududial sapwilim a im en kaudok.<l eID="gen377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen378"/>Pwe ni ansau apwal a kotin sinsila ia nan tanpas a im pwal. A pan kotin karuk ia la nan tanpas a im likau, o kotin kau ia da pon paip eu.<l eID="gen378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen379"/>A pan kotin kasapwil ia dang pon ai imwintiti kan, me kapil ia pena; i ap pan wiada mairong en kaping nan tanpas a im pwal, i pan kaul o kaping ong Ieowa.<l eID="gen379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen380"/>Maing, kom kotin ereki ngil ai, ma i pan likwir ong komui, kom kotin maki ong ia o mangi ia.<l eID="gen380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen381"/>Mongiong i kin kataman kin komui omui masan: Komail rapa kin ia! I me i pil kin rapaki silang omui. Maing Ieowa!<l eID="gen381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen382"/>Der karir sang silang omui mo i, o der kasapokela sapwilim omui ladu ni omui ongiong; pwe komui me sauas pa i. Kom der kotin kase ia la, o ender muei sang i, Kot ai saunkamaur.<l eID="gen382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen383"/>Pwe sam ai in ai likidmalie ia la; a Ieowa kotin sapwilim anekin ia la.<l eID="gen383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen384"/>Maing, kom kotin kasale ong ia sapwilim omui al o kalua ia nani al pung pweki ai imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen385"/>Kom der kotin mueid ong ai imwintiti kan en kaloe ia di; pwe saunkadede likam palian ia, o re wia sapung ong ia so masak.<l eID="gen385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen386"/>Ari so, i asa, me i pan ududial kalangan en Ieowa nan sap en me memaur akan.<l eID="gen386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen387"/>Auiaui Ieowa! Der masak, o mongiong om ender masak, o auiaui Ieowa!<chapter eID="Ps.27"/> <l eID="gen387" level="1"/><lg eID="gen373"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: MAING, ai paipalap, i lao likwir wong komui, kom der kotin sapaimokid, pwe ma re pan sapaimokid, i pan dueta ir, me pan lokidokila nan por o.<l eID="gen389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen390"/>Kom kotin mangi ngil en ai ngidingid, i lao likwir wong komui, i lao kapa wong pa i kat mol omui saraui.<l eID="gen390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen391"/>Re der kotin kasapoke ia la iangaki me sapung kan, iangaki me wia sued, me kin lokaia kaselel ong men impa, ap lamelame sued nan mongiong arail.<l eID="gen391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen392"/>Kotin depuk ong ir duen ar dodok o duen ar tiak sued; kotiki ong ir duen dodok en pa arail; katingi ong ir duen ar wiawia.<l eID="gen392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen393"/>Pwe re sota insenoki dodok en Ieowa de wiawia en lim a kan; i me a pan kotin kawe ir ala, a sota kauada.<l eID="gen393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen394"/>Kaping ong Ieowa, pwe a kotin erekier ngil en ai ngidingid.<l eID="gen394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen395"/>Ieowa kel pa i o pere pa i, mongiong i kin liki i, o sauas pa i mia. Mongiong i liki i o i pan danke i ki ai kaul.<l eID="gen395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen396"/>Ieowa kele parail; i me manaman ong sauasa sapwilim a me keidier.<l eID="gen396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen397"/>Kotin sauasa sapwilim omui aramas akan o kotin kamauiala sapwilim omui soso, o kotin kamanga ir o apwali irail ada kokolata!<chapter eID="Ps.28"/> <l eID="gen397" level="1"/><lg eID="gen388"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: KOMAIL lapalap akan, wa dong Ieowa, wa dong Ieowa wau o manaman!<l eID="gen399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen400"/>Wa dong Ieowa wau en mar a, pongi Ieowa ni omail kapwat saraui!<l eID="gen400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen401"/>Kapiti en Ieowa mi pon pil akan; Kot en lingan kin wiada nansapwe, iei Ieowa en pil kalaimun akan.<l eID="gen401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen402"/>Kapiti en Ieowa me manaman, kapiti en Ieowa me lingan.<l eID="gen402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen403"/>Kapiti en Ieowa kin katip pasang seder akan; Ieowa kin kotin katip pasang seder akan en Lipanon.<l eID="gen403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen404"/>A kin kotin kalukalus irail dueta kau pul amen, Lipanon o Sirion dueta kau pul ol amen.<l eID="gen404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen405"/>Kapiti en Ieowa kin luswei dueta umpul en kisiniai.<l eID="gen405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen406"/>Kapiti en Ieowa kin kamokidada sap tan; Ieowa kotin kamokidada sap tan en Kades.<l eID="gen406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen407"/>Kapiti en Ieowa kin kamokidada tia kan o kakilesauiada nana kan, o nan tanpas a im en kaudok karos kin kapinga i.<l eID="gen407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen408"/>Ieowa kotikot pon pil akan o Ieowa pan Nanmarki kokolata.<l eID="gen408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen409"/>Ieowa pan kamanada sapwilim a aramas akan; Ieowa pan kotin kamaui sapwilim a aramas akan ki popol.<chapter eID="Ps.29"/> <l eID="gen409" level="1"/><lg eID="gen398"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: I kapinga komui Maing, pwe komui me kotin kasapwil ia dar, o sota mueid ong ai imwintiti kan ren peren kin ia da.<l eID="gen411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen412"/>Ieowa, ai Kot, i likwir wong komui, komui ap kotin kakel ia dar.<l eID="gen412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen413"/>Maing, kom kotin kalua ngen i sang nan wasan mela. Kom kotin dore ia lar ni ansau me irail lokidokila nan pweleko.<l eID="gen413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen414"/>Komail lelapok kan en kapinga Ieowa, o kapinga mar a lingan!<l eID="gen414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen415"/>Pwe a ongiong kin marep ta ieu, a a mak arain maur en aramas amen; nin sautik re kin sangesang, a ni mansang ngisingis.<l eID="gen415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen416"/>A ngai inda ni ai ansau mau: I sota pan lodi kokolata.<l eID="gen416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen417"/>Maing, ni omui kalangan, kom kotin katengedi ai dol, a ni ansau me re karuki sang mo i silang omui, i masapwekadar.<l eID="gen417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen418"/>I likwir wong komui Maing, o i ngidingideki ong Kaun.<l eID="gen418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen419"/>Da kadepa en nt’ ai, i lao kodila nan por o? Pwel par pan kak kapinga komui, o kapakaparok duen omui kalangan?<l eID="gen419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen420"/>Maing Ieowa, re kotin mangi ia o kotin maki ong ia; Ieowa sauas pa i.<l eID="gen420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen421"/>Kom kotin kawukila ai insensued ong ngisingis; kom koti ki sanger ai tuken likau, ap id kalikauwi ia dar popol.<l eID="gen421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen422"/>Pwe ngen i en kauli ong komui, a ender nenenla. Maing ai Kot, i pan kapinga komui kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.30"/> <l eID="gen422" level="1"/><lg eID="gen410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: MAING, i liki komui, kom kotin ieiang ia, pwe i ender namenokala kokolata; dore kin ia la duen omui pung.<l eID="gen424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen425"/>Kapaikidi dong ia karong ar akan, madang sauasa ia! Kom kotin wiala ai paipalap roson, o kele pa i, pwen sauasa ia!<l eID="gen425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen426"/>Pwe komui ai paip, o ai kel. Kom kotin kalua ia pweki mar omui.<l eID="gen426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen427"/>Kom kotin api ia sang nan insar, me re wiai ong ia, pwe komui kele pa i.<l eID="gen427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen428"/>I kakaliki ong komui ngen i; kom kotin dore ia la, komui Maing Kot melel.<l eID="gen428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen429"/>I suedeki me kin kaporoporeki dikedik en ani mal akan, a i liki Ieowa.<l eID="gen429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen430"/>I pan pereperen o polauleki omui kalangan, pwe komui me kotin mangi ai luet, o kotin kupura ngen i ni ansau apwal.<l eID="gen430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen431"/>O re der mueid ong ai imwintiti, ren kaloe ia di. Kom kotin kasone nä i kat nan wasa salatok.<l eID="gen431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen432"/>Ieowa, kom kotin maki ong ia, pwe i masak; mas ai suedelar ki ai mamauk, pil dueta ngen i o pali war ai.<l eID="gen432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen433"/>Pwe maur i luet kilar ai insensued, o ai par akan malaulaular ki ai sangesang, ai kelail tikitikelar pweki dip ai, o kokon ai kan luetalar.<l eID="gen433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen434"/>Ai imwintiti kan karos lalaue ia, o i wialar kanamenok pan men imp ai kan, o kamasak pan sau i kan; me kilang ia nani al o, kin tangwei sang ia.<l eID="gen434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen435"/>Aramas monoke ia lar dueta me melar amen; ngai rasong dal eu, me mor pasang.<l eID="gen435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen436"/>Pwe i ronger duen me toto kin puserokiong ia; men kamasak kapil ia pena; re kin kapung pena duen ngai, pwen kame ia la.<l eID="gen436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen437"/>A i kin kaporoporeki komui Maing, i ap inda: Komui ta ai Kot!<l eID="gen437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen438"/>Ai ansau mi nan lim omui, dore ia sang nan pa en ai imwintiti kan o sang me kin pakipaki ia.<l eID="gen438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen439"/>Kamarainiki sapwilim omui ladu silang omui, dore ia ki omui, dore ia ki omui kalangan.<l eID="gen439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen440"/>Maing, kom der kotin mueid ong, i en soredi; pwe i likwiri wong komui. Me sapung kan en soredi, pwe irail en nenenla nan wasan mela.<l eID="gen440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen441"/>Kil en au en me likam akan en nenenla, irail, me lalaue me pung kan ni laumaum, o aklapalap, o kaurur.<l eID="gen441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen442"/>Meid laud omui kalangan, me kom kotin nekinekid ong me lan komui kan, o me kom kin kasale ong ir, me liki komui sansal mon aramas akan.<l eID="gen442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen443"/>Kom kin kotin karir ir ala re omui sang karos, me kailong kin ir; kom kin kadupal ir edi sang mon lo akamai.<l eID="gen443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen444"/>Kapinga ong Ieowa, me kotin kalangan laud ong ia nan kanim tengeteng eu.<l eID="gen444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen445"/>Pwe ni ai peikasal i indindar: I lokidokilar sang mon silang ar. Ari so, kom kotin ereki ngil en ai ngidingid, ni ai potoan werwiwer ong komui.<l eID="gen445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen446"/>Komail sapwilim a saraui kan karos, pok ong Ieowa! Ieowa kin kotin sinsila me poson akan, ap depuk ong ir melel, me aklapalap akan.<l eID="gen446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen447"/>Komail karos me kaporoporeki Ieowa, en kelail o der masak!<chapter eID="Ps.31"/> <l eID="gen447" level="1"/><lg eID="gen423"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: MEID pai, me dip arail lapwadar, o me ar sapung pwaipwaidier!<l eID="gen449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen450"/>Aramas meid pai, me Ieowa solar pan kapokoki ong dip ar, me sota likam nan mongiong ar.<l eID="gen450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen451"/>Pwe ni ai men okila, kokon ai kan ap susueda kilar ai sangesang ran karos.<l eID="gen451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen452"/>Pwe lim omui katoutou ia nin ran o ni pong, o ai kelail mongedier, dueta ni ansau en karakar. Sela.<l eID="gen452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen453"/>I me i weokadang komui dip ai kan, o sota okila ai sapung kan. Ngai indinda: I pan weokadang Ieowa ai katiwo kan; komui ap kotin maki ong ia sued en dip ai. Sela.<l eID="gen453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen454"/>I me saraui kan karos pan potoan kapakap ong komui arain ansau me komui kak diarokada. Lapake kalaimun pan wiaui, a a sota pan lel ong ir.<l eID="gen454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen455"/>Komui me pere pa i, kom pan kotin perawei sang ia men kamasak, i ap pan dorela o kapinga ni peren. Sela.<l eID="gen455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen456"/>I pan padaki ong uk o kasale ong uk al o, me koe en weweid ia; I pan kalua kin uk por en mas ai.<l eID="gen456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen457"/>Komail der dueta os de as amen me sota ar madamadaua, me mau ong, kisin mata en ko ong au arail, a ma so, re sota pan duki ong uk.<l eID="gen457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen458"/>Me sapung o kin lodi ong song en madak toto, a me kaporoporeki Ieowa, kalangan en Ieowa pan kapil pena i.<l eID="gen458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen459"/>Polauleki Ieowa, o pereperen komail me pung kan, o kapikapinga komail karos me lelapok melel akan.<chapter eID="Ps.32"/> <l eID="gen459" level="1"/><lg eID="gen448"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: KOMAIL me pung kan polauleki Ieowa, me lelapok kan en kapinga i.<l eID="gen461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen462"/>Danke Ieowa o kapikapinga ki men kasang o kaule ki ong i sal en arp eisok.<l eID="gen462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen463"/>Kauleki ong i kaul kap pot, komail kanai ong arp o ngil!<l eID="gen463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen464"/>Pwe masan en Ieowa me inen o a wiawia kan karos melel.<l eID="gen464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen465"/>A kin kotin pok ong me pung o melel, sappa direki kalangan en Ieowa.<l eID="gen465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen466"/>Nanlang wiaui kida masan en Ieowa o audepan a karos ki ngen en silang i.<l eID="gen466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
