verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen467"/>A kotin kolekol pena pil en madau dueta nan dal eu, o a kotin nekidala ad akan nan wasa rir.<l eID="gen467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen468"/>Sappa karos en lan Ieowa o karos me kaukauson nan sappa en wauneki i.<l eID="gen468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen469"/>Pwe ma a kotin masanta, ap pan wiaui, o ma a kotin pangokada, ap pan miela.<l eID="gen469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen470"/>Ieowa kin kotin kawela kapung en men liki kan, o a kin kawukila madamadaua en wei kan.<l eID="gen470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen471"/>A me Ieowa kileledier, pan duedueta, o me a kotin kupurada, pan kokolata.<l eID="gen471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen472"/>Meid pai wei o, me Ieowa ar Kot, o wei, me a kotin piladang a soso.<l eID="gen472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen473"/>Ieowa kin kotin irerong aramas akan karos sang nanlang.<l eID="gen473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen474"/>A kotin irerong karos, me kauson sappa sang mol a tengeteng.<l eID="gen474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen475"/>A kotin wiadar mongiong arail karos, o a kotin mangi ar wiawia kan karos.<l eID="gen475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen476"/>Nanmarki amen sota pan pwai kida a karis toto, o ol komad amen sota pan dore kila a kelail.<l eID="gen476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen477"/>Os akan pil sota kak sauasa ekis o a kelail melel sota kadepa.<l eID="gen477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen478"/>Kilang, silang en Ieowa kin irerong ong me lan i, o me kaporoporeki a kalangan.<l eID="gen478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen479"/>Pwen kapit ir ala sang ni mela o katekatungole ni ansau en lek.<l eID="gen479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen480"/>Ngen atail kin auiaui Ieowa, i me sauas patail o pere patail.<l eID="gen480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen481"/>Pwe mongiong atail kin peren kida i, pwe kitail kin liki mar a saraui.<l eID="gen481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen482"/>Maing, Ieowa, omui kalangan en mi po at duen at kaporoporeki komui.<chapter eID="Ps.33"/> <l eID="gen482" level="1"/><lg eID="gen460"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: I PAN kapinga Ieowa ansau karos; au ai pan kapinga i kokolata.<l eID="gen484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen485"/>Ngen i en suaiki Ieowa, me luet akan pan rong, ap peren kida.<l eID="gen485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen486"/>Komail iang ia kapinga Ieowa, pwe kitail en wiaki eu, kalangada mar a.<l eID="gen486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen487"/>Ni ai rapaki Ieowa, a kotin sapeng ia, o dore ia la sang nan ai masak karos.<l eID="gen487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen488"/>Me kin ariri i, pan kakelada, o mas arail sota pan namenokala.<l eID="gen488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen489"/>Ol luet men et lao likwir, Ieowa ap kotin erekier o dorela i sang nan a apwal akan karos.<l eID="gen489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen490"/>Toulang en Ieowa kotikot ren me lan i o kotin sauasa ir.<l eID="gen490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen491"/>Komail song o kilang duen kalangan en Ieowa! Meid pai, me liki i!<l eID="gen491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen492"/>Lan Ieowa sapwilim a saraui kan! Pwe me kin lan i, sota pan anane meakot.<l eID="gen492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen493"/>Laien pulepul akan lekila o men mangada, a me kin rapaki Ieowa, sota pan anane meakot.<l eID="gen493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen494"/>Sama ko, komail kodo re i, rong ia, i pan padaki ong komail duen lan Ieowa:<l eID="gen494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen495"/>Is me inong iong maur warai, o is me mauki ran kaselel akan?<l eID="gen495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen496"/>Pere sang mesued lo om o kilin au om, pwe re der kotaue.<l eID="gen496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen497"/>A muei sang mesued, ap wiada me mau, rapaki popol ap dadaurata.<l eID="gen497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen498"/>Silang en Ieowa mamangi me pung kan, o karonga ereki ar likwir;<l eID="gen498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen499"/>A silang en Ieowa kin palian ir, me kin wia mesued, pwen kawe ir ala sang nan sappa.<l eID="gen499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen500"/>Irail kin likwir, Ieowa ap kotin mangi ir o kotin sauasa ir sang ni ar apwal akan karos.<l eID="gen500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen501"/>Ieowa koren iong ir, me mongiong arail arail olar, o kotin sauasa ir, me ngen arail olar.<l eID="gen501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen502"/>Kalokolok toto lel ong me pung kan, a Ieowa kin kotin sauasa ir sang nan mepukat karos.<l eID="gen502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen503"/>A kotin sinsila kokon akan karos, pwe eu ender tip pasang.<l eID="gen503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen504"/>Me sued kot pan kamela mo doo sang Kot akan, o me kin kailonki me pung kan, pan kalokolok.<l eID="gen504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen505"/>Ieowa kin kotin dorela ngen en sapwilim a ladu kan, o karos me liki i sota pan kalokolok.<chapter eID="Ps.34"/> <l eID="gen505" level="1"/><lg eID="gen483"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: MAING, kom kotin pei ong ir, me kin pei ong ia; o kotin palian ong ir, me kin u ong ia.<l eID="gen507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen508"/>Re kotin ale pere o tatan mauin ap kotida, pwen sauasa ia.<l eID="gen508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen509"/>Ngapekida katieu sauasa ia ong ai imwintiti kan. Kotin masan dong ngen i: Ngai sauas pam!<l eID="gen509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen510"/>Me men kame ia la, en namenokala o kankaururala; o me men wia sued ong ia, en pure wei o sarodi.<l eID="gen510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen511"/>Ren wiala dueta dip en kisin war akan mon kisiniang, o tounlang en Ieowa sikin irail wei.<l eID="gen511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen512"/>Al arail en rotorotala o kitentel la, o tounlang en Ieowa en kotin pakipaki irail.<l eID="gen512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen513"/>Pwe re insensara ia, pwen kame ia la, ap sota karepa, o re wia por ong ia, a sota karepa.<l eID="gen513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen514"/>A en seseinlek lodi ong kalokolok; o insar me a wiadar, pein i en lodi ong; o mela en lel ong i wasa o.<l eID="gen514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen515"/>A ngen i en perenki Ieowa o polauleki a kotin sauasa ia.<l eID="gen515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen516"/>Kokon ai kan karos pan inda: Maing, is me rasong komui? Pwe kom kotin sauasa me luet o ong me a sota itar ong, o kom kotin sauasa me luet o samama ong me lolap akan.<l eID="gen516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen517"/>Saunkadede likam kai u ong ia, kalelapok re i, me i sota asa due.<l eID="gen517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen518"/>Re kin depukki me mau me sued, pwen kainsensuede kin ia.<l eID="gen518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen519"/>A ngai, ni ar somau, i puri ong nan tuk en likau, o kaloke pein ngai ni ai kaisesol, o kapakap sang mongion i.<l eID="gen519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen520"/>Ngai wiai ong ir dueta ong kompoke pa i o udan ri ai; ngai insensued dueta amen, me kin loleitki in a.<l eID="gen520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen521"/>A irail peren kida ai sikilikel o pokon pena. Men lalaue pokon penang ia o song en aramas, me i sasa, kin lalaue ia ansau karos.<l eID="gen521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen522"/>Re ngi tete ong ia, irail, me kin sansalmau o lalaue pweki kisin manga.<l eID="gen522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen523"/>Maing, arai da, me kom pan kotin masani mepukat? Dorela ngen i sang arail mesued, o maur ta ieu sang laien pulepul akan.<l eID="gen523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen524"/>I pan kapinga komui nan momodisou laud, o nan pung en aramas toto i pan danke komui.<l eID="gen524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen525"/>Der mueid ong ai imwintiti nin sokarepa, ren peren kin ia, o me kin kailong kin ia nin sokarepa, ren der lalaue ia ki mas arail.<l eID="gen525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen526"/>Pwe ar lokaia sota kin kareda popol, o re kin madamadaua, en dipi ong me lelapok kan nan sap o.<l eID="gen526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen527"/>O re sar pasang au arail ong ia indada: Io io, pein kit kilanger.<l eID="gen527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen528"/>Maing, kom kotin mangi mepukat, kom der kotin nenenla, Maing, kom der doo sang ia!<l eID="gen528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen529"/>Kotin opala wasa o kipada, pwen kapung ia la o ai dodok, ai Kot o ai Kaun.<l eID="gen529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen530"/>Maing, ai Kot, kotin kapung ia la duen omui pung, pwe ren der peren kin ia.<l eID="gen530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen531"/>Der mueid ong, ren inda nan mongiong arail: Io, io, i me se men! Der mueid ong, ren inda: Kitail katalalar i.<l eID="gen531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen532"/>Irail karos, me peren kida ai apwal akan, en namenokala o kankaurura la, ir me poponmaso ong ia, en likau kida namenok o kankaurur.<l eID="gen532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen533"/>Irail me kin peren kida ai pung en ngisingis o pereperen, o ren inda ansau karos: Meid kapinga ong Ieowa, me kin perenki sauasa sapwilim a ladu o,<l eID="gen533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen534"/>O lo i en kapakaparok duen omui pung, o kapinga komui ran karos.<chapter eID="Ps.35"/> <l eID="gen534" level="1"/><lg eID="gen506"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: IET me i men inda sang lol en mongiong i duen tiak en me sapung o: Sota lan Kot mi mon mas a.<l eID="gen536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen537"/>A kin kotaue o lingkaping, pwen pein i dadaurata a dodok sued, ap tataki me tei kan.<l eID="gen537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen538"/>A lokaia karos me sued o likam; a pil sota kin duki ong padak, pwen wiada me mau.<l eID="gen538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen539"/>A kin madamadaua pon a los. A kin weweid nani al me sota mau o sota kin suedeki me sapung.<l eID="gen539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen540"/>Maing, omui kalangan me ideda wong lang, o omui melel pil lel ong tapok kan.<l eID="gen540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen541"/>Omui pung rasong nana en Kot akan, o omui kadeik kan me rasong iluk ileile kalank; Maing, komui me kotin dorela aramas o man akan.<l eID="gen541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen542"/>Meid kasampwal omui kalangan Maing Kot, pwe aramas akan kin diar wasan kamaio pan mot en lim omui!<l eID="gen542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen543"/>Re pan saliel kila dipisou toto nan tanpas omui, o kom kotin kanim pil kin irail peren laud rasong pilap pot.<l eID="gen543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen544"/>Pwe parer ong maur mi re omui, o ni omui marain, se kin kilang marain.<l eID="gen544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen545"/>Kom kotin dadaurata omui kalangan ong me asa komui, o omui pung ong me melel sang ni mongiong arail.<l eID="gen545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen546"/>Kom der mueid ong, i en tiatidi pan me aklapalap akan, o pa en me sapung kan ender kapup ia di.<l eID="gen546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen547"/>A mesued akan en pupedi wasa o, pwe ren lokidokila o solar memaureda.<chapter eID="Ps.36"/> <l eID="gen547" level="1"/><lg eID="gen535"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: KOE der makaraki me sued akan; o der peirinki me kin wia sapung.<l eID="gen549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen550"/>Pwe re pan sorala madang dueta rä, o re pan mongedi dueta tan tuka kan.<l eID="gen550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen551"/>Kaporoporeki Ieowa o wiada me mau, kaukausonta nan sap o, o wiawia me pung.<l eID="gen551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen552"/>Polauleki Ieowa, a pan kotiki ong uk, me mongion om inong iong.<l eID="gen552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen553"/>Mueid ong Ieowa om wiawia kan o kaporoporeki i, a pan kotin wia mau.<l eID="gen553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen554"/>A pan kapwareda om wiawia me pung dueta marain, o om tiak pung dueta nin sauas.<l eID="gen554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen555"/>Kaporoporeki Ieowa ap nenenla o auiaui, o koe der makar kida pan me kin pwaida ni a wiawia kan, ol o, me kin kapwaiada me sued.<l eID="gen555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen556"/>Muei sang makar o pwilikidi om lingarangar; koe der makar, pwe koe der pil wia me sued.<l eID="gen556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen557"/>Pwe me sued akan pan kokoka sang, a me liki Ieowa, pan sapaneki sap o.<l eID="gen557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen558"/>Ansau takis, ap solar me sapung o, o ma koe men kilang deu a, a solar mia.<l eID="gen558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen559"/>A me opampap akan pan sosoki sap o, o re pan pereperen ki ar kapwa toto.<l eID="gen559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen560"/>Me sapung o kin kamasak me pung o, o ngi tete ong i.<l eID="gen560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen561"/>A Ieowa kotin kiparamateki i, pwe a kotin mangi a ansau.<l eID="gen561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen562"/>Me sapung kan kin ngape kida kodlas o kaonopada kasik katieu, pwen kasikiedi me luet o samama, o kamela me kekeit wei ni melel.<l eID="gen562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen563"/>A ar kodlas pan dokodi pein mongiong arail, o ar kasik katieu pan tip pasang.<l eID="gen563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen564"/>Me malaulau en me pung amen, me mau sang dipisou toto en me sapung kan.<l eID="gen564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen565"/>Pwe pa en me sapung kan pan tip pasang, a Ieowa pan kotin kolekol me pung kan.<l eID="gen565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen566"/>Ieowa kotin mangier ran en me lelapok kan, o ar dipisou pan duedueta.<l eID="gen566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen567"/>Re sota pan namenokala ni ansau apwal, o ni ansaun lek a pan itar ong ir.<l eID="gen567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen568"/>Pwe me sapung kan pan lokidokila, o imwintiti en Ieowa, ma re rasong sap kaselel eu, re pil pan mokonaidi dueta atiniai.<l eID="gen568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen569"/>Me sapung kan kin pwaipwand ap sota kapungala, a me pung o kin kadek o kin kisakisa wei.<l eID="gen569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen570"/>Pwe me paie kin i, pan sosoki sap o, a me a kotin karialar akan pan kokoka sang.<l eID="gen570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen571"/>Ieowa kin kotin katengetenge song en aramas due met ar kakakewei, o a kotin peren kida a wiawia kan.<l eID="gen571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen572"/>Ma a pan pupedi, a sota pan lokidokila; pwe Ieowa kotin kolekidi i lim a.<l eID="gen572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen573"/>Ngai pulepul ap malar, a i saikenta kilanger me pung amen likidmalielar, de na kan poekipoeki prot.<l eID="gen573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen574"/>A kin kadek ansau karos o kin men kisakis wei, o na kan pan paida.<l eID="gen574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen575"/>Muei sang me sued ap wia me mau, koe ap pan mimieta nan sap o.<l eID="gen575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen576"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin peren kida me pung, o a sota pan kotin likidmaliela sapwilim a saraui kan; re pan nekinek kokolata, a kadaudok en me sapung kan pan kokoka sang.<l eID="gen576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen577"/>Me pung kan pan sosoki sap o, ap mimieta kokolata.<l eID="gen577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen578"/>Au en me pung amen kin kida me lolekong, o lo a kaparokki me pung.<l eID="gen578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen579"/>Masan en a Kot mi nan mongiong i, a sota pan krisedi.<l eID="gen579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen580"/>Me sapung kin masamasan me pung, pwen kamela i.<l eID="gen580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen581"/>A Ieowa sota pan kotin mueid ong, en mi nan pa a kan, o a sota pan kotin kasela i, a lao pan pakadeikada.<l eID="gen581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen582"/>Auiaui Ieowa o weweid nan a al akan, a ap pan kotin kasapwil uk ada, pwe koe en sosoki sap o; koe pan kilang, me sapung kan pan kokoka sang.<l eID="gen582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen583"/>I kilanger me doo sang Kot amen, me katiwo o pwaida o maurada dueta tuka mau pot.<l eID="gen583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen584"/>A ni at dauli wasa o, kilang, a soer mia; i idok duen i, a a solar kak diarokada.<l eID="gen584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen585"/>Dadaurata om lelapok, o wiawia me pung; pwe song due met pan pwaida mau ni imwi.<l eID="gen585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen586"/>A me katiwo kan pan wiaki eu lokidokila, o me sapung kan pan koka sang ni imwi.<l eID="gen586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen587"/>A Ieowa kotin sauasa me pung kan, i me kele parail ni ar apwal akan.<l eID="gen587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen588"/>O Ieowa pan kotin ieiang ir o pan dore ir ala; A pan kotin dore ir ala sang me sapung kan, o a pan sauasa ir, pwe re kin liki i.<chapter eID="Ps.37"/> <l eID="gen588" level="1"/><lg eID="gen548"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: MAING, der kotin kaloke ia ni omui kupur sued, o der kame ia ni omui ongiong.<l eID="gen590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen591"/>Pwe sapwilim omui kanangan kasik katieu lel dong ia, o lim omui katoutou ia.<l eID="gen591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen592"/>Sota mau kot ni pali war ai pweki omui ongiong, o sota moleilei nan kokon ai kan pweki dip ai<l eID="gen592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen593"/>Pwe dip ai kin kadupaledi mong ai, re kin katoutou ia dueta meakot me toutou melel.<l eID="gen593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen594"/>Ai ola kan posuedela o nanan pweki ai pweipwei.<l eID="gen594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen595"/>I kin kos pena o pairok wei alialu, i kin insensued ansau karos,<l eID="gen595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen596"/>Pwe longelong ai mongedier melel, o sota mau kot ni pali war ai.<l eID="gen596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen597"/>Ngai luetalar melel o i wokiwok pasanger. I kin sangesang, pweki mongiong i sota kak moleilei.<l eID="gen597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen598"/>Maing, kom kotin mangi ai inong karos, o ai sangesang sota rir sang komui.<l eID="gen598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen599"/>Mongiong i rerer, ai kelail ko sanger re i, o marain en mas ai pil rotorotala.<l eID="gen599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen600"/>Kompoke pai o ai warok kan kin doowei sang ia, o suedeki ai kalokolok, o sau i kan kin doo sang ia.<l eID="gen600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen601"/>O me kin inong iong kame ia la, kin masamasan ia, o me men wia sued ong ia, kin indinda duen ar pan wiada dodok sued, o re kin widiwiding ansau karos.<l eID="gen601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen602"/>A ngai dueta me salongepon amen, me sota rong wasa, o dueta me lotong, me sota kak sar pasang au a.<l eID="gen602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen603"/>Ngai dueta ol amen me solar rong wasa, o sota depuk en lokaia mi nan au ai.<l eID="gen603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen604"/>A i kin auiaui komui, Maing. Komui Maing ai Kot pan kotin sapeng ia.<l eID="gen604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen605"/>Pwe i men, ren der peren kin ia. Ma nä i pan krisedi, re pan peren kida melel.<l eID="gen605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen606"/>Pwe i koren iong pupedi, o ai kalokolok kin koren iong ia ansau karos.<l eID="gen606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen607"/>Pwe i weokada dip ai kan o suedeki dip ai.<l eID="gen607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen608"/>A ai imwintiti kan memaureta o irail me kelail; me kailong kin ia ni sota karepa me toto.<l eID="gen608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen609"/>O me kin depukki ai me mau me sued, kin palian ia, pweki ai dadaurata me mau.<l eID="gen609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen610"/>Ieowa ai Kot, kom der muei sang ia o der doowei sang ia!<l eID="gen610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen611"/>Kom kotin madang dong ia, Maing sauas pa i.<chapter eID="Ps.38"/> <l eID="gen611" level="1"/><lg eID="gen589"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: NGAI inda: I pan kanai ong al ai kan, pwe i ender wia dip ki lo i. I pan sali pena au ai arain en me sapung o mi re i.<l eID="gen613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen614"/>I kadukiedier ai lokaia o nenenlar o solar inda duen peren, a ai kalokolok lalaudalar.<l eID="gen614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen615"/>Mongiong i karakaradar nan kapedi, o ma i pan tamanda mepukat, a rasong kisiniai lulada; i ap lokaia kida lo i.<l eID="gen615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen616"/>Maing, kotin padaki ong ia, me maur i pan imwisokela, o imwi pan ai ran akan, me i pan samoer.<l eID="gen616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen617"/>Mangi, ai ran akan dueta tälap en pa en aramas re omui; o maur i likamata sota meakot mo ’mui. Melel aramas, me kin keleki pein i, kin dueta adiniai. Sela.<l eID="gen617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen618"/>Re kin alialu sili rasong mota, o re kin katoutouki pein irail dodok mal. Re kin nanak pena ap sasa, is me pan naineki.<l eID="gen618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen619"/>Ari Maing, is me i en auiaui? I kaporoporeki komui.<l eID="gen619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen620"/>Dore ia la sang dip ai karos, o kom der mueid ong, me pweipwei kan en kaurur kin ia.<l eID="gen620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen621"/>I pan nenenla o sota sar pasang au ai, pwe kom kotin wiadar.<l eID="gen621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen622"/>Kotin katukiedi omui kaloke ia; pwe ngai dupok kilar ai kalokolok pan lim omui.<l eID="gen622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen623"/>Ma kom pan kaloke amen pweki dip a, mom a kaselel ap pan suedala likamada man en mot kangala. O meid mal aramas karos! Sela.<l eID="gen623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen624"/>Maing kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o mangi ai likwir, o der sapaimokid ni ai sangesang, pwe ngai sapwilim omui men kairu o pweledan omui wei men dueta sam ai kan karos.<l eID="gen624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen625"/>Kom kotin muei sang ia, pwe i en kelailada, mon ai pan kokowei o solar mia.<chapter eID="Ps.39"/> <l eID="gen625" level="1"/><lg eID="gen612"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: I AUIAUIER Ieowa, o a kotin iroir dong ia o kotin erekier ai likelikwir.<l eID="gen627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen628"/>A kotin api ia da sang nan por sued o sang wasa lususur, o kotin kasonedier nä i kat pon paip eu, pwen kak alu mau;<l eID="gen628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen629"/>O a kotiki ong nan au ai kaul kap pot, pwen kapinga atail Kot; i me aramas toto pan udial ap lan Ieowa o kaporoporeki i.<l eID="gen629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen630"/>Meid pai ol o me kaporoporeki Ieowa o sota waroki ong me aklapalap akan, de me weweid nin tiak likam!<l eID="gen630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen631"/>Maing ai Kot, meid kapuriamui sapwilim omui dodok kan o omui madamadaua, me komui kotin kasale ong kit. Sota me rasong komui. I men kaparok o kasokasoi duen, a re sota mau ong wadok.<l eID="gen631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen632"/>Kom sota kotin kupura mairong man de mairong wan tuka kan; a kom kotin kawasak pasang salong ai; kom sota kotin mauki mairong isis de mairong en dip.<l eID="gen632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen633"/>Ngai ap inda: Kilang, I kokodo; nan puk o me intingidier duen ngai.<l eID="gen633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen634"/>I men kapwaiada kupur omui, ai Kot; o sapwilim omui kapung o mi nan lol en mongiong i.<l eID="gen634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen635"/>I pan padaki ong momodisou laud duen me pung. Kilang, i sota pan nenenla, Maing kom kotin mangi.<l eID="gen635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen636"/>I sota okila omui pung nan mongiong i. I kin kapakaparok duen omui melel o maur, i sota kin okila omui kalangan o melel mon momodisou laud.<l eID="gen636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen637"/>A komui Maing der kotiki sang ia omui kalangan, omui kalangan o melel en sinsila ia ansau karos.<l eID="gen637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen638"/>Pwe ai kalokolok kapil ia pena, o re sota mau ong wadok; dip ai katoutou ia, i ap solar kilang wasa; ir me toto sang pit en mong ai, ap solar angiang.<l eID="gen638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen639"/>Kom kotin kupura ia Maing, o kotin dore ia la; Maing kom kotin sauasa madang!<l eID="gen639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen640"/>Me kin masamasan ia, pwen kame ia la, en namenokala o lisela; me men wia sued ong ia, en purewei o lisela.<l eID="gen640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen641"/>Ir me kin likelikwirki due ai: “Io, io!” en masak o lisela.<l eID="gen641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen642"/>Karos me idok komui, en pereperen o popol. O me pok ong omui maur, ansau karos ren inda: Meid kapingan Ieowa!<l eID="gen642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen643"/>Pwe ngai samama o luet; a Ieowa kin kotin apwali ia. Komui sauas pa i o ai saundor; ai Kot, kom der kotin pwand!<chapter eID="Ps.40"/> <l eID="gen643" level="1"/><lg eID="gen626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: MEID pai me kin apwali me samama o. Ieowa pan kotin dorela i ni ran apwal.<l eID="gen645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen646"/>Ieowa pan kotin apwali i o sinsila a maur, o a pan pwaida nin sappa, o a sota pan mueidala i nan pa en a imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen647"/>Ieowa pan kotin kakelada i ni a pan mela; kom kin kotin sauasa i ni a somau karos.<l eID="gen647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen648"/>Ngai inda: Maing, kom kotin maki ong ia; kakelada ngen i, pwe ngai wiadar dip ong komui.<l eID="gen648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen649"/>Ai imwintiti kan kin lokaia sued duen ngai. Iad a pan mela o mar a pan ririla?<l eID="gen649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen650"/>A kin kodon kilang ia, a kin lokelokaia, a mongiong a me toror, pwe a kin rapaki karepan a lalaue, ap kokowei lokelokaia due.<l eID="gen650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen651"/>Karos me kailong kin ia, kin lidilidumongin kin ia, o re madamadaua sued duen ngai.<l eID="gen651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen652"/>Me suedkot mi re a; a pupedier o solar pan uda.<l eID="gen652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen653"/>Pil kompoke pa i, me i liki, o me iang ia mangamanga, kin tiaki ia di.<l eID="gen653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen654"/>A komui Maing kotin maki ong ia, o kau ia da, i ap pan depuk ong ir.<l eID="gen654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen655"/>I me i pan asaki, me kom kotin kupura ia, pwe ai imwintiti ender ngisingis kin ia.<l eID="gen655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen656"/>A kom kin kolekol ia pweki ia lelapok, o kom pan kotin kasone ia di mon silang omui kokolata.<l eID="gen656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen657"/>Kapinga ong Ieowa, Kot en Israel sang met o kokolata! Amen. Amen.<chapter eID="Ps.41"/> <l eID="gen657" level="1"/><lg eID="gen644"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: DUEN tia amen inong iong pil, iduen ngen i kin inong iong komui o Kot.<l eID="gen659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen660"/>Ngen i inong iong Kot, ong Kot ieias. Iad i pan lel wasa o, me i pan ariri silang en Kot.<l eID="gen660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen661"/>Pil en mas ai, iei kan ai manga ni ran o ni pong, pwe irail kin indang ia ran karos: Ia om Kot?<l eID="gen661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen662"/>Ma i madamadaua duen mepukat, i ap wudokila audepan mongiong i ong pein ngai, pwe i inong iong iang pokon o kokodalang tanpas en Kot, o i men iang pokon, me kin wiada a ran, pereperen o kapikapinga.<l eID="gen662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen663"/>Ngen i, da me koe insensuedeki o sota moleileiki? Auiaui Kot! I pan purong kapinga i. Pwe a kotin sauasa kin ia silang i.<l eID="gen663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen664"/>Ai Kot, ngen i me insensued; i ap madamadaua duen komui nan sap en kailan Iordan o Ermonin, pon dol Misar.<l eID="gen664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen665"/>Sapwilim omui pil akan ngiringirsok, pil laud akan ngiringirsok; sapwilim omui iluk kan karos kadupal ia di.<l eID="gen665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen666"/>Ieowa kotin inaukidar a kalangan ni ran, a ni pong i kin kauli ong i, o i kapakap ong Kot en maur i.<l eID="gen666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen667"/>I kin indang Kot ai paip: Da me kom kotin likidmalie kin ia la? Da me i en weweideki ni insensued pweki ai imwintiti kelail ong ia?<l eID="gen667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen668"/>Likamata kokon ai kan mut pasanger, ni ai imwintiti lalaue ia. Pwe re kin indang ia ran karos: Ia om Kot?<l eID="gen668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen669"/>Ngen i, da me koe insensuedeki o sota moleileiki? Auiaui Kot! Pwe i pan danke i, pwe i sauas pan mas ai o ai Kot.<chapter eID="Ps.42"/> <l eID="gen669" level="1"/><lg eID="gen658"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: MAING Kot! Kotin sauasa ai pung, o kotin ieiang ia nan kapung ong aramas sued pukat, o kotin dore ia la sang aramas likam o morsued akan.<l eID="gen671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen672"/>Pwe komui Kot en ai kel; da me kom kotin kase kin ia la? Da me kom kotin mueid ong, i en weweidwei ni ai insensued, ma ai imwintiti kelail ong ia?<l eID="gen672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen673"/>Kom kotin kadarado omui marain o melel, pwe ira en kalua ia, o wa ia lang ni omui dol saraui o tanpas omui.<l eID="gen673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen674"/>Pwe i en pedelong ong nan pei saraui en Kot, iei Kot me kaperen pa i o kapol pa i, o i en danke komui Kot ki arp, ai Kot.<l eID="gen674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen675"/>Ngen i, da me koe insensuedeki o sota moleileiki? Auiaui Kot! Pwe i pan danke i, pwe i sauas pan mas ai o ai Kot.<chapter eID="Ps.43"/> <l eID="gen675" level="1"/><lg eID="gen670"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, se ronger ki salong at, sam at oko kasokasoi ong kit er, me kom kotin wiadar ni ar ansau mas.<l eID="gen677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen678"/>Kom kotin pakiweier men liki kan ki lim omui, ap wilian ir di; kom kotin koko sang wei kan, ap id katotoe ir ala.<l eID="gen678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen679"/>Pwe re sota kaloedier sap o ki ar kodlas, o pa arail sota katepa ong ir, pwe pali maun omui o lim omui, o marain en silang omui; pweki kom kotin kupura irail er.<l eID="gen679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen680"/>Pwe komui Kot ai Nanmarki, me inauki ong Iakop, en sauasa i.<l eID="gen680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen681"/>Komui, me se pan kawekila at imwintiti kan; ni mar omui me se pan tiakekidi me kin palian kit.<l eID="gen681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen682"/>Pwe i sota kin kaporoporeki ai kasik katieu, o ai kodlas sota kak dore ia la.<l eID="gen682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen683"/>Pwe komui me kin sauasa kit sang at imwintiti kan, o kom kin kanamenokala, me kailong kin kit.<l eID="gen683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen684"/>Ran karos se pan kapinga Kot, o se pan danke ong mar omui kokolata. Sela.<l eID="gen684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen685"/>Ari so, kom kotin likidmalie kin kit ala, pwe sen lisela, o komui sota iang at karis akan.<l eID="gen685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen686"/>Kom kotin mueid ong at imwintiti, ren paki kit wei, o me kailong kin kit, kin kulia sang at kapwa.<l eID="gen686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen687"/>Kom kotin mueid ong ir, ren kawe kit ala dueta sip oko, o kom kotin kamueit kit pasang nan pung en men liki kan.<l eID="gen687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen688"/>Kom netikila sapwilim omui kan ni pwai sued, a komui ap sota kapwapwa kilar.<l eID="gen688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen689"/>Kom kin kotin wiai ong kit, sen kankaurur ren men imp at, o lalaue o sarodi ren me kapil kit pena.<l eID="gen689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen690"/>Kom kotin wia kin kit karasepa eu ren men liki kan o aramas akan kin dueduälok kin kit.<l eID="gen690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen691"/>I kin saro nin ran karos o mas ai me dir en namenok,<l eID="gen691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen692"/>Ni ai rongerong aramas morsued o lalaue, o ni ai kilekilang ai imwintiti o me kin akdepuk kan.<l eID="gen692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen693"/>Mepukat karos lel dong kit er, ari so, se sota kak monokela komui, de wia dip ong sapwilim omui inau.<l eID="gen693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen694"/>Mongiong at sota pupwei sang komui, o se sota wuki wei sang al omui.<l eID="gen694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen695"/>A komui kawe kit alar ni wasan man sued, o kom kadupale kidi mot en mela.<l eID="gen695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen696"/>Ma se monokela mar en at Kol, o pokada pa at ong amen kot,<l eID="gen696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen697"/>Kot sota pan kotin diarada? Pwe a kotin mangi lol en mongiong at.<l eID="gen697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen698"/>Pwe kit kin kalokoloke kin komui ni ran karos, o kit rasong sip me pan kamela.<l eID="gen698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen699"/>Maing, kom kotida! Da me kom kotin saimokela? Kotin opada wasa, o der kasapoke kit ala kokolata!<l eID="gen699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen700"/>Da me kom kotin karirila silang omui, o kotin maliela at luet o at kalokolok?<l eID="gen700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen701"/>Pwe ngen it poridier ni pwel par; kaped it pas ong pwel.<l eID="gen701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen702"/>Kom kotida, sauasa kit, o dore kit ala pweki omui kalangan.<chapter eID="Ps.44"/> <l eID="gen702" level="1"/><lg eID="gen676"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: MONGIONG i kin wiada kaul kaselel apot; i pan kaule ki duen Nanmarki amen, lo i rasong pensil en sauninting koiok amen.<l eID="gen704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen705"/>Komui ta me kaselel sang aramas karos; meid kaselel silang omui; i me Kot kapai kin komui ta kokolata.<l eID="gen705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen706"/>Pira wong omui kodlas ni longelong omui, komui ol komad, o kapwata kin komui!<l eID="gen706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen707"/>Komui en pwaida ni omui kapwat. Kom kotiwei, pwen sauasa me melel, o me luet akan, pwen kolekol ong ir me pung. Lim omui maun ap pan wia dodok kapuriamui.<l eID="gen707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen708"/>Kanangan omui kasik katieu me kong — wei kan kin lodi ong komui —; re kin lel ong nan mongiong en imwintiti en nanmarki.<l eID="gen708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen709"/>Maing Kot, mol omui pan duedueta kokolata; o sokon en wei omui me sokon en pung apot.<l eID="gen709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen710"/>Kom kin pok ong me pung ap tataki tiak sued; i me Kot, omui Kot, keie kin komui le en kaperen mon omui warok kan.<l eID="gen710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen711"/>Omui likau kan kin pomauki mire, aloe, o kasia ni omui pedoi sang tanpas omui im elpenpain, komui kin polauleki kaul o arp.<l eID="gen711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen712"/>Sapwilim en Nanmarki seripein ko mi nan pung en toun tanpas omui; li Nanmarki a kotikot ni pali maun omui kapwateki kold en opir.<l eID="gen712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen713"/>Nai seripein koe rong, o kilang, o kapaikedi salong om, o monokela sap om o sau om akan.<l eID="gen713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen714"/>Nanmarki ap pan peren kida mom om kaselel; pwe i om Kaun, a koe en kaudoki ong i.<l eID="gen714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen715"/>Nain Tirus, me kapwapa re ’rail pan wado kisakis; o ngidingid re om.<l eID="gen715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen716"/>Sapwilim en Nanmarki seripein, me mi lole, meid kaselel ni mongiong i, a kapwateki likau kold.<l eID="gen716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen717"/>A pan pakaluala ren Nanmarki ni a likau lingan o a warok peinekap akan, me idauen i, kompoke pa, pan kalua dong komui.<l eID="gen717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen718"/>Re pan kalua irail ki peren o ngisingis, o re kin pedelong ong nan tanpas en Nanmarki.<l eID="gen718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen719"/>Noumui manakap akan pan wiliandi sam omui kan; i me kom pan kasapwiladang saupeidi en sap akan karos.<l eID="gen719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen720"/>I pan tamanda mar omui ni di kan karos; i me wei kan karos pan kapinga komui kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.45"/> <l eID="gen720" level="1"/><lg eID="gen703"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: KOT atail kaporopor o kele patail, o sauas patail ni atail apwal akan, me lel dong kitail.<l eID="gen722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen723"/>I me se sota pan masak, menda ma sappa pan sorela, o nana kan pan kirila nan warong en madau.<l eID="gen723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen724"/>Menda ma a iluk kan pan ongiongida o pudopudeda, o ma a kelail ong kawela nana kan. Sela.<l eID="gen724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen725"/>Pwe kanim en Kot pan pereperen a duedueta iangaki utun pil, me mi lole, wasa me tanpas saraui en me Lapalap o mia ia.<l eID="gen725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen726"/>Kot kotikot lole, i me a pan tengetengki kokolata; Kot pan kotin sauasa i nin soran.<l eID="gen726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen727"/>Men liki kan kin lingarangar o wei kan pan ola, sappa pan soredi, ma a pan kotin masani.<l eID="gen727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen728"/>Ieowa Sepaot kotin ieiang kitail; Kot en Iakop i pere patail. Sela.<l eID="gen728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen729"/>Komail kodo, kilang dodok lapalap en Ieowa, me kotin dodok kelail nin sappa,<l eID="gen729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen730"/>Me kotin kadukiedi mauin lel ni imwin sap karos o katip pasang kasik katieu, o kawela katieu, o karonga kila kisiniai war en mauin akan.<l eID="gen730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen731"/>Komail nenenla o asada, me Ngai ta Kot. I pan kawauwi pein Ngai ren men liki kan, I pan kalinganada nin sappa.<l eID="gen731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen732"/>Ieowa Sepaot kotin ieiang kitail; Kot en Iakop i pere patail. Sela.<chapter eID="Ps.46"/> <l eID="gen732" level="1"/><lg eID="gen721"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: KOMAIL kainok karos lopolop o kapinga Kot ki ngil kaperen!<l eID="gen734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen735"/>Pwe Ieowa me lapalap kaualap, a meid kalank; i Nanmarki lapalap nin sap akan karos.<l eID="gen735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen736"/>A kotin kaloedi ong kitail wei kan o aramas akan pan nä atail.<l eID="gen736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen737"/>A kotin piladang kitail atail soso, lingan en Iakop, me a kotin pok ong. Sela.<l eID="gen737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen738"/>Kot kotida ngisingis, o Ieowa ki ngil en koronete kelail.<l eID="gen738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen739"/>Kauli ong Kot psalm ko! Kaulki psalm ko! Kauli ong atail Nanmarki! Kakaul!<l eID="gen739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen740"/>Pwe Kot Nanmarki nan sap karos; komail kaul ki psalm ni lolekong.<l eID="gen740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen741"/>Kot Nanmarki en men liki kan; Kot kotikot pon mol a saraui.<l eID="gen741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen742"/>Saupeidi en wei kan pokon pena wiala wein Kot en Apraam; pwe pere en mauin nin sappa me sapwilim en Kot. A kotin lapalap melel.<chapter eID="Ps.47"/> <l eID="gen742" level="1"/><lg eID="gen733"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: IEOWA meid lapalap, o a indand mau melel nan kanim en atail Kot, pon sapwilim a dol saraui!<l eID="gen744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen745"/>Meid kaselel en dol Sion a uda, me sap karos kin peren kida; ni pali apong kanim en nanamarki lapalap mimi ia.<l eID="gen745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen746"/>Toun im kalaimun akan asa Kot, me i pere parail.<l eID="gen746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen747"/>Pwe kilang, nanmarki kan pokon pena, ap daulul wei.<l eID="gen747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen748"/>Irail puriamui kila ni ar kilanger mepukat; irail masapwekadar o tanger.<l eID="gen748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen749"/>Irail rerer, o re masak dueta li pan naitik amen.<l eID="gen749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen750"/>Kom kin kotin kawela sop en Tarsis ki ang en mas en lang.<l eID="gen750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen751"/>Duen atail rongadar, iduen kitail kin kilangada nan kanim en Ieowa Sepaot, nan kanim en atail Kot; Kot kin kolekol i kokolata. Sela.<l eID="gen751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen752"/>Maing Kot se kin tamatamanda omui kalangan nan sapwilim ar tanpas im en kaudok.<l eID="gen752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen753"/>Maing Kot duen mar omui iduen wau omui lel ni imwin sappa; pali maun omui me dir en pung.<l eID="gen753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen754"/>Dol en Sion en pereperen, o nain Iuda seripein ko en insenemauki omui kadeik kan.<l eID="gen754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen755"/>Komail kaidong kapil pena Sion, wadok im teng kan;<l eID="gen755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen756"/>Kilekilang mau a kel takai kan, o kasakasaui a im kalaimun akan, pwe komail en kak kasoia ong men mur akan,<l eID="gen756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen757"/>Me Kot men et, pan atail Kot ansau karos kokolata. A pan kotin kalua kitail kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.48"/> <l eID="gen757" level="1"/><lg eID="gen743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: Komail kainok kan karos rong o dedeki, komail toun sap karos,<l eID="gen759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen760"/>Ir karos, aramas o saupeidi, ir karos me kapwapwa o samama kan!<l eID="gen760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen761"/>Au ai pan kaparok duen lolekong, o mongiong i duen lamalam pung.<l eID="gen761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen762"/>I pan kapaike dong salong ai lepen masan, o i pan kasaleda me rir akan ni ngil en arp.<l eID="gen762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen763"/>Da me i en masak ni ran apwal akan, ma me sapung kan kapil ia pena,<l eID="gen763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen764"/>Me kin kaporoporeki ar dipisou o suaiki ar kapwa toto?<l eID="gen764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen765"/>Pwe sota me kak dorela ri a, de tomeki i ren Kot,<l eID="gen765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen766"/>(Pwe meid apwal, en dorela ngen ar; a sota pan pwaida kokolata).<l eID="gen766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen767"/>Pwen maur potopot o sota kilang sousou o.<l eID="gen767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen768"/>Pwe a kin kilang, me lolekong kan kin mela dueta me pweipwei o iakalar akan, o re pan mueid ong amen ar dipisou kan.<l eID="gen768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen769"/>I me re kin peren kida, ma im arail pan duedueta, o deu ’rail pan mimieta kokolata; o re konekon melel nin sappa.<l eID="gen769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen770"/>Ari so, aramas me konekon sota kak mimieta ni mepukat, pwe a pan kokowei dueta man amen.<l eID="gen770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen771"/>Iet ar wiawia pukat meid pweipwei; ari so, kadaudok ar kin kapinga ki au arail. Sela.<l eID="gen771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen772"/>Re wonon nan wasan mela dueta pwin sip; mela kin kamanga ir; a me lelapok kan pan kaun irail da madang, o mom ar pan soredi, o re pan doo sang deu ’rail, mimieta nan pweleko.<l eID="gen772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen773"/>A Kot pan kotin dorela ngen i sang nan mana en wasan mela, pwe a pan kotin sapwilimane kin ia. Sela!<l eID="gen773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen774"/>Koe der puriamuiki, ma amen pan kapwapwala, o ma lingan en im a pan laudala.<l eID="gen774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen775"/>Pwe a sota pan wala meakot ni a pan mela, o a lingan sota pan idauenla i.<l eID="gen775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen776"/>A kin insenemau kila peren en maur kaselel wet, o aramas kin kapinga ir, me kin apapwali pein ir eta ni maur et.<l eID="gen776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen777"/>A pan idauen la sam a kan, ap solar kilang marain kokolata.<l eID="gen777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen778"/>Ari, ma aramas amen indand mau, ap sota a lamalam, a pan kokowei dueta man amen.<chapter eID="Ps.49"/> <l eID="gen778" level="1"/><lg eID="gen758"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: KOT Ieowa manaman masanier o molipedo sappa sang ni tapin katipin lel ni a kiridi.<l eID="gen780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen781"/>Lingan en Kot tapida sang Sion.<l eID="gen781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen782"/>Atail Kot kotido, o a sota kin kotin sapaimokit. Kisiniai kelail kin tiong mo a, o melimel laud kin mi impa.<l eID="gen782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen783"/>A kotin molipe lang o sappa, pwen kapungala sapwilim a aramas akan!<l eID="gen783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen784"/>Komail kapokon pena nai lelapok kan, me wiadar ar inau ong ia ni ansau en mairong!<l eID="gen784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen785"/>Nanlang pan kasaleda a pung; pwe Kot kin kotin kadeikada. Sela.<l eID="gen785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen786"/>Komail nai aramas akan rong, I pan padaki ong komail. Israel, I pan kaparoki ong komail: Ngai Kot, om Kot.<l eID="gen786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen787"/>I sota pan kaloke uk pweki om mairong, pwe om mairong isis kin wiaui ong ia ansau karos.<l eID="gen787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen788"/>Ari so, I sota pan ale sang komail kau ol de kut o sip ol sang nan im omail.<l eID="gen788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen789"/>Pwe man en nan wel karos me ai o pil man akan, me mimi pon nana kid pak toto.<l eID="gen789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen790"/>I asa manpir en nana karos o song en man karos, me mi nan sap, kin mi re i.<l eID="gen790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen791"/>Ma I men mangadar, I sota pan indang uk, pwe sappa me ai o audepa karos.<l eID="gen791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen792"/>Da, koe lamelame, me I kin inong iong uduk en kau ol, de I men nim ntan kut ol?<l eID="gen792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen793"/>Mairongki danke ong Kot o kapungalang me Lapalap o om inau.<l eID="gen793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen794"/>Likwir dong ia ni om insensued, I ap pan dore uk ala, a koe pan kapinga ia.<l eID="gen794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen795"/>A Kot kotin masani ong me sapung o: Da me koe kaparok duen ai kusoned akan, o lokaia kida au om duen ai inau,<l eID="gen795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen796"/>Pwe koe kin tateki tiak pung o mamaleki ai kusoned akan?<l eID="gen796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen797"/>Ma koe pan kilang lipirap amen, koe kin iang i, o koe kin waroki ong me kamal akan.<l eID="gen797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen798"/>Au om kin lokaia kiwei me sued o lo om me likam.<l eID="gen798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen799"/>Koe kin wonon o lokaia likam duen ri om; o nain in om putak koe kin karaune mal.<l eID="gen799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen800"/>Koe wiada mepukat, a ngai kin nenenla; koe ap kiki ong, me ngai dueta koe. A I pan kapung ong uk o kasaleda mon mas om.<l eID="gen800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen801"/>Komail me mamaleki Kot, en asa, I pan kasor komail la o sota sauas pamail pan mia.<l eID="gen801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen802"/>Me kin mairongki danke, kin kapinga ia; o i al o, me I pan kasale ong i duen maur en Kot.<chapter eID="Ps.50"/> <l eID="gen802" level="1"/><lg eID="gen779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin maki ong ia duen omui kalangan, o kotin lapwada dip ai duen ar kalangan lapalap.<l eID="gen804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen805"/>Kom kotin widen ia sang ai wiawia sapung, o kotin kamakel ia da sang ni dip ai.<l eID="gen805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen806"/>Pwe i asa duen ai wiadar me sued, o dip ai me sansal ong ia ansau karos.<l eID="gen806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen807"/>Ong komui eta me i wiai dip ong, o wiadar sapung mon silang omui, pwe komui me pung eta ni omui masan akan, o komui makelekel eta ni omui pan kadeikada.<l eID="gen807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen808"/>Kotin masani, me i ipwidier ni sapung, o in ai ape kin ia dar ni mang en dip.<l eID="gen808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen809"/>Kotin masani, kom kin kotin mauki melel, me mi wasa rir; kom kin kasale ong ia lolekong rir.<l eID="gen809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen810"/>Kom kotin kamakele kin ia isop, pwe i en minla, widen ia, pwe i en puetepueteta sno.<l eID="gen810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen811"/>Kom kotiki ong ia peren o popol, pwe kokon ai kan, me kom kotin kawelar, en insenemaula.<l eID="gen811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen812"/>Kom kotin sopwei sang dip ai kan, o kotin lapwada ai sapung karos.<l eID="gen812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen813"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin wiai ong ia mongiong makelekel, o kotin kawiliakapada ngen i.<l eID="gen813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen814"/>Kom der kase ia la sang mon silang omui o der kotiki sang ia ar Ngen saraui.<l eID="gen814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen815"/>Kom kotin pur ong kamait ia la ki omui sauasa ia, o kotiki ong ia ngen en kaperen.<l eID="gen815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen816"/>I pan padaki ong me katiwo kan duen al omui kan, pwe me dipan akan en wuki ong komui.<l eID="gen816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen817"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin dore ia la sang dip en nta, pwe komui Kot ai saunkamaur, pwe lo i en kapinga omui pung.<l eID="gen817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen818"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kasar pasang kilen au ai, pwe au ai en kapikapinga komui.<l eID="gen818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen819"/>Pwe kom sota kotin mauki mairong kamela — a ma iei, i pan wiada — o mairong isis kom sota kotin kupura.<l eID="gen819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen820"/>A iet mairong, me Kot kin kotin kupura: Ngen olar, o mongiong insensuedalar, o karakarak, iei me komui Maing Kot sota pan kotin mamaleki.<l eID="gen820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen821"/>Kom kotin sauasa Sion ki omui kalangan, kotin kauada kel en Ierusalem.<l eID="gen821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen822"/>Komui ap pan kupura mairong pung, mairong isis o mairong unsok. I ansau me kau ol pan iseda pon sapwilim omui pei saraui.<chapter eID="Ps.51"/> <l eID="gen822" level="1"/><lg eID="gen803"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: KOE ol weit, da me koe suaikeki me sued, pwe kalangan en Ieowa kin duedueta ni ran karos.<l eID="gen824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen825"/>Lo om inong iong me sued, o kin rasong naip kong pot, ni a wia likam.<l eID="gen825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen826"/>Koe kin mauki lokaia sued sang me mau, o lokaia likam sang me pung. Sela.<l eID="gen826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen827"/>Koe kin men lokaiaki me sued lo om likam.<l eID="gen827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen828"/>I me Kot pil pan kawe uk ala, o lepuk uk pasang, o waik uk sang nan im om, o koko uk sang nan sap en me maur akan. Sela.<l eID="gen828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen829"/>A me pung kan pan kilang o masapwekada, o re pan kaurureki i:<l eID="gen829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen830"/>Kilang, iei ol o, me sota kaporoporeki Ieowa, pwe a keleki a dipisou toto o a kelail ong a wiada me sued.<l eID="gen830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen831"/>A ngai dueta tuka oliwe pot nan tanpas en Kot, i kaporoporeki kalangan en Kot kokolata.<l eID="gen831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen832"/>I pan kapinga komui kokolata, pwe kom kak kotin wiada; i pan kapinga mar omui, pwe a lingan ren sapwilim omui lelapok kan.<chapter eID="Ps.52"/> <l eID="gen832" level="1"/><lg eID="gen823"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: ME pweipwei kan kin indinda nan mongiong arail: Sota Kot. Arail tiak meid sued. Arail sapung kan sakanekan. Sota amen mia, me kin wia me mau.<l eID="gen834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen835"/>Ieowa kin irerong aramas akan sang nanlang, pwen masani, ma amen mia, me lolekong o rapaki Kot.<l eID="gen835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen836"/>A ir karos suedalar, o karos sapungalar, sota me kin wiada me mau, sota amen.<l eID="gen836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen837"/>Ir karos me kin wiada me sued, sota arail lolekong, irail, me kin namala nai aramas akan rasong prot, a re sota kin likwir ong Kot.<l eID="gen837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen838"/>Rap masak ni sota karepa, pwe Kot kotin kamueit pasanger kokon en ir, me kin kapil uk pena. Kom kotin kanamenok ir alar, pwe Kot kotin kase ir ala.<l eID="gen838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen839"/>O i men, sauas pan Israel en kodo sang nan Sion, o Kot en kotin lapwada sapwilim a salidi kan! I me Iakop pan insen mauki o Israel pan pereperenki.<chapter eID="Ps.53"/> <l eID="gen839" level="1"/><lg eID="gen833"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin sauasa ia ki mar omui, o kotin kasansaleda ai pung ki omui manaman.<l eID="gen841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen842"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o kotin mangi lokaia en au i.<l eID="gen842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen843"/>Pwe men wai kai palian ia, o me weit akan masamasan maur i, o re sota weweid mon Kot. Sela.<l eID="gen843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen844"/>Kilang, Kot sauas pa i, Ieowa kin kolekol ngen i.<l eID="gen844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen845"/>A pan kotin depuk ong ai imwintiti kan ar me sued. Kom kotin kawe ir ala ki omui melel.<l eID="gen845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen846"/>I ap pan wiai ong komui mairong kaperen, o kapinga mar omui, pwe a me mau.<l eID="gen846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen847"/>Pwe a kotin dore ia la sang nan ai apwal akan karos, o mas ai peren kidar ai imwintiti kan.<chapter eID="Ps.54"/> <l eID="gen847" level="1"/><lg eID="gen840"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o kom der rirwei sang mon ai ngidingid.<l eID="gen849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen850"/>Kom kotin mangi ia o kotin sapeng ia. Pwe i kin sansalong sili o sangesangki,<l eID="gen850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen851"/>Pwe ngil en ai imwintiti kin kainsensued ia o me doo sang Kot akan kin pakipaki ia; pwe re kin men wia sued ong ia, o re kin kailong kin ia.<l eID="gen851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen852"/>Mongiong i masapwekada nan kaped i, o masak en mela lel ong ia.<l eID="gen852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen853"/>Masak o rerer lel dong ia; wapon kadupal ia di.<l eID="gen853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen854"/>I ap indada: O ma pa i kat dueta pa en muroi, pwen pirwei o mi ekis wasa.<l eID="gen854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen855"/>I ap pan pirla wasa doo, o kaukauson sap tan. Sela.<l eID="gen855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen856"/>I pan madanglang wasan moleilei mon melimel o katau.<l eID="gen856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen857"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kawuk pasang lo arail, o kotin kasore ir ala, pwe i kilekilang, me toun kanim o kin weit o akamai pena.<l eID="gen857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen858"/>Mepukat kin wiaui ni ran o ni pong pon arail kel takai, o a dir en apwal o dodok kan.<l eID="gen858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen859"/>Me sued akan kin kaunda kanim o; o tou a kan sota kin muei sang likam o kotaue.<l eID="gen859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen860"/>Ma ai imwintiti pan wia sued ong ia, i sota pan insenoki, o ma me kailong kin ia pan pei ong ia, i pan ruki sang mo a.<l eID="gen860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen861"/>A koe, ai warok, o kompole pa i o kis ai.<l eID="gen861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen862"/>Pwe kitail minimin penaer nan pung atail. Kitail wiaki eu nan pung en pokon nan tanpas en Kot.<l eID="gen862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen863"/>Mela en madang lel wong irail, pwe ren lokidokila nan wasan mela ni ar memaur; pwe im arail o lol arail me dir en morsued.<l eID="gen863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen864"/>A i pan likwir ong Kot, o Ieowa pan kotin sauasa ia.<l eID="gen864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen865"/>Nin sautik, o ni mansang, o nin sauas i pan sangesang o weriwer, a ap pan kotin mangi ngil ai.<l eID="gen865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen866"/>A pan kotin dorela ngen i sang ren me men palian ia, o pan kotin kamoleilei ia; pwe ir me toto, me u ong ia.<l eID="gen866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen867"/>Kot pan kotin ereki o kanamenok ir ala, pwe a kotikot eta sang tapin kaua. Sela. Pwe re sota pan wukila, o re sota masak Kot.<l eID="gen867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen868"/>A saikidi sapwilim a popol akan, o a kawela a inau.<l eID="gen868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen869"/>Au a me kitentel sang wi, ap lamelame duen mauin, a lokaia me muterok sang le, ap rasong kodlas kong, me onopa dang pei.<l eID="gen869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen870"/>Mueid ong Ieowa, me koe inong iong, a pan apwali uk ada, a sota pan kotin mueid ong me pung kan en wukiwuk sili.<l eID="gen870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen871"/>Maing Kot, kom pan kotin kase ir long ong nan por lol en me sued o; me inong iong nta o likam kan sota pan lel ong apali en maur arail. A i pan kaporoporeki komui.<chapter eID="Ps.55"/> <l eID="gen871" level="1"/><lg eID="gen848"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin maki ong ia, pwe aramas akan ngiringir ong ia; re kin peipei o kamasak ia ni ran karos.<l eID="gen873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen874"/>Ai imwintiti kan kin ngiringir nin ran karos, pwe me toto pei ong ia ni ar aklapalap.<l eID="gen874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen875"/>Ni ai masak i kin kaporoporeki komui.<l eID="gen875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen876"/>I pan kapinga masan en Kot, i pan kaporoporeki Kot o pan sota masak, da me aramas kak wiai ong ia?<l eID="gen876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen877"/>Ran karos re kin kawukila ai lokaia, re kin madamadauata, duen ar pan kawe ia la.<l eID="gen877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen878"/>Re pokon pena, o masamasan, o kanakanai ong kaimwin nä i kat, duen ar pan kak kame ia la.<l eID="gen878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen879"/>Iaduen, re pan kak pitila ni ar morsuet? Maing Kot, kom kotin kasapokala song en aramas due met,<l eID="gen879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen880"/>Kom kotin wadok pena al en ai pitilar akan, o kotin kolekol pena pil en mas ai nan sapwilim omui dal o. Pwe kaidin karos kileledier nan sapwilim omui puk o?<l eID="gen880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen881"/>Ai imwintiti kan ap pan sapale wei ni ran o me i pan likelikwir; Iet me i asa, me Kot sauas pa i.<l eID="gen881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen882"/>I pan kapinga masan en Kot; i pan kapinga masan en Ieowa.<l eID="gen882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen883"/>I kaporoporeki Kot, ap sota masak, pwe da me aramas akan pan kak wiai ong ia?<l eID="gen883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen884"/>Maing Kot, i inauki ong komui, me i pan mairongki danke ong komui;<l eID="gen884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen885"/>Pwe kom kotin dorelar ngen i sang mela o nä, i kat sang ai krisidi, pwe i en weweid mon silang en Kot nan marain en me maur akan.<chapter eID="Ps.56"/> <l eID="gen885" level="1"/><lg eID="gen872"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin maki ong ia, maki ong ia! Pwe ngen i kin kaporoporeki komui, o pan mot en lim omui i wasan ai maur, lao ansau apwal daulier.<l eID="gen887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen888"/>I likwir ong Kot, me lapalapia, ong Kot, me kotin kaimwisokala ai kankangeranger.<l eID="gen888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen889"/>A kotin poronedo sang nanlang sauas pa i ong me kanamenok ia, o me kin ngiringir ong ia. Sela. Kot pan kotin kadarado a kalangan o melel.<l eID="gen889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen890"/>Ngen i mi nan pung en laien akan, aramas rasong umpul en kisiniai; ngi arail rasong katieu o kanangan kasik katieu, o lo arail rasong kodlas kong o.<l eID="gen890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen891"/>Maing Kot, kom kotida ileila sang lang, o wau omui nan sappa karos.<l eID="gen891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen892"/>Irail insarai ia nan al ai kan; re kin katoutoui ngen i; re weirada mo i por eu, ap pein pupedi ong lole. Sela.<l eID="gen892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen893"/>Mongiong i insenemaular, Maing Kot, ngen i onoper ong kaul o kaping.<l eID="gen893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen894"/>Ngen i pirida! Kaul o arp pirida! I pan pirida nin soran.<l eID="gen894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen895"/>Ieowa, i men danke ong komui nan wei kan; i pan kauli ong komui nan pung en aramas akan.<l eID="gen895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen896"/>Pwe omui kalangan me laud dueta nanlang, o omui melel dueta tapok kan.<l eID="gen896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen897"/>Maing Kot, kom kotida ileila sang lang, o wau omui lingan nan sappa karos.<chapter eID="Ps.57"/> <l eID="gen897" level="1"/><lg eID="gen886"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: IADUEN komail lotong, pwe komail sota men lokaia me pung, o komail sota men kapung nin tiak inen, komail aramas akan?<l eID="gen899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen900"/>Melel, komail kin wia me sapung nan mongiong o, o nan sap o komail kin kelail ong wiada me sued.<l eID="gen900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen901"/>Me doo sang Kot akan me sapung sang pon kapan in ar akan; me likam kan kin sansalong sili sang nan kaped en in ar akan.<l eID="gen901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen902"/>Ar lingarangar rasong lingarangar en serpent amen, rasong serpent salongepon, me penala salong a,<l eID="gen902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen903"/>Pwen der rong ngil en saunwun ani o kati ani men, me kadek wunani.<l eID="gen903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen904"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin katip pasang ngi nan au arail; Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kawela ngi en laien pulepul akan.<l eID="gen904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen905"/>Kom kotin kawe ir ala dueta pil me kin pwilipwili wei. Ma a kaonopada a kanangan kasik katieu, re kin tip pasang.<l eID="gen905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen906"/>Re pan soredi dueta kamadel amen kin mong pena; re sota pan kilang katipin dueta seri amen, me sota dar pungi.<l eID="gen906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen907"/>Mon omail ainpot pan pam tui, a pan kotin sipet wei ni a ongiong.<l eID="gen907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen908"/>Me pung o pan peren kida a lao kilang depuk ong ir, o a pan widen nä a nan ntan me doo sang Kot o.<l eID="gen908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen909"/>Aramas akan ap pan inda: Me pung kan pan tungole kating; pwe Kot eta saunkadeik nin sappa.<chapter eID="Ps.58"/> <l eID="gen909" level="1"/><lg eID="gen898"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: AI Kot, kom kotin dore ia la sang ai imwintiti kan, o kotin pera sang ia mon me palian ia.<l eID="gen911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen912"/>Dore ia la sang me morsued akan, o kotin sauasa ia sang me inong iong nta.<l eID="gen912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen913"/>Irail kin masamasan maur i, me kelail akan pokon pena ong ia, a sota dip ai, o sota me sued kot, me i wiadar, Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen914"/>Irail tang pena o kaonopada, a sota dip ai. Kom kotin opada wasa, o kotin ieiang ia, o irerong mepukat.<l eID="gen914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen915"/>Maing Ieowa, Kot Sepaot, Kot en Israel, kotin opada wasa, o kotin kadeikada men liki kan karos. Kom der maki ong amen ir, me kin wia dip ni ar aklapalap. Sela.<l eID="gen915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen916"/>Nin sautik re kin puredo ngungung dueta kidi kan, o re kin tangatang sili nan kanim o.<l eID="gen916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen917"/>Kom kotin mangi, re kin lidelidu mongin; kodlas kan mi pan kilin au arail: Is me pan rong?<l eID="gen917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen918"/>A komui, Maing Ieowa, pan kotin kiparamat kin irail, o kom pan kotin kalis irail la.<l eID="gen918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen919"/>Kele pa i, i pan rukila re omui. Pwe Kot pere pa i.<l eID="gen919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen920"/>Kot kin kotin kasale ong ia melel a kalangan; Kot kin kotin wiai ong ia, i en peren kida ai imwintiti.<l eID="gen920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen921"/>Kom der kotin kame ir ala, pwe nai aramas akan pan monokela, a kotin kamueit ir pasang ki omui mana, Ieowa pere pat, kasapoke ir ala.<l eID="gen921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen922"/>Dip eta lokaia en kilin au arail; i me re pan lokidi ni ar aklapalap; pwe re kin lokaia lalaue o likam eta.<l eID="gen922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen923"/>Kom kotin kawe ir ala o der maki ong ir; kawe ir ala, pwe ren solar meakot, ap asa, me Kot kotin kaunda kadaudok en Iakop o sap karos. Sela.<l eID="gen923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen924"/>Nin sautik re kin puredo ngungung dueta kidi kan, o re kin tangatang sili nan kanim o.<l eID="gen924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen925"/>Re kin tangatang sili rapaki kan ar manga, ap lipaned, ma re sota pan medila.<l eID="gen925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen926"/>A i pan kauleki duen omui manaman, o ni mansang i pan kapinga omui kalangan, pwe komui pere pa i o ai paip ni ran en ai apwal.<l eID="gen926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
