verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen927"/>I pan kauli ong komui ai paip, pwe Kot pere pa i o ai Kot kalangan.<chapter eID="Ps.59"/> <l eID="gen927" level="1"/><lg eID="gen910"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin kase kit alar, o kamueit kit pasanger ni omui ongiong, kom kotin pur ong kamait kit ala.<l eID="gen929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen930"/>Kom kotin kamokitadar sap o, o kawelar i, kom kotin kamauiala wasa ola kan, pwe a kin mokimokid.<l eID="gen930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen931"/>Pwe kom kotiki onger sapwilim omui kan katoutou parail. Kom kotiki ong kit er wain men kapweipwei kit alar.<l eID="gen931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen932"/>A kilel eu, me kom kotiki ong irail er, me masak komui, i me irail kauadar, ap kelail kidar. Sela.<l eID="gen932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen933"/>Pwe kompoke pamui kan en saladokala; kom kotin sauasa ki pali maun ar o kotin ereki kit.<l eID="gen933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen934"/>Kot kotin masanier nan sapwilim a mol saraui, i me i peren kida; i pan nek pasang Sikem o sosong sap Sukot.<l eID="gen934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen935"/>Kilead o Manase iei sap we; ngai kin kaunda Epraim; a Iuda iei ai sokon;<l eID="gen935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen936"/>Moap iei ai dal en dudu; i kin tiakedi Edom; Pilista kin ngisingis ong ia.<l eID="gen936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen937"/>Is me pan kalua ia nan kanim tengeteng eu? Is me pan iang ia lel Edom?<l eID="gen937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen938"/>Kaidin komui ai Kot? Komui me kase kit alar o sota iang at karis akan.<l eID="gen938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen939"/>Kom kotin sauasa kit ni at apwal akan, pwe en aramas ar sauase sota katepa.<l eID="gen939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen940"/>Iangaki at Kot kit pan kapwaiada dodok apwal akan. A pan kotin tiakedi at imwintiti kan.<chapter eID="Ps.60"/> <l eID="gen940" level="1"/><lg eID="gen928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotin ereki ai likelikwir o kotin mangi ai kapakap!<l eID="gen942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen943"/>Sang ni imwin sappa i pan likwir wong komui, ma mongiong i masakada, kom pan kotin kalua ia pon paip ileile eu.<l eID="gen943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen944"/>Pwe komui kapore pa i o imateng kelail ong ai imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen945"/>Kom kotin mueid ong ia, i en mimieta nan sapwilim tanpas omui kokolata, o diar wasan kamaur pan lim omui kan. Sela.<l eID="gen945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen946"/>Pwe komui Kot mangi duen ai inau; kom kin kotiki ong ia er soso en ir, me masak mar omui.<l eID="gen946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen947"/>Komui en kotiki ong nanmarki maur warai, pwe a saunpar akan en totola kokolata,<l eID="gen947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen948"/>Pwe a en mimieta mon Kot kokolata; kom kotin kasale ong i kalangan o melel, me pan sinsila i.<l eID="gen948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen949"/>I ap pan kauli ong mar omui kokolata, pwe i en kapwaiada ai inau kan ni ran karos.<chapter eID="Ps.61"/> <l eID="gen949" level="1"/><lg eID="gen941"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: NGEN i moleileilar ren Kot, me kotin sauasa ia.<l eID="gen951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen952"/>Pwe i eta ai paip, o sauas pa i, o pere pa i, pwe i en sota luetala kokolata.<l eID="gen952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen953"/>Arai da komail kin masamasan ol ta men, pwen kamela, me rasong did pangpangla o kel me pual pasanger?<l eID="gen953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen954"/>Re kin madamadaua duen ar pan kak kapupedi i, re kadek likam, re kin lokaia kaselel, a nan mongiong arail re kin lalaue. Sela.<l eID="gen954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen955"/>Ngen i, kaporoporeki Kot, pwe i kapore pa i.<l eID="gen955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen956"/>I eta ai paip o sauas pa i, o pere pa i, pwe i ender pupedi.<l eID="gen956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen957"/>Ai maur mi ren Kot, o ai lingan, o ai paip, o ai kel; i kaporoporeki Kot.<l eID="gen957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen958"/>Komail aramas akan karos kaporoporeki i ansau karos; kasansale ong i mongiong omail, Kot kapore patail. Sela.<l eID="gen958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen959"/>A aramas akan sota meakot, o me lapalap akan pil kin sapungala. Ni men tenok re kin kokoda, menda ma irail me toto.<l eID="gen959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen960"/>Komail der keleki omail dipisou sapung o der kaporoporeki me komail kuliadar. Ma komail pan kapwapwala, komail der kasampwaleki!<l eID="gen960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen961"/>Kot kotikidar masan eu, me i ronger akai ansau, iet: Kot eta me manaman.<l eID="gen961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen962"/>Komui Maing me kalangan o komui kin pwain ong amen amen duen a wiawia kan.<chapter eID="Ps.62"/> <l eID="gen962" level="1"/><lg eID="gen950"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: Kot komui ai Kot, nin soran i kin piridang komui. Ngen i kin inong iong komui. Pali war ai kin inong iong komui nan sap madekong o mongedi, wasa me sota pil mi ia.<l eID="gen964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen965"/>I wasa i kin tamanda komui nan sapwilim omui tanpas im saraui, pwe i men kilang omui manaman o lingan.<l eID="gen965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen966"/>Pwe omui kalangan mau sang maur; kil en au ai kin kapinga komui.<l eID="gen966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen967"/>I wasa i inong iong kapinga komui arain ai maur, o men pokada pa i kat ni mar omui.<l eID="gen967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen968"/>I me pan kaperen pan ngen i o ai popol, ma i pan kak kapinga komui ki au ai kaperen.<l eID="gen968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen969"/>Ni ai kin wendi pon los, i kin madamadaua duen komui, o ni ai pirida, i kin lokelokaia duen komui.<l eID="gen969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen970"/>Pwe komui sauas pa i, o pan mot en lim omui kan i kin ngisingis.<l eID="gen970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen971"/>Ngen i kin tengidi ong komui; lim omui pali maun kin apapwali ia.<l eID="gen971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen972"/>A irail me masamasan ia, pwen saik ia di, pan lokidokila pan sappa.<l eID="gen972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen973"/>Re pan pupedi ong nan kodlas, o kidi en wel pan kang ir ala;<l eID="gen973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen974"/>A nanmarki pan peren kida Kot. Me kin kaula ong i, pan pwaida, pwe au en me likam akan pan pena pinla.<chapter eID="Ps.63"/> <l eID="gen974" level="1"/><lg eID="gen963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kotin ereki ngil ai ni ai insensued. Kom kotin sinsila maur i mon ai imwintiti weit.<l eID="gen976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen977"/>Kom kotin karuki ia la sang mon pokon en me sued akan, mon pwin en me wia sapung kan.<l eID="gen977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen978"/>Me kin ada lo ’rail dueta kodlas pot, o me kaonopada ar kasik katieu, iei ar lokaia sued,<l eID="gen978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen979"/>Pwen rir kasikiedi me lelapok o; madang re pan kasikiedi i, o sota insenoki.<l eID="gen979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen980"/>Irail me weit ni ar tiak sued, o re kin inda, duen ar pan insar, o re kin inda: Is me pan kak kilang?<l eID="gen980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen981"/>Irail kin madamadaua duen me sued. Kitail kapwaiadar, karos kileledier. Mongiong en aramas me widing o meid koiok ni morsued.<l eID="gen981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen982"/>A Kot pan kotin kasik ir edi madang, pwen kamadak ong ir.<l eID="gen982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen983"/>Pein lo arail pan kapup ir edi, o karos, me pan kilang, pan kaurureki.<l eID="gen983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen984"/>O aramas karos pan masak o inda: Mepukat Kot kotin wiadar. O re pan asa, me i sapwilim a dodok.<l eID="gen984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen985"/>Me pung o pan perenki Ieowa, o pan liki i, o me lelapok kan karos pan pereperen.<chapter eID="Ps.64"/> <l eID="gen985" level="1"/><lg eID="gen975"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, se kin auiaui o kapinga komui nan Sion, o se kin kapwaiada at inau ong komui.<l eID="gen987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen988"/>Komui kotin ereki at kapakap, pwe i me aramas karos pan pwara wong komui.<l eID="gen988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen989"/>Dip at kin katoutoui kit kaualap. Kom kotin maki ong kit dip at akan.<l eID="gen989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen990"/>Meid pai, me kom kotin pilada o mueid ong, en pwarala re omui, pwen kauson nan sapwilim omui kel; kit pan tungetungole o medikila dipisou en tanpas omui, sapwilim omui im en kaudok saraui.<l eID="gen990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen991"/>Kom kotin mangi kit duen omui pung kapuriamui, Kot, at saunkamaur, komui me kapore pan meakaros nin sappa, o me mi wasa doo ni kailan madau;<l eID="gen991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen992"/>Me kotin pasonedier nana kan, pwen tengeteng ni a kelail, i me audeki manaman.<l eID="gen992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen993"/>Komui katukiedi ngirsok en madau, ngirsok en a iluk kan, o morongarong en aramas akan.<l eID="gen993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen994"/>Me kauson ni imwin sappa, kin masakada omui kilel akan; komui kin kaperenda me kauson ni pali mas o ni pali apong.<l eID="gen994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen995"/>Kom kin kotin kupura sappa o kawusokesok o kakepwapwala i melel. Parer en Kot me dir en pil kaualap. Kom kin kotin sauasa ar wantuka kan, iduen omui kotin kapaiada sap o.<l eID="gen995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen996"/>Kom kin kotin kapileda ar sap akan o kawusokesok ar mad akan o kamuterok kila katau o kapaiada ar tuka kan.<l eID="gen996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen997"/>Kom kotin kapwada kidar saunpar omui kalangan; o lip en aluwilu ar me dir en kamau kan.<l eID="gen997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen998"/>Mos en nan sap tan pil pwaida mau, o dol akan kin pereperen.<l eID="gen998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen999"/>O mal akan me dir en pwin sip, o sap me rokeki korn, me mau ong ngisingis o kakaul.<chapter eID="Ps.65"/> <l eID="gen999" level="1"/><lg eID="gen986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: NGISINGIS ong Ieowa nan sap karos!<l eID="gen1001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1002"/>Kauleki lingan en mar a; kapikapinga i melel!<l eID="gen1002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1003"/>Komail potoan ong Kot: Meid kapuriamui sapwilim omui dodok kan! Sapwilim omui imwintiti kapinga komui pweki omui manaman.<l eID="gen1003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1004"/>Sap karos en kaudok ong komui o kapinga komui o kauleki ong mar omui. Sela.<l eID="gen1004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1005"/>Komail kodo, kilang dodok en Kot, pwe a wiawia kan me kapuriamui ren aramas akan.<l eID="gen1005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1006"/>A kotin kawukila madau ong sap madakong, pwe aramas en kak alu pon pil o, i wasa se peren kidar kaualap.<l eID="gen1006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1007"/>A kotin kakaunda ni a manaman kokolata; silang i kin irerong wei kan. Me kangudi kan sota kak pwaida. Sela.<l eID="gen1007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1008"/>Komail wei kan kapinga atail Kot, o komail kalaudela ngil omail, pwen lel ong wasa doo.<l eID="gen1008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1009"/>Me kotin kolekol ong kitail maur atail, o sota mueid ong, nä atail en krisedi.<l eID="gen1009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1010"/>Pwe komui Kot me kotin kasongesong kit o kamakelekel kit er, dueta silper kin kamakelekelada.<l eID="gen1010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1011"/>Kom kotin mueid ong, sen lodi ni insar o, kom katoutou kin kit men katoutou eu.<l eID="gen1011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1012"/>Kom kotin mueid ong aramas kai, en tiakedi pon mong at; kit lel ong kisiniai o pil; a kom kotin kapiti sang kit o kakele kit adar.<l eID="gen1012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1013"/>I me i pan pedekilong ong nan tanpas omui, pwen mairong isis, o i pan kapwaiada ai inau ong komui,<l eID="gen1013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1014"/>Duen kil en au ai inaukidar, o duen au ai inda ni ai ansau apwal:<l eID="gen1014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1015"/>I pan mairong isis ong komui sip wi kan iangaki adiniai en sip ol, i pan mairongki kau iangaki sip o kut ol akan. Sela.<l eID="gen1015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1016"/>Komail karos, me masak Kot, kodo re i, i pan kasoi ong komail, duen me a kotin wiai ong ngen i.<l eID="gen1016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1017"/>I likwirki ong i au ai o i kapingaki i lo i.<l eID="gen1017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1018"/>Ma i pan lamelame nan mongiong i, me i pan wiada me sued, Ieowa ap sota pan mangi ia;<l eID="gen1018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1019"/>A Kot kotin ereki ai kapakap, o a kotin mangier ai ngidingid.<l eID="gen1019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1020"/>Kapinga ong Kot, me sota kotin mamaleki ai kapakap, o a sota kotiki wei sang ia a kalangan.<chapter eID="Ps.66"/> <l eID="gen1020" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1000"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: KOT en kotin maki ong kit, o kotin kapaia kin kit. A kotin kamaraine kin kit, silang i. Sela.<l eID="gen1022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1023"/>Pwe sapwilim a al akan me sansaleda nin sappa o ren men liki kan a maur.<l eID="gen1023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1024"/>Maing Kot, wei kan pan kapinga komui, wei kan karos pan kapinga komui.<l eID="gen1024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1025"/>Wei kan pan peren kida o ngisingis, pwe kom kin kotin kapung ong wei kan ni tiak pung, o kom kotin kaunda aramas akan nin sappa. Sela.<l eID="gen1025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1026"/>Maing Kot, wei kan pan kapinga komui, wei kan karos pan kapinga komui.<l eID="gen1026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1027"/>Sap o kin kapwaiada a tuka kan. Kot pan kotin kapai kit ada, at Kot.<l eID="gen1027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1028"/>Kot pan kotin kapai kit ada, o toun sappa karos pan masak i!<chapter eID="Ps.67"/> <l eID="gen1028" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1021"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: KOT en kotida, pwe a imwintiti en kamueit pasang, o me kailongki i, en tang wei.<l eID="gen1030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1031"/>Kom kotin paki irail wei dueta adiniai, dueta kris kin pei pasang nan kisiniai, iduen me doo sang Kot akan en soredi.<l eID="gen1031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1032"/>A me pung kan en pereperen o popol mon silang en Kot o ren pereperen melel.<l eID="gen1032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1033"/>Kauli ong Kot, kauli ong mar a! Kaonopada al o ong i, me kotiwei nan sap tan, a maraneki Ieowa — komail perenki i!<l eID="gen1033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1034"/>Pwe i Sam en me sapoupou kan o saunkapung en li odi kan. I Kot nan sapwilim a tanpas saraui.<l eID="gen1034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1035"/>Kot me kotin kadire kila seri ko im en me kin kelep, me kin lapwada me salidi kan, pwen pwaida o pereperen a me katiwo kan pan mimieta nan wasan lek.<l eID="gen1035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1036"/>Maing Kot, ni ansau kom kotiwei mon sapwilim omui aramas akan, ni omui kotiwei nan sap tan! Sela.<l eID="gen1036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1037"/>I ansau sap o rerer, o audepan lang kan moredier mon silang en Kot, nana Sinai mon silang en Kot en Israel.<l eID="gen1037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1038"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin kamoredier katau mau, o kom kotin kamauradar sapwilim omui soso, me mongedier,<l eID="gen1038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1039"/>Pwe sapwilim omui pwin diar wasa, me a kak kotikot ia. Maing Kot, kom kotin apwalilar me luet akan duen omui kalangan.<l eID="gen1039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1040"/>Ieowa kotikidier a masan ki pwin en wanporon kalaimun akan.<l eID="gen1040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1041"/>Nanmarki en karis toto tang wei madang, o waun im akan nek pasanger, me re atia sang ar imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1042"/>Ni omail kairu nan pung en noumail pwin man akan, komail rasong pa en muroi men, me lingan dueta silper o pa a kan dueta kold lingan.<l eID="gen1042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1043"/>Ma me Manaman o lao kotin kamueit pasang nanmarki kan, nana Salmon rotorot ap pan marainla.<l eID="gen1043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1044"/>Nana Pasan iei nana en Kot; Pasan nana kalaimun eu.<l eID="gen1044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1045"/>Menda komail nana kalaimun akan kin kilekilang ap peirin ong nana, me Kot kotin piladar en kotikot ia? O Ieowa pan kotikot wasa o kokolata.<l eID="gen1045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1046"/>War en Kot me kid toto pan pak kid; Ieowa kotikot re ’rail ni nana Sinai.<l eID="gen1046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1047"/>Komui kotidalang poa o saliedier me salidi kan, o kom kotin ale ong aramas pai kan, pil ong ir me katiwo kan, pwe Ieowa en kotikot wasa o.<l eID="gen1047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1048"/>Kapinga Ieowa nin ran akan karos; Kot kin kotiki ong kitail katoutou patail, ap pil kotin sauasa kitail. Sela.<l eID="gen1048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1049"/>Atail Kot iei sauas patail, o Ieowa Kaun kin kotin dorela sang mela.<l eID="gen1049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1050"/>Melel, Kot pan kotin kawela mongan a imwintiti kan, o a pan kotin leser pasang takain mongan ir, me dadaurata ar katiwo.<l eID="gen1050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1051"/>Ieowa kotin masanier: I pan kapure dong ir sang nan Pasan, I pan wa ir do sang nan kapin madau;<l eID="gen1051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1052"/>Pwe koe en tiakedi ong nan ntan imwintiti kan, o noum kidi kan en tamotamo.<l eID="gen1052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1053"/>Maing Kot, a sansal duen omui kotikot sili, duen omui kotikot sili nan mol omui saraui, ai Kot o ai Nanmarki.<l eID="gen1053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1054"/>Pwin en kaul kin tiong, ap pwin en saunkasang nan pung en peinakap akan, me wiadar aip.<l eID="gen1054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1055"/>Kapinga Kot Ieowa nan momodisou kan, komail me kisan parer en Israel.<l eID="gen1055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1056"/>Peniamin tikitik kin kakaun nan pung ar, saupeidi en Iuda iangaki sapwilim ar akan toto, saupeidi en Sepulon, o saupeidi en Naptali.<l eID="gen1056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1057"/>Omail Kot kotin kauadar omail wei; Maing Kot, i me komui en kotin katengetengedi, pwe sapwilim omui dodok.<l eID="gen1057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1058"/>Nanmarki kan pan wa dong uk ar kisakis pweki omail im en kaudok nan Ierusalem.<l eID="gen1058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1059"/>Kom kotin lipor ong man en nan rau, o pwin kau ol iangaki na kan, o wei kan, me kin pepei pweki kisin moni. Kotin kamueit pasang wek kan, me kin men mauin.<l eID="gen1059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1060"/>Saupedi en Äkipten pan pwarado; men Moren pan pokadang Kot pa ’rail.<l eID="gen1060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1061"/>Komail wei kan nin sappa kauli ong Kot, kakaul o kapinga Ieowa. Sela.<l eID="gen1061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1062"/>I, me kin kotikot sili nanlang, nanlang en masia! Kilang, a kin kotiki ong sapwilim a nansapwe manaman.<l eID="gen1062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1063"/>Komail kamelele mana en Kot! A lingan mi ren Israel, o a mana mi nan tapok kan.<l eID="gen1063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1064"/>Kot meid kapuriamui nan mole saraui. I Kot en Israel. A pan kotiki ong aramas akan mana o kelail. Kapinga Kot!<chapter eID="Ps.68"/> <l eID="gen1064" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1029"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kotin sauasa ia, pwe pil itida lel ong maur i.<l eID="gen1066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1067"/>I pan kirila nan wasa lususur lol, wasa me sota kakaluak; i mi nan pil lol, o ad pan kamop ia la.<l eID="gen1067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1068"/>I panga kila ai sangesang, kapin wor ai kirkilar, mas ai suedalar, pwe a warailar ai auiaui Kot.<l eID="gen1068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1069"/>Me kin tata kin ia nin sokarepa me toto sang pit en mong ai. Me imwintiti ong ia, o me kin kawe ia la, ap sota karepa, kin kelail. I en pwain, me i sota kulia sang.<l eID="gen1069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1070"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin mangi ai pweipwei, o ai sapung kan me sota rir sang komui.<l eID="gen1070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1071"/>Kom der mueid ong irail, me auiaui komui, en sarodi pweki ngai, Maing Ieowa Sepaot; kom der mueid ong irail, me rapaki komui, en namenokala pweki ngai, Kot en Israel.<l eID="gen1071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1072"/>Pwe i kin kankaururla pweki komui, mas ai me dir en namenok.<l eID="gen1072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1073"/>I wialar men wai amen ren ri ai kan, o nain in ai sasa ia lar.<l eID="gen1073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1074"/>Pwe limpok ong tanpas omui kasor ia dier, o lalaue en ir, me kin lalaue komui id ko dong ia.<l eID="gen1074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1075"/>I kin sangesang melel o kaisesol, ari so, re kin lalaue ia.<l eID="gen1075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1076"/>I likau kidar ed eu, a re kin lalaue ia.<l eID="gen1076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1077"/>O me mondi pan wanim, kin kasekasenda ia, o wasan kang sakau, re kin kakaul kin ia.<l eID="gen1077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1078"/>A i kin kapakap ong komui Maing Ieowa ni ansau me kon ong; Maing Kot, kom kotin mangi ia pweki omui kalangan lapalap o kotin sauasa ia.<l eID="gen1078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1079"/>Kotin dore ia la sang nan pwel, pwe i ender kirila; pwe i en piti sang, me kailong kin ia o sang nan pil lol;<l eID="gen1079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1080"/>Pwe lapake ender kamop ia la, o wasa lol ender kadala ia la, o au en por o ender pur pena ong po i.<l eID="gen1080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1081"/>Mangi ia, Maing Ieowa, pwe omui kalangan meid mau, kom kotin masan dong ia, pweki omui kalangan lapalap.<l eID="gen1081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1082"/>O kom der karirela sang sapwilim omui ladu silang omui, pwe i masak; kom kotin madang mangi ia!<l eID="gen1082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1083"/>Kom kotido ren ngen i o dorela i, kotin dore ia la pweki ai imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1084"/>Komui mangier duen ai sarodier, o ai lisela, o ai namenok, me palian ia, kin sansal ong komui.<l eID="gen1084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1085"/>Ai sarodier kin kawela nan mongiong i, o i luetalar melel. I auiaui, ma sota me pan insensuedeki mepukat, a sota man amen; o ma sota, me pan kamait ia la, a sota me i kak diar.<l eID="gen1085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1086"/>Irail kin kamanga kin ia ede, o kanim pil kin ia pinika ni ai men nim piladar kaualap:<l eID="gen1086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1087"/>Arail tepel en wiala insar arail, o lidip arail, o kapup arail.<l eID="gen1087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1088"/>Mas arail en rotorotala, pwe ren der kilang wasa, o irail en kos pena kokolata.<l eID="gen1088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1089"/>Wudokidi ong po ’rail omui ongiong, o omui ongiong melel en lel ong irail.<l eID="gen1089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1090"/>Deu ’rail en liselipingda, o sota me pan kauson nan im arail.<l eID="gen1090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1091"/>Pwe re kin pakipaki, me kom kotin kaloker, o re kin indinda, me dene komui kin kaloke mal sapwilim omui kan.<l eID="gen1091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1092"/>Kom kotin kaloedi ong ir ni sapung toto, pwe ren der konodi omui pung.<l eID="gen1092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1093"/>Iris sang ir nan puk en kamaur, pwe ren der iang me pung kan kileledi.<l eID="gen1093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1094"/>A ngai me luet, o i kin waiwairok. Maing Kot, omui sauasa ia en sinsila ia.<l eID="gen1094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1095"/>I pan kapinga mar en Kot ki kaul pot, o i pan wauneki i melel ki danke.<l eID="gen1095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1096"/>I me Ieowa kotin kupura sang kau ol, me ose o pat en nä pualapual mia.<l eID="gen1096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1097"/>Me luet akan kin kilang, o peren kida, o me kin rapaki Kot, mongiong arail pan maurada.<l eID="gen1097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1098"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin mangi me samama kan, o a sota kotin mamaleki sapwilim a salidi kan.<l eID="gen1098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1099"/>Nanlang en kapinga i, pil sappa, o madau, o karos me kin mokimokid lole.<l eID="gen1099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1100"/>Pwe Kot pan kotin sauasa Sion, o a pan kauada kanim en Iuda kan, pwe aramas en kauson wasa o, o aneki.<l eID="gen1100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1101"/>O wan a ladu kan pan sosoki irail, o me kin pok ong mar a, pan kauson wasa o.<chapter eID="Ps.69"/> <l eID="gen1101" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1065"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: MAING Kot kom kotin madangdo, dore ia la, Maing Ieowa, pwen sauasa ia!<l eID="gen1103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1104"/>Me kin masamasan ia, en namenokala o sarodi, o me kin peren kida ai apwal akan, en ponseker wei o lesila.<l eID="gen1104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1105"/>Pwe irail me kin indinda due ai: Io ol o! Ren namenokala.<l eID="gen1105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1106"/>A me kin idok komui, en pereperen o popolki komui, o me kin pok ong omui maur, en indinda ansau karos: Kot meid kapingan!<l eID="gen1106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1107"/>A ngai me luet o samama. Maing Kot, kom kotin madang dong ia, pwe komui ta sauas pa i o ai saundor; Maing Ieowa, kom der kotin pwand!<chapter eID="Ps.70"/> <l eID="gen1107" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, i liki komui, kom der mueid ong, i en sarodi kokolata.<l eID="gen1109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1110"/>Kom kotin dore ia la pweki omui pung, o kotin sauasa ia, o kotin kapaike dong ia karong omui kan o sauasa ia.<l eID="gen1110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1111"/>Komui en kotin wiala ai paipalap, wasa i pan kak pitila ia ansau karos, pwe kom kotin inauki ong ia er, me kom pan dore ia la, pwe komui ai paip o ai kel.<l eID="gen1111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1112"/>Ai Kot, sauasa ia sang nan pa en me doo sang Kot, o sang nan pa en me sapung o weit.<l eID="gen1112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1113"/>Pwe komui kapore pa i, Maing Ieowa, komui ai kel sang ni ai pulepul.<l eID="gen1113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1114"/>I liki komui sang ni ai ipwidier, o komui me kaipwi ia sang nan kaped en in ai, i pan kapinga komui kokolata.<l eID="gen1114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1115"/>Ngai dueta meakot me kapuriamui ong me toto; a komui kel pa i manaman.<l eID="gen1115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1116"/>Kom kotin kadireki au ai kaping o danke ong komui.<l eID="gen1116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1117"/>Kom der kotin kase ia la ni ai mala, o der muei sang ia ni ai pan luetala.<l eID="gen1117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1118"/>Pwe ai imwintiti kin palian ia ni ar lokaia, o me kin masamasan ia, kin kapakapung pena,<l eID="gen1118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1119"/>O indinda: Kot muei sanger i, komail paki o koledi i, pwe sota sauas pa a.<l eID="gen1119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1120"/>Maing Kot, kom der kotin doo wei sang ia, Maing Kot! Kom kotin madangdo o sauasa ia.<l eID="gen1120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1121"/>A me palian ia en namenokala o sarodi; o me rapa kin ia, pwen kame ia la, ren kadupale kidi namenok o lalaue.<l eID="gen1121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1122"/>A i pan auiauita, o i pan kalaudela ai kaping ong komui kokolata.<l eID="gen1122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1123"/>Au ai en kaloki sili omui pung, o omui kamau pan ran karos, me sota kak wadawad pena.<l eID="gen1123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1124"/>I kin weweid sili ni mana en Ieowa Kaun; i pan kapinga omui pung eta.<l eID="gen1124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1125"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin padaki ong ia er sang ni ai pulepul, o i kaloki sili omui manaman akan sang mas kokodo lel met.<l eID="gen1125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1126"/>Maing Kot, kom der kotin muei sang ia ni ai mala, pit en mong ai lao puetepuetala, lao i pan padaki ong seri en seri kan omui wiawia o ong me pan kokodo omui manaman.<l eID="gen1126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1127"/>Maing Kot, omui pung meid ileile, kom kin wiada dodok lapalap. Maing Kot, is me rasong komui?<l eID="gen1127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1128"/>Pwe komui kotiki ong kit er kamasak laud o toto, o kom kotin pur ong kamau kit ada o wai ia dado sang nan wasa lol.<l eID="gen1128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1129"/>Komui pan kotin kaileile ia da, o kom pan kotin pur ong kamait ia la.<l eID="gen1129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1130"/>I ap pan kapingaki komui kasang, pweki omui melel, ai Kot, i pan kauleki ong komui arp, ong komui, me Saraui en Israel.<l eID="gen1130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1131"/>Kil in au ai o ngen i, me re kotin dorelar, pan pereperen o kauli ong komui.<l eID="gen1131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1132"/>Pil lo i pan indinda duen omui pung sang mansang lel sautik. Pwe irail, me men kawe ia la, namenokala o sarodier.<chapter eID="Ps.71"/> <l eID="gen1132" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom kotiki ong nanmarki en kapung, o kotiki ong nain nanmarki ol omui pung.<l eID="gen1134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1135"/>Pwen kaunda sapwilim omui aramas akan nin tiak pung, o dorela sapwilim omui me luet akan.<l eID="gen1135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1136"/>Nana kan en kare dong aramas akan popol o dol akan me pung.<l eID="gen1136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1137"/>A pan sauasa pung en me luet ren aramas akan; a pan dorela nain me samama kan, o pan tiakedi me morsued o.<l eID="gen1137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1138"/>Aramas pan masak komui sang eu kainok lel eu kainok, arain katipin o saunipong mia.<l eID="gen1138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1139"/>A pan kotidi dueta katau ong mat kap, dueta katau me kawusokesok sap o.<l eID="gen1139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1140"/>Me pung o pan memaurata ni a ran akan, o muei mau pan pwaida, lao saunipong solar mia.<l eID="gen1140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1141"/>A pan kotin kaunda sang eu madau lel wong eu, o sang pilap o lel ni imwin sappa.<l eID="gen1141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1142"/>Me kaukauson nan sap tan, pan dairukedi ong mo a, o a imwintiti kan pan kangala pwel par.<l eID="gen1142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1143"/>Nanmarki en Tarsis o me mi nan dake kan, pan wa dong i ar kisakis; nanmarki en Arapia o Sepa pan wia nopwei.<l eID="gen1143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1144"/>Nanmarki kan karos pan kaudoki ong i, men liki kan karos pan upa ong i.<l eID="gen1144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1145"/>Pwe a pan dorela me samama o, me kin weriwer, o me luet, me sota sauas pa.<l eID="gen1145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1146"/>A pan kupura me tikitik o samama, o pan kotin sauasa ngen en me samama kan.<l eID="gen1146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1147"/>A pan kotin dorela ngen arail sang ren me morsued o weit, o nt’ arail me kasampwal mon silang i.<l eID="gen1147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1148"/>A pan ieiasata o kold sang wein Arapia pan wisik wong i, o aramas akan pan kapakapaki i ansau karos, a pan kapaida ni ansau karos.<l eID="gen1148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1149"/>Wantuka kan pan pwaida mau nin sappa o pon nana kan, korn pan momand dueta Lipanon; o aramas akan pan wosada nan kanim akan dueta rä nan sap o.<l eID="gen1149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1150"/>Mar a pan duedueta kokolata; arain katipin a pan mimieta, iduen warai en mar a, o re pan kapaikida i; men liki kan karos pan kapinga i.<l eID="gen1150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1151"/>Kaping ong Kot Ieowa, Kot en Israel, i eta, me kin wiada manaman akan.<l eID="gen1151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1152"/>O kaping ong mar a lingan kokolata, o sap karos en direki a wau! Amen, amen!<l eID="gen1152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1153"/>Iet imwilan kapakap en Dawid nain Isai.<chapter eID="Ps.72"/> <l eID="gen1153" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1133"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: MELEL, Kot kompoke pan men Israel, irail me makelekel nan mongiong arail.<l eID="gen1155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1156"/>A ngai, ekis ta, a nä i kat pan lodi, o i koren iong krisedi ni ai kakakawei.<l eID="gen1156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1157"/>Pwe i suedeki me aklapalap akan, ni ai kilanger en me sapung kan ar pwaidar.<l eID="gen1157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1158"/>Pwe sota apwal kot lel ong irail ni ar pan mela, re kin kelail o war arail wilar melel.<l eID="gen1158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1159"/>Sota ar apwal kot dueta aramas tei kan, o re sota pan kalokolok dueta aramas tei kan.<l eID="gen1159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1160"/>Ari aklapalap, iei kapwat en tapin wor arail, o arail likau, iei arail tiak weit.<l eID="gen1160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1161"/>Por en mas arail tikitik o sued kilar ar wilar, o re kin wiada, me re inong iong.<l eID="gen1161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1162"/>Re kin mamaleki meakaros, o re kin lokelokaia me sued, o re kin lalaue o lokaia ni ar aklapalap.<l eID="gen1162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1163"/>Dene arail lokaia tapi sang nanlang, o me irail indinda, dene i eta me pung nin sappa.<l eID="gen1163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1164"/>I me aramas akan lokidi ong irail; o pil totoia re kin nimala.<l eID="gen1164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1165"/>Re kin inda: Iaduen, Kot pan kotin insenoki irail? O menda ren me lapalap irail?<l eID="gen1165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1166"/>Kilang, iduen me doo sang Kot akan; irail meid pai nin sappa, o re pan kapwapwala.<l eID="gen1166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1167"/>Iaduen, likamata sota katepa ai kamakelekeladar mongiong i o kaminela pa i kat ni me pung?<l eID="gen1167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1168"/>Pwe ran karos i pan kalokolok, o ni mansang karos ai kamekam mia.<l eID="gen1168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1169"/>Koren iong i pil pan indinda dueta irail, a so, pwe i de pan suedeki sapwilim omui seri kan karos sang mas kokodo lel met.<l eID="gen1169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1170"/>I ap madamadaua duen mepukat, pwen dedeki, a i sota kak ong.<l eID="gen1170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1171"/>Ngai lao pedelong ong mon mol en Kot saraui o kilanger imwin me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1172"/>Melel kom kotin pwili kin irail edi wasa likakeris; kom kotin kapup irail edi ong nani pwel.<l eID="gen1172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1173"/>Iaduen arail madang soredier. Irail lokidokila, o imwila ’rail meid kamasapwek.<l eID="gen1173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1174"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kin kotin kawela mom arail nan kanim o dueta auramen.<l eID="gen1174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1175"/>Ni ai madak nan mongiong i, o waiwairok nan ai mudilik kan,<l eID="gen1175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1176"/>I ap diaradar, me ngai ol pweipwei men, me sota asa meakot; dueta man amen mo omui.<l eID="gen1176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1177"/>Ari so, i pan mimieta re omui kokolata, pwe komui kotin kolekol eta pa i pali maun.<l eID="gen1177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1178"/>Komui kin kalua ia duen kupur omui, o kom pan kotin kasamo ia nan lingan omui.<l eID="gen1178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1179"/>Ma komui ta ai Kot, i sota pan anane meakot nanlang de sappa.<l eID="gen1179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1180"/>Ma pali war ai o ngen i pan dupokala, pil menda, pwe komui Maing Kot kamait pa i o pwais ai kokolata.<l eID="gen1180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1181"/>Pwe kom kotin mangi irail, me muei sang komui pan lokidokila; Kom pan kotin kasapokela karos, me wuki wei sang komui.<l eID="gen1181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1182"/>A iet ai peren, i en tengeteng ong Kot, o i en kaporoporeki Kot Ieowa, pwen kalok sili omui wiawia kan karos.<chapter eID="Ps.73"/> <l eID="gen1182" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1154"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, da me kom kotin kase kin kit ala, o da me re ongiongiki sapwilim omui sip akan?<l eID="gen1184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1185"/>Kom kotin kupura sapwilim omui momodisou, me kom kotin pwaindar mas o, o me komui dorelar, pwen wiala sapwilim omui, kotin kupura dol Sion, wasa me kom kotikot ia.<l eID="gen1185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1186"/>Kom koti dong wasa me liseliping ansau warai; imwintiti me kawelar meakaros nan im saraui.<l eID="gen1186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1187"/>Me palian komui, kin weriwer nan tanpas omui o pwilikidi arail dikedik en ani mal akan lole.<l eID="gen1187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1188"/>Irail pwaradar dueta ir, me wia palapal nan wel.<l eID="gen1188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1189"/>Re kin kawela did kaselel akan ki sile laud o tikitik.<l eID="gen1189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1190"/>Irail karongala tanpas omui; irail kasaminela o tiakedi wasa me mar omui kotikot ia.<l eID="gen1190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1191"/>Irail kin inda nan mongiong arail: Na, kitail pan kawela! Irail karongalar wasan kaudok karos nan sap o.<l eID="gen1191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1192"/>Solar manaman akai sansal ong kitail, o solar saukop amen mia, o sota amen re atail me pan asa imwilan mepukat.<l eID="gen1192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1193"/>O Maing Kot, arai da me morsued o pan lalaue, o imwintiti o pan mamaleki mar omui?<l eID="gen1193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1194"/>Da me komui kotiki wei sang lim omui? Kotikida pali maun omui o kaimwisokala.<l eID="gen1194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1195"/>Pwe Kot ai Nanmarki sang mas o. I me sauas pan meakaros, me kin wiaui nin sappa.<l eID="gen1195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1196"/>Kom kotin kamueit pasanger madau ki omui manaman, o kom kotin kawelar mongan drake nan pil.<l eID="gen1196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1197"/>Kom kotin kawelar mongan walros, ap kotiki ong aramas nan sap tan, pwen kangala.<l eID="gen1197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1198"/>Komui kotin kapwaredar parer o pilap akan, o pilap kalaimun akan me kom kotin kangalangaladi.<l eID="gen1198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1199"/>Ran o pong me sapwilim omui; komui kotin wiadar saunipong o katipin.<l eID="gen1199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1200"/>Komui wiadar irair en sap akan; komui me kin wia ansaun karakar o kapou.<l eID="gen1200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1201"/>Kom kotin kupura mepukat: Imwintiti o lalaue komui Maing, o aramas pweipwei kan mamaleki mar omui.<l eID="gen1201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1202"/>Kom der kotiki ong man laualo ngen en sapwilim omui muroi, o kom der likidmaliela pwin en sapwilim omui luet akan.<l eID="gen1202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1203"/>Kom kotin tamanda inau o, pwe sap olar wasa karos o im akan pual pasanger.<l eID="gen1203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1204"/>Re der kotin mueid ong me luet o, en namenok purela, me samama o luet akan en kapinga mar omui.<l eID="gen1204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1205"/>Maing Kot, kom kotida o kotin kaimwisokala sapwilim omui dodok; kom kotin tamanda kankaurur, me kin wiaui ong komui sang ren me pweipwei kan.<l eID="gen1205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1206"/>Kom kotin der maliela weriwer en sapwilim omui imwintiti, morongorong en me palian komui kan, me kin lalaudalar ansau karos.<chapter eID="Ps.74"/> <l eID="gen1206" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1183"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: Se kapinga komui, Maing Kot, se kapinga komui, pwe mar omui me koren, o omui manaman akan kaloki sili due.<l eID="gen1208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1209"/>Pwe ni a ansau I pan wiada kapung pung.<l eID="gen1209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1210"/>Sap o tou a kan kin rerer; a I kin kolekol a ur akan. Sela.<l eID="gen1210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1211"/>I indang me aklapalap akan: Komail der aklapalap! O ong me doo sang Kot akan: Komail der keleki omail manaman!<l eID="gen1211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1212"/>Komail der kaileilada mong omail, komail der lokaia sued ni omail aklapalap.<l eID="gen1212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1213"/>Pwe sota sauaspa sang ni mas en lang de kapin lang, de sang nana en sap tan.<l eID="gen1213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1214"/>Pwe Kot, me kin kadeikada, o me kin kasapwilidi amen, o kasapwilada amen.<l eID="gen1214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1215"/>Pwe dal eu mi nan lim en Ieowa, me dir en wain kelail, me a kotin kodidodie; a me doo sang Kot akan karos nan sappa pan nim sang, o re pan nimala moroke.<l eID="gen1215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1216"/>A i pan padapadak kokolata, o kauli ong Kot en Iakop.<l eID="gen1216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1217"/>I pan kawela mana en me doo sang Kot akan karos, a mana en me pung kan pan kakairida.<chapter eID="Ps.75"/> <l eID="gen1217" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1207"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: KOT me indand mau ren Iuda, o mar a me lingan ren men Israel.<l eID="gen1219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1220"/>Tanpas a im pwal mi nan Salem, o tanpas a mi Sion.<l eID="gen1220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1221"/>I wasa a kotin katip pasang ia kanangan kasik katieu, o pere, o kodlas, o tatan mauin. Sela.<l eID="gen1221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1222"/>Komui me lingan o manaman sang dol en mauin kan.<l eID="gen1222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1223"/>Me aklapalap akan lodier ong men kul akan o mela, o saunpei komad karos en kidi pa arail.<l eID="gen1223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1224"/>Maing Kot en Iakop os o war kin pupekidi omui masan akan.<l eID="gen1224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1225"/>Komui meid kamasapwek. Is me kak u mo ’mui ni omui ongiong?<l eID="gen1225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1226"/>Ni omui kotin kasaledar omui kadeik sang nanlang, sappa ap masapwekadar o nenenlar,<l eID="gen1226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1227"/>Ni en Kot a kotidar, pwen kadeik, o sauasa me luet akan karos nin sappa. Sela.<l eID="gen1227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1228"/>Pwe makar en aramas kin kalinganada komui, o ma re pan pur ong moromorong, luan omui ongiong pan itar ong irail.<l eID="gen1228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1229"/>Komail inau ong Ieowa omail Kot o kapwaiada. Komail karos, me mi impa, wa dong ren me kalom omail kisakis akan.<l eID="gen1229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1230"/>I me pan atia sang saupeidi kan ar komad, a meid kalom ong nanmarki en sappa kan.<chapter eID="Ps.76"/> <l eID="gen1230" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1218"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: I KIN likwirki ngil ai ong Kot, ong Kot, me i pan likwir ong, o i me kotin mangi ia.<l eID="gen1232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1233"/>Ni ai ansau apwal, i kin rapaki Ieowa; ni pong pa i kin u wei o sota kin dukedi, pwe ngen i sota kak insenemaula.<l eID="gen1233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1234"/>Ni ai tamanda Kot, i kin asengokida, ni ai madamadaua, ngen i kin luetala. Sela.<l eID="gen1234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1235"/>Kom kin kotin kolekol por en mas ai, pwe ira en papat; ngai inen en luet, solar itar ong lokaia.<l eID="gen1235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1236"/>I kin lamelame duen ran en mas akan, duen par akan me samalar.<l eID="gen1236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1237"/>Ni pong i kin lamelame duen ai kasang arp, o mongiong i kin madamadaua; ngen i kin raparapaki.<l eID="gen1237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1238"/>Kalelapok, Ieowa pan kotin ongiong kokolata, o a sota pan kotin maki ong?<l eID="gen1238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1239"/>A kalangan roselar melel, o a inau imwisokalar kokolata?<l eID="gen1239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1240"/>Kot kotin malielar a mak ong kit, o a karirikilar ongiong a kalangan? Sela.<l eID="gen1240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1241"/>Ari so, i indadar: Mepukat me mau ong ia; pali maun en lim en me Lapalap pan kak dorela meakaros.<l eID="gen1241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1242"/>I me i kin taman kida wiawian Ieowa; melel i kin tamanda omui manaman akan sang mas o,<l eID="gen1242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1243"/>O madamadaua duen omui wiawia kan karos, o kilekilang duen omui dodok.<l eID="gen1243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1244"/>Maing Kot, al omui me pung. Ia wasa amen Kot manaman mia dueta Kaun o?<l eID="gen1244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1245"/>Komui ta Kot me kin wia manaman akan. Komui kotin kasansaledar omui manaman nan pung en wei kan.<l eID="gen1245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1246"/>Komui kotin dore kila sapwilim omui kan omui manaman, iei seri en Iakop o Iosep akan. Sela.<l eID="gen1246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1247"/>Pil akan ariri komui, Maing Kot, pil akan ariri komui, rap masapwekadar, o wasa lol rererdar.<l eID="gen1247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1248"/>Tapok kalaimun akan kamoredier pil, tapok kan wiadar nansapwe, o liol piripir sili.<l eID="gen1248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1249"/>Nansapwe wiauier nanlang; sapwilim omui liol akan kamaraini sappa; sappa mokieda o rerer.<l eID="gen1249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1250"/>Al omui mi nan madau, al omui tätik nan pil kalaimun akan, o sota me kaan aluwilu omui.<l eID="gen1250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1251"/>Kom kotin kalua sapwilim omui kan dueta pwin eu ren Moses o Aron.<chapter eID="Ps.77"/> <l eID="gen1251" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1231"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: KOMAIL nai aramas akan, rong ai kusoned; komail kapaike dong salong omail padak en au ai!<l eID="gen1253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1254"/>I pan ki pasang au ai, pwen padak, o pan kida kasoi en mas o,<l eID="gen1254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1255"/>Me kitail rongadar o asaer, o sam atail kasoi ong kitail er,<l eID="gen1255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1256"/>Pwe kitail ender karirila sang kadaudok arail, me pan pwarado mur, o kaparokki wau en Ieowa, o a manaman o a dodok kapuriamui kan.<l eID="gen1256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1257"/>Pwe a kotin kauada men kataman eu ren Iakop, o kotikida kapung eu ren men Israel, me a kotin kakaliki ong sam atail akan, pwe ren uselang nair seri kan,<l eID="gen1257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1258"/>Pwe di en mur en asa due, o seri ko, me pan ipwidi; o ni ar kokoda, ren pil kasoi ong nair seri kan,<l eID="gen1258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1259"/>Pwe irail en kaporoporeki Kot, o ren der monokela en Kot a wiawia kan, o ren kapwaiada a kusoned akan,<l eID="gen1259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1260"/>O ren der dueta sam arail akan, me kainok kangudi o katiwo eu, me mongiong arail sota tengeteng, o ngen arail sota melel ong Kot;<l eID="gen1260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1261"/>Dueta kainok Epraim, me wa tatan mauin, ap purela sang nan pei.<l eID="gen1261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1262"/>Irail sota dadaurata inau en Kot, o re sota men weweideki duen a kusoned akan;<l eID="gen1262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1263"/>O re monokelar a wiawia kan o a manaman akan, me a kotin kasansale ong irail er.<l eID="gen1263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1264"/>A kotin wiadar manaman akai sansal mon sam arail akan nan Äkipten, nan sap Soan.<l eID="gen1264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1265"/>A kotin palang pasang madau o kotin mueid ong ir, en kotela, o wiadar pil dueta kel takai eu.<l eID="gen1265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1266"/>A kotin kalua kin irail tapok ni ran o, a ni pong umpul en kisiniai.<l eID="gen1266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1267"/>A kotin palang pasang paip nan sap tan o kanim pile kin irail pil toto.<l eID="gen1267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1268"/>O a kotin kapkapwile wei pilap kai sang nan paip, pwe ren pwile wei dueta pilap laud akan.<l eID="gen1268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1269"/>Ari so, re dadaurata ni arail dipi ong i, o re kaongiongi me Lapalap o nan sap tan.<l eID="gen1269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1270"/>O re kasongesong Kot nan mongiong arail, ni ar inong iong kan arail manga.<l eID="gen1270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1271"/>O re palian Kot ni ar inda: Melel Kot pan kak wiada tepel eu nan sap tan?<l eID="gen1271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1272"/>Kilang, a poki paip o, pwe pil en pwarado o pilap akan pwilepwile wei, a iaduen, a pan kak kida prot o uduk ong na aramas akan?<l eID="gen1272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1273"/>Ieowa lao mangier mepukat, ap kotin ongiongadar, o kisiniai wiauier ren Iakop, o ongiong lel ong Israel,<l eID="gen1273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1274"/>Pweki ar so kamelele Kot, o sota kaporoporeki a sauas.<l eID="gen1274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1275"/>A ap kotin masani ong tapok en poa kan, o ritingida wanim en lang akan.<l eID="gen1275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1276"/>O kotin kamoredi ong ir manga, pwe ren manga, o a kotiki ong ir prot en lang.<l eID="gen1276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1277"/>Irail kangalar prot en tounlang kan; a kotin kadar ong ir kisin manga toto.<l eID="gen1277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1278"/>A kotin kapwaredar pan lang ang en mas en lang, o ni a manaman a kotin kamokidada ang en pali air.<l eID="gen1278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1279"/>O a kotin kamoredi ong ir uduk dueta pwel par, o manpir dueta pik en oror.<l eID="gen1279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1280"/>O a kotin kapup irail di wasa karos, me irail kauson ia.<l eID="gen1280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1281"/>Rap mangamanga o medilar kaualap, o a kotin mueid ong ir ar inong.<l eID="gen1281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1282"/>A ni ar kapwaiadar ar inong, o ni ar mangamanga,<l eID="gen1282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1283"/>Ongiong en Kot ap lel ong irail er, o kamelar ol lapalap re ’rail, o kotin wokiedi manakap en Israel kasampwal akan.<l eID="gen1283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1284"/>A re kalaudelar arail dip, o re sota kamelele a manaman akan.<l eID="gen1284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1285"/>I me a kotin mueideki ren mela, re sota paida, o ar apwal akan me toto arain ar maur.<l eID="gen1285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1286"/>Ni a kotin kame irail la, rap idok i, o wukila, o rapaki Kot.<l eID="gen1286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1287"/>O re tamandar, me Kot kele parail o Kot lapalap ar saundor.<l eID="gen1287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1288"/>O re lik sansal mau ong i ni au arail o re likam ong i ni lo ar.<l eID="gen1288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1289"/>A mongiong arail sota tengeteng ong i, o re sota dadaurata melel a inau.<l eID="gen1289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1290"/>Ari so, a kotin kalangan ong ir, o kotin makeki ong ir dip arail, o sota kame irail la, o katukiedi a ongiong pan pak toto, o sota ongiongi melel.<l eID="gen1290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1291"/>Pwe a kotin kupura, me irail pali uduk, dueta kisiniang, me pir wei o solar puredo.<l eID="gen1291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1292"/>Pan pak toto re kangudi ong i nan sap tan, o kakupur suedi i nan mal.<l eID="gen1292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1293"/>Irail pur ong ansau karos kasongesong Kot, o re akapungi ong me Saraui ren men Israel.<l eID="gen1293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1294"/>Re solar tamanda lim a manaman, me dore ir ala sang ar imwintiti kan ni ran o.<l eID="gen1294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1295"/>Duen a kotin wiadar a manaman akan nan Äkipten o a dodok kapuriamui nan Soan.<l eID="gen1295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1296"/>A kotin kawuki ong nta ar pil akan, rap solar kak nima sang ar pilap akan.<l eID="gen1296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1297"/>Ni a kotin kapwaredar man sued akan nan pung arail, me kang ir ala, o pros akan, me kawe ir ala.<l eID="gen1297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1298"/>A kotiki ong muedi ar tuka kan, o ar wantuka ong man siek.<l eID="gen1298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1299"/>A kotin kawekilar akel ar wain o tuka kan ki akel tikitik.<l eID="gen1299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1300"/>A kotin kamekila ar man akel akan o ar pwin man akan liol.<l eID="gen1300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1301"/>A kotin ongiong melel o porone wong ir tounlang sued kai, o mueid ong ir, ren lingarangar, o morsued, o kainsensued.<l eID="gen1301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1302"/>A kotin kaonopa dang ongiong al apot, o sota dorelar maur arail sang mela, o kotin mueid ong kilitop ni maur arail.<l eID="gen1302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1303"/>A kotin kamelar meseni karos nan Äkipten, meseni en ar kelail nan im en Am akan.<l eID="gen1303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1304"/>A kotin kaluala sapwilim a kan dueta pwin sip eu nan sap tan.<l eID="gen1304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1305"/>A kotin kalua irail ni pung, pwe ren der masak meakot, a madau kadupaledi ar imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1306"/>A kotin wa ir ala lel ni irair en sap saraui, lel nana wet, me lim a pali maun kileledier.<l eID="gen1306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1307"/>O kotin pakipaki men liki kan mo ’rail, o kotin nek ong ir sap arail, pwen sosoki, o a kotiki ong kainok en Israel akan, en kaukauson nan im arail.<l eID="gen1307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1308"/>A re songesong? o kaongiong Kot lapalap, o sota peiki ong i, o sota duki ong a masan akan.<l eID="gen1308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1309"/>O re muei sang o mamaleki meakaros, dueta sam arail akan, o re sota tengeteng, dueta kasik katieu luet eu.<l eID="gen1309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1310"/>O re kaongiong i ni ar kaudok pon dol akan, o re kupur suedeki i ki arail dikedik en ani kan.<l eID="gen1310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1311"/>A Kot lao kotin mangi mepukat, ap kotin ongiongada o kasapok ir ala melel.<l eID="gen1311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1312"/>A kotin muei sang tanpas a nan Silo, im pwal o, wasa a kotikot ia ren aramas akan.<l eID="gen1312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1313"/>A kotiki wei sapwilim akan nan imateng, o a lingan nan pa en imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1314"/>A kotiki wei sapwilim a aramas akan ni kodlas, o kotin ongiongi sapwilim a soso.<l eID="gen1314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1315"/>Kisiniai kangala ar manakap akan, o ar peinekap akan solar kak papaud.<l eID="gen1315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1316"/>Arail samero kan mekilar kodlas, a solar li odi kan, me kin maiei.<l eID="gen1316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1317"/>Ieowa ap kotin opala wasa dueta amen me mairelar, dueta ol komad amen kin ngisingis ni a kang wain.<l eID="gen1317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1318"/>A kotin kaloedier a imwintiti kan o kanamenok ir ala kokolata.<l eID="gen1318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1319"/>A kotin kaselar im en Iosep, o sota piladar kainok en Epraim.<l eID="gen1319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1320"/>Pwe a kotin piladar kainok en Iuda, dol Sion, me a kotin kupura.<l eID="gen1320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1321"/>O a kotin kauadar tanpas a im saraui wasa ileile, dueta sappa me pan tengeteng eta kokolata.<l eID="gen1321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1322"/>Ap kotin piladar sapwilim a ladu Dawid, o a kotin ale i sang nan deun sip akan.<l eID="gen1322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1323"/>A kotin kalua i sang ren sip en kadidi kan, pwen kamanga sapwilim a kainok en Iakop o a soso men Israel.<l eID="gen1323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1324"/>O a kotin apapwali ir ni tiak en mongiong melel o pung, o kakaun irail ada ni koiok en lim a kan.<chapter eID="Ps.78"/> <l eID="gen1324" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, men liki kan tang dong sapwilim omui soso; irail kasaminela sapwilim omui im saraui, o re wiaki Ierusalem kantakai eu.<l eID="gen1326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1327"/>Re ki onger manpir en pan lang akan kalep en sapwilim omui ladu kan, o uduk en sapwilim omui saraui kan ong man en nan sap akan.<l eID="gen1327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1328"/>Impan Ierusalem irail wudokila nt’ ar dueta pil, o sota, me pan sarepedi.<l eID="gen1328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1329"/>Kit wialar kanamenok eu ong men imp at, o me kapil kit pena, kin lalaue o kaurur kin kit.<l eID="gen1329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1330"/>Maing Ieowa, arai da kom pan kotin ongiong, o inong en kupur omui pan lulada dueta kisiniai?<l eID="gen1330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1331"/>Kom kotin wudokidi ong men liki kan, me sasa komui, omui ongiong, o ong wei kan, me sota kin likwir ong mar omui.<l eID="gen1331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1332"/>Pwe re kawelar Iakop o im ar akan.<l eID="gen1332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1333"/>Kom der kotin tamanda dip en sam at akan; a kom kotin madang sauasa kit, pwe kit me malaulaular.<l eID="gen1333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1334"/>Maing Kot, sauas pat, kom kotin sauasa kit, pweki wau en mar omui. Kom kotin dore kit ala o kotin maki ong kit dip at akan, pweki mar omui!<l eID="gen1334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1335"/>Da me kom kotin mueid ong men liki kan en inda: Ari, ia arail Kot? Kom kotin kasale ong men liki kan depuk en ntan sapwilim omui ladu kan, me wudokilar, en pil sansal mo at!<l eID="gen1335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1336"/>Kotin mangi sangesang en me salidi o; kom kotin kolekol kidi lim omui manaman me kileledier ong kamela.<l eID="gen1336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1337"/>Kom kotin depukki ong men imp at pan pak isu ar lalaue, me re lalaue kin komui.<l eID="gen1337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1338"/>A kit, sapwilim omui aramas akan, o sip en sapwilim omui mos, pan danke komui kokolata, kapakaparok duen omui lingan ansau karos.<chapter eID="Ps.79"/> <l eID="gen1338" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1325"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: KOMUI sile pan Israel, kotin mangi; komui me kin apapwali Iosep dueta sip akan. Kom kotido, me kaipokedi pon angin Kerup.<l eID="gen1340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1341"/>Kom kotin kasaleda omui manaman mon Epraim, o Peniamin, o Manase, o kotido, pwen sauasa kit!<l eID="gen1341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1342"/>Maing Kot Sepaot, kom kotin kamait kit ala o kotin kasaleda silang omui, kit ap pan kelail kida.<l eID="gen1342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1343"/>Ieowa Kot Sepaot, arai da, kom pan kotin ongiongiki kapakap en sapwilim omui aramas akan?<l eID="gen1343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1344"/>Kom kin kotin kamanga kin ir prot en pil en mas, o kom kin kanim pile kin irail pil en mas toto.<l eID="gen1344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1345"/>Kom kotin wiai ong kit, me men imp at kin akamaiki ong kit, o imwintiti pat kin lalaue kit.<l eID="gen1345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1346"/>Kot Sepaot, kom kotin kamait kit ala o kotin kasaleda silang omui, kit ap pan kelail kida.<l eID="gen1346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1347"/>Kom kotin wado sanger Äkipten tuka wain pot, o kom kokosang men liki kan, ap id padukedi i<l eID="gen1347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1348"/>Kom kotin kokoi ong i al a o kawosada i, pwen kadirela sap o.<l eID="gen1348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1349"/>Nana kan mi pan mot a, o ra kan kadupaledi sedern en Kot.<l eID="gen1349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1350"/>Kom kotin kalaudelar i lel ong madau o ra kan lel ni pilap o.<l eID="gen1350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1351"/>Da me kom kotin kawe kilar a kel, pwe karos me dauli kin kawela?<l eID="gen1351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1352"/>Pwik laualo dekadar, o man en nan sap kawelar.<l eID="gen1352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1353"/>Maing Kot Sepaot, kom kotin wukedoke dong kit, o ireredo sang nanlang, o masani, o kotin sauasa tukan wain pot et,<l eID="gen1353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1354"/>O kotin apapwali i, me lim omui padukedier, o me kom kotin apapwalier.<l eID="gen1354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1355"/>A rong kilar kisiniai, a paledier, re okilar masan en silang omui.<l eID="gen1355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1356"/>Lim omui apwali ol en pali maun omui, o irail, me kom kotin apapwalier.<l eID="gen1356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1357"/>Kit ap sota pan wuki wei sang komui. Kom kotin kamaur kit da, kit ap pan kapinga mar omui.<l eID="gen1357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1358"/>Ieowa Kot Sepaot, kom kotin kamait kit ala o kotin kasaleda silang omui, kit ap pan kelail kida.<chapter eID="Ps.80"/> <l eID="gen1358" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: KOMAIL pereperen kauli ong Kot, me kel patail; ngisingis ong Kot en Iakop!<l eID="gen1360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1361"/>Tapia kida kaul en kaping, o wiada tampurin, o laute kaselel iangaki arp!<l eID="gen1361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1362"/>Ni saunipong kap komail peuk koronete, ni maram, ni ran en im tantuka!<l eID="gen1362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1363"/>Pwe iduen tiak en Israel o kusoned en Kot en Iakop eu.<l eID="gen1363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1364"/>A kotin wiadar kusoned wet ong Iosep, ni a lipa sang Äkipten. I ronger masan pot, me i saikenta asa:<l eID="gen1364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1365"/>I kisanger katoutou kan pon apar a, o pa a saladokalar sang kopu kan.<l eID="gen1365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1366"/>Ni om likwirki dong ia om apwal. I ap sauasa uk; I kasaledok uk alar, ni ansau me koe lel ong nansapwe, o I sosong uk ni pil en akamai. Sela.<l eID="gen1366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1367"/>Komail nai aramas akan rong ia, I pan padaki ong komail! O Israel, ma koe pan peiki ong ia!<l eID="gen1367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1368"/>Sota amen Kot en mi re om, o koe der kaudoki ong kot en men wai amen.<l eID="gen1368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1369"/>Ngai Ieowa om Kot, me kalua uk sang nan Äkipten. Ki pasang au om, i pan kadirela.<l eID="gen1369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1370"/>A nai aramas akan sota kin peiki ong ngil ai, o Israel sota duki ong ia.<l eID="gen1370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1371"/>I ari mueid ong irail er insen arail ni ar aklapalap, pwe ren kekeid wei ni pein arail lamelam.<l eID="gen1371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1372"/>O ma nai aramas akan pan peiki ong ia, o Israel pan weweid nan al ai kan,<l eID="gen1372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1373"/>I ap pan kaloedi ar imwintiti kan madang, o pa i pan u ong me pali ong irail akan,<l eID="gen1373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1374"/>O irail me kailongki Ieowa, sota pan kak ong irail; o ansaun arail pakadeik pan duedeuta kokolata;<l eID="gen1374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1375"/>O I pan kamanga kin irail korn kaselelia, o I pan katungole kin i onik sang nan paip o.<chapter eID="Ps.81"/> <l eID="gen1375" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1359"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: KOT kotikot nan momodisou en Kot, o i saunkapung en kaun akan.<l eID="gen1377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1378"/>Arai da komail pan kadeik sapung o kasampwaleki me doo sang Kot akan? Sela.<l eID="gen1378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1379"/>Sauasa pung en samama o sapoupou kan, o sauasa me luet o samama kan ni ar pung!<l eID="gen1379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1380"/>Komail dorela me tikitik o samama o, o kamaioda sang nan pa en me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1381"/>A re sota kin duki ong, o sota ar lokekong; re kin weweid nan rotorot; pason en sappa kan karos mokimokideda.<l eID="gen1381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1382"/>Ngai indada: Komail rasong kot akan, o nain me lapalap;<l eID="gen1382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
