verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1383"/>Ari so, komail pan mela dueta aramas akan, o komail pan lokidokila dueta me weit amen.<l eID="gen1383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1384"/>Maing Kot, kom kotida o kotin kadeikada sappa, pwe komui pan sosoki men liki kan karos.<chapter eID="Ps.82"/> <l eID="gen1384" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1376"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, kom der so masan dong, o der sapaimokid, Maing Kot, kom der kotin nenenla!<l eID="gen1386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1387"/>Pwe kom kotin mangi, sapwilim omui imwintiti kan kin lingarangar, o me kailong kin komui, me aklapalap.<l eID="gen1387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1388"/>Irail kin widing ni ar kapakapung ki sapwilim omui kan, o re kin raparapaki duen ar pan kawela sapwilim omui me nekinekilar akan.<l eID="gen1388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1389"/>Re kin inda: Na kitail, kitail kokosang irail, pwe ren solar wei eu, o solar me pan inda duen wein Israel!<l eID="gen1389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1390"/>Pwe irail wiaki eu o re inauki pena, ren palian komui,<l eID="gen1390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1391"/>Im pwal en Edom, o Ismael, Moap, o Akar,<l eID="gen1391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1392"/>O Kepal, o Amon, o Amalek, men Pilista iangaki men Tirus.<l eID="gen1392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1393"/>Asor pil waroki ong ir; re kin sauasa kadaudok en Lot. Sela.<l eID="gen1393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1394"/>Kom kotin wiai ong ir dueta ong men Midian, o Sisera, o Iapin ni pilap Kison.<l eID="gen1394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1395"/>Me kamelar impan Endor, rap wia pwel la nan pwel.<l eID="gen1395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1396"/>Kom kotin wiala ar saupeidi kan dueta Orep o Seep, o ar monsap akan karos dueta Sepa o Salmuna,<l eID="gen1396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1397"/>Pwe re indinda: Kitail pan kaloedi im en Kot akan!<l eID="gen1397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1398"/>Maing Kot kom en kotin wia kin irail la älepip en kisiniang, dueta dip en rä mon kisiniang.<l eID="gen1398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1399"/>Duen kisiniai kin karongala tuka en wel o duen umpul en kisiniai kin isikeda nan wel,<l eID="gen1399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1400"/>Iduen kom kotin paki kin irail sapwilim omui liol ape, o kamasak kin irail omui melimel.<l eID="gen1400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1401"/>Kadire kila mas arail namenok, pwe ren rapaki mar omui, Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen1401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1402"/>Ren namenokala o masapwekada kokolata, o ren soredi o mela.<l eID="gen1402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1403"/>Rap pan asaki, me komui ta maraneki Kaun o me komui ta lapalap nan sap karos.<chapter eID="Ps.83"/> <l eID="gen1403" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1385"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: MEID kaselel tanpas omui kan, Maing Ieowa Sepaot!<l eID="gen1405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1406"/>Ngen i kin inong iong o anane pera en tanpas en Ieowa kan; pali war ai o ngen i kin polauleki Kot ieias.<l eID="gen1406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1407"/>Pwe manpir diaradar deu a, o swalpe pas a, wasa a kin naitik ia: Sapwilim omui pei saraui kan, Maing Ieowa Sepaot, ai Nanmarki o ai Kot.<l eID="gen1407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1408"/>Meid pai ir, me kin kauson nan tanpas omui! Re kin kapinga komui ansau karos. Sela.<l eID="gen1408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1409"/>Meid pai karos, me kin keleki komui, o idedauen komui melel!<l eID="gen1409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1410"/>Me kin weweid nan sap en mamaiei, wasa re kin weirada parer ia; pil katau kin pwain kidi i pai kan.<l eID="gen1410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1411"/>Re kin kakairida ni ar manaman akan, lao re pan sansalada mon Kot nan Sion.<l eID="gen1411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1412"/>Maing Ieowa, Kot Sepaot, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap: Maing Kot en Iakop kotin mangi ia! Sela.<l eID="gen1412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1413"/>Kot pere pat, kom kotin masan dong kit; kom kotin irerong mas en sapwilim omui keidier men.<l eID="gen1413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1414"/>Pwe ran ta ieu mon sapwilim omui pera saraui kan me mau sang ran kid; i mauki mimi pan wanim en tanpas en Kot, sang kauson nan im en me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1415"/>Pwe Kot Ieowa rasong katipin o pere, Ieowa kin kotikida mak o wau, a sota pan kotin mueid ong me lelapok kan, en anane me mau kot.<l eID="gen1415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1416"/>Maing Ieowa Sepaot, meid pai aramas amen, me kin liki komui!<chapter eID="Ps.84"/> <l eID="gen1416" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1404"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, kom kotin maki onger sapwilim omui sap mas o, o kom kotin dorelar salidi en Iakop akan.<l eID="gen1418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1419"/>Re kotin lapwadar me sued en sapwilim omui aramas akan, o kom kotin pwaidier dip arail karos. Sela.<l eID="gen1419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1420"/>Komui kotin kadukiedi omui ongiong karos, o kotin wukidoki wei sanger omui ongiong melel.<l eID="gen1420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1421"/>Kom kotin purong kamait kit ala, komui Kot at saunkamaur, o kotin katukiedi omui sokalangan ong kit.<l eID="gen1421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1422"/>Kom pan kotin ongiongi kit kokolata? Omui ongiong pan duedueta sang en kainok lel eu?<l eID="gen1422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1423"/>Kom sota pan kotin purong kamaur kit da, pwe sapwilim omui aramas kan en peren kin komui da?<l eID="gen1423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1424"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kasansaleda ar kalangan ong kit, o sauasa kit!<l eID="gen1424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1425"/>I men rong, da me Kot Ieowa pan kotin masani; pwe a pan mamasani duen muei mau ong sapwilim a aramas o me lelapok kan, pwe ren der lodi ong me pweipwei.<l eID="gen1425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1426"/>Melel, a sauas me koren iong ir, me masak i, pwe a lingan en mi nan sap atail.<l eID="gen1426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1427"/>Kalangan o melel pan tu pena, pung o muei mau en metik pena.<l eID="gen1427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1428"/>Melel pan wosada sang nan sap o, o pung pan ireredo sang nanlang.<l eID="gen1428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1429"/>Ieowa pil pan kotikido me mau, pwe sap atail en kida wa kan.<l eID="gen1429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1430"/>Pwe pung pan ti ong mo a, o a kak akan pan wiala al arail.<chapter eID="Ps.85"/> <l eID="gen1430" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1417"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, kom kotin kapaike dong ia karong omui kan o mangi ia, pwe ngai me luet o samama.<l eID="gen1432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1433"/>Kom kotin apwali maur i, pwe ngai me lelapok. Maing Kot, kom kotin sauasa ia, sapwilim omui ladu men et, me liki komui.<l eID="gen1433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1434"/>Maing, kom kotin maki ong ia, pwe i kin likwir ong komui ni ansau karos.<l eID="gen1434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1435"/>Kom kotin kaperenda mongiong en sapwilim omui ladu, pwe mongiong i kin anane komui Maing.<l eID="gen1435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1436"/>Pwe komui Maing me mau o kalangan, o kom kotin kalangan ong ir karos, me kin likwir ong komui.<l eID="gen1436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1437"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o kotin mangi ngil en ai ngidingid.<l eID="gen1437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1438"/>Ni ai apwal akan i kin likwir ong komui, pwe kom, kotin mangi ia!<l eID="gen1438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1439"/>Maing, sota me dueta komui nan pung en kot akan; o sota me kak wiawia dueta komui.<l eID="gen1439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1440"/>Men liki kan karos pan pwarado, pwen kaudoki ong komui Maing, o wauneki mar omui.<l eID="gen1440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1441"/>Pwe komui me lapalap, me kin wiada manaman, o komui ta me Kot.<l eID="gen1441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1442"/>Maing Ieowa, re kotin kasale ong ia al omui, pwe i en weweid ni omui melel, kom kotin kolekol mongiong i ong iet eta: Masak mar omui.<l eID="gen1442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1443"/>I men kapinga komui Maing, ai Kot, sang nan mongiong i, o wauneki mar omui kokolata.<l eID="gen1443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1444"/>Pwe omui kalangan me laud ong ia; komui dore maur i sang nan wasan mela.<l eID="gen1444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1445"/>Maing Kot, me aklapalap akan kin palian ia, o pwin en me weit akan kin masamasan maur i, o re sota kin weweid mon silang omui.<l eID="gen1445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1446"/>A komui Maing Kot, me dir en kalangan, o mak, o kanongama, o omui kapunglol o melel me lapalap.<l eID="gen1446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1447"/>Kom kotin wukidoki dong ia, o maki ong ia, o kamaui kida sapwilim omui ladu omui manaman, o kotin sauasa nain sapwilim omui lidu!<l eID="gen1447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1448"/>Kom kotiki ong ia kilel eu, me i pan paie kida, pwe ai imwintiti kan en kilang, rap namenok kila omui kotin sauasa ia, Maing Ieowa, o kom kotin kamait ia la.<chapter eID="Ps.86"/> <l eID="gen1448" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1431"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: A kakaudar mau pon dol saraui kan.<l eID="gen1450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1451"/>Ieowa kotin kupura wanim en Sion sang wasan kauson en Iakop karos.<l eID="gen1451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1452"/>Kasoi kaselel mia duen koe kanim en Kot. Sela.<l eID="gen1452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1453"/>I pan kasokasoi duen Raap o Papel, me asa ia. Kilang, Pilista o Tirus, o pil men Atiopia: Mepukat ipwidier wasa o.<l eID="gen1453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1454"/>A kasokasoi duen Sion indinda, me song en aramas karos ipwidi wasa o, o me Lapalap o pan kotin kamanada i.<l eID="gen1454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1455"/>Ieowa pan kotin wadok, ni a pan kotin kileledi aramas akan: Mepukat ipwidier wasa o. Sela.<l eID="gen1455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1456"/>O ni ar madomadong re pan kauleki: Ai parer karos mi re om!<chapter eID="Ps.87"/> <l eID="gen1456" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1449"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, Kot ai saunkamaur, i kin likwir nin ran o ni pong mo ’mui.<l eID="gen1458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1459"/>Kom kotin mueid ong, ai kapakap en lelda wong komui. Kom kotin kapaik dong karong omui kan ai likelikwir.<l eID="gen1459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1460"/>Pwe ngen i me dir en mamauk, o maur i koren iong mela.<l eID="gen1460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1461"/>Ngai kin wadok ong ir me melar, ngai dueta ol amen, me solar angiangi.<l eID="gen1461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1462"/>I wonon nan pung en me melar akan, me wonon nan sousou, me kom solar kotin kupura, pwe re lokidokilar sang nan lim omui.<l eID="gen1462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1463"/>Kom kotin kase ia lar nan sousou, wasa rotorot o lol.<l eID="gen1463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1464"/>Omui ongiong kin katoutou ia, o kom kotin idan kin ia di omui iluk kan. Sela.<l eID="gen1464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1465"/>Kom kotiki wonger kompoke pa i kan wasa doo, kom kotin wia kin ia la me sued kot ong ir, i salidier o so kak pitila.<l eID="gen1465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1466"/>Mas ai suede kilar ai luet, nin ran karos i potoan ong komui, Maing Ieowa, o i kapa wong komui pa i kat.<l eID="gen1466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1467"/>Kom pan kotin kasaleda omui manaman ren me melar akan? De me melar akan pan maurada danke komui? Sela.<l eID="gen1467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1468"/>Re pan kosoia duen omui kalangan nan sousou kan? O wasan mela duen omui melel?<l eID="gen1468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1469"/>Omui manaman akan pan sansaleda wasa rotorot, o omui pung nan sap en me re solar kin lamelame?<l eID="gen1469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1470"/>A i kin potoan likwir ong komui, Maing Ieowa nin mansang, ai kapakap pan lel wong komui.<l eID="gen1470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1471"/>Maing Ieowa, da me kom kotin kase ia kila, o da me kom okila ki silang ar mo i?<l eID="gen1471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1472"/>Ngai me luet o saliel sang ni ai pulepul; i kin kamekamki omui kalom, i koren iong solar kaporopor.<l eID="gen1472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1473"/>Omui ongiong kin kadupal ia di, omui kalom kawe ia lar.<l eID="gen1473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1474"/>Re kapil ia pena dueta pil akan sang ni mansang lel sautik, ir karos kapil ia pena.<l eID="gen1474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1475"/>Kom kotiki wonger kompoke pa i o ai warok kan wasa doo, rotorot eta ai warok.<chapter eID="Ps.88"/> <l eID="gen1475" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1457"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: I PAN kauleki duen kalangan en Ieowa kokolata, o i pan kaparokki au ai omui melel sang eu kainok lel eu.<l eID="gen1477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1478"/>Pwe i indinda: Mak soutuk eu pan pwarado, o kom pan kotin kolekol ar melel nanlang.<l eID="gen1478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1479"/>I inauki onger, ai pilipildar akan; I kauki onger Dawid nai ladu:<l eID="gen1479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1480"/>Kadaudok om pan mimieta kokolata, o I pan kauada mol om sang eu kainok lel eu. Sela.<l eID="gen1480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1481"/>Nanlang ap kapinga omui manaman akan, Maing Ieowa, o omui melel nan pokon en sapwilim omui saraui kan.<l eID="gen1481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1482"/>Pwe is nan tapok kan me rasong Ieowa? De is me rasong Ieowa nan pung en me lapalap akan?<l eID="gen1482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1483"/>Kot meid manaman nan pokon en me saraui kan, o meid kapuriamui ong me kaukauson re a.<l eID="gen1483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1484"/>Maing Ieowa, Kot Sepaot, is me rasong komui. Omui melel kin kapil komui pena.<l eID="gen1484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1485"/>Komui me kotin kaunda madau angiang. Komui kin kamoleilei iluk kan ni ar pan kokoda.<l eID="gen1485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1486"/>Komui me kotin tiakedi Raap dueta kamelar amen. Kom kotin kamueit pasanger imwintiti kan ki lim omui manaman.<l eID="gen1486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1487"/>Lang o sappa me sapwilim omui, sappa o audepa. Komui me kotin pasonedier.<l eID="gen1487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1488"/>Komui me kotin wiadar pali apong o pali air, Tapor o Ermon kin ngisingiski mar omui.<l eID="gen1488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1489"/>Lim omui me mananan o kumut en lim omui me roson, lim omui pali maun me ileile.<l eID="gen1489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1490"/>Melel o pung iei pason en mol omui; kalangan o melel kin tiong mo omui.<l eID="gen1490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1491"/>Meid pai aramas kan, me asa ngisingis! Ieowa, re pan weweid ni marain en silang omui.<l eID="gen1491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1492"/>Re kin polauleki mar omui sang ni mansang lel sautik, o re kin pwai kida omui pung.<l eID="gen1492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1493"/>Pwe lingan en ar kelail komui, o komui pan pokada os at.<l eID="gen1493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1494"/>Pwe Ieowa pere patail o me Saraui en Israel, i atail Nanmarki.<l eID="gen1494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1495"/>Mas o kom kotin masanier ki kasansal kai ong me lelapok kan: I kamanadar me Lapalap amen, I kasapwiladar pilipildar amen sang ren aramas akan.<l eID="gen1495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1496"/>I diaradar ai ladu Dawid, I keiekidier i ai le saraui.<l eID="gen1496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1497"/>Pa i pan kolekol i, o pa i pan kamanada i ansau karos.<l eID="gen1497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1498"/>Imwintiti kan sota pan kak widing ong i, o me sapung kan sota pan kak kaloedi.<l eID="gen1498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1499"/>I pan kamela me palian i mo a, o I pan kaloke ir, me kailongki i.<l eID="gen1499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1500"/>A ai melel o kalangan pan mi re a, o ni mar ai os a pan pokapokada.<l eID="gen1500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1501"/>I pan ki ong pa a, en kaunda madau, o pa a maun, en kaunda pil akan.<l eID="gen1501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1502"/>A pan likwir dong ia: Komui Sam ai, ai Kot, o paip en maur i.<l eID="gen1502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1503"/>O I pan wia kila i nai meseni, ileila sang nanmarki en sappa kan.<l eID="gen1503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1504"/>I pan kalangan ong i kokolata, o ai inau ong i pan duedueta.<l eID="gen1504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1505"/>I pan ki ong i kadaudok a kokolata, o mol a pan warai dueta lang.<l eID="gen1505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1506"/>A ma na kan pan muei sang ai kapung, o re sota pan weweid ni ai kusoned akan,<l eID="gen1506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1507"/>Ma re pan kasaminela ai tiak kan, o sota peiki ong ai kusoned akan,<l eID="gen1507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1508"/>I ap pan kaloke kin ir ar katiwo ki sokon pot, o pan woki ir, pweki ar sapung.<l eID="gen1508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1509"/>A I sota pan kiwei sang i ai mak, o ai melel pan mimieta re a.<l eID="gen1509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1510"/>I sota pan kawela ai inau, o I sota pan kawukila, me kowei sang nan au ai.<l eID="gen1510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1511"/>I kaukilar ai saraui pan me pak, me I sota pan likam ong Dawid:<l eID="gen1511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1512"/>Kadaudok a pan soutuk, o mol a dueta katipin mo i.<l eID="gen1512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1513"/>A pan duedueta dueta saunipong; o saunkadede nan tapok kan me melel. Sela.<l eID="gen1513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1514"/>A met komui kasapokela o ongiongi sapwilim omui me keidier.<l eID="gen1514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1515"/>Kom kotin kasela inau en omui ladu, o kom kotin kasaminela mar a.<l eID="gen1515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1516"/>Kom kotin karongk pasang a kel akan karos, o kawelar a im tengeteng kan.<l eID="gen1516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1517"/>Karos me daulier wasa o kulia sanger; a wialar kankaurur ong men imp a kan.<l eID="gen1517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1518"/>Kom kotin pokada pali maun en me palian i, o kaperendar a imwintiti kan karos.<l eID="gen1518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1519"/>Kom pil kotiki sanger mana en a kodlas kong, o sota kapwaiada i ni pei.<l eID="gen1519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1520"/>Kom kotin kaimwisokalar a lingan, o kasedi ong nan pwel mol a.<l eID="gen1520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1521"/>Kom kamotomotala ran en a manakap, o kadupalekidi i namenok. Sela.<l eID="gen1521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:46
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1522"/>Arai da, Maing Ieowa, me kom pan kotin karirela pein komui; arai da omui ongiong pan lulada dueta kisiniai?<l eID="gen1522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:47
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1523"/>Kom kotin tamanda duen motomot en maur i; de me mal kot omui kotin wiadar aramas akan?<l eID="gen1523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:48
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1524"/>Is ol o, me maur ap sota pan lel ong mela? A pan kak dorela pein i sang mana en wasan mela? Sela.<l eID="gen1524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:49
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1525"/>Maing, ia omui kalangan en mas o, me kom kotin inauki ong Dawid ni omui melel?<l eID="gen1525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:50
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1526"/>Maing, kotin tamanda kankaurur en sapwilim omui ladu kan sang ni wei toto, me kin katoutoui mongiong i.<l eID="gen1526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:51
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1527"/>Maing Ieowa, iaduen lalaue en omui imwintiti kan, iduen ar lalaue lip en sapwilim omui me keidier.<l eID="gen1527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:52
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1528"/>Kaping ong Ieowa kokolata! Amen, iei Amen!<chapter eID="Ps.89"/> <l eID="gen1528" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1476"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: MAING, kom me kotin nekid pat sang eu kainok ong eu.<l eID="gen1530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1531"/>Mon nana kan o sappa, o aude pan sappa a wiauiada, Kot kotin mia, sang mas kokodo o pil kokolata soutuk, Maing Kot.<l eID="gen1531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1532"/>Kom kin kotin kapurelang pwel par aramas akan o kotin mamasani: Puredo komail aramas akan!<l eID="gen1532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1533"/>Pwe par kid dueta aio me samalar mon silang omui o rasong masamasan eu ni pong.<l eID="gen1533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1534"/>Kom kin kotin kapwil irail wei, re rasong mair, dueta rä, me kin mongedi madang.<l eID="gen1534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1535"/>Me kin masel pasang ni mansang, a nin sautik a pan palepaledi o mongedi.<l eID="gen1535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1536"/>Omui ongiong me se kin sosore kidi, o omui ongiong melel, me se kin mekila madang.<l eID="gen1536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1537"/>Pwe kom kotin kasansale ong pein komui dip at akan, o dip at rir akan nan marain en silang omui.<l eID="gen1537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1538"/>I me at ran akan karos kin tang weiki omui ongiong, at par akan rasong kasoi pot.<l eID="gen1538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1539"/>Warain at maur me saunpar iseisok, a ma re toto, a pan waleisok, a ma me kasampwal, a pan apwal o dodok. Pwe a kin tang wei madang, dueta kit kin pir wei.<l eID="gen1539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1540"/>A is me kak dedeki mana en omui ongiong, o is me kin masak ongiong wet?<l eID="gen1540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1541"/>Kom kotin padaki ong kit, me kit pan mela, pwe sen lolekong kila.<l eID="gen1541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1542"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin purong wukedoke dong kit; arai da omui ongiong? Kom kotin maki ong sapwilim omui ladu kan!<l eID="gen1542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1543"/>Kom kotin kadire kin kit ala ar kalangan ni mansang, kit ap pan kaping o pereperen arain at maur.<l eID="gen1543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1544"/>Kom kotin kaperen kit da murin at kalokoloker, o murin at kamekam warai.<l eID="gen1544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1545"/>Kom kotin kasale ong sapwilim omui ladu kan omui wiawia kan, o omui wau ong na seri kan.<l eID="gen1545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1546"/>Ieowa at Kot, en kalangan dong kit o kotin kapwaiada dodok en pa at akan re at; ei kom kotin kapwaiada dodok en pa at akan!<chapter eID="Ps.90"/> <l eID="gen1546" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1529"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: ME kin momod pan lim en me lapalap, o me pan mimieta pan mot en me manaman o.<l eID="gen1548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1549"/>Iei me kin indang Ieowa: Ai paip, o ai kel, ai Kot, me i liki.<l eID="gen1549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1550"/>Pwe a pan kotin dore uk sang insar en sauninsar, o sang ni kilitop sued.<l eID="gen1550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1551"/>A pan kotin kadupal kin uk edi lim a, o koe pan moleilei pan lim a kan; a melel rasong kadauk o pere eu.<l eID="gen1551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1552"/>Koe sota pan masak kalom en ni pong, de kanangan kasik katieu, me kin tang wei nin ran,<l eID="gen1552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1553"/>De kilitop, me kin wawai sili pong, de eu song en kilitop me kin kaukawela nin sauas.<l eID="gen1553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1554"/>Kid pan mela imp om, o nen ni pali maun om, ap sota pan lel ong uk.<l eID="gen1554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1555"/>Koe pan kilangki mas om kan, o koe pan kilang duen a pan depuk ong me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1556"/>Pwe komui Maing Ieowa, kapore pa i. Koe piladar me lapalap o, pwen om kel.<l eID="gen1556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1557"/>Sota me sued kot pan lel ong uk, o sota kalokolok pan lel ong im om.<l eID="gen1557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1558"/>Pwe a kotin kakaliki ong sapwilim a tounlang kan, en apapwali uk o sinsila uk nan al omui kan karos.<l eID="gen1558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1559"/>Re pan wa kin uk ala lim ar akan, pwe nä om ender dipikelekel nin takai eu;<l eID="gen1559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1560"/>Koe pan tiakedi laien o oter kai, laien pulepul o serpent, me koe pan sok poa.<l eID="gen1560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1561"/>A kin peren kin ia, I ap pan sauasa i, a asa mar ai, I ap pan sinsila i.<l eID="gen1561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1562"/>A pan likwir dong ia, I ap pan sapeng i, I pan iang i ni wasa apwal, I pan kapitila i o kalinganada i.<l eID="gen1562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1563"/>I pan kamedi kin i maur warai, o I pan kasale ong i ai sauas.<chapter eID="Ps.91"/> <l eID="gen1563" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1547"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: IET me kasampwal: Danke Ieowa, o kauleki psalm akan ong mar omui, ir me kotin lapaplap.<l eID="gen1565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1566"/>Ni mansang omui kalangan o ni pong omui melel en lolok sili.<l eID="gen1566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1567"/>Sang kasang sal eisok o arp o laute.<l eID="gen1567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1568"/>Pwe kom kotin kaperen kin ia, Maing Ieowa ki ar wiawia; i pan ngisingiski dodok en lim ar akan.<l eID="gen1568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1569"/>Meid laud ar wiawia kan, Maing Ieowa! O meid lol kupur omui!<l eID="gen1569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1570"/>Aramas pweipwei men sota kak dedeki mepukat, o me rotorot amen sota kin insenoki.<l eID="gen1570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1571"/>Me doo sang Kot akan kin wosada dueta rä, o me katiwo kan karos kin masal pasang, lao re pan lokidokila kokolata.<l eID="gen1571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1572"/>A komui ta Maing Ieowa, me lapalapia, o komui pan duedueta.<l eID="gen1572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1573"/>Pwe kom kotin mangi duen ar imwintiti kan, Maing Ieowa, kom kotin mangi, ar imwintiti kan pan soredi, o me morsued akan en kamueit pasang.<l eID="gen1573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1574"/>A ai ose pan pwaida dueta os en man ose tapot, o i pan keikidier le kap.<l eID="gen1574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1575"/>O por en mas ai pan perenki ai imwintiti kan, o salong ai pan polauleki me morsued akan, me kin palian ia.<l eID="gen1575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1576"/>Me pung o pan pwaida mau dueta ni pot, a pan kakairida dueta seder en Lipanon.<l eID="gen1576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1577"/>Me patidier nan tanpas en Ieowa, pan pwaida mon pera saraui en atail Kot.<l eID="gen1577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1578"/>Menda ma re pan mala, pwe re pan pil masal pasang, o wa, o kelail.<l eID="gen1578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1579"/>Pwe re pan kasaleda, me Kot me pung, i ai paip o sota sapung mi re a.<chapter eID="Ps.92"/> <l eID="gen1579" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1564"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: IEOWA kotin kaunda, a kotin kapwateki pein i manaman, Ieowa kotin kalikauwiada pein i, a kotin piraki pein i manaman; pil sappa me tengeteng o sota pan mokimokid.<l eID="gen1581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1582"/>Sang mas lel met mol omui me tengeteng; komui me soutuk.<l eID="gen1582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1583"/>Maing Ieowa pil akan lalaudala, pil akan ngiringirsok, pil akan pil pan kokodo o ngiringirsok.<l eID="gen1583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1584"/>Ieowa kotikot wasa ileile. A manaman sang ngil en pil kalaimun akan o iluk en madau kalaimun akan.<l eID="gen1584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1585"/>Omui masan akan meid pung. Tanpas omui me linganaki saraui kokolata, Maing Ieowa.<chapter eID="Ps.93"/> <l eID="gen1585" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1580"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, komui saundepuk, Ieowa Kot saundepuk, kom kotin sansaleda!<l eID="gen1587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1588"/>Kom kotida, komui saunkapung en sappa, kom kotin depuk ong wiawia en me aklapalap akan.<l eID="gen1588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1589"/>Maing Ieowa, arai da me doo sang Kot akan, arai da me doo sang Kot akan pan poponmasu,<l eID="gen1589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1590"/>O pudupudada lokaia sued o arai da, me sapung kan karos en suaiki ar morsued?<l eID="gen1590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1591"/>Re kin tiakedi sapwilim omui aramas akan, o re kame omui soso;<l eID="gen1591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1592"/>Re kin kamela li odi o men wai, o patik takain wor en me sapoupou kan,<l eID="gen1592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1593"/>Rap inda: Ieowa sota kak kilang, o Kot en Iakop sota pan asa due.<l eID="gen1593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1594"/>Komail me pweipwei nan pung en aramas akan, en dedeki! O komail lolepon akan, iad me komail pan lolekongala?<l eID="gen1594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1595"/>Me kotin wiadar salong, o a sota pan ereki? Me kotin wiadar por en mas o, a sota pan kak masani?<l eID="gen1595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1596"/>Me kin kotin kaunda wei kan, a sota pan kaloke? Pwe i me kotin kalolekongi aramas.<l eID="gen1596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1597"/>Ieowa kotin mangi lamelam en aramas akan, me re aklapalap.<l eID="gen1597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1598"/>Meid pai ol o, me kom kotin kaloke, Maing, Ieowa, o me kom kotin padaki ong sang nan ar masan akan.<l eID="gen1598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1599"/>Pwen kanongama ni a apwal akan, lao sousou en me doo sang Kot akan pan weweida.<l eID="gen1599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1600"/>Pwe Ieowa sota pan kotin kasela sapwilim a aramas akan, o a sota pan muei sang a soso.<l eID="gen1600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1601"/>Pwe me pung, pan pungpungeta, i me lelapok kan karos pan weweideki.<l eID="gen1601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1602"/>Is me pan sauasa ia ong me morsued akan? O is me pan sauasa ia ong me dipan akan?<l eID="gen1602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1603"/>Ma Ieowa sota kotin sauasa ia, metar ekis ngen i pan kolang wasan kapormen.<l eID="gen1603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1604"/>Ni ai indada: Nä i pan krisedi, omui kalangan, Maing Ieowa, pan kolekol ia.<l eID="gen1604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1605"/>Ai insensued laud nan mongiong i, a omui kotin kamait ia la kaperenda ngen i.<l eID="gen1605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1606"/>Kom sota man paroki ong mol o, me kin kasapungala sapwilim omui masan.<l eID="gen1606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1607"/>Re kin onop ong kamela me pung amen, o re kin kadeikada nta makelekel.<l eID="gen1607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1608"/>A Ieowa ai paip lapalap, o Kot iei paip, me i pan rukila ia.<l eID="gen1608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1609"/>A pan kotin depuk ong ir ar me sued, o a pan kotin kame ir ala, pweki ar katiwo, Ieowa atail Kot pan kame ir ala.<chapter eID="Ps.94"/> <l eID="gen1609" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: KOMAIL kodo, pwe kitail pan kapinga Ieowa o ngisingis ong paip en maur atail.<l eID="gen1611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1612"/>Kitail pan kola tuki ong i kaping. Kitail en ngisingiski ong i psalm!<l eID="gen1612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1613"/>Pwe Ieowa Kot lapalap amen, o Nanmarki lapalap amen pon angin kot akan karos.<l eID="gen1613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1614"/>Pan sappa mi ni lim a, o pon komon nana me sapwilim a.<l eID="gen1614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1615"/>Madau me sapwilim a, pwe i me kotin wiadar, o lim a kan wiadar wasa madekong.<l eID="gen1615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1616"/>Komail kodo, kitail pan kaudok, o dairukedi, o kelepuki mon Ieowa, me kotin wia kitail dar.<l eID="gen1616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1617"/>Pwe i atail Kot, a kitail aramas en sapwilim a wasan kamanga o pwin en lim a. Ran wet, ma komail pan rong kapitie,<l eID="gen1617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1618"/>Komail der kapitakaila mongiong omail, duen a wiauier Meripa o ni ran en Masa nan sap tan,<l eID="gen1618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1619"/>Ni sam omail akan songesong ia o kasau ia da, pwe re kilanger ai dodok kan.<l eID="gen1619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1620"/>Par paeisok I suede kilar di wet, o I indada: Mongiong en song en aramas duen met kin wukiwuk sili, o re sota men asa duen al ai kan.<l eID="gen1620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1621"/>I ap kaula ni ai makar: Irail sota pan konodi ai kamol.<chapter eID="Ps.95"/> <l eID="gen1621" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1610"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: KAKAULEKI ong Ieowa kaul kap pot, sap karos en kakauli ong Ieowa!<l eID="gen1623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1624"/>Kakaul ong Ieowa o kapinga mar a; padapadak sang eu ran lel eu duen a maur!<l eID="gen1624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1625"/>Kasokasoi ong men liki kan wau i, o ong wei kan a manaman akan!<l eID="gen1625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1626"/>Pwe Ieowa meid lapalap o meid kapingan, o meid kalom mon kot akan karos.<l eID="gen1626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1627"/>Pwe Kot en aramas akan me mal a Ieowa kotin kapikadar lang akan.<l eID="gen1627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1628"/>Wau o lingan mi mon silang i, manaman o lingan kin kadirela nan tanpas a im saraui.<l eID="gen1628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1629"/>Komail men liki kan, ki ong Ieowa, ki ong Ieowa lingan o manaman.<l eID="gen1629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1630"/>Komail ki ong Ieowa lingan en mar a; komail ko dong mon sapwilim a pera saraui iangaki kisakis.<l eID="gen1630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1631"/>Komail kaudoki ong Ieowa ni omail kapwat saraui, toun sappa karos en masak i.<l eID="gen1631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1632"/>Komail kaireki ong men liki kan: Ieowa ta Nanmarki! Pil sappa me tengeteng o sota pan mokimokid. A pan kotin kaunda kainok kan ni tiak pung.<l eID="gen1632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1633"/>Lang en peren kida, o sappa en popol; madau en ngirngirsok o audepa!<l eID="gen1633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1634"/>Sap en pereperen o audepa karos, o tuka en nan wel karos en ngisingis.<l eID="gen1634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1635"/>Ong Ieowa, ni a kotido, ni a kotido, en kadeikada sappa. A pan kotin kaunda sappa ni tiak pung, o kainok kan ni a melel.<chapter eID="Ps.96"/> <l eID="gen1635" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1622"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: IEOWA ta Nanmarki, i me sappa en polaule kida o dake kan karos en pereperen!<l eID="gen1637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1638"/>Tapok o rotorot mi imp a, pung o melel iei pason en mol a.<l eID="gen1638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1639"/>Kisiniai kin tiong mo a, o isikeda sapwilim a imwintiti kan karos.<l eID="gen1639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1640"/>Sapwilim a liol akan kin kamaraini sappa, toun sappa kin kilang ap masapwekadar.<l eID="gen1640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1641"/>Nana kan pei pasang dueta kris mon Ieowa, Kaun en sap karos.<l eID="gen1641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1642"/>Lang akan kaparokki a pung, o kainok karos kin kilang a lingan.<l eID="gen1642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1643"/>Me kaudoki ong dikedik en ani kan en sarodi, o me kin suaiki ani kan; kot akan karos dairukedi ong mo a!<l eID="gen1643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1644"/>Sion kin rong mepukat ap peren kida, o peinekap en Iuda kan kin polauleki omui kapung kan, Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen1644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1645"/>Pwe komui ta Maing Ieowa me lapalap nan sappa karos, komui meid ileila sang Kot akan karos.<l eID="gen1645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1646"/>Komail me kin pok ong Ieowa en tataki me sued. A kin kotin apwali ngen en sapwilim a lelapok kan. A pan kotin dore ir ala sang nan pa en me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1647"/>Marain pan dakadang me pung kan, o peren ong me lelapok melel.<l eID="gen1647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1648"/>Komail me pung kan perenki Ieowa o kapinga mar a saraui!<chapter eID="Ps.97"/> <l eID="gen1648" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1636"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: KAKAULEKI ong Ieowa kaul kap pot; pwe a kotin wiadar dodok kapuriamui. A kotin kaloe kidi lim a pali maun o lim a saraui.<l eID="gen1650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1651"/>Ieowa kotin kasaledar a kamaur, o mon mas en kainok kan a kotin kasansaledar a pung.<l eID="gen1651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1652"/>A kotin kolekol ong men Israel a kalangan o melel; imwin sap karos kin kilang pai en atail Kot.<l eID="gen1652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1653"/>Sap karos en ngisingis ong Ieowa! Popol o kauleki psalm!<l eID="gen1653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1654"/>Kauleki ong Ieowa psalm iangaki laute, wiada laute o kaul!<l eID="gen1654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1655"/>Iang trompete o ngil en koronete, komail ngisingis ong Nanmarki Ieowa!<l eID="gen1655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1656"/>Madau en ngiringirsok o audepa, sappa o tou a kan;<l eID="gen1656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1657"/>Pilap akan en lopolopeki pa arail; o nana kan en pereperenki.<l eID="gen1657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1658"/>Ieowa, ni a kotidon kadeikada sappa. A pan kotin kadeikada sappa nin tiak pung o kainok kan nin tiak inen.<chapter eID="Ps.98"/> <l eID="gen1658" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1649"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: IEOWA ta kotin kakaunda; kainok kan kin rerer; a kotikot nan pung en Kerup akan, sappa kin mokimokid.<l eID="gen1660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1661"/>Ieowa me lapalap nan Sion, o lapalap melel sang wei kan karos.<l eID="gen1661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1662"/>Ren kapinga mar omui, me lapalap o kalom, i me saraui.<l eID="gen1662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1663"/>O manaman en Nanmarki me kin pok ong me pung. Kom kotin katengedier tiak pung. Komui me kotin wiadar me pung o inen nan kadaudok en Iakop.<l eID="gen1663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1664"/>Kapinga Ieowa atail Kot o poridier ong ni utipa, pwe i me saraui!<l eID="gen1664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1665"/>Moses o Aron kisan sapwilim a samero kan o Samuel nan pung en ir, me kin likwir ong mar a, re likwir wonger Ieowa, i ap kotin mangi ir.<l eID="gen1665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1666"/>A kotin masan ong irail sang nan ur en tapok; irail peiki ong a masan o kusoned akan, me a kotiki ong irail er.<l eID="gen1666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1667"/>Ieowa at Kot, kom kotin sapeng irail er. Maing Kot kom kotin maki ong irail er, o kotin depuk ong ir ar sapung kan.<l eID="gen1667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1668"/>Kapinga Ieowa atail Kot, o poridier ni sapwilim a nana saraui, pwe Ieowa atail Kot me saraui.<chapter eID="Ps.99"/> <l eID="gen1668" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: NGISINGIS ong Ieowa sap karos!<l eID="gen1670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1671"/>Papang Ieowa ki peren; koki dong mon silang i nisinis!<l eID="gen1671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1672"/>Komail en asa, me Ieowa Kot. I me kotin wia kitail dar — a kaidin pein kitail — pwen sapwilim a aramas o sip en sapwilim a pwin.<l eID="gen1672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1673"/>Pedelong ong nan sapwilim a wanim laud ki danke, o kaul en kaping mon sapwilim a pera saraui. Danke i o kapinga mar a!<l eID="gen1673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1674"/>Pwe Ieowa me mau, a kalangan soutuk, o a melel pan due lueta kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.100"/> <l eID="gen1674" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1669"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: I pan kauleki duen kalangan o pung; i pan kauleki psalm akan ong komui. Maing Ieowa.<l eID="gen1676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1677"/>I men inen eweita ni al pung — iad kom pan koti dong ia? — i men weweid ni melel ren toun im ai.<l eID="gen1677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1678"/>I sota men wia morsued; i tataki wiawian me dipan akan, a sota pan pat ong ia.<l eID="gen1678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1679"/>Mongiong sapung pan muei sang ia; i sota men asa duen me sued.<l eID="gen1679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1680"/>Me kin rir karaunemali men impa, i pan kamela; i suedeki me aklapalap ni mas ar o mongiong arail.<l eID="gen1680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1681"/>Mas ai pan apapwali me melel akan nan sap o, pwe ren kauson re i; me kin weweid ni al pung, pan papa ia.<l eID="gen1681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1682"/>Me kin kotaue, sota pan kauson nan im ai, me kin likam, sota pan pwaida mon mas ai.<l eID="gen1682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1683"/>Ni mansang karos i pan kawela me katiwo nan sap o, pwen kokosang kanim en Ieowa karos, me kin wia sapung.<chapter eID="Ps.101"/> <l eID="gen1683" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: IEOWA, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o ai weriwer en lel ong komui!<l eID="gen1685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1686"/>Kom der kotin karirala silang ir mo i ni ran en ai apwal; kom kotin kapaike dong ia karong omui kan; ni ran o, me i likelikwir, kom kotin mangi ia madang!<l eID="gen1686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1687"/>Pwe ai ran akan kin tangwei dueta adiniai, o kokon ai kan rongalar dueta nan kisiniai.<l eID="gen1687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1688"/>Kapedi mongedier dueta rä, i me i monoke kila ai mangamanga.<l eID="gen1688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1689"/>Kokon o uduk ai mong penaer pweki ai weriwer o sangesang.<l eID="gen1689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1690"/>Ngai rasong pelikan nan sap tan, o rasong däap nan wasa liseliping.<l eID="gen1690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1691"/>I kin papad o rasong manpir kelep amen, me mondi pon os en im o.<l eID="gen1691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1692"/>Ai imwintiti kin lalaue ia sang ni mansang lel ni sautik, o me palian ia, kin kaula kin ia.<l eID="gen1692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1693"/>Pwe i kin kangkang pas dueta prot, o lim ai pil kin doloki pil en mas ai.<l eID="gen1693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1694"/>Pweki omui ongiong o ongiong melel; pwe kom kotin pok ia da, ap kase ia di.<l eID="gen1694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1695"/>Ai ran akan tangwei dueta mota, o i mongedier dueta rä.<l eID="gen1695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1696"/>A komui Maing Ieowa pan kotikoteta kokolata, o kupur omui pan sang eu kainok lel eu potopoteta.<l eID="gen1696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1697"/>Kom pan kotida o kupurela Sion, pwe ansau leler, me kom pan kotin mak ong i, a auer leler.<l eID="gen1697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1698"/>Pwe sapwilim omui ladu kan kin pok ong takai (en Sion), o re insensuedeki moan im akan;<l eID="gen1698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1699"/>O men liki kan pan masak mar en Ieowa, o Nanmarki en sap akan karos omui lingan.<l eID="gen1699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1700"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin kauadar Sion. A kotin pwarada ni a lingan.<l eID="gen1700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1701"/>A kotin wukedoke dong kapakap en me samama o, o a sota kotin mamaleki a kapakap.<l eID="gen1701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1702"/>Mepukat pan kileledi ong kainok en mur akan; o wei eu, me pan wiaui, pan kapinga Ieowa.<l eID="gen1702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1703"/>Pwe a kotin irerong sang mol a saraui ileile; Ieowa kotin irerong sappa sang nanlang.<l eID="gen1703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1704"/>Pwen ereki sangesang en me salidi kan, pwen lapwada, me kileledi onger kamela.<l eID="gen1704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1705"/>Pwe mar en Ieowa en lolok sili nan Sion, o a kapingapa nan Ierusalem.<l eID="gen1705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1706"/>Kainok kan lao pokon pena o wei kan, pwen papa ong Ieowa.<l eID="gen1706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1707"/>A kotiki sanger ai kelail pon al o, a kamotemotelar ai ran akan.<l eID="gen1707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1708"/>I potoan ong: Ai Kot, kom der kotikiwei sang ia ni apali en ai ran akan. Omui par akan kin sang eu kainok lel eu kokolata.<l eID="gen1708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1709"/>Kom kotin kasonedier sappa mas o, o lang pokon me dodok en lim omui.<l eID="gen1709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1710"/>Irail pan sorela, a kom pan kotikot eta. Irail pan maringala rasong tuk en likau eu. Kom pan kotin kawuk ir ala likamata likau eu, irail ap pan wukila.<l eID="gen1710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1711"/>A kom pan deudueta o ansaun omui roson sota pan tukedi.<l eID="gen1711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1712"/>Nain sapwilim omui ladu kan pan mimieta, o kadaudok a pan pwaida re omui.<chapter eID="Ps.102"/> <l eID="gen1712" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1684"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: Ngen i kapinga Ieowa o lol i mar a saraui!<l eID="gen1714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1715"/>Ngen i kapinga Ieowa, o der monokela a kotin wiawia mau ong uk!<l eID="gen1715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1716"/>Me kotin makeki ong uk dip om karos, ap kotin kamauiala om somau kan.<l eID="gen1716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1717"/>Me kotin dore uk ala sang ni wasa apwal, me kotin ninie kin uk mak o kalangan;<l eID="gen1717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1718"/>Me kotin kapai uk adar ni om malar, o kotin kapulpul uk ala dueta adler.<l eID="gen1718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1719"/>En Ieowa a wiawia me pung, o a kotin kapungala, me mi ni kalokolok sapung.<l eID="gen1719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1720"/>A kotin kasale ong Moses al en a meakaros, o ong men Israil a wiawia kan.<l eID="gen1720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1721"/>Ieowa me dir en kalangan o mak, a kin kotin kanongama, o a kalangan me lapalap.<l eID="gen1721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1722"/>A sota kin kotin kaloke aramas ansau karos, o pil sota ongiong kokolata.<l eID="gen1722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1723"/>A sota kotin pwain ong kitail duen dip atail, o sota depuk ong kitail duen atail sapung kan.<l eID="gen1723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1724"/>A duen ileile en lang sang sappa, iduen a mak lapalap ong ir, me kin masak i.<l eID="gen1724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1725"/>Duen mas en lang o kapin lang ara doo pasang, iduen a kotin kadooana wei sang kitail dip atail.<l eID="gen1725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1726"/>Duen sam amen pokepoke na seri, iduen Kot kotin kupukupura irail, me lan i.<l eID="gen1726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1727"/>Pwe a kotin mangi, da me kitail wiaui kida, a kotin mangi, me kitail me pwel par.<l eID="gen1727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1728"/>Aramas amen kin rasong rä, a kin masal pasang dueta wantuka nan sap o.<l eID="gen1728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1729"/>Ma kisiniang pan leler, a soer mia, o a solar asa deu a.<l eID="gen1729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1730"/>A kalangan en Ieowa pan duedueta kokolata ong ir, me lan i, o a melel ong seri en seri kan,<l eID="gen1730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1731"/>Ong ir, me kin kolekol a inau, o madamadaua duen a masan kan, pwen kapwaiada.<l eID="gen1731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1732"/>Ieowa kotin kauada mol a nanlang, o a kotin kaunda meakan karos.<l eID="gen1732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1733"/>Kapikapinga Ieowa, komail sapwilim a tounlang kan, komail me lapalap akan ni manaman, me kin kapwaiada a masan kan, o peiki ong moat en a masan!<l eID="gen1733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1734"/>Kapikapinga Ieowa sapwilim a pokon akan karos, o sapwilim a ladu kan, me kin kapwaiada kupur a!<l eID="gen1734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1735"/>Kapikapinga Ieowa sapwilim a dipisou kan ni wasa karos, me a kotin kakaun, ngen i kapinga Ieowa!<chapter eID="Ps.103"/> <l eID="gen1735" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1713"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: NGEN i kapinga Ieowa! Ieowa ai Kot, komui meid lapalap, komui me kapwateki lingan o manaman.<l eID="gen1737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1738"/>Sapwilim ar likau iei marain, me komui kot lole; kom kotin pak pasang nanlang dueta likau eu.<l eID="gen1738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1739"/>Kom kin kotin wia kida pil pali poa en ponepon, a tapok kan wiala tan war omui, me kom kin kotikot sili ki pa en ang.<l eID="gen1739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1740"/>Kom me kotin wia kila sapwilim omui tounlang kan kisiniang o sapwilim ar ladu kan umpul en kisiniai.<l eID="gen1740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1741"/>A kotin kasonedier sappa pon a pason, a sota pan mokid kokolata.<l eID="gen1741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1742"/>Kom kotin kadupale kidi i dueta likau eu, pil akan ileilada sang nana kan.<l eID="gen1742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1743"/>Re tang wei mon ar masan, re madang wei mon ngil en omui nansapwe.<l eID="gen1743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1744"/>Nana kan kokodar, a wau kan kokodier ong wasa, me kom kotin kileledier ong ir.<l eID="gen1744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1745"/>Kom kotiki ong ir irair eu, me re sota pan dauli wei; re solar pan pur ong kadupaledi sappa.<l eID="gen1745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1746"/>Kom kin kotin wiada, parer en kusukusda nan wau kan; re kin pwilipwil wei nan pung en nana kan.<l eID="gen1746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1747"/>Re kotin kanim pileda man en nan sap akan o man en nan wel.<l eID="gen1747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1748"/>Manpir en pan lang kin kaukauson ni kail a, re kin kakaul nin tuka kan.<l eID="gen1748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1749"/>Komui me kin kotin kanim pileda nana kan sang sapwilim omui pera poa. Kom kin kotin kadire kila wa kan sappa, me kom kotin wiadar.<l eID="gen1749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1750"/>Komui me kotin kawosadang man akan rä, o wan tuka me mau ong aramas, pwen kapwareda sang nan pwel manga ong aramas akan.<l eID="gen1750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1751"/>O wain en kaperenda mongiong en aramas, o le en kalinganada mas en aramas, o prot en kakelada war en aramas.<l eID="gen1751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1752"/>Sapwilim en Ieowa tuka kan pan medila, seder en Lipanon akan, me a kotin padukedier.<l eID="gen1752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1753"/>Wasa manpir kin pas kin ia, o raier kauson nan seder.<l eID="gen1753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1754"/>Nana ileile iei deun kemse, a paip akan deun repit en wel.<l eID="gen1754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1755"/>A kotin wiadar saunipong, pwen kilelekidi ansau kan, katipin asa wasa me a pan kirila ia.<l eID="gen1755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1756"/>Kom kin kotin wiada pong, man en nan wel rap mokidada.<l eID="gen1756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1757"/>Laien pulepul weriwerki kan arail manga, re kin idok ren Kot, me re pan kang.<l eID="gen1757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1758"/>Katipin lao dakada, re kin purela wonon nan por ar akan.<l eID="gen1758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1759"/>Aramas ap kolang ar dodok, wia sapasap lel nin sautik.<l eID="gen1759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1760"/>Maing Ieowa, ar wiawia kan me dodok melel! Kom kotin kasone irail di ki omui erpit o sappa me direki sapwilim omui dipisou kan.<l eID="gen1760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1761"/>Madau me kalaimun o dälap ni pali karos; i wasa me dir en mam, me sota kak wadawad, man tikitik o kalaimun.<l eID="gen1761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1762"/>I wasa me sop akan kin tangatang ia, o walros, me komui kotin wiadar, kin madomadong lole.<l eID="gen1762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1763"/>Ir karos kin auiaui komui, pwe komui en kotin katungole kin ir kan arail ni ar ansau.<l eID="gen1763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1764"/>Kom kin kotiki ong ir, rap nanak pena; komui kotiki pasang lim omui, rap pan medi kila me mau kan.<l eID="gen1764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1765"/>Ni omui pan karirila silang omui, rap pan masapwekada, kom kin kotiki sang ir angiang arail, rap pan mela o purelang ar pwel par.<l eID="gen1765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1766"/>Kom kin kotin kadarala ang omui, rap pan wiauiada, o komui kin kawilikapada mas en sap o.<l eID="gen1766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1767"/>Lingan en Ieowa pan duedueta. Ieowa pan kotin peren kida sapwilim a wiawia kan.<l eID="gen1767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1768"/>A lao kotin irerong toun sappa, sappa ap rerer; a lao kotin sair nana kan, rap adida.<l eID="gen1768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1769"/>Arain ai maur i pan kakauli ong Ieowa, o arain ai mi sappa et, i pan kauleki psalm kan ong ai Kot.<l eID="gen1769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1770"/>I men, ai kasokasoi en kaparenda kupur a; i pan polauleki Ieowa.<l eID="gen1770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1771"/>Me dipan akan en niki sang sappa, o me doo sang Kot akan en sola mia. Ngen i kalingada Ieowa! Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.104"/> <l eID="gen1771" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1736"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: KAPINGA Ieowa, likwir wong mar a, kapakaparoki ong kainok kan duen a wiawia kan.<l eID="gen1773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1774"/>Kauli ong i, kauliki ong i psalm akan, kasokasoi duen a manaman akan karos;<l eID="gen1774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1775"/>Peren kida mar a saraui; mongiong en me rapaki Ieowa, en popol.<l eID="gen1775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1776"/>Komail inong iong Ieowa o a manaman; rapaki silang i ansau karos.<l eID="gen1776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1777"/>Tamatamanda sapwilim a dodok kapuriamui, me a kotin wiadar, o a manaman akan o masan en kadeik sang nan silang i.<l eID="gen1777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1778"/>Kadaudok en Apraam koe sapwilim a ladu, o nain Israel komail, me a kotin piladar!<l eID="gen1778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1779"/>I Ieowa atail Kot; a kotin kaunda nan sap karos.<l eID="gen1779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1780"/>A kin kotin tamanda sapwilim a inau kokolata, masan o me a kotin inauki onger di kid.<l eID="gen1780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1781"/>Inau me a kotin wiadang Apraam, o a kaula, me a kotin kauki ong Isaak.<l eID="gen1781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1782"/>O a kotiki ong Iakop kusoned eu, o ong Israel inau soutuk,<l eID="gen1782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1783"/>Ni a kotin masanier: I pan ki ong uk Kanaan, iei me I kileledier, en pwais omail soso;<l eID="gen1783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1784"/>I ansau, me irail pwin tikitik eu, o men kairu nan sap o.<l eID="gen1784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1785"/>Ni ar kokola sang eu kainok lel eu, o sang eu wei lel eu.<l eID="gen1785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1786"/>A sota kotin mueid ong amen aramas, en katoutou irail, o a kotin kaloke nanmarki kai pweki irail.<l eID="gen1786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1787"/>Komail der sair nai me keidier akan, o der wiai ong ai saukop akan me sued kot!<l eID="gen1787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1788"/>A lao kotiki ong sap o ansaun lek; o kotin kawelar wasan kaporopor en manga,<l eID="gen1788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1789"/>A kotin poronelar ol amen mo ’rail; Iosep, me netilar, pwen wiala ladu men.<l eID="gen1789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1790"/>Nä a kan kalokolokki sal mata, o pali war a wonon nan mata,<l eID="gen1790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1791"/>Lao ansau me sapwilim a masan pwarado; masan en Ieowa kamakelekeleda i.<l eID="gen1791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1792"/>Nanmarki ap ilakila, pwen lapwada i, iei kaun en wei kan, me kotin kamaioda i.<l eID="gen1792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1793"/>A kasapwiladang i pein im a, o kaun en a dipisou karos.<l eID="gen1793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1794"/>Pwen saliedi a saupeidi kan duen me a mauki, o padaki ong sapwilim a lapalap akan lolekong.<l eID="gen1794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1795"/>O Israel lipalang Äkipten, o Iakop wiala men kairu nan sap en Am.<l eID="gen1795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1796"/>I ansau Kot kotin kapara irail ada madang, o kotin kakelail ir ada sang a imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1797"/>A kotin kawukila kupur a, pwen kailongki sapwilim a aramas akan, o widiwiding ong sapwilim a ladu kan.<l eID="gen1797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1798"/>A ap kotin poronela Moses, sapwilim a ladu, o Aron, me a kotin piladar.<l eID="gen1798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1799"/>Ira wiadar manaman akai nan pung ar, o dodok kapuriamui nan sap en Am.<l eID="gen1799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1800"/>A kotin kadarado rotorot, ap pong pena, o re sota insenoki a masan kan.<l eID="gen1800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1801"/>A kotin kawuk ong nta ar pil akan, o kamelar ar man akan.<l eID="gen1801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1802"/>Sap arail me direki pros lao lel ong nan pera en ar nanmarki kan.<l eID="gen1802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1803"/>A kotin masanier, long sued ap rokilar, o amuse nan sap karos.<l eID="gen1803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1804"/>A kotiki ong ir akel wiliandi katau, umpul en kisiniai nan sap ar.<l eID="gen1804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1805"/>A kotin kawelar ar tuka en wain akan o tuka en paiken, o kotin katip pasang tuka en sap ar akan.<l eID="gen1805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1806"/>A kotin masanier, mansiok o long ap pwarada, rap pwaradar o re sota kak wadawad.<l eID="gen1806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1807"/>Rap kangala tuka kan karos nan sap o, o kangala wantuka kan nan matuel o.<l eID="gen1807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1808"/>O a kotin kamelar meseni karos nan sap arail, meseni karos en ar kelail.<l eID="gen1808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1809"/>O a kotin kalua irail sang nan sap o iangaki silper o kold, o sota me luet nan pung en ar kainok kan.<l eID="gen1809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1810"/>Äkipten peren kida ar samalar, pwe re masapwekadar.<l eID="gen1810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1811"/>A kotin wiada tapok en kadupal irail edi, o kisiniai en sereda irail ni pong.<l eID="gen1811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1812"/>Irail poekipoeki, i ap kotin kadarado manpir akan; o a kotin kamanga kin ir prot en nanlang.<l eID="gen1812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1813"/>A kotin palang pasang paip o, pil akan ap kuskus wei sang, re pwilipwile wei nan sap tan dueta pilap pot.<l eID="gen1813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1814"/>Pwe a kotin tamanda a masan saraui, o sapwilim a ladu Apraam.<l eID="gen1814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1815"/>A kotin kaluaki peren sapwilim a aramas akan sang nan sap o, o ngisingis sapwilim a pilipildar akan!<l eID="gen1815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1816"/>A ap kotiki ong ir sap en men liki kan, o re aleer dipisou en kainok kan.<l eID="gen1816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1817"/>Pwe ren peiki ong sapwilim a masan kan o kolekol a kusoned akan. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.105"/> <l eID="gen1817" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: KAPINGA Ieowa, pwe i me mau, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen1819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1820"/>Is me kak inda duen dodok manaman en Ieowa, o is me kak kapinga sapwilim a dodok kasapwal?<l eID="gen1820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1821"/>Meid pai, me kolekol me pung, o me kin wiada me pung ansau karos!<l eID="gen1821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1822"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin taman ia da duen ar kalangan, me kom kotin inauki ong sapwilim omui aramas akan, kasansale dong kit omui sauas!<l eID="gen1822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1823"/>Pwe i en kilang pai en sapwilim omui pilipildar akan o peren kidar peren en sapwilim omui aramas akan, o kapinga iang omui soso.<l eID="gen1823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1824"/>Kit iang sam at oko wiadar dip, se wiadar sapung, se kawelar kusoned o kapwaiada tiak en me pung kan.<l eID="gen1824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1825"/>Sam at akan nan Äkipten sota insenoki sapwilim omui manaman akan, pwe re sota tamanda omui kalangan lapalap, o re katiwo ong me lapalap o ni kailan madau ni sed waitata.<l eID="gen1825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1826"/>Ari so, a kotin dore ir ala pweki mar a, pwen kasaleda a manaman.<l eID="gen1826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1827"/>A kotin masani ong sed waitata, ap ngalangaledier; o a kotin kalua irail wasa lol dueta sap tan eu.<l eID="gen1827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1828"/>Iduen a kotin dore ir ala sang nan pa en me kailong kin ir, o a kotin sauasa ir sang nan pa en imwintiti;<l eID="gen1828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1829"/>Pil kadupaledi arail imwintiti kan, sota amen pitila.<l eID="gen1829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1830"/>Irail ap kamelele a masan akan, o kaul en kaping ong i.<l eID="gen1830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1831"/>A re pil madang monokelar a wiawia kan, o re sota auiaui a masan.<l eID="gen1831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1832"/>Irail dire kila inong sued, ap kasongesong. Kot nan sap tan,<l eID="gen1832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1833"/>Ap kotin mueid ong insen arail, o kotiki ong ir, lol ar lao suedala.<l eID="gen1833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1834"/>Re ap kangudi ong Moses nan deu ’rail, ong Aron me saraui en Ieowa men.<l eID="gen1834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1835"/>Sap ap sar pasang katalala Datan, o pur penang pon pwin en Apiram.<l eID="gen1835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1836"/>O kisiniai eu kamasikada nan pung en arail pwin, umpul en kisiniai eu karongalar me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen1836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1837"/>Re wiadar kau pul amen ni Orep, o dairukedi sang mon kilel kold eu.<l eID="gen1837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1838"/>O re kawilianeki arail lingan kilel en kau ol amen, me kin kangkang rä.<l eID="gen1838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1839"/>Re monokelar Kot, arail saunkamaur, me kotin wiadar dodok lapalap nan Äkipten.<l eID="gen1839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1840"/>O manaman akan nan sap en Am, o men kamasak ni sed waitata.<l eID="gen1840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1841"/>I ap kotin kupukupura, me a pan kame ir ala, ma Moses sapwilim a pilipildar amen sota pan pukoki dip arail, pwen kotiki wei sang sapwilim a ongiong, pwe ren der mela.<l eID="gen1841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1842"/>A re mamaleki sap kaselel, o sota kamelele a masan kan.<l eID="gen1842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1843"/>O re lipaned nan im arail, o sota peiki ong masan en Ieowa.<l eID="gen1843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1844"/>I ap kotin kaula ong ir, me a pan kame ir ala nan sap tan.<l eID="gen1844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1845"/>O kadaudok ar en wowokidi nan pung en men liki kan, o kamueit ir pasang nan sap akan.<l eID="gen1845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1846"/>O re wuki ong Pal-Peor, o kangala kisan mairong en ani mal.<l eID="gen1846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1847"/>O re kupur sued kin i ar wiawia kan, kalokolok eu ap lel ong ir.<l eID="gen1847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1848"/>Pineas ap kotida, kadeik irail ada, kalokolok ap imwisokalar.<l eID="gen1848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1849"/>Mepukat me a wadekida ni pung, sang eu kainok lel eu kokolata.<l eID="gen1849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1850"/>O re kupur suede kin i ni pil en Meripa, i me irail kareki ong Moses apwal laud.<l eID="gen1850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1851"/>Pwe re kapataui ngen i, ap kotin sapungala ekis ni a masan kan.<l eID="gen1851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
