verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1852"/>Re sota pil kanikiala wei kan, me Ieowa kotin masani ong ir.<l eID="gen1852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1853"/>O re dolola men liki kan, o padakki arail tiak kan.<l eID="gen1853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1854"/>O re kaudoki ong arail dikedik en ani kan, rap wialar insar arail.<l eID="gen1854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1855"/>O re mairongki ong tewil sued akan nairail putak o seripein kan.<l eID="gen1855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1856"/>O re kamelar mal aramas, iei udan nair putak o seripein oko, me re mairongki ong ani mal en Kanaan, a sap o kasamin kila nta.<l eID="gen1856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1857"/>O re kasamine kila pein irail ar wia kan, o nenekki ar dodok sued.<l eID="gen1857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1858"/>Ieowa ap kotin ongiongi ong sapwilim a aramas akan o kotin suedeki sapwilim a soso.<l eID="gen1858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1859"/>A kotin mueid ong ir nan pa en men liki kan, o me kailong kin ir, wialar ar kaun.<l eID="gen1859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1860"/>O ar imwintiti katoutoui ir, o re namenokalar pan pa ’rail.<l eID="gen1860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1861"/>A kotin dore ir ala pan pak toto, a re duedueta ni ar inong sued o madamadaua, o re malaulau kilar ar sapung.<l eID="gen1861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1862"/>A a kotin irerong ar kan kangeranger, ni a kotin ereki ar weriwer.<l eID="gen1862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1863"/>O a kotin tamanda sapwilim a inau, o a kotin kalukila duen a kalangan lapalap.<l eID="gen1863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:46
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1864"/>O a kotin maki ong ir mon karos, me sali irail weier.<l eID="gen1864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:47
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1865"/>Ieowa at Kot, kom kotin dore kit ala, sang ren men liki kan, pwe kit en danke mar omui saraui o sapwilim ar dodok mau kan.<l eID="gen1865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:48
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1866"/>Kaping ong Ieowa, Kot en Israel, sang mas kokodo o pil kokolata! O aramas karos en inda: Amen, Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.106"/> <l eID="gen1866" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: KAPINGA Ieowa, pwe i me mau, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen1868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1869"/>Iduen me dorelar ren Ieowa kan pan indinda, irail me a kotin dorelar sang nan pa en arail imwintiti;<l eID="gen1869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1870"/>Me a kotin kapokon pena sang sap en mas en lang, o kapin lang, o pali apang, o sang madau.<l eID="gen1870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1871"/>Irail sansalong sili nan sap tan, pol al apwal, re sota diarada deu ’rail.<l eID="gen1871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1872"/>Re men mangadar o men nim piladar, o kaped arail luetalar.<l eID="gen1872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1873"/>Rap weriwer wong Ieowa ni ar kankangeranger, o a kotin dore ir sang nan ar apwal akan.<l eID="gen1873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1874"/>O a kotin kalua ir pon al pung, pwe ren lel ong wasan kaukauson.<l eID="gen1874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1875"/>Ren kapinga Ieowa, pweki a kalangan o pweki a dodok manaman ong aramas akan.<l eID="gen1875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1876"/>Pwe a kotin kamede kilar kaped en me men nim piladar, o kadir kila me mau kan kaped en me men mangadar.<l eID="gen1876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1877"/>Me mi ni wasa rotorot o mot en mela, me salikidi luet o mata.<l eID="gen1877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1878"/>Pweki ar katiwo ong masan en Kot, o ar mamaleki kusoned en ma lapalap o.<l eID="gen1878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1879"/>I ap kaloke kin ir apwal akan, re wonon, a sota sauas parail.<l eID="gen1879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1880"/>Rap weriwer wong Ieowa ni ar apwal akan, i ap kotin dore ir ala sang katoutou parail.<l eID="gen1880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1881"/>A kotin kalua ir sang nan rotorot, o mot en mela, o kotin kamueit pasang ar sal akan.<l eID="gen1881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1882"/>Ren kapinga Ieowa, pweki a kalangan o pweki a dodok manaman ong aramas akan.<l eID="gen1882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1883"/>Pwe a kotin kawela wanim mata, o a kotin suk pasang kateng mata pan wanim akan.<l eID="gen1883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1884"/>Me pweipwei kan pan kalokolokki al en ar katiwo o ar sapung kan.<l eID="gen1884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1885"/>Kaped arail kin suedeki song en manga karos, o re lel ong kailan mela.<l eID="gen1885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1886"/>Rap weriwer wong Ieowa ni ar apwal akan, i ap kotin dore ir ala sang katoutou parail.<l eID="gen1886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1887"/>A kotin kadarado sapwilim a masan, o kotin kamaur irail da, o kotin sauasa ir sang nan ar por akan.<l eID="gen1887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1888"/>Ren kapinga Ieowa pweki a kalangan o pweki a dodok mau ong aramas akan.<l eID="gen1888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1889"/>O ren mairongki mairong en kaping o kasokasoia duen a wiawia kan ki peren!<l eID="gen1889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1890"/>Me kin mi pon madau o dake sop akan, o me kin netinet pon pil kalaimun akan,<l eID="gen1890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1891"/>Irail pukat kin kilekilang wiawian Ieowa kan, o a manaman akan nan madau.<l eID="gen1891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1892"/>A kotin masan eta, melimel ap wiaui, me kin kalaudela iluk kan.<l eID="gen1892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1893"/>Re kin koda ileile o kodi loledi, likamata kaped arail pei pasan ni ar masak.<l eID="gen1893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1894"/>Re rarauk sili dueta me sakaular, o ar lolekong karos pan soredi.<l eID="gen1894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1895"/>Rap weriwer wong Ieowa ni ar apwal akan, i ap kotin dore ir ala sang katoutou parail.<l eID="gen1895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1896"/>A kotin kawuki ong mole melimel, iluk kan ap moledi.<l eID="gen1896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1897"/>Rap peren kida, ma re pan moledi, o a kotin kalua ir nan kapitau me re inong iong.<l eID="gen1897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1898"/>Ren kapinga Ieowa, pweki a kalangan, o pweki a dodok manaman ong aramas akan.<l eID="gen1898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1899"/>O ren kapinga i nan pokon en aramas, o ren kapinga i nan momod en saumas akan.<l eID="gen1899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1900"/>A kotin kawuki ong sap tan pilap akan, o utun pil akan ong sap madekong.<l eID="gen1900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1901"/>O sap kaselel eu wiala sap tan en sol, pweki dip en me kaukauson wasa o.<l eID="gen1901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1902"/>A kotin kawuki ong len pil sap tan, o sap sued ong utun pil.<l eID="gen1902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1903"/>O a kotin mueid ong me men mangadar akan, en kaukauson wasa o, o re wiadar deu arail.<l eID="gen1903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1904"/>O re kin wia sapasap o padukedi mat en wain, me kin wa ni a ansau.<l eID="gen1904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1905"/>O a kotin kamau irail la, rap kin totolar, o a kotin kangederela arail man akan.<l eID="gen1905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1906"/>O irail malaulaular o namenok kilar me sued, o sapai o luet akan.<l eID="gen1906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1907"/>A kotin wudokidi ong saupeidi kan namenok, o mueid ong ir, ren sansalong sili nan sap tan, wasa me sota al mia ia.<l eID="gen1907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1908"/>O a kotin pokada me samama o sang ni a luet, o katotolar kadaudok a dueta pwin akai.<l eID="gen1908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1909"/>Me melel akan pan kilang, ap peren kida, o sapung kan karos pan kaku pena au arail.<l eID="gen1909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1910"/>Me lolekong kan pan kasampwale ki mepukat, o re pan dedeki kalangan en Ieowa.<chapter eID="Ps.107"/> <l eID="gen1910" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1867"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, mongiong i kin moleilei; i men kakaul o kakauleki psalm akan, o pil ngen i.<l eID="gen1912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1913"/>Koma arp o laute pirida! I pan paurida nin soran.<l eID="gen1913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1914"/>I pan kapinga komui nan pung en kainok kan, Maing Ieowa, o i pan kaule kin komui nan pung en aramas akan.<l eID="gen1914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1915"/>Pwe omui kalangan me laud, ileila sang nanlang, o omui melel lelada wong tapok kan.<l eID="gen1915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1916"/>Re kotida ponangin nanlang, Maing Kot, o omui lingan en kipadi sappa.<l eID="gen1916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1917"/>Pwe kompoke pamui kan en saladokala; kom kotin sauasaki pali maun ar, o kotin ereki kit.<l eID="gen1917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1918"/>Kot kotin masanier nan sapwilim a mol saraui, i me i peren kida; i pan nek pasang Sikem o sosong sap Sukot.<l eID="gen1918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1919"/>Kilead o Manase iei sap ai; ngai kin kaunda Epraim; a Iuda iei ai sokon.<l eID="gen1919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1920"/>Moap iei ai dal en dudu; i kin tiakedi Edom; i pan ngisingisiki men Pilista.<l eID="gen1920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1921"/>Is me pan kalua ia nan kanim tengeteng eu? Is me pan iang ia lel Edom?<l eID="gen1921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1922"/>Kaidin komui ai Kot? Komui me kase kit ala, o sota iang at karis akan. Maing Kot.<l eID="gen1922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1923"/>Kom kotin ieiang kit ni at apwal akan, pwe en aramas ar sauasa sota katepa.<l eID="gen1923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1924"/>Iangaki at Kot kit pan kapwaiada dodok manaman akan. A pan kotin tiakedi at imwintiti kan.<chapter eID="Ps.108"/> <l eID="gen1924" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1911"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: MAING Kot, me i kin kapikapinga, kom der kotin sapaimokid!<l eID="gen1926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1927"/>Pwe au en me doo sang Kot, o me kin kotaue sara dong ia, re lokelokaia ong ia ki lo likam;<l eID="gen1927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1928"/>Re lokaia sued ong ia wasa karos, o pei ong ia ni so karepa.<l eID="gen1928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1929"/>Ni ai pok ong ir, re kin imwintiti ong ia; a ngai kin poten kapakap.<l eID="gen1929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1930"/>Irail depukki ai me mau me sued, o re kin tata kin ia ni ai pok ong ir.<l eID="gen1930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1931"/>Kotin kasapwiladang i me doo sang Kot amen, pwen a saunkapung o me palian i, en mi ni pali maun a.<l eID="gen1931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1932"/>Ma a pan pakasau, a pan pakadeikada, o pil a kapakap en kadipala i.<l eID="gen1932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1933"/>A ran akan en malaulaula, o a koa en ko ong amen.<l eID="gen1933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1934"/>Na seri kan en sapoupou, o a paud en li odi amen.<l eID="gen1934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1935"/>Na seri kan en sansarwaru sili o wia poekipoek, o ren rapaki kan ar manga, doo sang nan moan im arail.<l eID="gen1935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1936"/>Me norok moni en pitia sang i a meakaros, o men wai en kulia sang i a dipisou kan.<l eID="gen1936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1937"/>O sota me pan kadek ong i, o sota me pan sauasa na sapoupou kan.<l eID="gen1937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1938"/>Kadaudok a en kokoka sang; o mar arail en niki sang nin di kaieu.<l eID="gen1938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1939"/>Sapung en sam a ko en sansal mon Ieowa, o dip en in a ender lapwada.<l eID="gen1939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1940"/>Ieowa en kotin masamasan irail ansau karos, o kataman parail en niki sang nin sappa.<l eID="gen1940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1941"/>Pweki a sota man kadek, pwe a pakipaki me luet o samama, o me insensued, pwen kamela i.<l eID="gen1941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1942"/>O a inong iong en riala; ari, en lel ong! O a sota insenoki kapai, ari, en doo sang i!<l eID="gen1942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1943"/>A kapwateki me sued dueta a likau, ari, me sued en kolong lole dueta pil o nan kokon akan dueta le.<l eID="gen1943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1944"/>Me sued en rasong a likau pup, me a kin likauwiada, o rasong men pirapir me a kin pirapireki.<l eID="gen1944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1945"/>Iduen Ieowa pan kotin pwain ong me palian ia, o me kin lokaia sued duen ngai.

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: A komui, Maing Ieowa ai Kot kotin wiawia ia, pweki mar omui; pwe omui kalangan kasampwal, dore ia la!<l eID="gen1945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1946"/>Pwe ngai me luet o samama, o nan mongiong i olar.<l eID="gen1946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1947"/>I kin tangwei dueta mota, o i pan kamasak wei dueta mansiek amen.<l eID="gen1947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1948"/>Nä i kat luete kilar kaisesol, o uduk ai tikitikilar;<l eID="gen1948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1949"/>O i wialar men lalaue re ’rail; ni ar kilang ia, re kin dueduälok!<l eID="gen1949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1950"/>Maing Ieowa, ai Kot, kom kotin dore ia la duen omui kalangan!<l eID="gen1950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1951"/>Pwe ren asa, mepukat tapi sang ni lim omui, me komui Ieowa kotin wiadar mepukat.<l eID="gen1951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1952"/>Menda, ma re lalaue, kom kotin kapai ia da. Ma re palian ia, ren namenokala, pwe sapwilim omui ladu en pereperen.<l eID="gen1952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1953"/>Re kotin wiai ong ai imwintiti, ren likau kida namenok, o ren puriong nan me sued dueta likau pup.<l eID="gen1953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1954"/>I pan danke Ieowa melel ni au ai, o i pan kapinga i nan pung en me toto.<l eID="gen1954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1955"/>Pwe a kotikot ni pali maun en me samama, pwen dorela i sang ir, me kadeikada i, en kamela.<chapter eID="Ps.109"/> <l eID="gen1955" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1925"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: IEOWA kotin masani ong ai Kaun, mondi ong ni pali maun i, lao I pan wia kida om imwintiti utipan nä om.<l eID="gen1957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1958"/>Ieowa pan kotin kadarado sokon en wei omui sang nan Sion; kakaun nan pung en omui imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1959"/>Murin omui poedier, sapwilim omui kan pan pereperen, wia mairong ong komui ni ar kapwat saraui. Sapwilim omui seri kan pan ipwidi ong komui dueta poik en ni mansang.<l eID="gen1959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1960"/>Ieowa kotin kaula, o a sota pan kalula: Komui samero soutuk amen, duen al en Melkisedek.<l eID="gen1960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1961"/>Kaun o kotikot ni pali maun om a pan kamela nanmarki kan ni ran en a ongiong.<l eID="gen1961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1962"/>A pan kotin kaunda nan pung en men liki kan, a pan kadir kila kalep akan wasa karos, a kotin palang pasang tapwi en wei lapalap.<l eID="gen1962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1963"/>A pan nima sang pil ni kailan al, i me a pan sara kida.<chapter eID="Ps.110"/> <l eID="gen1963" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1956"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: I PAN kapinga Ieowa sang nan mongiong i nan pung en me lelapok kan o nan momodisou.<l eID="gen1965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1966"/>Meid laud wiawian Ieowa kan, ir me insenoki, pan dedeki due.<l eID="gen1966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1967"/>A wiawia kan me pung o lingan, o a pung pan duedueta kokolata.<l eID="gen1967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1968"/>A manaman akan men kataman eu. Ieowa me dir en mak o kalangan.<l eID="gen1968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1969"/>A kotin kamanga ir, me masak i, a kin kolekol sapwilim a inau kokolata.<l eID="gen1969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1970"/>A kotin kasansale ong sapwilim a aramas akan mana en a wiawia kan, pwen kotiki ong ir soso en men liki kan.<l eID="gen1970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1971"/>Dodok en lim a kan me melel o pung; sapwilim a masan kan karos me melel.<l eID="gen1971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1972"/>Re pan duedueta kokolata, o re wiauier ni melel o pung.<l eID="gen1972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1973"/>A kotiki ong sapwilim a kan saunkamaur, o a kupureda, me a inau pan duedueta kokolata; mar a me saraui o kalom.<l eID="gen1973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1974"/>Masak Ieowa iei tapin pan lolekong; irail meid pai, me kin wia due met, pwe a pai pan potopot eta.<chapter eID="Ps.111"/> <l eID="gen1974" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1964"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: MEID pai ol o me masak Ieowa, me kin peren kida a kusoned akan.<l eID="gen1976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1977"/>Kadaudok a pan kelail nan sap o; kainok en me melel akan pan pwaida.<l eID="gen1977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1978"/>Im a pan dir en dipisou melel; o a pung pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen1978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1979"/>Marain kin daka dang me melel akan nan wasa rotorot; a kin dir en mak o kalangan o pung.<l eID="gen1979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1980"/>Meid pai ol o me kalangan, o kin kisakisa wei; a pan pwaida ni ansaun kadeik.<l eID="gen1980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1981"/>Pwe a sota pan luetala kokolata; me pung amen iei men kataman soutuk eu.<l eID="gen1981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1982"/>A sota pan masak rong sued; mongiong i me kelail ni a kaporoporeki Ieowa.<l eID="gen1982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1983"/>Mongiong i me kelail, a sota kin masak, lao a pan peren kida a imwintiti kan.<l eID="gen1983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1984"/>A kin kamoredi o kisakis ong me samama kan; a pung pan potopot eta; os a pan kokoda o indand mau.<l eID="gen1984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1985"/>Me doo sang Kot pan kilang ap makara kida; a pan teterokki ngi a kan ap soredi; inong en me doo sang Kot akan pan nikila.<chapter eID="Ps.112"/> <l eID="gen1985" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1975"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: KOMAIL ladun Ieowa kapinga mar en Ieowa!<l eID="gen1987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1988"/>Mar en Ieowa en pakapingala sang met o kokolata!<l eID="gen1988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1989"/>Mar en Ieowa en pakapingala sang wasan katipin a dakada ia lel wong wasa me a kin kirila ia!<l eID="gen1989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1990"/>Ieowa me ileila sang men liki kan karos, a lingan mi ponangin nanlang.<l eID="gen1990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1991"/>Is me rasong Ieowa atail Kot, me kotikot pon mol a ileile melel?<l eID="gen1991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1992"/>Me kotin irerong me tikitik kan nanlang o nin sappa?<l eID="gen1992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1993"/>Me kotin kasapwilada me tikikit o sang nan pwel par, o sang nan pwel me samama o,<l eID="gen1993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1994"/>Pwen kamondi i ren me lapalap akan, ren me lapalap en sapwilim a aramas akan;<l eID="gen1994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1995"/>Me kotin sauasa li dapwan men, pwen wiala en ol oko ar nono peren amen. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.113"/> <l eID="gen1995" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: Ni ansau men Israel lipa sang Äkipten, kadaudok en Iakop sang nan wai,<l eID="gen1997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1998"/>I ansau men Iuda wiala sapwilim a saraui kan, o men Israel sapwilim a wei.<l eID="gen1998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen1999"/>Madau kilanger, ap tangwei, o Iordan pal pasanger;<l eID="gen1999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2000"/>Nana kan lusilus dueta sip ol, o dol akan dueta sippul akan.<l eID="gen2000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2001"/>Madau, da me koe tangweier ki? Koe Iordan, da me koe palki pasanger?<l eID="gen2001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2002"/>Komail nana kan, da me komail lusiluski dueta sip ol, o komail dol akan dueta sippul akan?<l eID="gen2002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2003"/>Sappa, koe en rerer mon Ieowa, mon Kot en Iakop,<l eID="gen2003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2004"/>Me kotin kawuki ong len pil paip o, o kantakai ong utun pil.<chapter eID="Ps.114"/> <l eID="gen2004" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1996"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: KAIDIN kit Ieowa, kaidin kit, pwe mar omui, kom kotiki ong waui, pweki omui kalangan o melel!<l eID="gen2006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2007"/>Menda men liki kan en inda: Ia arail Kot?<l eID="gen2007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2008"/>Atail Kot kotikot nanlang, a kak kotin wia karos, me a kupura.<l eID="gen2008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2009"/>Arail dikedik en ani kan, me wia kidar silper de kold, iei dodok en pa en aramas.<l eID="gen2009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2010"/>Au arail mia, ap sasa lokaia, por en mas arail mia, ap sota kak kilang wasa;<l eID="gen2010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2011"/>Salong arail mia, ap sota rong wasa; tum arail mia, ap sota ned wasa;<l eID="gen2011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2012"/>Pa arail mia, ap sota kak koledi meakot; nä arail mia, ap sota kak alu; re sota kak lokaiaki kaping wor arail.<l eID="gen2012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2013"/>Me kin wiada pukat, me dueta irail, o pil karos, me kin liki irail.<l eID="gen2013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2014"/>A koe Israel, liki Ieowa; i sauas o pere parail.<l eID="gen2014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2015"/>Komail, kadaudok en Aron, liki Ieowa, i sauas o pere parail.<l eID="gen2015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2016"/>Komail, me kin masak Ieowa, liki Ieowa, i sauas o pere parail.<l eID="gen2016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2017"/>Ieowa kotin kupura kitail er, o a pan kotin kapai kitail la; a pan kotin kapaida kadaudok en Israel, kapaida kadaudok en Aron;<l eID="gen2017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2018"/>A pan kotin kapaida, me masak Ieowa, me tikitik o me laud akan.<l eID="gen2018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2019"/>Ieowa en kotin kapai komail da kokolata, pein komail o noumail seri kan!<l eID="gen2019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2020"/>Komail me kapaidar ren Ieowa, me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa.<l eID="gen2020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2021"/>Lang me sapwilim en Ieowa, a sappa me a kotiki onger aramas akan.<l eID="gen2021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2022"/>Me melar akan solar pan kapinga Ieowa, pil karos, me kodi wasan kaporemen;<l eID="gen2022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2023"/>A kitail pan kapinga Ieowa sang met o kokolata. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.115"/> <l eID="gen2023" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2005"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: I KIN pok ong Ieowa, pwe a kotin ereki ngil ai o ai ngidingid.<l eID="gen2025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2026"/>Pwe a kotin kapaike dong ia karong a, i me i pan likwir wong i arain maur i.<l eID="gen2026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2027"/>Sal en mela sali ia dier, o kamasak en pased lel ong ia, i lel onger kalokolok o mamauk.<l eID="gen2027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2028"/>I ap likwir wong mar en Ieowa: Maing Ieowa, kom kotin dorela maur i!<l eID="gen2028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2029"/>Ieowa me dir en mak o pung, o atail Kot me dir en kalangan.<l eID="gen2029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2030"/>Ieowa kin kotin apapwali me opampap akan; ngai luetalar, i ap kotin dore ia lar.<l eID="gen2030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2031"/>Ngen i pur ong om moleilei, pwe Ieowa kotin sauasa uk mau.<l eID="gen2031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2032"/>Pwe kom me kotin dorelar maur i sang nan mela, o por en mas ai sang sangesang, o nä i sang a pan krisedi.<l eID="gen2032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2033"/>I pan weweid mon Ieowa nan sap en me maur akan.<l eID="gen2033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2034"/>I liki, o i karepen ai padapadak; a i kin kalokolok laud.<l eID="gen2034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2035"/>I indinda ni ai insensued: Aramas karos me likam!<l eID="gen2035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2036"/>Iaduen i pan kak depuk ong Ieowa a kapai ia kan?<l eID="gen2036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2037"/>I pan ale dal en kamaur, o likwir ong mar en Ieowa.<l eID="gen2037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2038"/>I pan kapwai ong Ieowa ai inau sansal mon sapwilim a aramas akan karos.<l eID="gen2038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2039"/>Meid kasampwal ren Ieowa melan sapwilim a lelapok kan.<l eID="gen2039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2040"/>O Maing Ieowa, ngai sapwilim omui ladu men, ngai sapwilim omui ladu, nain omui lidu; kom kotin kamueit pasang ai sal akan.<l eID="gen2040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2041"/>I pan mairongki ong komui danke, o likwir ong mar en Ieowa.<l eID="gen2041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2042"/>I pan kapwai ong Ieowa ai inau sansal mon sapwilim a aramas akan karos,<l eID="gen2042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2043"/>Mon pera en tanpas omui im saraui, nan warong en Ierusalem. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.116"/> <l eID="gen2043" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2024"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: MEN liki kan karos kapinga Ieowa! O kainok karos kapinga i!<l eID="gen2045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2046"/>Pwe a kalangan me sansal melel ong kitail, o melel en Ieowa pan potopot eta. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.117"/> <l eID="gen2046" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2044"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: DANKE Ieowa, pwe i me mau, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2049"/>Israel en indinda: A kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2050"/>Kadaudok en Aron en indinda: A kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2051"/>Me masak Kot akan en inda: A kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2052"/>Ni ai apwal akan i likwir wong Ieowa; Ieowa kotin mangi ia er o kotin kasone ia dier wasa saledok.<l eID="gen2052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2053"/>Ieowa kin kotin ieiang ia, i sota pan masak, da me aramas akan kak wiai ong ia?<l eID="gen2053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2054"/>Ieowa kin kotin ieiang ia nan pung en me sauasa ia, o i pan peren kida, me kailong kin ia.<l eID="gen2054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2055"/>Me mau, en liki Ieowa, sang kaporoporeki aramas akan.<l eID="gen2055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2056"/>Me mau en liki Ieowa, sang kaporoporeki saupeidi kan.<l eID="gen2056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2057"/>Men liki kan karos kapil ia penaer; a ni mar en Ieowa i kaloe ir edier.<l eID="gen2057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2058"/>Re kapil ia penaer wasa karos, a ni mar en Ieowa i pan kaloe irail edier.<l eID="gen2058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2059"/>Re kapil ia penaer dueta longlap akan, a re kunlar dueta kinsiniai nan tuka; ni mar en Ieowa i kaloe irail edier.<l eID="gen2059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2060"/>Re woki ia, pwe i en pupedi, a Ieowa kotin sauasa iaer.<l eID="gen2060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2061"/>Ieowa iei ai kel o ai kaul, o i me kotin wiala ai saunkamaur.<l eID="gen2061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2062"/>Kaul en kaperen o kamaur kin wiaui nan im en me pung kan, lim en Ieowa pali maun kin kapwaiada dodok manaman.<l eID="gen2062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2063"/>Pali maun en Ieowa me ileile, pali maun en Ieowa kin kapwaiada dodok manaman.<l eID="gen2063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2064"/>I sota pan mela, pwe memaur eta o padaki duen wiawian Ieowa.<l eID="gen2064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2065"/>Ieowa kotin kaloke ia laud, ap sota mueid ong, i en mela.<l eID="gen2065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2066"/>Komail ritingadang ia wanim en pung, pwe i wasa me i pan pedelong ia, pwen danke Ieowa.<l eID="gen2066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2067"/>Iet wanim en Ieowa, wasa me pung kan pan pedelong ia.<l eID="gen2067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2068"/>I danke komui, pwe kom kotin erekier ai kapakap o sauasa ia.<l eID="gen2068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2069"/>Takai o me pwin sause kaselar, wialar takain pukakaim.<l eID="gen2069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2070"/>Mepukat wiauier sang ren Ieowa, meid kapuriamui ni mas at!<l eID="gen2070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2071"/>Iet ran o, me Ieowa kotin wiadar, kitail en popol o peren kida i.<l eID="gen2071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2072"/>O Maing Ieowa, kom kotin sauasa! O Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kapwaiada!<l eID="gen2072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2073"/>Meid kapingan me kotido ni mar en Ieowa! Kit kapai komail da, me kisan toun tanpas en Ieowa.<l eID="gen2073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2074"/>Ieowa iei Kot, o i me kotin kamarain kitail er; saliedi men mairong ni os en pei saraui!<l eID="gen2074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2075"/>Komui ai Kot, o i pan danke komui; ai Kot, i pan kalinganada komui.<l eID="gen2075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2076"/>Danke Ieowa, pwe i me mau, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<chapter eID="Ps.118"/> <l eID="gen2076" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2047"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: RE meid pai, me sota kin sapung ni al arail, me kin weweid ni kapung en Ieowa!<l eID="gen2078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2079"/>Re meid pai, me kin kolekol a kadede akan, me kin rapaki i sang nan mongiong arail!<l eID="gen2079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2080"/>Me sota kin wia me sued, a weweid nan a al akan.<l eID="gen2080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2081"/>Pein komui kotikidar sapwilim omui kusoned akan, pwe sen porisok kapwaiada.<l eID="gen2081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2082"/>O ma al ai kan inen wei, pwen kapwaiada omui kusoned akan,<l eID="gen2082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2083"/>I ap sota pan sarodi, ni ai pan apapwali sapwilim omui kusoned akan karos.<l eID="gen2083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2084"/>I danke komui sang nan mongiong i melel, pwe kom kotin padaki dong ia duen omui masan pung.<l eID="gen2084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2085"/>I pan kanai ong sapwilim omui kusoned akan, kom der likidmaliela.<l eID="gen2085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2086"/>Iaduen, manakap amen pan kak weweid ni makelekel? Ma a pan wiawia duen ar masan akan.<l eID="gen2086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2087"/>I raparapa kin komui sang nan mongiong i; kom der kotin mueid ong, i en pup wei sang ni omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2088"/>I kolekol omui masan nan mongiong i, pwe i ender wia dip ong komui.<l eID="gen2088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2089"/>Kaping en ko ong komui, Maing Ieowa! Kom kotin padaki dong ia omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2090"/>I kasokasoi ki au ai duen kusoned en silang omui karos.<l eID="gen2090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2091"/>I kin peren kita al en omui kadede kan, dueta dipisou toto.<l eID="gen2091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2092"/>I pan madamadaua duen omui kusoned akan, o kanai ong omui al akan.<l eID="gen2092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2093"/>I kin peren kida omui kusoned akan, i sota pan monokela omui masan akan.<l eID="gen2093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2094"/>Kom kotin kamauiada sapwilim omui ladu, pwe i en memaur eta; i ap pan kapwaiada omui masan o.<l eID="gen2094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2095"/>Kom kotin kapad pasang mas ai, pwe i en kilang manaman akan nan sapwilim omui kapung o.<l eID="gen2095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2096"/>Ngai men kairu men nin sappa; kom der kotin karir sang mo i omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2097"/>Ngen i okilar ai inong iong omui kusoned akan ansau karos.<l eID="gen2097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2098"/>Kom kotin ongiongi me aklapalap o, me pan wuki wei sang omui kusoned akan, en riala.<l eID="gen2098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2099"/>Kom kotin katoror sang ia namenok o me sued; pwe i kin apapwali ar kadede kan.<l eID="gen2099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2100"/>Pil saupeidi kan kin momod pena, kaokao ad ai; sapwilim omui ladu kin madamadaua duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2101"/>Melel, i kin peren kida omui kadede kan, pwe ir me sauas pa i.<l eID="gen2101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2102"/>Ngen i onon nan pwel; kamanga ia duen omui masan.<l eID="gen2102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2103"/>I potoan ong komui duen al ai kan, komui ap kotin mangi ia er; kotin padaki ong ia omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2104"/>Kom kotin padaki ong ia duen al en sapwilim omui kusoned akan, i ap pan madamadaua duen ar manaman akan.<l eID="gen2104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2105"/>Mongiong i luet kilar ai insensued; kom kotin kamanga ia da duen ar masan.<l eID="gen2105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2106"/>Re kotin pera wei sang ia al en likam, o kotiki ong ia ar masan.<l eID="gen2106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2107"/>I piladar al en melel; i kin madamadaua duen omui kusoned.<l eID="gen2107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2108"/>I kin tengeti ong omui kadede kan; Maing Ieowa, kom der mueid ong, i en namenokala.<l eID="gen2108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2109"/>Ma kom pan kotin kamaitala mongiong i, i pan tang wei nan al en omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2110"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kawewe ong ia al en omui kusoned akan, pwe i en apapwali lao lel imwi.<l eID="gen2110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2111"/>Kotin padaki ong ia, pwe i en kolekol omui kapung o peiki ong sang nan mongiong i.<l eID="gen2111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2112"/>Kalua ia nan al en omui kusoned akan, pwe i kin peren kin irail.<l eID="gen2112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2113"/>Kainongiong mongiong i omui kadede kan, a der norok moni.<l eID="gen2113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2114"/>Pirer wei mas ai, pwen der kilang me sued kot; a re kotin kakel ia da pon al omui.<l eID="gen2114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2115"/>Kolekol omui inau ong sapwilim omui ladu, pwe i en masak komui.<l eID="gen2115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2116"/>Kotiki sang ia namenok, me i suedeki; pwe omui kusoned akan me mau.<l eID="gen2116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2117"/>Kotin mangi, i kin inong iong ar masan akan; kakele kin ia omui pung.<l eID="gen2117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2118"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin maki ong ia, o kotin sauasa ia duen omui inau.<l eID="gen2118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2119"/>Pwe i en asa, sapeng ir, me mamale kin ia, pwe i kin liki omui masan.<l eID="gen2119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2120"/>O kom der kotiki sang au ai masan en omui melel; pwe i kaporoporeki omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2121"/>I pan kolekol omui kapung o ansau karos kokolata.<l eID="gen2121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2122"/>I pan weweid ni peren, pwe i raparapaki omui kusoned akan ansau karos.<l eID="gen2122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2123"/>O i pan kasokasoi ong nanmarki kan duen omui kadede kan, ap sota namenok.<l eID="gen2123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2124"/>Pwe i kin peren kida omui kusoned akan, o i kin pok ong ir.<l eID="gen2124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2125"/>I kin pokadang pa i kat omui kusoned akan, me i pok ong, o i pan madamadaua duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2126"/>Kotin tamanda sapwilim omui ladu, duen omui masan, me i kin kaporoporeki.<l eID="gen2126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2127"/>I me kin kamait ia la ni ai luet; omui ianu kan kin kakel ia da.<l eID="gen2127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2128"/>Me aklapalap akan kin mamale kin ia; ari so, i sota kin muei sang omui kapung o.<l eID="gen2128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2129"/>Maing Ieowa, ma i lamelame duen omui kusoned akan sang nin tapin sappa, i ap insenemau kila.<l eID="gen2129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2130"/>I makar kila me doo sang Kot akan, me kin muei sang sapwilim omui kapung o.<l eID="gen2130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2131"/>Omui kusoned akan, iei ai kaul en kaping nan ai im en kairu.<l eID="gen2131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2132"/>Maing Ieowa, ni pong i kin madamadaua duen mar omui, o peiki ong omui kapung.<l eID="gen2132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2133"/>Mepukat wiaui ong ia er, pweki ai peiki ong omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2134"/>Maing Ieowa, iet pwais ai, en kolekol omui masan kan.<l eID="gen2134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2135"/>I kin ngidingid ong komui sang nan mongiong i; kom kotin maki ong ia duen omui inau o.<l eID="gen2135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2136"/>I kin madamadaua duen al ai, ap kainen wong omui kadede kan nä i kat.<l eID="gen2136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2137"/>I kin nantiong o sota pwapwand kolekol omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2138"/>Pwin en me doo sang Kot akan kapil ia pena, ari so, i sota monokela omui kapung kan.<l eID="gen2138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2139"/>Ni ailep en pong i kin paurida, pwen danke komui, pweki omui kusoned pung.<l eID="gen2139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2140"/>I kin waroki ong ir karos, me masak komui o ir, me apapwali omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2141"/>Maing Ieowa, sappa direki omui kalangan; padaki ong ia omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2142"/>Maing Ieowa, komui me kotin wiai ong sapwilim omui ladu kamau kan duen omui inau o.<l eID="gen2142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2143"/>Padaki ong ia tiak mau o lolekong, pwe i kin liki omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2144"/>Mon ai aktikitikala, i kin sapusapung, a met i kin apapwali omui masan.<l eID="gen2144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2145"/>Komui me mau o kapunglol, kotin padaki dong ia sapwilim omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2146"/>Me aklapalap akan kin kalikama ia; a ngai kin apapwali omui kusoned akan sang nan mongiong i.<l eID="gen2146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2147"/>Mongiong arail masul kila wi; a i kin peren kida omui kapung.<l eID="gen2147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2148"/>Meid mau ong ia omui kaopampap ia la, pwe i en padakki omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2149"/>Kapung sang nan silang omui mau ong ia, sang kold o silper kid toto.<l eID="gen2149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2150"/>Lim omui kan kapik o wia ia dar, padaki ong ia, pwe i en asa omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2151"/>Me kin masak komui, pan kilang ia, ap peren kida, pwe i auiaui omui masan.<l eID="gen2151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2152"/>Maing Ieowa, i asa, me omui kadeik kan me pung, o kom kotin kaopampap ia la ni omui melel.<l eID="gen2152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2153"/>Omui mak pan kamait ia la, duen me kom kotin inauki ong sapwilim omui ladu.<l eID="gen2153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2154"/>Kom kotin kupura ia, i ap pan memaur eta, pwe i kin peren kida omui kapung.<l eID="gen2154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2155"/>Me aklapalap akan en sarodi, pwe re sapung ong ia ni sokarepa; a ngai madamadaua duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2156"/>Me masak komui, ren waroki ong ia, o me asa duen omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2157"/>Mongiong i en pung ni omui kusoned akan, pwe i ender sarodi.<l eID="gen2157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2158"/>Ngen i kin inong iong omui dore ia la, i auiaui omui masan.<l eID="gen2158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2159"/>Por en mas ai kin anane omui inau, kalelapok: Iad me kom pan kotin kamait ia la?<l eID="gen2159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2160"/>Pwe i luetalar rasong deun pil eu nan adiniai, i sota monokela omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2161"/>Arai da, sapwilim omui ladu pan memaurada? Iad me kom pan kotin kadeikada ai imwintiti kan?<l eID="gen2161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2162"/>Me aklapalap akan weiradang ia por akai, irail me sota kin duki ong sapwilim omui kapung o.<l eID="gen2162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2163"/>Sapwilim omui kusoned akan karos me melel. Irail raparapa kin ia ni sota karepa; kom kotin sauasa ia!<l eID="gen2163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2164"/>Me ekis, re pan kame ia la sang nin sappa, a ngai sota muei sang omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2165"/>Kamaur ia da duen omui kalangan, a ngai pan kolekol kadede en silang omui.<l eID="gen2165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2166"/>Maing Ieowa, omui masan pan potopot eta nanlang.<l eID="gen2166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2167"/>Omui melel kin sang eu kainok lel eu; komui me kotin kasonedier sappa o a pan mimieta.<l eID="gen2167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2168"/>Irail karos mimieta lao lel ran wet, duen omui kusoned akan, pwe karos kin upa komui.<l eID="gen2168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2169"/>Ma omui kapung sota pan kaperen pa i, i pan mela ni ai luet.<l eID="gen2169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2170"/>I sota pan monokela omui kusoned akan kokolata, pwe ir me komui kakela kin ia da.<l eID="gen2170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2171"/>Ngai sapwilim omui, kom kotin sauasa ia! Pwe i inong iong sapwilim omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2172"/>Me doo sang Kot akan masamasan ia, pwen kame ia la; i kin apwali omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2173"/>I kilanger imwin meakaros, a sapwilim omui kusoned pan mimieta.<l eID="gen2173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2174"/>Ia wan ai pok ong sapwilim omui kapung! Nin ran karos i kin kasokasoi due.<l eID="gen2174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2175"/>Kom kin kalolekong kin ia omui kusoned akan sang ai imwintiti kan, pwe irail pan ieiang ia kokolata.<l eID="gen2175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2176"/>Ngai lolekong sang ai saunpadak kan karos, pwe i kin madamadaua duen omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2177"/>Ngai lolekong sang me ma kan, pwe i kin apapwali sapwilim omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2178"/>I sota mueid ong nä i, en weweid pon al sapung, pwe i en kolekol omui masan.<l eID="gen2178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2179"/>I sota wuki wei sang omui kusoned akan, pwe kom kotin padaki ong ia er.<l eID="gen2179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2180"/>Omui masan me iau sang onik nan au ai.<l eID="gen2180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2181"/>Omui kusoned akan kin kalolekong ia, i me i kin tataki al sapung karos.<l eID="gen2181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2182"/>Sapwilim omui masan me ser pan nä i, o kamarain pan al ai.<l eID="gen2182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2183"/>I kaukilar, me i pan kolekol omui kusoned pung kan, o i pan kapwaiada.<l eID="gen2183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2184"/>I insensued melel; Maing Ieowa, re kotin kamaur ia da duen omui inau.<l eID="gen2184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2185"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kupura kisakis en au ai, o kotin padaki ong ia omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2186"/>I kin wewa maur i nan pa i kat; i sota monokela omui kapung.<l eID="gen2186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2187"/>Me doo sang Kot akan insensare ia, a i sota wuki wei sang omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2188"/>Omui kadede kan iei ai soso soutuk, pwe re kaperenda mongiong i.<l eID="gen2188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2189"/>Mongiong i kin inong iong kapwaiada omui kusoned akan ansau karos kokolata.<l eID="gen2189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2190"/>I kin kailongki me lol riapot, o i kin pok ong omui kapung.<l eID="gen2190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2191"/>Komui ai kadauk o pere pa i, i kaporoporeki omui masan.<l eID="gen2191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2192"/>Komail me sued akan en muei sang ia! I men apapwali kusoned en ai Kot akan.<l eID="gen2192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2193"/>Sauasa ia duen omui inau, i ap pan memaur eta; o kom der kotin mueid ong, i en namenokala ni ai kaporopor.<l eID="gen2193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2194"/>Kamanga ia da, i ap pan kelailada, i ap pan apapwali omui kusoned akan ansau karos.<l eID="gen2194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2195"/>Kom kin kotin tiakedi karos, me pan wuki wei sang omui kusoned akan; pwe arail sapung me dir en likam.<l eID="gen2195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2196"/>Kom kin kotin kase sang sappa me doo sang Kot akan karos dueta samit; i me i kin pok ong ki omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2197"/>I kin masak komui, i me i kin muserereki, o i kin masak omui kadeik kan.<l eID="gen2197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2198"/>I kin apapwali me inen o pung; kom der kotin pang ia lang ren me kin wia sued ong ia.<l eID="gen2198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2199"/>Sauasa sapwilim omui ladu o kamaitala i; me aklapalap akan ender sued ong ia.<l eID="gen2199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2200"/>Por en mas ai inong iong omui kamaur ia, o omui inau pung.<l eID="gen2200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2201"/>Wia ong sapwilim omui ladu duen omui kalangan, o kotin padaki ong ia omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2202"/>Ngai sapwilim omui ladu; kotin padaki ong ia, pwe i en dedeki sapwilim omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2203"/>Ansau leler, me Ieowa pan kotin wiawia; pwe irail kawela sapwilim omui kapung.<l eID="gen2203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2204"/>I me i kin pok ki ong sapwilim omui kusoned akan, sang kold o kold lingan.<l eID="gen2204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2205"/>I me i kin kasampwaleki sapwilim omui kusoned akan karos, i tata ki al en likam karos.<l eID="gen2205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2206"/>Omui kadede kan meid kapuriamui, i me mongiong, i apapwali kin ir.<l eID="gen2206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2207"/>Ma omui masan pan sansalada, a pan kareda peren o lolekong ong me opampap akan.<l eID="gen2207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2208"/>Au ai kin sar pasang o inong iong sapwilim omui kusoned akan; pwe i kin anane ir.<l eID="gen2208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2209"/>Kom kotin wukedoke dong ia, o maki ong ia, duen me kom kin wiai ong ir, me pok ong mar omui.<l eID="gen2209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2210"/>Kotin kainenela al ai nan sapwilim omui masan, o der mueid ong, me sued kot en wiawia ia.<l eID="gen2210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2211"/>Kotin dore ia la sang mor sued en aramas akan, a i ap pan kolekol omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2212"/>Kotin kamarainiki omui ladu silang omui, o kotin padaki ong ia duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2213"/>Por en mas ai me dir en pil, pweki ar sota peiki ong omui kapung.<l eID="gen2213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2214"/>Maing Ieowa, komui me kotin pung, o omui kusoned akan me pung.<l eID="gen2214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2215"/>Komui me kotiki ong kit er kadede pan omui pung o melel, pwe i en nantiong kapwaiada.<l eID="gen2215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2216"/>I insensued melel, koren iong mela, pweki ai imwintiti kan monokela omui masan akan.<l eID="gen2216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2217"/>Omui masan meid makelekel, o sapwilim omui ladu kin pok ong.<l eID="gen2217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2218"/>Ngai me tikitik o me mal amen, a i sota kin monokela omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2219"/>Omui pung me pung soutuk eu, o omui kapung me melel.<l eID="gen2219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2220"/>Masak o apwal lel dong ia; omui kusoned akan ai peren.<l eID="gen2220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2221"/>Pung en sapwilim omui kadede kan me soutuk, padaki ong ia, i ap pan memaur eta.<l eID="gen2221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2222"/>I ngidingid sang nan mongiong i; Ieowa kom kotin mangi ia! I pan apapwali omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2223"/>I likwir wong komui, kom kotin sauasa ia, a i ap pan kolekol omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2224"/>Nin soran i kodo o ngidingid; i auiaui omui masan.<l eID="gen2224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2225"/>I kin pirida ni ailep en pong, pwen madamadaua duen omui masan.<l eID="gen2225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2226"/>Ereki ngil ai duen ar kalangan; Maing Ieowa, kamaur ia da duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2227"/>Ai imwintiti sued akan koren iong ia, a re doo sang sapwilim omui kapung;<l eID="gen2227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2228"/>Maing Ieowa, komui me koren iong ia, o omui kusoned akan karos me melel.<l eID="gen2228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2229"/>I asa sang mas o, me komui kasonedier sapwilim omui kadede kan, pwen potopot eta.<l eID="gen2229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2230"/>Kom kotin irerong ai luet, o kamaio ia da! Pwe i sota monokela omui kapung.<l eID="gen2230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2231"/>Kotin apapwali ia, o dore ia la, o kamaur ia da duen omui inau.<l eID="gen2231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2232"/>Me doo sang Kot akan kin doo sang maur, pwe re sota kin isenoki omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2233"/>Omui kalangan meid laud, Maing Ieowa; kom kotin kamaur ia da duen omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2234"/>Me pakipaki ia, o palian ia me toto; ari so, i sota wuk wei sang omui kadede kan.<l eID="gen2234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2235"/>I kin kilekilang me mor sued akan, ap pokela, o i kin suedeki, pwe re sota kin peiki ong omui kusoned o.<l eID="gen2235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2236"/>Kotin masando, me i kin pok ong sapwilim omui kusoned akan; Maing Ieowa, kotin kakel ia da, duen omui kalangan.<l eID="gen2236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2237"/>Omui masan me dir en melel, o masan en omui kapung pan duedueta.<l eID="gen2237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2238"/>Saupeidi kan kin masamasan ia ni sokarepa; a mongiong i kin masak omui masan akan.<l eID="gen2238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2239"/>I kin peren kida omui inau dueta amen, me diaradar pai kasampwal eu.<l eID="gen2239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2240"/>I kailongki likam o suede kin irail, a i kin pok ong sapwilim omui kapung.<l eID="gen2240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2241"/>Pan ise pak i kin kapinga komui ni ran ta ieu, pweki kusoned en omui kapung kan.<l eID="gen2241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2242"/>Me kin pok ong sapwilim omui kapung, kin popol melel, re sota pan salongala.<l eID="gen2242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2243"/>Maing Ieowa, i kin auiaui omui kamaur, o i kin peiki ong sapwilim omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2244"/>Mongiong i kin kolekol sapwilim omui kadede kan, o kin pok ong irail melel.<l eID="gen2244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2245"/>I kin kolekol sapwilim omui kusoned o kadede kan, pwe al ai kan karos me sansal mo ’mui.<l eID="gen2245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2246"/>Maing Ieowa, kotin mangi ai ngidingid, o kotin padaki ong ia duen omui masan.<l eID="gen2246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2247"/>Re kotin mangi ai kapakap, o dore ia la duen omui inau.<l eID="gen2247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2248"/>Komui lao padaki ong ia omui kusoned akan, kil en au ai ap pan kapinga komui.<l eID="gen2248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2249"/>Lo i pan kauleki duen omui masan, pwe omui kusoned akan karos me pung.<l eID="gen2249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2250"/>Lim omui en sauasa ia, pwe i piladar omui kusoned akan.<l eID="gen2250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2251"/>Maing Ieowa, i kin inong iong omui kamaur, o i kin peren kida omui kapung.<l eID="gen2251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2252"/>Kom kotin ieiang ngen i, pwen memaur eta ap kapinga komui, o lim omui pali maun en sauasa ia.<l eID="gen2252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2253"/>Ngai ras ong sip amen me sansalong sili o salongala; kom kotin rapaki sapwilim omui ladu, pwe i sota monokela omui kusoned akan.<chapter eID="Ps.119"/> <l eID="gen2253" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2077"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: NI ai apwal akan i likwir wong Ieowa, a ap kotin mangi ia.<l eID="gen2255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2256"/>Maing Ieowa, kotin dore ia la, sang au en me kin likam, o lo en kotaue.<l eID="gen2256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2257"/>Da me lo likam kak wiai ong uk, o da me a kak kapwaiada?<l eID="gen2257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2258"/>A rasong kanangan kasik katieu kong kan ren me kelail amen, dueta kisiniai nan alek.<l eID="gen2258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2259"/>Meid apwal ong ia, ai kairu nan Mesek, o ai kauson impan im en men Kedar!<l eID="gen2259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2260"/>Meid warai ong ai kaukauson ren aramas akan me kin tataki muei mau.<l eID="gen2260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2261"/>I inong iong muei mau, a ni ai pan lokaia, re kin mauki mauin.<chapter eID="Ps.120"/> <l eID="gen2261" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2254"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: I SARADANG nana kan, wasa sauas pa i pan pwarado sang ia.<l eID="gen2263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2264"/>Sauas pa i pan pwarado sang ren Ieowa, me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa.<l eID="gen2264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2265"/>A sota pan kotin mueid ong nä om, en krisedi; o me kin sinsila uk, sota kin saimokala.<l eID="gen2265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2266"/>Kilang, sile pan Israel sota kin saimok de saimok kalik.<l eID="gen2266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2267"/>Ieowa iei sile pa om, Ieowa iei motan pa om pali maun.<l eID="gen2267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2268"/>Katipin sota pan dakar uk nin ran de maram ni pong.<l eID="gen2268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2269"/>Ieowa pan kotin pera wei sang uk song en sued karos, a pan kotin sinsila ngen om.<l eID="gen2269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2270"/>Ieowa pan kotin sinsila uk ni om pedoi o pedelong, sang met o kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.121"/> <l eID="gen2270" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: I PEREN kida ar indai ong ia: Kitail en kolang nan tanpas en Ieowa!<l eID="gen2272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2273"/>Nä at akan pan mi ni wanim en kel en Ierusalem.<l eID="gen2273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2274"/>Ierusalem kanim eu me kakaudar, pwen kanim kelail eu.<l eID="gen2274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2275"/>Wasa me kainok kan kin momaitala ia, kainok en Ieowa kan, saunkadede en Israel, pwen kapinga mar en Ieowa.<l eID="gen2275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2276"/>Pwe i wasa me mol en kadeik mi ia, mol en kadaudok en Dawid.<l eID="gen2276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2277"/>Poeki ong Ierusalem a pai kan! Me kin pok ong uk, en paida!<l eID="gen2277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2278"/>Muei mau en mi ni om kel, o pai nan om im akan!<l eID="gen2278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2279"/>I pan kapakapa kin uk pweki ri ai o kompoke pai kan.<l eID="gen2279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2280"/>I pan rapaki ong uk me mau melel, pweki tanpas en Ieowa at Kot.<chapter eID="Ps.122"/> <l eID="gen2280" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2271"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: I KIN sarada wong komui, me kotikot nanlang.<l eID="gen2282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2283"/>Kilang, duen mas en ladu kan kin kilekilang lim en ar saumas akan, o duen mas en lidu kan kin kilekilang a saumas li, iduen mas at kin ariri Ieowa at Kot, a lao kotin maki ong kit.<l eID="gen2283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2284"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin maki ong, kotin maki ong kit! Pwe kit me dir en namenok.<l eID="gen2284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2285"/>Moniong i toutouki en me sued akan ar mamale kin kit o en me aklapalap akan ar kanamenok kin kit.<chapter eID="Ps.123"/> <l eID="gen2285" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2281"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: ISRAEL en inda: Ma Ieowa sota pan kotin ieiang kit,<l eID="gen2287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2288"/>Ma Ieowa sota pan kotin ieiang kit, ni en aramas akan ar palian kit,<l eID="gen2288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2289"/>Re pan katala kit ala ni at memaur, ni ar lingarangar kin kit.<l eID="gen2289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2290"/>Pil akan ap pan kamop kit ala, pilap akan kadupwaledi ngen it.<l eID="gen2290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2291"/>Pil akan itida melel lao kadupwaledi ngen it.<l eID="gen2291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2292"/>Kaping ong Ieowa, me sota mueid ong, ngi arail en ter kit pasang!<l eID="gen2292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2293"/>Ngen it piti sang insar en sauninsar dueta manpir amen; insar ola, a kit pitila.<l eID="gen2293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2294"/>Sauas pat iei mar en Ieowa, me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa.<chapter eID="Ps.124"/> <l eID="gen2294" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2286"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: Me liki Ieowa kin rasong dol Sion, me sota kin mokid, a pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2297"/>Duen dol akan kin kapil pena Ierusalem, iduen Ieowa kin kotikot ren sapwilim a aramas akan, sang met o kokolata.<l eID="gen2297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2298"/>Pwe sokon en me doo sang Kot akan sota pan mimieta ren kisin pwin en me pung kan, pwe me pung kan ender kapa wong pa ar kan nin sapung.<l eID="gen2298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2299"/>Maing Ieowa, kotin kasansaleda omui kalangan ong me mau kan o ong ir, me melel nan mongiong arail.<l eID="gen2299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2300"/>A me kin wuki wong ni al sapung, Ieowa pan kotin paki irail wei iangaki me sued akan. Israel en popol!<chapter eID="Ps.125"/> <l eID="gen2300" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2295"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: NI ansau Ieowa kotin kapuredor me salidi en Israel akan, kit rasong ir, me auramen.<l eID="gen2302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2303"/>I ansau au at me dir en kaurur, o lo at me dir en ngisingis. I ansau men iki kan ap inda: Meid laud dodok en Ieowa re ’rail!<l eID="gen2303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2304"/>Melel, dodok en Ieowa meid laud ong kit er, o i me se kin peren kida.<l eID="gen2304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2305"/>Maing Ieowa, re kotin kapuredo at salidi kan dueta pilap en sap en pali air akan.<l eID="gen2305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2306"/>Me kamore kidi pil en mas arail, pan dolung ni peren.<l eID="gen2306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2307"/>Re kin weweidki sangesang, o kin wewa wa kasampwal, a ni ar puredo, re pan peren, wado ar kap en wa kan.<chapter eID="Ps.126"/> <l eID="gen2307" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2301"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: MA Ieowa sota pan kauada im o, dodok en pwin sause sota pan katepa; ma Ieowa sota pan sinsila kanim o, saunmasamasan pan masamasan mal.<l eID="gen2309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2310"/>Sota katepa ong komail, ma komail pan paurida nin soran, ap pil pwand kamol ni pong, o toutouki okotme, ni omail mangamanga, pwe a kin kakepwapwala sapwilim a kompokepa kan ni ar mamair.<l eID="gen2310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2311"/>Kilang, seri ko iei kisakis eu sang ren Ieowa, o wan aramas pai eu.<l eID="gen2311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2312"/>Duen kanangan kasik katieu nan pa en ol komad amen, iduen putak ko ar pan pwaida.<l eID="gen2312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2313"/>Meid pai ol o, me a lepan me direki mepukat! Re sota pan sarodi, ni ar kapung pena ren ar imwintiti kan.<chapter eID="Ps.127"/> <l eID="gen2313" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2308"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: MEID pai karos, me kin masak Ieowa, me kin weweid nan sapwilim a al akan!<l eID="gen2315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2316"/>Pwe koe pan memaureki dodok en pa om akan, koe meid pai o pwaida mau.<l eID="gen2316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2317"/>Om paud pan rasong tuka en wain pot, me wa mau nan im om, o noum seri kan pan dueta paini, me kapwata om tepel.<l eID="gen2317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2318"/>Kilang, iduen ol o, me masak Ieowa, a pan pwaida.<l eID="gen2318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2319"/>Ieowa pan kapai uk ada sang nan Sion, pwe koe en kilang pai en Ierusalem arain om maur.<l eID="gen2319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2320"/>O koe pan kilang seri eu noum seri ko. Israel en popol!<chapter eID="Ps.128"/> <l eID="gen2320" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2314"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: ISRAEL en inda: Re katoutou ia melel sang ni ai tikitik lel met pak toto.<l eID="gen2322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2323"/>Pan pak toto re katoutou ia melel sang ni ai tikitik lel met; ari so, re sota kak kaloe ia di.<l eID="gen2323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2324"/>Men sapasap weirada pon tinsau ai, wiadar warawar reirei.<l eID="gen2324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2325"/>A Ieowa me pung, a kotin lepuk pasanger sal en me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen2325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2326"/>Karos me kin tataki Sion, en sarodi o tangwei!<l eID="gen2326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2327"/>Ren rasong rä pon os en im o, me kin mong pena mon a pan ususda!<l eID="gen2327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2328"/>Me sota kin kadirela kumut en pa en saundolung, de pa en me kin pir pena kap akan.<l eID="gen2328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2329"/>Pwe me kin daulul wasa o, ren der inda: Kot en kotin kupura maui komail! Kit kapai komail da ni mar en Ieowa!<chapter eID="Ps.129"/> <l eID="gen2329" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2321"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, i kin likwirda wong komui sang nan wasa lol.<l eID="gen2331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2332"/>Maing, kotin ereki ngil ai! Karong omui en mamangi ai ngidingid!<l eID="gen2332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2333"/>Ma komui Ieowa, pan kotin kapokonki ong aramas dip akan, Maing, is me ap pan kak kasinenda mo ’mui?<l eID="gen2333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2334"/>A komui kin kotin mak, pwe aramas en masak komui.<l eID="gen2334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
