verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2335"/>I kin auiaui Ieowa, ngen i kin auiaui, o i kin auiaui a inau.<l eID="gen2335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2336"/>Ngen i kin auiaui Kaun o, sang saunmasamasan kin auiaui mansang, saunmasamasan kin auiaui mansang.<l eID="gen2336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2337"/>Israel auiaui Ieowa, pwe Ieowa me kalangan, o wasa en kamaio mi re a;<l eID="gen2337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2338"/>A pan kotin dorela Israel sang dip a kan karos.<chapter eID="Ps.130"/> <l eID="gen2338" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2330"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, mongiong i sota aklapalap, o por en mas ai sota aklapalap; i sota kin inong iong dodok, me i sota itar ong.<l eID="gen2340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2341"/>Melel, i kamoleileilar mongiong i dueta kisin seri me muei sang didi en a nono; duen seri me muei sang didi en a nono, iduen mongiong i moleileilar.<l eID="gen2341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2342"/>Israel, auiaui Ieowa sang met o kokolata!<chapter eID="Ps.131"/> <l eID="gen2342" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, kom kotin tamanda Dawid o a apwal akan karos,<l eID="gen2344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2345"/>Me kauki ong Ieowa, o a inauki ong Kot manaman en Iakop:<l eID="gen2345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2346"/>I sota pan pedelong ong nan im ai, o i sota pan wendi pon los,<l eID="gen2346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2347"/>I sota pan mueid ong mas ai en mair, de por en mas ai, en mair pena,<l eID="gen2347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2348"/>Lao i pan diar ekis wasa ong Ieowa, wasan tanpas en Kot manaman en Iakop.<l eID="gen2348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2349"/>Melel, se ronger duen i nan Eprata; se diaradar i nan sap en Iaar.<l eID="gen2349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2350"/>Se pan pedelong ong nan tanpas a o kaudok ni utipa.<l eID="gen2350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2351"/>Kotida, Maing Ieowa, koti dong omui kamol, komui o kopan omui manaman!<l eID="gen2351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2352"/>Sapwilim omui samero kan en likau kida pung, o sapwilim omui me saraui kan en pereperen.<l eID="gen2352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2353"/>Re der sopwei sang mas en sapwilim omui me keidier, pweki Dawid sapwilim omui ladu.<l eID="gen2353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2354"/>Ieowa kotin kaula ong Dawid kaula melel eu, o a sota pan kawukila: I pan kasapwiladang mol om kisan kadaudok om.<l eID="gen2354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2355"/>Ma noum seri ko pan kolekol ai inau, o ai kusoned akan, me I pan kawewe ong irail, nairail seri ko ap pil pan mondi pon mol om kokolata.<l eID="gen2355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2356"/>Melel Ieowa kotin pilada Sion, o a kotin men kotikot wasa o.<l eID="gen2356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2357"/>Iet wasan ai kamol kokolata; wata et, me I pan kaukauson ia, pwe wasa et I kin mauki.<l eID="gen2357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2358"/>I pan kapaiada kan a manga, o pan ki ong me samama re ’rail prot toto.<l eID="gen2358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2359"/>O I pan kalikauwi kida maur arail, samero kan, o me lelapok re ’rail pan ngisingis laud.<l eID="gen2359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2360"/>I wasa mana en Dawid pan pwaida mau, I kaonopadang nai, me keidier, marain eu.<l eID="gen2360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2361"/>I pan kalikauwi kida namenok a imwintiti kan a kapwat en nanmarki pan mi pon monga.<chapter eID="Ps.132"/> <l eID="gen2361" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2343"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: KILANG, meid kaselel, ma pirien eu kauson pena ni limpok!<l eID="gen2363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2364"/>A dueta le pon kadokenmai, me kin kerekeredi nan alis en Aron, me kin kerekeredi ni imwin a likau;<l eID="gen2364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2365"/>Dueta poik en Ermon, me kin moredi pon dol en Sion kan, pwe i wasa, me Ieowa pan kotin kapaiada o kamaurada kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.133"/> <l eID="gen2365" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: KILANG, kapinga Ieowa komail ladun Ieowa karos, me kin mi nan tanpas en Ieowa ni pong kan!<l eID="gen2367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2368"/>Komail pokada pa omail nan pera saraui o kapinga Ieowa!<l eID="gen2368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2369"/>Ieowa kotin kapai uk ada sang nan Sion, i me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa.<chapter eID="Ps.134"/> <l eID="gen2369" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2366"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: KAPINGA mar en Ieowa, papan Ieowa, komail kapinga!<l eID="gen2371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2372"/>Komail me mi nan tanpas en Ieowa, nan pera moa en tanpas en atail Kot.<l eID="gen2372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2373"/>Kapinga Ieowa, pwe Ieowa me kalangan; kauleki mar a, pwe i me mau.<l eID="gen2373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2374"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin piladar Iakop, o Israel, pwen sapwilim a.<l eID="gen2374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2375"/>Pwe i asa, Ieowa meid lapalap, o atail Kot me lapa sang kot akan karos.<l eID="gen2375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2376"/>Karos me Ieowa kotin kupura, a kin wiada nanlang o pil ni sappa, nan madau o pased.<l eID="gen2376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2377"/>A kin kotin wiai ong tapok kan, ren dauda sang ni imwin sappa, me kin kotin wiada liol o pil katau, me kin kotin kadarala kisiniang sang nan a pera kan.<l eID="gen2377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2378"/>A kotin kamelar meseni kan nan Äkipten karos ren aramas o man akan.<l eID="gen2378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2379"/>O kotikidang uk, Äkipten, kilel o manaman akan, ong Parao o na ladu kan karos.<l eID="gen2379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2380"/>Me kotin kaloedi wein men liki kalaimun akan o kamelar nanmarki kelail akan.<l eID="gen2380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2381"/>Siion, nanmarki en Amon, o Ok, nanmarki en Pasan, o wei en Kanaan karos.<l eID="gen2381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2382"/>O kotiki ong sapwilim a men Israel sap arail, pwe ren sosoki.<l eID="gen2382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2383"/>Ieowa, mar omui pan potopot eta; Maing Ieowa, kataman pa omui pan sang eu kainok lel eu.<l eID="gen2383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2384"/>Pwe Ieowa pan kotin kapung sapwilim a aramas akan, o a pan kotin maki ong sapwilim a ladu kan.<l eID="gen2384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2385"/>Dikedik en ani mal en men liki kan wiaui kida silper o kold, me pa en aramas wiadar.<l eID="gen2385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2386"/>Au arail mia, ap sasa lokaia, por en mas arail mia, ap sota kak kilang wasa;<l eID="gen2386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2387"/>Salong arail mia, ap sota kak rong wasa, pil sota ang mi nan au ar.<l eID="gen2387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2388"/>Me kin wiada pukat me dueta irail, o pil karos, me kin liki irail.<l eID="gen2388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2389"/>Kadaudok en Israel en kapinga Ieowa! Kadaudok en Aron en kapinga Ieowa.<l eID="gen2389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2390"/>Kadaudok en Lewi en kapinga Ieowa! Komail me masak Ieowa, en kapinga Ieowa!<l eID="gen2390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2391"/>Kaping ong Ieowa sang nan Sion, me kotikot Ierusalem! Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.135"/> <l eID="gen2391" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2370"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: DANKE Ieowa, pwe i me mau, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2394"/>Danke ong Kot en kot akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2395"/>Danke ong Kaun en kaun akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2396"/>Pwe i ta me kin wiada manaman akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2397"/>Me kotin wiadar lang akan ni a erpit, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2398"/>Me kotin pak pasanger sappa pon pil, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2399"/>Me kotin wiadar marain laud akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopol eta,<l eID="gen2399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2400"/>Pwe katipin en kaunda ran, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta;<l eID="gen2400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2401"/>Saunipong o usu kan en kaunda pong, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2402"/>Me kotin kaloedi Äkipten, ni a kamelar ar meseni kan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2403"/>O kotin kalua Israel sang wasa o, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2404"/>Ki lim a manaman o, ni a kotin kapa wei lim a, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2405"/>Me palang pasang sed waitata, wia pali ria pali, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2406"/>O mueid ong Israel, en kotela nan warong a, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2407"/>Me kotin kasedi ong nan sed waitata Parao o na karis akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopol eta,<l eID="gen2407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2408"/>Me kotin kalua sapwilim a aramas akan nan sap tan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2409"/>Me kotin kamelar nanmarki lapalap akan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<l eID="gen2409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2410"/>O kotin kamelar nanmarki kelail kan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2411"/>Siion, nanmarki en Amon, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2412"/>Ok, nanmarki en Pasan, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2413"/>O wiakila sap arail men soso, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2414"/>Soso en sapwilim a ladu Israel, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2415"/>Pwe a kotin kupura kit ni at kankangeranger, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2416"/>O kotin dore kitail la sang atail imwintiti kan, pwe a kalangan ngan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2417"/>Me kotin kamanga me maur akan karos, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta,<l eID="gen2417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2418"/>Danke ong Kot en nanlang, pwe a kalangan pan potopot eta.<chapter eID="Ps.136"/> <l eID="gen2418" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2392"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: KIT momoder ni kailan pilap en Papel akan o sangesang, ni at tamanda Sion.<l eID="gen2420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2421"/>Kit langadar at arp akan nin tuka kan, me mi wasa o,<l eID="gen2421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2422"/>Pwe me sali kit edi inda, sen kaul, o sen pereperen ni at mamaiei: Komail wiai ong kit kaul apot duen Sion.<l eID="gen2422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2423"/>Iaduen at pan kak wiada kaul ong Ieowa nan sap en men wai?<l eID="gen2423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2424"/>Ma i pan monoke uk ala Ierusalem, pa i pali maun ap pil pan monokinokla.<l eID="gen2424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2425"/>Lo i pan pas ong pan ngatangat ai, ma i solar pan taman uk adar, ma i solar pan peren kida Ierusalem mon meakaros.<l eID="gen2425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2426"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin tamanda en men Edom ar lokolokaia ni ran apwal en Ierusalem: Kawela, kawela lao lel ong nan pwel!<l eID="gen2426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2427"/>Toun Papel, morsued koe, re meid pai, me pan wiai ong uk duen me koe wiadar!<l eID="gen2427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2428"/>Meid pai ir, me pan koledi noum seri pwelel o kasuk pasang nin takai!<chapter eID="Ps.137"/> <l eID="gen2428" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2419"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: I KAPINGA komui sang nan mongiong i, i pan kakaule kin komui mon dikedik en ani kan.<l eID="gen2430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2431"/>I pan kakaudok inen wong sapwilim omui im en kaudok saraui, o kapinga mar omui, pweki omui kalangan o melel, pwe kom kotin kalinganada mar omui sang meakaros ki omui masan.<l eID="gen2431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2432"/>Ni ai likwir wong komui, komui ap kotin mangi ia, o kom kamanada mongiong i melel.<l eID="gen2432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2433"/>Maing Ieowa, nanmarki en sappa karos pan kapinga komui, ni ar pan rong masan en silang ir,<l eID="gen2433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2434"/>O re pan kauleki al en Ieowa kan, pwe lingan en Ieowa meid laud.<l eID="gen2434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2435"/>Pwe Ieowa me lapalap ap kotin irerong me tikitik kan, o a kotin mangi me aklapalap, sang ni wasa doo.<l eID="gen2435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2436"/>Ni ai weweid nan kamasak melel, kom kin kotin kolekol ong ia maur i, o kom kin kapa wong lim omui pan makar en ai imwintiti kan, o kom sauasa ia da ki lim omui maun.<l eID="gen2436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2437"/>Ieowa pan kotin wiawia ia. Maing Ieowa, omui kalangan me pan potopot eta; Kom der kotin muei sang dodok en lim omui kan.<chapter eID="Ps.138"/> <l eID="gen2437" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2429"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: MAING, Ieowa, kom kotin kadiarokada lol i, ap kotin mangi ia.<l eID="gen2439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2440"/>Kom pil kotin mangi ma i momod de uda, ap kotin mangi ai lamelam ni ar kotin doo sang ia.<l eID="gen2440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2441"/>Ir me kotin kupura ia ni ai potopoto sili, o ni ai wonon, ap kotin mangi ai tiak kan karos.<l eID="gen2441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2442"/>Melel Maing Ieowa, sota ai poto sang ni lo i, me kom sota kotin mangi.<l eID="gen2442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2443"/>Kom kin kotin ieiang ia wasa karos, o kom kin kapado lim omui po i.<l eID="gen2443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2444"/>Mepukat meid kapuriamui ong ia, meid apwal, i sota kak dedeki.<l eID="gen2444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2445"/>Ia wasa, i pan kak ko sang mon ngen ar ia? O ia wasa, i pan kak piti sang silang ar ia?<l eID="gen2445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2446"/>Ma i piridala nanlang, kom kotikot wasa o, o ma i onop ong wendi nan wasan mela, kom pil kotikot ia.<l eID="gen2446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2447"/>Ma i ale pan pir en umpul en katipin, ap mimieta ni kailan madau,<l eID="gen2447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2448"/>Lim ar pil pan kare ia wasa o, o lim ar maun pan kolekol ia.<l eID="gen2448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2449"/>Ma i pan inda: Rotorot en kadupwal ia di, pong ap pil pan marainla imp ai.<l eID="gen2449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2450"/>Pwe rotorot so kin rotorot mo omui, o pong kin marain dueta nin ran, rotorot kin dueta marain.<l eID="gen2450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2451"/>Pwe kom me kotin wiadar mudilik i, o kom kotin wia ia da nan kaped en in ai.<l eID="gen2451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2452"/>I danke komui, duen kapuriamui en ai wiaui ia da, meid kapuriamui sapwilim ar dodok kan, ngen i pil dedeki melel mepukat.<l eID="gen2452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2453"/>Kokon ai kan me sansal ong komui ni ai wiauier wasa rir, ni ai wiauier wasa lol en sappa.<l eID="gen2453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2454"/>Silang ir mangi ia ni ai saikenta wiauier, o ran karos me kokodo, ap saikenta mia, me kileledier nan sapwilim omui puk o.<l eID="gen2454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2455"/>Maing Kot, meid kasampwal ong ia duen meakan karos, me komui kin kupukupura!<l eID="gen2455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2456"/>Ma i pan wadok ir, i sota pan kak ong, pwe re me toto sang pik en oror, ni ai pirida, i kin mimieta re omui.<l eID="gen2456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2457"/>O Maing Kot, kom sota men kamela me doo sang Kot akan; o me kin inong iong nta, en muei sang ia!<l eID="gen2457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2458"/>Pwe re kin lokaia sued duen komui, o sapwilim omui imwintiti kan kin kangudi ni sokarepa.<l eID="gen2458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2459"/>I kin kailongki, Maing Ieowa, me kin kailongki komui, o i suedeki ar palian komui.<l eID="gen2459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2460"/>I kin kailong kin ir melel, re wialar ai imwintiti.<l eID="gen2460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2461"/>Maing Kot, kom kotin kasaui ia, o mangi duen mongiong i, kotin rapaki duen me i kin lamelame.<l eID="gen2461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2462"/>O kom kotin masani, ma i mi pon al sued, o kotin kalua ia pon al soutuk.<chapter eID="Ps.139"/> <l eID="gen2462" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa kom kotin dore ia la sang aramas sued akan; pera sang ia aramas morsued akan.<l eID="gen2464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2465"/>Me lamelame sued nan mongiong arail, o kareda pei nin ran karos.<l eID="gen2465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2466"/>Irail kin ada lo arail dueta serpent; poisen en serpent mi pan lo arail. Sela.<l eID="gen2466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2467"/>Pera wei sang ia pa en me doo sang Kot akan, o aramas morsued akan, me kin madamadaua duen ar pan kawe ia la.<l eID="gen2467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2468"/>Me aklapalap akan kin rir insare ia, o uk pot, me re wiai ong ia liman al o; o song, en men kol ia di, me re wiadar. Sela.<l eID="gen2468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2469"/>A ngai indang Ieowa: Komui ai Kot; kom kotin ereki ai ngidingid, Maing Ieowa!<l eID="gen2469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2470"/>Ieowa Kaun, iei sauas pa i kelail; ni ansau en pei komui peraer mong ai.<l eID="gen2470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2471"/>Maing Ieowa, kom der kotin mueid ong me doo sang Kot akan ar inong; o der kotin kapwaiada insen ar, pwe re de aklapalapala. Sela.<l eID="gen2471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2472"/>Me sued kot, me ai imwintiti kaonopadang ia en sapal wong pein irail.<l eID="gen2472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2473"/>Kisiniai en moredi ong po ’rail; A en kotin kase irail di nan kisiniai, nan lapake, pwe ren solar pitila.<l eID="gen2473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2474"/>Me lo a sued, ender pwaida nan sap o, ol morsued, me sued en pakipaki i, lao a pan pupedi.<l eID="gen2474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2475"/>I asa, me Ieowa pan kotin apapwali me luet akan, o sauas pung en me samama kan.<l eID="gen2475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2476"/>Melel, me pung kan pan kapinga mar omui, me melel akan pan mimieta mon silang ar.<chapter eID="Ps.140"/> <l eID="gen2476" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2463"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, i kin likwir wong komui, kom kotin madang dong ia; kom kotin ereki ngil ai, ni ai pan likwir wong komui.<l eID="gen2478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2479"/>Kom kotin kasampwaleki ai kapakap dueta mairong isis; o pokadan pa i kat dueta mairong eu ni sautik.<l eID="gen2479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2480"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin sinsila au ai, o pera kil en au ai.<l eID="gen2480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2481"/>O der kotin kainong ong me sued kot mongiong i, pwe i ender iang me doo sang Kot akan wiada me sued, o i ender iang ir kangkang, me re kin iauki.<l eID="gen2481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2482"/>Me pung amen en kame ia ni a kadek, o kapung ia, pwe iei me pan mau ong ia dueta le ong mong ai, mepukat i sota pan kang, o i kin kapakap ansau karos, pwe ren der wiai ong ia me sued.<l eID="gen2482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2483"/>Kalua parail en pisikendi sang pon paip; irail ap pan duki ong ai padak o asa, me ir me mau.<l eID="gen2483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2484"/>Duen amen pan wera pasang sap, iduen ti ’t akan, me lokidokila ni kailan wasan mela.<l eID="gen2484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2485"/>Ari so, mas ai kin ariri komui, Maing ai Kot, i liki komui, kom der kotin kasapokela maur i.<l eID="gen2485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2486"/>Pera wei sang ia insar, me re kaonop ong ia, o song en men kol ia di ren me morsued akan.<l eID="gen2486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2487"/>Me doo sang Kot akan en pein lodi ong arail insar, a ngai en dauli.<chapter eID="Ps.141"/> <l eID="gen2487" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2477"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: I LIKWIRKI ngil laud ong Ieowa. Ki ngil ai i kin ngidingideki ong Ieowa.<l eID="gen2489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2490"/>I kin kasansale ong i ai apwal akan, o i padaki ong i katoutou pa i kan.<l eID="gen2490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2491"/>Ngen i lao luetala, kom ap pan kotin apapwali. Irail rir wiai ong ia insar eu liman al, me i kin weid ia.<l eID="gen2491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2492"/>I kilang ni pali maun i, ari sota, me men sauasa ia; i sota kak pitila, pwe sota me kin idok ia.<l eID="gen2492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2493"/>Maing Ieowa, i likwir wong komui, o potoan: Komui me ai paip, o pwais ai nan sap en me maur akan.<l eID="gen2493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2494"/>Kom kotin mangi ai weriwer, pwe ngai meid luet; dore ia la sang me kin pakipaki ia; pwe ngai sota itar ong ir.<l eID="gen2494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2495"/>Kalua sang ngen i nan imateng, pwe i en kapinga mar omui. Me pung kan pan pokon dong ia, ma kom pan kotin sauasa ia.<chapter eID="Ps.142"/> <l eID="gen2495" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2488"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: MAING Ieowa, kom kotin ereki ai kapakap, o karong ar en mangi ai ngidingid; mangi ia ni ar melel o ar pung.<l eID="gen2497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2498"/>Kom der kotin kadeikada sapwilim omui ladu, pwe mo ’mui sota me maur men me pung.<l eID="gen2498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2499"/>Pwe imwintiti kin masamasan ia, o kin tiakedi maur i; a kin kase ia di wasa rotorot dueta ir me melar mas o.<l eID="gen2499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2500"/>Ngen i kin luetala, o mongiong i ponla.<l eID="gen2500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2501"/>I kin tamanda ansau mas akan, o madamadaua duen ar wiawia kan; i kin lamelame duen dodok en lim omui kan.<l eID="gen2501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2502"/>I kin kapa wong komui pa i kat, duen sap madekong eu, me kin inong iong katau, iduen ngen i kin inong iong ir. Sela.<l eID="gen2502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2503"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin mangi ia madang, ngen i kin dupokala. Kom der kotin karirala silang omui sang mo i, pwe i ender dueta ir, me pan lokidokila.<l eID="gen2503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2504"/>Nin soran omui kalangan en pwara dong ia, pwe i kin liki komui; kom kotin kasale ong ia al, me i en weid ia, pwe ngen i kin auiaui komui.<l eID="gen2504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2505"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin dore ia la sang ai imwintiti kan, i kin kaporoporeki komui.<l eID="gen2505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2506"/>Padaki ong ia, pwe i en dodok duen kupur omui; pwe komui ai Kot; ngen omui mau en kotin kalua ia pon al pung;<l eID="gen2506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2507"/>Maing Ieowa, kom kotin kamau ia da pweki mar omui; kalua ia sang nan wasa apwal ni omui pung.<l eID="gen2507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2508"/>O kotin kawela ai imwintiti kan, pweki omui kalangan; o kotin kamela karos me kin katoutoui ngen i, pwe ngai sapwilim omui ladu.<chapter eID="Ps.143"/> <l eID="gen2508" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2496"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: KAPING ong Ieowa ai paip, me kin padaki ong pa i kat pei, o sondin pa i kat mauin.<l eID="gen2510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2511"/>Komui ai mak, o ai kel, o ai imateng ileile, o ai saundor, o pere pa i, i me i kin liki, me kin kaloedi ong ia ngai aramas akan.<l eID="gen2511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2512"/>Dakot aramas o, pwe komui kin kotin kupukupura i, de nain aramas, pwe komui kin kotin apapwali i?<l eID="gen2512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2513"/>Aramas amen dueta sota meakot, a ansau kin tangwei dueta mota.<l eID="gen2513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2514"/>Maing Ieowa, kotikidi sapwilim ar lang akan o kotidi dong kit, kotin sair nana kan, pwe adiniai en kusuda.<l eID="gen2514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2515"/>O kotin kadarado liol, pwen kamueit ir pasang, kasiki wei sapwilim ar kanangan kasik kan, pwen kamasak ir wei.<l eID="gen2515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2516"/>Kapawei lim ar akan sang ni mol omui wasa ileile o dore ia la, o kotin kamaur ia da sang nan pil kalaimun o sang nan pa en nain men wai,<l eID="gen2516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2517"/>Me au arail kin lokaia likam o ar wiawia kan me sapung.<l eID="gen2517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2518"/>Maing Kot, i pan kaule kin komui kaul kap pot, i pan kasangki ong komui arp, psalter me sal eisok.<l eID="gen2518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2519"/>Komui me kotiki ong nanmarki kan, ren poedi, o dorela sapwilim omui ladu Dawid sang ni kodlas en me sued.<l eID="gen2519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2520"/>Re pil kotin dore ia la sang nan pa en nain men wai, me au arail kin lokaia likam o ar wiawia kan me sapung.<l eID="gen2520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2521"/>Pwe nait putak kan en kakairida dueta tuka mau kan, o nait seripein dueta mas en did en nan kaim en im lingan eu.<l eID="gen2521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2522"/>Pwe at pera en nak en dir en kisin manga, en itar ong kikiwei song karos, o at sip akan en kaparapar mau, wiala kid o nen pon at mos o;<l eID="gen2522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2523"/>O at kau ol en kak ong dodok toto, pwe sota me sued kot de men kuli, de sangesang en wiaui nan al at akan.<l eID="gen2523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2524"/>Meid pai wei eu, me kin due met! Meid pai wei eu, me Ieowa arail Kot!<chapter eID="Ps.144"/> <l eID="gen2524" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2509"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: I PAN kapinga komui, ai Kot o Nanmarki, o kapinga mar omui ansau karos kokolata.<l eID="gen2526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2527"/>I pan kapinga komui ni ran akan karos, o kapinga mar omui ansau kan karos kokolata.<l eID="gen2527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2528"/>Ieowa meid lapalap, o kapingapan, o sota me kak dedeki duen a lapalap.<l eID="gen2528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2529"/>Seri en seri kan pan kapinga omui dodok kan, o kasokasoi duen omui manaman.<l eID="gen2529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2530"/>I pan kasokasoia duen lingan en omui kapwat, o i pan kauleki duen omui manaman akan.<l eID="gen2530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2531"/>O re pan kasokasoia duen manaman en omui dodok kan, o pan kapakaparok duen omui lapalap.<l eID="gen2531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2532"/>Irail pan kasokasoia duen omui kalangan lapalap, o pereperen o kapinga duen omui pung.<l eID="gen2532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2533"/>Ieowa me dir en mak o kapunglol, kanongama o limpok.<l eID="gen2533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2534"/>Ieowa me kalangan ong karos o a kapunglol ong a wiawia kan karos.<l eID="gen2534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2535"/>Sapwilim omui wiawia kan en kapinga komui. Maing Ieowa, o sapwilim omui lelapok kan en kapinga komui.<l eID="gen2535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2536"/>O ren kasokasoia duen lingan en wei omui, o ren kapakaparokki duen omui manaman.<l eID="gen2536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2537"/>Pwe aramas akan en dedeki duen omui manaman o lingan ong wei omui.<l eID="gen2537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2538"/>Wei omui wei soutuk eu, o omui kakaun pan duedueta kokolata.<l eID="gen2538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2539"/>Ieowa kin kotin kolekol karos, me pan pupedi, o kainsen maula karos, me mamauk.<l eID="gen2539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2540"/>Por en mas karos kasikasik komui, o kom kotiki ong ir kan ar kisin manga ni ar ansau.<l eID="gen2540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2541"/>Kom kotiki pasang lim omui o kadirela karos, me memaur, duen kupur omui.<l eID="gen2541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2542"/>Ieowa me pung ni al a karos o saraui ni a wiawia kan karos.<l eID="gen2542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2543"/>Ieowa kotikot ren karos, me likwir ong i, karos, me likwir melel.<l eID="gen2543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2544"/>A kotin wiai ong, me masak i duen ar inong. A kotin mangi ar ngidingid, ap kotin sauasa ir.<l eID="gen2544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2545"/>Ieowa kin kotin sinsila karos, me pok ong i, a pan kamela me doo sang Kot akan karos.<l eID="gen2545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:21
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2546"/>Au ai pan kapinga Ieowa, o uduk karos kapinga mar a saraui ansau kan karos kokolata.<chapter eID="Ps.145"/> <l eID="gen2546" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2525"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: NGEN i kapinga Ieowa!<l eID="gen2548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2549"/>I pan kapinga Ieowa arain ai maur, i pan kauleki psalm akan ong ai Kot arain maur i.<l eID="gen2549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2550"/>Der kaporoporeki saupeidi kan, pwe irail aramas o sota kak sauasa.<l eID="gen2550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2551"/>Pwe ngen en aramas udan a pan kokola, o a pan pur ong wiala pwel, i ran ota a solar kak madamadaua meakot.<l eID="gen2551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2552"/>Meid pai me sauas parail Kot en Iakop, me kin kaporoporeki Ieowa a Kot,<l eID="gen2552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2553"/>Me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa, o madau, o audepa rail karos, me kin melel potopot eta,<l eID="gen2553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2554"/>Me kotin sauasa pung en me lodi ong kalokolok mal, me kamanga me men mangadar. Ieowa kin kotin lapwada me salidi kan.<l eID="gen2554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2555"/>Ieowa kin kotin kapad pasang mas en me maskun akan. Ieowa kin kotin kainsenemaula me mauk; Ieowa kin kotin pok ong me pung kan.<l eID="gen2555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2556"/>Ieowa kin kotin sinsila men wai kan, o sauasa me sapoupou o li odi kan, ap kotin kawela al en me doo sang Kot akan.<l eID="gen2556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2557"/>Ieowa iei Nanmarki soutuk, om Kot Sion kokolata. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.146"/> <l eID="gen2557" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2547"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: KAPINGA Ieowa! Pwe meid kasampwal, en kapinga atail Kot; pwe mak eta en kauleki kaul en kaping.<l eID="gen2559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2560"/>Ieowa kin kotin kauada Ierusalem, o a kin kapokon pena me salongala ren men Israel.<l eID="gen2560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2561"/>A kotin kamauiala me lol olar akan, o kotin kitim pena ar olar akan.<l eID="gen2561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2562"/>A kin kotin wadok pena usu kan, o kin kida ad arail karos.<l eID="gen2562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2563"/>Atail Kaun me lapalap o meid manaman, o sota me kak dedeki duen a erpit.<l eID="gen2563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2564"/>Ieowa kin kotin kamanada me luet akan, ap sikendi me doo sang Kot akan nan pwel.<l eID="gen2564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2565"/>Komail kakaul ong Ieowa, en wia pwin pasang o danke o kapinga atail Kot iang arp,<l eID="gen2565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2566"/>Me kin kotin pena kila lang tapok kan, o kotin kamoredi katau ong sappa; me kotin kawosada rä pon dol akan,<l eID="gen2566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2567"/>Me kin kotiki ong man akan kan ar, rape pulepul akan, me kin likwir ong i.<l eID="gen2567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2568"/>A sota kin kotin kupura kelail en os o, de nä en ol amen.<l eID="gen2568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2569"/>Ieowa kin kotin kupura, me masak i, me kin kaporoporeki a kalangan.<l eID="gen2569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2570"/>Ierusalem, kapinga Ieowa! Sion, kapinga om Kot!<l eID="gen2570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2571"/>Pwe i me kin kotin katengetengedi sal mata en om wanim akan, o kotin kapaiada noum seri ko, me mimi lole.<l eID="gen2571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2572"/>A kin kotiki ong irair en sap om muei mau, o kin kotin kamanga kin uk korn kasampwalia.<l eID="gen2572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:15
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2573"/>A kin kotin kadardi ong sappa a masan akan, a kusoned kin lolok sili madang.<l eID="gen2573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:16
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2574"/>A kin kotikidi sno dueta koten o kamoredi poik dueta pas.<l eID="gen2574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:17
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2575"/>A kin kotin kasedi akel; is me kak insenemau ni a kapou?<l eID="gen2575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:18
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2576"/>A kin masani, ap pan pei pasang, a kin kotin kadar wei ang, ap kin pwilewei.<l eID="gen2576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:19
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2577"/>A kotin kasansale ong Iakop a masan o ong Israel a kusoned o pung.<l eID="gen2577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:20
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2578"/>A sota kin kotin wia due ong eu wei, i me re sota kin asa ki a pung. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.147"/> <l eID="gen2578" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2558"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: KOMAIL kapinga Ieowa nanlang, kapinga i nan wasa ileile!<l eID="gen2580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2581"/>Komail sapwilim a tounlang, karos kapinga i, komail sapwilim a men en kadar karos, kapinga i!<l eID="gen2581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2582"/>Koma katipin o saunipong, kapinga i, o komail usu piripir karos, kapinga i!<l eID="gen2582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2583"/>Komail lang pokon, o pil komail pil akan pon ira pan lang, kapinga i!<l eID="gen2583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2584"/>Irail en kapinga mar en Ieowa, pwe a me kotin pangok, ap miala.<l eID="gen2584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2585"/>Ap kotiki ong ir, ren mimieta kokolata, o kotiki ong ir kusoned eu, me re sota pan kawela.<l eID="gen2585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2586"/>Toun sappa, kapinga Ieowa, walros o man akan karos, o pil en madau kan karos.<l eID="gen2586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2587"/>O kisiniai, o akel, o sno, o tokoi, o melimel, me kin kaloki sili a kusoned akan,<l eID="gen2587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2588"/>Komail nana o dol akan karos, tuka me wa mau o seder karos;<l eID="gen2588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2589"/>Man laualo o mand akan karos, man korop o manpir akan,<l eID="gen2589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2590"/>Komail nanmarki en sappa o wei kan karos, saupeidi o saunkadeik kan,<l eID="gen2590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2591"/>Manakap o peinekap, me ma o seri kan,<l eID="gen2591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2592"/>Irail karos en kapinga mar en Ieowa; pwe i eta mar, me lapalap, a manaman mi pon angin sappa o lang.<l eID="gen2592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2593"/>A kotin sauasa os en sapwilim a kan. Sapwilim a lelapok kan en kapinga i, kadaudok en Israel, iei wei, me kin upa i. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.148"/> <l eID="gen2593" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2579"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: KAULEKI kaul kap pot ong Ieowa; pokon saraui en kapinga i.<l eID="gen2595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2596"/>Israel en peren kida i, me kotin wia irail da; seri en Sion en peren kida arail Nanmarki.<l eID="gen2596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2597"/>Ren kapinga mar a ni pwin en pokol; ren wia aip o arp.<l eID="gen2597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2598"/>Pwe Ieowa kotin peren kida sapwilim a aramas akan; a kotin kapwate kin me luet akan lingan.<l eID="gen2598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2599"/>Lelapok kan en pereperen o kapinga, o ngisingis pon ki arail akan.<l eID="gen2599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2600"/>Au arail en kapinga Kot, o kodlas kong en mi nan pa arail.<l eID="gen2600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2601"/>Pwe ren depuk ong men liki kan, o kaloke wei kan,<l eID="gen2601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2602"/>Pwen salie kidi arail nanmarki kan sal, o me kasampwal re ’rail ki sal mata,<l eID="gen2602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2603"/>Pwe ren kapwaiada kalokolok, me kileledi ong irail er mas o. Iduen wau en sapwilim a lelapok kan. Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.149"/> <l eID="gen2603" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: KAPINGA Kot nan sapwilim a tanpas saraui; kapinga i duen a manaman akan.<l eID="gen2605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2606"/>Kapinga i duen a wiawia kan; kapinga i ni a lingan lapalap!<l eID="gen2606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2607"/>Kapinga i ki trompete; kapinga i ki arp o laute!<l eID="gen2607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2608"/>Kapinga i ki aip o pwin en pokol; kapinga i ki sal en kasang o pilote.<l eID="gen2608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2609"/>Kapinga i ki simpel; kapinga i ki simpel kaselel!<l eID="gen2609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: <l level="1" sID="gen2610"/>Karos, me kin memaur, en kapinga Ieowa! Aleluia!<chapter eID="Ps.150"/> <l eID="gen2610" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2604"/><div eID="gen1" osisID="Ps" type="book"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:1
verses.text: PUK en di kan, me Iesus Kristus, me sapwilim en Dawid, me sapwilim en Apraam, tapi sang ia.

verses.name: Matthew 1:2
verses.text: Apraam me wiadar Isaak, a Isaak me wiadar Iakop, a Iakop me wiadar Iuda o ri a ol akan;

verses.name: Matthew 1:3
verses.text: A Iuda me wiadar Pares i Sara ren Tamar; a Pares me wiadar Esrom, a Esrom me wiadar Aram;

verses.name: Matthew 1:4
verses.text: A Aram me wiadar Aminadap, a Aminadap me wiadar Naason, a Naason me wiadar Salmon;

verses.name: Matthew 1:5
verses.text: A Salmon me wiadar Poas ren Raap, a Poas me wiadar Oped ren Rud, a Oped me wiadar Iese:

verses.name: Matthew 1:6
verses.text: A Iese me wiadar nanmarki Dawid, a Dawid me wiadar Salomo ren li odi en Urias;

verses.name: Matthew 1:7
verses.text: A Salomo me wiadar Reapeam, a Reapeam me wiadar Apia, a Apia me wiadar Asa;

verses.name: Matthew 1:8
verses.text: A Asa me wiadar Iosapat, a Iosapat me wiadar Ioram, a Ioram me wiadar Usia;

verses.name: Matthew 1:9
verses.text: A Usia me wiadar Iotam, a lotam me wiadar Aas, a Aas me wiadar Iskia;

verses.name: Matthew 1:10
verses.text: A Iskia me wiadar Manase, a Manase me wiadar Amon, a Amon me wiadar Iosia;

verses.name: Matthew 1:11
verses.text: A losia me wiadar Iekonia o ri a ol akan ni ansaun arail salilang Papilon.

verses.name: Matthew 1:12
verses.text: Murin arail salidi nan Papilon Iekonia me wiadar Sealtiel, a Sealtiel me wiadar Serupapel;

verses.name: Matthew 1:13
verses.text: A Serupapel me wiadar Apiud, a Apiud me wiadar Eliakim, a Eliakim me wiadar Asor;

verses.name: Matthew 1:14
verses.text: A Asor me wiadar Sadok, a Sadok me wiadar Akim, a Akim me wiadar Eliud;

verses.name: Matthew 1:15
verses.text: A Eliud me wiadar Eliaser, a Eliaser me wiadar Matan, a Matan me wiadar Iakop;

verses.name: Matthew 1:16
verses.text: A Iakop me wiadar Iosep, me likondeki Maria, me kaipwiedi Iesus, me maraneki Kristus.

verses.name: Matthew 1:17
verses.text: Di karos sang ren Apraam lei Dawid me eisokpaieu; a sang Dawid lei arail salidi nan Papilon di eisokpaieu; a sang arail salidi nan Papilon lei Kristus di eisokpaieu.

verses.name: Matthew 1:18
verses.text: Nan iet duen Kristus a kotin ipwidier: Ni ansau me in a Maria kisin nin ong Iosep, a diarokadar, me a liseanekier Ngen saraui mon ara tu pena.

verses.name: Matthew 1:19
verses.text: A a warok Iosep ol pung amen, ap sota men kanamenokala i, ap kupukupura, en rir muei sang i.

verses.name: Matthew 1:20
verses.text: A ni a kotin madamadaue duen mepukat, kilang, tounlang en Kaun o pwara dong i ni a aliman masani: Iosep nain Dawid koe, der masak, en ale om warok Maria, pwe Ngen saraui me a lisean kidar.

verses.name: Matthew 1:21
verses.text: A pan kaipwiedi seri ol amen, me koe pan ki ong mar a Iesus, pwe a pan dorela sapwilim a aramas akan sang nin dip arail.

verses.name: Matthew 1:22
verses.text: Mepukat karos wiauier, pwen pwaida me lokido sang Kaun ren saukop o, me masani:

verses.name: Matthew 1:23
verses.text: Kilang seripein makelekel o pan liseanda, ap kaipwiedi seri ol amen, irail ari pan ki ong mar a Imanuel; iet wewe: Kot me kotin ieiang kitail.

verses.name: Matthew 1:24
verses.text: Iosep lao pirida sang a saimok, ap kapwaiadar, me tounlang en Kaun o kotin kakalik ong i o apapwali a likond.

verses.name: Matthew 1:25
verses.text: A ap sota pweidi re a, lao a kaipwiedier sapwilim a meseni ol, ap kotiki ong mar a Iesus.<div eID="gen2612" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.1"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:1
verses.text: A IESUS lao ipwidier Petleem nan Iudäa ni muein nanmarki Erodes, kilang ol lolekong kai ap pwarado sang ni mas en Iang ko dong Ierusalem, kalelapok:

verses.name: Matthew 2:2
verses.text: Ia Nanmarki en Sus akan, me apton ipwidier, kotikot ia? Pwe se kilanger a usu ni sap en mas en lang ap pwarado, pwen pongi i.

verses.name: Matthew 2:3
verses.text: A nanmarki Erodes lao rongadar mepukat, ap landar o toun Ierusalem karos,

verses.name: Matthew 2:4
verses.text: Ap kupokon pena samero lapalap karos o sounkawewe en aramas akan kainoma re ’rail, wasa Kristus pan ipwidi ia.

verses.name: Matthew 2:5
verses.text: Irail ari potoan ong i: Nan Petleem en Iudäa; pwe iduen a intingidi ren saukop o:

verses.name: Matthew 2:6
verses.text: A koe Petleem, sap en Iuda, kaidin me tikitik nan pung en saupeidi en Iuda kan; pwe Kaun amen pan tapi sang uk, me pan kaunda nai aramas en Israel akan.

verses.name: Matthew 2:7
verses.text: Erodes ap kawai pena ol lolekong kan, kalelapok mau re ’rail ansau o, me usu o pwarado.

verses.name: Matthew 2:8
verses.text: I ari porone ir alang Petleem masani: Komail kowei raparapaki mau seri o; a komail lao diaradar, en kaireki dong ia, pwe i en pil kola pongi i.

verses.name: Matthew 2:9
verses.text: Irail lao ronger nanmarki o ap koieila. A kilang usu o, me irail kilanger nan sap en mas en lang, ti ong mo ’rail, a lao udi ong wasa o, me seri pwelel kotikot ia.

verses.name: Matthew 2:10
verses.text: Irail lao kilanger usu o, re ap peren kida kaualapia.

verses.name: Matthew 2:11
verses.text: Irail lao pedelong ong nan im o, re ap masanier seri pwelel o in a Maria, re ap kaipokedi o pongi i, o kapwaredar arail kapwa kan, ap mairongki ong i kold, o men pomau, o mire.

verses.name: Matthew 2:12
verses.text: Kot ap kotin pangoki ong irail ni arail auramen, en der purelang Erodes, re ap weidwei ni apot al purelang sap arail.

verses.name: Matthew 2:13
verses.text: Irail lao samalar, kilang tounlang en Kaun amen ap pwara dong ren Iosep ni a aliman masani: Paurida, ale seri pwelel en o in a tangwei lang Äkipten o kaukauson wasa o, I lao kaire kin uk, pwe Erodes pan rapaki seri pwelel o pwen kamatala.

verses.name: Matthew 2:14
verses.text: I ari kipada, aleer seri pwelel o in a ni pong, kotilang Äkipten;

verses.name: Matthew 2:15
verses.text: O kaukauson ia, lao en Erodes a matala, pwen pwaida, me lokido sang Kaun o, ren saukop o me masani: Sang nan Äkipten me I ekeredo nai ol o.

verses.name: Matthew 2:16
verses.text: Erodes lao mangier, me a sarokidier ol lolekong kan, ap ongiong kidar kaualap o poronelan, kamela seri ol karos, me mi Petleem o nan sap salong karos, me saunpar riau o tikitik sang, duen ansau me a kalelapok mau ren me lolekong kan.

verses.name: Matthew 2:17
verses.text: I dokan a pwaidar me lokido ren saukop Ieremia me masani:

verses.name: Matthew 2:18
verses.text: Ngil eu wiauier nan Rama, sangesang o maiei laud; Rael sangesangki na seri kan, a kang insenemaula, pwe irail soer mia.

verses.name: Matthew 2:19
verses.text: A Erodes lao matalar, kilang tounlang en Kaun amen ap pwara dong ren Iosep nan Äkipten ni a aliman,

verses.name: Matthew 2:20
verses.text: Masani: Paurida ale seri pwelel en o in a, ko wong nan sap en Israel, pwe irail melar, me rapaki, pwen kamela seri pwelel o.

verses.name: Matthew 2:21
verses.text: I ari kipadar, ale seri pwelel o in a, pure dong sap en Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 2:22
verses.text: A lao mangi, me Arkelaus kaunda Iudäa wiliandi sam a Erodes, ap lan kotilang wasa o. Kot ap kotin pangoki ong i ni a aliman, ap kotilang sap en Kaliläa kai.

verses.name: Matthew 2:23
verses.text: O kotido kotikot nan kanim eu me adaneki Nasaret, pwen pwaida, me lokido ren saukop akan: A pan maraneki men Nasaret.<div eID="gen2613" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.2"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:1
verses.text: A NI ran pukat Ioanes saunpaptais pwarado, padapadak nan sap en Iudäa,

verses.name: Matthew 3:2
verses.text: Masani: Komail kalula, pwe wein nanlang korendor.

verses.name: Matthew 3:3
verses.text: Pwe iei i, me saukop Iesaia katitiki, masani: Ngil en saunkair amen nan sap tan: Komail kaonopada al en Kaun o, kainenela al a!

verses.name: Matthew 3:4
verses.text: A i Ioanes me a likau wun en kamel o a pirapireki kil in man, a sak a mansiek o oni en nan wel.

verses.name: Matthew 3:5
verses.text: Toun Ierusalem, o toun Iudäa, o toun sap akan liman Iordan ap koieila re a;

verses.name: Matthew 3:6
verses.text: O irail paptaisela re a nan Iordan, ni ar weokada dip arail akan.

verses.name: Matthew 3:7
verses.text: A lao masanier Parisär o Sadusar me toto ko dong a paptais, ap masani ong irail: Dakot wan oter komail! Is me padaki ong komailer, en piti sang ni kamekam me kokodo?

verses.name: Matthew 3:8
verses.text: Ari, komail kapwareda wan kalula mau!

verses.name: Matthew 3:9
verses.text: A komail depa lamelame, me komail pan indang pein komail: Nan Apraam sam atail. Pwe i indai ong komail, me Kot kotin kak ong wiaki ong Apraam na seri kai takai pukat.

verses.name: Matthew 3:10
verses.text: Sile o mier ni tapin tuka kan; a tuka karos me so wa mau, pan paledi o lokidokila nani iai.

verses.name: Matthew 3:11
verses.text: Melel, i paptais kin komail pil ong kalula, a me kotido muri, nan me laude sang ia, ngai sowar ong, en wa sapwilim a sut; i me pan paptais kin komail Ngen saraui o kisiniai.

verses.name: Matthew 3:12
verses.text: Sapwilim a tanir mi ni lim a; a pan kotin koko melel sapwilim a pera, ap nekid pena sapwilim a wan korn nan im en nak, a dip akan a pan kotin karong kila kisiniai soutuk.

verses.name: Matthew 3:13
verses.text: Iesus ap kotido sang Kaliläa, koti dong Iordan ren Ioanes, pwen paptaisela re a.

verses.name: Matthew 3:14
verses.text: A Ioanes kotin kang, ap potoan ong: Mak eta i en paptaisela re ir, a iaduen ir me kotido re i?

verses.name: Matthew 3:15
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Wiada mas, pwe me kon ong kita, en kapwuiada pung kan karos; a ap duki ong i.

verses.name: Matthew 3:16
verses.text: Iesus lao paptaiselar, ap kotin madangada sang nan pil o. A kilang, nanlang ap ritidang i, i ari kotin masani Ngen en Kot kotidido ni mom en muroi men a kaipokedi po a.

verses.name: Matthew 3:17
verses.text: O kilang, ngil eu sang nanlang masani: Iet nai ol kompok, me I kin polaule kida!<div eID="gen2614" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.3"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:1
verses.text: IESUS ap kotin kakaluadala ren Ngen nan sap tan, pwen songesong ren tewil.

verses.name: Matthew 4:2
verses.text: A lao kotin kaisesolar ran pangaul o pon pangaul ap men sak.

verses.name: Matthew 4:3
verses.text: Men kasongesong ap pwara dong i indada: Ma komui Sapwilim en Kot, en masani, takai pukat en wiala prot.

verses.name: Matthew 4:4
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: A intingidier: Kaidin prot eta, me aramas kin memaureki, pwe masan akan karos, me kin pwili sang nin silang in Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 4:5
verses.text: Tewil ap kalualang i nan kanim saraui o kauada i pon kongkong en kaudok,

verses.name: Matthew 4:6
verses.text: Indang i: Ma komui Sapwilim en Kot, kasedi pein komui, pwe a intingidier: A pan kasilaki sapwilim a tounlang kan komui, o irail pan wa komui ni lim ar akan, pwe aluwilu omui ede dipikelekel ni takai eu.

verses.name: Matthew 4:7
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: A pil intingidier: Koe der kasongesong Kot om Kaun.

verses.name: Matthew 4:8
verses.text: Tewil ap pil kaluadalang i pon nana ileile kaualapia eu o kasale ong i wein sappa karos o a lingan,

verses.name: Matthew 4:9
verses.text: Indang i: Mepukat karos i pan ki ong komui, ma komui men poridi o pongi ong ia.

verses.name: Matthew 4:10
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Ko sang ia Satan, pwe a intingidier: Koe en pongi ong Kot om Kaun, i eta koe en papa.

verses.name: Matthew 4:11
verses.text: Tewil ap muei sang i, a kilang, tounlang kan ap pwarado papa ong i.

verses.name: Matthew 4:12
verses.text: A lao mangier, me Ioanes salidier, ap kotilang Kaliläa,

verses.name: Matthew 4:13
verses.text: O a kotin muei sang Nasaret, kotido kaukausonla Kapernaum, me mi ni kailan sed impan sap Sepulon o Naptalim;

verses.name: Matthew 4:14
verses.text: Pwen pwaida, me lokido ren saukop Iesaia me masani:

verses.name: Matthew 4:15
verses.text: Sap Sepulon o sap Naptalim, me sal ong sed, palilan Iordan, o Kaliläa en men liki kan,

verses.name: Matthew 4:16
verses.text: Aramas akan, me momod nan rotorot, kilanger marain lapalap eu, o irail me momod nan sap en mot en mela, marain eu dakar irail adar.

verses.name: Matthew 4:17
verses.text: I dokan Iesus kotin tapiadar padapadak o mamasani: Kalula, pwe wein nanlang korendor.

verses.name: Matthew 4:18
verses.text: A lao kotikot sili pon oror en lein Kaliläa, ap masanier pirien eu, Simon, me adaneki Petrus, o ri a Andreas, me kadukaduedi ara uk nan sed, pwe ira me saused.

verses.name: Matthew 4:19
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong ira: Idauen ia do, I pan wia kin koma saused en aramas!

verses.name: Matthew 4:20
verses.text: Ira madang muei sang uk akan o idauenla i.

verses.name: Matthew 4:21
verses.text: A ni a kotila sang wasa o, ap pil masani eu pirien, Iakopus, nain Sepedäus o ri a Ioanes, me mi nin sop ren sam ara Sepedäus, wonewone ara uk akan. I ari kotin molipe ira do.

verses.name: Matthew 4:22
verses.text: Ira madang muei sang sop o sam ara ap idauenla i.

verses.name: Matthew 4:23
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin kakan sili nan Kaliläa kaukawewe nan arail sinakoke kan o padapadak rongamau en wei, o kotin kakelada song en somau o luet akan karos nan pung en aramas akan.

verses.name: Matthew 4:24
verses.text: I ari indant sili nan Sirien pon. O irail wa dong i me somau kan karos, me aneki song en somau o wairok kai, o me tewil ti poa kan, o me pwepwe kan, o me rerer akan, i ari kotin kakela ir ada.

verses.name: Matthew 4:25
verses.text: Pokon kalaimun me idauenla i sang Kaliläa o Dekapolis, o Ierusalem, o Iudäa, o sang palilan Iordan.<div eID="gen2615" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.4"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:1
verses.text: A LAO masani pokon o, ap kotida pong dol eu; a lao kaipokedi, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kai dong i.

verses.name: Matthew 5:2
verses.text: I ari kotin dauasa pasang silang i kawewe ong irail masani:

verses.name: Matthew 5:3
verses.text: Meid pai, me samama ni ngen ir, pwe nairail wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:4
verses.text: Meid pai, me mauk, pwe re pan kamaitala.

verses.name: Matthew 5:5
verses.text: Meid pai, me opampap, pwe re pan sosoki sappa.

verses.name: Matthew 5:6
verses.text: Meid pai, me kin men manga o men nim me pung, pwe re pan medila.

verses.name: Matthew 5:7
verses.text: Meid pai, me kadek, pwe re pan diar kadek.

verses.name: Matthew 5:8
verses.text: Meid pai, me nan mongiong arail makelekel, pwe re pan ariri Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 5:9
verses.text: Meid pai, me kin tom pena, pwe re pan adaneki seri en Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 5:10
verses.text: Meid pai, me kamekameki pung, pwe nairail wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:11
verses.text: Komail meid pai, ma irail lalaue o paki komail o palian komail ni arail lokaia sued o likam pweki ngai.

verses.name: Matthew 5:12
verses.text: Komail insenemau o perenda kaualap; pweki katinge pamail me lapalap nanlang. Pwe iduen irail paki saukop oko, me mo ’mail.

verses.name: Matthew 5:13
verses.text: Sol pan sappa komail. A ma sol sara sang, da me a pan soleki? Nan a pan me mal kot, men lokidokila, o aramas en tiak pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:14
verses.text: Marain pan sappa komail, Kanim eu, me mi pon dol eu, sota kak rirla.

verses.name: Matthew 5:15
verses.text: Aramas pil sota kin isikeda lamp eu, ap ki ong pan kasak, pwe pon deu a, o a kin kamaraini toun im karos.

verses.name: Matthew 5:16
verses.text: Iduen omail marain en sansal mon aramas, pwe irail en udial omail wiawia man kan, ap kapikapinga Sam omail, me kotiluit nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:17
verses.text: Eder kikiong me I kodon, tiakedi kapung de saukop akan. I sota kodon tiakedi, a pwen kapwaiada.

verses.name: Matthew 5:18
verses.text: Pwe melel, I indai ong komail, lao lang o sappa pan poula, sota iota eu de kisin muai en kapung eu pan lokidokila, lao karos pan pwaida.

verses.name: Matthew 5:19
verses.text: Ari, meamen me tiakedi eu kisin kusoned tikitik pukat, ap pil padaki ong aramas, ren tiakedi, nan a pan tikitik nan wein nanlang. A meamen, me oke o padaki ong aramas, ren oke, i me pan lapalap nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:20
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, ma omail pung so man sang pung en saunkawewe o Parisär, akan, komail sota pan kak pedelon ong nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 5:21
verses.text: Komail rongadar, me a loki, ong men kaua: Koe der kamela aramas! A me pan kamela aramas, pan pangalang kadeik o.

verses.name: Matthew 5:22
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, meamen makarada mal pan ri a ol, pan pangalang kadeik. A me pan indang ri a ol: Raka, pan pangalang kapung. A me pan inda: Koe me pweipwei, pan lokidokila nan le en pweleko.

verses.name: Matthew 5:23
verses.text: Ari, ma koe wa dong pei saraui om mairong, ap tamanda wasa o, me ri om ol insensued pa om.

verses.name: Matthew 5:24
verses.text: Pwilikidi mas om mairong impan pei saraui, ap kola kadeke ri om ol, ap kodo kapwaiada om mairong.

verses.name: Matthew 5:25
verses.text: Madang materoki ong me palian ong uk ni om iang i pon al o, pwe me palian ong uk ender pangalang uk ren saunkapung, a saunkapung pangalang uk ren papa o, o koe pan lokidokila nan imateng.

verses.name: Matthew 5:26
verses.text: Melel I indai ong uk, koe sota pan ko sang wasa o, koe lao kapungala lua karos.

verses.name: Matthew 5:27
verses.text: Komail rongadar, me a lokido: Koe der kamal!

verses.name: Matthew 5:28
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, meamen ngingar li amen, pwen norok, nan a kamal ong i nan mongiong i.

verses.name: Matthew 5:29
verses.text: O ma pali maun en mas om kamakar uk, waikada sang o kase sang uk, pwe a mau ong uk, kisan war om en ola, sang war om pon en lokidokila nan pweleko.

verses.name: Matthew 5:30
verses.text: O ma pali maun en pa om kamakar uk, waika sang o kase sang uk, pwe a mau ong uk, kisan war om en ola, sang war om pon en lokidokila nan pweleko.

verses.name: Matthew 5:31
verses.text: A pil lokido: Meamen me pan kasela a paud, i en ki ong i kisin likau en kamueit.

verses.name: Matthew 5:32
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, meamen me pan kasela a paud, me so nenek nan a kin kamal eki i; a meamen, me paudeki me lokido kilar, nan i me kamal.

verses.name: Matthew 5:33
verses.text: Komail pil rongadar, me a loki ong men kaua: Koe der kaula likam; a koe kapwaiada om kaula ong Kaun o!

verses.name: Matthew 5:34
verses.text: I indai ong komail, der man kaula! Der kaukila nanlang, pwe mol en Kot;

verses.name: Matthew 5:35
verses.text: Pil der sappa, pwe utipa; pil der Ierusalem, pweki kanim en Nanmarki lapalap.

verses.name: Matthew 5:36
verses.text: Koe pil der kaukila mong om, pwe koe sota kak ong wiada pit en monga eu, en puetepuet de tontol.

verses.name: Matthew 5:37
verses.text: Omail kasokasoi pena en: Ei ei; so, so; pwe me dauli mepukat, kin tapi sang ni me sued.

verses.name: Matthew 5:38
verses.text: Komail rongadar, me a lokido: Por en mas en depukki por en mas; o ngi pot en depukki ngi pot.

verses.name: Matthew 5:39
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, komail der palian me sued. A meamen pikir uk ni pali maun en likin sap om, pil ki ong i pali teio.

verses.name: Matthew 5:40
verses.text: O meamen, me men wa uk ala ni kapung, pwen adia sang om sakit, en pil ki ong i om likau pup.

verses.name: Matthew 5:41
verses.text: O ma meamen ngidingid kin uk, en iang i mail eu, koe en iang mail riau.

verses.name: Matthew 5:42
verses.text: Kisakisai ong me kin ngidingid re om, o koe der saupei sang me poekipoeki re om!

verses.name: Matthew 5:43
verses.text: Komail rongadar, me a lokidor: Koe en pok ong men imp om ap kailongki om imwintiti!

verses.name: Matthew 5:44
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, pok ong omail imwintiti kan. o kapakap kin irail, me paki komail;

verses.name: Matthew 5:45
verses.text: Pwe komail en sapwilim en Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang. Pwe a kin kapwareda sapwilim a katipin pon me sued o me mau kan, o kotin kamoredi katau pon me pung o me sapung kan.

verses.name: Matthew 5:46
verses.text: Pwe ma komail pok ong, me kin pok ong komail, da me pan kating pa ’mail? Saunopwei sota kin wia due met?

verses.name: Matthew 5:47
verses.text: O ma komail ranamau ong ri omail akan, da me komail sikiki sang me tei kan? Men liki kan sota kin wia due met?

verses.name: Matthew 5:48
verses.text: Komail ari en unsokela dueta Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, a unsok.<div eID="gen2616" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.5"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:1
verses.text: KOMAIL kalaka, pwe komail der kisakis sansal mon aramas, pwe ren udial; pwe ede sota pwain omail ren Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 6:2
verses.text: Ari, koe lao kisakis, ede peuk saui mo om, duen me malaun akan kin wia nan sinakoke kan o nani al akan, pwe ren indand ren aramas. Melel I indai ong komail, re aleer arail pwain.

verses.name: Matthew 6:3
verses.text: A koe lao kisakis, der kasale ong pali maing om, me pali maun om kin wiada.

verses.name: Matthew 6:4
verses.text: Pwe om kisakis en rir; a Sam om, me kin masani wasa rir, pan kotin katingi uk.

verses.name: Matthew 6:5
verses.text: Koe lao wia kapakap, koe der ras ong me malaun akan, pwe re men kapakap nan sinakoke kan, o nani al akan, pwe ren sansal mon aramas. Melel I indai ong komail, re aleer arail pwain.

verses.name: Matthew 6:6
verses.text: A koe lao wia kapakap, ko ong nan om pera, a koe lao ritingidier wanim o, ap kapakap ong Sam om, me kotikot wasa rir, a Sam om, me kin masani wasa rir, pan kotin katingi uk.

verses.name: Matthew 6:7
verses.text: Komail lao kapakap, komail depa purepur ong lokaia mal, duen men liki kan, pwe re kiki ong, me re pan pwaikida ar lokaia toto.

verses.name: Matthew 6:8
verses.text: Komail ari ender dueta irail, pwe Sam omail kotin mangi meakan, me mau ong komail, mon omail poeki re a.

verses.name: Matthew 6:9
verses.text: A iet duen omail pan wia kapakap: Sam at, me kotikot nanlang. Mar omui en saraui.

verses.name: Matthew 6:10
verses.text: Wei omui en pwaida. Kupur omui en wiaui sappa dueta nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 6:11
verses.text: Kotikido ran wet at tungol kaukaule.

verses.name: Matthew 6:12
verses.text: Lapwa sang kit dip at, dueta kit me kin lapwada koros, me wia dipi ong kit.

verses.name: Matthew 6:13
verses.text: Eder kaluang kit ren me katikatiamau kan, a nekid kit sang ni me sued akan,

verses.name: Matthew 6:14
verses.text: Pwe ma komail pan makeki ong aramas dip ar akan, Sam omail nanlang pan pil makeki ong komail.

verses.name: Matthew 6:15
verses.text: A ma komail sota pan makeki ong aramas dip ar akan, nan Sam omail sota pil pan makeki ong komail dip omail akan.

verses.name: Matthew 6:16
verses.text: Komail lao kaisesol, eder mas en sang duen me malaun akan, pwe re kin kawukila mas arail, pwe aramas en kilang arail kaisesol. Melel I indai ong komail, re aleer arial pwain.

verses.name: Matthew 6:17
verses.text: A koe lao kaisesol, usor mong om o opinok.

verses.name: Matthew 6:18
verses.text: Pwe koe dor kasale ong aramas om kaisesol, a ong Sam om, mi kotikot wasa rir, a Sam om, me kin masani nan wasa rir, pan kotin katingi uk.

verses.name: Matthew 6:19
verses.text: Komail der ki pena omail pai kan nin sappa, wasa man en mot o mir pan kawela ia, o men pirap kin weirada o pirapala.

verses.name: Matthew 6:20
verses.text: A komail ki pena omail pai kan nanlang, wasa man en mot de mir sota pan kawela, o men pirap sota kin weirada de pirapala.

verses.name: Matthew 6:21
verses.text: Pwe wasa om pai mia ia, iei wasa mongiong om kin pil mia ia.

verses.name: Matthew 6:22
verses.text: Por en mas iei marain en pali war. Ari, ma mas om makelekel, war om karos pan dir eng marain;

verses.name: Matthew 6:23
verses.text: A ma mas om me sued, war om karos pan dir en rotorot. A ma marain, me mi lol om, pan rotorot, daduen wan rotorot!

verses.name: Matthew 6:24
verses.text: Sota amen me pan kak papa saumas riamen, pwe a pan kailongki amen, ap pok ong me teio, de a pan kasampwaleki amen, ap mamaleki me teio. Komail sota pan kak papa Kot o mamon.

verses.name: Matthew 6:25
verses.text: I me I indaiki ong komail: Eder ngongongki ong maur omail, me komail pan kang o me komail pan nim, pil sota ong war omail, me komail pan likau kida. Pwe maur so kasampwal sang kisin manga, o pali war sang likau?

verses.name: Matthew 6:26
verses.text: Kalelapok ong manpir pan lang; re sote, kin kamoredi, re soin kin dolung, re sota kin nak pena; ari so, Sam omail nanlang kotin kamakamanga irail; a ia duen, komail so kasampwal sang irail?

verses.name: Matthew 6:27
verses.text: A is nan pung omail, ni a ngongki, me pan kak use pasang pein i ki tipong en pa eu?

verses.name: Matthew 6:28
verses.text: O menda komail ngongki likau? Kalelapok ong kiop akan, me mi nan sap, duen ar kakairida. Re sota kin dodok o sota monkol pena.

verses.name: Matthew 6:29
verses.text: A I indai ong komail: Nan Salomo ni a lingan karos sota a likau dueta apot irail.

verses.name: Matthew 6:30
verses.text: Ari, ma iduen Kot kotin kapwataki dip, me mi nan sap, me kin mi ran wet, a lakap pan lokidokila nan kisiniai, dadue a sota pan kotin kalikauwi komail da, me poson tikitik?

verses.name: Matthew 6:31
verses.text: I me komail der ngongongki moinda: Da me se pan kang? De da me se pan nim? De da me se pan likau kida?

verses.name: Matthew 6:32
verses.text: Pwe mepukat men liki kan kin raparapaki; pwe Sam omail nanlang kotin mangi, me mepukat karos mau ong komail.

verses.name: Matthew 6:33
verses.text: Rapaki mas wein Kot o a pung, a mepukat karos pan pouselang komail.

verses.name: Matthew 6:34
verses.text: Eder ngongki ong lakap; pwe lakap pan ngongki ong pein i; a itar ong ran eu pein a sued.<div eID="gen2617" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.6"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:1
verses.text: DER kadeikada, pwe komail der pakadeikada.

verses.name: Matthew 7:2
verses.text: Pwe duen kadeik, me komail kadeikekida aramas, iduen komail pan pakadeikada, o duen men song, me komail kin songki, iduen a pil pan song ong komail,

verses.name: Matthew 7:3
verses.text: A menda koe kilikilang diper ni mas en ri om ol, a sota kan ataut o ni mas om?

verses.name: Matthew 7:4
verses.text: De iaduen koe pan indang ri om ol: Aui mas, i pan ki sang diper ni mas om. A kilang, ataut apot mi ni pein mas om?

verses.name: Matthew 7:5
verses.text: Malaun amen koe, ki sang mas ataut ni mas om, koe ap pan kak kilang, duen om pan kak ki sang diper ni mas en ri om ol,

verses.name: Matthew 7:6
verses.text: Komail der ki ong kidi me saraui kot! O omail pai kan der kasedi ong mon pwik kan, pwe ren de tiak pasang, ap saupeido ngalis komail pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 7:7
verses.text: Poeki, a komail pan tungole; rapaki, a komail pan diarada; letelet, a a pan ritida mo omail.

verses.name: Matthew 7:8
verses.text: Pwe karos, me poekipoeki, kin tungole; o me kin raparapaki, kin diarada; o me kin letelet, nan a pan ritida mo a.

verses.name: Matthew 7:9
verses.text: De is aramas nan pung omail, ma na putak pan poeki kisin prot, pan ki ong i takai eu?

verses.name: Matthew 7:10
verses.text: De ma a poeki mam amen, pan ki ong i serpent amen?

verses.name: Matthew 7:11
verses.text: Ari, ma komail me song sued, ap asa, ki ong noumail seri kan kisakis mau, melel kaualap Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, pan kotiki ong, me poeki re a me mau kan.

verses.name: Matthew 7:12
verses.text: Ari meakaros, me komail men, aramas en wiai ong komail, i me komail en wiai ong irail, pwe iei kapung o saukop akan,

verses.name: Matthew 7:13
verses.text: Pedelong ong nan wanim tätik! Pwe wanim me walek o al me tälap, me kodilang mela, o irail me toto, me kin pedelong ong wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 7:14
verses.text: A wanim me watikitik, o al me tätik, me ko ong maur o irail me malaulau, me kin diarada.

verses.name: Matthew 7:15
verses.text: Komail kalaka saukop likam akan, me kin pwara dong komail ni likau en sip, a lole irail song en kidi komad.

verses.name: Matthew 7:16
verses.text: Komail pan asa kin irail ni arail wa. Pwe da, aramas pan kak dolung sang wain ni karer, de pik sang ni tuka kamadak?

verses.name: Matthew 7:17
verses.text: Nan iduen tuka mau karos kin wa mau, a tuka sued kin wa sued.

verses.name: Matthew 7:18
verses.text: Tuka mau sota kak wa sued, o tuka sued sota kak wa mau.

verses.name: Matthew 7:19
verses.text: Ari tuka karos, me so wa mau pan paledi o lokidokila nuni iai.

verses.name: Matthew 7:20
verses.text: Ari, komail pan asa kin irail ni arail wa.

verses.name: Matthew 7:21
verses.text: Kaidin karos, me kin kasokasoi ong ia: Maing, Maing, pan pedelong ong nan wein nanlang, a me kin wiawia kupur en Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 7:22
verses.text: Me toto pan kasoi ong ia ni ran o: Maing, Maing, kit so kokopadar ni mar omiu, o ni mar omui kausaki tewil akan, o ni mar omui wia kidar manaman toto?

verses.name: Matthew 7:23
verses.text: I ap pan indai ong irail: I sota mail asa komail, kowei sang ia, komail me kin wiada me sued.

verses.name: Matthew 7:24
verses.text: A meumen rongada ai padak pukut ap peiki ong, I pan karasai ong i ol lolokong amen, me kauada im a pon paip,

verses.name: Matthew 7:25
verses.text: Katau lao moredi, o lakape pwilipwiledo, o ang me iripoki dong im o, a sota rongki pasang, pweki a kakauda pon paip.

verses.name: Matthew 7:26
verses.text: O meamen rongada ai padak pukat, ap sota kapwaiada, nan a pan rasong ol pweipwei men, me kauada im a pon pik en oror.

verses.name: Matthew 7:27
verses.text: Katau lao moredi o lapake pwilipwilido, o ang ma irepoki dong im o, a rongki pasang; o a rongk laud melel,

verses.name: Matthew 7:28
verses.text: Kadekadeo Iesus lao kaimwisokela masan pukat, pokon o ap puriamuiki kaualap sapwilim a padak o.

verses.name: Matthew 7:29
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kawewe ong irail ni manaman, a sota dueta arail saunkawewe kan.<div eID="gen2618" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.7"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:1
verses.text: A LAO kotido sang nin dol o, pokon kalaimun idauendo i.

verses.name: Matthew 8:2
verses.text: A kilang, ol tuketuk amen ap kodo pongi i indada: Maing, ma re kotin kupura, re pan kak ong kamakele ia da.

verses.name: Matthew 8:3
verses.text: I ari kotin kapawei lim a, sair i, masani: I men, koe en makelekel; ari, a tuketuk ap madang modi sang.

verses.name: Matthew 8:4
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Kalaka, koe de kaireki amen; a kola kasale ong samero pein uk, o kida mairong eu, me Moses masani, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Matthew 8:5
verses.text: A lao kotilong ong nan Kapernaum, senturion amen apedong i poeki re a.

verses.name: Matthew 8:6
verses.text: Indada: Maing, ai ladu wonon nan deu a somau kokon madak ap wairok kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 8:7
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: I pan kola kakelailada i.

verses.name: Matthew 8:8
verses.text: Senturion sapeng potoan ong: Maing, i sowar ren kotilong ong nan im ai; a ren masani eta, ai ladu up pan kelailada,

verses.name: Matthew 8:9
verses.text: Pwe aramas amen ngai, me mi pan mana en kaun akan, ap kaunda saunpei kai. A ma i pan indang amen: Kowei, a pan kola, o ong amen: Kodo, a pan kodo, o ong ai ladu: Wiada met, a pan wiada.

verses.name: Matthew 8:10
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin puriamuiki, masani ong irail me idauendo: Melel I indai ong komail, song en poson wet I so diaradar, sota nan Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 8:11
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, me toto pan kodo sang mas en lang, o kapin lang, iang Apraam, o Isaak, o Iakop ni tepel nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 8:12
verses.text: A me pweledan wei pan lokidokila nan rotorot liki, iei wasan maiei o teterok.

verses.name: Matthew 8:13
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong Senturion o: U kowei, a pan wiaui ong uk duen om poson. A ladu o ap kelailadar ni auer ota.

verses.name: Matthew 8:14
verses.text: Iesus lao kotilong ong nan im en Petrus, ap masani, me saulap a wonon somau karakar.

verses.name: Matthew 8:15
verses.text: I ari kotin sair pa a, a karakar ap ko sang. I ari pauridar papa i.

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer re wa dong i me toto, me tewil oko ti poa. I ari kotin kauseki sang ngen akan a masan o kakelada me somau kang karos.

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: Pwen pwaida, me lokido ren saukop Iesaia, me masani: A kotin ale ong pein i atail luet akan, o wa atail somau kan.

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani aramas toto pokon dong i, ap kotin masani, ren kotela palio palilan sed o.

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: Saunkawewe men ap pwara do potoan ong i: Saunpadak i pan idedauen ir wasa karos re pan kotila ia.

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Poks akan por arail mia, o manpir en pan lang pas arail mia, a Nain aramas sota wasan kaulawei mong a.

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: O amen sang nan pung en sapwilim a tounpadak kan potoan ong i: Maing re kotin mueid ong ia en kola mas sarepedi ai papa.

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Idauen ia do! Me melar akan en sarepedi pein ar melar akan.

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: A lao kotida pon sop o, sapwilim a tounpadak kan idauenla i.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: A kilang, ap ongiongidar nan sed, iluk kan ari kadupaledi sop o, a i kotin saimokelar.

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kai dong i, kaupada i, potoan ong: Maing, re kotin dore kit ala, kit pan mela!

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail me poson tikitik, da me komail masak ki? I ari kotin kipadar masani ong ang o sed, ap molelar kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: Aramas akan puriamuiki indada: Daduen men et, me ang o sed kin peiki ong?

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
