verses.text: A lao kotin lei ong palio nan sap en men Kerkasin, ol riamen, me tewil oko ti poa, ap tu ong i; ira kodado sang nan sousou kai, me makar kaualap, o sota me kak weid wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: A kilang, ira weriwer indada: Iesus Sapwilim en Kot, da me kit en wia re omui? Kom kotido kame kit mon ansau o leler?

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: A pwin pwik kalaimun mi kaila wei mangamanga sili.

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: Tewil oko ap poeki re a indada: Ma kom pan kause kit ala, ap mueid ong kit, en tilong nan pwin pwik o.

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong irail: U ko ong! Irail keredi sang, rap tilong nan pwin pwik o. A kilang, pwin pwik o tangdaui, tangedi ong wasa ukedi nan sed, irail ari mopelar nan pil o.

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: Silepa kan ap tangdaui tanglong ong kanim o kakaireki meakaros, duen me wiaui ong me tewil ti poa ko.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: A kilang, toun kanim koiei sang pokon dong Iesus. Irail lao kilanger i, rap poeki, a en kotila sang sap arail.<div eID="gen2619" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.8"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: I ARI kotida pon sop o, kotela pur ong sapwilim a kanim.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: A kilang, re wa dong i me somau kokon madak, me wonon pon pet. Iesus lao kotin masani ar poson, ap masani ong me somau kokon madak: Nai, kaporopor mau, dip om akan me lapwadar.

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: A kilang, saunkawewe kai mongemongeloleki: Lap o kin lalaue.

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: A Iesus lao mangi arail lamelam, ap kotin, masani: Menda komail lamelam sued nan mongiong omail?

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: Pwe ia me mongai ren inda: Dip om akan lapwadar! De inda: Uda aluwei?

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: A pwe komail en asa, me Nain aramas me manaman ong lapwada dip nin sappa iei me a kotin masanieki ong me somau kokon madak: Uda, ale ki om ko ong deu om!

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: I ari udar, koieilar deu a.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: Pokon lao kilanger mepukat, rap malamalauak kila kapinga Kot, me kotiki ong aramas manaman due met.

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: Iesus lao kotiwei sang wasa o, ap masani aramas amen, me ad a Matäus, me momod nan deun nopwei, ap kotin masani ong i: Idauen ia do! I ari uda idauenla i.

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: Kadekadeo a lao kaipokedi konot nan im o, kilang saunopwei o me dipan me toto iang Iesus o sapwilim a tounpadak kan konokonot.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: Parisär akan lao kilanger met, ap indang sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Da me omail Saunpadak iangki saunopwei o me dipan akan konokonot?

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin masani: Me kelail akan sota mau ong saunwini, pwe me somau eta.

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: A komail kola, padakki wewen kasoi pot et: I kin polauleki kadek a kaidin mairong isis. I kodon eker dong kalula me dipan akan, a kaidin me pung kan.

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: En Ioanes a tounpadak kan ap pwara dong re a potoan ong: Da me kit o Parisär akan kin kaisesol pan pak toto, a sapwilim omui tounpadak kang sota kin kaisesol?

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Da, toun kamadip en kapapaud pan kak kamauk ni ansau ol kamot mi re ’rail? A kadekadeo eu ran ol kamod pan peukawei sang irail, re ap pan kaisesol.

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: Sota amen me kin deipinaki likau kap likau maring, pwe me depin a pan teirok sang likau o, a por o pan laudela.

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: Pil sota amen me kin kodie ong wain kap nan ed maring, a ma ei ed akan pan ola, a wain pan wudokela, o ed akan pan ola. A re kin kodie ong wain kap nan ed kap, ira karos ap nekinek mau.

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: Ni a kotin masani ong irail mepukat, kilang saupeidi amen ap pedelong, poridi ong i potoan ong: Nai seripein apton melar, a ren kotido, pwil po a lim ar, a ap pan maureda.

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: Iesus ari kotida idauenla i, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan pil iang.

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: A kilang, li amen, me nta pwilipwil par ngaulriau, a kai ong pon palikia o sair imwin sapwilim a likau.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21
verses.text: Pwe a lamelame: Ma i doke sapwilim a likau, i pan kelailada.

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
verses.text: A Iesus kotin saupeila; a lao masani i, ap kotin masani: Seripein kaporopor mau, om poson me kakelail uk ada. A li o kelailadar ni auer ota.

verses.name: Matthew 9:23
verses.text: A Iesus lao kotilong ong nan im en saupeidi o, ap masani saunkasang o moromorong en aramas akan,

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: Ap kotin masani: Kowei sang, pwe seripein en sota melar, pwe a mamair. Irail ap kaurureki i.

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: Aramas akan lao kokok sang, i ap kotilong ong, ale pa a, seripein ap paurida.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: Mepukat ap lolok sili nan sap karos.

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: Iesus lao kotila sang wasa o, ol maskun riamen idauenla i, weriwer indada: Kupura kit, Komui sapwilim en Dawid!

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: A lao kotilong ong nan im o, me maskun ko ap ko dong i. Iesus ari masani ong ira: Koma kamelele, me I kak ong wiada met? Ira potoan ong: Ei Maing.

verses.name: Matthew 9:29
verses.text: I ap kotin sair mas ara masani: Duen oma poson a pan wiaui ong koma.

verses.name: Matthew 9:30
verses.text: Mas ara ari pad pasang. Iesus ap kotin kalik ira di masani: Kalaka, pwe meamen de asa!

verses.name: Matthew 9:31
verses.text: A ira koieilar katiti sili ni sap karos.

verses.name: Matthew 9:32
verses.text: Ira lao koieilar, kilang, irail ap wa dong i aramas amen, me lotong o tewil ti poa.

verses.name: Matthew 9:33
verses.text: Tewil lao pakausa sang, me lotong o ap lokaia; pokon o ap malamalauak kila indada: Nan dueta met a saikenta wiauier nan Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 9:34
verses.text: A Parisär indada: Nan saumas en tewil akan me a kausaki sang tewil akan.

verses.name: Matthew 9:35
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin kakan sili nan kanim laud o me tikitik kan kawewe nan ar sinakoke kan o padapadaki rongamau en wei, o kotin kakelada song en somau o luet akan karos.

verses.name: Matthew 9:36
verses.text: A lao masani pokon o, ap kotin kupuro kin irail, pwe irail soangiangalar o dupokalar dueta sip akan, me sota sile parail.

verses.name: Matthew 9:37
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Nan melel rak me kalaimun, a men dodok me malaulau.

verses.name: Matthew 9:38
verses.text: Komail ari poeki ren Kaun en rak, en kadarala toun dodok kan nan a rak.<div eID="gen2620" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.9"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:1
verses.text: A LAO kotin molipe penaer sapwilim a tounpadak ekriamen ap kotiki ong irail manaman, en poedi ngen saut akan, pwen kaus ir wei o kamauiala song en somau o luet karos.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2
verses.text: A iet mar en wanporon ekriamen: Men mas Simon, me maraneki Petrus, o ri a Andreas, o Iakopus nain Sepedäus, o ri a Ioanes;

verses.name: Matthew 10:3
verses.text: Pilipus o Partolomäus, Tomas o Matäus saunopwei men, Iakopus nain Alpäus, Lepäus, me pil adaneki Tadäus;

verses.name: Matthew 10:4
verses.text: Simon men Kana o Iudas Iskariot men pangala i.

verses.name: Matthew 10:5
verses.text: Ekriamen pukat, me Iesus kotin poronela, kotiki ong irail kusoned eu masani: Komail der weweid nani al en men liki kan o der pedelong ong nan kanim en Samaria.

verses.name: Matthew 10:6
verses.text: A kola ren sip akan en saun Israel, me salongalar.

verses.name: Matthew 10:7
verses.text: A ni omail kokola komail padapadak indada: Wein nan lang korendor.

verses.name: Matthew 10:8
verses.text: Kakeada me somau kan, o kamaureda, me melar akan, kamakelekeleda, me tuketuk kan, o kause wei tewil akan; a duen komail aleer ni tiak en kisakis, iduen komail pan kisakis weita.

verses.name: Matthew 10:9
verses.text: Komail der wewa kold, de silper, de mata nan omail ed akan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:10
verses.text: Pil der ed en sailok, de sakit riau, de sut, de sokon, pwe toundodok me war ong kan a kisin manga.

verses.name: Matthew 10:11
verses.text: A ma komail pan pedelong ong nan kanim laud de tikitik eu, raparapaki, ma meamen mi lole, me war ong; ari, komail pan mondi re a, lao komail pan ko wei sang.

verses.name: Matthew 10:12
verses.text: A ma komail pan pedelong ong nan im o, komail pan ranamau ong tou a kan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:13
verses.text: O ma re war ong, omail popol pan ko ong irail; a ma re sowar, omail popol pan pure dong komail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:14
verses.text: A wasa kis meamen sota pan kasamo komail, de sota men rong omail padak, komail ari pedoi sang nan im o de kanim, ap sepede sang pwel ni nä omail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:15
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, nan a pan mongai ong sap en Sodom o Komora ni ran en kadeik o sang kanim o.

verses.name: Matthew 10:16
verses.text: Kilang I kadar komail la duete sip akan nan pung en kidi en wel; komail ari lolekong dueta serpent, a tiak mau dueta muroi.

verses.name: Matthew 10:17
verses.text: Perki aramas, pwe re pan pangalang komail kapung kan, o re pan kame komail nan ar sinakoke kan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:18
verses.text: O Komail pan wisike wong kaun o nanmarki kai pweki ngai, pwen kadede ong irail, o ong men liki kan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:19
verses.text: Irail lao pangala komail, ede madamadaua duen tiak en omail pan lokaia; pwe a pan ko ong komail, ni auer o me komail pan inda.

verses.name: Matthew 10:20
verses.text: Pwe kaidin komail, me lokaia, a Ngen en Sam omail, me pan kalokaia komail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:21
verses.text: A pirien eu, amen pan pangala amen, pwen kamela, a sam na seri, a seri ko pan u ong ar papa o nono, o sauasa, pwe ira en kamela.

verses.name: Matthew 10:22
verses.text: O komail pan tantat ren aramas karos pweki ad ai; a me pan dadaurata, lei imwi i me pan dorola.

verses.name: Matthew 10:23
verses.text: A ma re pan kame komail nan eu kanim, komail ari tangala nan eu. Pwe melel I indai ong komail, komail sota pan kanikiala kanim en Israel karos, Nain aramas lao pwarador.

verses.name: Matthew 10:24
verses.text: Tounpadak sota kin laude sang a saunpadak, de ladu laude sang a monsap.

verses.name: Matthew 10:25
verses.text: A itar ong tounpadak, en paroki ong a saunpadak o ladu dueta a monsap. Ma re kaadaneki kaun en im o Peelsepup, nan melel kaualap, re pil pan wiai ong toun im akan dueta.

verses.name: Matthew 10:26
verses.text: Komail ari der masak irail, pwe sota me rir kot, me so pan sansaleda, o me okiok, me so pan kadiarokad.

verses.name: Matthew 10:27
verses.text: Me I indai ong komail nan rotorot, i me komail katiti nan marain; o me pan ko ong nan salong omail, i me komail pan kalok sili pon im akan.

verses.name: Matthew 10:28
verses.text: Komail der masak irail, me kin kemela pali war, ap sota kak ong kamela pali ngen. A komail masak melel i, me kak ong kasopokela pali war o ngen nan pweleko.

verses.name: Matthew 10:29
verses.text: Siok riamen sota kin netila ni denar eu? Ari so, sota amen ira pan pupedi nan pwel, ma sota pwilisang ren Sam omail.

verses.name: Matthew 10:30
verses.text: Ari pit en mong’ omail karos me wadawad penaer.

verses.name: Matthew 10:31
verses.text: Komail ari der masak, pwe komail me mau sang siok toto.

verses.name: Matthew 10:32
verses.text: Meamen pan ponasa ia mon aramas, nan i me I pan ponasa ren Sam ai, me kotikot, nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 10:33
verses.text: A meamen ponsasa ia mon aramas, nan i me I pil pan ponsasa ren Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 10:34
verses.text: Eder kiki ong, me I kodon kamuei maula sappa; kaidin muei mau, me I kokido, a kodlas pot.

verses.name: Matthew 10:35
verses.text: Pwe I kodon kaliak toror pasang aramas ong sam a, o seripein ong in a, a li o ong en a paud a nono.

verses.name: Matthew 10:36
verses.text: O pein toun im en aramas amen pan a imwintiti.

verses.name: Matthew 10:37
verses.text: Me pok ong sam de in a lapa sang a pok ong ia, nan a sowar ia. O me pok ong na putak de seripein lapa sang a pok ong ia, nan a sowar ia.

verses.name: Matthew 10:38
verses.text: A me so ale a lopu o idauen ia do, nan a sowar ia.

verses.name: Matthew 10:39
verses.text: Me pan diar maur, i me pan katia sang, a me kasela maur a pweki ngai, i me pan diarada.

verses.name: Matthew 10:40
verses.text: Meamen kasamo komail, kin kasamo ia, a me kin kasamo ia, nan a kin kasamo i, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: Matthew 10:41
verses.text: Meamen kasamo saukop amen ni mar en saukop, pan ale pwain en saukop amen. Me kasamo pung amen ni mar en me pung amen pan ale pwain en me pung amen.

verses.name: Matthew 10:42
verses.text: O meamen pan ki ong dal en pil lamelamur eu, pwe amen tikitik pukat en nim, ni mar en tounpadak amen, melel I indai ong komail, a sota pan katia sang pwain a.<div eID="gen2621" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.10"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO Iesus lao kaimwisokela a masan ong sapwilim a tounpadak ekriamen, ap kotila sang wasa o, pwen kaukawewe o padapadak nan ar kanim akan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: A Ioaneis lao ronger nan imateng wiawian Kristus, ap poronela a tounpadak kai.

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: Kalelapok re a: Ir me pan kotido, de sen auiaui amen?

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail kowei kaireki Ioanes, me komail rong o kilang:

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: Me maskun akan kin kilang wasa, o me dangidang kan kin alu, o me tuketuk kan kin makeladar, o me salongepon kan kin rong wasa, o me melar akan kin maureda, o rongamau kin loloki ong me samama kan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: O meid pai, me sota pan makar kin ia.

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: Mepukat lao kokola, Iesus ap kotin tapiadar mamasani ong pokon o duen Ioanes: Da me komail koieila en kilang nan sap tan? Alek pot, me kin dueduälokki ang?

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: De da me komail koieila en kilang? Aramas amen nan likau muterok? Kilang, me kin likau kida likau muterok, kin mi nan im en nanmarki kan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: De da me komail koieila en kilang? Saukop amen? Ei I indai ong komail a laude sang saukop amen.

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: Pwe iei i, me intingidier: Kilang I kadarala mo ’mui ai men kadar, me pan koko al mo ’mui.

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, sota me ipwidi sang ren li akan, me laude sang Ioanes saunpaptais. Ari so, me tikitik nan wein nanlang, iei me laude sang i.

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: A sang ni muein Ioanes saunpaptais kokodo lel met wein nanlang kokido eta manaman, ari me manaman akan kin koledi ong irail.

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: Pwe saukop karos o kapung kokopadar lao lel Ioanes.

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: O ma komail men duki ong, nan iei Elias, me pan kodo.

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: Me salong a mia, men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: A da me I en karasai ong di wet? A ras ong seri kan, me kin momod nan wasan net akan o likelikwir ong kis arail,

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: Indada: Kit kasang ong komail, a komail, sota kakalek; kit kauleki ong komail kaul en mamauk, a komail sota sangesang.

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes pwarado, ap sota kang o nim, a re kin inda: Nan tewil kin ti poa.

verses.name: Matthew 11:19
verses.text: Nain aramas pwarado, mangamanga o nim, a re kin inda: Kilang, me kaped en manga o kamom sakau, kompoke pan saunopwei o me dipan akan, a lolekong o kin diarok kida na seri ko.

verses.name: Matthew 11:20
verses.text: A kotin tapiada kidaueda kanim akan, me a wiai onger manaman to to, aki re sota kalula:

verses.name: Matthew 11:21
verses.text: Suedi ong uk Korasin! Suedi ong uk Petsaida! Pwe ma manaman akan, me wiaui ong uk er, wiauier ong Tirus o Sidon, nan melel re pan pitipit kalula nan tuk en likau o nan pas.

verses.name: Matthew 11:22
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, a pan mongai ong Tirus o Sidon ni ran en kadeik sang komail.

verses.name: Matthew 11:23
verses.text: A koe Kapernaum, me paidar lel nanlang, pan pisikindi nan pweleko; pwe ma manaman akan, me wiaui ong uk er, wiauier ong Sodom, nan a pan mimieta lao lel ran wet.

verses.name: Matthew 11:24
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, a pan mongai ong sap en Sodom ni ran mi kadeik sang koe.

verses.name: Matthew 11:25
verses.text: Ni ansau ota Iesus kotin tapiadar masani: I kapinga komui Sam, Kaun pan lang o sappa, me komui okila mepukat sang me lolekong o koiok kan, ap kasale ong seri pwelel akan.

verses.name: Matthew 11:26
verses.text: Ei Sam ai, pwe iduen me komui kupukupura.

verses.name: Matthew 11:27
verses.text: Meakaros muei ong ia er sang ren Sam ai, o sota amen, me asa sapwilim a Ol, pwe Sam eta, o sota amen, me asa Sam, pwe sapwilim a Ol eta, o me sapwilim a Ol pan kasale ong.

verses.name: Matthew 11:28
verses.text: Komail karos, me pangadar o toutoular kodo re i I pan kamoleilei komail la.

verses.name: Matthew 11:29
verses.text: Ale ong komail ai iok, o padakki sang ia; pwe Ngai me opampap o karakarak melel, komail ari pan diarada kamol pan ngen omail.

verses.name: Matthew 11:30
verses.text: Pwe ai iok me mangai, o katoutou pai me marara.<div eID="gen2622" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.11"/>

verses.name: Matthew 12:1
verses.text: I ANSAU o Iesus kotila nan mat en korn ni ran en sapat, a sapwelim a tounpadak kan men mangadar, rap dolunga sang wan korn o kangkang.

verses.name: Matthew 12:2
verses.text: Parisär lau kilanger mepwukat, rap patoan ong i: Masani, sapwilim omui tounpadak kan kin wiada, me sota pung, en wiaui ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: Matthew 12:3
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Komail sota doropwe, me Dawid wiadar ni a o iang akan men mangadar?

verses.name: Matthew 12:4
verses.text: Duen a pedelong ong nan im en Kot o kangkang prot en kasansal, me sota pung, i o iang akan en kang, pwe samero akan eta.

verses.name: Matthew 12:5
verses.text: De komail sota wadoker nan kapung o, duen samero akan ar kin kaupali ran en sapat nan im en kaudok ni ran en sapat, ap sota dip arail?

verses.name: Matthew 12:6
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, i, me laude sang im en kaudok, mi wasa kis et.

verses.name: Matthew 12:7
verses.text: A ma komail pan asa wewen kasoi pot et: I kin polauleki kadek a kaidin mairong isis, komail sota pan kadeikada me makelekel akan.

verses.name: Matthew 12:8
verses.text: Pwe nain aramas pil udan Kaun en sapat.

verses.name: Matthew 12:9
verses.text: A kotila sang wasa o, ap kotilong ong nan ar sinakoke.

verses.name: Matthew 12:10
verses.text: A kilang, aramas amen mia, me pa a motorlar. Irail idok re a indada: Me pung, en kakelailada ni ran en sapat? Pwe ren kadipa i.

verses.name: Matthew 12:11
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong irail: Is aramas nan pung omail, me na sip amen mia, ma a pupedi ong nan por ni ran en sapat, a so pan poridi ong, kida sang?

verses.name: Matthew 12:12
verses.text: A iaduen aramas amen sota kasampwal kaualap sang sip amen? I me aramas amen kak wia kida me mau ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: Matthew 12:13
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong aramas o: Kapa wei pa om! I ari kapa wei, ap maular dueta pali teio.

verses.name: Matthew 12:14
verses.text: Parisär ap pedoi sang o kapukapung pena, duen ar pan kamatala i.

verses.name: Matthew 12:15
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi met, ap kotila sang wasa o, a pokon kalaimun idauenla i; i ari kakelailadar irail karos.

verses.name: Matthew 12:16
verses.text: O masani ong irail, ren der kalok sili i.

verses.name: Matthew 12:17
verses.text: Pwen pwaida, me lokido ren saukop Iesaia, me masani:

verses.name: Matthew 12:18
verses.text: Kilang, i ai ladu, me I piladar, o kompokepa i, me I kin polaule kida. I pan aude kin i Ngen i, o a pan kasale ong men liki kan duen kadeik o.

verses.name: Matthew 12:19
verses.text: Nan a sota pan akamai de weriwer, o sota amen me pan rong ngil a pon al akan,

verses.name: Matthew 12:20
verses.text: A sota pan katip pasang alek luet o, o a sota pan kakundi wik inkingkong o, lao a pan kaimwisokala kadeik o.

verses.name: Matthew 12:21
verses.text: O men liki kan pan kaporoporeki mar a.

verses.name: Matthew 12:22
verses.text: Me tewil ti poa men, me maskun o lotong ap wisike dong i; i ari kakelailada i, a me maskun o lotong ap lokaia o kilang wasa.

verses.name: Matthew 12:23
verses.text: Aramas karos ap malamalauak kila indada: Kaidin i sapwilim en Dawid?

verses.name: Matthew 12:24
verses.text: A Parisär akan lao rongadar, rap indada: Nan sota, me lap en kauseki wei tewil akan, Peelse pup eta, saumas en tewil akan.

verses.name: Matthew 12:25
verses.text: I ari angi ar lamelam masani ong irail: Wei karos, ma tou a kan pan u pena nan pung ar, a pan ola, o ma toun kanim de toun im eu pan u pena nan pung ar, a sota pan pwaida.

verses.name: Matthew 12:26
verses.text: O ma Satan pan kause wei Satan, a pan u ong pein i, a iaduen a wei pan kak pwaida?

verses.name: Matthew 12:27
verses.text: Ma I kin kauseki wei Peelsepup tewil akan, a is me noumail seri kang kin kause kin irail? Irail ari pan omail saunkapung.

verses.name: Matthew 12:28
verses.text: A ma I kausaki wei Ngen en Kot tewil akan, nan wein Kot lel ong komail er.

verses.name: Matthew 12:29
verses.text: De iaduen, is me pan kak kolong ong nan im en me kelail amen, kulia sang a kapwa, ma a so saliedi mas me kelail o? A ap pan kak kulia sang a kapwa.

verses.name: Matthew 12:30
verses.text: Meamen me sota iang ia, iei me palian ia; o me sota kin dolung penang ia, iei me kin kasapoka pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 12:31
verses.text: I me Ngai indai ong komail, dip karos o lalaue pan kak lapwa sang aramas, a lalaue ong Ngen sota pan lapwa sang aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 12:32
verses.text: O me pan lalaue Nain aramas, a pan lapwa sang i; a me pan lalaue Ngen saraui, a sota pan lapwa sang i, sota nan muei met pil sota nan muei kokodo.

verses.name: Matthew 12:33
verses.text: Padukedi tuka mau pot, a wa pan mau; de padukedi tuka sued apot, a wa pan sued. Pwe tuka kin diarok kida wa.

verses.name: Matthew 12:34
verses.text: Wan serpent komail, iaduen komail kak lokaia mau, pwe komail me sued? Pwe aua kin lokaia sang nan audepan mongiong o.

verses.name: Matthew 12:35
verses.text: Aramas mau kin kida me mau sang nan pai mau en mongiong i, a aramas sued kin kida me sued sang nan pai sued en mongiong i.

verses.name: Matthew 12:36
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, lokaia mal karos, me aramas inda, pan puk ong ir ni ran en kadeik o.

verses.name: Matthew 12:37
verses.text: Pwe sang ni om kasokasoi koe pan kapung kila, o sang ni om kasokasoi koe pan pakadeikada.

verses.name: Matthew 12:38
verses.text: Saunkawewe o Parisär kai ap sapeng i indada: Saunpadak, se men kilang kilel eu sang re omui

verses.name: Matthew 12:39
verses.text: A i me kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Di sued o kamal o kin rapaki kilel eu, a sota kilel eu, me pan sansal ong irail, pwe kilel en saukop Iona eta.

verses.name: Matthew 12:40
verses.text: Pwe duen Iona a mimi nan kaped en mam kalaimun amen ran silu o pong sili pong, iduen Nain aramas pan mimi nan mongiong en sappa ran silu o pong sili pong.

verses.name: Matthew 12:41
verses.text: Ol en Niniwe kan pan u ong di wet ni kadeik lapalap o pan kadeikada, pwe re kalula ni ar rongadar padak en Iona, a kilang, me laude sang Iona mi met.

verses.name: Matthew 12:42
verses.text: Li nanmarki en pali air amen pan u ong di wet ni kadeik lapalap o pan kadeikada; pwe a pwurado sang ni imwin sappa, pwen rong lolekong en Salomo. A kilang me laude sang Salomo mi met.

verses.name: Matthew 12:43
verses.text: Ngen saut lao kowei sang ren aramas o, a kin tangatang sili nan sap tan akan, rapaki wasan kamol, a sota, me a diarada.

verses.name: Matthew 12:44
verses.text: I ap kin inda: I pan purelong nan im ai, me i pedoi sanger. A lao puredo, a diar me a tan, kokok, o kapwater.

verses.name: Matthew 12:45
verses.text: I ari mi koieila, ale ong i ngen isimen, me sued sang pein i; irail lao pedelong ong lole, rap kaukauson ia, a aramas pan sued sang mas. Iduen a pan wiaui ong di sued wet.

verses.name: Matthew 12:46
verses.text: A ni a kotin masani ong pokon o mepukat, kilang, in a o ri a ol akan u liki, re men lokaia ong i.

verses.name: Matthew 12:47
verses.text: Amen ap potoan ong i: Re kotin mangi, in ar o ri ar ol akan mimi liki o men lokaia ong ir.

verses.name: Matthew 12:48
verses.text: A a kotin sapeng masani ong, me kaireki ong i: Is in ai o is ri ai ol akan?

verses.name: Matthew 12:49
verses.text: Ap kotin kapawei lim a pon sapwilim a tounpadak kan masani: Kilang, in ai o ri ai ol pukat!

verses.name: Matthew 12:50
verses.text: Pwe meamen, me kin wia kupur en Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang, nan i me ri ai ol, o ri ai li, o in ai.<div eID="gen2623" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.12"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:1
verses.text: NI ran ota Iesus kotila sang nan im o, ap kaipokedi pon oror.

verses.name: Matthew 13:2
verses.text: A pokon kalaimun pokon dong i, i ari kotidang pon sop pot, kaipokedi, a pokon o udar pon oror o.

verses.name: Matthew 13:3
verses.text: I ari karaseraseki ong me toto masani: Kilang, saunkamor o kolan kamorok.

verses.name: Matthew 13:4
verses.text: Ni a kamokamorok, akai ap moredier ong pon kailan al, manpir ap pirido nam ir ala.

verses.name: Matthew 13:5
verses.text: A akai moredier wasa takain, wasa pwel pedeped; ir ari pitipit wosadar pweki sota pwel lole.

verses.name: Matthew 13:6
verses.text: A katipin lao dakaradar, re motoredier o mongelar, pweki sota kalau ar.

verses.name: Matthew 13:7
verses.text: A akai moredier nan tuka teketek; a tuka teketek wosadar kasoka ir ala.

verses.name: Matthew 13:8
verses.text: A akai moredier nan pwel mau o wadar: Akai pan me epuki, akai me woneisok, akai me sileisok.

verses.name: Matthew 13:9
verses.text: Me salong a mia, men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Matthew 13:10
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap pwarado potoan ong i: Da me re kotin kaukawewe ong irail ni karaseras akan?

verses.name: Matthew 13:11
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: A muei ong komail er, en asa, me rir en wein nanlang, a ap sota muei ong mepukat.

verses.name: Matthew 13:12
verses.text: Pwe me a mia, ekis pan ko ong, pwen aneki me laud; a me sota a mia, nan a pan katia sang, me mi re a.

verses.name: Matthew 13:13
verses.text: I me I padaki ong irail ni karaseras. Pwe re kilang wasa, ap sota kin kilang, o rong wasa, ap sota kin rong, pwe re sota kin dedeki.

verses.name: Matthew 13:14
verses.text: Nan irail kapung pan kokop en Iesaia, me masanier: Komail pan rongki salong omail, ap sota dedeki, o kilangki mas omail, ap sota weweki.

verses.name: Matthew 13:15
verses.text: Pwe mongiong en aramas pukat kapitakailar, o salong arail ponlar, o re kamair pena mas arail. Pwe kadekadeo re de kilangki mas arail, o rongki salong arail, o lolokongki mongiong arail, o wukila, a I de kakel irail ada.

verses.name: Matthew 13:16
verses.text: A mas omail meid pai, pwe re kilang wasa, o salong omail, pwe re rong wasa.

verses.name: Matthew 13:17
verses.text: Pwe melel I indai ong komail, saukop o me pung akan me toto, me anane en kilang, me komail kin kilekilang, ap sota kilanger, o en rong, me komail kin rongerong, a re sota rongadar.

verses.name: Matthew 13:18
verses.text: Komail ari rong karasepa wet duen saunkamorok:

verses.name: Matthew 13:19
verses.text: Meamen rong masan duen wei o ap sota dedeki, me sued ap pwarado, katia sang, me kamoremoredier nan mongiong i, a iei i, me ale war akan pon kailan al o.

verses.name: Matthew 13:20
verses.text: A me kamoremoredier wasa takain, iei i, me kin rongada masan o, ap pitipit peren kida ale;

verses.name: Matthew 13:21
verses.text: A sota kalau a re a, pwe a lol masarang, pwe ansau apwal o kamekam lao pwaida pweki masan o, a ap madang makar kida.

verses.name: Matthew 13:22
verses.text: A me kamoremoredi ong nan tuka teketek, iei i, me kin rongada masan o, a anan en pai en sappa o widing en dipisou kang kin kasokela masan o, ap so wa.

verses.name: Matthew 13:23
verses.text: A me kamoremoredi nan pwel mau, iei i, me kin rongada masan o, ap dedeki o wada; akai kin pan me epuki, a akai me woneisok, a akai sileisok.

verses.name: Matthew 13:24
verses.text: A kotiki ong irail er pil apot karaseras masani: Wein nanlang rasong aramas amen, me kamoredi war mau nan sap we.

verses.name: Matthew 13:25
verses.text: A aramas lao mairelar, a imwintiti ap pwarado kamoredier dip nan pung en korn ap koieila.

verses.name: Matthew 13:26
verses.text: A tuka lao wosadar o wadar, dip ap pil pwaradar.

verses.name: Matthew 13:27
verses.text: Ladu en kaun pan im o kan ap pwara dong i potoan ong i: Maing, kaidin war mau, me kom kotin kamoredier nan sap omui? A iaduen dip, a ko sang ia?

verses.name: Matthew 13:28
verses.text: A masani ong irail: Aramas mor sued amen me wiadar. Ladu kan ap potoan ong i: Kom kotin mauki, sen kola matiada sang?

verses.name: Matthew 13:29
verses.text: A masani: Iermen, pwe komail der matia sang dip iangaki korn.

verses.name: Matthew 13:30
verses.text: A karos pan mimieta lao ansaun rak; ni ansaun rak i pan indang men dolung kan: Ki pena mas dip akan, pira pena ni kap akan, pwe aramas en karongala, a korn ki pena nan ai im en nak.

verses.name: Matthew 13:31
verses.text: A kotiki ong irail pil apot karaseras masani: Wein nanlang rasong wan tuka eu, me aramas amen ale, padukedi ong nan sap we,

verses.name: Matthew 13:32
verses.text: Me tikitik sang war karos, a a lao wosada, a kalaimun sang dip akan, o wiala tuka laud apot, manpir en pan lang akan ap pokon pena o mimi nan ra a kan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:33
verses.text: A pilapot karaseras me a kotin masani ong irail: Wein nanlang rasong kalep kis, me li amen ale okila nan kasak en plaua silu, karos lao mutala.

verses.name: Matthew 13:34
verses.text: Mepukat karos Iesus kotin padapadaki ni karaseras ong pokon o, o sota, me a kotin padaki ong irail, ma sota ni karaseras.

verses.name: Matthew 13:35
verses.text: Pwen pwaida me lokido ren saukop o, me masani: I pan ki pasang au ai, pwen karaseras o pan kasansaleda me rir akan sang ni tapin kaua.

verses.name: Matthew 13:36
verses.text: A ap kotin kadar pasang pokon o, kotilong ong nan tanpas o. Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kai dong i potoan ong: Re kotin kawewe ong kit karasepan dip nan matual o.

verses.name: Matthew 13:37
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: Me kamoredi war mau, iei Nain aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 13:38
verses.text: Matuel iei sappa. War mau iei toun wei. Dip iei nain mesued.

verses.name: Matthew 13:39
verses.text: Imwintiti, me kin kamor ir edi, iei tewil. Rak me kaimwisoke pan sappa. Saundolung pene iei tounlang kan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:40
verses.text: A duen dip akan a kin usa sang rong kila kisiniai, iduen a pan wiaui ni imwin kaua.

verses.name: Matthew 13:41
verses.text: Nain aramas pan kadarala na tounlang kan, o re pan ki sang nan wei men kamakar karos, o me kin wiawia me sued.

verses.name: Matthew 13:42
verses.text: O re pan kasapok ir alang len kisiniai iei wasan mamaiei o teterok.

verses.name: Matthew 13:43
verses.text: Me pung kan ap pan lingaling dueta katipin nan wein Sam arail. Me salong a mia, men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Matthew 13:44
verses.text: Wein nanlang rasong pai eu, me rir nan matuel, me aramas amen diaradar ap okila, o peren kida, koieila, netikilar karos, me a naineki, ap netiadar matuel o.

verses.name: Matthew 13:45
verses.text: Wein nanlang pil rasong saunet amen, me raparapaki takai kasampwal kai.

verses.name: Matthew 13:46
verses.text: A lao diaradar eu, me kasampwalia, ap koieila netikilar a dipisou karos, netiada i.

verses.name: Matthew 13:47
verses.text: Wein nanlang pil rasong uk apot, me kin kadudi nan sed, pwen oro pena song karos.

verses.name: Matthew 13:48
verses.text: A lao direla, re kin apiadado pon oror, ap mondi pena, deuk ong me mau akan nan dal akan, a me sued akan re kin kasela.

verses.name: Matthew 13:49
verses.text: Nan iduen a pan wiaui ni imwin kaua: Tounlang kan pan koieila, katoror sang me sued akan me pung kan.

verses.name: Matthew 13:50
verses.text: O kasapok ir alang len kisiniai, iei wasan maiei o teterok.

verses.name: Matthew 13:51
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Komail weweki mepukat karos? Re potoan ong: Ei Maing.

verses.name: Matthew 13:52
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: I me saunkawewe karos, me sukusukuleki wein nanlang me rasong kaun pan im eu, me kin kapwareda sang a pai me kap o me maring.

verses.name: Matthew 13:53
verses.text: Kadekadeo Iesus lao kaimwisokela karaseras pukat, ap kotin koieila sang wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 13:54
verses.text: A koti dong udan sap we kawewe ong irail nan ar sinakoke. Irail ari puriamui kila indada: Lolekong en Ol men et o a manaman akan ko sang ia?

verses.name: Matthew 13:55
verses.text: Kaidin i nain kapenta? In a sota adaneki Maria? O ri a ol akan Iakop, o Iosep, o Simon, o Iudas?

verses.name: Matthew 13:56
verses.text: O ri a li akan, kaidin irail karos mi re atail? Ari, ia wasa mepukat ko sang ia?

verses.name: Matthew 13:57
verses.text: O irail makar kin i. A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Sota wasa me saukop so waui ia, nan sap we ota o ren sau i ko.

verses.name: Matthew 13:58
verses.text: I ari sota wiadar manaman toto wasa o pweki ar soposon.<div eID="gen2624" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.13"/>

verses.name: Matthew 14:1
verses.text: I DOKAN nanmarki Erodes ronger duen wiawia en Iesus.

verses.name: Matthew 14:2
verses.text: Ap masani ong sapwilim a ladu kan: Nan i Ioanes saunpaptais, a mauredar sang ren me melar akan, i me a wia kida manaman pukat.

verses.name: Matthew 14:3
verses.text: Pwe Erodes koledier Ioanes o saliedier ong nan imateng pweki Erodias en ri a Pilip a paud.

verses.name: Matthew 14:4
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes me masani ong i: A sota muei ong komui en ale i.

verses.name: Matthew 14:5
verses.text: O a men kamela i, a a masak aramas akan, pwe re wiakin i saukop amen.

verses.name: Matthew 14:6
verses.text: A en Erodes a ran en ipwidi wiauier, nain Erodias seripein ap kakalek mo ’rail, i me Erodes peren kidar.

verses.name: Matthew 14:7
verses.text: I ari inauki ong i, me a pan ki ong i, meakaros, me a pan poeki, ap kotin kaula,

verses.name: Matthew 14:8
verses.text: A lao pwili sang in a, ap potoan ong: Kotiki dong ia mongan Ioanes saunpaptais pon dal wet.

verses.name: Matthew 14:9
verses.text: Nanmarki ap kupur suedelar; a pweki a kaula o pweki irail, me iang i kot ni tepel o, a masani ren ki ong i.

verses.name: Matthew 14:10
verses.text: I ari poronelar en lepuk sang mangan Ioanes nan imateng.

verses.name: Matthew 14:11
verses.text: Monga ap wisikedor pon dal eu, ap pangalang seripein o, i ap wala ren in a.

verses.name: Matthew 14:12
verses.text: A tounpadak kan ap pwarador, ale kalep a, sarepedier, rap kola kaireki Iesus.

verses.name: Matthew 14:13
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin iangalar sop pot, kotilang sap tan eu. Pokon lao rongadar, rap idauenla i sapasapal sang nan kanim akan.

verses.name: Matthew 14:14
verses.text: A lao kotila sang wasa o, ap kotin masani pokon kalaimun, ap kupuro kin ir ala, o kotin kakelada, me somau re ’rail.

verses.name: Matthew 14:15
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer sapwilim a tounpadak kan kaidong i potoan ong: Sap tan eu met o ansau daulier; re kotin kadar pasang pokon o, pwe ren kola nan kanim akan, netiada kang ar manga.

verses.name: Matthew 14:16
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Sota kare pan ar kola, komail pan katungole irail.

verses.name: Matthew 14:17
verses.text: A irail potoan ong i: Sota at tungol met, lopon en prot eta limau o mam eta riamen.

verses.name: Matthew 14:18
verses.text: A a kotin masani: Wa dong ia!

verses.name: Matthew 14:19
verses.text: A ap kotin masani, pokon en mondi nan ra, ap kotikida lopon en prot limau o mam riamen, ap kotin masanda nanlang, laolaoki pilitiki pasang o kotiki ong tounpadak kan lopon en prot oko a tounpadak kan ap nek ong pokon o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:20
verses.text: Irail karos ari manga o medier; rap deuk pena kopou en maremor eisok riau luan kamadip o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:21
verses.text: A irail, me mangaer, me ol limekid a li o seri kan sota iang wadawader.

verses.name: Matthew 14:22
verses.text: A ap kotin pain tounpadak kan, ren keredi pon sop pot, pwe ren madangwei mo a lel palio, lao a pan kotin kadar pasang pokon o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:23
verses.text: A lao kotin kadar pasang ponkon o, ap kotin kelepelar pon nana eu, pwen laolao. A lao, sautik penaer i eta, me kotikot wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:24
verses.text: A sop o mi ni ailepan sed o lusiluseki iluk kan pwe ang udo sang moa.

verses.name: Matthew 14:25
verses.text: A kadekadeo nan lukepan pong Iesus ap kotikot ko dong irail pon sed o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:26
verses.text: A tounpadak kan lao kilanger i kotikot sili pon sed o, ap masapwekadar indada: Ani amen! Irail ap weriwer pweki ar masak.

verses.name: Matthew 14:27
verses.text: A Iesus kotin madang kasoi ong irail masani: Kaporopor mau, pwe Ngai met, der masak!

verses.name: Matthew 14:28
verses.text: A Petrus sapeng i patoan ong: Maing, ma ir, re kotin masan dong ia, i en kowei re ir pon pil o.

verses.name: Matthew 14:29
verses.text: A ap kotin masani: Ukedo! Petrus ap keredier sang nan sop o, weweid pon pil o, pwen kola ren Iesus.

verses.name: Matthew 14:30
verses.text: A lau kilanger ang ma, ap masapwekadar, a ni a pan kirila, a weriwer indada: Maing kupwura ia!

verses.name: Matthew 14:31
verses.text: Iesus kotin madang kapawei lim a koledi i, masani ong i: O koe meid poson tikitik, da me koe so posonki?

verses.name: Matthew 14:32
verses.text: Ira lao kotidar pon sop o ang ap moledier.

verses.name: Matthew 14:33
verses.text: A toun sop o ap kaiong i, poridier potoan ong: Melel ir me Sapwilim en Kot!

verses.name: Matthew 14:34
verses.text: Irail lao kotin kotela, rap kotilang sap Kenesaret.

verses.name: Matthew 14:35
verses.text: Toun sap o lao asa i, rap kadar sili wasa karos, o re wa dong i me somau kan karos,

verses.name: Matthew 14:36
verses.text: O poeki re a, ren potoan sair ta imwin sapwilim a likau. A karos, me sair i kelailadar melel.<div eID="gen2625" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.14"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:1
verses.text: PARISÄR o saunkawewe kan ap ko dong i sang Ierusalem, kalelapok re a:

verses.name: Matthew 15:2
verses.text: Menda sapwilim omui tounpadak kan tiakedi padok en kaua ko? Pwe re sota kin omiom ni ar pan kang prot.

verses.name: Matthew 15:3
verses.text: A i kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Menda komail pil tiakedi kusoned en Kot pweki omailpadok kan?

verses.name: Matthew 15:4
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotin kusonedadar masanier: Kakaki sam om o in om, o meamen lalaue sam a de in a, i en kamela.

verses.name: Matthew 15:5
verses.text: A komail kin inda: Meamen indang sam a o in a: Korpan, iet wewe: Mairong eu, me koe men aneki sang ia; komail inda, dene sota dip a; i ari sota pan kakaki sam a o in a.

verses.name: Matthew 15:6
verses.text: Iduen omail tiakedi kusoned en Kot pweki omail padok kan.

verses.name: Matthew 15:7
verses.text: Malaun akan komail, nan melel, me Iesaia kokopadar iran komail, ni a masani:

verses.name: Matthew 15:8
verses.text: Aramas pukat kin kaka kin ia au arail, a mongiong arail me doo sang ia;

verses.name: Matthew 15:9
verses.text: Ari, me mal ar kaudok ia, pwe kusoned en aramas eta, me re kin kaukawewe.

verses.name: Matthew 15:10
verses.text: I ari molipe pena aramas akan masani ong irail: Rong o weweki!

verses.name: Matthew 15:11
verses.text: Kaidin me kin ko ong nan aua kin kasaminela aramas, a me kin ko sang nan aua, i me kin kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 15:12
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap kodo, potoan ong i: Re kotin mangi, me Parisär akan makar kida ni ar rongadar masan o?

verses.name: Matthew 15:13
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: Tuka karos, me kaidin Sam ai nanlang, padukedier, pan weiweida.

verses.name: Matthew 15:14
verses.text: Puei sang irail; irail me maskun, ap kalua me maskun akan. A ma me maskun amen pan kalua me maskun, nan ira karos pan pupedi ong nan por o.

verses.name: Matthew 15:15
verses.text: Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong i: Re kotin kawewe ong kit karaseras pot et.

verses.name: Matthew 15:16
verses.text: I ari kotin masani: Komail pil sota lolekong?

verses.name: Matthew 15:17
verses.text: Komail saikenta weweki, meakaros, me kin ko ong nan aua kin kodilong ong nan kaped o ap kin kasapokela?

verses.name: Matthew 15:18
verses.text: A me kin ko sang nan aua, kin tapida sang nan mongiong, o i me kin kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 15:19
verses.text: Pwe sang nan mongiong o lamelam sued kin tapi sang ia: Kamela aramas, o kamal, o nenek, o pirap, o kadede likam, o lalaue.

verses.name: Matthew 15:20
verses.text: Song pukat, me kin kasaminela aramas. A so omiom ap manga sota kin kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 15:21
verses.text: Iesus ap kotila sang wasa o, kotilang wein Tirus o Sidon.

verses.name: Matthew 15:22
verses.text: A kilang, li en Kanaan amen, me kodo sang wasa o, likelikwir ong i, potoan ong: Kupura ia! Maing, ir me sapwilim en Dawid! Nai sereipein waiwairokki tewil.

verses.name: Matthew 15:23
verses.text: A a sota kotin sapeng i meakot. Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kai dong i poeki re a potoan ong: Re kotin kadarala i, pwe a kin likelikwir dong kitail.

verses.name: Matthew 15:24
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: Sota me I pakadara dong, pwin sip en saun Israel eta, me salongalar.

verses.name: Matthew 15:25
verses.text: A a kodo, poridi ong i potoan ong: Maing, re kotin kupura ia!

verses.name: Matthew 15:26
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: A sota mau, en ale en seri ar tungol prot ap kasedi ong ren kisin kidi kan.

verses.name: Matthew 15:27
verses.text: A potoan ong: Melel Maing, ari so, kisin kidi kan kin namenam maremor akan, me kin pupedi sang ni tepel en ar saumas.

verses.name: Matthew 15:28
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong i: O li, om poson mo laud! A pan wiaui ong uk duen me koe inong iong. Na seripein ap kelailadar ni auer ota.

verses.name: Matthew 15:29
verses.text: Iesus ari kotila sang wasa o, koti dong liman sed en Kaliläa, a lao kotida pon dol eu ap kaipokedi wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 15:30
verses.text: O pokon kalaimun pokon dong i, me wado me dangidang kai, o me maskun, o me lotong, o me sikilikil, o song toto, ap pwilikidi ni aluwilua. A ap kotin kakelail ir ada.

verses.name: Matthew 15:31
verses.text: Pokon o ap puriamuiki ni ar kilang, me lotong akan lokolokaia, o me sikilikil akan kelailadar, o me dangidang kan alialu, o me maskun akan kilang wasa; rap kapinga Kot en Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 15:32
verses.text: Iesus lao molipe pena sapwilim a tounpadak kan a kotin masani: I ap pokela pokon en, pwe re mi re i ran silu ap sota kan ar manga, a I sota pan kadar ir ala ni ar sota mangaer, pwe ren der dupokala pon al o.

verses.name: Matthew 15:33
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap potoan ong i: Se pan kisang ia prot toto, men kamedela pokon et nan sap tan wet?

verses.name: Matthew 15:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Lopon en prot me depa mi re omail? Irail potoan ong: Me isu o kisin mam kis.

verses.name: Matthew 15:35
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong pokon o, en mondi ong nan pwel o,

verses.name: Matthew 15:36
verses.text: Ap kotikidar lopon en prot isu o kisin mam akai, laolaoki, pwilitiki pasang o kotiki ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, a tounpadak kan ap nek ong pokon o.

verses.name: Matthew 15:37
verses.text: Irail karos ari mangaer, o medier; irail ap deuk pena kopou isu luan kamadip o.

verses.name: Matthew 15:38
verses.text: A irail, me mangaer, me ol pakid, a li o seri kan sota iang wadawader.

verses.name: Matthew 15:39
verses.text: A lao kotin kadar pasang pokon o, a kotilang pon sop pot, koti dong impan Maktala.<div eID="gen2626" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.15"/>

verses.name: Matthew 16:1
verses.text: PARISÄR o Sadusär akan ap ko do, kasongesong i o poeki i kilel eu sang nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 16:2
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: A lao sautiker komail kin inda: Lakap a pan ran kaselel eu, pwe lang me waitata.

verses.name: Matthew 16:3
verses.text: A ni mansang: A pan katau, pwe lang me waitata o rotorot. Komail kak ong kasauiada mom en lang, a komail sota kak kasauiada kilel en ansau.

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: Di sued o kamal o kin ngongki kilel eu, a sota kilel eu, me pan sansal ong irail, pwe kilel en Iona eta. I ari kotin muei sang irail o koti wei.

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan lao kotela lel palio, ap sota arail prot, pwe re monokelar.

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Kalaka o pereki kalep en Parisär o Sadusär akan!

verses.name: Matthew 16:7
verses.text: Irail ari kasokasoi nan pung arail indada: Nan pweki sota atail prot, me se wado.

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin masani: Komail meid soposon, menda komail kasokasoi nan pung omail, iran omail sota wado prot oko?

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: Komail saikenta dedekila o komail sota tamanda lopon en prot limau ren aramas limekid o kopou depa, me komail deuk penaer?

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: Pil so lopon prot isu ren aramas pakid, o kopou depa, me komail deuk penaer?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: Daduen, komail so lolekongki, me kaidin kisin manga, me i kasokasoi; pwe komail en pereki kalep en Parisär o Sadusär akan,

verses.name: Matthew 16:12
verses.text: Irail ap weweki, me a kaidin masanier, me ren kalaka kalep en prot, pwe ren kalaka padak en Parisär o Sadusär.

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: Iesus lao koti dong wein Säsarea Pilipi, ap kotin kainoma ren sapwilim a tounpadak kan masani: Da me aramas kin inda, is me ngai, Nain aramas?

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: Irail potoan ong: Akai: Ioanes saunpaptais, a akai: Elias, o pil akai: Ieremias de amen ren saukop oko.

verses.name: Matthew 16:15
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong irail: A komail, is me komail kin inda me nai?

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: Simon Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong: Ir me Kristus, Sapwilim en Kot ieias!

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong i: Koe meid pai Simon nain Iona, pwe kaidin uduk o nta, me kasale ong uk met, pwe Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang,

verses.name: Matthew 16:18
verses.text: A I pil indai ong uk, koe Petrus, a I pan kauada pon paip wet ai momodisou a wanim en pweleko kan sota pan kak kawela i.

verses.name: Matthew 16:19
verses.text: I pan ki ong uk kapiri pan wein nanlang kan. A meakot koe pan saliedi nin sappa, pan salidi nanlang; o meakot, koe pan lapwada nin sappa, pan lapwada nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 16:20
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, me ren der indang meamen, me i me Kristus.

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
verses.text: I ansau me Iesus kotin tapiadar kasale ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, me a pan kotilang Ierusalem o kalokolok laud ren saumas akan, o ren samero lapalap akan, o ren saunkawewe kan, o me a pan kalokolok toto o kamela o ni ran kasilu a pan maureda,

verses.name: Matthew 16:22
verses.text: Petrus ap ukadar i, kapukapung i indada: Maing re kotin kupura pein ir, mepukat sota pan pwai ong ir!

verses.name: Matthew 16:23
verses.text: A ap kotin saupeido masani ong Petrus: Kola muri Satan! Koe men kamakar ong ia, pwe om lamelam kaidin en Kot, a en aramas,

verses.name: Matthew 16:24
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Meamen pan idauen ia en tounmeteki pein i, ap wada a lopu, idauen ia.

verses.name: Matthew 16:25
verses.text: Pwe meamen dorela maur a, pan pupe sang, a meamen kasela maur a pwreki ngai, i me pan diarada.

verses.name: Matthew 16:26
verses.text: Pwe da kadepa ong aramas o, ma a aneki sappa pon, ap kasela maur a? De da me aramas pan kak kida, pwen kasapaledo maur a?

verses.name: Matthew 16:27
verses.text: Pwe Nain aramas pan kokido lingan en Sam a, o sapwilim a tounlang kan pan iang i; i ari pan pwain ong aramas akan duen ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: Matthew 16:28
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, akai me iang mimi met, me sota pan mela, irail lao kilang Nain aramas a kodo nan a wei.<div eID="gen2627" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.16"/>

verses.name: Matthew 17:1
verses.text: MURIN pong wonu pong Iesus ap kotin ukadar Petrus, o Iakopus, o ri a Ioanes kalua ir dalang pon nana ileila eu kalapuk.

verses.name: Matthew 17:2
verses.text: I ari kotin linganla mo ’rail silang i lingaling dueta katipin, o sapwilim a likau o puetpuet eta marain eu.

verses.name: Matthew 17:3
verses.text: A kilang, Moses o Elias pwara dong ir, kasokasoi ong i.

verses.name: Matthew 17:4
verses.text: Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong Iesus: Maing, meid mau atail kotikot met. Ma re kotin mauki se pan kauada kisin im sili kis: Tanpas ar, o eu sapwilim en Moses, o eu sapwilim en Elias.

verses.name: Matthew 17:5
verses.text: Ni a kasokasoidar, kilang, pali en dapok pali ap kadupal irail edi; o kilang, ngil eu peidido sang nan dapok o, me masani: Iet nai Ol kompok, me I kin polaule kida! Komail ron i!

verses.name: Matthew 17:6
verses.text: Tounpadak kan lao rongadar met, rap pupedier pon mas arail, masapwekadar kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 17:7
verses.text: Iesus ap kotido, sair ir, masani: Uda, der masak!

verses.name: Matthew 17:8
verses.text: Irail lao saradar, sota amen, me re kilanger, pwe Iesus eta.

verses.name: Matthew 17:9
verses.text: Ari, ni arail kotikot kodido sang ni nana o, Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail masani: Komail depa indai ong meamen duen kasansal o, Nain aramas lao mauredar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Matthew 17:10
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan kalelapok re a indada: Da me saunkawewe kan kin indinda, dene Elias pan kotido mas?

verses.name: Matthew 17:11
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Nan melel, Elias pan pwarado mas kapungala karos.

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: A ngai indai ong komail, Elias me pwaradoer, a re sasa i, pwe irail wiai ong i meakan, me re men wiada. Iduen Nain aramas pil pan kamekam re ’rail.

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap asadar, me a kotin masani ong irail duen Ioanes saunpaptais o.

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: Irail lao lel dong pokon o, aramas amen poto dong i kelepuki mo a sakaradar:

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: Maing kupura nai ol o, pwe a pweipwei o madak kaualap, pwe pan pak toto a kin pupedi nan iai o nan pil,

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: Ngai ari wa dong i ren sapwilim ar tounpadak kan, a irail sota kak kakelada i.

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani: Di wet meid soposon o katiwo. Ia arain ai pan mi re omail? Ia arain ai pan kokoa komail? Wa dong ia!

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin kidaua i, tewil ari kodi sang lole; putak o ap kelailadar ni auer ota.

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: A tounpadak kan ap kelep poto dong Iesus potoan ong: Da me kit so kak kauseki wei sang i?

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Aki omail soposon. Pwe melel I indai ong komail, ma omail poson pan laude ong wan katiring, komail pan kak indang nana wet: Koda sang wasa en, kola monen! I ap pan kola, sota me sota pan kak pa omail.

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: Song wet sota kin koki sang meakot, kapakap o kaisesol eta.

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: A ni ar kotikot sili nan wein Kaliläa, Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Nain aramas pan pangalang nan pa en aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: Irail pan kamela i, a ni ran kasilu a pan maureda. Irail ari mamauk kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: Irail lao kotilon ong nan Kapernaum, saunopwei kai ap ko dong Petrus indang i: Omail Saunpadak sota kin iang nopwei?

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: A masanier: Ei. A lao pedelong ong nan im o, Iesus ap kotin madang masani: Simon, da me koe lamelame, nanmarki en sappa kin ale taksis de nopwei sang ren is? Sang ren nairail seri de sang men liki kan?

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: Petrus potoan ong i: Sang ren men liki kan. Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ari, seri kan me saladok.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: Ari so, pwe kitail der kamakar irail ada, kola ni oror kasedi kas, a mam men mas, me pan lodi, apiada, kasara pasang au a, koe pan diar lepen moni lep; i me koe pan ale o kida ai o noum.<div eID="gen2628" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.17"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: NI auer ota tounpadak kan poto dong Iesus potoan ong: Iaduen is me pan lapalap nan wein nanlang?

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin molipeido kisin seri amen, ap kotin kotiki ong nan pung arail,

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: Masani: Melel I indai ong komail, ma komail sota pan wukila, wiala song en kisin seri, komail sota pan kak ko ong nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: Ari, meamen pan kasapwiledi pein i, dueta kisin seri men et, i me pan lapalap nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5
verses.text: O ma amen apwali kisin seri men due met ni ad ai, i me kin apwali ia.

verses.name: Matthew 18:6
verses.text: A meamen me pan kamakar amen ir, me tikitik, me poson ia, a mau ong, takai en plaua eu en sali ong tapin wor a, ap kamopela nan madau wasa me lol.

verses.name: Matthew 18:7
verses.text: Suedi ong sappa pweki a men kamakar akan, Ari so, men kamakar akan udan mia; suedi ong aramas o, me men kamakar pan tapi sang ia.

verses.name: Matthew 18:8
verses.text: A ma apali en pa om de apali en nä om pan kamakar uk, lepuke sang, o kase sang uk, pwe a mau ong uk ko ong maur ni om dangidang de sikilikil, sang om pa de nä pokon mia, ap ko ong kisiniai soutuk.

verses.name: Matthew 18:9
verses.text: O ma apali en mas om pan kamakar uk, waikada sang o kase sang uk, pwe a mau ong uk, ko ong maur ni om mas pali, sang mas om pokon mia ap lokidokila nan iai en pweleko.

verses.name: Matthew 18:10
verses.text: Kalaka, pwe komail der mamaleki amen tikitik pukat; pwe I indai ong komail, me arail tounlang kan, me mi nanlang, kin ariri Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 18:11
verses.text: Pwe Nain aramas kodon dorela, me salongalar akan.

verses.name: Matthew 18:12
verses.text: Da me komail lamelame, ma aramas amen, naineki sip epuki, a amen irail pan salongala, a so pan pwilikidi duekduamen pon nana, ap kola raparapaki me salongala?

verses.name: Matthew 18:13
verses.text: A ma a pan diar, melel I indai ong komail, a pan peren kida, me men en sang duekduamen, me sota salongalar.

verses.name: Matthew 18:14
verses.text: Iduen Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, sota kotin men, amen kisin seri pukat en salongala.

verses.name: Matthew 18:15
verses.text: A ma ri om ol wia dip ong uk, en kelep kila i, kapung ong i dip a; ma a pan rong uk, nan koe kasapaledo ri om.

verses.name: Matthew 18:16
verses.text: A ma a sota pan rong uk, ap ukada amen de riamen, pwe meakaros en mi ren saunkadede riamen de silimen.

verses.name: Matthew 18:17
verses.text: A ma a kang rong irail, ap kaireki momodisou, a ma a pil kang rong momodisou, ap wia kin i men liki o saunopwei men.

verses.name: Matthew 18:18
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, me komail pan saliedi nin sappa, pan salidi nanlang, o me komail pan lapwada nin sappa, pan lapwada nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 18:19
verses.text: I pil indai ong komail, ma riamen nin sappa pan minimin pene ni meakot, me re men poeki, a pan pwai ong ira sang Sam ai, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 18:20
verses.text: Pwe wasa kis, me riamen de silimen pokon pena ni ad ai, i wasa I kin mi nan pung arail.

verses.name: Matthew 18:21
verses.text: Petrus ap kai dong i potoan ong: Maing, pan pak depa i en makeki ong ri ai ol o, me wia dip ong ia? A itar ma a pan me isepak?

verses.name: Matthew 18:22
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: I indai ong uk, kaidin isepak eta, a pan pak isu wad iseisok.

verses.name: Matthew 18:23
verses.text: I me wein nanlang rasong nanmarki amen, me pan kapukapung na ladu kan.

verses.name: Matthew 18:24
verses.text: A ni a tapiada kapukapung, amen ap wisike dong i, me pwaipwandeki talent nen.

verses.name: Matthew 18:25
verses.text: A ni sota a men pwain, a monsap ap masanier, me a pan netila, o a paud, o na seri kan, o karos, me a aneki, pwen pwainda.

verses.name: Matthew 18:26
verses.text: A ladu o ap poridi mo a pongi, potoan ong: Maing kom kotin kanongama ong ia, i pan pwain ong komui karos.

verses.name: Matthew 18:27
verses.text: A monsap en ladu o ap pokela, ap lapwada o makeki ong i a pwaipwand.

verses.name: Matthew 18:28
verses.text: A ladu ota ap koieila, diaradar kis a ladu amen, me pwaipwand ong i denar epuki; i ari koledi i, padik pena tapin wor a indada: Kapungala, ma om pwaipwand mia.

verses.name: Matthew 18:29
verses.text: Ladu ap poridi mo a, poeki indada: Kom kotin kanongama ong ia, i pan pwain ong komui.

verses.name: Matthew 18:30
verses.text: A a kang, ap koieila, kasedi ong nan imateng lao a kapungala a pwaipwand.

verses.name: Matthew 18:31
verses.text: A kis a ladu kan lao kilanger me wiauier, rap mauk kaualap, koieila kaireki arail monsap karos, me wiauier.

verses.name: Matthew 18:32
verses.text: A monsap ap ekere dong i, masani ong i: Koe meid ladu sued amen! I make ki ong uk er om pwaipwand karos pweki om poeki re i.

verses.name: Matthew 18:33
verses.text: Menda koe sota kadek ong ri om ladu, duen i kin kadek ong uk er?

verses.name: Matthew 18:34
verses.text: A monsap ap makar kidar o pangalang i ren saun kalokolok lao a kapungalar a pwaipwand karusia.

verses.name: Matthew 18:35
verses.text: Iduen Sam ai nanlang, pan pil wia ong komail, ma komail sota pan makeki sang nan mongiong omail ong ri omail.<div eID="gen2629" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.18"/>

verses.name: Matthew 19:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO Iesus lao kaimwisokela padak pukat, ap kotila sang Kaliläa, koti dong wein Iudäa palilan Iordan.

verses.name: Matthew 19:2
verses.text: O pokon kalaimun idauendo i. I ari kotin kakelail ir adar wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 19:3
verses.text: Parisär akai ap kodo kasongesong i indada: Me pung, ol en kasela a paud pweki okotme?

verses.name: Matthew 19:4
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani: Komail sota doropwe, me i, me wia ir adar ni tapio, a kotin wiadar ol o li?

verses.name: Matthew 19:5
verses.text: A ap kotin masani: I me aramas amen pan pweidedi sam a in a pat ong eta a paud; ira ari pan udukala eu;

verses.name: Matthew 19:6
verses.text: Ira ari solar riamen pwe uduk eu. Ari, me Kot kotin kapad penaer, aramas depa kamueit pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: Irail ap indai ong i: A da me Moses masaniki, kisin likau en kamueit en koda, ol ap pan muei sang a paud?

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Moses mueid ong komail er, en kasela omail paud akan pweki mongiong omail kapitakailar. A sang ni tapi o a sota kin due.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: A ngai indai ong komail: meamen kasela a paud, ma sota pweki nenek, ap paudekida amen; nan a kamal, o me pan paudeki, me lokidokilar o, a kin kamal.

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap potoan ong i: Ma iduen kusoned, me ol o en kapwaiadang a paud, a sota mau ong papaud.

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong ir: Kaidin karos, me pan kak weweki padak pot et, irail eta, me a muei ong er.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: Pwe akai mia, me udan sota unsok, a akai, me aramas ki sanger, a pil akai, me wia kapwat pweki wein nanlang. Meamen kak ong weweki, i en weweki.

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: Kisin seri kai ap wisike dong i, pwen pwil po ’rail lim a kan o laolaoki, a tounpadak kan kapoui irail.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani: Mueid ong kisin seri kan, en ko dong ia. Der kalik irail edi! Pwe iei song en me udan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: I ari kotikida po ’rail lim a kan, ap kotila sang wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: O kilang, amen poto dong i potoan ong: Saunpadak da me mau kot, i en wiada, pwe i en aneki maur soutuk?

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong i: Menda koe idok re i duen me mau? Pwe amen ta me mau. A ma koe men ko ong maur, dadaurata kusoned akan!

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: A ap potoan ong: Kusoned da? A Iesus kotin masani, iet akan: Koe der kamela aramas; Koe der kamal; Koe der pirap; Koe der kadede likam;

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: Kakaki sam om o in om; o pok ong men imp om dueta ong pein uk.

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: Manakap ap potoan ong i: Mepukat karos i kapwaiadar; a da me i en pil wia?

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ma koe men unsokela, u kowei, netikila om dipisou, ap kisakisaki ong me samama kan, koe ap pan aneki om pai nanlang, o kodo idauen ia do.

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: Manakap lao ronger masan pot et, ap mamauk koieila, pwe a dipisou me toto.

verses.name: Matthew 19:23
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Melel I indai ong komail, meid apwal ong me kapwapwa kan, en pedelong ong nan wein nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 19:24
verses.text: I pil katitiki ong komail, me mangai, kamel en tilong nan au en dikok eu, sang me kapwapwa en ko ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 19:25
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan lao rongadar met, ap puriamuiki kaualap indada: Ari, is me pan kak kamaurela?

verses.name: Matthew 19:26
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin saupei wong irail, ap kotin masani ong irail: A so kak pan aramas, a ren Kot meakaros me kak.

verses.name: Matthew 19:27
verses.text: Petrus ap sapeng poto dong i: Masani, kit likidmaliela meakaros, ap idedauen komui, a da me pan katingi kit?

verses.name: Matthew 19:28
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Melel I indai ong komail, komail me idedauen ia do ni ipwi sapal, Nain aramas lao mondi pon mole lingan, komail pil pan mondi pon deun kadeik, kakaunda kainok en Israel eisokriau.

verses.name: Matthew 19:29
verses.text: O meamen kasela im a kan, de ri a ol o li akan, de sam a, de in a, de a paud, de seri, de sap pweki ad ai, nan a pan ale pan pak epuki o sosoki maur soutuk.

verses.name: Matthew 19:30
verses.text: A me toto men moa, pan muri; a men muri pan moa.<div eID="gen2630" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.19"/>

verses.name: Matthew 20:1
verses.text: PWE wein nanlang rasong kaun pan im amen, me sangkonai ong raparapaki toundodok kai nan a mat en wain.

verses.name: Matthew 20:2
verses.text: Irail lao inauki pena, me denar eu ni ran eu, ap kadar ir ala nan a mat en wain.

verses.name: Matthew 20:3
verses.text: A pil kotila ni auer kasilu, ap masani akai, me momod mal nan deun saunet akan,

verses.name: Matthew 20:4
verses.text: Ap masani ong irail: Komail pil kola nan mat en wain o, o meakot me pung, i pan pwain ong komail; irail ari kola.

verses.name: Matthew 20:5
verses.text: A pil kola ni auer kawonu o kaduau o wiadar dueta.

verses.name: Matthew 20:6
verses.text: A pil kotila ni auer eisokeu, ap diaradar akai, me momod mal, ap masani ong irail: Da me komail momodeki mal ran pon?

verses.name: Matthew 20:7
verses.text: Irail potoan ong: Aki sota amen, me kadokeki kit. Ap masani ong irail: Komail pil kola nan mat en wain o, komail pan ale me pung.

verses.name: Matthew 20:8
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer monsap en mat en wain masani ong a saunkoa: Kapokon pena toundodok kan o pwain ong irail. Tapiada sang ren men pwand oko lao kokodo lel men madang kan,

verses.name: Matthew 20:9
verses.text: Me kadodokier ni klok eisokeu kan ap kodo, amen amen ap ale denar eu.

verses.name: Matthew 20:10
verses.text: A men mas akan lao kodo, rap kiki ong, me re pan ale siki sang, a re pil aleer denar ta ieu.

verses.name: Matthew 20:11
verses.text: Irail lao ale, rap lipaned ong monsap o.

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: Indada: Mepukat dodok auer ta ieu, a komui karasai kit pena; kit me dodokki apwal en ran o karakar en katipin.

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani ong amen re ’rail: Kompoke pai, kaidin me sapung, me i wiai ong uk. Kita sota inauki pena denar eu?

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: Ale me om, kowei, i men pwain ong me pwand pukat rasong uk.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: De iaduen, a sota pung, i en wiaki me udan ai, me i mauki? De por en mas om me sued pweki ai kadek?

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: Ari, me pwand akan pan moa, a me moa kan pan pwand, pwe me toto paeker, a me malaulau me piladar.

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin kodala Ierusalem, a kotin kelepe kila tounpadak ekriamen pon al a, masani ong irail:

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: Kilang, kitail kin kodalang Ierusalem o Nain aramas pan ko ong ren samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan, o irail pan kadeikada, en kamela i.

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: O re pan pangala i ren men liki kan, pwen kapikapiti i, o kaloke, o kalopuela, a ni ran kasilu a pan maureda.

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: In en nain Sepedäus ap poto dong i, a na putak riamen iang i, pongi i o poeki okotme re a.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong i: Da me koe mauki? A potoan ong i: Re kotin mueid ong ai tungol putak riamen, en mondi re ir, amen ni pali maun omui, amen ni pali maing omui nan omui wei.

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani: Koma sota asa, me koma poeki. Koma kak nim dal me I pan nim? Ira potoan ong: Se kak.

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ira: Melel, komail pan tungole ai dal, a momod ni pali maun o maing i, I sota kak mueid ong, pwe pwais en irail me a onop onger sang ren Sam ai.

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: Ni en ek oko ar rongadar, ap suede kidar pirien o.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: A Iesus kotin molipe ir do masani: Komail asa, duen saupeidi en wei pokon ar kin poe irail edi, o me lapalap akan kin manaman ong irail.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: A duen met a sota pan wiaui nan pung omail. A me men laud nan pung omail, en papa komail.

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: O meamen re omail, me men saumas, i en lidui komail.

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: Dueta Nain aramas, me kaidin kodo, pwe aramas en papa, a pwe i en papa o kida maur a wiliandi me toto.

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: Ni arail kotila sang Ieriko, pokon kalaimun idauen la i.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: A kilang, ol maskun riamen momod ni kailan al o. Ni ara rongadar, me Iesus kotin daulul, ira ap likelikwir indada: Maing kupura kit, ir me sapwilim en Dawid!

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: A pokon o kidau ira da, pwen nenenla. A ira kalaudela ara likelikwir indada: Maing, kupura kit, ir me sapwilim en Dawid!

verses.name: Matthew 20:32
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin udi, molipe ira do masani: Da me koma mauki, I en wiai ong koma?

verses.name: Matthew 20:33
verses.text: Ira potoan ong: Maing, mas at en kapad pasang!

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: Iesus ari kupuro kin ira dar o kotin sair mas ara. Mas ara ari madang pad pasanger; ira ap idauenla i.<div eID="gen2631" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.20"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:1
verses.text: NI arail koren iong Ierusalem o lel ong Petpake impan dol Oliwe, Iesus ap kotin poronela tounpadak riamen.

verses.name: Matthew 21:2
verses.text: Masani ong ira: Koma ko ong nan kanim monen, a madang koma pan diar esel amen, me salidi, o na pul mi imp a, lapwa ira da, ap kare dong ia!

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: A ma meamen pan indang koma meakot, koma pan indada: Kaun o men dake, i ari pan madang kadar ira do.

verses.name: Matthew 21:4
verses.text: A mepukat karos wiauier, pwen pwaida, me lokido ren saukop o me masani:

verses.name: Matthew 21:5
verses.text: Kaireki nain Sion seripein: Kilang, om Nanmarki kotido re om. A kotin opampap o kaipokedi pon esel li amen.

verses.name: Matthew 21:6
verses.text: A tounpadak ko lao kolar, o wiadar duen Iesus kotin masani ong ira,

verses.name: Matthew 21:7
verses.text: Ira ap wado esel o na, ap irepadi po ’ra arail likau kan a ap kotin kaipokedi poa.

verses.name: Matthew 21:8
verses.text: O pokon kalaimunia irepadi arail likau kan nani al o, a akai paledier ran tuka kan irepadi nani al o.

verses.name: Matthew 21:9
verses.text: A pokon o, me tiong moa, o me idauen, ngisingis indada: Osiana ong sapwilim en Dawid! Meid iasanai me kotido ni mar en Kaun, osiana nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 21:10
verses.text: A lao kotilong ong nan Ierusalem, toun kanim ap mokimokid indada: Is i?

verses.name: Matthew 21:11
verses.text: Pokon o katitiki: Nan i Iesus, saukop en Nasaret en Kaliläa.

verses.name: Matthew 21:12
verses.text: Iesus ap kotilong ong nan im en kaudok en Kot, ap kotin kase sang karos, me kin netinet nan im en kaudok, o kotin wukededi tepel en saunkawilian moni ko, o deun men netin muroi.

verses.name: Matthew 21:13
verses.text: O kotin masani ong irail: A intingidi: Im ai pan adaneki im en kapakap, a komail wia kilar deu en lipirap.

verses.name: Matthew 21:14
verses.text: A me maskun o me sikil akan poto dong i nan im en kaudok o; i ari kotin kakel irail adar.

verses.name: Matthew 21:15
verses.text: A samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan lao kilanger manaman akan, me a kotin wiadar, o seri kan nan im en kaudok, me ngisingis indada: Osiana ong sapwilim en Dawid! Irail ap makara kidar,

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: Indai ong i: Kom sota mangi, me mepukat katitiki? A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Ei, komail saikenta doropwe: Sang nan au en seri o me kin kang didi, ir me kotin kapwaiadar kaping eu?

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: I ari kotin muei sang irail, kotila sang nan kanim o, koti dong Petanien o pweiokidi wasa o.

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: A ni mansang ni a kotin purlang kanim o, ap men konotedar:

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: A kotin masani tuka pik pot ni kailan al o, ap kotilang i. A sota, me a kotin diaradar, pwe ta eta, ap kotin masani ong i: Koe solar pan wa kokolata! A tuka pik ap madang mongedier.

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: Tounpadak kan lao kilanger, irail ap puriamui kidar indada: Daduen tuka pik o madang mongelar.

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Melel I indai ong komail, ma komail poson, ap sota peikasal, kaidin met eta, me wiaui ong tuka pik en, me komail pan kak wiada, pwe ma komail pan indang nana wet: Mokid wei lokidokila nan madau, nan a pan pwaida.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: O meakaros komail pan poeki ni omail kapakap, ap poson komail pan ale.

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: A lao kotilong ong nan im en kaudok o, samero lapalap akan o saumas en toun sap o ap ko dong i ni a kotin kaukawewe indada: Manaman en is, me komui wiaki mepukat? O is me ki ong komui manaman wet?

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: I pan pil kalelapok meakot re omail, ma komail pan sapeng ia, I pil pan indang komail manaman en is, me I wiaki mepukat.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: En Ioanes a paptais a tapi sang ia? Men nanlang de me ren aramas? Irail ap lamelame nan pung arail katiti, ma kitail pan inda men nanlang, a pan masani ong kitail: Da me komail so posonki i?

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: A ma kitail inda, me ren aramas, kitail masak pokon o, pwe karos kin wia saukopki Ioanes,

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: Irail ari sapeng Iesus potoan ong: Kit sota potoan. I ari pil masani ong irail: I sota pil pan indai ong komail, manaman en is, me I wiaki mepukat.

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: A iaduen omail lamelam? Aramas amen naineki ol riamen. A kola ren amen indang i: Lao, kola ran wet dodok nan ai mat en wain.

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: A sapeng indada: I sota mauki; a mur ekis a kalukila, ap koieila.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: O a kola ren me teio indai ong pil dueta. I me sapeng indada: Ei maing; ap sota kola.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: Ari, is re ’ra, me wiadar insen en sam a? Irail potoan ong i: Men mas o. Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Melel I indai ong komail, saunopwei o me nenek kan pan mo ’mail pedelong ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes pwara dong komail, padapadak ong komail duen al pung, a komail sota kamelele i; a saunopwei o me nenek kan kamelele i. A komail lao kilanger, komail sota kalukila, pwen kamele i.

verses.name: Matthew 21:33
verses.text: Komail rong pil apot karaseras! Kaun pan im amen padukedier mat en wain eu o kele pene, ap weiradar deun men wungid wan wain, o kauada im en daulik eu, ap kasile kin i ong saumat akai, o momaitelar nan wai.

verses.name: Matthew 21:34
verses.text: A lao ansau en rak, a kadaralang saumat akan a ladu kai, pwen ale a wan wain.

verses.name: Matthew 21:35
verses.text: Saumat akan ap saikedi a ladu kan; re woki amen, kamela amen, a amen me re kate.

verses.name: Matthew 21:36
verses.text: A pil kadarala ladu kai, toto sang men mas, Irail ari wiai ong irail pil dueta.

verses.name: Matthew 21:37
verses.text: A ikmuri a kadara wong irail na ol masani: Nan re pan masak nai ol.

verses.name: Matthew 21:38
verses.text: A saumat akan lao kilanger ol o, irail ap kasokasoi nan pung arail: I me pan ale soso, ukodo kitail en kamela i, a kitail pan id ale a soso.

verses.name: Matthew 21:39
verses.text: Irail ari saikedi i o kasapoke sang i nan mat en wain o, o kamela i.

verses.name: Matthew 21:40
verses.text: Ari, monsap en mat en wain lao pwarado, da me a pan wiai ong saumat pukat?

verses.name: Matthew 21:41
verses.text: Irail potoan ong i: A pan kamela aramas sued pukat, ap pan neki ong akai saumat a mat en wain o, me pan ki ong i wan wain ni ansau me kon ong.

verses.name: Matthew 21:42
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail saikenta doropwer nan kisin likau kan: Takai o, me sause kan kasapokelar, ap id wialar takai en pukakaim. Mepukat wiauier ren Kaun o, men kapuriamui patail?

verses.name: Matthew 21:43
verses.text: I me I indai ong komail, wein Kot pan sapadoke sang komail, ap ko ong eu kainok, me pan kida wa.

verses.name: Matthew 21:44
verses.text: O meamen pupedi ong pon takai wet, pan ola, a meamen me a pan pupedi ong poa, a pan pitaki pasang i.

verses.name: Matthew 21:45
verses.text: A samero lapalap o Parisär akan lao rongadar a karaseras akan, re mulikiadar, me a kotin karaserase kin irail.

verses.name: Matthew 21:46
verses.text: Irail ari masamasan sili en saikidi i, a re masak aramas akan, pwe re wia kin i saukop amen.<div eID="gen2632" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.21"/>

verses.name: Matthew 22:1
verses.text: A IESUS kotin sapeng o pil karaseras ong irail masani:

verses.name: Matthew 22:2
verses.text: Wein nanlang rasong nanmarki amen, me kamadipe na ol ni ran en a kapapaud.

verses.name: Matthew 22:3
verses.text: O a kadarala na ladu kan, pwen luke dong kamadip o, me kileledier akan; a re kang kodo.

verses.name: Matthew 22:4
verses.text: A pil kadarala akai ladu masani: Kaireki me kileledier akan: Kilang, i kaonopadar ai kamadip o: nai kau ol o man wi kan me kamelar, o karos nikier, ko dong kamadip en kapapaud!

verses.name: Matthew 22:5
verses.text: A irail sota insenoki, ap kowei, amen nan sap we, o amen ko ong dodok.

verses.name: Matthew 22:6
verses.text: A me tei kan saikidi a ladu kan kaloke o kame ir ala.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: Nanmarki ap makara kidar, kadarala a saunpei kan, kamela me lolap oko o isikedar ar kanim o.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: A ap indang a ladu kan: Ari, kamadip onoper, a me kileledier akan sota war ong.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: Komail ari kowei nan al akan, a karos me komail diar, en kalua dong kamadip o.

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: Ladu kan ap kola nani al akan, kapokon pena karos, me irail diaradar, me sued o me mau kan; kamadip ari tounlar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: A nanmarki lao pwarado, en kilang toun kamadip, ap diaradar aramas amen, me sota a kapwat,

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: A ap masani ong i: Kompoke pai, iaduen om kak pedelong, pwe sota om kapwat? I ari sapaimokid.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: Nanmarki ap masani ong papa kan: Saliedi i pa o nä akan, ale o kasapokela nan rotorot liki iei wasan maiei o teterok.

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: Pwe me toto paekeredo, a me malaulau piladar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: Parisär ap pokon pena, kaparok pena duen ar pan kasapunga i sang a masan;

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: Irail ap kadaralang i nairail tounpadak kan iangaki ladun Erodes kan, potoan ong: Saunpadak, se asa, ir me kotin melel, o kotin kawewe melel duen al en Kot o re sota kotin kupuroki meamen, pwe re sota kotin kasampwaleki sansal en aramas.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: Ari, re kotin masani ong kit kupur ar. Me pung, en nopwei ong nanmarki de so?

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: A Iesus lao kotin mangi ar me suet, ap masani: Malaun komail, da me komail kasongesong kin ia?

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: Kasale dong ia moni en nopwei! Irail ap potoan ong i denar eu.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Mom en is o inting wet?

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
verses.text: Irail potoan ong i: En nanmarki, a i kotin masani ong irail: Ari, komail ki ong nanmarki, me nain nanmarki, o ong Kot, me sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, rap puriamuiki o muei sang i, o koieilar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: Ran ota Sadusär akai ko dong i, me kin inda, me dene me melar akan solar pan maureda, ap kalelapok re a.

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: Indada: Saunpadak, Moses masani, ma meamen melar o sota na seri, ri a ol en id paudeki a paud, pwen kaipwi ong ri a kadaudok a.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: Ari, pwin pirien eu mi re at, ol isimen. Meseni paudeki li amen, ap melar, a sota kadaudok a, ap kakaliki ong ri a ol a paud;

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: Pil dueta kariamen o kasilimen kokola lao kaisimen.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: A ikmuri li o pil melar.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: Ari; ni en me melar akan ar pan iasada, a pan en is a paud ren me isimen, pwe irail karos me paudekidar i?

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail meid sapung pwe komail so weweki kisin likau kan de mana en Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: Pwe me mauredar akan solar pan papaud de kapapaud, pwe irail dueta tounlang en Kot akan, me mimi nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31
verses.text: Komail saik doropwe duen en melar akan ar pan maureda, me lolok ong komail sang ren Kot, me kotin masani:

verses.name: Matthew 22:32
verses.text: Ngai Kot en Apraam o en Isaak o en Iakop? A kaidin Kot en me melar akan, pwe en me maur akan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:33
verses.text: A pokon o lao rongadar met, irail ap puriamuiki a padak.

verses.name: Matthew 22:34
verses.text: A Parisär akan lao rongadar, me a kotin kadukiedier Sadusär akan, ap pokon pena.

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: Amen irail, saunkawewe men, kasongesong i potoan ong:

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: Saunpadak, kusoned da me lapalap nan kapung o?

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
