verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Koe en pokeki ong Kot om Kaun mongiong om unsok, o ngen om unsok, o om lamelam unsok.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: Iei met me moa en kusoned akan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: O me kariau me dueta: Koe en pok ong men imp om dueta ong pein koe.

verses.name: Matthew 22:40
verses.text: Kusoned riau met me audepan kapung o saukop akan.

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: Ni en Parisär akan ar momod pena, Iesus ap kotin kainoma re ’rail.

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: Masani: Da me komail lamelame duen Kristus, nain is i? Re potoan ong: Sapwilim en Dawid.

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: A iaduen da me Dawid kaadaneki i Kaun reng Ngen ni a masani:

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: Kaun o kotin masani ong ai Kaun, mondi ong ni pali maun i, lao I pan wia kida om imwintiti utipan nä om?

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: A iaduen, ma Dawid kaadaneki i Kaun, a pil pan kak na ol?

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: A sota amen, me kak sapengki i meakot, o solar me idok meakot re a kokolata.<div eID="gen2633" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.22"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: IESUS ap kotin kaparok ong pokon o sapwilim a tounpadak kan,

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: Masani; Saunkawewe o Parisär akan kin mondi nan deun Moses.

verses.name: Matthew 23:3
verses.text: Ari, karos me re indang komail, i me komail en wia o kapwaiada, a der ale sang ar wiawia kan; pwe irail kin indada, ap sota kapwaiada.

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: Re kin pira pena kapwa en wisik me toutou melel, ap kidang pon apar en aramas, a irail sota men sairki sondin pa arail.

verses.name: Matthew 23:5
verses.text: O re kin kapwaiada ar wiawia kan karos, pwe aramas en ududial. Pwe irail kin kadälape ar kisin likau en kataman o kalaudela ni kailan ar likau.

verses.name: Matthew 23:6
verses.text: Irail kin ngongki mondi ni tapin tepel ni kamadip o, o leppandam nan sinakoke kan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: O re kin mauki, aramas en ranamau ong irail nan deun net, o aramas en wia kin ir Rapi, Rapi,

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: A komail der ngongki, aramas en wia kin komail Rapi, pwe me ta men omail Saunpadak, a komail pirien pena.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: O komail der kaadaneki meamen sam nan sappa, pwe amen Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: O komail der ngongki, aramas en wia kin komail saumas, pwe me ta men omail Saumas: Kristus.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: A me lapalap re omail, en omail papa.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: Pwe me pan kasapwilada pein i, pan sapwilidi, a me pan kasapwilidi pein i, pan kasapwilada.

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Komail kin ritingidi wein nanlang mon aramas akan, pwe komail sota pan pedelong, a me men pedelong, komail sota kin mueid ong.

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Komail me ngopur sang im en li odi kan ap liliasos kapakap reirei. Omail kalokolok pan laud melel.

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Komail kin pidipidaki sed o sap, pwen wiada proselit amen, a lao wialar, komail ap pan wia kin i toun pweleko amen, me sued sang komail.

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkalua maskun, komail me kin inda: Meamen kin kaukila im en kaudok, dene sota katepa, a me kin kaukila kold en im en kaudok, i me pung.

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: Komail pweipwei o maskun, pwe da me kasampwal ren kold de im en kaudok o, me kin kasarauiala kold?

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: O meamen kin kaukila pei saraui, dene sota katepa, a me kaukila mairong, me mi poa dene i me pung,

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: Komail pweipwei o maskun, pwe da me kasampwal ren mairong de pei saraui, me kin kasarauiala mairong?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: Ari, meamen kaukila pei saraui, kin kaukila i o meakan, me mi poa.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: O meamen kaukila im en kaudok, king kaukila i iangaki i me kotikot lole.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: O me kaukila nanlang, kin kaukila mol en Kot o me kin kaipokedi ong poa.

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Komail kin mairongki eisokkis eu en minse, o til, o kimel, ap sota insenoki kusoned en kapung kasampwal akan: Pung, o kadek, o poson. Komail wiada mepukat, ap pil kapwaiada me tei kan!

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: Saunkalua maskun komail, me kin isenoki kisin am en wel, ap katalala kamel!

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Pwe komail kin kamakelekel kasak o dal liki, a lol me dir en me re kuliada o me sued.

verses.name: Matthew 23:26
verses.text: Parisär maskun koe, kamakelekele mas lol en kasak o dal akan, pwe pali liki en pil makelekeleda!

verses.name: Matthew 23:27
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Komail rasong sousou kan, me sementen, me kin sansal kaselel, a lole me dir en ti en me melar akan o song en saut karos.

verses.name: Matthew 23:28
verses.text: I duen komail, me sansal pung mon aramas, a lole komail me dir en malaun o sapung.

verses.name: Matthew 23:29
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe o Parisär akan, malaun komail! Pwe komail kin apapwali sousou en saukop akan o kapwataki sousou en me pung kan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:30
verses.text: Ap inda: Ma kit mia ni muein sam atail akan, kit sota pan iang irail kamela saukop akan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:31
verses.text: Ari, pein komail kin kadede, me komail nain me kamelar saukop akan.

verses.name: Matthew 23:32
verses.text: A komail kaunsokala wiawia en sam omail akan!

verses.name: Matthew 23:33
verses.text: Komail serpent o wan oter akan! Pala komail pan piti sang kadeik en nan pweleko?

verses.name: Matthew 23:34
verses.text: Kilang, i me I kadara dong komail saukop akai, o me lolekong kai, o saunkawewe kai; a akai irail, me komail pan kamela, o kalopuela, o akai komail pan kaloke nan omail sinakoke kan, o komail pan paki irail sang nan eu kanim ong nan eu.

verses.name: Matthew 23:35
verses.text: Pwen kapokon ong komail nta makelekel karos, me kapwilipwilidier nan sappa sang ntan Apel pung kokodo lel ntan Sakarias, nain Parakias, me komail kamelar nan pung en im en kaudok o pei saraui.

verses.name: Matthew 23:36
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, mepukat pan pwai ong di wet.

verses.name: Matthew 23:37
verses.text: O Ierusalem, Ierusalem, me kin kamela saukop akan o kate me pakadara dong uk kan; pan pak toto, me I pan kapokon pena noumail akan, duen litok kin kompwal pena na purok kan pan pa a, a komail kang.

verses.name: Matthew 23:38
verses.text: Kilang, im omail pan tanla.

verses.name: Matthew 23:39
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, komail solar pan kilang ia sang ni ansau wet, lao komail pan inda: Meid iasanai, me kotido ni mar en Kaun o!<div eID="gen2634" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.23"/>

verses.name: Matthew 24:1
verses.text: IESUS ap kotila kotiwei sang nan im en kaudok o, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ari poto dong i, pwen kasansale ong i im en kaudok o.

verses.name: Matthew 24:2
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail so ududial mepukat karos? Melel I indai ong komail, sota eu takai pan mimi pon eu, me sota pan karongk pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 24:3
verses.text: Ni a kotin kaipokedi pon dol Oliwe, tounpadak kan kelep poto dong i potoan ong: Re kotin masan dong kit ansau da, me mepukat pan pwaida o da kilel pan ar pan kotin puredo, o imwin kaua?

verses.name: Matthew 24:4
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Kalaka, pwe sota amen en kotaue komail.

verses.name: Matthew 24:5
verses.text: Pwe me toto pan kodo ni ad ai katiti: Ngai me Kristus o kotaue me toto.

verses.name: Matthew 24:6
verses.text: Komail pan rongada duen mauin o kasokasoi pan mauin; Komail kalake, der masak; pwe mepukat pan wiaui mas, a imwi saikenta mia.

verses.name: Matthew 24:7
verses.text: Pwe eu sap pan u ong eu, o eu wei ong eu; o ansaun lek, o kilitop, o rerer en sap akai pan wiaui.

verses.name: Matthew 24:8
verses.text: Mepukat karos tapin kalokolok.

verses.name: Matthew 24:9
verses.text: Irail ap pan pang komail lang kamakam o kame komail la; o komail pan tantat pan kainok karos pweki ad ai.

verses.name: Matthew 24:10
verses.text: Me toto ap pan makarada, o amen pan pangala amen, o re pan tataki nan pung arail.

verses.name: Matthew 24:11
verses.text: O saukop likam toto pan pwarada o kotaue me toto.

verses.name: Matthew 24:12
verses.text: A limpok en me toto pan laula, aki sapung, me pan pwaida kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 24:13
verses.text: A me pan dadaurata lel imwi, i pan dorela.

verses.name: Matthew 24:14
verses.text: A rongamau en wei o pan kalok sili nan sappa karos, pwen kadede ong wei karos, iei ansau, me imwi korendo.

verses.name: Matthew 24:15
verses.text: A komail lao kilang saut akan, o ola laud mi nan wasa saraui, duen me saukop Daniel kopadar, meamen doropwe, i en weweki.

verses.name: Matthew 24:16
verses.text: Me kin mi nan sap en Iudäa, ap tangala pon nana;

verses.name: Matthew 24:17
verses.text: O me mi pon im, ender ko ong lole, pwen ale a kapwa sang;

verses.name: Matthew 24:18
verses.text: O me mimi nan sap, ender purong ale a likau.

verses.name: Matthew 24:19
verses.text: O me suedi ong irail me lisean o me kin kadidi ni ran oko!

verses.name: Matthew 24:20
verses.text: Komail ari kapakap, pwe komail depa pitila ni ansaun kapau, o pil der ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: Matthew 24:21
verses.text: Pwe i ansaun kamakam kaualap, sota me dueta sang ni tapin kaua kokodo lel met, pil sota pan wiaui kokolata.

verses.name: Matthew 24:22
verses.text: O ma ran oko so kamalaulau la, sota uduk eu me pan dorela; a pweki me piladar akan ran oko pan kamalaulaula.

verses.name: Matthew 24:23
verses.text: O ma meamen pan indang komail: Kilang iet Kristus de monen, komail der kamelele.

verses.name: Matthew 24:24
verses.text: Pwe Kristus likam kai o saukop likam kai pan pwarada, o kapwareda kilel o manaman akan, pwen pil kotaueda me piladar akan, ma re kak ong.

verses.name: Matthew 24:25
verses.text: Kilang, ngai me kop ong komail er.

verses.name: Matthew 24:26
verses.text: Ari, ma re pan katiti ong komail: Kilang, a kotikot nan sap tan o, der koieila; kilang, a kotikot wasa rir o, der kamelele.

verses.name: Matthew 24:27
verses.text: Pwe duen liol a tapida sang ni mas en lang linganla lel kapin lang, iduen en Nain aramas a pan pwarado.

verses.name: Matthew 24:28
verses.text: Pwe wasa man melar mia ia, i wasa ikel pan pokon pena ia.

verses.name: Matthew 24:29
verses.text: A murin kamakam o katipin pan madang rotorotala o maram pan solar lingan, o usu kan pan moredi sang nanlang, o kateng pan nanlang pan mokidada.

verses.name: Matthew 24:30
verses.text: Kadapakilene pan Nain aramas ap pan pwarada nanlang, o kainok karos en sappa ap pan mamaiei, o irail pan kilang Nain aramas a kokido dapok en lang akan, me manaman o lingan kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 24:31
verses.text: O a pan kadarala na tounlang kan peuk posaune lapalap, re pan kapokon pena na me piladar akan sang pali paieu, sang ni mas en lang lel ong kapi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:32
verses.text: Sang ni tuka pik o komail padakki karaseras en: Ra kan lao pilen o ta pwarada, komail asaki, me rak korendor.

verses.name: Matthew 24:33
verses.text: Pil dueta komail, komail lao diar mepukat, en asa, me a korendor, a leler liman wanim.

verses.name: Matthew 24:34
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, di wet sota pan mela, lao mepukat karos pan pwaida.

verses.name: Matthew 24:35
verses.text: Lang o sappa pan poula, a ai padak sota pan poula.

verses.name: Matthew 24:36
verses.text: A duen ran o auer sota amen, me asa, pil tounlang kan sasa. Sam ai ta me mangi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:37
verses.text: A duen ni muein Noa iduen en Nain aramas a pan pwarado.

verses.name: Matthew 24:38
verses.text: Pwe duen ni ran akan mon nolik lapalap re manga o nim, re papaud o kapapaud, lao lel ran en Noa a pedelong ong nan warim o.

verses.name: Matthew 24:39
verses.text: O re sota dedeki lao lel nolik pwaida o kamop ir ala karos, iduen en Nain aramas a pan pwarado.

verses.name: Matthew 24:40
verses.text: I ran o riamen pan mi nan sap; amen pan peuka sang o amen luadi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:41
verses.text: Riamen pan iris nan im en plaua, amen pan peuka sang a amen luadi.

verses.name: Matthew 24:42
verses.text: Komail ari masamasan, pwe komail sasa auer, me omail Kaun pan pwarado.

verses.name: Matthew 24:43
verses.text: A met komail en asa, ma saumas en im o asaer auer en men lipirap pan kodo, a pan masamasan, a sota pan mueid ong kawela im a.

verses.name: Matthew 24:44
verses.text: Komail ari pil masamasan, pwe Nain aramas pan kodo ni auer, me komail sota lamelame.

verses.name: Matthew 24:45
verses.text: Ari, is ladu lelapok o lolekong o, me a monsap kasapwilada pon im a, pwen nene ong irail ni ansau me kon ong.

verses.name: Matthew 24:46
verses.text: Ladu o meid pai, me a monsap pwara diarada i a wiawia due met!

verses.name: Matthew 24:47
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, a pan kasapwilada i pon a dipisou karos.

verses.name: Matthew 24:48
verses.text: A ma ladu sued o pan lamelame nan mongiong i: Ai monsap pwapwand kodo;

verses.name: Matthew 24:49
verses.text: Ap kame a warok kan o nam o nim nan pung en me kamom sakau;

verses.name: Matthew 24:50
verses.text: Monsap en ladu o ap pan pwarado ni ran eu, me a sota lamelame o ni klok, me a sasa.

verses.name: Matthew 24:51
verses.text: O a pan palang pasang i o katororalang i ren me malaun akan, iei wasan maiei o teterok.<div eID="gen2635" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.24"/>

verses.name: Matthew 25:1
verses.text: I ANSAU o wein nanlang me rasong li ek, me ale ar lamp akan, ap koieilang ol kamod.

verses.name: Matthew 25:2
verses.text: Me limen me lolekong a me limen me lolepon.

verses.name: Matthew 25:3
verses.text: Me lolepon oko wa ar lamp akan ap sota iangaki kadirepa.

verses.name: Matthew 25:4
verses.text: A me lolekong ko wa ar lamp akan iangaki kadirepa.

verses.name: Matthew 25:5
verses.text: A ni en ol kamod a pwapwand ir karos men mair ap mairelar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:6
verses.text: A lao nan lukepan pong a lok sili: Kilang, ol kamod kotido, komail koieilang i!

verses.name: Matthew 25:7
verses.text: Li karos ap pauridar kaonopadar ar lamp akan.

verses.name: Matthew 25:8
verses.text: Me lolopon ap indang me lolekong kan: Komail ki dong kit kisan omail le, pwe nait lamp akan pan kunla.

verses.name: Matthew 25:9
verses.text: A me lolekong kang sapeng indada: O iermen, pwe ede sola itar ong kit o komail, komail kola ren saunet netiada pein omail.

verses.name: Matthew 25:10
verses.text: Ni arail kokolan net, ol kamod ap samador. Irail me onoper iang i pedelong ong nan kamadip o, wanim ap ritidier.

verses.name: Matthew 25:11
verses.text: Murin ansau kis li tei ko ap pwarado indada: Maing, maing, re kotin ritingadang kit!

verses.name: Matthew 25:12
verses.text: A ap sapeng indada: Melel i indang komail, i sasa komail.

verses.name: Matthew 25:13
verses.text: Komail ari masamasan, pwe komail sasa ran de auer.

verses.name: Matthew 25:14
verses.text: Pwe a rasong aramas amen, me pan momaitela nan wai. Ap kapokon pena na ladu kan o nek ong irail a dipisou kan.

verses.name: Matthew 25:15
verses.text: A ki ong amen talent limau, a ong amen riau, a ong amen eu, duen me re itar ong, a ap madang samalar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: Me aleer talent limau, ap koieila dodokki o diaradar pil talent limau.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: A me aleer riau, pil dueta, a diaradar pil riau.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: A me aleer eu, ap koieilar sarepedier nani pwel, okilar moni en monsap o.

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: A kadekadeo a warailar monsap en ladu pukat ap puredo o kainene irail adar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: Me aleer talent limau ap potodo wado pil talent limau indada: Maing komui kotiki ong ia er talent limau, kom kotin masani, iet pil talent limau, me i netia kidar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: A monsap ap indang i: Meid mau, me koe wiadar, ladu lelapok o melel amen koe. Koe apapwali mau me tikitik o, i ap pan kasapwiladang uk pon dipisou toto, ko ong nan peren en om monsap!

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: A me aleer talent riau ap pil potodo indada: Maing komui kotiki dong ia er talent riau, kom kotin masani, iet pil talent riau, me i netia kidar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: A monsap ap indant i: Meid mau, me koe wiadar, ladu lelapok o melel amen koe. Koe apapwali mau me tikitik o, i ap pan kasapwiladang uk pon dipisou toto ko ong nan peren en om monsap!

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: A me aleer talent eu ap pil potodo indada: Maing, i asaer komui, me komui ol padik amen, me kin dolung sang wasa, me kaidin komui padukedier ia, o nak pena, wasa me kaidin komui kamorok ia;

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: Ngai ari masak, o koieila o okilar sapwilim omui talent nani pwel, masani, iet sapwilim omui.

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: A monsap ap sapeng indang i: Ladu sued o ponkake men koe, ma koe asaer, me i kin dolung wasa, me kaidin ngai padukedier, o nak pena wasa, me kaidin ngai kamorokier.

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: Menda koe sota ki ong saun kawilian moni nai moni, a ngai lao puredo, i ap pan ale me udan ai iangaki moni me a naitikadar.

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: Komail ari ki sang re a a talent, ap ki ong, me a talent eisok.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: Pwe me a mia, ekis pan ko ong, pwen aneki me laud; a me sota a mia, nan a pan katia sang me mi re a.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: A ladu me sota katepa, komail kasela nan rotorot liki, iei wasan maiei o teterok.

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: A Nain aramas lao kodo ni a lingan, o tounlang saraui kan iang i, a pan mondi pon mol en a lingan;

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: O toun sappa karos pan kapokon pena mo a. A ap pan katoror irail pasang dueta silepa o kin katorore sip ol ren li akan.

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: A pan kila na sip li akan ni pali maun, o na sip ol akan ni pali maing.

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: Nanmarki ap pan masani ong toun pali maun: Ukodo, komail kompoke pan Sam ai, sosoki wei o, me onop ong komail er sang ni tapin kaua!

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: Pwe ngai men mangadar, a komail ap kamanga ia; ngai men nim piladar, a komail ap kanim pil ia; ngai men kairu men, a komail ap kasamo ia.

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: Kiliso, a komail ap kalikauwi ia dar, ngai somaudar, a komail ap pwara dong ia; ngai salidier, a komail ap pwara dong ia.

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: Me pung kan ap pan sapeng i potoan ong: Maing, iad me se potoan ir men konot, ap potoan dong ir konot, de men konot pil, ap id konote dong ir?

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: Iad kit potoan ir men kairu, ap kasamo ir? De kiliso, ap kalikauwi ir adar?

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: Iad kit potoan ir lomum, de salidi, ap poto dong ir?

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: Nanmarki ap pan sapeng masani ong irail: Melel i indai ong komail, meakot komail wiai ong amen, ri ai ol tikitik pukat, i me komail wiai ong ia er.

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: A ap pil pan indang irail toun pali maing: Komail me riala, kowei sang ia, ko ong nan kisiniai soutuk, me onoper ong tewil o nal kan.

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: Pwe ngai men mangadar, a komail sota kamanga ia, o men nim piladar, a komail sota kanim pil ia,

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: Ngai men kairu men, a komail sota kasamo ia, kiliso, a komail sota kalikauwi ia dar, o somau, o salidi, a komail sota pwara dong ia.

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: Irail ap pil pan potoan ong: Maing, iad me se potoan ir men konot, de men konot pil, de men kairu men, de kiliso, de lomum, de salidi, ap sota papa ong ir?

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: A ap pan sapeng irail masani: Melel i indai ong komail, meakot komail sota wiai ong amen tikitik pukat, i me komail sota wiai ong ia.

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: Mepukat ap pan kolang kalokolok soutuk, a me pung kan pan maur soutuk.<div eID="gen2636" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.25"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO Iesus lao kaimwisokela padak pukat karos, ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan:

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: Komail asa, pong ria pong pasa pan wiaui o Nain aramas pan pangala, en kalopula.

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan o saumas akan en toun sap o ap pokon pena nan im eng samero lapalap, me maraneki Kaipas.

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: O kapukapung pena duen ar pan widingadi Iesus en kamatala.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: A irail inda: Iermen ni ran en kamadip, pwe aramas ede moromorongada.

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: Iesus lao kotikot Petaniem nan im en Simon tuketuk,

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: Li amen ap poto dong i, wa kisin potel alapasta audaud en men kei kasampwalia ap kieledier ong pon kadokenmai, ni a kotin konot.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: A tounpadak kan lao kilanger, ap suede kidar indada: Menda kei wet olar mal?

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: Pwe a pan netila, kareda pwai laud ap nek ong samama kan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi met, ap kotin masani ong irail: Da me komail kainsensuedeki li o? Pwe me mau, me a wiai ong ia er.

verses.name: Matthew 26:11
verses.text: Pwe me samama kan kin mi re omail ansau karos, a ngai sota ansau karos.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: Pwe ni a wudok kidi pil wet pon war ai, a kaonopadar ai saredi.

verses.name: Matthew 26:13
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, wasa karos, me rongamau wet pan kalok ia, pangada sappa pon, me a wiaer et, pil pan kaloki, pwen katamanpa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: Amen ekriamen, me adaneki Iudas Iskariot, ap koieila ren samero lapalap akan,

verses.name: Matthew 26:15
verses.text: Indada: Da me komail pan ki dong ia, i pan panga dong komail i? Irail ari inauki ong i sip en moni sileisok.

verses.name: Matthew 26:16
verses.text: A sang ni ansau o a sosong duen a pan mangai ong en pangala i.

verses.name: Matthew 26:17
verses.text: Ni ran kaieu en prot somut tounpadak kan poto dong Iesus patoan ong: Ia wasa re kotin kupura, sen kaonopadang ir kamadip en pasa?

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: A kotin masani: Kola nan kanim ren ol amen indai ong i: Saunpadak o masani: Ai ansau korendor, I pan wiada kamadip en pasa re om, o ai tounpadak kan pan iang ia.

verses.name: Matthew 26:19
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap wiadar duen masan en Iesus, kaonopadar pasa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:20
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer, a kaipokedi ni tepel, a ekriamen akan iang i.

verses.name: Matthew 26:21
verses.text: Ni arail konokonot, a kotin masani: Melel I indai ong komail, amen komail pan pang ia la.

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: Irail ap insensued o amen amen potoan ong i indada: Maing ngai i?

verses.name: Matthew 26:23
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani: Me ian ia kaduedi nan dal o, i me pan pang ia la.

verses.name: Matthew 26:24
verses.text: Pwe Nain aramas pan kokola duen a intingidier. A suedi ong aramas o, me Nain aramas pangala re a, me mau ong aramas o, ma a sota ipwidier.

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: A Iudas, me pangala i ap sapeng potoan ong indada: Rapi, ngai i? A kotin masani ong i: Koe me indada.

verses.name: Matthew 26:26
verses.text: Ni arail wiadar konot. Iesus kotin limadar prot laolaoki, o pilitiki pasang, kotiki ong toupadak kan masani: Ale tungole, war ai metet.

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: A pil kotikida dal o laolaoki kotiki ong irail masani: Komail karos nim sang;

verses.name: Matthew 26:28
verses.text: Pwe nt’ ai metet, udan inau kap, me pan kapwilipwilidi ong me toto, men lapwada dip.

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, me I solar pan nim sang wan wain sang ansau wet lao lei ni ran o, me I pan pil nim nan wein Sam ai iangaki komail!

verses.name: Matthew 26:30
verses.text: Irail lao melkakaki melkaka en kaping, rap kotila pon dol Oliwe.

verses.name: Matthew 26:31
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail karos pan makar kin ia pongpong wet, pwe a intingidier: I pan kame silepa o, a pwin sip o pan more pasang.

verses.name: Matthew 26:32
verses.text: A murin ai maureda, I pan ti ong mo ’mail kola Kaliläa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:33
verses.text: A Petrus sapeng potoan ong i: Ma karos pan makar kin ir a ngai sota pan makar.

verses.name: Matthew 26:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Melel I indai ong uk, pongpong wet mon malek a kakorot, koe pan kamam kin ia pan silepak.

verses.name: Matthew 26:35
verses.text: Petrus potoan ong i: Ma i iang ir matala, i sota pan man kamam kin ir; iduen en tounpadak kan karos ar indinda.

verses.name: Matthew 26:36
verses.text: Iesus ap kotilang wasa o me adaneki Ketsemane, a irail iang i, ap kotin masani ong tounpadak kan: Komail mondi met, lao I pan kola kapakap monen.

verses.name: Matthew 26:37
verses.text: O a kotin ukadar Petrus o nain Sepedäus ol riamen, ap kotin tapiadar kupur olar o patau kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 26:38
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Ngen i ap insensuedelar kaualap ong mela. Komail pan mimieta met, iang ia masamasan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:39
verses.text: O a kotila ekis wasa, ap kotin pupekidi silang i laolaoki masani: Sam ai, ma a kak, kom kotiki sang ia dal wet; ari so, kaidin ngai, komui ta en wiawia.

verses.name: Matthew 26:40
verses.text: I ari kotin pure dong tounpadak kan, diar ir adar mamair, ap kotin masani ong Petrus: Komail so kak iang ia masamasan auer ta ieu?

verses.name: Matthew 26:41
verses.text: Masamasan o kapakap, pwe komail de ko ong nan songesong. Nen me peik, a uduk me luet.

verses.name: Matthew 26:42
verses.text: A pil kotila kariapak laolaoki masani: Sam ai, omui kupur eta, me dal wet sota kak kowei sang ia, ari I pan tungole.

verses.name: Matthew 26:43
verses.text: A lao kotin puredo diar ir adar pil mamair, pwe mas arail me toutou.

verses.name: Matthew 26:44
verses.text: A a kotin muei sang irail, pil kotilar laolaoki kasilepak ni masan ota.

verses.name: Matthew 26:45
verses.text: Ap kotin pure dong tounpadak kan masani ong irail: Komail ari mamair o kamol. Kilang, auer leler, me Nain aramas pan pangalang pa en me dipan akan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:46
verses.text: Paurida, kitail en kola, kilang, a samador, me pan pang ia la.

verses.name: Matthew 26:47
verses.text: Ni a kotin mamasandar, kilang, Iudas, amen ir ekriamen oko, pwarador, pokon lapalap iang i, me wa kodlas o sokon sang ren samero lapalap akan o saumas akan en toun sap o.

verses.name: Matthew 26:48
verses.text: Men pangala i ki ong ir kilel eu indada: Me I pan metik, iei I komail pan koledi.

verses.name: Matthew 26:49
verses.text: I ap madang dong Iesui indada: Pong mau Rapi ap metik i.

verses.name: Matthew 26:50
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Kompoke pai, menda koe pwarador? Irail ap por ong Iesus, saikidi i.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: A kilang, amen irail, me iang Iesus, kapawei pa a, usadar na kodlas, pale sang salong en ladu en samero lapalap o.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Kapure iong om kodlas nan deu a! Pwe karos, me ale kodlas, pan kamekila kodlas.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: De koe lamelame, me I sota kak poeki ren Sam ai en kadara dong ia tounlang toto sang lekion eisokriau sama;

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: A iaduen kisin likau kak pwaida? A udan a pan wiaui duen met.

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: Ni auer ota Iesus kotin masani ong pokon o: Da, ngai lolap amen, me komail kodon aleki kodlas o sokon akan? Ni ran akan karos I mier re omail, kauwewe nan im en kaudok, a komail sota kol ia dier.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: A mepukat karos wiauier, pwe kisin likau en saukop akan en pwaida. Tounpadak kan karos ap muei sang i tangdaui.

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: A me saikidier Iesus, ap kaluang i ren samero lapalap Kaipas, wasa saunkawewe o saumas akan pokon pena ia.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: A Petrus idauendo i doowei sang lel tanpas en samero lapalap o pedelong ong mondi ren papa kan, pwen kilang imwin mepukat.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: A samero lapalap akan, o saumas akan, o pwin en kapung o roporop kadede likam ong Iesus, pwen kamatala;

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: Ari, sota me irail diar. Saunkadede likam me toto, me pwarado, ari so, sota me irail diar. Ikmuri saunkadede riamen pwarado,

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: Indada: Lap en me inda: I kak ong kawela im en kaudok en Kot ap id kauada ni pong sili pong.

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: Samero lapalap ap kasinenda masani ong i: Kom sota sapengki meakot, me mepukat kin kadede ong komui?

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: A Iesus kotin nenenlata. Samero lapalap ap masani ong i: I kakau kin komui la ren Kot ieias, komui en indang kit, ma komui Kristus Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Komui me inda. A I pil men kaire kin komail, sang ni ansau wet, komail pan kilang Nain aramas a pan kaipokedi ni pali maun en manaman o kokido dapok en lang akan.

verses.name: Matthew 26:65
verses.text: Samero lapalap ap ter pasang, a likau kan indada: A lalaue. Menda pil akai saunkadede? Kilang, komail apton rongadar a lalaue,

verses.name: Matthew 26:66
verses.text: Da me komail lamelame? Irail sapeng potoan ong: A mau ong kamela.

verses.name: Matthew 26:67
verses.text: Irail ap kondipi ong silang i o pakir i, o akai pikir i ni silang i,

verses.name: Matthew 26:68
verses.text: Indada: Kristus, kokop ong kit, is me pikir uk?

verses.name: Matthew 26:69
verses.text: Petrus momod liki panakepir; lidu men ap ko dong i indada: Koe me pil iang Iesus en Kaliläa.

verses.name: Matthew 26:70
verses.text: A i me kamamaki mo ’rail karos indada: I poneponeki me koe inda.

verses.name: Matthew 26:71
verses.text: A ni a pedoi wei sang nan wanim, amen lidu ap kilang i indang irail, me mi wasa o: Lap men et me pil iang Iesus en Nasaret.

verses.name: Matthew 26:72
verses.text: A pil kamamki ap kaula: I sasa aramas en.

verses.name: Matthew 26:73
verses.text: Mur ekis irail me u impa pil kaido indang Petrus: Melel koe amen irail, pwe ngil om kadiarok kin uk ada.

verses.name: Matthew 26:74
verses.text: I ap lalaue o kaula indada: I sasa aramas en. Malek ap kakorot.

verses.name: Matthew 26:75
verses.text: Petrus ap tamanda masan en Iesus, me kotin masani ong i: Mon malek a kakorot, koe pan kamam kin ia pan silepak. A ap koieila sangesang laud.<div eID="gen2637" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.26"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:1
verses.text: A LAO ran pasanger, samero lapalap akan o saumas akan en toun sap o kapukapungada duen Iesus pwen kamatala.

verses.name: Matthew 27:2
verses.text: Irail lao saliedi i, ap wawei, ki ong ren kopina Pontius Pilatus.

verses.name: Matthew 27:3
verses.text: A Iudas, me pangala i lao kilanger me a pakadeikadar, en kamatala, ap kalukila o purekido moni sileisok ren samero lapalap akan o saumas akan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:4
verses.text: Indada: Ngai me wiadar dip, ni ai pangalar nta makelekel. A irail inda: Menda re at? Koe en pein wia.

verses.name: Matthew 27:5
verses.text: I ari kasedi moni ko nan im en kaudok, ap koieilar lusiamalar.

verses.name: Matthew 27:6
verses.text: A samero lapalap akan ale moni ko indada; A sota pung kitail en ki ong nan deun mairong, pwe pwain pan nta.

verses.name: Matthew 27:7
verses.text: Irail ari kapukapung, ap netiadar sap en saun wia dal, wasa me men liki pan seredi ia,

verses.name: Matthew 27:8
verses.text: I me wasa o adaneki sap en nta kokodo lel ran wet.

verses.name: Matthew 27:9
verses.text: I dokan a pwaidar, me lokidor ren saukop Ieremia, me masani: Irail ari aleer moni sileisok i pwaine pan i, me re netiada ren men Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 27:10
verses.text: O pwaine kida sap en saun wia dal, duen me Kaun o kotin masani ong ia.

verses.name: Matthew 27:11
verses.text: Iesus ari kotikot mon kopina; kopina ap kainoma re a masani: Nanmarki en Sus akan komui? A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Komui me masani.

verses.name: Matthew 27:12
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan o saumas akan lao karaune kin i, a sota kotin sapeng.

verses.name: Matthew 27:13
verses.text: Pilatus ap masani ong i: Komui sota rong duen ar karakarauni komui kaualap?

verses.name: Matthew 27:14
verses.text: I ari sota kotin masani ong i meakot. Kopina ap poneponeki kaualap.

verses.name: Matthew 27:15
verses.text: Ari, ni kamadip o kopina kin lapwa ong irail amen me salidi, meamen, me re mauki,

verses.name: Matthew 27:16
verses.text: A i ansau o ol amen, ad a Parapas, me salidi re ’rail.

verses.name: Matthew 27:17
verses.text: Irail lao pokon penaer, Pilatus ap masani ong irail: Is me komail mauki, i en lapwa dang komail, Parapas de Iesus, me maraneki Kristus?

verses.name: Matthew 27:18
verses.text: Pwe a asaer, ar peirin, me re pang kilar i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:19
verses.text: A lao kaipokedi pon deun kadeik, a paud ilokilang i indada: Komui der wia meakot ong ol pung men et, pwe i auramandar duen i, me i lokelokeki laud ran wet.

verses.name: Matthew 27:20
verses.text: A samero lapalap akan o saumas akan sairen kila pokon o, ar poekipoeki Parapas o kamatala Iesus.

verses.name: Matthew 27:21
verses.text: A kopina sapeng masani ong irail: Is re ’ra, me komail mauki, i en lapwadang komail? Irail potoan ong: Parapas.

verses.name: Matthew 27:22
verses.text: Pilatus ap masani ong irail: Da me i en wiaki Iesus, me maraneki Kristus? Irail karos potoan ong: A en kalopuela!

verses.name: Matthew 27:23
verses.text: A kopina masani: Pwe sued da, me a wiadar? A re kalaudela ar weriwer: A pan kalopuela!

verses.name: Matthew 27:24
verses.text: Pilatus lao kilang, me a sota kak wiada meakot, pwe moromorong pan wiaui, ap ale pil, omiom mo ’rail masani: Ngai makelekel sang ntan ol pung men et, komail pan wia.

verses.name: Matthew 27:25
verses.text: Aramas karos ap wiaki eu sapeng indada: Nta en kapokon ong kit o nait seri kan!

verses.name: Matthew 27:26
verses.text: A ap lapwa dong irail Parapas, a Iesus me a woki ap mueid ong irail, en kalopuela i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:27
verses.text: Nain kopina saunpei kan ap ale Iesus kalualong ong nan im en kadeik o, ap kapokon pena saunpei karos;

verses.name: Matthew 27:28
verses.text: Irail ap ki sang i sapwilim a likau kan, ap id kalikauwie kida i likau waitata;

verses.name: Matthew 27:29
verses.text: Ap pada al en tek eu, ap kida pon kadokenmai, o ki ong sokon apot ni lim a maun, o kelepukidi mo a o kapikapidi i indada: Iong Nanmarki en Sus akan!

verses.name: Matthew 27:30
verses.text: Irail kondipe ong i, o re ale sokon o, o pokieki kadokenmai.

verses.name: Matthew 27:31
verses.text: Irail lao kapiti i, ap kisang likau waitata, ap kapure ong i udan sapwilim a likau o kaluawei, pwen kalopuela.

verses.name: Matthew 27:32
verses.text: Ni arail kotikot kokola, rap diarada aramas en Kirene men, me ad a Simon, i me re iton ong, en wadala sapwelim a lopu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:33
verses.text: Irail lao lel ong wasa o, me ad a Kolkata, iet wewe: Wasa en pondal en monga.

verses.name: Matthew 27:34
verses.text: Irail ki ong i pinika, me doleki edi. A lao kotin song kis, a sota urak.

verses.name: Matthew 27:35
verses.text: Irail lao kalopuelar i, ap nek pasang sapwilim a likau kadoropwe kidar.

verses.name: Matthew 27:36
verses.text: Irail ari mondi ong wasa o masamasan i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:37
verses.text: O ponangin kadokenmai re pasuredier inting o, me a pukoki: Iet Nanmarki en Sus akan.

verses.name: Matthew 27:38
verses.text: Lolap riamen iang i lopuelar, amen mi ni pali maun, a amen ni pali maing.

verses.name: Matthew 27:39
verses.text: Me dadaulul akan lalaue i, dueduälok.

verses.name: Matthew 27:40
verses.text: Katiti: Koe me kin kawela im en kaudok ap id kauada pong sili pong, en pein dore uk ala; ma Sapwilim en Kot koe, en keredi sang nin lopu en!

verses.name: Matthew 27:41
verses.text: A samero lapalap, o saunkawewe, o saumas akan pil dueta kapikapiti i indada:

verses.name: Matthew 27:42
verses.text: A dorelar akai, ap sota kak dorela pein i; ma i Nanmarki en Israel, i en keredi sang ni lopu en, a kitail pan kamelele i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:43
verses.text: A liki Kot, i en kotin dorela, ma a kotin kupura i, pwe a indada: Ngai Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Matthew 27:44
verses.text: Lolap oko, me iang i lopuelar, pil lalaue i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:45
verses.text: Sang ni auer kawonu lel auer kaduau rotorot kipadi sap o.

verses.name: Matthew 27:46
verses.text: Ni auer kaduau Iesus ap kotin ngil laud masani: Eli, eli lama asaptani! Iet wewe: Ai Kot, ai Kot, da me komui likitmalia kin ia la?

verses.name: Matthew 27:47
verses.text: Akai me u wasa o, rongadar me, ap indada: A eker Elias.

verses.name: Matthew 27:48
verses.text: A amen irail pitipit tang ale lim eu, kaduedi ong nan pinika kauong ni alek apot, kidang i en urak,

verses.name: Matthew 27:49
verses.text: A akai me inda: Iermen, kitail en kilang mas, ma Elias pan pwarado dorela i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:50
verses.text: Iesus pil kotin ngil laud, ap kadarala ngen e.

verses.name: Matthew 27:51
verses.text: A kilang, perepa likau en im en kaudok o ap dei pasang, sang pali poa lel pa, o sap rereda, o paip akai rongkilar,

verses.name: Matthew 27:52
verses.text: O sousou kai sara pasang, o war en me saraui kan toto, me mamair, ap iasadar.

verses.name: Matthew 27:53
verses.text: O murin ar iasadar, irail koda sang nan sousou kan, kolang kanim saraui, pwara dong me toto.

verses.name: Matthew 27:54
verses.text: Senturion o me iang i sinsila Iesus, kilanger sap a rereda, o meakan, me wiauier, rap masakadar kaualap, katiti: Melel i, me Sapwilim en Kot!

verses.name: Matthew 27:55
verses.text: O li toto mi kailewei, kilekilang me wiaui, iei irail, me idauendo Iesus sang Kaliläa papa i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:56
verses.text: Maria men Makdala, o Maria in en Iakopus i Ioses, o in en nain Sepedäus akan mi nan pung arail.

verses.name: Matthew 27:57
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer, ol kapwapwa men pwarado, men Arimatia, me ad a Iosep, me pil tounpadak en Iesus amen.

verses.name: Matthew 27:58
verses.text: I ari poto dong Pilatus poeki kalep en Iesus. Pilatus ap masani, a en pangalang i.

verses.name: Matthew 27:59
verses.text: Iosep ari ale kalep o, kidimiki pena likau makelekel o kaselel;

verses.name: Matthew 27:60
verses.text: Ap nekidedi nan pein a sousou kap, me a weiradar nan paip; i ap kadapure ong takai kalaimun eu nan au en sousou o, ap kotila sang,

verses.name: Matthew 27:61
verses.text: A Maria men Makdala, o Maria teio momod sal ong sousou o.

verses.name: Matthew 27:62
verses.text: A mandan ran o, ran en kaonop, samero lapalap o Parisär akan pokon pena ren Pilatus.

verses.name: Matthew 27:63
verses.text: Indada: Maing, kit tamandar, me ol sued men et katitiki ni a memaur: I pan maureda murin ran silu.

verses.name: Matthew 27:64
verses.text: Komui ari masani, me ren sinsila sousou o lel ran kasilu, pwe a tounpadak kan de kodo pirapela, ap indang aramas: A kotin iasadar sang ren me melar akan, pwe pakotau wet pan sued sang men mas,

verses.name: Matthew 27:65
verses.text: Pilatus masani ong irail: let silepa ko, komail kowei sinsila sousou o duen komail kak ong.

verses.name: Matthew 27:66
verses.text: Irail ari koieila, kileledier takai o, o kasilaki sousou o saunpei kai.<div eID="gen2638" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.27"/>

verses.name: Matthew 28:1
verses.text: RAN en sapat lao daulier, ni mansang en at en wik, Maria men Makdala, o Maria teio ap kodon ududial sousou o.

verses.name: Matthew 28:2
verses.text: A kilang, sap rereda kaualap, pwe tounlang en Kaun amen, pwaradido sang nanlang o katapur sang takai o, ap kaipokedi ong poa,

verses.name: Matthew 28:3
verses.text: Mom a dueta liol o a likau puetepueteta sno.

verses.name: Matthew 28:4
verses.text: Silepa ko ap masapwekadar, o re likamata mela.

verses.name: Matthew 28:5
verses.text: A tounlang o kotin sapeng masani ong li oko: Komail der masak pwe i asa, me koma rapaki Iesus, me lopuelar.

verses.name: Matthew 28:6
verses.text: A soer met, pwe a iasadar, duen a kotin masanier. Kodo udial wasa, me Kaun nekinekidi mas o,

verses.name: Matthew 28:7
verses.text: O tangwei kaireki sapwilim a tounpadak kan, me a kotin iasadar sang ren me melar akan. A kilang a pan kotin tiong mo ’mail kotilang Kaliläa. I wasa komail pan diarada i. Kilang, i kop ong komail er.

verses.name: Matthew 28:8
verses.text: Ira ari madang sang ni sousou o masak o peren kaualap, o tangwei kaireki ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan.

verses.name: Matthew 28:9
verses.text: A ni ara kola, kaireki sapwilim a tounpadak kan, kilang, Iesus ap tu ong ira masani: Ran mau! Ira ap kai ong poridi ni aluwilu a o pongi i.

verses.name: Matthew 28:10
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong ira: Der masak, kowei kaireki ri ai ol akan, pwe re en koieilang Kaliläa. I wasa re pan diar ia.

verses.name: Matthew 28:11
verses.text: Ni ara kokola, kilang silepa kai ko dong kanim o kaireki samero lapalap akan karos me wiauier.

verses.name: Matthew 28:12
verses.text: Irail ari pokon pena iangaki saumas akan o kapukapung, ap ki ong saunpei moni toto.

verses.name: Matthew 28:13
verses.text: Indai ong irail: Komail pan inda: A tounpadak kan pwarador pong pirapela i ni at mamair.

verses.name: Matthew 28:14
verses.text: A ma kopina pan rongada duen mepukat, kit ap pan sauasa komail re a.

verses.name: Matthew 28:15
verses.text: Irail ari aleer moni kan o wiadar duen me re katiti ong irail. A kasoi pot et lolok sili ren Sus akan kokodo lel ran wet.

verses.name: Matthew 28:16
verses.text: A tounpadak ekamen kowei ong Kaliläa, pon nana eu, me Iesus kotin kakalik ong irail er.

verses.name: Matthew 28:17
verses.text: Irail lao diaradar i, re pongi ong i, a akai me peikasal.

verses.name: Matthew 28:18
verses.text: Iesus ap kotido masani ong irail: Manaman en nanlang o sappa karos muei ong ia er.

verses.name: Matthew 28:19
verses.text: Komail ari kola o padaki ong toun sappa karos o paptais ir ala ni mar en Sam o Na o Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Matthew 28:20
verses.text: Padaki ong irail, me ren dadaurata meakan, me I kakalik ong komail er. O kilang, I pan daudaulole komail sili kokolata, lao lel sappa imwisokela.<div eID="gen2639" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Matt.28"/> <div eID="gen2611" osisID="Matt" type="book"/>

verses.name: Mark 1:1
verses.text: TAPIN rongamau en Iesus Kristus, Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Mark 1:2
verses.text: Duen a intingidi ren saukop Iesaia: Kilang, i kadarala mo ’mui ai men kadar me pan kaonopada al omui!

verses.name: Mark 1:3
verses.text: Ngil eu likelikwir sili nan sap tan: Komail kaonopada al en Kaun o kaineneda al a!

verses.name: Mark 1:4
verses.text: Ioanes kotido wia paptais nin sap tan o padapadak duen paptais en kalula ong lapwa dip akan.

verses.name: Mark 1:5
verses.text: Toun sap en Sus akan o toun Ierusalem karos pokon dong re a; irail paptaisela re a nan pilap Iordan, weokada dip arail akan.

verses.name: Mark 1:6
verses.text: Ioanes kin likauwi wun en kamel, o perapirki kil en man, o kin kangkang mansiek o oni en nan wel.

verses.name: Mark 1:7
verses.text: O padapadak masani: Meamen laud sang ia kotido mur i. Sal en a sut i sota war ong idiokidi lapwada.

verses.name: Mark 1:8
verses.text: I paptais kilar komail pil. A a pan paptais kin komail Ngen saraui!

verses.name: Mark 1:9
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni ran oko Iesus ap kotido sang Nasaret en Kaliläa ap paptaisela ren Ioanes nan Iordan.

verses.name: Mark 1:10
verses.text: A madang kotida sang nan pil o, ap kotin masani nanlang kan ar ritida, o Ngen mom en muroi piridi dong po a.

verses.name: Mark 1:11
verses.text: Ngil eu ap peidido sang nanlang kan: Nai kompok komui, me I perenki!

verses.name: Mark 1:12
verses.text: A madang Ngen kalua wong i sap tan.

verses.name: Mark 1:13
verses.text: A ap kotikoteki sap tan ran pangaul wia songesong pan Satan, ieiang man laualo; a tounlang kan me papa ong i.

verses.name: Mark 1:14
verses.text: Murin en Ioanes a pangalar, Iesus ap koti dong Kaliläa, padapadak rongamau en wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 1:15
verses.text: Masani: Ansau o leler wein Kot mier! Komail kalula! Kamelele rongamau!

verses.name: Mark 1:16
verses.text: Ni a kotikot sili liman sed en Kaliläa, a ap masani Simon o ri a ol Andreas ara lalaid sili, pwe ira saused.

verses.name: Mark 1:17
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong ira: Koma idauen ia do! Pwe I pan wia kin koma la saused en aramas!

verses.name: Mark 1:18
verses.text: Ira ari madang kasedi ara uk eko, ap idauenla i.

verses.name: Mark 1:19
verses.text: Ari, ni a kotila sang wasa o, a ap kotin masani Iakopus, nain Sepedäus o ri a ol Ioanes mimi pon sop pot wonewone ara uk oko.

verses.name: Mark 1:20
verses.text: I ari kotin molipe ira madang, ira ari pededi sam ara Sepedäus nin sop o ren toun dodok ko o idauen la i.

verses.name: Mark 1:21
verses.text: Irail ap koti dong Kapernaum. A madang kotilong ong nan sinakoke ni ran en sapat o kawewe.

verses.name: Mark 1:22
verses.text: Re ap puriamuiki a padak, pwe a kotin kawewe ong irail ni manaman sota dueta saunkawewe kan.

verses.name: Mark 1:23
verses.text: Aramas amen iang mi nan sinakoke o, me ngen saut mi lole, ap weriwer,

verses.name: Mark 1:24
verses.text: Indada: Ko sang kit! Menda re omui kit, Iesus en Nasaret? Komui kotido en kawe kit ala? I asa komui, Saraui en Kot.

verses.name: Mark 1:25
verses.text: Iesus ari ongiongida, masani: Nenenla o kowei sang i!

verses.name: Mark 1:26
verses.text: Ngen saut lao kapururada ap weriwer laudeda, a ap koiei sang i.

verses.name: Mark 1:27
verses.text: Irail karos puriamui, pepeidok nan pung arail indada: Dakot met? Padak kap, dakot met? Pwe ni manaman a masani ong ngen saut akan, irail ari peiki ong i.

verses.name: Mark 1:28
verses.text: I ari madang indand sili nin sap karos impan Kaliläa.

verses.name: Mark 1:29
verses.text: Irail ari madang koti sang nan sinakoke, ap iang Iakopus o Ioanes kotilong ong nan im en Simon o Andreas,

verses.name: Mark 1:30
verses.text: Saulap en Simon wononeki somau karakar. Irail ap kaireki i madang duen i.

verses.name: Mark 1:31
verses.text: I ari koti wong ale pa a, kauada. Somau karakar ap madang ko sang; i ari papa irail.

verses.name: Mark 1:32
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer, ni katipin kirila, re ap wa pena ong i karos me somau o me tewil ti po arail.

verses.name: Mark 1:33
verses.text: O toun kanim o pokon dong ni im o.

verses.name: Mark 1:34
verses.text: A ap kotin kakelailada me toto me somauki song en somau toto, kausa sang tewil toto, ap kulikedi tewil akan, ren der lokaia, pwe re asa i.

verses.name: Mark 1:35
verses.text: A kotin kipada nin soran, kotilang sap tan, pwen laolao wasa o.

verses.name: Mark 1:36
verses.text: Simon o me iang ko ap idauenla i.

verses.name: Mark 1:37
verses.text: Ni arail diar i, re ap potoan ong i: Irail karos raparapa kin komui.

verses.name: Mark 1:38
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Kitail daulul wong sap tei ko, pwe I en pil padak wasa o, pwe i me I kokido.

verses.name: Mark 1:39
verses.text: A ap kotin padapadak sili nan arail sinakoke kan nan sap en Kaliläa karos o kakaus tewil akan.

verses.name: Mark 1:40
verses.text: Ol tuketuk amen ap poto dong i kelepuki poeki potoan ong i: Ma re kotin kupura, re kotin kamakeke ia da!

verses.name: Mark 1:41
verses.text: Iesus ari kupuro kila, kapawei lim a, sair i masani ong i: I pan, makelekelada!

verses.name: Mark 1:42
verses.text: A ni a masani eta, ari a tuketuk ko sang madang, a ap makelekel lar.

verses.name: Mark 1:43
verses.text: I ari kalikedi i, ap madang kadarala.

verses.name: Mark 1:44
verses.text: Masani ong i: Kalaka! Koe depa indai ong meamen; a kowei kasale ong koe samero o, o kida, pweki om makelekelada, me Moses masani, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 1:45
verses.text: Ari, a kolata kalokisili, suaiki sili o ari, kareda en Iesus a sola sansal koti dong kanim o, kotikot eta liki nan sap tan, irail ap pokon dong re a sang pali karos.<div eID="gen2641" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.1"/>

verses.name: Mark 2:1
verses.text: MURIN ran akai a ap pil kotilong ong Kapernaum, ap loki sili me a kotikot nan im o.

verses.name: Mark 2:2
verses.text: Me toto ap madanga pena, im o lao koidala o pil likin im o. A ap kotin kawewe ong ir masan o.

verses.name: Mark 2:3
verses.text: Irail ari poto dong re a, wa kodo me somau rerer men, roan pa men.

verses.name: Mark 2:4
verses.text: Irail sota kak kai dong impa pweki pokon o. Re ap palang pasang pon im o, wasa a kotikot ia; irail lao palang pasang ap kakiredi ro o, me somau o mi poa.

verses.name: Mark 2:5
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi ar poson, ap masani ong me somau rerer o: Nai, dip om akan lapwa sang uk er!

verses.name: Mark 2:6
verses.text: Ari, saunkawewe kai momod wasa o, mongemongloleki:

verses.name: Mark 2:7
verses.text: Da me men et lokelokaia? A lalaue. Is me kak lapwada dip akan, pwe amen ta, Kot?

verses.name: Mark 2:8
verses.text: Iesus ari madang angiada nan kupur a duen ar mongemonglole, ap kotin masani ong irail: Da me komail mongemongloleki?

verses.name: Mark 2:9
verses.text: Ia me mangai ren indai ong me somau rerer: Dip om akan lapwa sang uk er, de inda: Uda, ale ki om, kowei?

verses.name: Mark 2:10
verses.text: A pwe komail en asa, me Nain aramas me manaman ong lapwada dip akan nin sappa, iei me a kotin masanieki ong me somau rerer:

verses.name: Mark 2:11
verses.text: I indai ong uk: Uda! Al eki om! U ko ong ni im om!

verses.name: Mark 2:12
verses.text: I ari madang uda, ale ki, aluwei mo ’rail karos. Irail karos ari malamalaua kila, kapinga Kot inda: Se saikenta man kilang meakot et!

verses.name: Mark 2:13
verses.text: I ari pil kotila liman sed o. Irail karos ap pokon dong i, i ari kotin kawewe ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 2:14
verses.text: A lao kotin daulul wasa o, ap masani Lewi, nain Alpäus, a momod ni wasan nopwei, ap masani ong i: Idauen ia do! I ari uda idauenla i.

verses.name: Mark 2:15
verses.text: Kadekadeo a lao kaipokedi konot nan im a, saunopwei o me dipan akan me toto iang Iesus o sapwilim a tounpadak kan konokonot; pwe irail me toto, me idauen i.

verses.name: Mark 2:16
verses.text: Ari, ni en saunkawewe o Parisär akan ar kilang a kotin iang me dipan o saunopwei kan konokonot, irail ap indai ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Da me a iangki saunopwei o me dipan akan konot o kaker eki?

verses.name: Mark 2:17
verses.text: Ni en Iesus angiada, ap kotin masangi ong irail: Me kelail akan sota mau ong saunwini pwe me somau ta. I sota kodon ekeredo me pung kan, a me dipan akan.

verses.name: Mark 2:18
verses.text: En Ioanes a tounpadak kan o Parisär akan kin kaisesol. Irail ari kodo potoan ong i: Da me en Ioanes a tounpadak kan kin kaisesol, o en Parisär ar tounpadak kan, a sapwilim omui tounpadak kan sota kin kaisesol?

verses.name: Mark 2:19
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Da, toun kamadip en kapapaud pan kak kaisesol ni en ol kamod a iang irail? Ni en ol kamod a iang irail, re sota pan kak kaisesol.

verses.name: Mark 2:20
verses.text: A ansau kokodo, me ol kamod pan wisike sang irail, iei ran o, me re pan kaisesol.

verses.name: Mark 2:21
verses.text: Sota amen me pan deik ong likau kap ni likau maring, pwe likau kap pan dei sang likau maring, por o ap pan laudela.

verses.name: Mark 2:22
verses.text: Pil sota amen me kin deuke kida ed maring wain kap, pwe wain o de ter pasang ed o, wain o ari wudokila, ed o ola. A wain kap mau ong nan ed kap.

verses.name: Mark 2:23
verses.text: Kadekadeo a kotin weid nan mat en korn ni ran en sapat. Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap dondolung kowei wan korn.

verses.name: Mark 2:24
verses.text: Parisär oko ap indai ong i: Kilang, da me irail wia ni sapat me sota pung, en wiaui?

verses.name: Mark 2:25
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Komail sota wadoker, me Dawid wiadar, ni a men kaualap, o a men manga, i o me iang i?

verses.name: Mark 2:26
verses.text: Duen a pedelong ong nan tanpas en Kot ni muein Apiatar samero lapalap, o kangala prot mairong o nek ong irail, me iang i, me sota pung aramas en tungole, samero kan eta?

verses.name: Mark 2:27
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Sapat me wiaui ong aramas a kaidik aramas ong sapat.

verses.name: Mark 2:28
verses.text: I me Nain aramas pil udan kaun en sapat.<div eID="gen2642" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.2"/>

verses.name: Mark 3:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO a pil kotin pur ong nan sinakoke. Ari, aramas amen mia, me pa a motor.

verses.name: Mark 3:2
verses.text: Irail ari masamasaneki, ma a pan kakelada i ni ran en sapat, pwe irail en karaun i.

verses.name: Mark 3:3
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong aramas o, me pa a motor: Uda kodo met!

verses.name: Mark 3:4
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Me pung, wia mau ni ran en sapat de wia sued? Kamaur de kamela? Ir ari nenenla.

verses.name: Mark 3:5
verses.text: I ari angiang aupwili sili po ’rail, kupurokila ar kapitakai, ap kotin masani ong aramas o: Kapawei pa om! I ari kapawei. Pa a ap kelailada.

verses.name: Mark 3:6
verses.text: Parisär oko ap madangalang ren iang en Erodes. Re ap kapakaparok duen ar pan kamatala i.

verses.name: Mark 3:7
verses.text: A Iesus kotin kapitawei sang pein i o sapwilim a tounpadak kan, koti wong liman sed. Pokon kalaimun ap idauen i sang Kaliläa, o Iudäa.

verses.name: Mark 3:8
verses.text: O sang Ierusalem, o sang Idumäa, o sang palilan Iordan, o toun liman Tirus o Sidon, pokon kalaimun, re rongada duen a kotin wiada manaman kaualap, re ap pokon dong re a.

verses.name: Mark 3:9
verses.text: A kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, kisin sop kis en kaonop ong i, pweki pokon o, pwe re de koi dong i.

verses.name: Mark 3:10
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kakelada me toto, irail ari pakoideda, pwe me somau ko me sair i.

verses.name: Mark 3:11
verses.text: O ni en ngen saut akan ngar i, re pupedi mo i, weriwer, indada: Sapwilim en Kot komui!

verses.name: Mark 3:12
verses.text: I ari kotin kalik irail edi, ren der kaireki i.

verses.name: Mark 3:13
verses.text: I ari kotidala nan nana o, ap molipei dong i, me a kotin kupura, re ap poto dong re a.

verses.name: Mark 3:14
verses.text: I ari kotin kileledi ekriamen, pwe re en ieiang i, pwen poroporone ir sili padapadak.

verses.name: Mark 3:15
verses.text: O manamanla kakelada me somau kan o kakaus tewil akan;

verses.name: Mark 3:16
verses.text: Simon a kotiki ong ad a Petrus.

verses.name: Mark 3:17
verses.text: O Iakopus nain Iepedäus, o Ioanes ri en Iakopus, a kotiki ong ad ara Poanerkes. Iet wewe: Nain nansapwe.

verses.name: Mark 3:18
verses.text: O Andreas, o Pilipus, o Partolomäus, o Matäus, o Tomas, o Iakopus, nain Alpäus, o Tadäus, o Simon men Kana,

verses.name: Mark 3:19
verses.text: O Iudas Iskariot, me pangala i.

verses.name: Mark 3:20
verses.text: Irail ari ko dong nan im eu. Pil pokon eu pokon pena. Irail ari sola kak manga.

verses.name: Mark 3:21
verses.text: Ni kompokepa ko rongada, re kodo, pwen wala sang i; pwe re inda, me a iakala.

verses.name: Mark 3:22
verses.text: A saunkawewe ko, me kodido sang Ierusalem inda: A katia Peelsepup o saumas en tewil akan; iei me a kakauseki tewil akan.

verses.name: Mark 3:23
verses.text: I ari molipe ir do, masani ong irail ni karaseras akan: Ia pan duen Satan a kausawei Satan?

verses.name: Mark 3:24
verses.text: O ma toun wei eu u pena nan pung ar, wei o sota pan kak pwaida.

verses.name: Mark 3:25
verses.text: O ma penainai eu u pena nan pung ar, penainai o sota pan kak pwaida.

verses.name: Mark 3:26
verses.text: O ma Satan u ong pein i, a sota pan kak pwaida, a pan imwisokela.

verses.name: Mark 3:27
verses.text: Sota amen me pan kak ko ong nan im en kelail amen kulia a kapwa, ma a so saliedi mas me kelail o. A ap pan kak kawela im a.

verses.name: Mark 3:28
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail: Dip akan karos pan lapwa sang nain aramas akan, o laue, me re lalaueki.

verses.name: Mark 3:29
verses.text: A meamen lalaue Ngen saraui sota pan lapwada, a a pan puk ong kamekam soutuk.

verses.name: Mark 3:30
verses.text: Pweki ar inda: A katia ngen saut.

verses.name: Mark 3:31
verses.text: Ari in a, o ri a ol akan ap kodo, mi liki o iloke dong.

verses.name: Mark 3:32
verses.text: A pokon me momod impa o ap potoan ong i: Re mangi, in ar o ri ar ol akan mimi liki kainoma komui.

verses.name: Mark 3:33
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng irail masani: Is in ai de ri ai kan?

verses.name: Mark 3:34
verses.text: A ap kotin aupwil sili po ’rail, me mod impa ko, masani: Kilang, in ai o ri ai ol akan!

verses.name: Mark 3:35
verses.text: Pwe meamen wiawia kupur en Kot, iei me ri ai ol o ri ai li o in ai.<div eID="gen2643" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.3"/>

verses.name: Mark 4:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO a pil kotin tapiada kawewe liman sed o. Pokon kalaimun eu ap ko pena re a. A ap kotidang pon sop pot kotikot pon sed o. A pokon o mi nan sap pon oror.

verses.name: Mark 4:2
verses.text: A kotin kawewe ong irail me toto ni i karaseras akan, masani ong irail ni a padak:

verses.name: Mark 4:3
verses.text: Rong! Kilang, saunkamor o kolan kamorok.

verses.name: Mark 4:4
verses.text: Ni a kamokamorok akai ap moridi ong pon kailan al, manpir ap pirido nam ir ala.

verses.name: Mark 4:5
verses.text: A akai moredi ong wasa takain, wasa pwel petepet; irail ari madang wosada, pweki sota pwel lole.

verses.name: Mark 4:6
verses.text: Ni en katipin dakarada, re ap mongela o mela pweki sota kalau ar.

verses.name: Mark 4:7
verses.text: A akai moredi nan tuka teketek; o tuka teketek wosada, kasokiala, re ap sota wa.

verses.name: Mark 4:8
verses.text: A akai moredi nan pwel mau o pwaida wa; akai pan me sileisok; a akai me woneisok, a akai me epuki.

verses.name: Mark 4:9
verses.text: A kotin masani: Me salong a mia men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Mark 4:10
verses.text: A lao kotin kalapukela, men imp a iangaki ekriamen ap kalelapok re a duen karaseras pukat.

verses.name: Mark 4:11
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: A muei ong komail, en asa duen me rir en wein Kot. A men liki re pan asa meakaros sang ni karaseras akan.

verses.name: Mark 4:12
verses.text: Pwe re kilang, ari sota kilang, o rongerong, ap sota dedeki; pwe re de pan wukila o dip ar lapwa sang irail.

verses.name: Mark 4:13
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail sota dedeki karaseras pot et? A iaduen, omail pan asa karaseras tei ko?

verses.name: Mark 4:14
verses.text: Saunkamor me kamorok sili masan.

verses.name: Mark 4:15
verses.text: A mepukat me mi pon kailan al, wasa masan moredi ong, a re lao rongadar, Satan ap madangado, ki sang masan, me kamoremoredi ong nan mongiong arail.

verses.name: Mark 4:16
verses.text: O mepukat me moredi ong wasan takain, re lao rongadar masan o ap madang peren kida ale.

verses.name: Mark 4:17
verses.text: A sota kalaua re ’rail ap dadaur eta ekis, lao songesong o kamekam wiaui pweki masan o, re ap madang makar kida.

verses.name: Mark 4:18
verses.text: A mepukat me moredi ong nan tuka teketek, me rongada masan.

verses.name: Mark 4:19
verses.text: A anan en pai en sappa o inong kapwa, o norok en okotme pwaida, kasokela masan, ap sota wa.

verses.name: Mark 4:20
verses.text: A mepukat irail, me moredi ong nan pwel mau, me rongada masan o, ale o wa, akai pan me sileisok, a akai me woneisok, a akai me epuki.

verses.name: Mark 4:21
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Kandel pan wisikedo, pwen ko ong pan kasak de pan men wendi? A sote koda wong nin deun kandel?

verses.name: Mark 4:22
verses.text: Pwe sota me rir kot, me so pan sansalada, pil sota me okiok kot, me so pan lok sili.

verses.name: Mark 4:23
verses.text: Meamen me salong a mia men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Mark 4:24
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail kalaka, me komail rong! Pwe men song, me komail songki iduen a pil pan song, ong komail. O omail tungol pan laud.

verses.name: Mark 4:25
verses.text: Pwe me a mia, ekis pan ko ong; a me sota a mia, me ekis mi re a, pan katia sang.

verses.name: Mark 4:26
verses.text: A kotin masani: Iet duen wein Kot, ras ong aramas amen, me kamoredi ong nan pwel war en tuka.

verses.name: Mark 4:27
verses.text: Ap mairela, pirida, pong ran; a war o wosada ap kakairida a ap sota asa due.

verses.name: Mark 4:28
verses.text: Pwe pwel kin pein kawosada tuka. Mas katoka, mur mpok, mur war en korn nan mpok ap pwarada.

verses.name: Mark 4:29
verses.text: A ni wa ma, a ap madang ki ong men lepukedi, pwe rak mier.

verses.name: Mark 4:30
verses.text: A pil kotin masani: Da me kitail en karasai ong wein Kot? De da me kitail en kasosong ong?

verses.name: Mark 4:31
verses.text: A rasong wan tuka, me pan kamoremoredi ong nan pwel, me tikitik sang war karos, me mi nan sap.

verses.name: Mark 4:32
verses.text: A lao kamoredi, ap wosada laude sang dip karos, ap kasang pasang laud; manpir en pan lang ap kin wendi pan mot a.

verses.name: Mark 4:33
verses.text: I song en karaseras akan toto a kotiki ong irail ni a kawewe ong irail masan o duen ar weweki.

verses.name: Mark 4:34
verses.text: Sota a masan, ma so karaseras. Ni arail kelepala, a ap kotin kadede ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan meakan.

verses.name: Mark 4:35
verses.text: Ni ran ota, lao sautik penaer, a kotin masani ong irail: Kitail daulul wong palio!

verses.name: Mark 4:36
verses.text: Ari, ni ar kadar pasang pokon o, re kamasalada nin sop o. Pil akai kisin sop mi re a.

verses.name: Mark 4:37
verses.text: Melimel ap koda, iluk ap pungedi ong nan sop o kadirela.

verses.name: Mark 4:38
verses.text: A a kotikot nan murin sop o, saisaimok pon ulunga. Irail ap kaopada potoan ong i: Saunpadak, kom sota kupurai kit, pweki at pan mela?

verses.name: Mark 4:39
verses.text: I ari kotin kipada, angiangida melimel, o kotin masani ong sed o: Moledi! Ang ap dukedi o molela kaualap.

verses.name: Mark 4:40
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Da me komail masapwekeki? Iadue, sota omail poson?

verses.name: Mark 4:41
verses.text: Irail masapwekada kaualap, ap indada nan pung arail: Iaduen ol men et, me ang o sed peiki ong?<div eID="gen2644" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.4"/>

verses.name: Mark 5:1
verses.text: IRAIL ari kotela sed o koti dong nan wein Katara;

verses.name: Mark 5:2
verses.text: A lao kotidi sang nin sop, aramas me ngen saut ti poa, madang ap tang dong i sang nin sousou kan.

verses.name: Mark 5:3
verses.text: Pwe a kin kaukauson nin sousou kan, sota amen, me kak saliedi i, sal mata sota pil kak.

verses.name: Mark 5:4
verses.text: Pwe pan toto a salikidi sal en nä o sal mata, ari a kin kamueit pasang sal mata o sal en nä; sota amen me kak kamandala i.

verses.name: Mark 5:5
verses.text: Ansau karos, pong o ran, a kin mimi nan sousou kan o nana, weriwer o pein lokeki i takai.

verses.name: Mark 5:6
verses.text: A ni a kilang Iesus wasa doo, a ap tangalang dairukedi.

verses.name: Mark 5:7
verses.text: Weriwer laudeda indada: Menda re omui ngai Iesus, Sapwilim en Kot lapalap? I kaukilang komui Kot, komui ender kawairok ia!

verses.name: Mark 5:8
verses.text: Pwe a kotin masani ong i: Koti sang aramas en, ngen saut koe!

verses.name: Mark 5:9
verses.text: I ari kotin kainoma re a: Is ad om? A ap sapeng potoan ong i: Iet ad ai lekion, pwe kit me toto.

verses.name: Mark 5:10
verses.text: A ap poeki, ender kotin kaus ir ala nin sap o.

verses.name: Mark 5:11
verses.text: Ari, pwin pwik kalaimun eu mimi impan nana o, mangamanga sili.

verses.name: Mark 5:12
verses.text: Irail ap poekipoeki potoan ong: Re kotin kadar kit ala, pwe sen til ong nan pwik oko.

verses.name: Mark 5:13
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin mueid ong. Ngen saut akan ap koiei sang, ko ong nan pwik oko. Pwik oko ap tangedi wei ni aul ong nan sed ap mopila nan sed. Irail impan riakid.

verses.name: Mark 5:14
verses.text: Silepa kan ap tangdaui, kaireki sili nan kanim o nan sap; re ap koieila pwen kilang duen me wiaui;

verses.name: Mark 5:15
verses.text: Irail ari poto dong ren Iesus, kilang, me tanwar en tewil o a momod, o likauer, o lolekonglar; iei i me lekion mier re a. Re ap masapwekada,

verses.name: Mark 5:16
verses.text: Irail me kilanger ap indai ong irail duen me wiaui ong me tanwar en tewil o, o duen pwik akan.

verses.name: Mark 5:17
verses.text: Re ap poekipoeki, a en kotiwei sang sap arail.

verses.name: Mark 5:18
verses.text: Ni a koti dong nin sop o, me tanwar en tewil o poeki re a en iang i.

verses.name: Mark 5:19
verses.text: A i sota mueid ong i, ap masani ong i: Ko ong ni im om ren sau om, kaire kin ir duen manaman lapalap, me Kaun o wiai ong uk er o poke uk alar.

verses.name: Mark 5:20
verses.text: I ari kola, kaloki sili nan Dekapolis duen manaman lapalap, me Iesus kotin wiai ong i; irail karos ap puriamui kila.

verses.name: Mark 5:21
verses.text: Iesus lao pil kotela sed o ong palio, pokon kalaimun eu ap ko pena re a. A kotikot pon oror.

verses.name: Mark 5:22
verses.text: Ari, saumas en sinakoke amen, me ad a Iairus kotido. Ni a tu ong i, ap dairukedi sang.

verses.name: Mark 5:23
verses.text: Poekipoeki kaualap, potoan ong: Nai kisin seripein kis koren iong mela; i poeki, komui en kotido en pwil lim omui poa, pwen kelailada, ap pan maurela.

verses.name: Mark 5:24
verses.text: I ap kotin iangala, aramas toto ap idauenla, koi dong pena.

verses.name: Mark 5:25
verses.text: Li amen, me nta pwilipwil par ngaulriau.

verses.name: Mark 5:26
verses.text: O lokolokki me toto ren saunwini toto o kida a kapwa karos, ap sota katepe, pwe a totorela eta.

verses.name: Mark 5:27
verses.text: Ni a rongada duen Iesus, a ap dilongedo muri nan pokon o, o sair sapwilim a likau.

verses.name: Mark 5:28
verses.text: Pwe a inda: Ma i sair sapwilim a likau eta, i pan kelailada.

verses.name: Mark 5:29
verses.text: Ari, pwilipwil en nta madang matata. I ari pamada nan war a, me a kelada sanger somau o.

verses.name: Mark 5:30
verses.text: Iesus ap madang kotin kaanda, me roson kis ko sanger. A ap saupei dong pokon o masani: Is me sair ai likau?

verses.name: Mark 5:31
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan potoan ong: Komui masani, pokon et koi dong komui penaer; a komui masani: Is me sair ia?

verses.name: Mark 5:32
verses.text: I ari kotin aupwil sili, pwe a men masani, me wia me o.

verses.name: Mark 5:33
verses.text: Li o ari masapwekada, rerer, asaer me wiaui ong i ap potodo, dairukedi mo a, potoan ong duen melel en me wiaui o.

verses.name: Mark 5:34
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong i: Nai om poson me kakelail uk adar. Ukowei popol, o kelada sang om somau!

verses.name: Mark 5:35
verses.text: Ni a kotin mamasan, irail kodo sang ren saumas en sinakoke indada: Noum serepein o melar. Menda kom kangiri saunpadak en?

verses.name: Mark 5:36
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a angi kair o, ap masani ong saumas en sinokoke o: Kom der masak poson eta!

verses.name: Mark 5:37
verses.text: A ap sota kotin mueid ong meamen en idauenla i, Petrus eta, o Iakopus o Ioanes ri en Iakopus.

verses.name: Mark 5:38
verses.text: Irail koti dong ni im en saumas en sinakoke o, ap masani arail moromorong o mamaiei kaualap.

verses.name: Mark 5:39
verses.text: A ni a kotilong, a masani ong irail: Da me komail moromorongki o mamaukeki? Seri en sota melar, a mamair eta.

verses.name: Mark 5:40
verses.text: Re ap kakaurureki i. I ari kotikiiei sang irail karos, ap kotin ukada sam o in en seri o me iang i ko; a ap pedelong ong wasa, me seri o wonon ia;

verses.name: Mark 5:41
verses.text: I ari kotin ale pa en seri o masani ong i: Talita kumi! Iet wewe: Seripein i indai ong uk, paurida!

verses.name: Mark 5:42
verses.text: Seripein ap madang paurida, alu; pwe a saunpar eisokriau; irail ap malamalaua kila kaualap.

verses.name: Mark 5:43
verses.text: I ari kotin kalik irail edi, pwe meamen de asada, ap masani, kisin manga en ko ong.<div eID="gen2645" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.5"/>

verses.name: Mark 6:1
verses.text: A AP kotila sang wasa o, ap koti dong ni udan sap we, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan idauenla i.

verses.name: Mark 6:2
verses.text: Lao lel ran en sapat a kotin tapiada kawewe nan sinakoke; me toto, me rong puriamui kila, inda: Ia me lap en ale mepukat? O lolekong da eu, me mi re a, me a kak wiaki manaman pukat?

verses.name: Mark 6:3
verses.text: Kaidin i kapenta o, nain Maria, o ri en Iakopus, o Ioses, o Iudas, o Simon? A kaidin ri a li akan kin mi re atail? Re ap makar kida i.

verses.name: Mark 6:4
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Sota wasa, me saukop sota wau ia; nan sap we ta o ren sau i ko o toun im a.

verses.name: Mark 6:5
verses.text: A ap sota kak wia manaman eu wasa o, me somau kai ta, me a kotin pwil po ar lim a ko o kakelail ir ada.

verses.name: Mark 6:6
verses.text: I ari pone kida ar soposon, ap kotin paang sili kanim akan, kaukawewe.

verses.name: Mark 6:7
verses.text: A ap kotin molipe dong re a ekriamen oko, o kotin kadar ir pasang riamen me eu o kotiki ong irail manaman, en poedi ngen saut akan.

verses.name: Mark 6:8
verses.text: Ap masani ong irail, re depa wa meakot ni ar koko sili, sokon eta pot; iermen ed, de prot, pil sota moni nan ed.

verses.name: Mark 6:9
verses.text: A re ko ong eta nan sut, o der mi nan sakit riau.

verses.name: Mark 6:10
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Wasa kis, me komail pedelong onger ni im eu, komail mimieta, komail lao kowei sang wasa o.

verses.name: Mark 6:11
verses.text: A wasa eu, me kang kasamo o rong komail, komail sipede sang pwel ni nä omail, ni omail ko sang, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 6:12
verses.text: Irail ap kola o padapadaki me ren kalula.

verses.name: Mark 6:13
verses.text: Re pil kause sang tewil toto o keie me somau toto, kakela ir ada.

verses.name: Mark 6:14
verses.text: Erodes nanmarki mangiada pwe mar a indandsili, a ap masani: Iei Ioanes saunpaptais o, me mauredar sang ren me melar akan; iei i me a wia manaman pukat.

verses.name: Mark 6:15
verses.text: Akai inda, me i Elias; a akai, me i saukop amen de amen me due saukop akan.

verses.name: Mark 6:16
verses.text: Ni en Erodes mangiada, a ap masani: Ioanes, me i lepuke sang mong a; ari, a mauredar.

verses.name: Mark 6:17
verses.text: Pwe pein Erodes me poron wong, saikidi Ioanes, o saliedi ong nan imateng pweki Erodias, en ri a ol Pilip a paud, pwe a id paude kida i.

verses.name: Mark 6:18
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes me kapung ong Erodes: Me sota pung omui atia sang en ri omui ol a paud!

verses.name: Mark 6:19
verses.text: Iei, me Erodias kailong kila i, ap men kamela i; ari, a sota kak.

verses.name: Mark 6:20
verses.text: Pwe Erodes laan Ioanes, pwe a asa, me i ol pung o saraui amen, i ari tataakata i, ap peiki ong o mamangi pereneki.

verses.name: Mark 6:21
verses.text: Ari ran mau eu, ran en Erodes a ipwidi, a ap kotin kamadipa a saupedi ko, o a saumas oko, o na me lapalap en wein Kaliläa kan.

verses.name: Mark 6:22
verses.text: Ari, nain Erodias seripein ap kodo kakalek, kamakamait Erodes o me momod re a ko ni tepel. Nanmarki ap masani ong seripein o: Poeki re i meakot, me koe mauki; i pan ki ong uk.

verses.name: Mark 6:23
verses.text: I ari kotin kaula: Meakot koe poeki re i, i pan ki ong uk, lao lel apali en ai wei.

verses.name: Mark 6:24
verses.text: A ap pedoi wei indang in a: Da me i pan poeki? I ari inda: Monga en Ioanes saunpaptais o.

verses.name: Mark 6:25
verses.text: I ari puredo, madang dong ren nanmarki o, poeki, inda: I men, komui en madang kotikido monga en Ioanes saunpaptais nan eu dal en!

verses.name: Mark 6:26
verses.text: Nanmarki ap topwaila kaualap, a pweki a kotin kaula o pweki ir, me iang i ni tepel ko a sota men kapapalawei.

verses.name: Mark 6:27
verses.text: Nanmarki o ap madang poronela saunpei amen, masani, monga en wisikedo.

verses.name: Mark 6:28
verses.text: A ap kola, lepuke sang monga nan imateng, ap wa kodo monga o nan dal eu ap ki ong seripein o; seripein o ap kiong in a.

verses.name: Mark 6:29
verses.text: A tounpadak kan lao rongadar, re ap kodo ale kalep a, nekidala nan sousou o.

verses.name: Mark 6:30
verses.text: Wanporon oko kapokon irail pena ren Iesus, potoan ong i meakaros, me re wia o me re kawewedar.

verses.name: Mark 6:31
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail kelepe dong sap tan; kamol mas. Pwe me toto purepure ir; irail ari sota pisokki ong manga.

verses.name: Mark 6:32
verses.text: Re ap takeda sop kelep kolang sap tan.

verses.name: Mark 6:33
verses.text: A me toto kilang ar masalwei; me toto asa irail. Ir ari sapal sang kanim karos audi mo a ap pokon pena re a.

verses.name: Mark 6:34
verses.text: A Iesus lao keredi sang nan sop o, ap masani aramas toto, ap kupura ir ala; pwe likamata irail sip, me sota sile parail. A ap kotin tapiada kawewe ong irail me toto.

verses.name: Mark 6:35
verses.text: Wasa lao sautik penaer, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap poto dong re a, potoan ong: Sap tan eu met, ap wasa sautiker;

verses.name: Mark 6:36
verses.text: Re kotin kadar ir pasang; pwe re en paangewei sap koren kan o kisin kanim akan o pein netiada kan ar prot, pwe sota man ar tungole meakot.

verses.name: Mark 6:37
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail katungole ir! Re ap potoan ong i: Se en kola en netiada prot me denar riepuki, ap ki ong irail ren tungole?

verses.name: Mark 6:38
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Lopon en prot depa mi re omail? Kowei kalelapok! Re lao kalelepok, rap potoan: Me limau o mam riamen.

verses.name: Mark 6:39
verses.text: A masani ong irail, re en wia pwini ir pasang, kamodang ir di ong nan rä.

verses.name: Mark 6:40
verses.text: Re ap mondi ni pwin akai; wad epuki o limek ni pwin ko.

verses.name: Mark 6:41
verses.text: A ap kotikidar lopon en prot limau o mam riamen masandang nanlang laolaoki pwilitiki pasang o ari, kotiki ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, pwe re en nek ong irail. O mam riamen oko pil nene ong irail karos.

verses.name: Mark 6:42
verses.text: Irail karos ari mangaer o medier.

verses.name: Mark 6:43
verses.text: Rap deuk pena kopou eisokriau maremor en kamadip o luan mam oko.

verses.name: Mark 6:44
verses.text: Irail me tungoler prot oko me ol limekid.

verses.name: Mark 6:45
verses.text: I ari kotin madang pain sapwilim a tounpadak kan, irail en ko ong nin sop o, tiong wong Petsaida palio, pwe a pan kotin kadar pasang pokon o.

verses.name: Mark 6:46
verses.text: A lao kotin kadar ir pasang, a ap kotidalang nan nana eu, pwen laolao.

verses.name: Mark 6:47
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer, sop o mi nan ailep en sed. A a kotin kalakalapuk nan sap.

verses.name: Mark 6:48
verses.text: I ari masani arail wiawia roro, pwe me ang matong irail. A nin soran a koti dong irail, weid pon sed, a pan dauli ir wei.

verses.name: Mark 6:49
verses.text: Ari, ni arail kilang a kotin weweid pon sed, re kiki ong, me ani amen. Re ap weriwer.

verses.name: Mark 6:50
verses.text: Pwe irail karos kilang i, ap masapwekada i ari madang masani ong irail, masani: Komail perenda! Ngai met! Der masak!

verses.name: Mark 6:51
verses.text: I ari keredang pon sop o, ap moledi. Re ap puriamui kila kaualap o ponepone kida.

verses.name: Mark 6:52
verses.text: Pwe re sota lamelame prot oko; pwe mongiong arail kakaluakalar.

verses.name: Mark 6:53
verses.text: Irail lao kotido, re ap inen dong wein Kenesaret, ap kai ong liman sap o.

verses.name: Mark 6:54
verses.text: Irail lao keredi sang nan sop o, re ap madang asada i.

verses.name: Mark 6:55
verses.text: Re ap tang pasang wasa karos tapiada wa dong i me somau pon ro ’rail wasa re rong, me a kot ia.

verses.name: Mark 6:56
verses.text: O wasa, me a kot ia, kisin kanim laud akan de sap, re kin pwilikidi nani al akan me somau kan, ap poekipoeki, pwe re en sair kailan sapwilim a likau ta. Ari, me doke ko karos ap kelailada.<div eID="gen2646" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.6"/>

verses.name: Mark 7:1
verses.text: PARISÄR akan o saunkawewe kai ap pokon dong re a, me kodo sang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Mark 7:2
verses.text: Ni ar kilang sapwilim a tounpadak kai kang proteki pa samin, so omiom,

verses.name: Mark 7:3
verses.text: Pwe Parisär o Sus akan sota kin manga, ma re so omiom mas; pwe re wiawia padok en men kaua ko.

verses.name: Mark 7:4
verses.text: O ni ar kin puredo sang wasan net, re sota kin manga, ma re so omiom mas o tiak toto, me re aledi, re kin wiawia: Widen dal tikitik, dal laud, dal pras, o men momod.

verses.name: Mark 7:5
verses.text: Parisär o saunkawewe ko ap kalelapok re a: Da me sapwilim omui tounpadak kan sota wiaki padok en men kaua kan? A re mangata prot so omiom?

verses.name: Mark 7:6
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Melel eta en Iesaias a kopadar, me komail malaun akan, iduen a intingidi: Aramas pukat kin kaka kin ia au arail a mongiong arail me doo sang ia.

verses.name: Mark 7:7
verses.text: Ari, me mal ar kaudok ia, pwe kusoned en aramas eta, me re kin kaukawewe.

verses.name: Mark 7:8
verses.text: Pwe komail kin kasela kusoned en Kot, ap id wiawia padok en aramas; iet widen dal laud o tikitik ape; o pil akai, me komail kin wiawia.

verses.name: Mark 7:9
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong ir, melel me komail kasela kusoned en Kot, pwe komail en apwaliela pein omail padok.

verses.name: Mark 7:10
verses.text: Pwe Moses masani: Kakaki sam om o in om; o meamen me lalaue sam a de in a en kamela!

verses.name: Mark 7:11
verses.text: A komail kin inda, ma aramas amen indai ong sam de in a: Korpan (iet wewe: Mairong eu), me koe men aneki sang ia, komail inda, me sota dip a.

verses.name: Mark 7:12
verses.text: Komail ari sola mueid ong i, en wiai ong sam a de in a meakot.

verses.name: Mark 7:13
verses.text: Ap kawe kila masan en Kot omail padok, me komail pein wiada. O pil me toto me due met, me komail kin wiawia.

verses.name: Mark 7:14
verses.text: Ni a kotin molipe pena pokon o re a, a kotin masani ong irail: Komail karos rong ia o weweki!

verses.name: Mark 7:15
verses.text: Sota meakot men likin aramas, me pan ko ong lole, kasaminela i. A meakan, me koda sang lole, iei eta, me kin kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Mark 7:16
verses.text: Meamen me salong a mia men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Mark 7:17
verses.text: Ni a kotilong ong nan im eu sang ren aramas oko, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kalelapok re a duen karaseras o.

verses.name: Mark 7:18
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Da, komail me pil so lolekong? Komail sota dedeki, me meakot men likin aramas kin ko ong lole, sota kak kasaminela?

verses.name: Mark 7:19
verses.text: Pwe a sota ko ong nan mongiong; pwe nan kaped eta, ap pidok wei sang, koko sang meakaros?

verses.name: Mark 7:20
verses.text: A ap kotin masani: Meakan me koda sang lol en aramas, iei me kin kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Mark 7:21
verses.text: Pwe sang lol en aramas, sang nan mongiong, lamelam sued kin tapida sang ia: Kamal, nenek, kamela aramas.

verses.name: Mark 7:22
verses.text: Pirap, norok, sarsued, widing, sengo, poosued, lalaue, lemai, soukoti.

verses.name: Mark 7:23
verses.text: Mesued pukat karos tapida sang lole, ap kasaminela aramas.

verses.name: Mark 7:24
verses.text: I ari kotila sang wasa o, kotilang wein Tirus o Sidon, a lao kotilong ong nan im eu, ap sota men, aramas en asa i. Ari, a sota kak rirala.

verses.name: Mark 7:25
verses.text: Pwe li amen, me na seripein ngen saut ti poa, madang rongada i, ap kodo dairukedi ong ni aluwilu a.

verses.name: Mark 7:26
