verses.text: Li en Krik amen, kisan sap en Siro-Penisia, potoan ong, poekipoeki re a, en kausa sang na seripein tewil o.

verses.name: Mark 7:27
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Seri ko pan med mas. Pwe a sota mau, ale en seri ar tungol prot, ap kasedi ong ren kiti.

verses.name: Mark 7:28
verses.text: A ap sapeng potoan ong i: Melel Maing! Ari, kiti kin tungole maremor en seri ar tungol prot pan tepel.

verses.name: Mark 7:29
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong i: Pweki om lokaia en, kowei! Tewil o ko sanger ren noum serepein o!

verses.name: Mark 7:30
verses.text: Ari, a kolang im a, a ap diarada, me tewil o ko sanger, o na seripein wonon nan deu a.

verses.name: Mark 7:31
verses.text: A lao pil kotin purela sang wein Tirus o Sidon ap koti dong ni le en Kaliläa, weidedo nan wein Dekapolis.

verses.name: Mark 7:32
verses.text: Re ap wa dong i salongepon amen, me lotong; irail ari poeki re a, en kotin pwil poa lim a.

verses.name: Mark 7:33
verses.text: I ari kotin ukala sang i ni pokon o, ap kilong ong sondin lim a nan salong a o likidi sair lo a.

verses.name: Mark 7:34
verses.text: A ap masandang nanlang, asmamarada, masani ong i: Epata! (iet wewe: Wasok pasang).

verses.name: Mark 7:35
verses.text: Salong a ap madang wasok pasang o sal en lo a lapwada. A ap lokaia mau.

verses.name: Mark 7:36
verses.text: I ari kalik irail edi re depa indai ong meamen. A kainapwi irail; ari, re ap kalaudela ar kaloki sili.

verses.name: Mark 7:37
verses.text: Re puriamui kila kaualap, inda: Me mau, me a wia dar kan! Pwe a kakarongada me salongepon, ap kalokaiada, me lotong.<div eID="gen2647" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.7"/>

verses.name: Mark 8:1
verses.text: NI ran oko pil pokon kalaimunia mia, ap sota me re tungole; a ap kotin molipedo sapwilim a tounpadak kan, masani ong irail:

verses.name: Mark 8:2
verses.text: I pokela pokon et, pwe re ieiang ia ran silu, ap sota ar tungol.

verses.name: Mark 8:3
verses.text: O ma I kadar ir wong ni im ar dupok, re pan lipongmas nani al, pwe akai ir kodo sang wasa doo.

verses.name: Mark 8:4
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap sapeng potoan ong i: Ia wasa, me amen pan kak ki sang ia prot, men kamedela pokon et nan sap tan et?

verses.name: Mark 8:5
verses.text: A ap kotin kainoma re irail: Prot depa mi re omail? Re ap sapeng potoan ong: Me isu.

verses.name: Mark 8:6
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong pokon o, en mondi ong nan pwel, ap kotikida lopon en prot isu, laolaoki, pilitiki pasang o ari, ap kotiki ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, pwe ren nek. Irail ari nek ong pokon o.

verses.name: Mark 8:7
verses.text: Kisin mam kai pil mia, i ari laolaoki o masani, ren pil neki ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 8:8
verses.text: Irail ari manga o medier. Irail ap deuk pena kopou en maremor isu luan kamadip,

verses.name: Mark 8:9
verses.text: Me mangaer me koren iong pakid. A ap kotin kadar ir pasang.

verses.name: Mark 8:10
verses.text: Io sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap madang kotidang pon sop pot, kotelang nan wein Dalmanuta.

verses.name: Mark 8:11
verses.text: Parisär akai ap kodo, tapiada akamai ong i, men kilang re a kilel sang nanlang, pwe re kasongesong i.

verses.name: Mark 8:12
verses.text: A ap kotin kaangangala nan ngen i, masani: Menda di wet ngongki kilel eu? Melel I indai ong komail: Sota kilel eu pan ko ong di wet.

verses.name: Mark 8:13
verses.text: I ari kotila sang irail, pil pur ong nin sop o, kotilang palio.

verses.name: Mark 8:14
verses.text: Irail ap monokela prot oko, men kapinwar arail, lopon prot ta ieu mimi re rail nin sop o.

verses.name: Mark 8:15
verses.text: I ari kapung ong irail masani: Kalaka en Parisär ko ar kalap o en Erodes a kalap.

verses.name: Mark 8:16
verses.text: Irail ap lamelame nan pung arail: Sota atail prot oko.

verses.name: Mark 8:17
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a kotin mangiada, a masani ong irail: Da me komail toutouki a sota kan omail prot? Komail saikenta dedekila o weweki? Mongiong omail kapikapitakaita?

verses.name: Mark 8:18
verses.text: Mas omail mia, ap sota kilang; salong omail mia, ap sota rong. O komail sota tamataman,

verses.name: Mark 8:19
verses.text: Ni ai pilingong me limekid lopon en prot limau o, kopou en maremor depa, me komail deukada? Re ap potoan ong i: Me eisokriau.

verses.name: Mark 8:20
verses.text: O isu nan pung en me pakid, kopou en maremor depa, me komail deukada? Re ap potoan: Me isu.

verses.name: Mark 8:21
verses.text: A ap kotin kainoma re ’rail: A da me komail sota dedeki?

verses.name: Mark 8:22
verses.text: A ap koti dong Petsaida. Re ap wa dong i maskun amen, poekipoeki en sair i.

verses.name: Mark 8:23
verses.text: A ap kotin ale pa en me maskun o kaluala sang ni kisin kanim o; A ap likidi ong ni mas a o pwil poa lim a ko ap kainoma re a, ma a kilangada wasa de so?

verses.name: Mark 8:24
verses.text: I ari sarada potoan: I kilang aramas akan likamada tuka kai, me alialu sili.

verses.name: Mark 8:25
verses.text: A pil pwil pon mas a lim a ko, ap kasaradakeda. I ari kelailada ap kilangada mau.

verses.name: Mark 8:26
verses.text: A ap kotin kadaralang nin im a masani: Koe depa pur wong ni kisin kanim o, o pil depa indai ong meamen nin kanim o!

verses.name: Mark 8:27
verses.text: Iesus i sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kotieila nan kanim en Säsarea Pilipi ko. Ari, ni a kotikot kowei, ap kotin kainoma ren sapwilim a tounpadak kan masani ong irail: Is me aramas inda me ngai?

verses.name: Mark 8:28
verses.text: Irail sapeng i potoan ong: Ioanes saunpaptais; a akai inda, me Elias; a akai, me amen sang ren saukop akan.

verses.name: Mark 8:29
verses.text: A ap kotin kainoma re irail: A komail, is me komail kin inda me ngai? Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong i: Komui Kristus!

verses.name: Mark 8:30
verses.text: I ari kotin kalik irail edi, re depa indai ong meamen i.

verses.name: Mark 8:31
verses.text: A ap kotin tapiada kawewe kin irail, me Nain aramas en kalokolok toto o sokonekonla pan saumas akan, o samero lapalap akan, o saunkawewe kan, o pan kamela, ap pan maureda murin ran silu.

verses.name: Mark 8:32
verses.text: Masan wet a kotin masani sansal. Petrus ap ukada i tapiada kapung ong i.

verses.name: Mark 8:33
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin saupeido aupwil sili pon sapwilim a tounpadak kan, kapung ong Petrus masani: Kola muri, Satan! Pwe om lamelam kaidin en Kot, a en aramas.

verses.name: Mark 8:34
verses.text: A kotin molipedo pokon o sapwilim a tounpadak kan, a masani ong irail: Meamen pan idauen ia, en tounmeteki pein i, ap wada a lopu, idauen ia.

verses.name: Mark 8:35
verses.text: Pwe meamen kanakanai maur i, pan pupe sang. A meamen kasela maur i pweki ngai o rongamau, pan dorela i.

verses.name: Mark 8:36
verses.text: Pwe da me katepan aramas a aneki sappa u, ap kasela maur?

verses.name: Mark 8:37
verses.text: O da me aramas pan wiliankida maur i?

verses.name: Mark 8:38
verses.text: Pwe meamen namenok kin ia o ai padak kan nan pung en di en kamal o sued wed, i me Nain aramas pil pan ailaki, ni a pan kodo ni lingan en Sam a iang tounlang saraui kan.<div eID="gen2648" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.8"/>

verses.name: Mark 9:1
verses.text: A AP kotin masani ong irail: Melel I indai ong komail: Akai me iang mi met, sota pan mela, lao kilang wein Kot a kokido manaman.

verses.name: Mark 9:2
verses.text: Murin pong wonu pong Iesus ap kotin ukada Petrus o Iakopus o Ioanes kalua ir dalang pon nana ileile eu, ir kalapuk. I ari kotin wukila mo ’rail.

verses.name: Mark 9:3
verses.text: Sapwilim a likau ko lingalingala, puetepueteta sno. Sota saunlopolop nan sappa kak kapuetepuetetala dueta.

verses.name: Mark 9:4
verses.text: Elias i Moses ap pwara dong ir, ari, ira o Iesus ap mamasan pena.

verses.name: Mark 9:5
verses.text: Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong Iesus: Rapi, me mau ong kitail en kotikot met. Kitail en kauada kisin im silikis: Tanpas ar, o en Moses o en Elias.

verses.name: Mark 9:6
verses.text: Pwe a sasa, da me a pan inda, pwe re masapwekada.

verses.name: Mark 9:7
verses.text: Pali en dapok pali ap kadupwal irail edi; o ngil eu peidido sang nan dapok o: I met nai. Ol kompok! Komail rong i!

verses.name: Mark 9:8
verses.text: Ari, re saliokeda, solar amen me re kilang, Iesus ta, me kotikot re ’rail.

verses.name: Mark 9:9
verses.text: Ari, ni arail kotikot kotido sang nin nana o, a kotin kalik irail edi, re depa indai ong meamen, me re kilang ko, lao Nain aramas mauredar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Mark 9:10
verses.text: Re ap edie pena masan pot et nan pung ar, ap peipeidokki pena, da wewe en maureda sang ren me melar akan?

verses.name: Mark 9:11
verses.text: Irail ap peidok re a potoan ong: Da me saunkawewe kan indaki, Elias pan pwarado mas?

verses.name: Mark 9:12
verses.text: I ari kotin sapeng, masani ong irail: Melel Elias kodo mas, kamauiada meakan. O iaduen intingidi duen Nain aramas? Me pan kolokolok toto o sokonekon.

verses.name: Mark 9:13
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, Elias pwarer, o re wiai ong i, me re mauki duen a intingidi due.

verses.name: Mark 9:14
verses.text: A lao koti dong tounpadak kan, a masani pokon kalaimunia eu kapil ir pena o saunkawewe kan peipeidok re irail.

verses.name: Mark 9:15
verses.text: Ni ar kilangadar i, pokon o ap puriamuiki la tangado ranamau ong i.

verses.name: Mark 9:16
verses.text: A ap kotin kainoma re irail: Peidok da kai, me komail idedok re ’rail?

verses.name: Mark 9:17
verses.text: Amen toun pokon o sapeng i potoan ong: Saunpadak, i potoan dong komui nai putak o, me ngen lotong mi poa.

verses.name: Mark 9:18
verses.text: Ari, wasa karos me a kin tiada poa, a kin kapururada; a ap kin pudopud o katekatete ngi o tongetongela. I potoan ong sapwilim omui tounpadak kan, pwe re en kausa sang i, ari, re sota kak.

verses.name: Mark 9:19
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng irail masani: Di wet meid soposon. Ia arain ai pan mimi re omail, ia arain ai pan kokoa komail? Wa dong ia i!

verses.name: Mark 9:20
verses.text: Irail ap poto dong i. Ni a kotin masani i, ngen o ap madang kupururada i; a ap pupedi ong nan pwel, wia pudopud taputapur sili.

verses.name: Mark 9:21
verses.text: A ap kainoma ren sam a: Ia arain me kot et a lel? A ap potoan ong: Sang ni a seri.

verses.name: Mark 9:22
verses.text: Pan me toto a kin kasedi ong i nan iai o nan pil, pwen kamela i. Ari, ma re kotin kak ong, re kotin kupura kit ala sauasa kit!

verses.name: Mark 9:23
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Ma koe me poson; meakaros me kak ren me poson.

verses.name: Mark 9:24
verses.text: Madang sam en kisin seri ap weriwer, sangesang, potoan: Maing, i poson. Kom kotin katinaiada sang ai soposon.

verses.name: Mark 9:25
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a kotin masani ar tangetang pena, a ap angiangiada ngen saut o kotin masani ong ngen lotong o salongepon: I indai ong uk, koieido sang lole! Koe depa pure wong i!

verses.name: Mark 9:26
verses.text: A ap weriwer, kapururada kaualap, ap koiei sang. I ari likamata a melar. Akai ap inda, a melar.

verses.name: Mark 9:27
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin ale pa a kauada, i ari uda.

verses.name: Mark 9:28
verses.text: Ni a koti dong ni im o, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap okiok peidok re a potoan ong: Da me se sota kak kauseki sang?

verses.name: Mark 9:29
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Song wet sota kin koki sang meakot kapakap o kaisesol eta.

verses.name: Mark 9:30
verses.text: Re ap kotila sang wasa o, weidala nan Kaliläa. A sota men, meamen en asa.

verses.name: Mark 9:31
verses.text: Pwe a men kotin kawewe ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap masani ong irail: Nain aramas pan pangalang ni pa en aramas. Irail pan kamela i a murin a kamela a pan maureda murin ran kasilu.

verses.name: Mark 9:32
verses.text: A irail sota dedeki masan o; a re masak kalelapok re a.

verses.name: Mark 9:33
verses.text: A ap koti dong Kapernaum; ni a kotikot nan im o a ap kotin kainoma re ’rail: Da me komail akakamaiki nani al o?

verses.name: Mark 9:34
verses.text: Irail ari nenenla, pwe re akamaiki nani al o, is me pan laud re ’rail.

verses.name: Mark 9:35
verses.text: I ari kotidi, molipedo ekriamen oko, ap masani ong irail: Meamen men moa, a en mi muri o papa ong karos.

verses.name: Mark 9:36
verses.text: I ari kotin ale kisin seri amen, kotikidi ong nan pung arail: A lau palodi i ap masani ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 9:37
verses.text: Meamen me apwali amen sang ren kisin seri pukat ni ad ai, a pil apwali ia. A me apwali ia, kaidik ngai, me a apwali, a me kadar ia do.

verses.name: Mark 9:38
verses.text: Ioanes ap sapeng i, potoang ong: Saunpadak, se kilang amen, me kakaus tewil akan ni mar omui, a ap sota kin iang kit. Kit ari inapwiedi, pweki a kaidin kis at.

verses.name: Mark 9:39
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Der inapwiedi! Pwe meamen me wia manaman ni ad ai, sota pan kak en lalaue ia.

verses.name: Mark 9:40
verses.text: Pwe meamen sota u ong kitail, i kisan atail pali.

verses.name: Mark 9:41
verses.text: Pwe meamen, me pan ki ong komail dal en pil eu ni ad ai, pweki omail kisan Kristus, melel I indai ong komail, kating i sota pan salonga sang.

verses.name: Mark 9:42
verses.text: O meamen, me kamakar amen ir me tikitik, me poson ia, a mau ong takai en ir plaua eu en paudoki ong ni tapin wor a; a ap lokidokila nan madau.

verses.name: Mark 9:43
verses.text: Ma apali en pa om kamakar uk, lepuke sang! A mau ong uk, ko ong maur, ni om dangidang sang om pa pokon mia, ap ko ong nan pweleko, nan kisiniai sokun.

verses.name: Mark 9:44
verses.text: Wasa ar muas sota kin mela o kisiniei sota kin kunla.

verses.name: Mark 9:45
verses.text: O ma apali en nä om kamakar uk, lepuka sang! A mau ong uk, ko ong maur ni om sikilikil sang om pat en nä pokon mia, ap lokidokila nan pweleko, nan kisiniai sokun.

verses.name: Mark 9:46
verses.text: Wasa ar muas sota kin mela o kisiniai sota kin kunla.

verses.name: Mark 9:47
verses.text: Ma apali mas om kamakar uk, kapida sang! Me mau ong uk, mas pali pedelong ong nan wein Kot sang mas unsok lokidokila nan kisiniai en pweleko.

verses.name: Mark 9:48
verses.text: Wasa ar muas sota kin mela, o kisiniai sota kin kunla.

verses.name: Mark 9:49
verses.text: Pwe amen amen pan soleki kisiniai, dueta mairong karos kin soleki sol.

verses.name: Mark 9:50
verses.text: Me mau sol. A ma sola nam en sol, nam a pan ko sang ia? Sol en mi re omail o komail popol pena!<div eID="gen2649" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.9"/>

verses.name: Mark 10:1
verses.text: IESUS ap kotila sang wasa o, koti dong wein Iudäa, palila sang Iordan. Aramas ap pil pokon dong re a. A ap pil pur ong padak kin ir, due me a kin wiawia.

verses.name: Mark 10:2
verses.text: Parisär kai ap kodo peipeidok re a: Me pung, ol en muei sang a paud? Irail ari kasongesong i.

verses.name: Mark 10:3
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Da me Moses masani ong komail?

verses.name: Mark 10:4
verses.text: Re ap sapeng: Moses mueideda kisin likau en kamueit en wiaui, ap muei sang.

verses.name: Mark 10:5
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Pweki omail kapitakai, me a intingie kida kusoned wet.

verses.name: Mark 10:6
verses.text: A nin tapin sappa a wiauiata: Kot a kotin wia ira da ol o li.

verses.name: Mark 10:7
verses.text: I me aramas amen pan pededi sam a in a, pat ong eta a paud.

verses.name: Mark 10:8
verses.text: Ira ari pan uduk eta eu, ira soer riamen, a uduk eta eu.

verses.name: Mark 10:9
verses.text: Ari, meakot Kot kapad penaer, aramas der kamueit pasang!

verses.name: Mark 10:10
verses.text: Nan im o sapwilim a tounpadak kan pur ong kalelapok re a due.

verses.name: Mark 10:11
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong irail: Meamen, me muei sang a paud li, ap ale amen, a kamal i.

verses.name: Mark 10:12
verses.text: O ma li amen muei sang a paud, ap ale amen, a kin kamal.

verses.name: Mark 10:13
verses.text: Re ap poto dong re a kisin seri kai, pwen kotin sair ir. Tounpadak kan ap kapoui irail me wado ko.

verses.name: Mark 10:14
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a kotin masani, a ap kotin suede kida, ap masani ong irail: Mueid ong kisin seri akan, en ko dong re i. Der kalik irail edi! Pwe iei song en, me udan wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 10:15
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, meamen, me sota ale wein Kot rasong kisin seri men, a sota pan pedelong ong lole.

verses.name: Mark 10:16
verses.text: A kotin palo irail edi, pwil po ’rail lim a ko, kapai irail ada.

verses.name: Mark 10:17
verses.text: Ni a kotiieilang nani al o, meamen ap tang dong i, kelepukedi, kalelapok re a: Saunpadak mau, da me i en wia, pwe i en soki maur soutuk?

verses.name: Mark 10:18
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Da me koe indaki, me I mau? Sota meamen me mau, Kot eta.

verses.name: Mark 10:19
verses.text: Koe kin asa kusoned akan: Koe der kamal! Koe der kamela! Koe der pirap! Koe der kinakine mal! Koe der morsued! Wauneki sam om o in om!

verses.name: Mark 10:20
verses.text: A ap sapeng potoan ong i: Saunpadak, mepukat i kin wiawiada sang ni ai tikitik kokodo.

verses.name: Mark 10:21
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin mamasani i o kupura, ap masani ong i: Me takis me lua, kowei, netikila meakaros, me koe aneki, ki ong me samama kan; om pai ap pan mi nanlang; ap kodo, ale om lopu idauen ia!

verses.name: Mark 10:22
verses.text: I ari patau kila masan pot et, kokola insensued, pwe a kapwa me toto.

verses.name: Mark 10:23
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin aupwili sili, ap masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Meid apwal ong me kapwapwa, en pedelong ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 10:24
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap puriamui kila a masan oko. Iesus ap pil kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Seri ko! Meid apwal ong irail, me keleki kapwa, en pedelong ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 10:25
verses.text: Me mangai ong kamel en tilong nan por en dikok, sang me kapwapwa en ko ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 10:26
verses.text: Irail ari waponda kaualap, indinda nan pung arail: A is me kak kamaurela?

verses.name: Mark 10:27
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin mamasani wong irail masani: A so kak pan aramas, a kaidin pan Kot; pwe ren Kot meakaros me kak.

verses.name: Mark 10:28
verses.text: Petrus ap tapiada potoan ong: Re masani, se likidmaliela meakaros, ap idedauen komui sili.

verses.name: Mark 10:29
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani! Melel I indai ong komail: Sota meamen, me likidmaliela im, de ri a ol, de li akan, de sam, de in, de a paud, de seri ko, de sap pweki ngai o rongamau,

verses.name: Mark 10:30
verses.text: Me so pan id aneki pan me epuki ansau wet im, o ri a ol, o li akan, o nono, o seriko, o sap, iangaki kamekam, o maur soutuk nan muei kokodo.

verses.name: Mark 10:31
verses.text: A me toto men moa, pan men murla, o men mur pan moala.

verses.name: Mark 10:32
verses.text: Ni arail kotikot kodalang Ierusalem, Iesus me kotin tiong mo ’rail; a irail puriamui kila, idedauen wapon. A ap kotin ale ekriamen oko, ap kotin tapiada masani ong irail, me pan wiaui ong i ko:

verses.name: Mark 10:33
verses.text: Kilang, kitail kodalang Ierusalem. Nain aramas pan pangalang samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan; re ap pan kadeikada, en kamela, ap id kilang ren me kisan men liki kan.

verses.name: Mark 10:34
verses.text: Re ap pan kapikapit i, o woki, o kondipi, o kamela. A ap pan maureda murin ran silu.

verses.name: Mark 10:35
verses.text: Iakopus i Ioanes nain Sepedäus akan potodo, potoan ong i: Saunpadak, se men, komui en kotin wiai ong kit meakot, me se mauki.

verses.name: Mark 10:36
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong ira: Da me koma mauki, I en wiai ong koma?

verses.name: Mark 10:37
verses.text: Ira ap potoan ong i: Re kotin mueid ong kit, amen kit en mod pali maun omui, a amen pali maing nan omui lingan.

verses.name: Mark 10:38
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong ira: Koma sasa, me koma poekipoeki en. Koma pan kak nim dal, me I nim, de paptaiseki paptais me I paptaiseki?

verses.name: Mark 10:39
verses.text: Ira ap potoan ong i: Se kak. Iesus ap kotin masani ong ira: Ei, koma pan nim dal me I nim, o paptaiseki paptais, me I paptaiseki.

verses.name: Mark 10:40
verses.text: A mod pali maun i o pali maing i, I sota kak mueid ong; pwe ong irail eta, me a onop ong.

verses.name: Mark 10:41
verses.text: Ni en ek oko ar rongada, re ap suedekida Iakopus i Ioanes.

verses.name: Mark 10:42
verses.text: Iesus lao molipe ir do, ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail asa duen saupeidi en wei pokon ar kin poe irail edi o ar saumas akan kin manaman ong ir.

verses.name: Mark 10:43
verses.text: Ari, due met sota pan wiaui nan pung omail. A me men laud nan pung omail, a en omail papa.

verses.name: Mark 10:44
verses.text: Meamen re omail, me men saumas, en ladu en karusia.

verses.name: Mark 10:45
verses.text: Pwe pil Nain aramas sota kotido, pwe en papa i, a pwen papa ong irail, kida maur i wiliandi me toto.

verses.name: Mark 10:46
verses.text: Irail ap ko dong Ieriko. Ari, ni i o sapwilim a tounpadak kan o pokon kalaimun kotiiei sang Ieriko, Partimäus maskun, nain Timäus, momod liman al o, wia poekipoek.

verses.name: Mark 10:47
verses.text: A ni a rongada, me iei Iesus en Nasaret, a ap weriwer indada: Iesus, sapwilim en Dawid, kupura ia!

verses.name: Mark 10:48
verses.text: Me toto ap kidaue, pwen nenenla. Ari, a ap kalaudela a weriwer: Sapwilim en Dawid kupura ia!

verses.name: Mark 10:49
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin udi, masani en peekek kodo. Ir ari ekeredo ol maskun o indai ong i: Insenemau, uda! A kotin molipe uk!

verses.name: Mark 10:50
verses.text: I ari kasela a likau madang uda ap poto dong Iesus.

verses.name: Mark 10:51
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong i: Da me koe mauki, I en wiai ong uk? Me maskun o ap potoan ong: Rapuni, i men potoan kilang wasa.

verses.name: Mark 10:52
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Ukewei! Om poson me kakelail uk ada. I ari madang kilangada wasa, ap idauen la Iesus.<div eID="gen2650" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.10"/>

verses.name: Mark 11:1
verses.text: NI arail koren iong Ierusalem, kokolang Petpake o Petanien impan dol Oliwe, a ap kotin poronela sapwilim a tounpadak riamen.

verses.name: Mark 11:2
verses.text: Masani ong ira: Koma ko ong nan kisin kanim en, me palilan komail. Ari, ni oma pedelong ong lole, koma pan madang diar esel pul amen a sansal, me aramas amen kaikenta dake. Lapwada i o kaluado met!

verses.name: Mark 11:3
verses.text: A ma meamen indai ong koma: Da me koma wiaki met? A koma sapeng: Kaun o men en upa. Ari, a pan madangada kadarado.

verses.name: Mark 11:4
verses.text: Ira ari kola, diar esel pul o, a sansal likin im o nan au en al riau; ira ap lapwada.

verses.name: Mark 11:5
verses.text: Akai ir u wasa o indai ong ira: Da me koma lapwakida esel pul en?

verses.name: Mark 11:6
verses.text: Ira ari sapeng kin irail, me Iesus masani ong ira. Irail ari kadar ong ira.

verses.name: Mark 11:7
verses.text: Ira ari potoan dong esel pul o ren Iesus, pwilidi ong ar likau ko poa. I ari kaipokedi ong poa,

verses.name: Mark 11:8
verses.text: Me toto perokida sang ar likau nani al, akai paledi ran tuka, irepakidi nani al o.

verses.name: Mark 11:9
verses.text: Irail me tiong o me idauen ap ngisingis, inda: Osiana! Meid iasunai me kotikido ni mar en Kaun!

verses.name: Mark 11:10
verses.text: Meid pai wei kokodo, en sam atail Dawid! Osiana nanlang!

verses.name: Mark 11:11
verses.text: A ap kotilong ong Ierusalem o im en kaudok. A lao kotin mamasani sili meakan, a ap kotilang Petanien pwe a wasa pongier, iangaki eikriamen.

verses.name: Mark 11:12
verses.text: Pweidi songada, irail ap kotin puredo sang Petanien. A ap kotin men konotada.

verses.name: Mark 11:13
verses.text: A lao kotin masani tuka pik apot sang wasa doo, ta mia. A ap koti dong, ma a so pan diar meakot ia. Ni a lel dong, a ap kotin diarada ta eta, pwe saikenta ansau en pik.

verses.name: Mark 11:14
verses.text: I ap kotin sapeng masani ong i: Sota meamen pan kang sang uk wan tuka kokolata. A sapwilim a tounpadak kan rong.

verses.name: Mark 11:15
verses.text: Irail ap koti dong Ierusalem. Iesus lao kotilong ong nan im en kaudok, a ap kotin tapiada kase sang irail, me netinet nan im en kaudok, ap wukidedi en saun kawil moni ko ar tepel o en men netin muroi ko ar men momod.

verses.name: Mark 11:16
verses.text: Ap sola mueid ong meamen, en wala dal eu nan im en kaudok.

verses.name: Mark 11:17
verses.text: I ari kotin kawewe masani ong irail: A so intingidi, me im ai adaneki, im en kapakap ong toun sappa karos? A komail wia kila deun men pirap!

verses.name: Mark 11:18
verses.text: Samero laplap akan o saunkawewe kan rongada, ap lamelame duen ar pan kamela i, pwe re masak i, pwe aramas karos puriamuiki a padak.

verses.name: Mark 11:19
verses.text: Ni a sautik pena, a ap kotiieila sang kanim o.

verses.name: Mark 11:20
verses.text: Ni mansang, ni arail kotikot kowei, re ap masaniada tuka pik o a mongedar sang nin tapi.

verses.name: Mark 11:21
verses.text: Petrus ap katamaneki potoan ong i: Rapi, re kotin masani tuka, me re kotin kariala o a mongelar.

verses.name: Mark 11:22
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail poson Kot!

verses.name: Mark 11:23
verses.text: Pwe melel, I indai ong komail, ma meamen pan indai ong nana wet: Mokidewei lokidokila nan madau! Ap sota peikasal nan mongiong i, a poson me meako, me a inda, pan pwaida, a pan wiaui ong, me a inda.

verses.name: Mark 11:24
verses.text: Iei me I indaki ong komail: Meakaros, me komail inong iong ni omail kapakap, kamelele, me komail pan ale, a ap pan pwai dong komail.

verses.name: Mark 11:25
verses.text: Ari, ni omail kapakap maki ong, ma kasuede kai mi re omail ong amen, pwe Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, en pil makeki omail sapung kan.

verses.name: Mark 11:26
verses.text: A ma komail sota mak, Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, sota pil pan makeki ong komail omail sapung kan.

verses.name: Mark 11:27
verses.text: Re ap pil pure dong Ierusalem. Ni a kotikot sili nan im en kaudok o, samero lapalap akan, o saunkawewe kan, o saumas akan ko dong re a.

verses.name: Mark 11:28
verses.text: Ap potoan ong: Manaman en is, me komui wiawiaki mepukat? O is me kiwei manaman om, en wiawia mepukat?

verses.name: Mark 11:29
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: I pan pil idok peidok eu re omail. Komail sapeng ia, I ap pan id indai ong komail, manaman en is, me I wiaki mepukat.

verses.name: Mark 11:30
verses.text: En Ioanes a paptais, men nanlang de me ren aramas? Sapeng ia!

verses.name: Mark 11:31
verses.text: Irail ap lamelame nan pung arail inda: Ma kitail inda, men nanlang, a pan masani: Da me komail so kameleleki?

verses.name: Mark 11:32
verses.text: A ma kitail inda, me ren aramas irail masak pokon o, pwe irail karos lamelame, me Ioanes saukop melel amen.

verses.name: Mark 11:33
verses.text: Re ap sapeng potoan ong Iesus: Se sasa. Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: I sota pil pan indai ong komail, man en is me I wiaki mepukat.<div eID="gen2651" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.11"/>

verses.name: Mark 12:1
verses.text: A AP kotin tapiada padaki irail ni karaseras akan: Aramas amen me padukedi mat en krep eu o kele pena, ap weirada deun wungit krep eu, o kauada im en silasil eu, ap mueidalang saumat akai, ap momaitelang nan wai.

verses.name: Mark 12:2
verses.text: Kadekadeo ansaun rak, a ap kadaralang saumat oko ladu amen, pwen ale ren saumat oko kisan wan matuel o.

verses.name: Mark 12:3
verses.text: Re ap saikidi, kame o ari, kadarala kaip.

verses.name: Mark 12:4
verses.text: A ap pil kadaralang irail amen ladu, re ap kate, pwalang ong monga, ap kadarala i kasaroela.

verses.name: Mark 12:5
verses.text: A ap pil kadarala amen; re ap kamela; pil me toto re woki akai, a re kamela akai.

verses.name: Mark 12:6
verses.text: Ari, na ieros eu, me a pokepoke, i me a kadarala ikmuri, a masani: Re pan wauneki nai ol.

verses.name: Mark 12:7
verses.text: A saumat pukat inda pena nan pung arail: Seri en soso met; na, kitail en kamela! Ari, kitail ap pan id aneki soso o;

verses.name: Mark 12:8
verses.text: Re ap ale, kamela, kasewei sang nan mat en krep.

verses.name: Mark 12:9
verses.text: Ari, da me saumas en mat o pan wia? A pan kodo, kamela saumat oko; a ap pan mueid ong akai matuel o.

verses.name: Mark 12:10
verses.text: Komail sota wadoker kisin likau et: Takai, me sause kan kasapokelar ap id wialar takai en pukakaim?

verses.name: Mark 12:11
verses.text: Mepukat wiauier ren Kaun o, men kapuriamui patail.

verses.name: Mark 12:12
verses.text: Irail ari sosong pwen saikidi i, a re masak aramas akan, pwe re asa, me a karaserase kin irail. Irail ari kokola sang re a.

verses.name: Mark 12:13
verses.text: Irail ap kadaralang re a Parisär o iang en Erodes akai, pwen kasapunge i sang ni a masan.

verses.name: Mark 12:14
verses.text: Ari, ni ar kodo, re potoan ong i: Saunpadak, se asa, me komui me melel o sota insenoki meamen. Pwe komui sota lipilipil mas en aramas, a kom kaukawewe al en Kot ni me pung. Me pung, en nopweiki moni ong nanmarki de so? Se en kida, de se ender kida?

verses.name: Mark 12:15
verses.text: A a kotin mangi ar malaun masani ong irail: Menda komail songesong ia? Wa dong ia eu denar en, pwe I en kilang.

verses.name: Mark 12:16
verses.text: Irail ap wado. A ap kotin masani ong irail: Mom o inting en is met akan? Irail potoan ong i: En nanmarki.

verses.name: Mark 12:17
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng, masani ong irail: Ari, komail ki ong nanmarki me nain nanmarki, o ong Kot me sapwilim en Kot. Re ap puriamui kila i.

verses.name: Mark 12:18
verses.text: Sadusär akai ap ko dong re a, me kin inda me dene sota me pan maureda sang mela. Re ap peidok re a indada:

verses.name: Mark 12:19
verses.text: Saunpadak, Moses intinge dong kit er, ma ri en ol amen mela, kidi a paud, sota na seri ko, a ri a ol ap pan id ale a paud, pwen wiada kadaudok a ong ri a ol o.

verses.name: Mark 12:20
verses.text: Ari pirien, ol isimen mia. Men mas re ’rail paude kida li amen ap melar, sota kadaudok a.

verses.name: Mark 12:21
verses.text: Men muri ap id ale, ap melar, pil sota kadaudok a. A kasilimen pil dueta.

verses.name: Mark 12:22
verses.text: A irail isimen oko paude kida i, sota kadaudok a. Ari, murin karos li o ari pil melar.

verses.name: Mark 12:23
verses.text: Ran en iasada ni ar pan maureda, is me pan paudeki i re ’rail, pwe irail isimen oko paudekier i?

verses.name: Mark 12:24
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng, masani ong irail: Omail sota lelapokki kisin likau kan o roson en Kot, kaidik iei me kareda omail sas kida?

verses.name: Mark 12:25
verses.text: Pwe irail pan lao maureda sang ren me melar akan, re sola pan papaud de kapapaud. A re pan duela tounlang kan me mimi nanlang.

verses.name: Mark 12:26
verses.text: Ari, duen me melar akan ar pan maureda, komail sota wadoker nan puk en Moses, duen Kot a kotin masani ong i nan wel en tuka o: Ngai Kot en Apraain, o Kot en Isaak, o Kot en Iakop!

verses.name: Mark 12:27
verses.text: Kaidin i Kot en me melar akan, pwe Kot en memaureta! Iei, me komail sas kida kaualap.

verses.name: Mark 12:28
verses.text: Ari, amen ren saunkawewe kan ap potodo, me ronger duen ar kapakaparok pena, ap kasauiada, me a pasapeng me inen, ap idok re a: Ia mo en kusoned karos?

verses.name: Mark 12:29
verses.text: Iesus ari masani ong i: Iet mo en kusoned akan: Rong Israel! Kaun patail Kot me Kaun me ta men.

verses.name: Mark 12:30
verses.text: Ari, koe en poke ki ong Kaun, om Kot, mongiong om unsok, o ngen om unsok, o om lamelam unsok, o om kel unsok! Iei met me mo en kusoned akan.

verses.name: Mark 12:31
verses.text: A kariau me dueta. Iet et: Koe en pok ong men imp om due pein koe! Sota eu kusoned me lapasang mepukat.

verses.name: Mark 12:32
verses.text: Saunkawewe ap potoan ong i: Me mau Saunpadak! Melel me kom masani en! Pwe i me ta men, a sota pil amen, pwe i eta!

verses.name: Mark 12:33
verses.text: O poke ki ong i mongiong unsok, o lamelam unsok, o ngen unsok, o kel unsok, o pok, ong men impa due pein i, mau sang mairong isis o mairong tei kan.

verses.name: Mark 12:34
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a kotin masani a pasapeng a inen, a ap masani ong i: Kom sota doo sang wein Kot. Ari, ap solar, me men pil idok re a meakot.

verses.name: Mark 12:35
verses.text: Iesus ap pil kotin sapeng masani ni a kotin kaukawewe nan im en kaudok o: Da me saunkawewe kan indaki, me Kristus nain Dawid?

verses.name: Mark 12:36
verses.text: Pwe pein Dawid masaniki ren Ngen saraui: Kaun o kotin masani ong ai Kaun: Kom kotidi ong pali maun i, I lao wia kida wutipan aluwilu omui om imwintiti kan!

verses.name: Mark 12:37
verses.text: Ari, Dawid pein kaadaneki i Kaun; a daduen a wia na? Aramas akan ap mauki a padak.

verses.name: Mark 12:38
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail ni a padak: Kalaka saunkawewe kan, me mauki mi nan likau reirei o men, re en ranmaui ir nan wasan net.

verses.name: Mark 12:39
verses.text: O men mod leppantam nan sinakoke kan o kamadip.

verses.name: Mark 12:40
verses.text: O ngoper sang li odi im ar, ap liliasos kapakap reirei. Irail pan lodi ong kadeik lapalap.

verses.name: Mark 12:41
verses.text: Iesus ap kotikot sal ong deun moni en mairong, ap mamasani, en aramas ar kasedi ong moni nan deu o. A me toto, me kapwapwa, kasedi ong me toto.

verses.name: Mark 12:42
verses.text: Li odi samama ap kodo o kasedi ong kisin moni riakis, me wiada kwadrans eu.

verses.name: Mark 12:43
verses.text: A ap kotin molipedo sapwilim a tounpadak kan, masani ong ir: Melel I indai ong komail, me li odi samama men et kasedi ong me laude sang irail karos, me pil kasedi ong nan deun moni o.

verses.name: Mark 12:44
verses.text: Pwe karos kasedi ong sang ni ar pai. A i me kasedi ong sang ni a samama, karos me a, i eta a manga.<div eID="gen2652" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.12"/>

verses.name: Mark 13:1
verses.text: NI a kotieila sang ni im en kaudok, amen sapwilim a tounpadak kan potoan ong i: Saunpadak, kom kotin masani takai o im pukat!

verses.name: Mark 13:2
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng, masani ong i: Koe kilekilang im kalaimun pukat? Sota takai eu pan mi pon eu, me so pan lokidoki sang.

verses.name: Mark 13:3
verses.text: Ari, ni a kotikot pon dol Oliwe sal dong im en kaudok, Petrus, o Iakopus, o Ioanes, o Andreas, re ap kelep potoan ong i:

verses.name: Mark 13:4
verses.text: Re kotin masani ong kit, iad mepukat pan wiaui o da pan kadapakilene en mepukat karos a pan pwaida?

verses.name: Mark 13:5
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng irail masani: Kalaka, pwe meamen de kotaue komail!

verses.name: Mark 13:6
verses.text: Pwe me toto pan kodo ni ad ai, inda: Ngai i. Re ap pan kotaueda me toto.

verses.name: Mark 13:7
verses.text: O ni omail pan rong mauin o rong en mauin, komail depa masak! Pwe mepukat udan wiaui; a saikenta imwi.

verses.name: Mark 13:8
verses.text: Pwe wei eu pan u ong eu wei o pil wei en nanmarki ko, o sap rerer pan wiaui sili, o lek, o insensued, mepukat kamoe en patau.

verses.name: Mark 13:9
verses.text: A komail kalaka pein komail! Pwe re pan pang komail la ong kapung o sinakoke kan; o komail pan kamekame o wisike dong mon monsap o nanmarki kan pweki ngai, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Mark 13:10
verses.text: O rongamau en kaloki ong mas nan sap karos.

verses.name: Mark 13:11
verses.text: A ni arail wa komail la o pangla komail, der lamelame mas, me komail pan inda, pil der madamadaua mas. A iei me o, me pan ko ong komail ni klok ota, i me komail en inda! Pwe kaidin komail me lokaia a Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Mark 13:12
verses.text: Pwe ol pan pangala ri a ol, pwen kamela; o sam na seri, o seri ko pan u ong sam, in, o pan kare ong ir, en kamela.

verses.name: Mark 13:13
verses.text: Komail ap pan kalingaringarla pan aramas karos pweki ad ai. A me dadaurata lao imwi lel, a pan dorela.

verses.name: Mark 13:14
verses.text: Ni omail kilang wiawi sued en kao lapalap, me a pan wiaui wasa, me a so kon ong meamen wudok a en dedeki me mimi Iudäa, re en sopo wong nan nana ko.

verses.name: Mark 13:15
verses.text: O me mi pon im, depa kodido nan im; a depa pil pedelong ong lole, pwen ki sang meakot.

verses.name: Mark 13:16
verses.text: O me mi nan sap, depa sapaledo ale a likau.

verses.name: Mark 13:17
verses.text: A pan non suede ong me lisean o ong ir, me kadidi ni ran oko.

verses.name: Mark 13:18
verses.text: Komail kapakapeki, pwe omail sapola de wiaui ni ansau en pou.

verses.name: Mark 13:19
verses.text: Pwe ni ran oko kainsensued pan wiaui, me sota due sang ni tapin sappa, ni en Kot a kotin wiada kokodo kokolata.

verses.name: Mark 13:20
verses.text: Ma Kaun o sota kotin kamotola ran oko, sota uduk, me pan dorela. A pweki me pilipildar akan, me a kotin piladar, iei me a kotin kamoto kila ran oko.

verses.name: Mark 13:21
verses.text: Ma meamen indai ong komail ni ansau o: Kilang, iet et Kristus! De ionen! Der kamelele.

verses.name: Mark 13:22
verses.text: Pwe Kristus likam o saukop likam akai pan koda o re pan kasaleda kilel o manaman, pwen pil kotaue ir, me pilipildar akan ma re kak ong.

verses.name: Mark 13:23
verses.text: Komail ari kalaka! Pwe I kop ong komail er meakaros!

verses.name: Mark 13:24
verses.text: Ari, ni ran oko murin kainsensued katipin pan rotala, o maram pan solar lingan.

verses.name: Mark 13:25
verses.text: O usu en lang pan pupedi o kelail en lang akan pan mokimokid.

verses.name: Mark 13:26
verses.text: Ari, re ap pan kilang Nain aramas pan kotikot kodo nan dapok ni a roson melel o ni a lingan.

verses.name: Mark 13:27
verses.text: A ap pan kadar pasang na tounlang kan, kapokon pena sang pali en lang paieu sapwilim a pilipildar akan, sang imwin sappa lel imwin lang.

verses.name: Mark 13:28
verses.text: Komail en asa karaseras en tuka pik. Ni ra kan ar pons o pepe pwarado, komail kin asa, me rak korenier.

verses.name: Mark 13:29
verses.text: O pil komail; ni omail kilang wiawia pukat a pan pwaida, komail en asa, me a korendor, a mier pan wanim.

verses.name: Mark 13:30
verses.text: Melel, I indai ong komail: Di wet sota pan imwisokela, lao wiawia pukat pwaida.

verses.name: Mark 13:31
verses.text: Lang o sappa pan soredi, a ai masan sota pan soredi.

verses.name: Mark 13:32
verses.text: A duen ran o klok sota amen me asa. Tounlang kan, me mi lang, pil sota asa; Na pil so, Sam eta.

verses.name: Mark 13:33
verses.text: Komail kalaka! Masamasan o kapakap! Pwe komail sasa ansau o!

verses.name: Mark 13:34
verses.text: Due aramas amen, me wia sailok doo, me kidi im a, ap ki ong manaman ren a ladu kan, pil ki ong karos ar dodok, ap pil masani ong silepan wanim o, en masamasan.

verses.name: Mark 13:35
verses.text: Iei me komail en masamasaneki, pwe komail sasa ansau, saumas en im o a purodo, ma sautik, de ailep en pong, de ni malek kakorot, de ni mansang.

verses.name: Mark 13:36
verses.text: Pwe a depa madangedo, diarada omail mamair.

verses.name: Mark 13:37
verses.text: O me I indai ong komail, I pil indai ong karos, masamasan!<div eID="gen2653" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.13"/>

verses.name: Mark 14:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO pong ria pong mon pasa o kamadip en prot somut, Samero lapalap akan o saunkawewe kan sosong duen widingadi i kamatala.

verses.name: Mark 14:2
verses.text: Pwe irail inda: Iermen ni ran en kamadip, pwe de kamorongada aramas akan.

verses.name: Mark 14:3
verses.text: Ari, ni a kotikot Petanien nan im en Simon tuketuk, ni a kotin kaipokedi ni tepel, li amen ap potodo, wa kisin kopa alapasta audaud en men kei, inen en pil en narde, me kasampwal. A ap kawela kopa o keiedi ong tapwi.

verses.name: Mark 14:4
verses.text: Akai re irail ap suedeki, mongemongeloleki: Menda men kei wet ola mal?

verses.name: Mark 14:5
verses.text: Pwe a pan netila kareda laude sang denar silipuki, ap pan ko ong me samama. Re ap lipelipanede li o.

verses.name: Mark 14:6
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Komail ko sang! Menda komail kainsensued i? Dok mau ong ia, me a wiada et.

verses.name: Mark 14:7
verses.text: Pwe samama kin mi re omail ansau karos. Ari, ansau me komail mauki, komail kak kadek ong. A ngai sota kin ieiang komail ansau karos.

verses.name: Mark 14:8
verses.text: A wiaer me a kak ong. A kaonopedier a keie war ai ni saredi.

verses.name: Mark 14:9
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail: Wasa karos me rongamau wet pan kalok ia pangada sappa u, re pil pan lokolokaia duen me a wiadar, pwen katamanpa.

verses.name: Mark 14:10
verses.text: Iudas Iskariot, amen ekriamen oko, ap kolang ren samero lapalap akan, pwen pang ong irail i.

verses.name: Mark 14:11
verses.text: Irail lao rong, re ap peren kida, ap inauki, me re pan ki ong moni. I ari song duen a pan mongai ong en pangala i,

verses.name: Mark 14:12
verses.text: Ni kaieu en ran en prot somut, ni ar kin kamela sippul en pasa, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap potoan ong i: Ia wasa re kotin men, sen potolang kaonopada, pwe re en kotin konot pasa?

verses.name: Mark 14:13
verses.text: A ap kotin poronela sapwilim a tounpadak riamen masani ong ira: Koma ko ong nan kanim o; aramas amen ap pan tu ong komail, wa men deun pil eu. Idauen i!

verses.name: Mark 14:14
verses.text: Wasa a pan pedelong ong, koma indai ong kaun en im: Saunpadak o masani, ia pera en men kairu kan, wasa me I pan tungole pasa ia iang ai tounpadak kan?

verses.name: Mark 14:15
verses.text: A ap pan kasale ong koma pera laud poa kasongsonger o onoper. Iei wasa koma onop ong kitail.

verses.name: Mark 14:16
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kola, lel dong kanim o, o diaradar duen me a kotin masani ong ira ko; ira ari kaonopada pasa.

verses.name: Mark 14:17
verses.text: A lao sautik penaer, a ap kotido iang ekriamen ko.

verses.name: Mark 14:18
verses.text: A ni arail kotidi ni tepel konokonot, Iesus ap kotin masani: Melel I indai ong komail, amen komail me iang ia mangamanga et, pan pang ia la.

verses.name: Mark 14:19
verses.text: Re ap tapiada insenola ap potoan ong i amen amen: Ngai i? A pil amen inda: Ngai i?

verses.name: Mark 14:20
verses.text: A ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Amen ekriamen oko me iang ia kadukadu nan dal et.

verses.name: Mark 14:21
verses.text: Ari so, Nain aramas kokola duen a intingidi ong er; o non suede ong aramas o, me Nain aramas pangpangala re a. Me mau ong, ma aramas men et sota ipwidi.

verses.name: Mark 14:22
verses.text: Ari, ni arail konokonot, Iesus ap kotikida prot o laolaoki, ap pilitiki pasang kotiki ong irail masani: Ale, tungole! War ai metet,

verses.name: Mark 14:23
verses.text: A ap kotikida dal o murin a kotin laolaoki; a ap kotiki ong irail; irail karos ap nim.

verses.name: Mark 14:24
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Nt’ ai metet, ntan inau kap, me kapwilipwilikidi me toto.

verses.name: Mark 14:25
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, I solar pan nim sang wan wain, lao ran en ai pil pan nim nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Mark 14:26
verses.text: Murin arail kauleki kaul pot, re ap kotilang dol Oliwe.

verses.name: Mark 14:27
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail karos pan makarada; pwe a intingidi: I pan kame silepa, ari pwin sip ap pan muei pasang.

verses.name: Mark 14:28
verses.text: A murin ai pan maureda, I pan tiong wei mo ’mail ong Kaliläa.

verses.name: Mark 14:29
verses.text: A Petrus potoan ong i: Karusia pan makar kila, a ngai so.

verses.name: Mark 14:30
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Melel I indai ong uk, ran wet, pongpong wet, mon malek a pan kakorot pan riapak, koe pan kamam kin ia pan silipak.

verses.name: Mark 14:31
verses.text: I ari kalaudela a sapeng: Ma i iang komui matala i sota pan man kamam kin komui. Irail karos pil inda dueta.

verses.name: Mark 14:32
verses.text: Irail ap kotilang wasa, me ad a Ketsemane, a ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Komail mondi ong met, ni ai pan wia kapakap.

verses.name: Mark 14:33
verses.text: A ap kotin ukada Petrus, o Iakopus, o Ioanes, ap kotin laualoda kaualap o pataula.

verses.name: Mark 14:34
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Ngen i ap insensuedela kaualap ong mela. Komail mimi met o masamasan.

verses.name: Mark 14:35
verses.text: A ap kotila ekis, ap pupedi ong nan pwel, ap laolaoki, ma a kak auer en dauliela.

verses.name: Mark 14:36
verses.text: A ap kotin masani: Apa Sam ai, meakaros me kak pa omui! Kotikiwei sang ia dal wet! Ari so, kaidik me I men, a me komui men.

verses.name: Mark 14:37
verses.text: I ari kotido diar ir ar mamair, ap kotin masani ong Petrus: Simon koe men mair, koe sota kak masamasan auer eu?

verses.name: Mark 14:38
verses.text: Komail masamasan o kapakap, pwe komail de ko ong nan songesong. Ngen me okok, a uduk me luet.

verses.name: Mark 14:39
verses.text: A ap pil kotila o laolao pil masani masan ko ota.

verses.name: Mark 14:40
verses.text: A ni a kotin sapaledo, pil diar ar mamair, pwe mas arail me toutou; irail sasa, me re en sapengki.

verses.name: Mark 14:41
verses.text: A ap kotido ni kasilepak, masani ong irail: Komail kanangata omail mair en o kamola? Arier, auer leler! Kilang, Nain aramas pangapangalanger ni pa en me dipan akan!

verses.name: Mark 14:42
verses.text: Paurida! Kitail kokola! Kilang, me pang ia la me korendor.

verses.name: Mark 14:43
verses.text: Madang ni a kotin mamasan, ari, Iudas kodo, amen ekriamen oko; pokon kalaimunia eu iang, wado kodlas o sokon, kodo sang ren samero lapalap akan o saunkawewe kan o saumas akan.

verses.name: Mark 14:44
verses.text: A me pangala i, ki ong irail kilel eu inda: Meamen i metik, iei i. Ale, kaluawei, kanai ong!

verses.name: Mark 14:45
verses.text: A pwarado eta ap madang inen dong Iesus inda: Rapi, Rapi, ap metik i.

verses.name: Mark 14:46
verses.text: Irail ari por pena ong ale.

verses.name: Mark 14:47
verses.text: Amen ir, me u wasa o, usada na kodlas, ap pale ladu en samero lapalap amen, ap lepuka sang salong a.

verses.name: Mark 14:48
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail ko dong ia due lipirap amen, wado kodlas o sokon, pwen koledi ia.

verses.name: Mark 14:49
verses.text: I kin ieiang komail ta ran karos nan im en kaudok o kaukawewe. A komail sota ale ia. A pwe kisin likau kan en pungala.

verses.name: Mark 14:50
verses.text: Irail karos ap pededi, tanga sang.

verses.name: Mark 14:51
verses.text: Manakap amen ap idauen i, pineki pena war a likau linen kaselel eu. Manakap akai ap parokidi.

verses.name: Mark 14:52
verses.text: I ari kasela a likau linen kaselel o, ap sopola kiliso.

verses.name: Mark 14:53
verses.text: Re ap kalualang Iesus ren samero lapalap o. Samero lapalap akan, o saumas akan, o saunkawewe kan, karos pokon dong re a.

verses.name: Mark 14:54
verses.text: Petrus idauendo i doowei sang lao lel nan tanpas en samero lapalap. A ap mondi ong ren ladu ko, wia rangerang.

verses.name: Mark 14:55
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan o pwin en kadeik roporop kadede, pwen kine ong Iesus, pwen kamela. Ari, sota me re diar.

verses.name: Mark 14:56
verses.text: Pwe me toto me kine ong i mal. Ari, ar kinakin sota dupeneta.

verses.name: Mark 14:57
verses.text: Akai uda, kine ong i mal inda:

verses.name: Mark 14:58
verses.text: Se rong, a inda: I pan kawela im en kaudok wet, me pa wiadar, ap id kauada eu ni ran silu, me sota pa wiada.

verses.name: Mark 14:59
verses.text: Ari, ar kinekin sota pil kon pena.

verses.name: Mark 14:60
verses.text: Samero lapalap ap kasinenda nan pung ar ap idok ren Iesus, masani: Kom sota sapengki meakot, me mepukat kine ong komui?

verses.name: Mark 14:61
verses.text: A a kotin nenenlata, sota sapeng. Samero lapalap ap pil idok masani ong i: Komui Kristus sapwilim en men Kaping kaualap?

verses.name: Mark 14:62
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Ngai i! Komail pan kilang Nain aramas a kaipokedi ni pali maun en me roson o kokido dapok en lang.

verses.name: Mark 14:63
verses.text: Samero lapalap ap ter pasang a likau ap inda: Menda re atail pil eu kinakin?

verses.name: Mark 14:64
verses.text: Komail ronger a lalaue. Da me komail lamelame? A irail karos ap kadeikada, me a war ong kamela.

verses.name: Mark 14:65
verses.text: Akai tapi ong kondipi ong i o pwaindi silang i, ap pikir, ap indai ong i: Kopada! Papa ko pil pikir i.

verses.name: Mark 14:66
verses.text: Ni en Petrus a mimi panakepir en tanpas, lidu en samero lapalap amen ap kodo.

verses.name: Mark 14:67
verses.text: Ni a kilang Petrus a wiawia rangerang, a ap kangkakil i o ari, inda: Koe me pil iang Iesus, men Nasaret!

verses.name: Mark 14:68
verses.text: A a kamama kida inda: I sasa. I pil sota dedeki, me koe indinda en! I ari koieilang nan katipar; malek ap kakorot.

verses.name: Mark 14:69
verses.text: A lidu lao kilang i, ap pil indang irail, me mimi wasa o: Amen irail met et.

verses.name: Mark 14:70
verses.text: A ap pil kamama kida. Mur ekis irail me u impa ko; pil indang Petrus: Melel me amen irail koe, pwe koe pil men Kaliläa amen.

verses.name: Mark 14:71
verses.text: I ari lalaue o kaula: I sasa aramas men et, me komail indinda en!

verses.name: Mark 14:72
verses.text: Ap kariapak en malek a kakorot. Petrus ap tamanda en Iesus a kotin masani ong i: Mon malek a pan kakorot pan riapak, koe pan kamam kin ia pan silipak; ni a lamelamela a ap sangesang.<div eID="gen2654" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.14"/>

verses.name: Mark 15:1
verses.text: MADANG sangkonai samero lapalap akan, iangaki saumas akan, o saunkawewe kan, o pil saunkapung karos kapungada ap saliedi Iesus, ap wawei pangalang Pilatus.

verses.name: Mark 15:2
verses.text: Pilatus ap idok re a: Komui Nanmarki en Sus akan? A kotin sapeng masani ong i: Komui me masani.

verses.name: Mark 15:3
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan karauneki i me toto.

verses.name: Mark 15:4
verses.text: Pilatus ap pil idok re a masani: Komui sota sapeng? Kom masani, me re kinakine ong komui me toto.

verses.name: Mark 15:5
verses.text: Iesus pil sota kotin sapeng Pilatus ap ponepone kida.

verses.name: Mark 15:6
verses.text: Ari, ni kamadip o a kin lapwa ong ir me sensal amen, me re mauki.

verses.name: Mark 15:7
verses.text: Ol amen, ad a Parapas, me iang sansal ren me iang i kamela aramas ni ar kauadar moromor eu.

verses.name: Mark 15:8
verses.text: Pokon ap morongada, ngidi ngideki, en wiai ong irail, me a kin wiai ong irail mas.

verses.name: Mark 15:9
verses.text: Pilatus ap sapeng irail masani: Komail men, i en lapwadang komail Nanmarki en Sus akan?

verses.name: Mark 15:10
verses.text: Pwe a asa, me samero lapalap akan wakido i ar peirin.

verses.name: Mark 15:11
verses.text: A samero lapalap akan kapururada pokon o, pwe en mauki lapwa ong irail Parapas.

verses.name: Mark 15:12
verses.text: Pilatus ap sapeng pil masani ong irail: Da me komail mauki i en wiai ong me komail kaadaneki Nanmarki en Sus akan?

verses.name: Mark 15:13
verses.text: Irail ap wer laudeda: Kalopuela i!

verses.name: Mark 15:14
verses.text: Pilatus ap masani ong irail: Pwe sued da, me a wiadar? Re ap kalaudela ar wer: Kalopuela i!

verses.name: Mark 15:15
verses.text: Ari, Pilatus men kainsenemaui aramas oko, ap lapwa dong irail Parapas, ap kida Iesus murin a woki, pwen kalopuela.

verses.name: Mark 15:16
verses.text: Saunpei ko ap kalualang i nan pera eu me ad a pretorium. Re ap eker pena ar pwin.

verses.name: Mark 15:17
verses.text: Re ap kalikauwie kida i purpur o pidada al en tek, ap langelangie kida.

verses.name: Mark 15:18
verses.text: Ap tapi ong kepwene: Iong Nanmarki en Sus akan!

verses.name: Mark 15:19
verses.text: Re ap wokieki tapwi alek, o kondipe i, ap kelepuki, poridi sang.

verses.name: Mark 15:20
verses.text: A lao nek ar kapailok, re ap ki sang i purpur, ap kapur ong udan sapwilim a likau, kaluaieila, pwe ren kalopuela i.

verses.name: Mark 15:21
verses.text: Re ap iton ong Simon, men Kirene amen, me sam en Aleksander o Rupus, me dauli irail ni a kodo sang nan sap, pwen wada a lopu.

verses.name: Mark 15:22
verses.text: Re ap walang i Kolkata. Iet wewe: Wasa en pontal en mong.

verses.name: Mark 15:23
verses.text: Re ap ki ong i, en kakere wain dol mir. Ari, a sota kotin urak.

verses.name: Mark 15:24
verses.text: Ni arail kalopuedar i, re ap ter pasang sapwilim a likau ko. Re ap kadoropwe, da me amen amen pan aneki.

verses.name: Mark 15:25
verses.text: Ari, ni auer kasilu, me re kalopuela i.

verses.name: Mark 15:26
verses.text: O inting en poa me a pukoki due met: Nanmarki en Sus akan.

verses.name: Mark 15:27
verses.text: Lolap en pirap riamen iang i kalopuela; amen pali maun i, amen pali maing i.

verses.name: Mark 15:28
verses.text: Iei me kisin likau pung kila, me inda: A wadawad ong ren me dipan.

verses.name: Mark 15:29
verses.text: Ir me kin dauli, kin lalaue, dueduälok inda: Ei, koe me pan kawela im en kaudok, ap id kaua kida ran silu.

verses.name: Mark 15:30
verses.text: Pein dore uk ala, o kodido sang nin lopu en!

verses.name: Mark 15:31
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan pil dueta, kapailoke, inda nan pung ar iang saunkawewe kan: A dorelar akai, a pein i a sota kak ong.

verses.name: Mark 15:32
verses.text: Kristus Nanmarki en Israel, kodido sang nin lopu en, pwe se en kilang o poson. O ira, me iang i lopu la ko, pil lalaue.

verses.name: Mark 15:33
verses.text: Ari, auer kawonu lel, rotorot ap kipadi sap lao lel auer kaduau.

verses.name: Mark 15:34
verses.text: Ni auer kaduau Iesus ap kotin weriwer laudeda masani: Eloi, Eloi, lama sapaktani! Iet wewe: Ai Kot, ai Kot! Da me re kotin kase kin ia la!

verses.name: Mark 15:35
verses.text: Akai me u impa, ni arail rong inda: Kilang, a ekeker Elias.

verses.name: Mark 15:36
verses.text: Amen ap tangala, ale lim en pinika eu, ki ong ni alek apot, ap kida ong en kakere, ap inda: Udi mas! Kitail kilang, ma Elias pan kodo en kidi sang.

verses.name: Mark 15:37
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin weriwer laudeda kadarala Ngen e.

verses.name: Mark 15:38
verses.text: Pera likau nan im en kaudok ap dei pasang, sangeda pali poa lel pa.

verses.name: Mark 15:39
verses.text: O ni en senturion o, me u saledong, a kilang a wer laudeda due mo, ap kadarala Ngen e, a ap inda: Nan melel Sapwilim en Kot aramas men et.

verses.name: Mark 15:40
verses.text: Li akai pil mimi wasa doo, kilekilangedo; Maria men Magdala, me mi nan pung ar, o pil Maria, in en Iakopus, me tik, o en Ioses, o Salome.

verses.name: Mark 15:41
verses.text: Me pil kin idauen papa i mas o, ni a kotikot Kaliläa; o pil me toto, me iang i kotida dong Ierusalem.

verses.name: Mark 15:42
verses.text: Ari, ni a sautik penaer, pweki kaonop iei ran mon sapat.

verses.name: Mark 15:43
verses.text: Iosep, men Arimatia amen, ap kodo, me saunkapung isou amen, me kin pil auiaui wein Kot, me so masak koti dong Pilatus, poeki kalep en Iesus.

verses.name: Mark 15:44
verses.text: Pilatus ap puriamuiki, me a matalar, ap molipe dong i senturion o, ap kainoma re a, ma a matalar warai.

verses.name: Mark 15:45
verses.text: A lao mangi sang ren senturion o, a ap ki ong kalep a ren Iosep.

verses.name: Mark 15:46
verses.text: A ap netiada likau linen mau, ap lapwadi i, kidimeki pena likau o, nekidedi i nan sousou eu, me weiweida nan paip, ap kadapuri ong takai eu ni au en sousou o.

verses.name: Mark 15:47
verses.text: O Maria men Magdala o Maria in en Ioses kilang wasa, re nekidedi i.<div eID="gen2655" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.15"/>

verses.name: Mark 16:1
verses.text: SAPAT lao daulul, Maria men Magdala o Maria in en Iakopuso Salome netiada men kei pomau kai, pwe re en kodon keieki i.

verses.name: Mark 16:2
verses.text: Nin soran nin tapin wik, re ap ko dong nin sousou o, ni katipin a pwarada,

verses.name: Mark 16:3
verses.text: Irail ap indinda nan pung arail: Is me pan kadapure sang au en sousou o takai o re atail?

verses.name: Mark 16:4
verses.text: Ari, ni ar kilang, re ap kilangada, me takai o tapure sanger, pwe me kalaimun kaualap.

verses.name: Mark 16:5
verses.text: Ni ar pedelong ong sousou o, re ap kilang manakap amen momod pali maun, likauki likau puetepuet. Re ap masakada.

verses.name: Mark 16:6
verses.text: A ap indang irail: Komail der masak! Iesus, men Nasaret me komail roporop, me kalopular, a iasadar. A solar kot met. Kilang wasa, re nekidedi ia.

verses.name: Mark 16:7
verses.text: Komail kowei, kaireki a tounpadak kan o Petrus, me a pan tiong mo omail koti wong Kaliläa. I wasa, komail ap pan kilang i, duen a kotin masani ong komail.

verses.name: Mark 16:8
verses.text: Re ap madangiei sang o tang sang nin sousou o, pwe re masapwekada rerer, re pil sota indai ong meakot meamen, pwe re masapwekada.

verses.name: Mark 16:9
verses.text: Ari, murin a iasada sangkonai nin tapin wik a ap kotin pwar ong mas Maria men Magdala, me a kotin kause sang tewil isimen.

verses.name: Mark 16:10
verses.text: A ap kola indai ong irail me iang i ko mas, ni ar mamaiei o sangesang.

verses.name: Mark 16:11
verses.text: Ni arail ronger, me a iasadar, o me a kotin pwar onger i, re sota kamelele.

verses.name: Mark 16:12
verses.text: Muri a kotin pwar ong riamen irail ni eu mom, ni ara kokolang nan sap.

verses.name: Mark 16:13
verses.text: Re ap kola indai ong me tei kan. A re sota pil kamelele ira.

verses.name: Mark 16:14
verses.text: Mur a pil kotin pwar ong ir ekamen oko ni ar momod tungotungol, ap kotin kapung ong irail ar soposon o kapitakai, pweki ar sota kamelele ir me kilang i murin a iasadar.

verses.name: Mark 16:15
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail ko ong sappa u, padaki ong aramas karos rongamau!

verses.name: Mark 16:16
verses.text: Meamen me poson o paptaisola, pan dorela. A me so poson pan kariala.

verses.name: Mark 16:17
verses.text: A kilel pukat pan idauen ir, me poson: Ni ad ai re pan kausaki sang tewil akan, re pan lokaia toror.

verses.name: Mark 16:18
verses.text: Re pan kawela serpent; ma re nimala men kamela kot, a sota pan kawe ir ala; irail pan pwil pa ar pon me somau, re ap pan kelailada.

verses.name: Mark 16:19
verses.text: Ari, Kaun o lao kotin masani ong irail mepukat, a ap peukadala nanlang o kotido ong pali maun en Kot.

verses.name: Mark 16:20
verses.text: Irail ap kola, padapadak sili wasa karos. A Kaun o kotin iang dodok, kameleleki masan manaman me iang.<div eID="gen2656" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Mark.16"/> <div eID="gen2640" osisID="Mark" type="book"/>

verses.name: Luke 1:1
verses.text: MURIN me toto ar intingiedier kasoi pan meakan, me kitail kin kamelele,

verses.name: Luke 1:2
verses.text: Duen ir, me kasokasoi ong kit, me saunkakede o papa pan masan sang ni tapi o,

verses.name: Luke 1:3
verses.text: I ap pil lamedar, me mau, i en inting wong komui, Maing Tiopilus, pwe i lelepokki karos sang ni tapi o kokodo.

verses.name: Luke 1:4
verses.text: Pwe komui en asa duen meakan me komui aleer, me pung melel.

verses.name: Luke 1:5
verses.text: Ni muein Erodes nanmarki en Iudäa, samero amen mia, kisan pwin ong Apia, me mar a Sakarias, o a paud amen sang nain Aron seripein oko, me mar a Elisapet.

verses.name: Luke 1:6
verses.text: Ira karos me pung mon Kot, o ira ineneweita ni en Kaun a kusoned o tiak kan karos.

verses.name: Luke 1:7
verses.text: A sota naira seri, pwe Elisapet li dapwan amen, o ira karos likailapalar.

verses.name: Luke 1:8
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni a kapwaiada a dodok en samero mon Kot ni ansau o, me a pwin pwaisaneki,

verses.name: Luke 1:9
verses.text: Duen a kin wiaui ren samero kan, o ansau en isik mairong lao leler, a kotilong ong nan im en kaudok en Kaun o.

verses.name: Luke 1:10
verses.text: A pokon kalaimun mi liki, wiawia kapakap ni klok en isis.

verses.name: Luke 1:11
verses.text: A tounlang en Kaun amen pwara dong i, kotikot ni pali maun en pei saraui en potik.

verses.name: Luke 1:12
verses.text: Sakarias lao masani, ap lusikida o masapwekada.

verses.name: Luke 1:13
verses.text: A tounlang o masani ong i: Sakarias, der masak, pwe om kapakap pwaidar, om paud Elisapet pan naitikeda seri ol amen, a koe pan ki ong mar a Ioanes.

verses.name: Luke 1:14
verses.text: O a pan kare ong uk peren o popol, o me toto pan perenki a ipwidi.

verses.name: Luke 1:15
verses.text: Pwe a pan lapalap ren Kaun o, a sota pan nim wain, pil so eu song en soko; a pan dir en Ngen saraui nan kupur en in a.

verses.name: Luke 1:16
verses.text: A me toto ren nain Israel akan, me a pan kawuki ong Kaun ar Kot.

verses.name: Luke 1:17
verses.text: A pan tiong mo a ni ngen o roson en Elias, pwen kawuki ong seri kan mongiong en sam arail akan o me sopeik kan ong lamalam en me pung kan, pwen kaonopadang Kaun o pwin aramas lelapok eu.

verses.name: Luke 1:18
verses.text: A Sakarias masani ong tounlang o: Da me i en asaki me wet? Pwe i ol laudalar amen, o ai paud pil likailapalar.

verses.name: Luke 1:19
verses.text: A tounlang sapeng masani ong i: Ngai Kapriel, me kin ariri Kot, o me pakadarado, en lokaia ong uk, o wa dong uk rongamau pukat.

verses.name: Luke 1:20
verses.text: Kilang, koe pan lotong la, o sasa lokaia lao lel ran o, me mepukat pan pwaida, pweki om sota kamelele ai kasoi, me pan pwaida ni a ansau.

verses.name: Luke 1:21
verses.text: A pokon o auiaui Sakarias, puriamuiki a pwapwand nan im en kaudok.

verses.name: Luke 1:22
verses.text: A lao pedoi sang, a solar kak masan ong irail. Irail ap dedeki, me a udial manaman eu nan im en kaudok o. A olol ong irail o lotonglar.

verses.name: Luke 1:23
verses.text: Kadekadeo ran akan en a dodok lao nikier, a kotin purelang sap we koieilang im a.

verses.name: Luke 1:24
verses.text: Murin ran pukat a paud Elisapet liseanda o mimieta nan deu a saunipong limau indada:

verses.name: Luke 1:25
verses.text: Iduen Kaun o kotin wiai ong ia ni ran oko, ni a kotin masan dong ia, pwen kotiki sang ia kanamenok pai ren aramas.

verses.name: Luke 1:26
verses.text: Ni kawonu en saunipong tounlang Kapriel pakadarala sang ren Kot ong nan kanim en Kaliläa eu, me ad a Nasaret,

verses.name: Luke 1:27
verses.text: Ren seripein makelekel amen, me kisin nin ong ol amen, me mar a Iosep, kisan kadaudok en Dawid; seripein makelekel o adaneki Maria.

verses.name: Luke 1:28
verses.text: Tounlang o kotilong ong nan deu a masani ong i: Kaselelia Maing, kom meid pai, Kaun o kotikot re omui! Kom meid pai nan pung en li akan!

verses.name: Luke 1:29
verses.text: A lao kilanger i, o rongadar a masan, ap masapwekadar madamadaua: Duen song en ranamau o.

verses.name: Luke 1:30
verses.text: A tounlang masani ong i: Maria, ender masak, pwe komui me konekonelar ren Kot.

verses.name: Luke 1:31
verses.text: A kilang, komui pan liseanda o naitikeda seri ol amen, a komui pan ki ong mar a Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 1:32
verses.text: Nan i me pan lapalap, o a pan maraneki Sapwilim en Kaun lapalap, o Kaun Kot pan kotiki ong i mol en sam a Dawid.

verses.name: Luke 1:33
verses.text: O a pan kakaunda kadaudok en Iakop kokolata, o sapwilim a wei sota pan imwila.

verses.name: Luke 1:34
verses.text: Maria ap masani ong tounlang o: Daduen mepukat pan kak wiaui, aki i sasa ol amen?

verses.name: Luke 1:35
verses.text: Tounlang o kotin sapeng masani ong i: Ngen saraui pan kotin ti po omui o roson en Kaun lapalap pan kipa komui di, i me saraui o, me pan ipwi sang komui, pan maraneki: Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 1:36
verses.text: O masani, ri om Elisapet pil liseandar ni a likailapala, a pan naitikeda seri ol amen, a kawonu en saunipong ansau wet; iei i me dapwan,

verses.name: Luke 1:37
verses.text: Pwe sota meakot, me Kot sota kak ong.

verses.name: Luke 1:38
verses.text: A Maria potoan ong: Masani, ngai lidu en Kaun o; en wiaui ong ia duen omui masan. Tounlang o ap kotila sang re a.

verses.name: Luke 1:39
verses.text: I ran oko Maria madang kotila pon nana o nan kanim en Iuda eu,

verses.name: Luke 1:40
verses.text: Ap pedelong ong nan im en Sakarias o ranamau ong Elisapet.

verses.name: Luke 1:41
verses.text: Kadekadeo Elisapet lao ronger en Maria a ranamau ong i, seri o ap mokideda nan kaped a; a Elisapet ap direkila Ngen saraui,

verses.name: Luke 1:42
verses.text: O ngil laudeda masani: Komui meid pai ren li akan, o meid iasanai ipwin kupur omui!

verses.name: Luke 1:43
verses.text: A iaduen pai wet a ko sang ia, pwe in en ai Kaun koti dong ia?

verses.name: Luke 1:44
verses.text: Masani, ni ai ronger omui ranamau, seri o ap mokideda nan kaped i aki a peren.

verses.name: Luke 1:45
verses.text: O komui meid pai, pweki komui poson! Pwe a pan pwaida, me Kaun o kotin masani ong komui.

verses.name: Luke 1:46
verses.text: Maria ap masani: Lol ai kapinga Kaun o,

verses.name: Luke 1:47
verses.text: O ngen i perenki Kot ai Saunkamaur.

verses.name: Luke 1:48
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kupurala sapwilim a lidu tikitik o. Kilang, sang met o kokolata di karos pan kapai kin ia,

verses.name: Luke 1:49
verses.text: Pwe a kotin wiaer song en manaman ong ia, me lapalap o mar a me saraui.

verses.name: Luke 1:50
verses.text: A kotin kalangan ong di karos kokolata, ong irail me kin lan i.

verses.name: Luke 1:51
verses.text: O a kotin wia kida lim a manaman akan. O a kotin karawan pasang, me kin lemai nan mongiong arail.

verses.name: Luke 1:52
verses.text: A kotin sikin wei saupeidi kan sang mol ar, ap id kasapwilada me tikitik kan.

verses.name: Luke 1:53
verses.text: A kotin kamede kida kapwa me men mangadar akan, ap kotin kadarala kaip me kapwapwa kan.

verses.name: Luke 1:54
verses.text: A kotin upor kin sapwilim a ladu Israel, o kotin tamataman a kalangan,

verses.name: Luke 1:55
verses.text: Duen a kotin masani ong sam atail akan, ong Apraam o kadaudok a kokolata.

verses.name: Luke 1:56
verses.text: A Maria kotikot re a saunipong silu, ap purelang im a.

verses.name: Luke 1:57
verses.text: Ari, ansaun Elisapet leler pwen naitik, a naitikeda seri ol amen.

verses.name: Luke 1:58
verses.text: O men imp a kan o sau i rongadar, me Kaun o kotin kupura i, rap iang i peren kida.

verses.name: Luke 1:59
verses.text: Kadekadeo auel en ran o re pwara dong sirkomsais seri o; ir ari ki ong mar en sam a Sakarias.

verses.name: Luke 1:60
verses.text: A in a sapeng indada: O kaidin, pwe a pan maraneki Ioanes.

verses.name: Luke 1:61
verses.text: Irail ap indang i: Nan sota sau om men me maraneki met.

verses.name: Luke 1:62
verses.text: Irail ap olol ong sam a, duen me a mauki, seri en adaneki.

verses.name: Luke 1:63
verses.text: I ari poeki slet eu, ap intingiedier o masani: A pan adaneki Ioanes. Irail karos ap puriamuiki.

verses.name: Luke 1:64
verses.text: A madang silang i wasok pasang o tenap a sapadokada; i ari masani o kapinga Kot.

verses.name: Luke 1:65
verses.text: A masak kipadi karos, me kaukauson imp ar, o wiawia pukat lolok sili pon nana en Iudäa karos.

verses.name: Luke 1:66
verses.text: A karos me rongadar, kin nekinekid nan mongiong arail, indada: Da me seri men et pan wiala? Pwe lim en Kaun o kotin iang i.

verses.name: Luke 1:67
verses.text: A sam a Sakarias direkila Ngen saraui ap kokopada masani:

verses.name: Luke 1:68
verses.text: Kapinga ong Kaun Kot en Israel, pwe a kotidier ren sapwilim a aramas akan dore ir ala.

verses.name: Luke 1:69
verses.text: O kotin wiadang kitail kamaur patail sang nan kadaudok en sapwilim a ladu Dawid.

verses.name: Luke 1:70
verses.text: Duen a kotin masanier ren sapwilim a saukop saraui kan, sang tapin kaua kokodo,

verses.name: Luke 1:71
verses.text: Me a pan kotin dore kitail la sang ren atail imwintiti o sang nan pa en me kailong kin kitail,

verses.name: Luke 1:72
verses.text: O kotin kalangan ong sam atail akan, o kotin kupureda a inau saraui,

verses.name: Luke 1:73
verses.text: O kaula eu, me a kotin kauki ong sam atail Apraam, en kotiki ong kitail.

verses.name: Luke 1:74
verses.text: Pwe sen dore sang nan pa en atail imwintiti, ap papa i so masak,

verses.name: Luke 1:75
verses.text: Nin tiak lelapok o pung mon silang i ran karos kokolata.

verses.name: Luke 1:76
verses.text: A koe nai seri pan adaneki: Saukop en me lapalap o, pwe koe pan tiong mon silang en Kaun o, pwen kaonopada sapwilim a al akan.

verses.name: Luke 1:77
verses.text: Pwen kawewe ong sapwilim a aramas kamaur, iei lapwa pan dip ar akan;

verses.name: Luke 1:78
verses.text: Pweki en atail Kot a kalangan melel, me marain dakaraki dong kitail sang poa.

verses.name: Luke 1:79
verses.text: Pwen kamaraini toun pali rotorot o mot en mela, o kainen ong nä atail nan al en popol.

verses.name: Luke 1:80
verses.text: A seri o kakairida, o kelail ni ngen e, o a kin mimi nan sap tan, lao a pan sansal ong Israel.<div eID="gen2658" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.1"/>

verses.name: Luke 2:1
verses.text: A KADEKADEO ni ran oko nanmarki Aukustus masani, toun sap akan pan wadawad pena.

verses.name: Luke 2:2
verses.text: I wadawad kaieu, me wiauier ni muein Kirenius kopina en Sirien.

verses.name: Luke 2:3
verses.text: Amen amen koieilang udan sap we, pwen iang wadawad.

verses.name: Luke 2:4
verses.text: Iosep ari pil kotila sang Nasaret nan Kaliläa, kotilang Iudäa nan kanim Petleem, me udan kanim en Dawid, pwe i kisan kadaudok en Dawid,

verses.name: Luke 2:5
verses.text: Pwen wadawad iangaki Maria, me kisin nin ong i o me lisean.

verses.name: Luke 2:6
verses.text: Kadekadeo ira lao kot wasa o, a ansau ap leler pwen naitik.

verses.name: Luke 2:7
verses.text: I ari naitikeda na meseni men, ap kitimki pena likau en seri kai, o pwilikidi ong nan deun kamanga man, aki im en kairu a koitalar.

verses.name: Luke 2:8
verses.text: Silepan sip kai mi nan sap o sinsila ar pwin sip ni pong.

verses.name: Luke 2:9
verses.text: A kilang, tounlang en Kaun amen pwara dong ir, o lingan en Kaun dakar irail ada, ir ari masapwekadar kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 2:10
verses.text: A tounlang o masani ong irail: Komail der masak, kilang, i wa dong komail rongamau, me pan kaperenda aramas karos.

verses.name: Luke 2:11
verses.text: Pwe Saunkamaur ipwidi ong komail ran wet nan kanim en Dawid iei Kaun Kristus.

verses.name: Luke 2:12
verses.text: A iet kilel ong komail: Komail pan diar seri o a kidikidiki pena likau en seri o wonon nan deun kamanga man.

verses.name: Luke 2:13
verses.text: A madang pwin en tounlang ngederenia mi ren tounlang o, me kapinga Kot masani:

verses.name: Luke 2:14
verses.text: Kapinga ong Kot wasa ileile o sappa en popol; o aramas konekonelar!

verses.name: Luke 2:15
verses.text: Kadekadeo tounlang kan lao kotila sang ir, kotidala nanlang, silepan sip akan ap inda nan pung arail: Kitail pan kola Petleem pwen kilang me wiauier wasa o, me Kaun o kotin kasale ong kitail er.

verses.name: Luke 2:16
verses.text: Irail ari madangedo, ap diaradar Maria i Iosep o seri o, a wonon nan deun kamanga man.

verses.name: Luke 2:17
verses.text: Irail lao kilanger, rap kalok sili me re kasokasoi ong ir duen kisin seri o.

verses.name: Luke 2:18
verses.text: A karos, me rongadar, puriamuiki en silepan sip oko ar kasokasoi ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 2:19
verses.text: A Maria nekinekid masan pukat karos o madamadauaki nan mongiong i.

verses.name: Luke 2:20
verses.text: O silepa ko puredo kalinganada o kapinga Kot duen karos, me irail rongadar o kilanger, duen a loloke dong irail er.

verses.name: Luke 2:21
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin pong walu pong, ran en a sirkomsais, re ki ong mar a Iesus, duen me tounlang kotiki ong mon a kotin ipwidier.

verses.name: Luke 2:22
verses.text: Ran akan en a kamakelekel lao daulier duen kapung en Moses, ira ap wa dong i Ierusalem, pwen mueid ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Luke 2:23
verses.text: Duen a intingidier nan kapung en Kaun o: Meseni ol karos me saraui ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Luke 2:24
verses.text: O pwen kida mairong eu, duen me intingidier nan kapung en Kaun: Turtel muroi riamen de muroi pulepul riamen.

verses.name: Luke 2:25
verses.text: A kilang, aramas amen mi Ierusalem, mar a Simeon, iei aramas o me pung o masak Kot, o auiaui kapol pan Israel, o Ngen saraui kotikot re a.

verses.name: Luke 2:26
verses.text: A Ngen saraui kotin kasale ong i, me a sota pan mela, mon a pan kilang sapwilim en Kaun Kristus.

verses.name: Luke 2:27
verses.text: O Ngen saraui kotiki ong i, en kolang im en kaudok. A sam o in a lao walong ong nan im en kaudok seri o, pwen kapwaiada duen tiak en kapung o,

verses.name: Luke 2:28
verses.text: I ap koledi i kapinga Kot indada:

verses.name: Luke 2:29
verses.text: Maing, re kotin kasamo sapwilim omui ladu popol duen omui masan,

verses.name: Luke 2:30
verses.text: Pwe mas ai udialer omui kamaur,

verses.name: Luke 2:31
verses.text: Me re kotin kauada sansal mon aramas karos.

verses.name: Luke 2:32
verses.text: Pwen marain eu, me kamaraineki men liki kan, o kalinganada sapwilim omui men Israel.

verses.name: Luke 2:33
verses.text: A sam a o in a puriamuiki meakan, me re indinda duen i.

verses.name: Luke 2:34
verses.text: Simeon ari kapai ir ada indang Maria in a: Kom kotin mangi, men et me sapwile dong kapupedi o kamaureda me toto ren men Israel, kilel eu, me re pan kaundenkoma.

verses.name: Luke 2:35
verses.text: Nan kodlas pan dokodi ngen omui, pwe mongiong en me toto en mulekiada.

verses.name: Luke 2:36
verses.text: O li saukop amen mia, mar a Ana, nain Panuel kisan kadaudok en Aser, me likailapalar, me papaud saunpar isu sang ni ansaun a makelekel.

verses.name: Luke 2:37
verses.text: I ari li odi men saunpar waleisok paieu tauer poa, ap sota kin pedoi sang nan im en kaudok, papa Kot kaisesol o kapakap ni ran o ni pong.

verses.name: Luke 2:38
verses.text: I me pil pwarado ni klok ota, kapinga Kaun o kasokasoi duen i ong toun Ierusalem karos, me auiaui saunkamaur.

verses.name: Luke 2:39
verses.text: Irail kanikiela karos duen kapung en Kaun o, re ap purelang Kaliläa nan kanim Nasaret.

verses.name: Luke 2:40
verses.text: A seri o kakairida, o ngenin, o dire kila erpit, o kalangan en Kot kotin ieiang i.

verses.name: Luke 2:41
verses.text: Ni par karos sam a o in a kotilang Ierusalem iang kamadip en pasa.

verses.name: Luke 2:42
verses.text: A lao saunpar eisokriau, irail ap kotilang Ierusalem, duen re kin wia, pwen iang kamadip en pasa.

verses.name: Luke 2:43
verses.text: Ran oko lao daulier, irail purelang sap arail, a seri Iesus kotikot eta Ierusalem, a sam o in a sota mangi.

verses.name: Luke 2:44
verses.text: A ira kiki ong, me a kotin iang kapar o tiong mo ’ra. Ira kokola ran eu, ap rapaki i nan pung en sau ’ra o ren men imp arail akan.

verses.name: Luke 2:45
verses.text: Ni ara sota diaradar i, ira ap purelang Ierusalem rapaki i.

verses.name: Luke 2:46
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin pong sili pong ira diaradar i nan im en kaudok, kaipokedi nan pung en snunpadak kan, kotin mamangi ir o kaikainoma irail.

verses.name: Luke 2:47
verses.text: A karos me rongadar i puriamuiki a kupurokong o a sapasapeng.

verses.name: Luke 2:48
verses.text: Ira lao diaradar i, ap puriamuiki. In a ap masani ong i: Nai seri, da me kom wiaki ong kit met? Mangi, sam omui o ngai raparapa kin komui sangesang.

verses.name: Luke 2:49
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ira: Menda koma rapa kin ia? Koma sota asa, me I en mimieta nan me Sam ai?

verses.name: Luke 2:50
verses.text: Ira ari sota weweki a masan ong ira.

verses.name: Luke 2:51
verses.text: A ap kotin iang ira kotidilang Nasaret papa ira, a in a nekinekid masan pukat karos nan mongiong i.

verses.name: Luke 2:52
verses.text: Iesus ari kupurokong, kokoda, lalaudela, o masamas ren Kot o aramas akan.<div eID="gen2659" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.2"/>

verses.name: Luke 3:1
verses.text: PAR eisoklimau murin nanmarki Tiperius a sapwileda ni muein Pontius Pilatus kopina en Iudäa, o Erodes nanmarki en Kaliläa, o ri a ol Pilipus nanmarki en Ituräa o Trakonitis, o Lisanias nanmarki en Apilene,

verses.name: Luke 3:2
verses.text: Ni muein Anas o Kaipas samero lapalap, masan en Kot ap pwara dong Ioanes nain Sakarias nan sap tan.

verses.name: Luke 3:3
verses.text: I ari kotikot sili nan sap karos ni kail en Iordan, padapadak duen paptais en kalula ong lapwada dip akan,

verses.name: Luke 3:4
verses.text: Duen a intingidier nan puk en masan akan en saukop Iesaia, me masani: Ngil eu likelikwir sili nan sap tan: Komail kaonopada al en Kaun o, kaineneda al a!

verses.name: Luke 3:5
verses.text: Wau karos pan audaud o nana o dol karos pan patapatedi, o me pirok, pan inenla, o me ululen, pan patapatela.

verses.name: Luke 3:6
verses.text: Uduk karos pan udial kamaur en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 3:7
verses.text: A ap masani ong aramas akan, me koieila, pwen paptaisla re a: Dakot, wan oter komail; is me padaki ong komail, en piti sang ni kamekam, me kokodo?

verses.name: Luke 3:8
verses.text: Ari komail kapareda wan kalula mau. A komail depa lamelame, me komail pan indang pein komail: Nan Apraam sam atail. Pwe i indai ong komail, me Kot kotin kak ong wiaki ong Apraam na seri kai takai pukat.

verses.name: Luke 3:9
verses.text: Sile o mier ni tapin tuka kan. Ari, tuka karos, me so wa mau, pan palepaledi o lokidokila nan iai.

verses.name: Luke 3:10
verses.text: Pokon o ap idok re a indada: A da me kit en wia?

verses.name: Luke 3:11
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Meamen, me a sakit riau, i en ki ong, me sota a. O me kan a kisin manga mia, i en wia dueta.

verses.name: Luke 3:12
verses.text: A saunopwei kan pil pwara dong i pwen paptais, irail potoan ong i: Saunpadak, a da me kit en wia?

verses.name: Luke 3:13
verses.text: A masani ong irail: Komail der ale laude sang me kileledier.

verses.name: Luke 3:14
verses.text: Saunpei kan ap pil kalelapok re a indada: A da me kit en wia? A masani ong irail: Komail der kaloke mal meamen, o der wia sapung ong meamen, a komail ale pwain omail o insenemau kila.

verses.name: Luke 3:15
verses.text: Aramas akan lao kiki ong o mongemongeloleki, me Ioanes me Kristus,

verses.name: Luke 3:16
verses.text: Ioanes ap sapeng masani ong irail karos: I paptais kin komail pil, a me laude sang ia kotido muri, me i sowar ong, en lapwada sal en sapwilim a sut, i me pan paptais kin komail Ngen saraui o kisiniai.

verses.name: Luke 3:17
verses.text: Tanir mi nan lim a, a pan kotin koko melel sapwilim a pera, ap nekid pena wan korn nan sapwilim a im en nak, a dip a pan kotin karong kila kisiniai sokun.

verses.name: Luke 3:18
verses.text: O song toto, me a kotin panaui aramas akan o padaki ong pokon o rongamau.

verses.name: Luke 3:19
verses.text: A nanmarki Erodes, me Ioanes kapung pweki Erodias en ri a ol a paud, o pweki sued karos, me Erodes wiadar,

verses.name: Luke 3:20
verses.text: Kalaudela dip a ni a saliedi Ioanes nan imateng.

verses.name: Luke 3:21
verses.text: A kadekadeo aramas karos lao paptaiselar, o Iesus pil paptaiselar o kotin laolaoki, nanlang ap ritida,

verses.name: Luke 3:22
verses.text: O Ngen saraui kotidi dong i ni mom en muroi men, o ngil eu sang nanlang masani: Koe nai Ol kompok, me I kin peren kida.

verses.name: Luke 3:23
verses.text: Iesus impan saunpar sileisok ni a kotin tapiada saunpadak, o re kikiong me i nain Iosep, me nain Eli,

verses.name: Luke 3:24
verses.text: Me nain Matat, me nain Lewi, me nain Melki, me nain Ianes, me nain Iosep,

verses.name: Luke 3:25
verses.text: Me nain Matatia, me nain Amos, me nain Naum, me nain Esli, me nain Nakai,

verses.name: Luke 3:26
verses.text: Me nain Maat, me nain Matatia, me nain Simei, me nain Iosep, me nain Iuda,

verses.name: Luke 3:27
verses.text: Me nain Ioanan, me nain Resa, me nain Serupapel, me nain Salatiel, me nain Neri,

verses.name: Luke 3:28
verses.text: Me nain Melki, me nain Adi, me nain Kosam, me nain Elmodam, me nain Er,

verses.name: Luke 3:29
verses.text: Me nain Ioses, me nain Elieser, me nain Iorim, me nain Matat, me nain Lewi,

verses.name: Luke 3:30
verses.text: Me nain Simeon, me nain Iuda, me nain Sosep, me nain Ionam, me nain Eliakim,

verses.name: Luke 3:31
verses.text: Me nain Melia, me nain Mena, me nain Matatan, me nain Natan. Me nain Dawid,

verses.name: Luke 3:32
verses.text: Me nain Iese, me nain Oped, me nain Poas, me nain Sala, me nain Naasan,

verses.name: Luke 3:33
verses.text: Me nain Aminadap, me nain Aram, me nain Esron, me nain Peres, me nain Iuda,

verses.name: Luke 3:34
verses.text: Me nain Iakop, me nain Isaak, me nain Apraam, me nain Tara, me nain Naor,

verses.name: Luke 3:35
verses.text: Me nain Seruk, me nain Reku, me nain Palek, me nain Eper, me nain Sala,

verses.name: Luke 3:36
verses.text: Me nain Kainan, me nain Arpaksad, me nain Sem, me nain Noa, me nain Lamek,

verses.name: Luke 3:37
verses.text: Me nain Metusala, me nain Enok, me nain Iared, me nain Maalaleel, me nain Kainan,

verses.name: Luke 3:38
verses.text: Me nain Enos, me nain Set, me nain Adam, me sapwilim en Kot.<div eID="gen2660" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.3"/>

verses.name: Luke 4:1
