verses.text: A IESUS, me dir en Ngen saraui, puredo sang Iordan, o Ngen kotin kalualang i nan sap tan.

verses.name: Luke 4:2
verses.text: O wia songesong pan tewil ran pangaul. A sota kotin konot ni ran oko. Ran akan lao imwisokela ap men konot.

verses.name: Luke 4:3
verses.text: Tewil ap indai ong i: Ma komui sapwilim en Kot, en masani ong takai wet, a en wiala prot.

verses.name: Luke 4:4
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng i masani: A intingidier: Kaidin prot eta, me aramas en memaureki, pwe masan en Kot akan.

verses.name: Luke 4:5
verses.text: Tewil ap kaluadalang i pon nana ileile eu o kasala ong i wein sappa karos ni marep taieu.

verses.name: Luke 4:6
verses.text: Tewil indang i: I pan ki ong komui manaman pukat karos o a lingan, pwe a muei ong ia er, a i pan ki ong, me i mauki.

verses.name: Luke 4:7
verses.text: Ari, ma komui pan pongi ia, karos ap pan sapwilim omui la.

verses.name: Luke 4:8
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng i masani: A intingidier: Koe en pongi ong Kaun om Kot; i eta, koe en papa.

verses.name: Luke 4:9
verses.text: I ap kalualang i Ierusalem o kauada i pon kongkong en im en kaudok o indai ong i: Ma komui sapwilim en Kot, kasedi pein komui,

verses.name: Luke 4:10
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier: A pan kasilaki sapwilim a tounlang kai komui, pwen apapwali komui.

verses.name: Luke 4:11
verses.text: O wa komui nan lim ar akan, pwe aluwilu omui der dipikelekel ni takai eu.

verses.name: Luke 4:12
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: A lolokido, koe ender kasongesong Kaun om Kot!

verses.name: Luke 4:13
verses.text: Tewil lao kanikiela songesong karos, ap muei sang i ansau kis.

verses.name: Luke 4:14
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin pure dong Kaliläa ni roson en Ngen, ap indand sili nan sap karos me mi imp a.

verses.name: Luke 4:15
verses.text: A kotin kaukawewe nan ar sinakoke kan, o karos kapinga i.

verses.name: Luke 4:16
verses.text: A kotin lel Nasaret, wasa a kotin kakairida ia, ap kotilong song nan sinakoke duen a kin wiada ni ran en sapat o kotida, pwen wadok.

verses.name: Luke 4:17
verses.text: Puk en saukop Iesaia ap wisike dong i a lao lim pasang puk o ap diarada wasa o me intingidier:

verses.name: Luke 4:18
verses.text: Ngen en Kaun kotikot re i, i me a keie kin ia da, pwen padaki ong me samama kan rongamau. A kadar ia do, pwen kaloki ong me salidi kan, me ren saladokela, o me maskun akan pan kilang wasa, o me patau kan pan maioda,

verses.name: Luke 4:19
verses.text: O kaloki saunpar mau en Kaun o.

verses.name: Luke 4:20
verses.text: A kotin lim pena puk o ap kupure ong me papa men o kotidi. Mas en karos nan sinakoke kangkakil i.

verses.name: Luke 4:21
verses.text: I ari tapiada masani ong irail: Kisin likau wet pwaidar mo ’mail ran wet.

verses.name: Luke 4:22
verses.text: Ir karos ap kadede o puriamuiki masan kompok kan, me pwili sang silang i, ap indada: Kaidin i nain Iosep?

verses.name: Luke 4:23
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Nan melel, komail pan indang ia karaseras wet: Saunwini, sauasa pein uk! Pwe se rongadar duen song kapuriamui, me wiauier nan Kapernaum; ari kom pil wiada dueta wasa et nan sap omui.

verses.name: Luke 4:24
verses.text: A kotin masani: Melel I indai ong komail, sota saukop amen me konekon nan sap we.

verses.name: Luke 4:25
verses.text: A melel I indai ong komail, li odi toto mi nan Israel ni muein Elias, ni ansau nanlang matata par silu o saunipong wonu, ni lek lapalap kipadi sap karos;

verses.name: Luke 4:26
verses.text: A sota amen, me Elias pakadar wong, pwe ren li odi men nan Sarepta nan sap Sidon.

verses.name: Luke 4:27
verses.text: O me tuketuk kan me toto nan Israel ni muein saukop Elias, a sota amen re ’rail, me kelailadar, pwe Naeman eta men Sirien.

verses.name: Luke 4:28
verses.text: Karos, me mi nan sinakoke ni ar rongadar mepukat, ap makar kida kaualap,

verses.name: Luke 4:29
verses.text: Re udar sikonlar i sang kanim o, o kalualang i pon kailan dol o, wasa ar kanim kakaudar ia, pwen kasedi sang ia,

verses.name: Luke 4:30
verses.text: A i kotin weid nan pung ar, kotila sang irail.

verses.name: Luke 4:31
verses.text: I ari kotilang Kapernaum kanim en Kaliläa, o kotin kawewe ong irail ni ran en sapat akan.

verses.name: Luke 4:32
verses.text: Irail ari puriamuiki a padak, pwe a masan me manaman.

verses.name: Luke 4:33
verses.text: A aramas amen mi nan sinakoke, me ngen en tewil saut amen ti po a, me weriwer laud,

verses.name: Luke 4:34
verses.text: Inda: Ko sang kit, menda re omui kit Iesus en Nasaret! Kom kotido, en kawe kit ala. I asa, me komui nain Kot saraui.

verses.name: Luke 4:35
verses.text: Iesus ap kidaue i masani: Nenenla o ko sang re a. Tewil lao kasedi i nan pung arail, ap koiei sang re a, sota me sued kot a wiai ong i.

verses.name: Luke 4:36
verses.text: Irail karos ap puriamui kila, kasokasoi nan pung arail indada: Dakot masan pot et? Pwe a masan manaman o roson ong ngen saut akan, irail ap kin ko wei sang.

verses.name: Luke 4:37
verses.text: I ari indand sili nin sap karos wasa o.

verses.name: Luke 4:38
verses.text: I ap kotida sang nan sinakoke, ap kotilong ong nan im en Simon. A saulap en Simon me somau karakar. Irail ari poekipoeki i re a.

verses.name: Luke 4:39
verses.text: I ari koti dong i masani ong somau o, ap madang ko sang, i ari madang paurida papa irail.

verses.name: Luke 4:40
verses.text: Katipin lao kirilar, rap wa dong i ar luet akan karos. I ari kotikidang amen amen lim a kan, kakelail ir ada.

verses.name: Luke 4:41
verses.text: O tewil akan pil kowei sang ren me toto, me weriwer indada: Komui sapwilim en Kot. I ari kotin kidau ir ada, o sota mueid ong irail, en lokaia, pwe re asa, me i Kristus.

verses.name: Luke 4:42
verses.text: A lao wasa ran a kotilang wasa rir, a pokon o raparapaki i, re pokon dong i o kolekol i pwen der koti wei sang irail.

verses.name: Luke 4:43
verses.text: A i kotin masani ong ir: I pil pan padaki rongamau en wein Kot nan kanim tei ko, pwe i me I pakadar kidor.

verses.name: Luke 4:44
verses.text: A i kotin padapadak nan sinakoke en Kaliläa kan.<div eID="gen2661" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.4"/>

verses.name: Luke 5:1
verses.text: A KADEKADEO ni en aramas toto ar tanga dong imp a, pwen rongerong masan en Kot, a kotikot pon kailan le en Kaliläa,

verses.name: Luke 5:2
verses.text: Ap masani kisin sop riapot, me peipei nan le o, a saused akai keredi sanger widen ar uk kai.

verses.name: Luke 5:3
verses.text: I ari kotida pon apot ren sop oko, war en Simon, kotin poeki re a, en kaiieila ekis sang ni sap o. I ari kaipokedi, kawewe ong aramas sang nan sop o.

verses.name: Luke 5:4
verses.text: I lao kaimwisokela a masan, ap masani ong Simon: Seisei kowei wasa lol, ap kaduedi oma uk kan, pwe koma en saikidi.

verses.name: Luke 5:5
verses.text: A Simon sapeng potoan ong i: Maing, se laiter pong lao lel wasa ran, ap sota saik at, ari so ar masan, me i pan kaduekidi uk en.

verses.name: Luke 5:6
verses.text: Irail lao wiadar met, rap oro pena mam toto; ara uk ari ola.

verses.name: Luke 5:7
verses.text: Irail ari olole kis arail oko, me mi nin apot sop, pwe re en kodo sauasa irail. Irail ari kodo, kadirela sop riapot, ira ari pan mauidi.

verses.name: Luke 5:8
verses.text: Simon Petrus lao kilanger mepukat, ap poridi sang Iesus, potoan ong: Maing, re kotiwei sang ia, pwe aramas sued amen ngai.

verses.name: Luke 5:9
verses.text: Pwe a puriamuiki o ir karos, me iang i, pweki saik ar, me re saikidi.

verses.name: Luke 5:10
verses.text: A pil dueta Iakopus o Ioanes nain Sepedäus ol oko, me iang Simon. Iesus ap kotin masani ong Simon: Koe der masak, pwe sang ansau wet kokola koe pan saikidi aramas.

verses.name: Luke 5:11
verses.text: Irail kaikilong ong liman sap ar sop oko, re ap kasela karos, idauendo i.

verses.name: Luke 5:12
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni a kotikot nan eu kanim, kilang, ol amen mia, me dir en tuketuk. A lao kilanger Iesus, ap pupekidi mas a, poeki re a potoan ong: Maing, ma re kotin kupura, re pan kak ong kamakel ia da.

verses.name: Luke 5:13
verses.text: I ari kotin kapawei lim a sair i masani: I men, koe en makelekel. Ari, a tuketuk madang modi sang.

verses.name: Luke 5:14
verses.text: I ari kotin inapwiedi i, en der indang meamen; a kola kasale ong pein uk samero ko, o kida mairong, pweki om makelekeladar, me Moses masanier, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 5:15
verses.text: A a madang indand sili o pokon kalaimun pokon pena, pwen rong i o kelailada sang ar somau kan.

verses.name: Luke 5:16
verses.text: I ari kotin kelepela nan sap tan, pwen laolao.

verses.name: Luke 5:17
verses.text: Kadekadeo eu ran ni a kotin kaukaweweda, Parisär o saunkawewe kan, me mod imp a, irail pwarado sang kanim en Kaliläa o Iudäa karos o sang Ierusalem; a roson en Kaun o pwili wei sang i, kakelada amen amen.

verses.name: Luke 5:18
verses.text: A kilang, ol akai roado aramas amen me kokon madak, rap raparapaki duen ar pan kak walang lole, pwilikidi mo a.

verses.name: Luke 5:19
verses.text: A ni ar sota kak diar wasa, me re pan kai dong impa pweki pokon o, rap dauda pon im o, kakiridi i nan os iangaki pet, lao nan pung arail mon Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 5:20
verses.text: A lao mangi arail poson, ap kotin masani: Aramas o, dip om akan lapwa sang uk er.

verses.name: Luke 5:21
verses.text: A saunkawewe o Parisär akan ap mongemongeloleki indada: Is men et, me kin lalaue? Is me kak lapwada dip akan, pwe Kot eta?

verses.name: Luke 5:22
verses.text: A Iesus lao mangi ar mongemongelol, ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Da me komail kin mongemongeloleki lol omail?

verses.name: Luke 5:23
verses.text: Da me mongai ren inda, dip om akan lapwa sang uk er, de inda, uda, aluwei?

verses.name: Luke 5:24
verses.text: A pwe komail en asa, me Nain aramas manaman ong lapwada dip akan nin sappa, iei me a kotin masanieki ong me kokon madak: I indai ong uk, uda, ale ki om kola deu om!

verses.name: Luke 5:25
verses.text: A madang uda mo ’rail, kida a pet, me a wonon poa, koieilang im a kapikapinga Kot.

verses.name: Luke 5:26
verses.text: Ir karos ap puriamui kida o kapikapinga Kot, o dire kila masak indada: Ran wet kitail kilanger me kapwuriamui melel.

verses.name: Luke 5:27
verses.text: Murin mepukat a kotila sang wasa o, ap masani saunopwei amen, ad a Lewi momod nan wasan nopwei, ap masan ong i: Idauen ia do!

verses.name: Luke 5:28
verses.text: I ari kasela a meakaros, uda, idauenla i.

verses.name: Luke 5:29
verses.text: Lewi ari wiada kamadip lapalap ong i nan im a; a saunopwei ape me toto, me iang i ni tepel.

verses.name: Luke 5:30
verses.text: A Parisär o arail saunkawewe kan lipaned ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan indada: Da me komail iangaki saunopwei o me dipan akan manga o nim.

verses.name: Luke 5:31
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Me kelail sota mau ong saunwini, pwe me somau kan.

verses.name: Luke 5:32
verses.text: I kodon ekeker dong kalula me dipan akan a kaidin me pung kan.

verses.name: Luke 5:33
verses.text: Irail ap potoan ong i: Da me tounpadak en Ioanes akan kaisesol pan pak toto o re kapakap toto, o pil dueta en Parisär akan, a sapwilim omui kan kin tungole o nim?

verses.name: Luke 5:34
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: O komail sota kak ki ong toun kapar en kamadip en kapapaud en kaisesol arain ol kamod mi re ’rail!

verses.name: Luke 5:35
verses.text: A eu ran ol kamod pan peuka wei sang irail, i ran oko re ap pan kaisesol.

verses.name: Luke 5:36
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail karaseras eu: Sota me kin deik ong likau kap ni likau maring; a ma ei, a pan ter pasang likau kap; a kisan likau kap pil sota pan paroki ong likau maring.

verses.name: Luke 5:37
verses.text: A sota me kin kodie ong wain kap nan ed maring; a ma ei, wain kap pan ter pasang ed akan, ap wudokila o ed akan pan ola.

verses.name: Luke 5:38
verses.text: A re kin kodie ong wain kap nan ed kap, ira karos ap nekinek mau.

verses.name: Luke 5:39
verses.text: O sota, me kin nim sang wain maring, pan mauki wain kap, pwe a kin inda: Me maring o me mau sang.<div eID="gen2662" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.5"/>

verses.name: Luke 6:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO ni ran en sapat kariau a kotin weid nan mat en korn o sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap dolung wan korn o irriris nan pa arail, ap kangkang.

verses.name: Luke 6:2
verses.text: A Parisär akai indang irail: Menda komail kin wiada, me sota pung, en wiaui ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: Luke 6:3
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail sota wadoker, me Dawid wiadar ni a men mangadar, i o me iang i?

verses.name: Luke 6:4
verses.text: Duen a pedelong ong nan tanpas en Kot, o ale prot en kasansal, o kangkang o pil ki ong me iang i, me sota pung, aramas en tungole, samero kan eta?

verses.name: Luke 6:5
verses.text: O masani ong irail: Nain aramas pil kaun en sapat.

verses.name: Luke 6:6
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni eu sapat a kotilong ong nan sinakoke kaweweda. A aramas amen mia, me pa a pali maun motorla.

verses.name: Luke 6:7
verses.text: A saunkawewe o Parisär akan masamasan i, ma a pan kakelada i ni ran en sapat, pwe re en kadipa i.

verses.name: Luke 6:8
verses.text: A kotin angi ar lamelam ap masani ong aramas o, me pa a motorla: Uda kodo met! A ap uda ko ong wasa o.

verses.name: Luke 6:9
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: I men idok re omail, da me pung en wiada ni ran en sapat ren me mau de me sued? En kolekol de kawela maur en aramas?

verses.name: Luke 6:10
verses.text: I ari kotin aupwil sili po ’rail masani ong i: Kapawei pa om! A ap wiada, pa a ap kelailada, a maula dueta me teio.

verses.name: Luke 6:11
verses.text: Irail ap makaradar kaualap o kapukapung pena, da me re pan wiai ong Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 6:12
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni ran oko, a kotidala pon nana pwen laolao. I ari kotin laolao ong Kot lao wasa ran.

verses.name: Luke 6:13
verses.text: A lao ran pasang, ap kotin molipei pena sapwilim a tounpadak kan. A kotin piladar ekriamen, me a kamareki wanporon.

verses.name: Luke 6:14
verses.text: Simon me a kotin kaadaneki Petrus, o ri a Andreas, o Iakopus, o Ioanes, o Pilipus, o Partolomäus,

verses.name: Luke 6:15
verses.text: O Matäus, o Tomas, o Iakopus nain Alpäus, o Simon, me adaneki Selotes,

verses.name: Luke 6:16
verses.text: O Iudas nain Iakopus, o Iudas Iskariot, me pangala i.

verses.name: Luke 6:17
verses.text: A lao kotin iang ir kotidi dong wasa kis nan sap patapat o, sapwilim a tounpadak kan toto o aramas ngederenia pokon dong i sang nan Iudäa, o Ierusalem, o Tirus, o Sidon, re mi pon oror, pwen rong i o kakelailada sang ar somau kan;

verses.name: Luke 6:18
verses.text: O me kalokolok ren ngen saut akan ap kelailadar.

verses.name: Luke 6:19
verses.text: A aramas karos men doke i, pwe roson kin pwiliwei sang i, kakel irail karos.

verses.name: Luke 6:20
verses.text: A ap kotin aupwil sili pon sapwilim a tounpadak kan masani: Meid pai komail, me samama, pwe noumail wein nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 6:21
verses.text: Meid pai komail, me men mangadar ansau wet, pwe komail pan medila. Meid pai komail, me kin sangesang ansau wet, pwe komail pan kaurur.

verses.name: Luke 6:22
verses.text: Komail meid pai, ma aramas akan kailong kin komail, o kase komail la, o kidaue komail, o kawela ad omail, pwe dene me sued, pweki Nain aramas.

verses.name: Luke 6:23
verses.text: Komail en peren ni ran o, o lusilus, pwe kilang, pwain omail me lapalap nanlang, pwe iduen me sam arail akan wiai ong saukop akan.

verses.name: Luke 6:24
verses.text: A me suedi ong komail kapwapwa kan, pwe komail anekier omail peren.

verses.name: Luke 6:25
verses.text: Suedi ong komail, me medier, pwe komail pan dupokala. Suedi ong komail, me kin peren ansau wet, pwe komail pan mauk o sangesang.

verses.name: Luke 6:26
verses.text: Suedi ong komail, ma aramas akan karos pan lokaia mau kin komail; pwe iduen me sam arail akan wiai ong saukop likam akan.

verses.name: Luke 6:27
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, me kin rongerong, pok ong omail imwintiti, wiawia mau ong me kin kailong kin komail,

verses.name: Luke 6:28
verses.text: Kapaiada, me kin karia komail la, kapakapa kin ir, me kainsensuede kin komail;

verses.name: Luke 6:29
verses.text: O me pikir uk ni apali en likin sap om, pil ki ong i pali teio, o me pan ki sang om likau pup, pil mueid ong i noum sakit.

verses.name: Luke 6:30
verses.text: Ki ong karos, me kin poeki re om, o me pan atia sang om kapwa, koe der poeki re a, a kapuredo.

verses.name: Luke 6:31
verses.text: A duen me komail men, aramas en wiai ong komail, iduen me komail en wiai ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 6:32
verses.text: Pwe ma komail pok ong, me kin pokepoke komail, da me pan kating pamail? Pwe me dipan akan pil kin pok ong kompoke parail.

verses.name: Luke 6:33
verses.text: A ma komail wiawia mau ong, me wia mau ong komail, da me pan kating pamail? Pwe me dipan akan kin wia pil dueta.

verses.name: Luke 6:34
verses.text: A ma komail pan ki ong irail, me komail akpwainongki, da me pan kating pamail? Pwe me dipan akan pil kin wiai ong me dipan, pwen ale me dueta.

verses.name: Luke 6:35
verses.text: A pok ong omail imwintiti, o wiawia mau, o ki ong so akapwainok, a pwain omail pan lapalap, o komail pan seri en me lapalap o. Pwe a kupura, me so danke o me sued akan.

verses.name: Luke 6:36
verses.text: Komail ari kadek rasong Sam omail me kalangan.

verses.name: Luke 6:37
verses.text: Ender kadeikada a komail sota pan pakadeikada. Ender kariala, a komail sota pan kariala. Lapwada, a komail pan lapwada.

verses.name: Luke 6:38
verses.text: Kisakisa wei, a a pan depuk ong komail dal mau eu, me idang pena, o itik pena, o dir kaualap, me pan ko ong komail. Pwe men song ota, me komail kin songki, iduen a pil pan song ong komail.

verses.name: Luke 6:39
verses.text: A kotin pil masani ong irail karaseras eu: Da, me maskun pan kak kare me maskun? Ira karos sota pan pupedi nan por o?

verses.name: Luke 6:40
verses.text: Tounpadak sota kin laude sang a saunpadak. Ma tounpadak paroki ong a saunpadak, nan a unsokala.

verses.name: Luke 6:41
verses.text: A menda koe kilekilang pul ni mas en ri om ol, ap sota kan ataut o ni pein mas om?

verses.name: Luke 6:42
verses.text: De iaduen, koe pan indang ri om: Ri ai, aui mas, i pan ki sang pul ni mas om, ap sota kilang ataut o ni mas om? Malaun amen koe, ki sang mas ataut o ni mas om, a koe ap pan kak kilang, duen om pan kak kisang pul, me mi ni mas en ri om.

verses.name: Luke 6:43
verses.text: Pwe tuka mau sota pan wa sued. Pil sota tuka sued pan wa mau.

verses.name: Luke 6:44
verses.text: Tuka karos kin diarok kida a wa. Pwe aramas sota kak dolung sang pik ni tuka kamadak, aramas pil sota kin dolung sang wan wain ni tuka mal.

verses.name: Luke 6:45
verses.text: Aramas mau amen kin kapwareda me mau sang nan a pai mau en mongiong i, a me sued amen kin kapwareda me sued sang nan a sued, pwe aua kin kida sang nan audepan mongiong o.

verses.name: Luke 6:46
verses.text: A iaduen, komail kin indang ia: Maing, Maing, ap sota kin wiada, me I kin inda?

verses.name: Luke 6:47
verses.text: Meamen ko dong ia o rongerong ai masan kan, o kapwaiada, nan I pan kasale ong komail, me a rasong.

verses.name: Luke 6:48
verses.text: Nan i me rasong aramas amen, me kauada im eu o weirada lol, o pasonedi pon paip. A lapake lao pwilido, ad ap maimai ong im o, ap so kak kamokidedala, pwe a kakau pon paip o.

verses.name: Luke 6:49
verses.text: A meamen rongerong, ap sota kapwaiada, nan a rasong aramas amen, me kauada im eu nan pwel so pasonedi. A lapake pwil maiai ong, a ap madang rongk pasang, o ola en im o me laud.<div eID="gen2663" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.6"/>

verses.name: Luke 7:1
verses.text: A LAO kotin erela a masan akan karos ong pokon o, a ap kotilang Kapernaum.

verses.name: Luke 7:2
verses.text: Ladun senturion amen mia, me kasampwal re a, me somau, a pan mela.

verses.name: Luke 7:3
verses.text: A lao rongada duen Iesus, ap poronelang i saumas en Sus akan, poeki re a, en kotido kakelailada a ladu.

verses.name: Luke 7:4
verses.text: Irail lao pwara dong Iesus, ap ngidingideki i potoan ong: A war ong, ren kotin wiai ong i mepukat.

verses.name: Luke 7:5
verses.text: Pwe a kin pok ong toun sap atail o kauadang kit sinakoke o.

verses.name: Luke 7:6
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin iang ir ala. A ni solar non doo sang im o, senturion ap poronelang i kompok kai, potoan ong: Maing re der kangere ir kotido, pwe i sowar, ren ketlong ong nan im ai.

verses.name: Luke 7:7
verses.text: Ngai ari sota kin aka, me i war ong poto dong ir. A re kotin masaniata; a ai ladu pan kelailada.

verses.name: Luke 7:8
verses.text: Pwe ngai pil aramas amen, me mi pan manaman akan, ap kaunda saunpei kai. A ma i pan, indang amen: Kowei! A pan kola; o ong amen: Kodo! A pan kodo; o ong ai ladu: Wiada met! A pan wiada.

verses.name: Luke 7:9
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin puriamui kila, saupei dong pokon o, me idauendo i, masani: I indai ong komail, me I saik diar poson lapalap duen met, sota ren men Israel.

verses.name: Luke 7:10
verses.text: A me pakadarala kan lao purelong ong nan im o, re ap diarada, me ladu o kelailada.

verses.name: Luke 7:11
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin mepukat a kotilang kanim eu ad a Nain; sapwilim a tounpadak kan toto iang i; o aramas pil me toto.

verses.name: Luke 7:12
verses.text: A lao koren iong wanim en kanim o, kilang, melar amen, me re wawei, ieros en in a, a iei li odi amen; a toun kanim me toto iang i.

verses.name: Luke 7:13
verses.text: Kaun o lao masani i, ap kotin kupurela, masani ong i: Eder sangesang.

verses.name: Luke 7:14
verses.text: I ari koti ong, doke kopa o, a me roa kan ap udi. I ap kotin masani: Manakap, I indai ong uk, paurida!

verses.name: Luke 7:15
verses.text: A me melar o ap modada, pikekidi lokaia. Iesus ap kotiki ong i ren in a,

verses.name: Luke 7:16
verses.text: Masak ap kipa ir edi, o kapikapinga Kot indada: Nan saukop lapalap amen, me pwarado re atail, o Kot me kotier ren sapwilim a aramas akan.

verses.name: Luke 7:17
verses.text: A kasoi pot et duen i lolok sili nan Iudäa o sap karos, me mi imp a.

verses.name: Luke 7:18
verses.text: En Ioanes a tounpadak kan kaire kin i mepukat karos.

verses.name: Luke 7:19
verses.text: Ioanes ap molipeido sapwilim a tounpadak kan riamen, porone ira lang Iesus, masanlang i: Ir me pan kotido, de sen auiaui amen?

verses.name: Luke 7:20
verses.text: Ol oko lao poto dong i, ap potoan ong: Ioanes saunpaptais kadar kit dong ir potoan kalelapok: Ir me pan kotido, de sen auiaui amen?

verses.name: Luke 7:21
verses.text: A ni auer ota a kotin kakelada me toto sang ar somau, o luet, o ngen sued akan, o kotin kapad pasang mas en me maskun toto.

verses.name: Luke 7:22
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Koma u kowei, kaireki Ioanes, meakan komail kilanger o ronger: Me maskun akan kilangada wasa, o me luet akan kin alialu, o me tuketuk kan makelekeleda, o me salongepon kin rong wasa, o me melar akan kin maureda, o rongamau me lolok ong me samama kan.

verses.name: Luke 7:23
verses.text: O meid pai, me sota pan makar kin ia!

verses.name: Luke 7:24
verses.text: A men kadar en Ioanes lao purela, Iesus ap kotin tapiada masani ong pokon o duen Ioanes: Da me komail koieila en kilang nan sap tan? Komail men kilang alek pot, me kin dueduälokki ang?

verses.name: Luke 7:25
verses.text: De da me komail koieila en kilang? Komail men kilang aramas amen, me likau kida likau muterok? Kilang, me kin likau kida likau lingan, o kaped en manga, kin mi nan im en nanmarki kan.

verses.name: Luke 7:26
verses.text: De da me komail koieila en kilang? Saukop amen? Ei, I indai ong komail, a laude sang saukop amen.

verses.name: Luke 7:27
verses.text: Pwe iei i me intingidier due: Kilang, I kadarala mo mui nai men kadar amen, me pan koki al mo ’mui.

verses.name: Luke 7:28
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, sota saukop amen me ipwi sang ren li akan, me laude sang Ioanes saunpaptais, ari so, me tikitik nan wein Kot, iei me laude sang i.

verses.name: Luke 7:29
verses.text: A aramas karos, me rongerong i, o saunopwei kan kapinga Kot ni ar iang paptaiseki paptais en Ioanes.

verses.name: Luke 7:30
verses.text: A Parisär o saunkawewe kan sapai ong pein irail ni ar mamaleki kupur en Kot, ap sota iang paptais re a.

verses.name: Luke 7:31
verses.text: A da me I en karasai ong aramas en di wet? O da me irail rasong?

verses.name: Luke 7:32
verses.text: Irail me rasong seri kai, me kin momod nan wasan net akan o likelikwir nan pung arail indinda: Kit kasakasang, a komail sota kakalek; kit kamamauke kin komail, a komail sota sangesang.

verses.name: Luke 7:33
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes saunpaptais pwarado, ap sota kang prot, o sota nim wain, a komail kin inda: Nan tewil kin di poa.

verses.name: Luke 7:34
verses.text: Nain aramas pwarado, manga o nim, a komail kin inda: Kilang, me kaped en manga o kamom sakau, kompoke pan saunopwei o me dipan akan!

verses.name: Luke 7:35
verses.text: A lolekong kin diarok kida na seri kan karos.

verses.name: Luke 7:36
verses.text: A Parisär amen poeki i, en konot re a. I ari kotilong ong nan im en Parisär o kaipokedi ni tepel.

verses.name: Luke 7:37
verses.text: A kilang, li amen mi nan kanim o, me dipan amen, a lao asa, me Iesus kotikot konot nan im en Parisär o, ap wado kokon en alapasta,

verses.name: Luke 7:38
verses.text: O poridi mur i ni aluwilu a sangesang o pikekidi widenki pil en mas a aluwilu a, o limwieki a pwilipeipei, o metik aluwilu a kan o keieki alapasta.

verses.name: Luke 7:39
verses.text: A Parisär o, me lukedo i lao kilanger, ap mongemongeloleki indada: Ma ol men et saukop amen, a pan asa, is li o, me sair i, pwe me dipan amen.

verses.name: Luke 7:40
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong i: Simon, I men indai ong uk meakot. I ari indada: Saunpadak, masania do!

verses.name: Luke 7:41
verses.text: Ol amen mia, me aramas riamen pwaipwand ong. Amen ira pwaipwandeki denar limepuki, a amen limeisok,

verses.name: Luke 7:42
verses.text: A ni ara sota men kapungala, a kisakisa kin ira la karos. Indang ia, is re ’ra, me pan pok ong i laud?

verses.name: Luke 7:43
verses.text: Simon sapeng potoan ong: I lamelame i, me a kisakis laud ong. A kotin masani ong i: Koe meid pung kasauiada.

verses.name: Luke 7:44
verses.text: I ari saupei dong li o masani ong Simon: Koe kilang li men et, I pedelong ong nan im om, a koe sota ki ong ia pil men widen nä i kat, a i me widenki pil en mas a nä i kat, o limwieki a pwilipeipei.

verses.name: Luke 7:45
verses.text: Koe sota metik ia, a i sota tukedi sang metik nä i kat, sang ni a pedelong lao lel met.

verses.name: Luke 7:46
verses.text: Koe sota usore kin ia le, a met keiekier nä i kat alapasta.

verses.name: Luke 7:47
verses.text: Nan i me I indaki ong uk: Dip a kan me toto me lapwadar, pwe a kin limpok laud; a me dip a sota non lapwada, nan a kin limpok tikitik.

verses.name: Luke 7:48
verses.text: I ari masani ong li o: Dip om akan me lapwadar.

verses.name: Luke 7:49
verses.text: A me iang mod ni tepel o ap tapiada inda nang pung ar: Is men et, me pil kin lapwada dip akan?

verses.name: Luke 7:50
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong li o: Om poson me dore uk ala, kowei popol!<div eID="gen2664" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.7"/>

verses.name: Luke 8:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO murin mepukat a kotin kakan sili nan kanim laud o me tikitik kan, padapadak o kaloki rongamau en wein Kot, o ekriamen iang i.

verses.name: Luke 8:2
verses.text: O pil li akai, me a kotin kakelailada sang ngen sued o somau kan, iet akan: Maria, me pil adaneki men Makdala, me tewil isimen koiei sang.

verses.name: Luke 8:3
verses.text: O Ioana iei likond en Kusas en Erodes a saunkoa men, o Susana, o me toto, me papaki i ar kapwa kan.

verses.name: Luke 8:4
verses.text: A aramas totoia lao pokon dong i sang nan kanim akan, karos, ap kotin karaseras masani:

verses.name: Luke 8:5
verses.text: Saunkamor kolan kamor a war akan. Ni a kamokamorok akai ap moredi ong pon kailan al ap tiatidi o manpir en pan lang nam ir ala.

verses.name: Luke 8:6
verses.text: A akai moredi ong pon paip. A lao wosada, a mongedi, pweki a sota lamelamur.

verses.name: Luke 8:7
verses.text: Akai moredi nan tuka teketek, a tuka teketek wosada, kasokä ir ala.

verses.name: Luke 8:8
verses.text: A akai moredi nan pwel mau, ap wosada o wada pan me epuki. Ni a kotin masanier mepukat, ap masan laudeda: Me salong a mia, men rong, i en rong!

verses.name: Luke 8:9
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kalelapok re a: Ia wewe en karaseras wet?

verses.name: Luke 8:10
verses.text: I ari kotin masani: A muei ong komail er, en asa me rir en wein Kot, a met akan en asa ni karaseras akan pwe ren kilang, ap sota kilang, o rong, ap sota weweki.

verses.name: Luke 8:11
verses.text: A iet wewe en karaseras o: Masan en Kot iei war akan.

verses.name: Luke 8:12
verses.text: A me mi pon kailan al o, iei ir, me rongadar, a muri tewil pwarada katia sang masan en Kot nan mongiong arail, pwe ren der poson, rap maurela.

verses.name: Luke 8:13
verses.text: A me mi pon paip, iei ir, me kin rong masan o ap pereperen ale, a sota kalau re ’rail. Ansau kis re kin poson, a ni ansaun songesong, irail kin pupe sang.

verses.name: Luke 8:14
verses.text: A me moredi nan tuka teketek, iei irail me kin rong, ap koieila tiropeki anan o pai, o inong sued en maur et, rap sokekila, ap sota wa.

verses.name: Luke 8:15
verses.text: A nan sap mau, iei irail, me kin rong masan o, ap nekinek nan mongiong ar inen o mau, o wada nin tiak en kanongama.

verses.name: Luke 8:16
verses.text: Sota me kin isikeda lamp, ap pwainekidi kopa eu, de ki ong pan men wendi a pon deu a, pwe me pan pedelong ong en kilang marain o.

verses.name: Luke 8:17
verses.text: Pwe sota me rir kot, me so pan sansaleta, pil sota me okiok kot, me so pan kalok sili.

verses.name: Luke 8:18
verses.text: Komail ari kalaka duen omail kin rongerong, pwe me a mia, ekis pan ko ong; a me sota a mia, i, me a kiki ong, me a, pan katia sang.

verses.name: Luke 8:19
verses.text: In a o ri a kan ap ko dong i, a re sota kak kaiong impa pweki pokon o.

verses.name: Luke 8:20
verses.text: A ap loki ong i: In ar o ri ar akan poto liki, re men udial ir.

verses.name: Luke 8:21
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: In ai o ri ai mepukat, me kin rongerong masan en Kot o apapwali.

verses.name: Luke 8:22
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni eu ran a kotilang pon apot sop, a sapwilim a tounpadak kan iang i. A kotin masani ong irail: Kitail en kotela le en: Irail ari tangetang koieila.

verses.name: Luke 8:23
verses.text: O ni ar tangetang kokowei, a kotin saimokela; melimel ap koda nan sed. A sop o pwilipwil, a pan mauidi.

verses.name: Luke 8:24
verses.text: Irail ap kai dong i, kaopada i, potoan ong: Maing, Maing, kit pan mela! I ari kipada masani ong ang o iluk en sed akan, rap tikitikala o molelar.

verses.name: Luke 8:25
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong irail: Ia omail poson? A irail masakada inda nan pung ar: Daduen, is men et, pwe a kin masani ong ang o sed, ir ari duki ong.

verses.name: Luke 8:26
verses.text: Irail ap lele dong sap en Kadara, me sal ong Kaliläa.

verses.name: Luke 8:27
verses.text: I lao kotidi sang, ol amen tu ong i, me kodo sang kanim o, me tanwar en tewil sang mas kokodo, o me kiliso, o a sota kin kauson nan im, pwe a kin mimi nan sousou kan.

verses.name: Luke 8:28
verses.text: I lao kilang Iesus, ap werida, poridi sang mo a indaki ngil laud: Menda re omui ngai, Iesus Sapwilim en Kot lapalap? I men poeki re omui, kom der kalok ia la!

verses.name: Luke 8:29
verses.text: Pwe a kotin masani ong ngen saut o, en koiei sang ren aramas o, pwe pan pak toto a saikidi i; i ari kin sali kidi sal mata o sal en nä kai. A i kamueit ir pasang, o tewil paki i lang sap tan.

verses.name: Luke 8:30
verses.text: Iesus kotin kainoma re a masani: Ia ad om? A potoan ong: Lekion; pwe tewil toto mi re a.

verses.name: Luke 8:31
verses.text: Ir ari poeki re a, ender masani ong irail, me ren kodilang pweleko.

verses.name: Luke 8:32
verses.text: Ari, pwin pwik kalaimun mi wasa o mangamanga sili nin nana o. Irail ari poeki i, en kotin mueid ong irail re en til ong irail. I ari kotin mueid ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 8:33
verses.text: Tewil oko ap kodi sang ren aramas o, ap tilong nan pwin pwik o. Pwin pwik o ap tangedi wei ni aul ong nan sed ap mopila.

verses.name: Luke 8:34
verses.text: Silepa ko lao kilanger me wiauier, rap tangdaui, kolang kanim laud o tikitik kan, kaireki sili.

verses.name: Luke 8:35
verses.text: Irail ap koieila, kilang me wiauier, re ap kola ren Iesus, diarada aramas o, me tewil oko keredi sang lole, momod ni aluwilu en Iesus, likauda o lolekonglar; irail karos masakadar.

verses.name: Luke 8:36
verses.text: Me iang udialer, ap kaire kin irail duen tanwar en tewil a kakeladar.

verses.name: Luke 8:37
verses.text: Men Kadara karos ap poekipoeki i, en koti wei sang re ’rail, pwe re masakadar kaualap. I ari kotida pon sop o, ap kotin purelar.

verses.name: Luke 8:38
verses.text: A ol o, me tewil oko kodi sanger, poeki re a, en iang i; a Iesus sota kotin mueid ong i masani:

verses.name: Luke 8:39
verses.text: Purelang deu om, kalok sili duen manaman lapalap, me Kot wiai ong uk er! I ari kola, kalok sili nan kanim o duen manaman lapalap, me Iesus kotin wiai ong i.

verses.name: Luke 8:40
verses.text: Kadekadeo Iesus lao kotin puredo, aramas akan ap kasamo i, pwe irail karos auiaui i.

verses.name: Luke 8:41
verses.text: A kilang, ol amen, ad a Iairus, saumas en sinakoke, kotido poridi ni aluwilu en Iesus o poeki i, en kotilong ong nan im a.

verses.name: Luke 8:42
verses.text: Pwe na ieros seripein amen, me a par ngaulriau, me koren iong mela. A ni a kotikot kokodo, pokon o koi dong i.

verses.name: Luke 8:43
verses.text: A li amen, me nta pwilipwil par ngaulriau, me pwaineki ong saunwini kan a dipisou karos. A sota me kak kakelailada i.

verses.name: Luke 8:44
verses.text: I me apedo mur i, doke ni kailan sapwilim a likau. A pwilipwil en nta madang madada.

verses.name: Luke 8:45
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Is i me sair ia? A karos lao inda me sota, Petrus o me iang i ap potoan ong: Maing, pokon o kin kapil pena o koi dong ir, a iaduen, re kotin masani: Is i me sair ia?

verses.name: Luke 8:46
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani: Nan meamen sair ia, pwe I pam, me kel eu ko sang ia er.

verses.name: Luke 8:47
verses.text: A li o lao asaer, me a so kak rirala, ap masapwekada, apedi poridi sang mo a, ap katitiki mon aramas karos, karepan a sair i, o duen a kelailada madang.

verses.name: Luke 8:48
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong i: Seripein popoleta, om poson me kakel uk ada, kowei popol.

verses.name: Luke 8:49
verses.text: A ni a kotin masaniata, amen potodo sang ren saumas en sinakoke o katitiki ong i: Sapwilim omui seripein melar. Menda kom kangirieki saunpadak o.

verses.name: Luke 8:50
verses.text: A Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap kotin sapeng i masani: Koe der masak, koe poson ta, a ap pan maureda.

verses.name: Luke 8:51
verses.text: A lao kotilong ong nan im o, a sota kotin mueid ong amen en iang pedelong ong nan pera, Petrus, o Ioanes, o Iakupus eta, o sam en seripein o in a.

verses.name: Luke 8:52
verses.text: A irail karos sangesang o mamaukeki i. A i kotin masani: Komail der sangesang! Pwe a sota melar, a mamair eta.

verses.name: Luke 8:53
verses.text: Rap kaururki, pwe re asa, me a melar.

verses.name: Luke 8:54
verses.text: I ari kotikiiei sang ir nan pera o, a ap kotin ale pa a warong ong i masani: Seripein, paurida!

verses.name: Luke 8:55
verses.text: Ngen en seripein ap pure dong i, i ari madang uda. I ap kotin masani, kisin manga en ko ong.

verses.name: Luke 8:56
verses.text: A sam a in a puriamui kila. I ari kotin inapwiedi irail ren der indang meamen me wiauier.<div eID="gen2665" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.8"/>

verses.name: Luke 9:1
verses.text: A LAO kotin molipe pena ekriamen oko, ap kotiki ong irail kel o manaman, en kaloedi tewil akan karos o kakelada me somau kan.

verses.name: Luke 9:2
verses.text: I ari kotin porone ir ala, pwen padapadak duen wein Kot o kakelada me somau kan.

verses.name: Luke 9:3
verses.text: O a kotin masani ong irail: Komail der wala meakot pon al o: Sota sokon, de ed, de prot, de moni, amen pil so pan wa sakit riau.

verses.name: Luke 9:4
verses.text: O wasa kis me komail pan pedelong ong nan im eu, komail pan mimieta wasa o, komail lao kowei sang ia.

verses.name: Luke 9:5
verses.text: O meamen kang kasamo komail, komail sapalewei sang kanim o, o sipede sang pwel ni nä omail, pwen kadede ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 9:6
verses.text: Irail ari kokola, kakan sili nan kisin kanim akan, padaki rongamau o kakelada me somau kan wasa karos.

verses.name: Luke 9:7
verses.text: A nanmarki Erodes lao mangi duen meakan, me wiauiki i, ap pingidar, pweki akai katitiki, me dene Ioanes iasadar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Luke 9:8
verses.text: A akai indada, me dene Elias pwarado, o akai me inda, me dene saukop en kaua men iasadar,

verses.name: Luke 9:9
verses.text: A Erodes masani: Ioanes, i me i lepuke sang mong a, a is men et, me i kin rongerong due? A ap men udial i.

verses.name: Luke 9:10
verses.text: A wanporon akan lao pure doer, ap kaireki i karos, me re wiadar. I ari kotin uk irail ada, kotilang wasa rir, nan kanim eu, me ad a Petsaida.

verses.name: Luke 9:11
verses.text: Toun sap o lao asaer, rap idauenla i, i ari kotin kasamo irail, o kotin padaki ong irail duen wein Kot, o kotin kakelada me mau ong.

verses.name: Luke 9:12
verses.text: A lao pan wasa pongier, ekriamen potodo potoan ong i: Re kotin kadar pasang pokon en, pwen kola nan kisin kanim akan o nan sap, en rapaki wasan pweidi o kan ar kisin manga, pwe kitail kotikot nan sap tan wet,

verses.name: Luke 9:13
verses.text: A a kotin masani ong irail: Komail pan ki ong irail kan ar manga! Re potoan ong: Lopon prot eta limau o mam eta riamen mi re at. De se pan kola netie dong pokon kalaimun wet manga?

verses.name: Luke 9:14
verses.text: Pwe irail me ol impan limekid. A a kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Komail pwini ir pasang wad limek o limek!

verses.name: Luke 9:15
verses.text: Irail ari wiada o kamod irail edi.

verses.name: Luke 9:16
verses.text: A kotin limada lopon prot limau o mam riamen, masanda nanlang, laolaoki, pilitiki pena, kotiki ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan, pwe ren nene ong pokon o.

verses.name: Luke 9:17
verses.text: Irail sak, o karos medier, ap rikada dodo eisokriau luan kamadip o.

verses.name: Luke 9:18
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni a kotin laolao kelep, sapwilim a tounpadak kan iang i. A kotin kainoma re ’rail masani: Is me aramas kin inda me ngai?

verses.name: Luke 9:19
verses.text: Irail sapeng potoan ong: Ioanes saunpaptais, a akai me inda Elias, o pil akai kin inda, me dene saukop en kaua men iasadar.

verses.name: Luke 9:20
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: A da me komail kin inda is ngai? Petrus ap sapeng potoan ong: Ir me Kristus sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 9:21
verses.text: A i me kotin padik inapwiedi irail, ren der indang meamen mepukat,

verses.name: Luke 9:22
verses.text: Masani: Nain aramas pan kalokolok laud, o lokidokila ren saumas, o samero lapalap, o saunkawewe kan, o a pan kamela, o ni ran kasilu a pan maureda,

verses.name: Luke 9:23
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong irail karos: Meamen men idauen ia i en tonmeteki pein i o ale a lopu ni ran karos, o idedauen ia do.

verses.name: Luke 9:24
verses.text: Pwe meamen kanakanai ong maur a, pan pupe sang. A meamen kasela maur a pweki ngai, pan diarada.

verses.name: Luke 9:25
verses.text: Pwe da me pan mau ong aramas amen, me aneki pena sappa karos, ap kasela pein i o kasapokela pein i?

verses.name: Luke 9:26
verses.text: Pwe me kin namenok kin ia o ai padak kan, i me Nain aramas pil pan namenokki, a lao kodo ni a lingan, o lingan en Sam a, o na tounlang saraui kan.

verses.name: Luke 9:27
verses.text: A melel I indai ong komail, akai irail, me mi met, sota pan mela, irail lao udial wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 9:28
verses.text: A kadekadeo murin pong walu pong murin masan pukat i ap ukada Petrus, o Ioanes, o Iakopus kotidala pon nana o pwen laolao.

verses.name: Luke 9:29
verses.text: A ni a kotin laolao mom en silang i ap wukila o sapwilim a likau puetepuetela o lingaling.

verses.name: Luke 9:30
verses.text: A kilang, ol riamen iang i masan pena! Ira me Moses o Elias.

verses.name: Luke 9:31
verses.text: Ira pwarado ni ara lingan o mamasani duen a pan kamatala nan Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:32
verses.text: A Petrus o me iang i me toutouki mair. Ira lao pirida, re ap udial a lingan o ol riamen kotikot impa.

verses.name: Luke 9:33
verses.text: Kadekadeo ira lao kotiwei sang re a, Petrus ap indang Iesus: Maing, meid mau atail kotikot met. Kit en kauada kisin im silikis: Tanpas ar, o en Moses, o en Elias; a sasa me a kasokasoi.

verses.name: Luke 9:34
verses.text: Ni a kasokasoi mepukat, pali en dapok kadupal irail edi, irail ari masakadar ni ar tilong nan dapok o.

verses.name: Luke 9:35
verses.text: O ngil eu peidido sang nan dapok o masani: Iet nai ol kompok, komail en rong i!

verses.name: Luke 9:36
verses.text: A ngil wet lao wiauier, re ap diaradar Iesus ta. Ir ari nenenlata; o ni ran oko re sota kaireki meamen duen me re kilanger.

verses.name: Luke 9:37
verses.text: A kadekadeo manda en ran o irail lao kotidido sang nana o, pokon kalaimun ap poto dong i,

verses.name: Luke 9:38
verses.text: A kilang, ol amen nan pokon o ngil laudeda potoan ong: Saunpadak, i poeki re ir, re kotin masani dong ai tungol putak o, pwe iei ai ieros.

verses.name: Luke 9:39
verses.text: Re kotin mangi, ngen o lao koledi i, a kin madang weriwer, a kin senseroki sili, a ap kin pudopud o meid apwal ni a kin koiei sang i.

verses.name: Luke 9:40
verses.text: Ngai ari poeki ren sapwilim ar tounpadak kan, ren kause wei sang i, a re sota kak.

verses.name: Luke 9:41
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani: O di wet meid soposon o sapung, ia arain ai pan mimi re omail? Ia arain ai pan kokoa komail? Wa dong ia noum putak!

verses.name: Luke 9:42
verses.text: A ni a kokodo, tewil ap kapururada o seroki sili i, a Iesus kotin kidaueda ngen saut o, o kakelada putak o, ap kapure ong i ren sam a.

verses.name: Luke 9:43
verses.text: A irail karos puriamuiki manaman en Kot. A ni ar puriamuiki en Iesus a wiawia kan ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan:

verses.name: Luke 9:44
verses.text: Masan pukat en kaloledi nan salong omail: Nain aramas pan pangala ni pa en aramas.

verses.name: Luke 9:45
verses.text: A irail sota weweki masan wet, pwe a rir sang irail, i me irail sasaki. Irail ari masak kalelapok re a duen masan pot et.

verses.name: Luke 9:46
verses.text: Irail ap pil lamelame, is me pan lapalap re ’rail?

verses.name: Luke 9:47
verses.text: A Iesus lao kotin mangi ar lamelam nan mongiong arail, ap ale seri men, kida impa a,

verses.name: Luke 9:48
verses.text: O masani ong irail: Meamen pan apwali kisin seri men et ni ad ai, nan a kin apwali ia, a meamen pan apwali ia, nan a kin apwali, me kadar ia do; a me tikitik re omail, nan i me pan lapalapala.

verses.name: Luke 9:49
verses.text: Ioanes ap sapeng potoan ong: Maing, se kilanger amen, me kausewei tewil akan ni mar ar. Kit ari inapwiedi, pwe a sota kin iang kit idedauen ir.

verses.name: Luke 9:50
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Eder inapiedi, pwe me so kin palian komail, nan a kin iang komail.

verses.name: Luke 9:51
verses.text: A kadekadeo a lao ansau, me a pan peukadala, a ap kotin saupeilang kotilang inen wong Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:52
verses.text: A kotin poronela men kadar akan, me pan tiong mo a. Irail ari kokola lele dong kisin kanim en Samaria eu, pwen rapaki wasa, me a pan pweiokidi ia.

verses.name: Luke 9:53
verses.text: A re sota kasamo i aki a kotin saupeila kotilang inen wong Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 9:54
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan Iakopus o Ioanes lao kilanger mepukat, ap potoan ong: Maing, ma re kotin kupura, se pan poeki, kisiniai en moredi sang nanlang, kang irail la, duen Elias wiadar.

verses.name: Luke 9:55
verses.text: A i kotin saupeido, kapung ong ira masani: Koma sota asa is Ngen, me naina kin koma?

verses.name: Luke 9:56
verses.text: Irail ap daulul wei nan eu kisin kanim.

verses.name: Luke 9:57
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni arail kotikot kokodo amen ap potoan ong i: Maing i pan idedauen ir wasa karos me re pan kotila ia.

verses.name: Luke 9:58
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Poks akan por ar mia, o manpir en pan lang pas ar mia, a Nain aramas sota wasa en kaula wei mong a.

verses.name: Luke 9:59
verses.text: A kotin masani ong amen: Idauen ia do! A i indada: Maing, komui kotin mueid ong ia mas, i en purela sarepedi sam ai.

verses.name: Luke 9:60
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Me melar akan en sarepedi ar melar akan, a koe kowei kalok sili wein Kot!

verses.name: Luke 9:61
verses.text: Pil amen potoan: Maing, i pan idedauen ir sili, a re kotin mueid ong ia mas, i en kamurimuri ong toun im ai.

verses.name: Luke 9:62
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Sota me pan koledi men weirada pwel, ap kilang muri, a sota koiok ong wein Kot.<div eID="gen2666" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.9"/>

verses.name: Luke 10:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat Kaun o pil kotin piladar isiakan o porone irail wei mo a ni wad riamen, en kakan sili nan kanim laud o tikitik kan, wasa me a pein pan kotilang ia.

verses.name: Luke 10:2
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Rak me kalaimun, a toun dodok me malaulau; poeki ren Kaun en rak, en kadarala toun dodok nan a rak.

verses.name: Luke 10:3
verses.text: Komail kola; kilang, I kadar komail la dueta sippul akan nan pung en kidi en wei akan.

verses.name: Luke 10:4
verses.text: Komail der wewa ed en moni, de ed en sailok, de sut, o der ranamau ong meamen nani al o.

verses.name: Luke 10:5
verses.text: A ma komail pan pedelong ong nan im eu, komail pan inda mas: Popol en mimi nan im wet!

verses.name: Luke 10:6
verses.text: A ma popol amen mi wasa o, omail popol pan mimieta re a, a ma so, omail popol pan pure dong komail.

verses.name: Luke 10:7
verses.text: A komail pan mimieta nan im ota, o manga o nim, me mi re ’rail pwe toun dodok me warong pwain a. Komail der pedoi sang nan eu im ap kolong ong nan eu.

verses.name: Luke 10:8
verses.text: A ma komail pan pedelong nan eu kanim, o re pan kasamo komail, i wasa komail pan tungole, me pan wisike dong komail.

verses.name: Luke 10:9
verses.text: O kakelada me somau kan, me mi wasa o, o kaire kin irail: Wein Kot koren dong komail.

verses.name: Luke 10:10
verses.text: A ma komail pan pedelong nan eu kanim, o re sota pan kasamo komail, i wasa komail pan pedoi nani al indada:

verses.name: Luke 10:11
verses.text: Pil pwel par, me ko dong kit nan omail kanim, sipede dong komail; ari so, komail en asa, me wein Kot koren dong komail.

verses.name: Luke 10:12
verses.text: I indai ong komail, nan a pan mangai ong Sodom ni ran o sang kanim o.

verses.name: Luke 10:13
verses.text: Suedi ong uk Korasim! Suedi ong Petsaida! Pwe ma manaman akan, me wiaui ong uk er, wiaui ong Tirus o Sidon, nan melel, re pan kalula nan tuk en likau o nan pas.

verses.name: Luke 10:14
verses.text: A a pan mangai ong Tirus o Sidon ni kadeik o sang komail.

verses.name: Luke 10:15
verses.text: A koe Kapernaum, me paidar nanlang, pan pisikondi ong nan pweleko.

verses.name: Luke 10:16
verses.text: Me rongerong komail, nan a kin rongerong ia; o me mamaleki komail, nan a kin mamaleki ia. O me mamaleki, ia, nan a kin mamaleki, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: Luke 10:17
verses.text: Me isiakan ap puredo, pereperen potoan ong: Maing, pil tewil akan udi ong kit ni mar omui.

verses.name: Luke 10:18
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: I kilanger Satan likamata liol a pupedi sang nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 10:19
verses.text: Kilang, I ki ong komail manaman, en tiakedi serpent o skorpion, o en poedi kel en imwintiti karos. O sota meakot pan kasuedi ong komail,

verses.name: Luke 10:20
verses.text: Ari so, komail der peren kida, me ngen akan kin udi ong komail, a komail peren kida me ad omail intingidier nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 10:21
verses.text: Ni auer ota Iesus kotin perenda ni ngen e masani: I kapinga komui, Sam ai, kaun pan lang o sappa, me komui okila mepukat sang me lolekong o koiok kan, ap kasale ong seri pwelel akan! Ei Sam ai, pwe iduen me komui kupukupura.

verses.name: Luke 10:22
verses.text: Meakaros muei ong ia er sang ren Sam ai, o sota me asa sapwilim a Ol, pwe Sam eta. O sota me asa Sam, pwe sapwilim a Ol eta, o me sapwilim a Ol pan kasale ong.

verses.name: Luke 10:23
verses.text: I ap kotin saupei dong tounpadak kan, masani ong irail eta: Meid pai por en mas akan me udial, me komail udialer.

verses.name: Luke 10:24
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, saukop o nanmarki kan toto anane udial, me komail kin ududial, a re sota kilanger; a re men rongada, me komail kin rongerong, ap sota rongadar.

verses.name: Luke 10:25
verses.text: A kilang, saunkawewe men ap uda, kasongesong i potoan ong: Saunpadak, da me i en wiada, pwen sosoki maur soutuk?

verses.name: Luke 10:26
verses.text: A kotin masani ong i: Da me intingidier nan kapung o? Daduen om dondoropwe?

verses.name: Luke 10:27
verses.text: A sapeng indada: Koe en pok ong Kaun om Kot mongiong om unsok, o ngen om unsok, o kel om unsok, o om Iamelam unsok, o men imp om dueta pein koe.

verses.name: Luke 10:28
verses.text: A kotin masani ong i: Koe meid sapeng inen, wiada mepukat, a koe pan maurela.

verses.name: Luke 10:29
verses.text: A ap men ak kapungki pein i indang Iesus: A is men imp ai?

verses.name: Luke 10:30
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani: Aramas amen momait sang Ierusalem kodila Ieriko ap lodi ong lolap akai, me ter sang a likau kan, o kame i, rap koieila; i ari pan mela.

verses.name: Luke 10:31
verses.text: A samero amen momaitela nani al ota. A ni a kilang i, ap daulul wei sang.

verses.name: Luke 10:32
verses.text: A leap amen pil dueta. Ni a leler wasa o, kilang i, ap daulul wei sang.

verses.name: Luke 10:33
verses.text: A ol en Samaria amen sailok sili ap pil weid wasa o. Ni a kilanger i ap pokela,

verses.name: Luke 10:34
verses.text: Kola re a, o kidim pena a pwal akan, ap ki ong le o wain lole o kamondi i pon dake pa man o, wala nan im en kairu eu, apapwali i.

verses.name: Luke 10:35
verses.text: Manda a pan samala, ap ki ong kaun en im o denar riau indang i: Apapwali i! A ma mekis pan dauli, i pan kapungala, ni ai pan puredo.

verses.name: Luke 10:36
verses.text: A is ren ir silimen, me koe wiaki men impan ol o, me lodi ong lolap oko?

verses.name: Luke 10:37
verses.text: A sapeng: Me wiadar dodok kadek ong i. Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Ari, kowei ala sang!

verses.name: Luke 10:38
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni ar kotin sailokela, a kotilong ong nan kisin kanim eu. Li amen mi wasa o, ad a Marta, me kasamo i long ong nan im a.

verses.name: Luke 10:39
verses.text: Ri a li amen mia, me ad a Maria, me momod ni aluwilu en Iesus, rongerong a masan.

verses.name: Luke 10:40
verses.text: A Marta kasopisokki pein i a papa i. I ari potodo potoan ong: Maing, re sota kotin kupuroki ri ai li, me sota kin iang ia dodok? Re kotin padaki ong i, en sauasa ia.

verses.name: Luke 10:41
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Marta, Marta, koe meid nongki o sopisokki okotme.

verses.name: Luke 10:42
verses.text: A me ta kot me kasampwal. Maria piladar pwais mau, me sota pan katia sang.<div eID="gen2667" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.10"/>

verses.name: Luke 11:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO ni a kotikot wasa kis pwen laolao, a lao kotin erelar, amen sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap potoan ong i: Maing re kotin padaki ong kit kapakap, dueta Ioanes kin padaki ong a tounpadak kan.

verses.name: Luke 11:2
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail lao wia kapakap, ap inda: Sam at, mar omui en saraui, wei ’mui en pwaida,

verses.name: Luke 11:3
verses.text: Kotikido ran wet at tungol kaukaule.

verses.name: Luke 11:4
verses.text: Lapwa sang kit dip at, dueta kit, me kin lapwada karos, me wia dipi ong kit, eder kaluang kit ren me katikatiamau kan.

verses.name: Luke 11:5
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong irail: Is re omail, me a kompok amen mia o me pan kola re a ni ailep en pong indang i: Kompoke pai, ki ong ia lopon prot silu,

verses.name: Luke 11:6
verses.text: Pwe kompoke pai men pwarado sang a sailok o, ap sota, me i pan kak ki ong i.

verses.name: Luke 11:7
verses.text: A me mi nan im o pan sapeng inda: Koe der kadiropa ia, pwe wanim ritidier, o nai seri ko iang ia nan wasan mair; i so kak paurida o ki ong uk meakot.

verses.name: Luke 11:8
verses.text: I indai ong komail, ma a sota pan paurida o ki ong i aki kompokepa a, nan a pan paurida o ki ong, me itar ong i aki a ngidingid.

verses.name: Luke 11:9
verses.text: I indai ong komail, poeki, a komail pan tungole; rapaki, a komail pan diarada; letelet, a a pan ritida mo ’mail.

verses.name: Luke 11:10
verses.text: Pwe karos me poekipoeki, kin tungole; o me kin rapaki, kin diarada; o me kin letelet, nan a pan ritida mo a.

verses.name: Luke 11:11
verses.text: De is sam amen nan pung omail, ma na putak pan poeki na kisin prot, pan ki ong i takai eu? De ma a poeki mam, pan ki ong i serpent amen?

verses.name: Luke 11:12
verses.text: De ma a pan poeki kitor eu, pan ki ong i skorpion amen?

verses.name: Luke 11:13
verses.text: Ma komail, me song sued, asa duen kisakis mau ong noumail seri kan, nan melel kaualap. Sam omail nanlang pan ki ong Ngen saraui ren me poeki re a.

verses.name: Luke 11:14
verses.text: A ap kotin kause wei tewil amen, me lotong. A kadekadeo tewil lao koiei sanger, me lotong o ap lokelokaia, a aramas puriamuiki.

verses.name: Luke 11:15
verses.text: A akai ir katitiki: Nan Peelsepup, saumas en tewil akan, me a kauseki sang tewil akan.

verses.name: Luke 11:16
verses.text: A akai kasongesong i, poekipoeki kilel eu sang nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 11:17
verses.text: A ap kotin angi ar lamelam, masani ong irail: Wei karos ma a pan u pena nan pung a, a pan ola; o ma toun im eu pan u pena nan pung a, a sota pan pwaida.

verses.name: Luke 11:18
verses.text: A iaduen, ma Satan u ong pein i, a wei pan kak pwaida? Aki komail indinda me dene ngai kause wei tewil akan ki Peelsepup.

verses.name: Luke 11:19
verses.text: Ma I kin kauseki wei Peelsepup tewil akan, a is me noumail ol akan kin kause kin irail? Irail ari pan omail saunkapung.

verses.name: Luke 11:20
verses.text: A ma I kauseki wei lim en Kot tewil akan, nan wein Kot lel ong komail er.

verses.name: Luke 11:21
verses.text: Ma me kelail o, me audeki kapwa en pei, pan sinsila im a, nan a kapwa nekinekid mau.

verses.name: Luke 11:22
verses.text: A ma amen, me kelail sang i, pan palian i o kaloedi i, ap pan atia sang a kapwa en pei, me a kelekier, o nek pasang kapwa en kul.

verses.name: Luke 11:23
verses.text: Meamen, me sota iang ia, iei me palian ia, o me sota kin dolung penang ia, iei me kin kasapoka pasang.

verses.name: Luke 11:24
verses.text: Ngen saut lao kowei sang ren aramas, a kin tangatang sili nan sap tan akan, rapaki wasan kamol, a sota, me a diarada, i ap kin inda: I ap pan purelong ong nan im ai, me i pedoi sanger.

verses.name: Luke 11:25
verses.text: A lao puredo, a diar, me a kokok o kapwater,

verses.name: Luke 11:26
verses.text: I ari koieila, ale ong i ngen isimen, me sued sang pein i. Irail ap pedelong ong lole, rap kakauson ia; a aramas pan sued sang mas.

verses.name: Luke 11:27
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni a kotin mamasani mepukat, li amen, kisan pokon o, ap potoan ong i: Meid pai kupur o, me wia ir adar, o didi kan, me re kotiki!

verses.name: Luke 11:28
verses.text: A i kotin masani: Ei, meid pai, me kin rong masan en Kot ap kapwaiada.

verses.name: Luke 11:29
verses.text: A pokon o lao tengeteng pena, a kotin masani: Di wet meid sued! Re kin rapaki kilel eu, a sota kilel pan sansal ong ir, pwe kilel en Iona eta.

verses.name: Luke 11:30
verses.text: Pwe duen Iona kilel eu ong men Niniwe, iduen Nain aramas ong di wet.

verses.name: Luke 11:31
verses.text: Li nanmarki en pali air amen pan u ong ol akan en di wet ni kadeik o pan kari ir ala, pwe a pwrarado sang ni imwin sappa, pwen rong lolekong en Salomo. A kilang, me laude sang Salomo mi met.

verses.name: Luke 11:32
verses.text: Ol en Niniwe kan pan u ong di wet ni kadeik, o pan kariala i, pwe re kalula ni ar rongadar padak en Iona. A kilang, me laude sang Iona mi met.

verses.name: Luke 11:33
verses.text: Sota me kin isikeda lamp, ap kila wasa rir, pil so pan kopa, a pon deu a, pwe me pan pedelong ong, en kilang marain o.

verses.name: Luke 11:34
verses.text: Por en mas marain en pali war. Ma mas om makelekel, war om karos pan dir en marain. A ma mas om me sued, war om karos me pil dir en rotorot.

verses.name: Luke 11:35
verses.text: En kalaka, pwe marain mi lol om, der rotorot!

verses.name: Luke 11:36
verses.text: Ma war om dir en marain kaualap, o sota kisan rotorot mia, karos pan dir en marain dueta lingan en lamp, me kin sensere uk ada.

verses.name: Luke 11:37
verses.text: A ni a kotin kaparok, Parisär amen luke i, en konot re a. I ari kotilong kotidi nin tepel.

verses.name: Luke 11:38
verses.text: A Parisär lao udial, ap puriamuiki, me a sota kotin omiom mon konot.

verses.name: Luke 11:39
verses.text: A Kaun o kotin masani ong i: Nan komail Parisär akan kin widen likin dal o plet, a lol omail me dir en me re kuliada o me sued.

verses.name: Luke 11:40
verses.text: Nan pweipwei komail, kaidin i me wiadar pali liki, pil wiadar pali lole?

verses.name: Luke 11:41
verses.text: A kisakis weita duen komail kak ong! A kilang, karos pan makelekel ong komail.

verses.name: Luke 11:42
verses.text: Suedi ong komail Parisär akan, pwe komail, kin mairongki eisokkis eu en minse, o raute o song en kisin tan tuka kai, ap sota insenoki kadeik o limpok en Kot! Wiada mepukat ap pil kapwaiada me tei kan.

verses.name: Luke 11:43
verses.text: Suedi ong komail Parisär akan, pwe komail men mondi leppantam nan sinakoke kan o mauki, ren ranamau ong komail nan wasa en netinet akan.

verses.name: Luke 11:44
verses.text: Suedi ong komail, pwe komail rasong sousou kan, me so sansal, o aramas alialu poa, ap sasa ir!

verses.name: Luke 11:45
verses.text: Saunkawewe men ap sapeng potoan ong i: Saunpadak, komui pil kin suede kin kit masan pukat.

verses.name: Luke 11:46
verses.text: A i kotin masani: Pil suedi ong komail saunkawewe! Pwe komail kin katoutou kila kapwa en wisik toutou aramas akan, ap sota sairki sondin pa omail.

verses.name: Luke 11:47
verses.text: Suedi ong komail! Pwe komail kin apapwali sousou en saukop akan, a sam omail akan kame ir ala.

verses.name: Luke 11:48
verses.text: Komail ari kin kadede o peren kida wiawia en sam omail akan. Pwe re kame ir ala, a komail apapwali ar sousou kan.

verses.name: Luke 11:49
verses.text: I me erpit en Kot indada: I pan kadar wong irail saukop o wanporon akan, a akai irail re pan kamela o pwaki irail sili.

verses.name: Luke 11:50
verses.text: Pwe ntan saukop akan, me kapwilipwili weier sang ni tapin kaua kokodo, en kapokon ong di wet.

verses.name: Luke 11:51
verses.text: Sang ntan Apel lel ntan Sakarias, me kamelar nan pung en pei saraui o im en kaudok, ei I indai ong komail, a pan kapokon ong di wet.

verses.name: Luke 11:52
verses.text: Suedi ong komail saunkawewe! Pwe komail atia sang men kapir pan lolekong. Komail sota pan pedelong, ap inapwiedi, me men pedelon ong.

verses.name: Luke 11:53
verses.text: A ni a kotin mamasani ong irail mepukat, saunkawewe o Parisär akan ap tapiada palian i kaualap, kalekalelapok re a song toto,

verses.name: Luke 11:54
verses.text: O re masamasan i, o raparapaki, ma re sota kak diar meakot sang ni a masan akan, pwe ren kadipa i.<div eID="gen2668" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.11"/>

verses.name: Luke 12:1
verses.text: ARAMAS toto ap pokon pena lao kidalar, irail lao it pena, i ap kotin tapiada masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Komail kalaka kalep en Parisär akan, me malaun.

verses.name: Luke 12:2
verses.text: Pwe sota me rir kot, me sota pan sansalada. Pil sota me okiok kot, me so pan kalok sili.

verses.name: Luke 12:3
verses.text: Ari, me komail pan indada ni wasa rotorot, i me pan sansal nan marain. O me komail pan monginingin nan pera kan, i me pan kalok sili pon im akan.

verses.name: Luke 12:4
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, kompok pai kan, komail der masak irail, me kin kamela pali war, ap solar kak wia meakot.

verses.name: Luke 12:5
verses.text: A I pan kaasa kin komail, me komail en masak: Masak i, me manaman ong kamela aramas ap kak kasela nan pweleko. Melel I indai ong komail, i me komail en masak.

verses.name: Luke 12:6
verses.text: Siok limen sota kin netila ni denar riau? Ari so, sota amen irail me Kot kin maliela.

verses.name: Luke 12:7
verses.text: Ari, pil pit en mong omail karos me wadawad penaer. Komail ari der masak, pwe komail me mau sang siok toto.

verses.name: Luke 12:8
verses.text: A I indai ong komail, meamen ponasa ia mon aramas, i me Nain aramas pan ponasa ren tounlang en Kot akan.

verses.name: Luke 12:9
verses.text: A meamen kamam kin ia mon aramas, i me pan kamamaki mon tounlang en Kot akan.

verses.name: Luke 12:10
verses.text: O meamen me pan lokaia sued duen Nain aramas, a pan kak lapwada. A me lalaue Ngen saraui, a sota pan lapwada.

verses.name: Luke 12:11
verses.text: A ma re pan wa komail la nan ar sinakoke kan mon kapung o ren me manaman akan, komail depa lamelame, da me komail pan sapengki de me komail en inda.

verses.name: Luke 12:12
verses.text: Pwe Ngen saraui pan kapame kin komail ni klok ota, me komail en inda.

verses.name: Luke 12:13
verses.text: A amen toun pokon potoan ong i: Saunpadak, kom kotin masani ong ri ai ol o, en nek pasang at soso.

verses.name: Luke 12:14
verses.text: A kotin masani ong i: Aramas o, is me kasapwil ia da, en saunkapungla o saunnene re oma?

verses.name: Luke 12:15
verses.text: O kotin masani ong irail: Kalaka norok sued, pwe kaidin kapwa toto, me aramas amen kin memaur kida!

verses.name: Luke 12:16
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail karaseras eu: Ol kapwapwa amen mia, me sap we kaparapar kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 12:17
verses.text: I ari lamelame indada: Da me i en wiada? Pwe solar wasa en nekinek ia ai kapwa kan.

verses.name: Luke 12:18
verses.text: I ari indada: Nan iet me i pan wiada: I pan palang pasang ai im en nak kan, ap kauada me laude sang kai; i wasa me i pan nekidala me wosadang ia o ai dipisou karos;

verses.name: Luke 12:19
verses.text: A i pan indang ngen i: Ngen i, dipisou toto ong par toto, me nekineki ong uk er. En moleilei, o manga, o nim o perenta!

verses.name: Luke 12:20
verses.text: A Kot ap masani ong i: Pweipwei men koe, pwe pongpong wet ngen om pan ilakido. A is me pan aneki kapwa pukat, me koe nanak penaer?

verses.name: Luke 12:21
verses.text: Nan iduen me kin roporop pena dipisou ong pein i, ap sota kapwapwa ren Kot.

verses.name: Luke 12:22
verses.text: A a kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: I me I indai ong komail, eder lamelame maur omail, me komail pan tungole, pil iermen pali war, me komail pan likauki!

verses.name: Luke 12:23
verses.text: Maur me kasampwal sang manga, o war me mau sang likau.

verses.name: Luke 12:24
verses.text: Kalelapok ong rape kan! Re sota kin kamorok, re pil sota kin nak pena, pil sota arail pera de im en nak, a Kot kin kotin katungole ir. A komail so kasampwal sang manpir kaualap?

verses.name: Luke 12:25
verses.text: A is nan pung omail, ni a ngongki, me pan kak use pasang pein i ki tipong en pa eu?

verses.name: Luke 12:26
verses.text: Ari, ma komail sota kak ong wiada me mangai, a da me komail kin ngongki okotme?

verses.name: Luke 12:27
verses.text: Kalelapok ong kiop akan, me mi nan sap, duen ar kakairida! Re sota kin dodok, o re sota kin monkol pena. A I indai ong komail, pil Salomo ni a lingan karos sota a likau dueta apot irail.

verses.name: Luke 12:28
verses.text: Ari, ma iduen Kot kotin kapwataki dip, me mi nan sap ran wet, a lakap pan lokidokila nan stop, iaduen a sota pan madang kalikauwiada komail, me poson tikitik?

verses.name: Luke 12:29
verses.text: A komail, ender ngongki, me komail pan manga o nim, o komail der insensued!

verses.name: Luke 12:30
verses.text: Pwe mepukat men liki kan kin ngongongki. Pwe Sam omail, me kotikot nanlang, mangi, me mepukat karos mau ong komail.

verses.name: Luke 12:31
verses.text: A rapaki sapwilim a wei, a mepukat pan pousalang komail.

verses.name: Luke 12:32
verses.text: Der masak pwin tikitik koe, pwe iet kupur en Sam omail: En ki ong komail wei o.

verses.name: Luke 12:33
verses.text: Netikila omail kapwa kan, ap kisakisa wei, wiai ong komail ed ko, me sota pan maringala, o pai nanlang, me so pan ola, wasa me lipirap men so kak ong, o man en mot so kak kawela ia.

verses.name: Luke 12:34
verses.text: Pwe wasa omail pai mi ia, iei wasa mongiong omail pil kin mia,

verses.name: Luke 12:35
verses.text: Nan luke pamail en katengteng pena o omail ser en isis

verses.name: Luke 12:36
verses.text: O komail en dueta aramas akan, me auiaui ar monsap ni a pan kodo sang kamadip en papaud, pwe i lao kodo letelet, re en madang ritingada mo a.

verses.name: Luke 12:37
verses.text: Ladu ko meid pai, me monsap o ni a pan pwarado, diar ar masamasan. Melel I indai ong komail, a pan kaiada a likau o kamod irail edi ong manga, ap pan apapwali irail.

verses.name: Luke 12:38
verses.text: O ma a pwarado ni auer kariau, de kasilu, ap diar ir masamasan, nan meid pai ladu pukat.

verses.name: Luke 12:39
verses.text: A komail en asa, ma kaun pan im o asaer ansaun lolap o pan pwarado, a pan masamasan o so pan mueid ong, im a en kulia sang.

verses.name: Luke 12:40
verses.text: Komail ari pil ononop, pwe Nain aramas pan pwarado niansau me komail sasa.

verses.name: Luke 12:41
verses.text: Petrus ap potoan ong i: Maing, re kotin masani dong kit karaseras wet, de ong irail karos?

verses.name: Luke 12:42
verses.text: A Kaun o kotin masani: Ari is saunkoa lelapok o lolekong, me a monsap kasapwilada, en kaunda a ladu kan, pwen nek ong irail kan ar manga ni ansau me kon on?

verses.name: Luke 12:43
verses.text: Meid pai ladu o, me a monsap pan diarada wiawia duen met ni a pan pwarado!

verses.name: Luke 12:44
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, a pan kasapwiladang i pon a dipisou karos.

verses.name: Luke 12:45
verses.text: A ma ladu o pan lamelame nan mongiong i: Ai monsap pwapwand, o a pan tapiada kame ladu o lidu kan, o manga o nim, o kamom sakau,

verses.name: Luke 12:46
verses.text: Monsap en ladu o ap pan pwara do ni ran o, me a so auiaui i, o ni auer, me a sasa, o a pan lepuk pasang i, o kasapokalang nan pung en me soposon akan.

verses.name: Luke 12:47
verses.text: A ladu o, me asa kupur en a monsap, a sota kaonopada pein i, pil sota wiada kupur a, nan i me pan kamekam kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 12:48
verses.text: A me sasa, ap wiadar me mau ong kalokolok, nan i me pan kalokolok tikitik. Pwe me aleer me toto, i me pan kida me toto; o me koaki me toto, pan purokido me toto.

verses.name: Luke 12:49
verses.text: I kodon saundi kisiniai sappa, a da me I en wiada, ma a saundier?

verses.name: Luke 12:50
verses.text: A mas I pan paptaise kila paptais eu; I ap patau kila melel, a lao daulier.

verses.name: Luke 12:51
verses.text: Komail lamelame, me I kodon ki ong sappa popol? I indai ong komail: So! A pwen kumuei suedala.

verses.name: Luke 12:52
verses.text: Pwe sang met kokola limen toun im eu pan liak toror pasang; silimen pan palian riamen, o riamen pan palian silimen.

verses.name: Luke 12:53
verses.text: Sam pan palian na putak, a putak o pan palian sam a; in pan palian na seripein, a seripein pan palian in a; a li amen pan palian na ol a paud, o en na ol a paud pan palian li o.

verses.name: Luke 12:54
verses.text: A kotin masani ong pokon o: Komail lao udial dapok sang kapin lang, komail kin inda: A pan katau; o a pan pwaida

verses.name: Luke 12:55
verses.text: O ma komail kin kilang ang a usang ni pali air, komail kin inda: A pan karakar; o a pan wiaui.

verses.name: Luke 12:56
verses.text: Malaun komail! Komail asa kasaui mas en sappa o lang, a da me komail sasaki kasauida ansau wet?

verses.name: Luke 12:57
verses.text: A da me pein komail sota kasauia kida me pung?

verses.name: Luke 12:58
verses.text: A ma koe pan iang me palian uk kolang kapung o, en nantiong pon al o, en kapungala re a, pwe a de pang uk alang saunkapung, a saunkapung pang uk ala ren silepan imateng, a silepan imateng pan kase uk ala nan imateng.

verses.name: Luke 12:59
verses.text: I indai ong uk: Koe sota pan koda sang wasa o, koe lao kapungala lua karos.<div eID="gen2669" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.12"/>

verses.name: Luke 13:1
verses.text: NI ansau o akai mia, me potoan ong i duen men Kaliläa kai, me Pilatus doleki nt’ arail ar mairong.

verses.name: Luke 13:2
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail kiki ong, me men Kaliläa pukat me dipan akan mon men Kaliläa tei kan, pweki ar kalokolok o?

verses.name: Luke 13:3
verses.text: Ngai, me indai ong komail: So! A ma komail sota pan kalula, komail karos pan mela dueta.

verses.name: Luke 13:4
verses.text: De irail ekwalemen ko, me im en ruk en Siloa pupedi ong poa, kame ir ala, komail kiki ong, me irail me sued sang aramas akan, me kaukauson Ierusalem?

verses.name: Luke 13:5
verses.text: Ngai me indai ong komail: So! A ma komail sota pan kalula, komail karos pan mela dueta.

verses.name: Luke 13:6
verses.text: A kotin karaseras ong irail masani: Aramas amen mia, me a tuka pik apot padedi nan a mat en wain, ap kodon rapaki wa, a sota me a diarada.

verses.name: Luke 13:7
verses.text: A ap indai ong saumat en wain: Kilang, par silu i kodon rapaki wan pik pot et, a sota, me i diarada; paledi, da me a pinaki mal wasa o!

verses.name: Luke 13:8
verses.text: A a sapeng indang i: Maing, pui sang pil par wet, pwe i en weirada ni tapi, o ki ong pwel mau.

verses.name: Luke 13:9
verses.text: A ma a pan wa, ari me mau, a ma so, komui ap pan paledi sang.

verses.name: Luke 13:10
verses.text: A kotin padapadak nan sinakoke eu ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: Luke 13:11
verses.text: A kilang, li amen mia, me ngen en somau ti poa par ngaulwalu, a kos pena o sota man kak uda.

verses.name: Luke 13:12
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani i, ap molipei wong i masani ong i: Li, koe en maioda sang om somau!

verses.name: Luke 13:13
verses.text: I ap kotin pwil po a lim a kan, i ari madang kasinenda, kapikapinga Kot.

verses.name: Luke 13:14
verses.text: A saumas en sinakoke o makara kida pan Iesus a kakelada i ni ran en sapat, ap sapeng indang pokon o: Ran wonu, aramas en dodok, i ansau me komail kodon kakelada, a iermen ni ran en sapat!

verses.name: Luke 13:15
verses.text: Kaun o ap kotin sapeng i masani: Malaun koe, kaidin komail karos kin lapwada kau o esel sang deu a kalualang nim pil ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: Luke 13:16
verses.text: A li men et, me nain Apraam seripein, me Satan saliedi par ngaulwalu, me so mau, en lapwada ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: Luke 13:17
verses.text: Ni a kotin masani mepukat, karos me palian i, ap namenokala o aramas karos peren kida wiawia mau kan karos, me wiauier pa a.

verses.name: Luke 13:18
verses.text: A a kotin masani: Wein Kot rasong da? O da me I en karasai ong i?

verses.name: Luke 13:19
verses.text: A rasong wantuka eu, me aramas amen kasela nan matuel ap wosada, wiala tuka kalaimun pot, o manpir en pan lang kaukauson nan ra kan.

verses.name: Luke 13:20
verses.text: A pil kotin masani: Da me I en karasai ong wein Kot?

verses.name: Luke 13:21
verses.text: A rasong kalep kis, me li amen ale, okila nan kasak en plaua silu, karos lao mutala.

verses.name: Luke 13:22
verses.text: Ni a kotilang Ierusalem, a kotin padapadak sili nan kanim laud o tikitik kan.

verses.name: Luke 13:23
verses.text: Amen ap potoan ong i: Maing, me malaulau pan maurela? A kotin masani ong irail:

verses.name: Luke 13:24
verses.text: Ngiangi en pedelong ong nan wanim tätik, pwe I indai ong komail, me toto pan sosong pedelong ong, a sota pan kak.

verses.name: Luke 13:25
verses.text: A kaun pan im o lao udar ritingidier wanim o, komail ap pan pikikidi letelet ni wanim o indada: Maing, ritingida sang kit! A ap pan sapeng indang komail: I sasa komail, o wasa me komail ko sang ia.

verses.name: Luke 13:26
verses.text: Komail ap pan pikikidi indada: Kit me manga o nim imp omui, o komui pil kaukawewe nan atail al akan.

verses.name: Luke 13:27
verses.text: A i me pan inda: I indai ong komail, I sasa komail o wasa komail ko sang ia, ko wei sang ia, komail karos me wiawia sued.

verses.name: Luke 13:28
verses.text: Sangesang o teterok ap pan wiaui, komail lao kilang Apraam, o Isaak, o Iakop, o saukop akan karos nan wein Kot, a komail pisikonla sang.

verses.name: Luke 13:29
verses.text: Nan re pan kodo sang nan mas en lang, o sang nan kapin lang, o sang nan apang, o sang air en lang, o re pan mondi ni tepel nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 13:30
verses.text: A kilang, me pwand akai mia, me pan madang, o me madang kai mia, me pan pwand.

verses.name: Luke 13:31
verses.text: Ni auer ota Parisär akai kodo indai ong i: Koti wei sang met, pwe Erod pan kame komui la.

verses.name: Luke 13:32
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Komail u kowei, indai ong poks ota: Kilang I kin kause wei tewil oko o kamakamaureda ran wet o lakap, a ni kasilu en ran I pan imwisokela.

verses.name: Luke 13:33
verses.text: I en kokola ran wet, pil lakap, pil pali, pwe sota saukop amen me pan kamela likin Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 13:34
verses.text: Ierusalem, Ierusalem, me kin kamela saukop akan o kasuk, me pakadara dong uk, pan pak toto I men kapokon pena noum seri kan dueta lituk amen kin kompwal pena na kan pan pa a, a komail kanger,

verses.name: Luke 13:35
verses.text: Kilang, im omail pan tanla, pwe I indai ong komail, komail solar pan kilang ia, lao a pan pwaida omail pan inda: Kapinga ong me kotido ni mar en Kaun!<div eID="gen2670" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.13"/>

verses.name: Luke 14:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO ni a kotilong ong nan im en kaun pan Parisär amen, pwen konot ni ran en sapat; a irail masamasan i.

verses.name: Luke 14:2
verses.text: A kilang, aramas amen mia wasa o, me lisongepo.

verses.name: Luke 14:3
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong saunkawewe o Parisär akan: Me pung, en kakelada ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: Luke 14:4
verses.text: Irail nenenla. I ap kotin sair i, kakelada o kadara wei.

verses.name: Luke 14:5
verses.text: Ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Is re omail, me na as de kau pupedi ong nan por o, me so pan madang apiada sang ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: Luke 14:6
verses.text: A irail sota kak sapengki i meakot.

verses.name: Luke 14:7
verses.text: A kotin masani ong toun kapar karaseras eu, ni a kotin mangi, me re inong iong en mondi ni tapin tepel, masani ong irail:

verses.name: Luke 14:8
verses.text: Koe lao pan luke dong kamadip en kapapaud ren meamen, ender mondi ong leppantam, pwe ele amen, me lapa sang koe lukedor.

verses.name: Luke 14:9
verses.text: O me luk uk edo o pil i, pan kodo indai ong uk: Ki ong ol men et deu om! A koe pan namenok kodido ong nan roulap.

verses.name: Luke 14:10
verses.text: A koe lao paluke, kola mondi ong nan roulap, pwe me luke uk lao pwarado, en indai ong uk: Kompoke pai, kotidato! Koe ari pan kaindand nan pung en ir, me iang uk ni tepel.

verses.name: Luke 14:11
verses.text: Pwe karos me kin kasapwilada pein i, pan kasapwilidi, o me kin kasapwilidi pein i, pan kasapwilada.

verses.name: Luke 14:12
verses.text: Ap pil kotin masani ong me lukedo i: Kom lao wiada konot en ni sauas de nin sautik, eder lukedo kompokepa om ko, de ri om akan, de sau om, de men imp om kapwapwa kan, pwe re de pil luke uk, o depuk ong uk.

verses.name: Luke 14:13
verses.text: A ma koe pan wia kamadip, en lukedo me samama o me pali duk kai, o me sikilikil, o me maskun akan.

verses.name: Luke 14:14
verses.text: Koe ari pan meid pai, pwe irail sota pan kak depuk ong uk, a a pan depuk ong uk ni ran o, me pung kan pan maureda.

verses.name: Luke 14:15
verses.text: A amen ir, me iang ni tepel o lao rongadar mepukat, ap potoan ong i: Meid pai, me pan sak prot nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 14:16
verses.text: A a kotin masani ong i: Aramas amen mia, me wiadar kamadip lapalap o luke pena me toto.

verses.name: Luke 14:17
verses.text: O kadarala na ladu o ni dokan kamadip, pwen kaire kin irail, me pan toun kapar: Komail ukedo, pwe meakaros onoper.

verses.name: Luke 14:18
verses.text: Irail ap wiaki eu ikidiki okotme. Men mas indai ong i: I netiada sap eu, i pan kola kilang; i poeki re om, koe en kadar ia la.

verses.name: Luke 14:19
verses.text: A amen inda: I pwainda kau ol ek, a met i pan kola kilang ir; i poeki re om, koe en kadar ia la.

verses.name: Luke 14:20
verses.text: A amen inda: I paudeki li amen, i me i sota kak kokila.

verses.name: Luke 14:21
verses.text: Ladu o ari purodo, kaireki a monsap meakan. Monsap o ap makara kidar indai ong a ladu: Tange wei nani al laud o al tikitik en kanim o wado me samama kan, o me pali duk, o me sikilikil, o me maskun akan.

verses.name: Luke 14:22
verses.text: A ladu o indada: Maing, a wiauier duen omui masan, a deun akai pil mia.

verses.name: Luke 14:23
verses.text: Monsap o ap indai ong a ladu: Kakan sili nani al o ni kailan kel akan, papain ir do, pwe im ai en tounla!

verses.name: Luke 14:24
verses.text: A i indai ong komail, nan sota amen ren ol oko, me paluke, pan song ai kamadip.

verses.name: Luke 14:25
verses.text: A pokon kalaimun idauenla i. I ari saupei ong irail masani:

verses.name: Luke 14:26
verses.text: Meamen kodo re i, ap so maliela sam a, o in a, o a paud, o na seri kan, o ri a ol, o li akan, o pil pein maur a, nan a sota pan kak ai tounpadak.

verses.name: Luke 14:27
verses.text: A meamen so kida a lopu o idauen ia do, a sota pan kak ai tounpadak.

verses.name: Luke 14:28
verses.text: Pwe is re omail, me pan kauada im en taulik eu, me sota pan mondi mas ap lamelame duen pwain a, ma a pan kak ong de so?

verses.name: Luke 14:29
verses.text: Pwe a de pasonedi, ap sota kak kanikiela; a karos, me udial, pan kaurureki i,

verses.name: Luke 14:30
verses.text: Indada: Aramas men et pikikidi kauada im, ap sota kak kanikiela.

verses.name: Luke 14:31
verses.text: De is nanmarki o, me pan mauin ong amen nanmarki, me sota pan mondi mas ap lamelame, ma a pan kak kaloekidi aramas nen aramas rianen?

verses.name: Luke 14:32
verses.text: A ma so, a pan kadarala men kadar akai, poekipoeki muei mau ni ara non doo pasang.

verses.name: Luke 14:33
verses.text: Nan iduen amen amen komail, me so muei sang meakaros, nan a sota pan kak ai tounpadak.

verses.name: Luke 14:34
verses.text: Sol me mau, a ma sol sarasang, da me a pan kanomanom mau kida?

verses.name: Luke 14:35
verses.text: A solar mau ong nan sap, pil so nan pwel, pwe aramas kin kasela. Me salong a mia men rong, i en rong!<div eID="gen2671" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.14"/>

verses.name: Luke 15:1
verses.text: A SAUNOPWEI o me dipan akan karos ap kai dong i pwen rong i.

verses.name: Luke 15:2
verses.text: A Parisär o saunkawewe kan lipaned indada: Ol men et kin kompokeki me dipan akan o iang irail sakasak.

verses.name: Luke 15:3
verses.text: A a kotin masani ong irail karaseras wet:

verses.name: Luke 15:4
verses.text: Is aramas re omail me na sip epuki, a ma amen irail salongalar me so pan pwilikidi ir duekduemen nan wel ap raparapaki me salongalar, lao a pan diarada i?

verses.name: Luke 15:5
verses.text: A lao diarada i, a kidang pon pop a pereperen.

verses.name: Luke 15:6
verses.text: A lao pure dong deu a, a kin eker pena kompokepa kan o men imp a kan indai ong irail: Komail iang ia perenda, pwe i diaradar nai sip me salongalar.

verses.name: Luke 15:7
verses.text: I indai ong komail, nan iduen peren pil pan mi nanlang pweki me dipan me ta men, me kalula, sang duekduemen me pung ap sota mau ong kalula.

verses.name: Luke 15:8
verses.text: O is li o me na denar eisok, eu ap salongala sang, me so pan isikada lamp o koke im o, o raparapaki mau, lao a pan diarada?

verses.name: Luke 15:9
