verses.text: A lao diaradar i, a kin eker pena kompokepa kan o men imp a kan indai ong irail: Komail iang ia perenda, pwe i diarada ai denar o, me salongalar.

verses.name: Luke 15:10
verses.text: Nan I indai ong komail, iduen peren mi ren tounlang en Kot akan, pweki me dipan me ta men, me kalula.

verses.name: Luke 15:11
verses.text: A kotin masani: Aramas amen mia, me na ol riamen.

verses.name: Luke 15:12
verses.text: A me tikitik re ’ra indai ong sam a: Sam ai, kotiki dong ia pwais ai en soso, me udan ai. I ari nene ong ira ara dipisou kan.

verses.name: Luke 15:13
verses.text: A murin ran akai me tikitik ren ol oko ki pena a dipisou karos, ap sailokalang sap doo, wasa a kasela mal a kapwa kan nin tiak sued.

verses.name: Luke 15:14
verses.text: A lao kamuse weita a kapwa karos, lek lapalap ap pwaida sap o, i ari dupokalar.

verses.name: Luke 15:15
verses.text: I ap koieila dodok ren me pweledan sap o men. I ap kadarala i, pwen kamanga na pwik kan.

verses.name: Luke 15:16
verses.text: I ari inong iong, kangkang wantuka kai, me pwik kin namenam, a sota me mueid ong i.

verses.name: Luke 15:17
verses.text: A kadekadeo i lao lolekongalar, ap indada: Ladu me depa mi ren sam ai, me kan ar manga me rak, a ngai pan mekila so kan ai manga.

verses.name: Luke 15:18
verses.text: I pan uda purela ren sam ai indai ong i: Sam ai, i wiadar dip ong nanlang o ong komui.

verses.name: Luke 15:19
verses.text: I solar warong adaneki noumui putak, komui ari wia kin ia ladu ’mui men.

verses.name: Luke 15:20
verses.text: I ari uda purela ren sam a. A ni a mi wasa doo, sam a kilangada i, ap pokela, pitipiti dong i o polodi i, metik i.

verses.name: Luke 15:21
verses.text: A putak o indai ong i: Sam ai, i wiadar dip ong nanlang o ong komui, i solar war ong adaneki noumui putak.

verses.name: Luke 15:22
verses.text: A sam masani ong na ladu kan: Wado likau kasampwal o kalikauwia kida i, o ki ong ring ni sondin pa a, o sut ni nä a kan.

verses.name: Luke 15:23
verses.text: O wado kau pul wi o kamela, pwe kitail en kang o pereperen.

verses.name: Luke 15:24
verses.text: Pwe nai putak men et melar ap mauredar, a salongalar ap diarokadar. Irail ari perendar.

verses.name: Luke 15:25
verses.text: A na putak laud mi nan sap o. Ni a pure dong koren iong im o, ap rongadar kakaul o kakalek,

verses.name: Luke 15:26
verses.text: Ap kalelapok ren ladu men duen ar wiawia.

verses.name: Luke 15:27
verses.text: A indang i: Ri omui ol puredo, sam omui ap kamela kau pul wi o, pwe a diaradar i memaur o kelail.

verses.name: Luke 15:28
verses.text: A ap makara kida o sota men pedelong, sam a ap pedoi dong re a poekipoeki.

verses.name: Luke 15:29
verses.text: A a sapeng indang sam a: Kom mangi, par toto me i papa komui, o i saikenta kawela eu omui masan akan, a kom sota kotiki ong ia kisin kut amen, i en kamadipeki kompoke pai kan.

verses.name: Luke 15:30
verses.text: A noumui putak men et lao kodo, murin a kamuse wei a dipisou ren me sued akan, komui ap isik ong i kau pul wi o.

verses.name: Luke 15:31
verses.text: Sam a ap masani ong i: Nai seri, koe kin mimieta re i ansau karos, o ai meakaros me om.

verses.name: Luke 15:32
verses.text: Me mau, koe en peren o insenemau. Pwe ri om ol men et melar, ap mauredar, a salongalar ap diarokadar.<div eID="gen2672" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.15"/>

verses.name: Luke 16:1
verses.text: A PIL kotin masani ong tounpadak kan: Ol kapwapwa men mia, me a saunkoa men indandeki, a peitlakit a koa kapwa kan.

verses.name: Luke 16:2
verses.text: I ari eker dong i indang i: Iaduen ai rongadar duen koe? Kaineneta noum kisin likau duen om dodok! Pwe koe solar kak saunkoa.

verses.name: Luke 16:3
verses.text: Saunkoa ap madamadaua indada: Da me i en wia, pwe ai monsap pan ki sang ia ai koa, nan i sota kak weweir, a poekipoeki me i namenokki.

verses.name: Luke 16:4
verses.text: I ap asada, me i pan wia, i lao sapwilidi sang ai koa, pwe irail en kasamo ia long ong nan im ar akan.

verses.name: Luke 16:5
verses.text: I ari ekeredo me pwaipwand ong a monsap, ap idok ren men mas: Da me om pwaipwand ong ai monsap?

verses.name: Luke 16:6
verses.text: A inda: Potel en le epuki. A indai ong i: Ale noum puk mondi pitipit intingiedi me limeisok!

verses.name: Luke 16:7
verses.text: Ap pil indai ong amen: A koe, da me om pwaipwand? A inda: Kopa en wan korn epuki. A indang i: Ale noum puk intingiedi me waleisok!

verses.name: Luke 16:8
verses.text: Monsap ap kapinga saunkoa sapung, pweki a dodok lolekong. Pwe seri en sappa kan me lolekong ni song ar sang seri en marain akan.

verses.name: Luke 16:9
verses.text: I ap indai ong komail, komail wia kompoke pamail ki mamon sapung pwe komail lao samamalar, ren kasamolong ong nan deu potopot.

verses.name: Luke 16:10
verses.text: Meamen apwali mau me tikitik o, nan i me pil kin apwali mau me lapalap. A me kin sapung ni me tikitik o, nan i me pil sapung ni me toto.

verses.name: Luke 16:11
verses.text: Ma komail sota apwali mau pai pali pa, is me pan liki ong komail pai pali poa?

verses.name: Luke 16:12
verses.text: O ma komail sota apwali mau en amen a kapwa, is me pan liki ong komail me udan omail?

verses.name: Luke 16:13
verses.text: Sota ladu men me pan kak papa saumas riamen; pwe a pan kailongki amen o pok ong me teio. De kasampwaleki amen o mamaleki me teio. Komail sota pan kak pariai pena Kot o mamon.

verses.name: Luke 16:14
verses.text: Parisär akan, me kin pok ong moni, pil rongadar mepukat, ap kaurureki i.

verses.name: Luke 16:15
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Nan komail me kin akapungki pein komail ren aramas, a Kot kin mangi nan mongiong omail. Pwe me kasampwal ren aramas, kin me mal ren Kot.

verses.name: Luke 16:16
verses.text: Kapung o saukop akan kokoper lel ni muein Ioanes. A sang ni ansau o rongamau en wein Kot kin lolok sili, a karos kin pedelongki manaman.

verses.name: Luke 16:17
verses.text: Nan me mongai, lang o sappa pan sorela, sang ekis kisan kapung en lokidokila.

verses.name: Luke 16:18
verses.text: Meamen kasela a paud, ap paudeki amen li, nan i me kamal, o meamen me paudekida me lokidokila sang ren ol amen, nan i me kamal.

verses.name: Luke 16:19
verses.text: Ol kapwapwa men mia, me a likau waitata o materok o a kin kamadip o peren ni ran karos.

verses.name: Luke 16:20
verses.text: O pil amen ol me samama, ad a Lasarus, me kin wonon pan wanim en ol kapwapwa o; a kensela kili karos.

verses.name: Luke 16:21
verses.text: Ap men tungole maremor akan, me kin pupedi ni tepel en me kapwapwa; a kidi kan kin tamotamo a kens akan.

verses.name: Luke 16:22
verses.text: A kadekadeo me samama o mela o tounlang kai ap wadala pon kapa en Apraam. A me kapwapwa o pil mela o saredier.

verses.name: Luke 16:23
verses.text: Ni a mi nan pweleko, wasan waiwairok, ap sarada, udial Apraam ni wasa doo o Lasarus mondi pon kapa,

verses.name: Luke 16:24
verses.text: Ap likwirda indada: Sam (ai) Apraam, kom kotin kupura ia, poronedo Lasarus en kaduedi sondin pa a nan pil, ki ong pon lo i, pwe i kin waiwairok nani iai wet.

verses.name: Luke 16:25
verses.text: A Apraam kotin masani: Nai, tamanda, me koe tungoler om mau kan karos ni maur om, a Lasarus a me sued akan; ari a pan pereperenta, a koe pan kalokolok.

verses.name: Luke 16:26
verses.text: A pil eu me kawela, wau kalaimun eu mi nan pung atail, pwe ma amen kit men sapale wong re omail, a sota pan kak, pil sota amen komail pan kakedo.

verses.name: Luke 16:27
verses.text: A ap inda: I ap men poeki, sam ai, komui en kotin poronelang Lasarus nan im en sam ai.

verses.name: Luke 16:28
verses.text: Pwe ri ai ol me limen, me a pan kaasaki irail; pwe ren de lel ong wasa apwal wet!

verses.name: Luke 16:29
verses.text: A Apraam masani ong i: Moses o saukop akan mi re ’rail, ren nok rong irail.

verses.name: Luke 16:30
verses.text: A ol o potoan ong: Kaidin sam (ai) Apraam, a ma amen sang ren me melar akan pan pwara dong irail, rap pan kalula.

verses.name: Luke 16:31
verses.text: A ap masani ong i: Ma re sota pan rong Moses o saukop akan, re pil sota pan poson la, ma amen pan maureda sang ren me melar akan.<div eID="gen2673" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.16"/>

verses.name: Luke 17:1
verses.text: A KOTIN masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Nan a sota kak, men kamakar kan en so pwaida, a suedi ong me kokido.

verses.name: Luke 17:2
verses.text: A mau ong, takai en ir plaua eu en paudoki ong ni tapin wor a, ap lokidokila nan madau, sang a kamakar amen tikitik pukat.

verses.name: Luke 17:3
verses.text: Kalaka pein komail! Ma ri om ol wia dipi ong uk, en kapung ong i, a ma a pan kalukila, maki ong i.

verses.name: Luke 17:4
verses.text: A ma a wia dipi ong uk pan isepak ni ran eu o pure dong uk pan isepak indada: I kalula, koe en maki ong i!

verses.name: Luke 17:5
verses.text: A wanporon akan potoan ong Kaun o: Re kotin kalaudela at poson!

verses.name: Luke 17:6
verses.text: A Kaun o kotin masani: Ma omail poson laudi ong wan katiring, komail pan kak indai ong tuka pik pot et: Kaisang, kasau ong nan madau, a pan oke komail.

verses.name: Luke 17:7
verses.text: A is re omail, me a ladu men, me kin matimat o kamakamanga man akan, pan indang i ni a puredo sang matuel o: Madang kodo mondi o manga?

verses.name: Luke 17:8
verses.text: A sota pan indang i: Kaonopada me i pan manga nin sautik o, kaiada om likau, papa ia, lao i mangaer o nim, a muri koe pan manga o nim.

verses.name: Luke 17:9
verses.text: De a pan danke ladu pweki a wiada, me a masani ong i? I lamelam so.

verses.name: Luke 17:10
verses.text: Pil dueta komail, komail, lao wiadar meakan me kakaliki ong komail er, komail ap pan inda: Kit ladu mal, pwe i eta, me se wiadar, me kakalik ong kit er.

verses.name: Luke 17:11
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni a kotilang Ierusalem, a kotin weid nan wein Samaria o Kaliläa.

verses.name: Luke 17:12
verses.text: O ni a kotin kotilong ong nan kisin kanim eu, ol tuketuk ek tu ong i, me udi ong kaila wei.

verses.name: Luke 17:13
verses.text: Irail ngil laudeda indada: Maing Iesus, kupurai kit!

verses.name: Luke 17:14
verses.text: A lao kotin masanier, ap masani ong irail: Komail koieila kasansale ong pein komail ong samero kan. Kadekadeo ni arail kokola irail kelailada.

verses.name: Luke 17:15
verses.text: A amen irail ni a kilanger me a kelailadar, ap puredo ngil laudeda, kapikapinga Kot.

verses.name: Luke 17:16
verses.text: O poridi sang aluwilu a, danke i; ari, i men Samaria men.

verses.name: Luke 17:17
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani: Kaidin me ek, me kelailadar, a ia me duemen oko?

verses.name: Luke 17:18
verses.text: Sota me pure dong kapinga Kot, ol en liki men et eta?

verses.name: Luke 17:19
verses.text: A masani ong i: Uda ko wei, om poson me kakel uk ada!

verses.name: Luke 17:20
verses.text: Parisär akai lao kalelapok re a: Dokan da me wein Kot pan pwaida? A kotin sapeng masani: Nan wein Kot sota kin sansal kokodo.

verses.name: Luke 17:21
verses.text: Irail sota pan indada: Kilang met, de kilang monen, pwe kilang, wein Kot mi lol omail.

verses.name: Luke 17:22
verses.text: A kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Ran oko pan kodo, me komail pan men kilangada ran eu en Nain aramas, a komail sota pan kak kilang.

verses.name: Luke 17:23
verses.text: Irail pan indai ong komail: Kilang monen, de kilang met! A der kola o der idauen ir ala!

verses.name: Luke 17:24
verses.text: Pwe duen liol kin lingaling sang apali en lang lel pali teio en lang, iduen Nain aramas ni a ran o.

verses.name: Luke 17:25
verses.text: A mas a pan kalokolok toto o lokidokila ren di wet.

verses.name: Luke 17:26
verses.text: O duen a wiaui ni muein Noa, iduen a pan wiaui ni ran oko en Nain aramas:

verses.name: Luke 17:27
verses.text: Irail manga, irail nim, irail papaud, irail kapapaud, lao lel ran en Noa a pedelong ong nan war im o, o nolik pwaida kamom ir ala karos.

verses.name: Luke 17:28
verses.text: Pil dueta ni muein Lot: Irail manga, irail nim, irail netinet, irail sapasap, irail kauadar im,

verses.name: Luke 17:29
verses.text: A ni ran o, me Lot koiei sang Sodom, kisiniai o swepel ap moredi sang nanlang, kame ir ala karos.

verses.name: Luke 17:30
verses.text: Nan iduen a pan wiaui ni ran, me Nain aramas pan sansaledo.

verses.name: Luke 17:31
verses.text: Ni ran o meamen mi pon im, o a kapwa mi nan im, a ender kodi ong ale. O pil dueta me mimi nan sap, i ender puredo.

verses.name: Luke 17:32
verses.text: Tamatamanda en Lot a paud!

verses.name: Luke 17:33
verses.text: Pwe meamen kanakanai ong maur a, pan pupe sang, a me pan kasela, nan i me pan maureta.

verses.name: Luke 17:34
verses.text: I indai ong komail, ni pong ota ol riamen pan wonon pon pet eu, amen pan peuka sang, a me teio pan mimieta.

verses.name: Luke 17:35
verses.text: Li riamen pan iris pena plaua, amen pan peuka sang, a me teio pan mimieta.

verses.name: Luke 17:36
verses.text: Ol riamen pan mi nan sap, amen pan peuka sang, a me teio pan mimieta.

verses.name: Luke 17:37
verses.text: Irail sapeng potoan ong i: Ia Maing? A kotin masani ong irail: Wasa me man mat mi ia, nan i wasa pwin ikel pan pil pokon pena ia.<div eID="gen2674" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.17"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:1
verses.text: A PIL kotin masani ong irail karaseras eu, me ren poden kapakap o der pangada.

verses.name: Luke 18:2
verses.text: A kotin masani: Saunkapung amen mi nan kanim eu, me sota lan Kot, o sota insenoki aramas amen.

verses.name: Luke 18:3
verses.text: A li odi men mi nan kanim ota, me poto dong i potoan ong: Kom kotin sauasa ia ong me kailong kin ia!

verses.name: Luke 18:4
verses.text: A a kang mas o, a kadekadeo a mongemongeloleki: Nan i sota lan Kot, o pil sota insenoki aramas,

verses.name: Luke 18:5
verses.text: A pweki li odi men et a kadiropa ia, i pan sauasa i, pwen der purodo kadiropa ia.

verses.name: Luke 18:6
verses.text: Kaun o ap kotin masani: Komail rong, me saunkapung sapung indada!

verses.name: Luke 18:7
verses.text: A iaduen Kot, a sota pan kotin sauasa sapwilim a pilipildar akan, me kin likelikwir ong i ni ran o ni pong? Pala a pan kotin pwapwand?

verses.name: Luke 18:8
verses.text: I indai ong komail: Nan a pan madang sauasa ir. Ari so, Nain aramas lao pwarado, da, a pan diar poson ni sappa?

verses.name: Luke 18:9
verses.text: A pil kotin karasai ong irail me kin akapungki pein irail, ap akasapungki me tei kan:

verses.name: Luke 18:10
verses.text: Aramas riamen kodala ong nan im en kaudok pwen kapakap. Amen ira Parisär, a amen saunopwei men.

verses.name: Luke 18:11
verses.text: Parisär o kasinenda kelepela ekis wasa kapakap due met: Maing Kot, i danke ir, me i sota dueta aramas tei kan: Lolap, sapung, kamal, de dueta saunopwei men et.

verses.name: Luke 18:12
verses.text: I kin kaikaisole pan riapak ni wik eu o koleireki eisokkis eu en ai kapwa karos.

verses.name: Luke 18:13
verses.text: A saunopwei u doo sang ekis wasa, ap sota men sarada nanlang, a a pikir maramar a indada: Maing Kot, re kotin kupura ia me dipan!

verses.name: Luke 18:14
verses.text: I indai ong komail, ol men et kodila deu a pungala mon me teio. Pwe me kin kasapwilada pein i, pan kasapwilidi, a me kin kasapwilidi pein i pan kasapwilada,

verses.name: Luke 18:15
verses.text: Irail ap wa dong i kisin seri kai, pwen kotin sair ir. A sapwilim a tounpadak kan lao kilanger, re ap kapoui irail.

verses.name: Luke 18:16
verses.text: A Iesus kotin molipe ir masani: Mueid ong kisin seri kan, en kodo re i! Der kalik irail edi! Pwe irail me udan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 18:17
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, meamen, me sota ale wein Kot rasong kisin seri men, a sota pan pedelong ong lole.

verses.name: Luke 18:18
verses.text: A monsap amen idok re a masani: Saunpadak mau, da me i en wiada, pwen sosoki maur soutuk?

verses.name: Luke 18:19
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin masani ong i: Da me koe indaki, me I me mau? Sota me mau men, Kot eta.

verses.name: Luke 18:20
verses.text: Koe kin asa kusoned akan: Koe der kamal; koe der kamela aramas; koe der pirap, koe der kinekine mal, kakaki sam om o in om!

verses.name: Luke 18:21
verses.text: I ari indada: Nan mepukat karos i kin wiawia sang ni ai tikitik kokodo.

verses.name: Luke 18:22
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi mepukat, ap masani ong i: Me ta kis me lua, netikila om kapwa karos, o nene ong me samama kan, a om pai pan mi nanlang, ap kodo idauen ia do.

verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: A lao rongadar met, ap insensuede kila melel, pwe a kapwapwa kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: A Iesus lao kotin masani, me a insensuedela, ap masani: Nan me apwal ong me kapwapwa kan, en pedelong ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: Pwe me mangai, kamel en tilong nan por en dikok, sang ol kapwapwa men pedelong ong nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: Irail me rongerong indada: Ari, is me kak ong maur?

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: A kotin masani: Me aramas akan so kak ong, Kot me pan kak ong.

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: Petrus ap potoan ong: Re kotin mangi, kit me likid maliela meakaros ap idauen la ir.

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Melel I indai ong komail, nan sota me likidmaliela im a, de sam, de in a, de ri a ol akan, de a paud, de na seri kan pweki wein Kot,

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: Me so pan id aneki me lapalap ni ansau wet o ni muei kokodo maur soutuk.

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: A kotin ukala ekriamen ko masani ong irail: Kilang, kitail kin kodalang Ierusalem, o karos pan pwaida, me intingidier ren saukop akan duen Nain aramas.

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: Pwe a pan pangala ren men liki kan, pwe re pan kapikapiti i o ki sang wau i, o kondipi ong i.

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: O re pan woki i o kamela, a ni kasilu en ran a pan maureda.

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: Irail ari sota man weweki mepukat, O masan pot et me rir sang irail. Re pil sasa, me a kotin masani.

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni a koren iong Ieriko, ol maskun amen momod pon kailan al, poekipoeki.

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: I lao rongadar pokon o me daudaulul, ap idok due.

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: Irail ari indang i, me Iesus men Nasaret kotin daulul.

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: I ari ngil laudeda potoan ong: Iesus, sapwilim en Dawid, kotin kupura ia!

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: A me tiong moa kidekidaue i, en nenenla: A i ap kalaudela a poekipoeki: Sapwilim en Dawid, kotin kupura ia!

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin udi ong wasa o, masani, ol o en wisike dong i. A lao koren iong imp a, ap kotin kainoma re a.

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: Masani: Da me koe men, I en wiai ong uk? A potoan ong: Maing, i men potoan ngarada wasa.

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Kilang wasa, om poson me kakel uk ada!

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: Ap pitipit kilangada wasa, o idauenla i, o kapinga Kot, o aramas karos, me udial met, ap kapikapinga Kot.<div eID="gen2675" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.18"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: I ARI kotilong ong nan kanim Ieriko, ap kotin daulula.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: A kilang, ol kapwapwa men mia, ad a Sakäus, me saumas en saunopwei kan.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: A men kilang Iesus, pwen asa, is i, ap sota kak, pweki pokon o, o a sakakair.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: I ari tiong mo ’rail, dauda nin tuka pot, pwen kak kilang i, pwe a pan kotin daulul wasa o.

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: A lao lel wasa o Iesus ap kotin masanda diar i, masani ong i: Sakäus, madang daudi, pwe I pan pedelong ong nan im om ran wet.

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: I ari madang daudi kasamo i pereperen.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: Irail lao kilanger met, karos ap lipanedeki inda: A pedelonger, pwen kairu ren ol dipan amen.

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: A Sakäus potodo potoan ong Kaun o: Maing re kotin mangi, apali en ai kapwa i pan kisakisaki me samama kan, o ma i kotaue amen, i kin kasapal wong i pan pa pak laude sang.

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Maur me pwara dong nan im wet ran wet, pwe a pil nain Apraam amen.

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: Pwe Nain aramas pwara don rapaki o kamaureda me salongalar.

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: A ni ar rongadar mepukat, a pil kotin masani karaseras eu, aki koren iong Ierusalem, o re kiki ong, me wein Kot pan madang sansaleda.

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: A kotin masani: Ol lapalap amen kolang sap doo eu, pwen nine mar a, ap pan puredo.

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: I me eker pena na ladu ek, o ki ong irail paun eisok, indang irail: Komail dodokki, i lao puredo.

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: A na aramas akan kailongki i, kadarala mur i kaireki lang i: Se sota mauki, ol men et en kaun kit.

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: Kadekadeo a lao puredo, murin a aleer wei o, ap ilakelang ladu kan, me a ki ong na moni, pwen asa duen en amen amen ar kalaudelar na moni.

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: Men mas ap pwarado indada: Maing, omui paun kareda paun eisok.

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: A indang i: Meid pai ladu mau koe, aki om apapwali mau me tikitik, koe pan id kaunda kanim eisok.

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: O kariamen ap pwarado indada: Maing, omui paun me kareda paun limau.

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: A pil indang i: Koe pan kaunda kanim limau.

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: O pil amen pwarado indada: Maing, mangi, ietet sapwilim omui paun, me i nekidala nan lim en pudo.

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: Pwe i masak komui, pwe ol petik amen komui. Komui kin aleda, me kaidin komui kidier, o dolung sang, me kaidin komui padukedier.

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: A indang i: Sang nan au om i pan kadeik kin uk ada ladu sued koe. Koe asaer, me ol petik amen ngai, me kin ale, me kaidin ngai kidier o dolung sang, me kaidin ngai padukidier.

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: Menda koe sota wala nai moni wasan kanaitik, o i lao puredo, i pan ale me udan ai iangaki moni naitik.

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: A indai ong irail me u impa: Ale sang i paun o, ki ong ren me a paun eisok!

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: Irail indai ong i: Maing, nan a nainekier paun eisok.

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, meamen, me a mia, ekis pan ko ong, a me sota a mia, nan a pwitikatik pil pan katia sang.

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: A ir, ai imwintiti, me kang, i en kakaun ir, wa ir do, o kame ir ala mo i!

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: A lao kotin kaimwisokala a masan pukat, ap kotiwei kotidala Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: Kadekadeo a lao koti dong Petpake o Petanien impan dol me ad a Oliwe, ap kotin poronela sapwilim a tounpadak riamen,

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: Masani: Koma ko ong nan kanim monen, koma lao pedelong, koma pan diarada esel pul amen salidi, me aramas amen saik mondi poa. Lapwada i, ap karedo!

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: A ma meamen pan idok re oma: Da me koma lapwa kida i? Koma ap pan inda: Kaun o men dake.

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: A ira me pakadara wei, ap kola o diarada, duen a kotin masani ong ira.

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: A ni ara lawada esel pul o, ol oko, me naineki, ap indang ira: Da me koma lawa kida esel pul en?

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: Ira ap indada: Kaun o men dake.

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: Ira ari wado ren Iesus, ap irepadi pon esel pul arail likau kan ap potoan dang Iesus poa.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: Ni a kotikot kokowei, irail ap irepakidi arail likau kan nani al.

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: A lao kotin korendor kotidila dol Oliwe tounpadak kan karos ap wiaki eu ngil laudeda kapinga Kot, pweki manaman akan karos, me re kilanger,

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: Indada: Kapinga ong Nanmarki, me kotido ni mar en Kaun! Nanlang en popol o lingan wasa ileile!

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: A Parisär kai kisan pokon o indai ong i: Saunpadak, kotin kidaue sapwilim omui tounpadak kan.

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: I ari kotin sapeng masani ong irail: I indai ong komail, ma mepukat pan nenenla, takai pan id kadededa.

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: A lao kotin korendor, ap masani kanim o, ap tontonireki,

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: Masani: O i men, koe en dedeki om ran mau wet, me pan kare ong uk popol: Ari, a rir sanger mon mas om.

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: Pwe ran apwal ko pan lel ong uk, me om imwintiti pan kele kin uk pena o it pena sang ni pali karos;

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: O irail pan kase uk ala iangaki noum seri kan, o re pan karongk uk ala; sota eu takai pan mimieta pon eu, pweki om sota dedeki ansaun om kasosong.

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: I ari kotilong ong nan im en kaudok, ap sikon sang me netinet lole,

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: Masani ong ir: Nan a intingidier: Im ai im en kapakap, a komail wiaki deun lolap akan.

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: I ari kotin kaukawewe nan im en kaudok ran karos. A samero lapalap, o saunkawewe, o me lapalap akan ren aramas raparapaki, en kamatala i.

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: A re sota kak diar, me ren wiada, pwe aramas karos apwali i kaualap o men rong i.<div eID="gen2676" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.19"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO eu ran ni a kotin kawewe ong aramas akan nan im en kaudok o, o padaki rongamau, samero lapalap, o saunkawewe, iangaki saumas akan ap ko dong i.

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: Potoan ong i indada: Masani ong kit, manaman en is, me komui wiaki mepukat? De is me ki ong komui manaman wet?

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: A kotin sapeng masani ong irail: I pil pan kalelapok meakot re omail, komail en sapeng ia!

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: En Ioanes a paptais men nanlang, de me ren aramas?

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: Irail ap lamelame nan pung arail indada: Ma kitail pan inda, men nanlang, a pan masani ong kitail: Da me komail so posonki i?

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: A ma kitail inda, me ren aramas, aramas karos ap pan kate kit, pwe re kin wia saukopki Ioanes.

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: Irail ari sapeng, me re sasa, wasa me a kosang ia.

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Ari, I pil sota pan indai ong komail, manaman en is, me I wiaki mepukat.

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: A ap kotin tapiada masani ong pokon o karaseras wet: Aramas amen padukedier mat en wain eu, ap liki ong saumat akai, o kokola nan wai ansau warai.

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: A lao ansau, a kadaralang saumat akan ladu men, pwe ren ki ong kisan wan wain. A saumat akan woki i, o kadarala i kaip.

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: A murin met a pil kadarala amen ladu, a re pil woki i, o wia suedi ong, o kadarala i kaip.

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: A murin met a kadarala kasilimen. A re pil kame i o siken wei sang.

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: Monsap en mat en wain o ap masani: Da me i en wiada? I pan kadarala nai ol kompok, ele re pan masak, ni ar pan kilang i.

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: A saumat akan lao kilanger i, rap lamelame nan pung ar indada: Iei i, me pan ale soso, kitail pan kamela, pwen id aneki a soso.

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: Irail lao kasapoka sang i nan matuel o, ap kamela i. Da me monsap en mat en wain pan wiai ong irail?

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: A pan kodo kamela saumat pukat, ap liki ong akai a mat en wain. Irail lao ronger mepukat, rap indada: O mepukat sota pan wiaui!

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: A kotin saupei wong irail ap kotin masani: Iaduen wewe en inting wet: Takai o, me sause kasapokela, id wiala takai en pukakaim?

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: Meamen, me pupedi pon takai wet pan ola. A me a pupedi ong poa, a pan kapitaka pasang i.

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: I dokan o saunkawewe o samero lapalap akan raparapaki en saikidi i. A re masak aramas akan, pwe re muilikiada, me a karaseras kin irail.

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: Irail ari masamasan i o kadarala liparok kai, me pan wia kin pein irail aramas pung, pwe ren saikikidi i a masan akan ap pangalang saunkapung o manaman en kopina.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: Irail ari kalelapok re a potoan ong: Saunpadak, kit potoan asa, me ar masan o padak kan me pung, o re sota kotin kupuroki sansal en aramas. Pwe re kin kotin kaukaweweda melel duen al en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: Me pung kit en nopwei ong nanmarki, de so?

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: A i kotin mangi ar widing, ap masani ong ir: Da me komail kasongesong kin ia?

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: Kasale dong ia denar eu! Mom en is o inting wet? Re sapeng potoan ong: En nanmarki.

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: A i kotin masani ong irail: Ari komail ki ong nanmarki, me nain nanmarki, o ong Kot, me sapwilim en Kot!

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: Irail ari sota kak saikikidi i a masan akan mon pokon o. Irail puriamuiki me a kotin sapeng, o nenenlata.

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: Sadusär akai, me kin inda, me dene melar akan solar pan maureda, ap kai dong i kalelapok re a,

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: Potoan ong: Saunpadak, Moses intingie dong kit, ma ri ol en amen pan mela, me a paud li dapwan men, ri a ol ap pan paudekida i, pwen kaipwi ong ri a ol na seri kai.

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: Ari, pwin pirien, ol isimen mia, men mas paudeki li amen, ap mela, a sota na seri ko.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: A kariamen paude kida li o ap mela a sota na seri ko.

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: A kasilimen paude kida i, iduen ir isimen karos, re mela, ap sota nairail seri ko.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: A ikmuri li o pil mela.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: Ari, ni en me melar akan ar iasada, a pan en is a paud? Pwe ir isimen karos paude kida i.

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Seri en sappa et kin papaud o kapapaud.

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: A me war ong ale eu sap o konodi maureda sang ren me melar akan, re sota kin papaud de kapapaud.

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: Pwe re pil solar kak mela. Pwe re paroki ong tounlang kan, o re seri en Kot akan, pwe re seri en kamaur.

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: A duen en me melar akan ar pan maureda, Moses pil kadededa, ni a udial tuka o, ni a kaadaneki Kaun o: Kot en Apraam, o Kot en Isaak, o Kot en Iakop.

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: Pwe Kot kaidin Kot en me melar akan, a en me maur akan, pwe karos memaur ong i.

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: A Saunkawewe kai sapeng indada: Saunpadak, ar masan me pung.

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: Irail ap solar kak peidok re a okotme,

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong irail: Iaduen ar indinda, me Kristus nain Dawid?

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: A pein Dawid katitiki nan puk en Psalm: Kaun o kotin masani ong ai Kaun: Mondi ong ni pali maun i.

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: Lao I pan wia kida om imwintiti utepan nä om.

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: Dawid ari wia kin i a Kaun, a iaduen a pan kak na ol?

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: A ni aramas karos rongadar, a kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan:

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: Kalaka saunkawewe kan, me kin mauki momait sili nan likau reirei o mauki, aramas en ranamau ong irail nan wasa en netinet akan, o men mondi leppantam nan sinakoke kan o ni tapin tepel.

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: Me kin ngopur im en li odi kan, liasoski kapakap reirei, mepukat pan pangalang kadeik apwal.<div eID="gen2677" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.20"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: A KOTIN aupwil sili ap masani, me kapwapwa kan kasedi ong ar mairong nan deun mairong.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: A pil kotin masani, me li odi samama men kasedi ong lepta riau.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: A kotin masani: Melel I indai ong komail, li odi samama men et kasedi ong laude sang irail karos.

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: Pwe mepukat karos kasedi ong mairong en Kot sang ni ar pai, a li men et kasedi sang ni a samama, a dipisou karos, me a naineki.

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: Akai lao kasokasoiadar duen im en kaudok, me kapwata kida takai kasampwal akan o kapwa en mairong kai, ap kotin masani:

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: Ran oko kokodo, karos, me komail ududial, pan karangk pasang, sota eu takai pan mi pon eu.

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: Irail kalelapok re a potoan ong: Saunpadak iad mepukat pan pwaida? O da pan kilel en mepukat pan wiaui?

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: A kotin masani: Komail kalaka, pwe meamen de kotaue komail! Pwe me toto pan kodo ni ad ai o pan inda: Ngai i o ansau korendor! A komail der idauen ir ala.

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: A komail lao rong duen mauin o muei sued, ender masak, pwe mepukat pan wiaui mas, a saikenta imwi.

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Toun sap eu pan u ong eu sap, o wei eu pan u ong eu wei.

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: O rerer laud en sap akan pan wiaui, o lek, o song en somau pan pwaida, o pil sansal kamasapwek kai, o kilel lapalap akan pan pwarada sang nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: A mon mepukat re pan saik komail edi, o kame komail, o panga komail la nan sinakoke kan o imateng pwen kalualang ren nanmarki o saumas akan pweki ad ai.

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: A mepukat pan wiaui ong komail, pwen kadede kin ia.

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: Komail ari inauki ong pein komail nan mongiong omail, me komail sota pan patauki, me komail pan sapengki.

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: Pwe ngai me pan kalokaia komail, o kalolekongla, pwe me kailong kin komail, en sota kak kalikama, o so palian.

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: A sam o in omail, o ri ol akan, o sau omail, o kompokepa kan pan panga komail la, o akai komail me re pan kamela.

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: O aramas karos pan kailong kin komail pweki ad ai.

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: A sota pit en mong omail pit pan lokidokila.

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: Dore kila kanongama maur omail:

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: A komail lao udial, me saunpei kan kapili pena Ierusalem, komail ap asaki, me a ola korendor.

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: A me mimi Iudäa, ni ansau o, en tangdala nan nana; o me mi nan warong a, en pitila sang; o me mimi nan sap, ender purelang i.

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: Pwe i ansaun depuk, pwe karos, me intingidier, en pwaida.

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: Suedi ong me lisean o me kadidi seri ni ran oko! Pwe kalokolok pan lapalapia nan sap et o ongiong ong aramas pukat.

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: O re pan kame kila kodlas, o salilang wei karos, o Ierusalem pan tiak pasang ren men liki kan, lao ansau en men liki kan, pan lel.

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: O kilel akan pan wiaui ni katipin, o saunipong, o usu kan, o aramas nan sappa pan masak o pan pingidar, o madau o iluk kan pan angiang ngil laudeda;

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: O aramas akan pan okila ar masak o auiaui me pan wiaui nan sappa; pwe kel en lang akan pan mokideda.

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: Irail ap pan kilangada Nain aramas a kodido ni dapok ki roson o lingan kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: Mepukat lao pikikidi wiaui, komail ap sarada o kasinenda, pwe a leler omail kamaioda.

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: A kotin masani karaseras eu ong irail: Kilang tuka pik o tuka karos!

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: Ni omail kilang me irail wiliada, komail kin asaki, me rak o me korendor.

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: Iduen komail, komail lao kilang mepukat lao wiaui, komail asaki, me wein Kot korendor.

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: Melel I indai ong komail, di wet sota pan imwila mon mepukat karos pan pwaida.

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: Lan o sappa pan sorela, a ai masan akan sota pan poula.

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: Komail ari kalaka pein komail, pwe mongiong omail de toutouki kaped en manga, o kamom sakau, o ngongongki maur et, o ran o ap madang lel dong komail.

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: Pwe likamata insar eu, a pan ko dong karos, me kin kakauson sappa.

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: Komail ari masamasan o poden kapakap, pwe komail en war ong en piti sang mepukat karos, me pan wiaui, o en pat ong Nain aramas.

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: Ni ran o a kotin kaukawewe nan im en kaudok o, a ni pong a kotieila kotikot pon dol o me adaneki Oliwe.

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: O aramas karos sangkonai pokon dong i nan im en kaudok o, pwen rong i.<div eID="gen2678" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.21"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: A KAMADIP en prot somut korendor, me adaneki pasa.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: Samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan raparapaki, pwen kamatala i, pwe irail masak aramas akan.

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: A Satan tilong ong Iudas me adaneki Iskariot, me kisan ekriamen ko.

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: I ari koieila ren samero lapalap o saumas akan, kalelapok duen a pan pangalang ir i.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: Irail ari peren kida, wiaki eu en ki ong i moni.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: I ari inauki ong irail, o raparapaki, duen a pan pangalang ir i so moromorong.

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: Ran en prot somut ap leler, ansaun kamela pasa.

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: I ari poronela Petrus o Ioanes masani: U kowei, kaonopadang kitail pasa, pwe kitail en manga.

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: Irail idok re a: Ia wasa, re kotin kupura, sen kaonopada?

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Kilang, koma lao pedelong kanim o, aramas amen pan tu ong koma, me wa pakit en pil eu, idauen i nan im o, me a pedelong ong lole!

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: Koma ap indang kaun pan im o: Saunpadak o masanie dong komui: Ia pera en kairu, wasa I pan manga pasa ia iangaki ai tounpadak kan?

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: I ari pan kasale ong koma weip poa eu, me audeki men momod, i wasa koma pan kaonopada!

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: Ira lao koieila, ap diarada, duen a kotin masani ong ira; ira ap kaonopada pasa.

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: Auer lao leler, i ap kaipokedi ni tepel o wanporon ekriamen iang i.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: I ap kotin masani ong irail. I anane melel iang komail manga pasa wet mon ai pan kalokolok.

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, I solar pan kang sang met kokolata, a lao kapungala nan wein Kot.

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: I ari kotikida dal o laolaoki ap masani: Ale met, nek nan pung omail!

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, I solar pan nim sang kisan wan wain, wein Kot lao pwaidar.

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: A kotin limada prot, laolaoki o pilitiki pena, ap kotiki ong irail masani: War ai metet, me pangalang komail! Komail en wia me wet, men kataman kin ia.

verses.name: Luke 22:20
verses.text: O pil dal en nim murin kasipong masani: Dal wet kadede kap ni mom en nt’ ai, me kapwilepilidi ong komail.

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: A kilang, pa en me pan pang ia la, me iang ia ni tepel o.

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: Nan melel, Nain aramas pan kokola duen a kileledier, a suedi ong aramas o, me a pan pangkila!

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: Irail ari pikikidi idok nan pung arail, is re irail, me pan wiada met?

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: Irail pil akamaiki nan pung arail, duen is me pan lapalap re irail.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Nanmarki en wei pokon akan kin poe irail edi o me manaman akan kin adaneki monsap kalangan.

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: A komail sota pan dueta, a me lapalap re omail, i en dueta me tikitik, o me kin kaunda, en dueta me kin papa.

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: Pwe is me lapalap ren me mondi ni tepel de me kin papa? Kaidin i, me mondi ni tepel? A ngai dueta ladu pamail.

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: Nan komail me iang ia ni ai songesong.

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: Ngai ari kileledi ong komail wei eu, duen Sam ai kileledi ong ia er;

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: Pwe komail en manga o nim ni ai tepel nan ai wei o mondi pon men mondi ko, kakaun kainok en Israel eisokriau.

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: Kaun ap kotin masani: Simon, Simon, kilang, Satan ngongkin komail, pwen koko komail dueta wan prot.

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: A ngai me kapakapa kin uk, pwe om poson de nikila. A koe lao sapaledo kakelada ri om ol akan!

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: A a potoan ong i: Maing, i pan idauen ir lel nan imateng o matala.

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: A kotin masani: Petrus, I indai ong uk, nan malek sota pan kakorot ran wet, koe lao kamamki pan silepak, me koe asa ia.

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Ni ai kadar komail wei so ed en moni, o so ed en sailok, o so sut, meakot komail lekekilar? Re ap potoan ong: Sota.

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong irail: A met, me a ed en moni mia, en ale o pil ed en sailok, o me so a, i en netekila a likau, ap id netiada kodlas pot.

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: Pwe I indai ong komail, me intingidier, pil pan pwai ong ia: A wadawad ong me dipan akan, pwe me intingidier duen ngai, pan kaimwisokala.

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: Irail indada: Maing, kotin masani, iet kodlas riapot. A kotin masani ong irail. Ari, i eta.

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: I ari kotilang dol Oliwe, duen a kin wia; tounpadak kan idauenla i.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: I lao lel ong wasa o, ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail kapakap pwe komail de ko ong nan songesong.

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: I ari tororela sang irail doo weita kapir won takai eu, ap kelepuki laolao.

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: Masani: Sam (ai), ma komui mauki, koti ki wei sang ia dal wet, ari so, kaidin insen ai, pwe kupur omui ta en wiaui.

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: Nan tounlang amen pwarado sang nanlang katinada i.

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: A ni a kotin pador ong mela, ap ngiangiang a laolao, lao pudo a likamata nta, me dingedingedi ong nan pwel.

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: A kotida sang a laolao o kotin pur ong tounpadak kan, ir mamair aki ar mamauk.

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: Masani ong irail: Da me komail mamairki? Paurida o kapakap, pwe komail de ko ong nan songesong!

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: A ni a kotin masani mepukat, kilang, pokon o, o me adaneki Iudas, amen ir ekriamen, tiong mo ’rail, kaikai dong Iesus, pwen metik i.

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: A Iesus kotin masani ong i: Iudas, koe pan pang kila metik eu Nain aramas?

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: Irail me iang i lao kilanger me pan wiaui, rap indai ong i: Maing, se so pan wokieki ir kodlas?

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: Amen ir pala ladun samero lapalap amen o sara sang salong a pali maun.

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani: Arier! I ap kotin sair salong a, kakelada i.

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong samero lapalap akan, o kaun pan im en kaudok, o saumas akan, me ko dong i: Dueta lolap amen, me komail koko dong, wa kodlas o katiu kai?

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: Ni ran karos ngai iang komail nan im en kaudok, a komail sota man sair ia, pwe ansau wet omail ansau o manaman en rotorot.

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: Re ap saikidi i o kalualong ong nan im en samero lapalap o, a Petrus idauenla doowei sang.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: Irail ap saunda kisiniai eu nan warong en kel o mod pena, a Petrus mondi nan pung arail.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: A lidu men kilang i a momod impan kisiniai o kangkakil i indada:

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: Iet et pil iang i. I ari kamam kin i indada: Li, i sasa i.

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: A mur kis amen kilang i indada: Koe pil amen irail. A Petrus indada: O kaidin ngai!

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin auer eu amen katitiki indada: Melel i men et iang i, pwe i kisan men Kaliläa.

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: A Petrus indada: O i poneponeki om kasokasoi! A pitipit ni a lokelokaia malek ap kakoroteda.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: Kaun ap kotin saupeido masani Petrus. Petrus ap tamanda masan en Kaun, duen a kotin masani ong i: Mon malek kakorot, koe pan kamam kin ia pan silepak.

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: Petrus ari koieila sangesang kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: A ol oko, me kolekol i, lalaue o woki i.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: Irail lao perala silang i, ap idedok re a indada: Kopada, is i, me pikir uk ada?

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: O song en lalaue toto, me re ki ong i.

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: A lao ran pasang saumas akan o samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan ap pokon pena o kalua i dong nan arail kapung.

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: Indada: Ma koe Kristus, ap katiti ong kit! A kotin masani ong irail: Ma I pan indai ong komail, komail sota pan kamelele;

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: A ma I pan idok, komail sota pan sapeng, o pil sota lapwa ia da.

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: Ari, sang met Nain aramas pan mondi ni pali maun en roson en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: Ir karos ap idok: Ari, sapwilim en Kot koe? A a kotin masani ong irail: Komail me indada, pwe ngai i.

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: Irail indada: Ari, menda apot kadede? Pwe pein kitail ronga sang nan au a.<div eID="gen2679" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.22"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: TOUN pokon karos ap kasinenda kalualang i ren Pilatus.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: Irail ari pikikidi impimpa i indada: Se diarada lap men et, me a kin kaweid sapung aramas akan o inapwiedi, ender nopwei ong nanmarki, ap inda, me dene pein i Kristus o nanmarki.

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: Pilatus ari idok re a masani: Nanmarki en Sus akan komui? A kotin sapeng i masani: Komui me inda.

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: Pilatus ap masani ong samero lapalap akan o pokon o: Sota dip, me i diar ren aramas men et.

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: A irail ngidingideki i indada: A kin kapeida aramas ni a kaukawewe sili nan Iudäa, tapiada Kaliläa kokodo lel sap wet.

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: Pilatus lao rongadar Kaliläa, ap idok, ma i aramas en Kaliläa men.

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: A i lao rongadar, me kisan toun wein Erodes, ap kadarala i ren Erodes, me pil kotikot Ierusalem ni ran oko.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: Erodes lao masani Iesus, ap perenda kaualap, pwe me warai a kin anane udial i, pweki me toto a rongadar iran i, o a pil kaporoporeki, me a pan udial kilel eu sang re a.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: I ari kalelapok re a ni masan toto. A i sota kotin man sapeng i.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: A samero lapalap o saunkawewe kan kasinenda o impimpa i kaualap.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: A Erodes o na saunpei kan mamaleki i o likauki i likau puetepuet o kapure wong i ren Pilatus.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: A ni ran ota Pilatus o Erodes insenemau pena, pwe mas o ira imwintiti pena.

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: A Pilatus kapokon pena samero lapalap, o monsap, o aramas akan,

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: Ap masani ong irail: Komail wa dong ia aramas men et, dene kaweid sapung aramas akan. A kilang, i kalekalelapok re a mo ’mail, ap sota dip, me i diar ren aramas men et, duen me komail katikatipiaki i.

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: Erodes pil so, pwe i kadar wong i komail. A kilang, sota me a wiadar pwen kame kila i.

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: Ari, i pan woki i ap lapwada.

verses.name: Luke 23:17
verses.text: Pwe a pan udan lapwa dang irail meamen nin kamadip o.

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: Irail karos ap likelikwir indada: Kasapokela men et o lapwa dong kit Parapas!

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: Me lokidokilar nan imateng aki moromorong eu o kamela en aramas amen, me wiauier nan kanim o.

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: Pilatus ari men lapwada Iesus, ap pil masani ong irail.

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: A irail likelikwir indada: Kalopuela, kalopuela i!

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: A masani ong irail kasilepak: Pwe me sued da, me a wiadar? Sota me i diaradar re a, me i en kamata kila. Ari, i pan woki i ap lapwada.

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: A irail nantiong weriwereda ngidingidiki i, me a en lopuela; o ar weriwer o en samero lapalap akan lalaudelar.

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: Pilatus ap inda, me ar poekipoek en pwaida,

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: Ap lapwada i, me lokidokilar nan imateng aki moromorong eu o kamela en aramas amen, me irail poeki, ap mueid ong irail Iesus, en wiai ong i duen insen arail.

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: O ni arail kalua wei i, re ap saikidi Simon men Kirene, me kodo sang nan sap o. Ir ari kidang po a lopu, pwen wala murin Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: O pokon kalaimun idauenla i, o li kai me sangesang o mamaukeki i.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: Iesus kotin saupei dong irail masani: Li en Ierusalem akan, ender sangesang kin ia, a sangesang kin pein komail o noumail seri kan.

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: Pwe kilang, ni ran oko kokodo aramas pan indinda: Meid pai li dapwan o irail me sota naitik, o didi kan, me sota kadidi!

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: Re ap pan pikikidi ekeker ong nana kan: Pupedi ong po at! O ong dol akan: Kadupal kit edi!

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: Pwe ma re wiadar mepukat ong tuka maur, da me re pan wia ong tuka mongedi?

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: A pil lolap riamen iang i kalua wei kamela.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: Irail lao lei wasa, me adaneki pondal en mong, ap kalopuela i o me lolap oko, amen ni pali maun o amen ni pali maing.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Sam (ai), Kom kotin maki ong irail, pwe irail sasa, me re wiawia. Irail ari nene pasang sapwilim a likau kan o kadoropwa kida.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: Aramas me u kangkakil o monsap akan iang irail kapikapiti i indada: A kamaureda akai, i en kamaureda pein i, ma i Kristus sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: A saunpei kan pil kapikapiti i, kai ong i, ki ong i pinika,

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: Indada: Ma koe Nanmarki en Sus akan, en kapitila pein uk.

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: A pil inting eu, me intingidier ponangen i ni lokaia en Krik, o Latain, o Ipru: Iet Nanmarki en Sus akan.

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: A amen ren lolap oko, me langadar, lalaue i indada: Kaidin koe Kristus Kapiti sang pein uk o kit!

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: Me teio ap sapeng, kapung ong i indada: Koe pil sota masak Kot ni om iang kadeik wet?

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: Pwe ata kalokolok me pung, pwe iduen ata wiawia kan, a ol men et sota wiadar meakot me sued.

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: Ap potoan ong Iesus: Maing, re kotin kupura ia, lao re kotida nan wei ar.

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Melel I indai ong uk, ran wet koe pan iang ia mi nan paradis.

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: Ni auer kawonu ap rotorotala nan sap karos lao lel auer kaduau,

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: O katipin rotorotala, o likau en pera en im en kaudok o dei pasang sang poa lel pa.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin kapitie laudeda masani: Sam (ai), i mueidalang ngen i nan lim omui kan. A lao kotin masanier met, ap kotin poular.

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: A saumas en saunpei o, ni a kilanger me wiauier, ap kapikapinga Kot indada: Melel, aramas men et me pung.

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: O aramas karos me pokon penaer pwen iang kilang, lao kilanger me wiauier, ap pikir maramar arail o pure pasang.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: A kompokepa kan karos o li akan, me idauendo i sang Kaliläa, u kailawei, kilekilang mepukat.

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: O kilang ol amen, me mar a Iosep, saunkapung amen, ol mau o pung amen,

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: Me sota apali ong irail ni ar kapukapung o wiawia kan, men Arimatia, kanim eu en Iudäa, me pil auiaui wein Kot,

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: I me poto dong Pilatus poekipoeki kalep en Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: I ari kidi sang i o kidimki pena likau linen kaselel o kidi ong nan sousou, me weiweida nan paip, wasa me saikenta amen saredi ia.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: A ran o ran en kaonop o sapat korendor.

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: A li akan, me iang i kodido sang Kaliläa, pil iang udial sousou o, wasa me kalep a nekinekid ia.

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: Irail ap purer o kaonopada potik kai o men usor, re ap kamol ni ran en sapat duen kusoned o.<div eID="gen2680" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.23"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: A NIN tapin wik, nin soran kaualap re pwara dong sousou o, wado potik kai me re kaonopadar;

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: Irail ari diaradar, me takai o kadapura sang sousou o,

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: O irail lao pedelong ong lole, ap sota diarada kalep en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: Kadekadeo irail lao insensued kidar, kilang, ol riamen, me likau kida likau linang, ap pwara dong irail.

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: Irail lao masapwekadar o ikiokidi nan pwel, ira ap masani ong irail: Da me komail raparapaki me maur amen ren me melar akan?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: A soer kotikot met, a iasadar. Tamanda, me a kotin masani ong komail ni a kotikoteta Kaliläa,

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: Mamasani: Nain aramas pan pangalang ni pa en me dipan akan, o lopuela, o ni ran kasilu a pan iasada.

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: Ir ari tamanda a masan akan.

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: O purodo sang nin sousou o, ap kaireki mepukat ong ekamen ko o ong me tei kan karos.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: Maria men Makdala, o Ioana, o Maria in en Iokopus, o me tei ko me iang irail, me kaireki mepukat ong wanporon akan.

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: A arail kasoi likamata kasoi likam pot re ’rail, ap sota kamelele.

verses.name: Luke 24:12
verses.text: Petrus ap uda tangalang sousou o, rukedi ong lole, ap diarada, me likau linen akan ta wonon wasa kis, ap purodo sang o puriamui kida me wiauier.

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: A kilang ni ran ota riamen re ’rail momaitelang kisin kanim eu ad a Emaus; a doo sang Ierusalem mail wonu de isu.

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: Ira ari kasokasoi penaer duen mepukat karos.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni ara kasokasoi o idedok pena, pein Iesus ap kotin pwara dong ira o iang ira kotila.

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: A mas ara me atiat, pwe re de asa i.

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: I ari kotin masani ong ira: Da me koma kasokasoi pena ni oma alialu, o da me koma insensued kila?

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: Amen ira, me ad a Kleopas, ap sapeng indang i: Koe men wai ta men nan Ierusalem, me sasa, me wiauier wasa o ni ran pukat?

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ira: Pwe dakot? Ira ap indang i: Duen Iesus en Nasaret, me saukop manaman amen ni a wiawia o masan akan mon Kot o aramas karos.

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: O duen samero lapalap o atail saumas akan ar pangala i pwen pakadeikada ong matala o kalopuela i.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
verses.text: A se kiki ong, me a pan kotin kamaioda wein Israel. Ari ran wet pong sili pong murin mepukat wiauier.

verses.name: Luke 24:22
verses.text: O pil kis at li akai kamasak kin kit ar pwaralang sousou o sangkonai.

verses.name: Luke 24:23
verses.text: Ni ar sota diar kalep a, rap puredo indada, me re diaradar sansal en tounlang kai, me katitiki, me a iasadar,

verses.name: Luke 24:24
verses.text: O kis at kai kolang sousou o, ap diaradar, duen li oko kasokasoida, a i me re sota diarada.

verses.name: Luke 24:25
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ira: O koma meid lolepon o pwand nan mongiong omail, en kamelele meakan, me saukop akan kopadar.

verses.name: Luke 24:26
verses.text: Kaidin i, me udan Kristus en kalokolok ap kodalang a lingan?

verses.name: Luke 24:27
verses.text: A ap kotin kawewe ong ira kisin likau kan duen pein i, tapiada ni Moses kokodo lel saukop akan.

verses.name: Luke 24:28
verses.text: Irail ap koren iong kanim, me irail koko ong. I ari kasongesong ira, dene a pan kotin daulul.

verses.name: Luke 24:29
verses.text: Ira ap ngidingidiki i potoan ong: Kom kotikoteta re at, pwe a pan wasa pongier o ran wet koren iong imwisokela. A ap kotilong ong nan im o, pwen mimieta re ra.

verses.name: Luke 24:30
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni a kotin iang ira ni tepel o, a kotin limada prot, laolaoki, a lao pilitiki pena, a kotiki ong ira.

verses.name: Luke 24:31
verses.text: Mas ara ap pad pasanger, ira ap asa i. A ap kotin soredi sang mo ’ra.

verses.name: Luke 24:32
verses.text: Ira ap inda nan pung ara: Mongiong ata sota mokimokid ni a kotin mamasani ong kita pon al o, ni a kotin kawewe ong kita kisin likau kan?

verses.name: Luke 24:33
verses.text: Ira ari uda ni auer ota o purelang Ierusalem, o diarada ekamen ko, o me iang ir, kot pena wasa takis,

verses.name: Luke 24:34
verses.text: Katitiki: Nan melel Kaun o kotin iasadar o pwara dong Simon,

verses.name: Luke 24:35
verses.text: Ira ap kasokasoi, me wiauier nani al o, o duen ara asaki i a pilitiki pasang prot.

verses.name: Luke 24:36
verses.text: A ni ar masan pena mepukat, pein Iesus ap kotin pwara dong nan pung arail masani ong ir: Komail popol!

verses.name: Luke 24:37
verses.text: Irail ari masapwekadar o wapondar, o re kiki ong, me ani men, me re udial.

verses.name: Luke 24:38
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Da me komail masak ki? O menda lamelam pukat mi nan mongiong omail?

verses.name: Luke 24:39
verses.text: Komail kilang pa i kat o na i kat, pwe pein ngai ta. Doke ia o kilang, pwe ani sota kin uduk o ti, duen omail kilang ia.

verses.name: Luke 24:40
verses.text: A lao masani mepukat, ap kasale ong irail lim a o aluwilu a kan.

verses.name: Luke 24:41
verses.text: A ni ar sota non kamelele pweki ar peren o puriamuiki, ap kotin masani ong irail: Sota kan omail met?

verses.name: Luke 24:42
verses.text: Rap ki ong i kisan mam inin o onik.

verses.name: Luke 24:43
verses.text: I ari konot mo ’rail.

verses.name: Luke 24:44
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: I masan akan, me I ki ong komail er, ni ai mimieta re omail, pwe karos en pwaida, me intingidier duen ngai nan kapung en Moses, o saukop akan, o psalm akan.

verses.name: Luke 24:45
verses.text: I ap kotin kalolikongi irail, pwe ren dedeki kisin likau kai.

verses.name: Luke 24:46
verses.text: O kotin masani ong irail iduen a intingidier, o iduen udan kalokolok en Kristus, ap maureda sang ren me melar akan ni ran kasilu,

verses.name: Luke 24:47
verses.text: O padapadaki ong wei karos ni mar a, ren kalula, pwe dip akan en lapwada, a pan tapida nan Ierusalem.

verses.name: Luke 24:48
verses.text: A komail me saunkadede en mepukat.

verses.name: Luke 24:49
verses.text: A kilang, I pan kadara dong komail, me Sam ai inaukidar. A komail pan mimieta nan kanim o, komail lao audaudekier manaman sang poa.

verses.name: Luke 24:50
verses.text: A kotin kalua ir alang Petanien, kotikida lim a, kapai irail ada.

verses.name: Luke 24:51
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni a kotin kapal ir ada, a kotiwei sang irail, kotidala nanlang.

verses.name: Luke 24:52
verses.text: Irail ari kaudok ong i, ap pure dong Ierusalem perenda kaualap;

verses.name: Luke 24:53
verses.text: O re potopot nan im en kaudok kapinga o kaudok ong Kot.<div eID="gen2681" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Luke.24"/> <div eID="gen2657" osisID="Luke" type="book"/>

verses.name: John 1:1
verses.text: MASAN kotier ni tapi o, a masan kotier ren Kot, a masan me udan Kot.

verses.name: John 1:2
verses.text: I me kotikot ren Kot ni tapi o.

verses.name: John 1:3
verses.text: I me dipisou karos tapi kidar, o sota man meakot mia, me kaidin i kotin wiadar.

verses.name: John 1:4
verses.text: Maur mi re a; o iei maur o marain en aramas.

verses.name: John 1:5
verses.text: A marain o me dakarada rotorot, a rotorot sota lingan kila.

verses.name: John 1:6
verses.text: Aramas amen me pakadarador sang ren Kot ad a Ioanes!

verses.name: John 1:7
verses.text: I me pwara dong kadede, pwen kadede marain o pwe karos en poson pweki i.

verses.name: John 1:8
verses.text: Kaidin i me marain o, a a kin kadede marain o.

verses.name: John 1:9
verses.text: Iei marain melel, me pwara dong sappa, ap kamaraini aramas karos.

verses.name: John 1:10
verses.text: I me kotier sappa, o i me sappa tapi kidar, a sappa sasa i.

verses.name: John 1:11
verses.text: A koti dong udan sapwilim a, a sapwilim a kan me san i.

verses.name: John 1:12
verses.text: Karos, me kasamo i, a kotiki ong ir manaman, en wiala seri en Kot, ir, me poson mar a,

verses.name: John 1:13
verses.text: Me kaidin ipwidi sang nta, de inong en uduk, de inong en ol o, pwe ipwidier sang ren Kot.

verses.name: John 1:14
verses.text: Masan me wia uduk ala o kotikot re atail, o kitail kilanger a lingan, lingan dueta lingan en Ieros eu sang ren Sam o, me dir en mak melel.

verses.name: John 1:15
verses.text: Ioanes me kadede i ngil laudeda indada: Iei i, me i padaki wei: Me pan kotido mur i, iei me mier mo i, pwe a kotikotier mo i.

verses.name: John 1:16
verses.text: Pwe kitail karos ale sang nan audepa a mak sapan potopot.

verses.name: John 1:17
verses.text: Pwe kapung me kokido sang Moses, a mak o melel sang Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: John 1:18
verses.text: Sota me kilanger Kot kokodo, Ol ieros ta, me kin kotikot pan kupur en Sam o, i me kotin kasaledar i.

verses.name: John 1:19
verses.text: A met en Ioanes a kadede, ni men Sus kadarala sang Ierusalem samero o lepit oko, pwen idok re a: Is koe?

verses.name: John 1:20
verses.text: I ari kotin kadede; a sota likam; a kotin kadede: Kaidin Kristus ngai.

verses.name: John 1:21
verses.text: Irail idok re a: A is? Elias komui? A masani: Kaidin ngai i. Komui saukop o? A sapeng: Kaidin.

verses.name: John 1:22
verses.text: Irail ap indang i: A is komui? Pwe sen sapeng irail me kadar kit dor. Da me komui kadedeki pein komui?

verses.name: John 1:23
verses.text: A masani: Ngai ngil eu, me likelikwir sili nan sap tan: Kaineneda al en Kaun o, duen saukop Iesaia masanier!

verses.name: John 1:24
verses.text: A irail pakadaradoer sang ren Parisär akan.

verses.name: John 1:25
verses.text: Irail ap idok re a indada: Da me komui wia paptaisiki, ma komui kaidin Kristus, o kaidin Elias, o pil kaidin saukop o?

verses.name: John 1:26
verses.text: Ioanes sapeng irail masani: Ngai me paptaisiki pil, a amen kin kotikot nan pung omail, me komail sasa.

verses.name: John 1:27
verses.text: Iei i me kotido mur i, me ngai sowar ong, en lapwada sal en sapwilim a sut.

verses.name: John 1:28
verses.text: Mepukat wiauier Petapara palilan Iordan, wasa Ioanes kin wia paptais ia.

verses.name: John 1:29
verses.text: Mandan ran o a masani Iesus a koti dong i ap masani: Kilang Sippul en Kot, me kin wawei dip en sappa!

verses.name: John 1:30
verses.text: Iei i, me i padaki wei: Ol amen pan kotido mur i iei, me mier mo i, pwe a kotikotier mo i.

verses.name: John 1:31
verses.text: A ngai so asa i, a pwe i en sansal dong Israel, iei me i kokido paptaisiki pil.

verses.name: John 1:32
verses.text: A Ioanes kadede masani: I kilanger Ngen o kotidido sang nanlang ni mom en muroi kotikot re a.

verses.name: John 1:33
verses.text: A ngai so asa i, a me porone ia don wia paptaisiki pil, iei me kotin masani ong ia: Me koe pan kilang. Ngen piridi sok poa, o kotikoteta re a, iei i, me kin wia paptaisiki Ngen saraui.

verses.name: John 1:34
verses.text: A i kilangadar ap kadedeki, me iei Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: John 1:35
verses.text: Mandan ran o Ioanes pil kotida wasa o, o na tounpadak riamen iang i.

verses.name: John 1:36
verses.text: A ni a udial Iesus kotikot kokodo, ap masani: Kilang Sippul en Kot!

verses.name: John 1:37
verses.text: A tounpadak riamen rongadar a masan, ap idauen wei Iesus.

verses.name: John 1:38
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin saupeido masani ara idedauen, ap kotin masani ong ira: Da me koma rapaki? Ira potoan ong: Rapi (iet wewe: Saunpadak), ia wasa re kin kotikot ia?

verses.name: John 1:39
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ira: Kodo kilang! Ira ap poto dong kilanger wasa, me a kotikot ia, ap mimieta re a ni ran o. Mepukat wiauier impan auer kaeisok.

verses.name: John 1:40
verses.text: Andreas, ri en Simon Petrus amen re ra, me rongadar sang ren Ioanes ap idedauen i.

verses.name: John 1:41
verses.text: I me diaradar mas udan ri a Simon, indai ong i: Se diaradar Mesias (iet wewe: Kristus).

verses.name: John 1:42
verses.text: I ap kalualang i ren Iesus. A Iesus lao masani i, ap masani: Simon, koe nain Iona, koe nok adaneki Kepas (iet wewe: Paip).

verses.name: John 1:43
verses.text: Mandan ran o a pan kotilang Kaliläa, Iesus ap kotin diaradar Pilipus, masani ong i: Idauen ia do!

verses.name: John 1:44
verses.text: Pilipus men Petsaida, kanim en Andreas o Petrus.

verses.name: John 1:45
verses.text: Pilipus diaradar Natanael, ap indang i: Se diaradar i, duen me Moses intingiedier nan puk en kapung o saukop akan: Iesus men Nasaret, sapwilim en Iosep.

verses.name: John 1:46
verses.text: A Natanael indai ong i: Pala maukot pan kak pwarada sang Nasaret? Pilipus indang i: Kodo kilang!

verses.name: John 1:47
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani Natanael koko dong i, ap masani duen i: Kilang, ol melel en Israel amen, me sota kin widing.

verses.name: John 1:48
verses.text: Natanael potoan ong i: Re kotin mangi ia sang ia? Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Mon Pilipus a eker uk edo, ni om mod pan tuka pik o, I kilang uk ada.

verses.name: John 1:49
verses.text: Natanael sapeng potoan ong i: Rapi, ir me Sapwilim en Kot, ir me Nanmarki en Israel.

verses.name: John 1:50
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Pweki I indai ong uk, me I kilang uk ada pan tuka pik o, iei me koe posonki, a koe nok kilang me lapa sang mepukat.

verses.name: John 1:51
verses.text: A kotin masani ong i: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, sang met komail pan kilang nanlang a ritida o tounlang en Kot akan dauda o daudi pwarado ren Nain aramas.<div eID="gen2683" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.1"/>

verses.name: John 2:1
verses.text: A NI kasilu en ran kamadip en kapapaud wiaui Kana nan Kaliläa; a in en Iesus kot wasa o.

verses.name: John 2:2
verses.text: Iesus o sapwilim a tounpadak kan me pil luke dong kamadip o.

verses.name: John 2:3
verses.text: Arail wain lao roselar, in en Iesus ap masani ong i: Solar arail wain.

verses.name: John 2:4
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Li, menda re om? Ai ansau saikenta leler.

verses.name: John 2:5
verses.text: In a ap masani ong papa kan: Komail wiada meakaros, me a pan kotin masani ong komail.

verses.name: John 2:6
verses.text: Ari, potel takai wonu mi wasa o, en Sus akan ar men dopedop lole. Eu me laude ong metreten riau de silu.

verses.name: John 2:7
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Komail idip ong pil en potel akan! Irail ari kodiada lel au ar.

verses.name: John 2:8
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong irail: Deukada, wala ren me kaun en konot: Irail ap wala.

verses.name: John 2:9
verses.text: Kaun en konot lao song kis pil, me wia wain la, o so asa, a idipi sang ia, a papa kan, me idip pil da, asa. Kaun en konot ap ekeredo ol kamod o,

verses.name: John 2:10
verses.text: Indang i: Aramas karos kin kida mas wain mau, toun kamadip lao medilar, re kin kida, me sota non mau. A komui kin nekinekid wain mau lel met.

verses.name: John 2:11
verses.text: I met tapidan kilel akan, me Iesus kotin wiadar Kana nan Kaliläa, o kotin kasaleda a lingan, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan posonla i.

verses.name: John 2:12
verses.text: A murin met a kotidilang Kapernaum, i o in a, o ri a ol akan, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan, ari, sota non ran toto, me re kotikot wasa o.

verses.name: John 2:13
verses.text: A pasa en Sus akan me korendor, a Iesus kotidalang Ierusalem.

verses.name: John 2:14
verses.text: A kotin masani nan im en kaudok men netinet en kau, o sip, o muroi, o men wiliandi moni me momod ia.

verses.name: John 2:15
verses.text: Ap kotin wiakida men wokiwok sal akai, ap woki ir sang nan im en kaudok iangaki sip o kau akan, o moni en saunwiliandi a kotin kasapokela o kotin wukedidi tepel akan.

verses.name: John 2:16
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong men netinet en muroi kan: Wawei sang met met akan, o der wiakidar tanpas en Sam ai im en net eu!

verses.name: John 2:17
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan tamanda me intingidier: Limpok ong tanpas omui me kasor ia dier.

verses.name: John 2:18
verses.text: Sus oko ap sapeng indang i: Kilel da, me kom kadedeki ong kit, me komui manaman ong, en wiada mepukat?

verses.name: John 2:19
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Palanga pasang im en kaudok wet, a pong sili pong I pan kauada.

verses.name: John 2:20
verses.text: Sus oko ap indada: Par ngaulwonu me im en kaudok wet wiaui kidar, a pong sili pong komui pan kaua kida?

verses.name: John 2:21
verses.text: Ari, tanpas en pali war a, me a kotin masanie kida.

verses.name: John 2:22
verses.text: A lao iasadar sang a matalar, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap tamandar, me a kotin masanier mepukat. Irail ari poson kisin likau kan o masan, me Iesus kotin masaniadar.

verses.name: John 2:23
verses.text: Ni a kotikot Ierusalem ni pasa, ni kamadip o, me toto posonla mar a, ni ar kilanger kilel akan, me a kotin wiadar.

verses.name: John 2:24
verses.text: A Iesus sota kotin liki ong ir pein i, pwe a kotin mangi irail karos.

verses.name: John 2:25
verses.text: O a sota mau ong, meamen en kadede ong i aramas amen, pwe pein i kotin mangi lol en aramas.<div eID="gen2684" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.2"/>

verses.name: John 3:1
verses.text: ARAMAS amen mia, kisan Parsär akan, me mar a Nikodemus, me saumas amen ren Sus akan,

verses.name: John 3:2
verses.text: Me poto dong i ni pong o, katiti ong i: Rapi, se asa, me komui saunpadak amen, me tapido sang ren Kot, pwe sota, me kak wia kilel akan due me komui kotin wiada, ma Kot so iang.

verses.name: John 3:3
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Melel, melel I indai ong uk, meamen so ipwi sapal, sota pan kak kilang wein Kot.

verses.name: John 3:4
verses.text: Nikodemus potoan ong i: Iaduen aramas laud pan kak ipwidi? A pan kak pur ong nan kaped en in a, ipwidi sang?

verses.name: John 3:5
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Melel, melel I indai ong uk, meamen so ipwiki pil o ngen, a sota kak pedelong ong nan wein Kot!

verses.name: John 3:6
verses.text: Me ipwiki uduk, iei uduk, a me ipwiki Ngen, iei ngen.

verses.name: John 3:7
verses.text: Koe der puriamuiki, me I katitiki ong uk: Komail en ipwi sapal.

verses.name: John 3:8
verses.text: Ang kin pein ipip sili, o koe kin rong ngil a, a koe sasa, wasa a tapi sang ia o wasa a ko ong ia; iduen amen amen, me ipwiki Ngen.

verses.name: John 3:9
verses.text: Nikodemus sapeng indai ong i: Iaduen mepukat kak wiaui?

verses.name: John 3:10
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Saunpadak en Israel amen koe, a koe sasa duen mepukat?

verses.name: John 3:11
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong uk, me se asadar, iei me se kin indada, o me se kilanger, iei me se katitiki, a komail sota kin kamelele at kadede.

verses.name: John 3:12
verses.text: Ma I katitiki ong komail men pa, a komail ap sota kamelele, a iaduen, komail pan kamelele, ma I katitiki ong komail men nanlang?

verses.name: John 3:13
verses.text: Sota meamen, me kodala nanlang, i eta, me kodido sang nanlang, Nain aramas, me kin mimieta nanlang.

verses.name: John 3:14
verses.text: Duen Moses me kauadar serpent amen nan sap tan, iduen Nain aramas pan kakauda.

verses.name: John 3:15
verses.text: Pwe meamen posonla i, sota pan lokidokila, a en aneki maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 3:16
verses.text: Pwe iet duen Kot kotin kupura sappa, me a kotikidoki sapwilim a Ieros, pwe karos, me posonla i, ender salongala, a en aneki maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 3:17
verses.text: Pwe Kot me kotin porone dong sappa sapwilim a Ol, kaidin en kadeikada sappa, a pwe sappa en kamauri kila i.

verses.name: John 3:18
verses.text: Me poson i, sota pan pakadeikada, a me so poson i, iei pakadeikadar, pweki a sota poson mar en sapwilim en Kot ieros.

verses.name: John 3:19
verses.text: A iet kadeik o, marain pwara dong sappa, a aramas pok ong rotorot mon marain, pweki ar wiawia kan me sued.

verses.name: John 3:20
verses.text: Pwe amen amen, me wiawia sued, kin kailongki marain, o sota kin pwara dong marain, pwe a wiawia kan de sansaleda.

verses.name: John 3:21
verses.text: A me wiawia melel, kin ko dong marain, pwe a wiawia kan en sansaleda, me re tapi sang ren Kot.

verses.name: John 3:22
verses.text: Murin mepukat Iesus o sapwilim a tounpadak kan kotilang sap en Iudäa ap kotikot ia wia paptais.

verses.name: John 3:23
verses.text: A Ioanes pil wia paptais Enon koren iong Salim, aki pil toto mi wasa o, irail ari koieila paptaisela.

verses.name: John 3:24
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes saikenta lokidokilar nan imateng.

verses.name: John 3:25
verses.text: En Ioanes a tounpadak kan o ol en Sus amen ap akamaiki pena duen kamakelekel.

verses.name: John 3:26
verses.text: Irail ari ko dong ren Ioanes indang i: Rapi, me kot re omui palilan Iordan, me komui kin kadede, masani, a kin wia paptais o karos kin pwarala re a.

verses.name: John 3:27
verses.text: Ioanes sapeng masani: Aramas amen sota kak aneki meakot, ma a so aneki sang nanlang.

verses.name: John 3:28
verses.text: Komail pein kadede kin ia, me i indada: Kaidin Kristus ngai, pwe ngai me pakatarador mo a.

verses.name: John 3:29
verses.text: Me li amen kisin nin ong, iei ol kamod. A kompoke pan ol kamod kin u rongerong perenki ngil en ol kamod; ari, iei ai peren unsokala.

verses.name: John 3:30
verses.text: I en kakairida, a ngai en kakairidi.

verses.name: John 3:31
verses.text: Me kotido sang poa, i me poedi karos, a me kisan sappa, iei men sappa, o a kin kasokasoia duen sappa. A me kotido sang nanlang, me poedi karos,

verses.name: John 3:32
verses.text: O me a kilangada o rongada, iei me a kin kadedeki, a sota me kamelele a kadede.

verses.name: John 3:33
verses.text: A me kamelele a kadede, kin kadede, me Kot me melel.

verses.name: John 3:34
verses.text: Pwe i, me Kot kotin poronedor, kin kida en Kot a masan, pwe Kot sota kotikida Ngen ki men song.

verses.name: John 3:35
verses.text: Sam me kotin kupura sapwilim a Ol o kotiki onger ni lim a meakaros.

verses.name: John 3:36
verses.text: Me poson sapwilim a Ol, aneki maur soutuk. A me sota poson sapwilim a Ol, sota pan kilang maur, a ongiong en Kot pan mimieta re a.<div eID="gen2685" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.3"/>

verses.name: John 4:1
verses.text: KAUN lao kotin mangi, me Parisär akan rongadar, me Iesus kin wiada tounpadak kan o paptais toto sang Ioanes,

verses.name: John 4:2
verses.text: Ari, pwe sota me pein Iesus kotin paptais, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ta,

verses.name: John 4:3
verses.text: Ap kotila sang Iudäa, kotin purelang Kaliläa.

verses.name: John 4:4
verses.text: A a kotin weid nan wein Samaria.

verses.name: John 4:5
verses.text: I ap kotilang kanim en Samaria eu, me adaneki Sikar, koren iong sap, me Iakop ki ong na ol Iosep.

verses.name: John 4:6
verses.text: Iei wasa en Iakop a parer eu mia. Iesus ari ngirekila a sapasapal, ap kaipokedi pon parer o, ari mepukat wiauier impan auer kawonu.

verses.name: John 4:7
verses.text: A li en Samaria amen ap kodon idip pil ia. Iesus kotin masani ong i: Kido lim ai kis pil en!

verses.name: John 4:8
verses.text: Pwe sapwilim a tounpadak kan ko ong nan kanim, pan netiada sak arail.

verses.name: John 4:9
verses.text: Li en Samaria ap indang i: Iaduen, komui kisan men Sus, ap poeki pil re i? Pwe ngai li en Samaria amen, pwe Sus akan sota kin waroki ong men Samaria.

verses.name: John 4:10
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Ma koe asa duen kisakis sang ren Kot o is i, me indang uk: Kido lim ai kis pil en, koe pan poeki re a, a ap pan ki ong uk pil memaur.

verses.name: John 4:11
verses.text: Li o indang i: Maing, sota sapwilim omui men idip pil, a parer me lol, a ia wasa, kom pan idip sang ia pil memaur?

verses.name: John 4:12
verses.text: De komui lapa sang sam at Iakop, me kotiki ong kit er parer en, o pein nima sang, o na kan, o na man akan?

verses.name: John 4:13
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Karos, me nima sang pil wet, pan pur ong men nim pilada.

verses.name: John 4:14
verses.text: A meamen, me nima sang pil, me I ki ong i, pan solar men nim pilada kokolata, pwe pil, me I kin ki ong, pan pot loli kusukusudang maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 4:15
verses.text: Li o ap indai ong i: Maing, kom kotiki ong ia kisan pil o, pwe i en solar men nim pil, o solar kodo o idipa sang met!

verses.name: John 4:16
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Kowei ukedo om paud!

verses.name: John 4:17
verses.text: Li o sapeng indada: Sota ai paud. Iesus kotin masani ong i: Melel om lokaia: Sota ai paud.

verses.name: John 4:18
verses.text: Pwe om paud me limen mas kokodo, a kaidik om paud, me koe paudeki met; iei melel, me koe indada.

verses.name: John 4:19
verses.text: Li o indang i: Maing, i ap asaer, me saukop amen komui.

verses.name: John 4:20
verses.text: Sam at akan kaukaudok pon nana wet, a komail kin inda dene Ierusalem eta wasa me aramas en kaudok ia.

verses.name: John 4:21
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Li, kamelele ia, a korendor ansaun omail pan solar kaukaudok ong Sam pon nana wet, pil sota Ierusalem.

verses.name: John 4:22
verses.text: Komail kin sasa, me komail kin kaukaudok ong. A kit asa, me se kaukaudok ong, pwe kamaur pwarado sang ren men Sus akan.

verses.name: John 4:23
verses.text: A ansau korendor, ari a leler, me toun kaudok melel akan pan kaudok ong Sam ni Ngen o melel, pwe iei ta song en toun kaudok kan, me Sam pil kotin kupura.

verses.name: John 4:24
verses.text: Ngen eu Kot, a me kaudok ong i, ren kaudokki Ngen o melel.

verses.name: John 4:25
verses.text: Li indai ong i: I asa, me Mesias pan kotido, me maraneki Kristus. I lao kotido, a pan katiti ong kit meakaros.

verses.name: John 4:26
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ngai i, me lokelokaia ong uk.

verses.name: John 4:27
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap purodo, puriamui a masan ong li amen. Ari so, sota me indada: Da me re kotin kainoma, de da me re kotin mamasani ong i?

verses.name: John 4:28
verses.text: Li o ap pwilikidi potel en pil o, ap koieilang kanim o kasoi ong aramas akan:

verses.name: John 4:29
verses.text: Kodo, kilang aramas amen, me kasale ong ia karos, me i wiadar, ma i kaidin Kristus?

verses.name: John 4:30
verses.text: Rap koieila sang nan kanim o potodo re a.

verses.name: John 4:31
verses.text: Ni ansau ota sapwilim a tounpadak kan poeki re a, potoan ong: Rapi, re kotin konot!

verses.name: John 4:32
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Kan ai kisin manga mia, me komail sasa.

verses.name: John 4:33
verses.text: Tounpadak kan ap kasokasoi nan pung arail: Muein amen wa dong i sak.

verses.name: John 4:34
