verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Wiawia kupur en me kadar ia do, o kapwaiada sapwilim a dodok, iei kan ai,

verses.name: John 4:35
verses.text: Komail sota kin indada: Saunipong paieu mi mon rak? Kilan, I indai ong komail, sarada, kilang matuel o pwe a malar.

verses.name: John 4:36
verses.text: Me dolung kin pwaipwai o nanak ong maur soutuk, pwe ira karos, me kamorok o me dolung en peren pena.

verses.name: John 4:37
verses.text: Pwe ni mepukat kasoi o pwaidar: Amen me kin kamokamorok, a amen me kin dolung.

verses.name: John 4:38
verses.text: I kadar komail wei, en dolung pena, me komail so doke, Akai me dodoker, a komail me id aneki arail rak.

verses.name: John 4:39
verses.text: Men Samaria toto kisan kanim o posonla i pweki kasoi en li o, me kadede: A kotin kasale ong ia karos, me i wiadar.

verses.name: John 4:40
verses.text: Men Samaria kan lao pokon dong i, rap poeki re a, en kotikot re ’rail. I ari kotikot ia pong ria pong.

verses.name: John 4:41
verses.text: A me toto me posonlar pweki a masan,

verses.name: John 4:42
verses.text: Ap indang li o: Se poson kila kaidin om kasoi, pwe se pein rongadar o weweki, me i melel Saunkamaur pan sappa.

verses.name: John 4:43
verses.text: Murin ran riau Iesus kotila sang wasa o, kotilang Kaliläa.

verses.name: John 4:44
verses.text: Pwe pein Iesus kotin kadedeki, me saukop amen sota kin mau nan udan sap we.

verses.name: John 4:45
verses.text: A lao kotilang Kaliläa, men Kaliläa me kasamo i, pwe re iang kilanger me a kotin wiadar Ierusalem ni kamadip o, pwe re toun iang kamadip.

verses.name: John 4:46
verses.text: Iesus ari kotin pure dong Kana nan Kaliläa, wasa a kotin kapikila pil wain. A monsap amen mia, me na ol somau nan Kapernaum.

verses.name: John 4:47
verses.text: A lao rongadar, me Iesus koti dong Kaliläa sang Iudäa, ap poto dong re a, poeki i en kotidi, kakelada na ol, pwe a koren iong mela.

verses.name: John 4:48
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Ma komail so kilang kilel o manaman akan komail sota pan poson.

verses.name: John 4:49
verses.text: Monsap potoan ong i: Maing kotidi mon nai seri mela!

verses.name: John 4:50
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: U kowei, noum ol memaur. Ari aramas o poson masan o, me Iesus kotin masani ong i ap koieila.

verses.name: John 4:51
verses.text: A ni a kodila, a ladu kan me tu ong i, kasoi ong i, me na putak mauredar.

verses.name: John 4:52
verses.text: I ap kalelapok re ’rail: Ansau da me a pikikidi maur? Irail indang i: Aio ni auer kaisu karakar ko sanger.

verses.name: John 4:53
verses.text: Sam o ap asadar, me i ansau, me Iesus kotin masani ong i: Noum ol memaur. I ari o na kan me posonla i.

verses.name: John 4:54
verses.text: Iet kilel kariau, me Iesus kotin wiadar ni a koti dong Kaliläa sang Iudäa.<div eID="gen2686" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.4"/>

verses.name: John 5:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat ran lapalap eu en Sus oko pwaida; Iesus ap kotilang Ierusalem.

verses.name: John 5:2
verses.text: Len pil eu mi Ierusalem impan im en sip, me ad a Petesda ni lokaia en Ipru; im limau mi impa,

verses.name: John 5:3
verses.text: Me somau toto mi lole: Me maskun, o me dangidang, o me motor mia, auiaui lao pil o pan mokimokid.

verses.name: John 5:4
verses.text: Pwe akai ansau tounlang amen kin koti dong le o kamokideda pil o, a meamen me madang tiong mas nan pil o ni a mokimokid, iei me kin maureda sang a somau kan karos, me mi re a.

verses.name: John 5:5
verses.text: A aramas amen mia, me somauki par sileisokwalu.

verses.name: John 5:6
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani men et a wonon, ap kotin mangi, me a wonon ansau warai, ap kotin masani ong i: Koe so men kelailada?

verses.name: John 5:7
verses.text: Ol somau potoan ong i: Maing, sota nai aramas, me pan wa ia di wong ni pil o ansaun a mokideda. Pwe ni ai kokodi, amen kin madang mo i.

verses.name: John 5:8
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Uda, ale ki om, kokowei!

verses.name: John 5:9
verses.text: Aramas o ap madang kelailadar, kida ki e, alu wei, a ran o ran en sapat.

verses.name: John 5:10
verses.text: Sus oko ap indai ong me kelailadar: Ran wet ran en sapat. A sota pung koe en wewa sili ki om.

verses.name: John 5:11
verses.text: A sapeng irail: Me kakela ia da, masani ong ia: Ale ki om koko wei!

verses.name: John 5:12
verses.text: Irail ap kalelapok re a: Is aramas o me indai ong uk: Ale ki om kokowei?

verses.name: John 5:13
verses.text: A me kelailadar sasa i, pwe Iesus kotila sanger, pwe pokon mi wasa o.

verses.name: John 5:14
verses.text: Kadekadeo Iesus kotin diaradar i nan im en kaudok o ap kotin masani ong i: Kilang, koe kelailadar, koe der pil wia dip, pwe me sued kot sang mas de ko dong uk!

verses.name: John 5:15
verses.text: Aramas o ap koieila, kaireki Sus oko, me Iesus kakeladar i.

verses.name: John 5:16
verses.text: I me Sus oko ap raparapaki Iesus, o masamasan, pwen kamela i, pweki a kotin wiadar meakan ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: John 5:17
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail: Sam ai kin dodok kokodo, a ngai pil iang dodok.

verses.name: John 5:18
verses.text: I me Sus oko ap masamasan melel, en kamatala i, pweki a kotin kawela ran en sapat o pil masani, me dene Kot Sam a, o a kaparoki ong pein i Kot.

verses.name: John 5:19
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Melel melel I indai ong komail, a sota kak, Na en pein wia meakot, pwe i eta, me a kilang ren Sam, me a wiada. Pwe me a kin wiada, iei me Na pil kin wiada.

verses.name: John 5:20
verses.text: Pwe sam pok ong Na o kasansale ong i karos, me pein i kin wiada. O a pan kasale ong i wiawia kan, me lapa sang met akan, pwe komail en puriamui kila.

verses.name: John 5:21
verses.text: Pwe duen Sam kin kapikapirida me melar akan, kamaur ir ada, iduen Na pil kamaureda me a mauki.

verses.name: John 5:22
verses.text: Pwe sota me Sam kin kadeikada, pwe a kotiki ong Na kadeik o.

verses.name: John 5:23
verses.text: Pwe karos en wauneki Na, dueta ar wauneki Sam. Me sota wauneki Na, sota kin wauneki Sam, me kadar i dor.

verses.name: John 5:24
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, meamen rong ai padak o poson, me kadar ia do, a aneki maur soutuk. A a sota pan pangalang kadeik o, pwe a sapale sang mela sapal ong maur.

verses.name: John 5:25
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, ansau kokodo, iei a leler, me melar akan pan rongada ngil en Nain Kot, a me rongadar pan maureda.

verses.name: John 5:26
verses.text: Pwe duen Sam a udan maur, iduen a ki ong Na, en pil udan maur.

verses.name: John 5:27
verses.text: O a kotiki ong i manaman, en kaunda kadeik o, pweki Nain aramas i.

verses.name: John 5:28
verses.text: Der puriamuiki met, pwe ansau kokodo me irail, me mi nan sousou kan, pan rong ngil a.

verses.name: John 5:29
verses.text: Irail ap pan pwarada: Me wiadar me mau, en maureda, pwen memaur, a me wiadar mesued, en maureda, pwen pangalang kadeik o.

verses.name: John 5:30
verses.text: Sota me I kak wiada sang pein ngai, duen me I kin rong, iduen I kin kadeikada, o ai kadeik me pung, pwe I sota kin rapaki insen ai, pwe kupur en i, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 5:31
verses.text: Ma I kadede pein ngai, ai kadede sota melel.

verses.name: John 5:32
verses.text: Amen me kadede ia, a I asa melel, me a kadede ia me melel.

verses.name: John 5:33
verses.text: Komail me ilakilang Ioanes, i ari me kadede melel.

verses.name: John 5:34
verses.text: A I sota kin ale kadede ren aramas, a iet me I indawei, pwe komail en dorola.

verses.name: John 5:35
verses.text: I me ser umpul o marain eu, a komail men perenki a marain ansau kis.

verses.name: John 5:36
verses.text: A ai kadede me lapa sang en Ioanes. Pwe dodok kan, me Sam o kotiki ong ia, I en kapwaiada, iei dodok kan, me I kin wiawia, me kadede ia, me Sam kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 5:37
verses.text: A Sam, me kadar ia dor, pein i kadede ia. Komail sota rongadar ngil a, o sota kilang mom a.

verses.name: John 5:38
verses.text: O a masan sota kin kot re omail, pwe komail sota poson, me a kadarador.

verses.name: John 5:39
verses.text: Komail kin kalelapok nan kisin likau kan, pwe komail lamelame, me maur soutuk mi lole. Ari, iei irail, me kin kadede ia.

verses.name: John 5:40
verses.text: A komail kang ko dong ia, pwe komail en aneki maur.

verses.name: John 5:41
verses.text: I sota kin mauki ale wau ren aramas akan.

verses.name: John 5:42
verses.text: I asa komail, limpok en Kot sota kin mi re omail.

verses.name: John 5:43
verses.text: I kodo ni mar en Sam ai, a komail sota kin kasamo ia. A ma amen pan kokido pein ad a, komail pan kasamo i.

verses.name: John 5:44
verses.text: Pala komail kak poson ni omail ngongongki wau ren aramas, ap sota rapaki wau sang ren Kot.

verses.name: John 5:45
verses.text: Der kiki ong, me I pan mpäkin komail ren Sam, amen me kin mpäkin komail: Moses, me komail kin kaporoporeki.

verses.name: John 5:46
verses.text: Pwe ma komail posonla Moses, komail pan poson ia, pwe i me intingiedier duen ngai.

verses.name: John 5:47
verses.text: A ma komail so kamelele a inting kan, pala komail pan kamelele ai padak kan?<div eID="gen2687" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.5"/>

verses.name: John 6:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat Iesus kotin kotela le en Tiperias nan Kaliläa.

verses.name: John 6:2
verses.text: A pokon kalaimun me idedauen i pweki ar kilanger kilel akan, me a kotin wiai ong me somau kan.

verses.name: John 6:3
verses.text: Iesus ap kotidala pon dol o, kaipokedi wasa o ren sapwilim a tounpadak kan.

verses.name: John 6:4
verses.text: A pasa o, ran lapalap en Sus oko me korendor.

verses.name: John 6:5
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masanda masani pokon kalaimun koko dong i, ap kotin masani ong Pilipus: Ia wasa, sen neti sang ia kisin manga, pwe mepukat en manga?

verses.name: John 6:6
verses.text: A kotin masani mepukat, pwen kasongesong i. Pwe pein i mangi, me a pan wiada.

verses.name: John 6:7
verses.text: Pilipus potoan ong i: Prot me denar riepuki sota pan itar ong irail, pwe amen amen en tungole ekis.

verses.name: John 6:8
verses.text: Andreas, sapwilim a tounpadak amen, ri en Simon Petrus potoan ong i:

verses.name: John 6:9
verses.text: Kisin putak amen mia, me a lopon en prot limau o mam riamen, a sota katepa ren me toto.

verses.name: John 6:10
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: Kamod ong irail edi! Ari, wasa o me reen. Impan ol limekid ap mondi.

verses.name: John 6:11
verses.text: Iesus ap kotikida lopon ko, a lao laolaoki, ap kotin nek ong irail me mondier, pil dueta mam oko, irail lao metilar.

verses.name: John 6:12
verses.text: Irail lao metier, a kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Ki pena me lua, pwe ekis der lokidokila!

verses.name: John 6:13
verses.text: Irail ap ki pena kopou eisokriau kisan lopon ko, me luadi murin arail manga.

verses.name: John 6:14
verses.text: Aramas akan lao kilanger kilel o, me Iesus kotin wiadar, re ap indada: Melel i Saukop o, me pan pwara dong sappa.

verses.name: John 6:15
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin mangi, me re pan poto dong i, pwen kasapwiladang i Nanmarki, ap pil kotidalang nin dol o, kotin kelepala.

verses.name: John 6:16
verses.text: A lao sautik pena, sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap kotilang ni oror,

verses.name: John 6:17
verses.text: Kereda pon sop pot, kotela kokolang Kapernaum. A lao wasa pongier, Iesus saikenta iang irail.

verses.name: John 6:18
verses.text: A sed me iluken, pwe ang me ma.

verses.name: John 6:19
verses.text: Irail seisei kila mail eisoklimau de rieisok, rap kilangada Iesus a kotikotido pon sed koren iong sop, irail ap masapwekadar.

verses.name: John 6:20
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Ngai i komail der masak!

verses.name: John 6:21
verses.text: lrail ap men kasamo i pon sop o, a sop o madang milar ni sap o, me re ko ong ia.

verses.name: John 6:22
verses.text: A mandan ran o pokon o, me mi palilan le, lao kilanger, me sota apot sop mi wasa o, pwe i eta, me sapwilim a tounpadak kan keredang poa, o me Iesus sota iang sapwilim a tounpadak kan kotidang pon sop o, pwe a tounpadak kan kola kelep.

verses.name: John 6:23
verses.text: A pil akai kisin sop me pwarado sang Tiperias, tanga dong wasa o, me re mangamanga ia, murin Kaun o kotin laolao.

verses.name: John 6:24
verses.text: Aramas akan lao kilanger, me Iesus solar kotikot ia, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan pil so, rap dake sop pot kolang Kapernaum, raparapaki Iesus.

verses.name: John 6:25
verses.text: Irail lao diaradar i palilan le, ap potoan ong: Rapi iad me re kotido?

verses.name: John 6:26
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail masani: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, komail kin rapakin ia kaidin pweki kilel akan, me komail kilang, a pweki komail kangala kisin prot ap metier.

verses.name: John 6:27
verses.text: Komail der dokki manga, me kin ola, a dokki manga me kin mimieta ong maur soutuk, me Nain aramas pan ki ong komail, pwe i me Kot Sam kileledier.

verses.name: John 6:28
verses.text: Irail ap potoan ong i: Da me sen wiada, pwen kapwaiada en Kot a dodok kan?

verses.name: John 6:29
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Iet en Kot a dodok: Komail en poson i, me a kadarado.

verses.name: John 6:30
verses.text: Irail ari potoan ong i: Kilel da, me re kotikida, pwe sen kilang o poson ir? Da me re kotin wiada?

verses.name: John 6:31
verses.text: Sam at akan me kangala mana nan sap tan o, duen a intingidier: A kotiki ong irail prot sang nanlang, en kangala.

verses.name: John 6:32
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, kaidin Moses, me ki ong komail prot sang nanlang, a Sam ai kin ki ong komail prot melel sang nanlang.

verses.name: John 6:33
verses.text: Pwe me kodido sang nanlang, o ki ong sappa maur, iei prot en Kot.

verses.name: John 6:34
verses.text: Irail ap indang i: Maing, kotiki dong kit prot wet kaukaule!

verses.name: John 6:35
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Prot en kamaur ngai, me ko dong ia solar pan men mangadar, o me poson ia, solar men nim piladar.

verses.name: John 6:36
verses.text: A I indai ong komail er, komail kilang ia er, ap so poson la.

verses.name: John 6:37
verses.text: Karos me Sam ki ong ia, pan ko dong ia, a me ko dong ia, I sota pan kasela.

verses.name: John 6:38
verses.text: Pwe ngai kodido sang nanlang, kaidin pwen wiada insen ai, pwe kupur en i, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 6:39
verses.text: Pwe iet kupur en me kadar ia do, karos me a ki ong ia er, I ender kasela amen, pwe I en kamaureda ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 6:40
verses.text: A iet kupur en Sam ai, amen amen, me kin kilang Na o poson i, en aneki maur soutuk, a I pan kamaureda i ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 6:41
verses.text: Sus oko ap lipanedeki i, pweki a kotin masani: Ngai prot, me kodi sang nanlang.

verses.name: John 6:42
verses.text: Irail indada: Kaidin i Iesus nain Iosep? A sam a o in a se asa. Ari, daduen a indada: I kodido sang nanlang?

verses.name: John 6:43
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Komail der lipaned nan pung omail!

verses.name: John 6:44
verses.text: Sota me pan kak ko dong ia, ma Sam, me kadar ia dor, sota kainongido i. A I pan kamaureda i ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 6:45
verses.text: A intingidier nan saukop akan: Irail karos pan ale padak sang ren Kot. Amen amen me rongadar o padakki ren Sam, kin ko dong ia.

verses.name: John 6:46
verses.text: Ari, kaidin pweki meamen kilang Sam; i eta, me kodo sang ren Kot, i me kilanger Sam.

verses.name: John 6:47
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, me poson ia, iei me aneki maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 6:48
verses.text: Prot en maur ngai.

verses.name: John 6:49
verses.text: Sam omail oko, me kangala mana nan sap tan o, ir ari melar.

verses.name: John 6:50
verses.text: Met prot, me kodido sang nanlang, meamen kin kang sang i, sota pan mela.

verses.name: John 6:51
verses.text: Ngai prot maur, me kodido sang nanlang, meamen kang sang prot wet, pan memaur kokolata. Prot, me I pan kida, iei uduk ai, me i pan kida en kamaur kida sappa.

verses.name: John 6:52
verses.text: Sus oko ari akamaiki pena indada: Iaduen men et pan kak ki ong kit uduk a sen kang?

verses.name: John 6:53
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, ma komail sota pan kang uduk en Nain aramas o nim nta, sota maur omail.

verses.name: John 6:54
verses.text: Me kin kang uduk ai o nim nt’ ai, iei me aneki maur soutuk, a I pan kamaureda i ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 6:55
verses.text: Pwe manga melel uduk ai, o pil melel nt’ ai.

verses.name: John 6:56
verses.text: Me kin kang uduk ai o nim nt’ ai, iei me podidi ong ia o ngai podidi ong i.

verses.name: John 6:57
verses.text: Duen Sam ieias kadar ia do, o ngai memaureki Sam, iduen me kang uduk o nt’ ai, pan meaureki ngai.

verses.name: John 6:58
verses.text: Iet prot, me kodido sang nanlang, kaidin duen sam omail akan, me kangala mana ap mela, a meamen kin kang prot wet, pan memaur kokolata.

verses.name: John 6:59
verses.text: Mepukat a kotin masani wei nan sinakoke, ni a kotin kawewe nan Kapernaum.

verses.name: John 6:60
verses.text: Ari, me toto ren sapwilim a tounpadak kan, me rongadar mepukat indada: Padak pot et meid apwal! Is me kak rong?

verses.name: John 6:61
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin angi nan kupur a, me sapwilim a tounpadak kan lipanedeki mepukat, ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail makaraki mepukat?

verses.name: John 6:62
verses.text: A ma komail pan kilang Nain aramas kodala wasa, me a kauson ia mas o?

verses.name: John 6:63
verses.text: Ngen me kin kamaureda, a uduk sota katepa. Padak kan, me I kin padapadaki ong komail, iei Ngen o maur.

verses.name: John 6:64
verses.text: A akai mi re omail, me so poson. Pwe Iesus kotin mangi, me so poson o me pan pangala i.

verses.name: John 6:65
verses.text: A kotin masani: I me I indaki ong komail, sota me kak ko dong ia, ma Sam sota kainongido.

verses.name: John 6:66
verses.text: Sang ni ansau o sapwilim a tounpadak kan toto mueiwei sang o solar idauen i.

verses.name: John 6:67
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin kainoma ren ekriamen oko: Komail pil pan kola?

verses.name: John 6:68
verses.text: A Simon Petrus ap sapeng i: Maing, is me se en ko ong? Pwe ar masan akan iei maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 6:69
verses.text: A kit posonlar o asaer, me ir me Saraui en Kot.

verses.name: John 6:70
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail: Kaidek komail ekriamen, me I piladar, a amen komail me tewil amen.

verses.name: John 6:71
verses.text: A kotin masaniada duen Iudas Iskariot nain Simon, pwe i amen ren ekriamen oko, me pan pangala i.<div eID="gen2688" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.6"/>

verses.name: John 7:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat Iesus kotin kakan sili Kaliläa, pwe a solar men kakan sili Iudäa, pweki Sus oko masamasan kamatala i.

verses.name: John 7:2
verses.text: A ran lapalap en Sus oko; iei ran en im en tan tuka korendor.

verses.name: John 7:3
verses.text: Ri a ol akan ap indai ong i: Kom kotiwei kotilang Iudäa, pwe omui tounpadak kan en pil udial omui wiawia kan, me kom kin wiawia.

verses.name: John 7:4
verses.text: Pwe sota me kin wiada meakot wasa rir, ma a men indand sili. Ma komui wia mepukat, en kasansale ong sappa.

verses.name: John 7:5
verses.text: Pwe ri a ol akan pil sota poson i.

verses.name: John 7:6
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Ai ansau saikenta leler, a omail ansau mia ansau karos.

verses.name: John 7:7
verses.text: Sappa sota kak kailongki komail, a ngai me a kin kailongki, aki I kin kadede, me a wiawia kan me sued.

verses.name: John 7:8
verses.text: Komail kodalang kamadip et, I sota pan kodalang kamadip et, pwe ai ansau saikenta leler.

verses.name: John 7:9
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail mepukat, ap kotikotita Kaliläa.

verses.name: John 7:10
verses.text: A ri a ol akan lao samalar, i ap pil kotidalang kamadip, ap so sansal a duen me rir.

verses.name: John 7:11
verses.text: Sus akan ari rapaki i ni kamadip o indada: Ari, ia wasa a kotikot ia?

verses.name: John 7:12
verses.text: A aramas akan lokolokaia toto duen i, pwe akai indada: Me mau men. A akai me indada: Kaidin, pwe a kin kaweid sapung aramas.

verses.name: John 7:13
verses.text: Sota me lokaia sansal duen i, pweki ar masak Sus oko.

verses.name: John 7:14
verses.text: Lao lel ailepan kamadip o, Iesus ap kotin kodalang im en kaudok o kaukaweweda.

verses.name: John 7:15
verses.text: A Sus akan ap puriamui kila indada: Da duen men et asa wewe en kisin likau, pwe a sota iang padakki.

verses.name: John 7:16
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin sapeng irail masani: Kaidin ai padak, me I kin kida a en me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 7:17
verses.text: Meamen wiawia kupur a, pan weweki ai padak, ma a ren Kot, de sang ren pein ngai.

verses.name: John 7:18
verses.text: Me kin padapadak sang ni pein i, kin rapaki pein wau i, a me kin rapaki wau en me kadarala i, iei me melel o sota man sued kot pit.

verses.name: John 7:19
verses.text: Kaidin Moses, me ki ong komail kapung o, a sota amen komail kin kapwaiada kapung o? A da me komail rapakiki kame ia la?

verses.name: John 7:20
verses.text: Aramas oko sapeng indada: Koe me tanwar en tewil, is me rapaki kame uk ala?

verses.name: John 7:21
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Dok taieu, me I wiadar, a komail puriamui kila.

verses.name: John 7:22
verses.text: Moses ki ong komail er sirkomsais, a kaidin tapi sang ren Moses, pwe sang ren sam akan, a komail kin sirkomsais aramas ni ran en sapat.

verses.name: John 7:23
verses.text: Ari ma aramas amen ale sirkomsais ni ran en sapat, pwe kapung en Moses ender sapungala, a komail kin suede kin ia, pweki ai kakelailada aramas pon ni ran en sapat?

verses.name: John 7:24
verses.text: Der kadeikada duen pali liki, a komail kasaui nin tiak en kadeik pung.

verses.name: John 7:25
verses.text: Men Ierusalem kai ap inda: Kaidin i, me re raparapaki en kamela?

verses.name: John 7:26
verses.text: A kilang, a padapadak sansal, a re sota man lokaia ong i, de muein saumas akan asaer mau, me i Kristus?

verses.name: John 7:27
verses.text: Ari, se asaer, wasa men et ko sang ia, a Kristus lao kotido sota me pan asa wasa, me a pwarado sang ia.

verses.name: John 7:28
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin kapitie laudeda kawewe nan im en kaudok masani: Komail asa ia o wasa I ko sang ia. Ari, kaidin pein ngai, me I kokido, a me kadar ia dor, me melel, me komail sasa.

verses.name: John 7:29
verses.text: A I asa i, pwe I kodo sang re a, o i me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 7:30
verses.text: Irail ap song saikidi i, a sota me sair i, pwe a ansau kaikenta leler,

verses.name: John 7:31
verses.text: Aramas toto sang nan pokon o posonla i indada: Iaduen, Kristus lao pwarado, a pan wia kilel toto sang mepukat, me men et wiadar?

verses.name: John 7:32
verses.text: Parisär akan rongadar, me aramas akan lokelokaia mepukat duen i. Samero lapalap o Parisär akan ap kadarala papa kan, en saikidi i.

verses.name: John 7:33
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: I pan mi re omail ansau motomot. I ap pan kola ren me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 7:34
verses.text: Komail pan rapakin ia, ap sota diar, a wasa, me I pan mi ia, komail sota pan kak ong.

verses.name: John 7:35
verses.text: Sus oko ap inda nan pung arail: A pan kola ia, pwe sen solar diar i? A pan kola ren me salongalar ren men Krik kan, kaukawewe ong men Krik?

verses.name: John 7:36
verses.text: Iaduen masan en, me a indada: Komail pan rapakin ia, ap sota diar, a wasa, me I pan mi ia, komail sota pan kak ong?

verses.name: John 7:37
verses.text: Ni ran en kamadip a nikilar, ni ran lapalap o, Iesus kotida, kapitie laudeda masani: Meamen men nim piladar, i en ko dong ia nim.

verses.name: John 7:38
verses.text: Me poson ia, duen kisin likau kan indada, sang nan war a pil memaur pan pwilipwili sang ia.

verses.name: John 7:39
verses.text: Mepukat a kotin masani duen Ngen, me irail, me poson i, en tungole; pwe Ngen saikenta pakadarado, aki Iesus saikenta linganlar.

verses.name: John 7:40
verses.text: Ari, akai sang nan pokon o ni ar rongadar masan pukat ap indada: Melel Saukop o.

verses.name: John 7:41
verses.text: A akai indada: Kristus men et! A akai indada: Da, Kristus pan pwarado sang Kaliläa?

verses.name: John 7:42
verses.text: Kaidin kisin likau me inda, me Kristus pan wan Dawid o kisan men Petleem, kanim o, me Dawid kotikot ia?

verses.name: John 7:43
verses.text: Irail ap liak toror pasang pweki i.

verses.name: John 7:44
verses.text: A akai men saikidi i, a sota me sair i.

verses.name: John 7:45
verses.text: A papa ko ap pure dong ren samero lapalap o Parisär akan. Irail ari idok re irail: Da me komail sota wakido?

verses.name: John 7:46
verses.text: A papa ko sapeng: Sota man aramas amen padapadak duen men et.

verses.name: John 7:47
verses.text: Parisär oko ap sapeng irail: Komail pil pakodauelar?

verses.name: John 7:48
verses.text: Iaduen saumas de Parisär amen posonla i?

verses.name: John 7:49
verses.text: A aramas pukat, me so asa kapung o, re rialar.

verses.name: John 7:50
verses.text: Nikodemus kis arail ap indang irail:

verses.name: John 7:51
verses.text: Iaduen, atail kapung pil kin kadeikada aramas amen mon a rong o asa sang pein i duen a wiawia?

verses.name: John 7:52
verses.text: Irail sapeng indang i: Iaduen, komui pil kisan men Kaliläa? Rapaki o kilang, me sota saukop amen ko sang Kaliläa.

verses.name: John 7:53
verses.text: Amen amen ap purelang deu a.<div eID="gen2689" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.7"/>

verses.name: John 8:1
verses.text: IESUS ap kotidala pon dol Oliwe.

verses.name: John 8:2
verses.text: A nin soran a kotin pure dong ong nan im en kaudok. Aramas karos ap pokon dong i. I ari kaipokedi kaukawewe ong irail.

verses.name: John 8:3
verses.text: A saunkawewe o Parisär akan wa dong i li amen, me diarokadar ni a kamal. Irail kidang i nan pung arail.

verses.name: John 8:4
verses.text: Ap indang i: Saunpadak, li men et diarokadar ni a kamal.

verses.name: John 8:5
verses.text: A Moses masani ong kitail nan kapung o, sen kate song en. A komui, da me komui masani?

verses.name: John 8:6
verses.text: A mepukat re indang i, pwen kasongesong i, pwe ren kak impimpaiki i meakot. A Iesus kotin idiokidi, intingiekidi ong nani pwel sondin lim a.

verses.name: John 8:7
verses.text: A ni ar poden kalekalelapok re a, a ap kotin dengida masani ong irail: Ari, me sota dip a nan pung omail, a pan tapiada kate i.

verses.name: John 8:8
verses.text: A pil kotin idiokidi intingiedi ong nan pwel.

verses.name: John 8:9
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, rap mulikidar tentelwei, me laud mas lel me tikitik o. A Iesus kelepela, li eta, me mi re a.

verses.name: John 8:10
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin dengida o sota masani meamen, li eta, ap masani ong i: Ia me karaun uk edi kan? Sota me kadeik uk ada?

verses.name: John 8:11
verses.text: A potoan ong: Sota Maing. Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: I sota pil pan kadeik uk ada. Kowei, koe der pil wiada dip!

verses.name: John 8:12
verses.text: Iesus ap pil kotin padaki ong irail masani: Ngai marain en sappa. A me kin idauen ia, sota pan weid ni rotorot, pwe marain en maur pan mi re a.

verses.name: John 8:13
verses.text: Parisär oko ap indai ong i: Komui kadede pein komui; ari, omui kadede sota melel.

verses.name: John 8:14
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong irail: Ma I kadede pein ngai, ari melel ai kadede, pwe I asa, wasa I kodo sang ia o wasa I koko ong ia, a komail sasa, wasa I ko sang ia o wasa I koko ong ia.

verses.name: John 8:15
verses.text: Komail kin kadeikada duen pali uduk, a sota meamen, me I kin kadeikada.

verses.name: John 8:16
verses.text: Ari so ma I kadeikada, ai kadeik pan melel, pwe I sota kin kelep, pwe ngai o Sam, me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 8:17
verses.text: A pil intingidier nan omail kapung, me kadede en aramas riamen me melel.

verses.name: John 8:18
verses.text: Ngai me kin kadede pein ngai o Sam, me kadar ia dor, kin kadede ia.

verses.name: John 8:19
verses.text: Irail ap indai ong i: Ia Sam omui? Iesus kotin sapeng: Komail sota asa ngai, pil sota Sam ai. Ma komail asa ia, komail pil pan asa Sam ai.

verses.name: John 8:20
verses.text: Masan pukat Iesus kotikida nan pera en moni, ni a kotin kaukawewedar nan im en kaudok o. A sota me koledi i, pwe a ansau saikenta leler.

verses.name: John 8:21
verses.text: Iesus pil kotin masani ong irail: I kokola, a komail pan rapakin ia o mela ni omail dip akan, a wasa, me I pan kola ia, komail sota pan kak ong.

verses.name: John 8:22
verses.text: Sus oko ap indada: A pan kamela pein i, pweki a inda: A wasa, me I pan kola ia, komail sota pan kak ong?

verses.name: John 8:23
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Komail kisan men pa, a ngai kisan men poa. Komail kisan sappa et, a ngai kaidin kisan sappa et.

verses.name: John 8:24
verses.text: Iei me I indaki ong komail, komail pan mela ni omail dip akan, pwe ma komail sota kamelele ia, komail pan mela ni omail dip akan.

verses.name: John 8:25
verses.text: Irail ap indai ong i: Is koe? Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Me I indawei mas o, i eta.

verses.name: John 8:26
verses.text: Me toto I men padaki ong komail o kadeikada, ari so, me kadar ia do me melel. A I kin kasoia ong komail, me I rongadar re a.

verses.name: John 8:27
verses.text: Irail ari sasa, me a kotin kasoia ong irail duen Sam a.

verses.name: John 8:28
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail lao kauadar Nain aramas, komail ap pan asa, me ngai i, o me I sota wia meakot sang pein ngai. A duen Sam, me padaki ong ia er, iduen I kin kasoia wei.

verses.name: John 8:29
verses.text: Me kadar ia do, kin ieiang ia, a sota lokit ia la, pwe I kin potin wia, me a kupura mauki.

verses.name: John 8:30
verses.text: Ni a kotin masani mepukat, me toto ap posonla i.

verses.name: John 8:31
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong Sus oko, me poson i: Ma komail pan podidi ong ai padak, nan ai tounpadak melel komail.

verses.name: John 8:32
verses.text: O komail pan asala melel, o melel pan kamaio komail da.

verses.name: John 8:33
verses.text: Irail sapeng i: Wan Apraam kit, sota me se lidui sang mas kokodo. A iaduen, komui indada: Komail pan maioda?

verses.name: John 8:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail masani: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, meamen; me wiawia dip, i me ladun dip.

verses.name: John 8:35
verses.text: A ladu o sota pan mimieta nan im o, na eta pan mimieta.

verses.name: John 8:36
verses.text: Ari, ma Na pan kamaio komail da, komail pan maioda melel.

verses.name: John 8:37
verses.text: I asa, me wan Apraam komail, a komail kin rapaki, en kame ia la, pwe ai padak sota kin podidi ong komail.

verses.name: John 8:38
verses.text: Me I kilang ren Sam ai, iei me I inda wei, a komail kin wiawia, me komail rongada ren sam omail.

verses.name: John 8:39
verses.text: Irail sapeng indang i: Sam at Apraam. Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Ma komail nain Apraam, seri kan, komail pan wia duen en Apraam a wiawia kan.

verses.name: John 8:40
verses.text: Ari, met komail kin rapaki kame ia la, aramas amen, me kasoi ong komail melel, me I rongadar ren Kot, i me Apraam sota wiadar.

verses.name: John 8:41
verses.text: Komail kin kapwaiada wiawia kan en sam omail. Irail ap indang i: Kaidik kit ipwin nenek. Sam at me ta men Kot.

verses.name: John 8:42
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Ma Kot Sam omail, komail pan pok ong ia, pwe I kodo sang ren Kot, kaidik sang pein ngai, me I kokido, pwe i me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 8:43
verses.text: Da me komail sota weweki ai padak? Pweki omail sota kak rong ai padak.

verses.name: John 8:44
verses.text: Komail tapi sang ren sam omail tewil, o inong en sam omail, me komail men wiada. Nan i men kamela men sang ni tapi o, o a sota dadaurata melel, pwe sota man melel mi re a, ni a lalal likam, a kin kida sang pein audepa, pwe i me likam men o sam en likam o.

verses.name: John 8:45
verses.text: A komail sota kamelele ia, pweki I padaki ong komail melel.

verses.name: John 8:46
verses.text: Is re omail, me kak indang ia, me dip ai mia? A ma I kasoi melel, menda komail so poson?

verses.name: John 8:47
verses.text: Men ren Kot kin rong en Kot a masan akan. Komail ari sota rong, pwe kaidin me ren Kot komail.

verses.name: John 8:48
verses.text: Sus oko sapeng indang i: Kaidik meid melel, koe men Samaria amen o tanwar en tewil.

verses.name: John 8:49
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: Kaidik tanwar en tewil ngai, pwe I wauneki Sam ai, a komail kin kisang ia wau i.

verses.name: John 8:50
verses.text: I sota kin rapaki pein wau i, amen mia, me kin raparapaki o kadeikada.

verses.name: John 8:51
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, meamen kapwaiada ai padak, sota pan mela kokolata.

verses.name: John 8:52
verses.text: Sus oko ap indai ong i: Se ap asaer, me koe tanwar en tewil. Apraam melar, pil saukop akan, a koe me inda: Meamen kapwaiada ai padak, sota pan mela kokolata,

verses.name: John 8:53
verses.text: Da, komui me lapa sang sam at Apraam, me matalar, pil saukop akan, me matalar? Is me komui pein wia kin uk?

verses.name: John 8:54
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Ma I pein kaka kin ia, ai kaka me mal. A Sam ai, me kaka kin ia, me komail kin inda: I atail Kot.

verses.name: John 8:55
verses.text: Komail ari kaikenta asa i, a I asa i, a ma I inda, me I sasa i, I pan me likam amen dueta komail. A I asa i o kapwaiada a masan akan.

verses.name: John 8:56
verses.text: Sam omail Apraam peren kida, me a pan kilang ai ran. I ari kilanger ap peren kidar,

verses.name: John 8:57
verses.text: Sus oko ap indang i: Par limeisok kaik dau po ’mui, a kom kilanger Apraam?

verses.name: John 8:58
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, I mier mon Apraam.

verses.name: John 8:59
verses.text: Irail ap rik takai, pwen kasuk i, i ap kotin oki sang irail pein i, kotila sang nan im en kaudok o.<div eID="gen2690" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.8"/>

verses.name: John 9:1
verses.text: IESUS lao kotin daulul, ap masani aramas amen me maskun sang a ipwidi.

verses.name: John 9:2
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap idok re a potoan ong: Rapi, is me wiadar dip, i de sam a in a, pweki a ipwidi maskun?

verses.name: John 9:3
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Kaidik i me wiadar dip, pil kaidik in a de sam a, a pwe en Kot a wiawia kan en kasansal kida i.

verses.name: John 9:4
verses.text: I en kapwaiada wiawia kan en me kadar ia do arain ansaun ran, pwe pong pan kodo, i ansau solar amen kak dodok.

verses.name: John 9:5
verses.text: Arain ai mi sappa, ngai marain en sappa.

verses.name: John 9:6
verses.text: A lao kotin masanier met, ap likidi nani pwel, wiakida pwel madak iriski mas a.

verses.name: John 9:7
verses.text: Masani ong i: Kolang pil en Siloa (iet wewe: Pakadarado), opinok ia! I ari kola opinok, ap puredo kilangada wasa.

verses.name: John 9:8
verses.text: A men imp a kan, o me iang kilangadar, me a men poekipoek amen mas o, rap indada: Kaidik i, me wonon poekipoeki?

verses.name: John 9:9
verses.text: Akai me inda: I met; a akai me inda: Likamata i, a pein i indada: Ngai i.

verses.name: John 9:10
verses.text: Irail ari indang i: Iaduen por en mas om akan a kapad pasang?

verses.name: John 9:11
verses.text: A sapeng indada: Aramas amen me adaneki Iesus, me wiadar pwel madak, iriski mas ai, masani ong ia: Kolang pil en Siloa, opinok ia! I ari kola opinok, ap kilangada wasa.

verses.name: John 9:12
verses.text: Irail ap idok re a: Ia i? A sapeng: I sasa.

verses.name: John 9:13
verses.text: Irail ap kalualang ren Parisär akan me maskun mas.

verses.name: John 9:14
verses.text: Ari, ni ran en sapat, me Iesus kotin wiadar pwel, kapad pasang por en mas a kan.

verses.name: John 9:15
verses.text: Parisär akan pil idok duen me a kilang kida wasa. A sapeng irail: A ki ong pwel ni por en mas ai, i ap opinok, ngai ari kilangada wasa.

verses.name: John 9:16
verses.text: Parisär kai ap inda: Aramas men et kaidik men ren Kot, aki a sota apwali ran en sapat. Akai indada: Daduen, aramas dipan amen kak wia kilel pukat? Irail ari liak toror pasang.

verses.name: John 9:17
verses.text: Irail pil kalelapok ren me maskun o: Da me koe lamelame duen i? Pwe a kapad pasang mas om? A sapeng: Saukop amen i.

verses.name: John 9:18
verses.text: Men Sus oko ap sota kamelele, me a ipwiki wei maskun, ap kilangada wasa. Irail lao ekeredo sam o in en me kilangada wasa.

verses.name: John 9:19
verses.text: Irail idok re ’ra: Nouma ol men et, me komail indinda, me a ipwiki wei maskun? Iaduen a ngarada wasa ansau wet?

verses.name: John 9:20
verses.text: Sam a in a sapeng ir indada: Se asa, me nait ol et, me ipwiki wei maskun.

verses.name: John 9:21
verses.text: A se sasa duen a ngarada wasa o me kapad pasang por en mas a. A malar, kainoma re a, a pan pein sakaraki i.

verses.name: John 9:22
verses.text: Sam o in a inda mepukat, pweki ar masak Sus oko. Pwe Sus oko inauki pena, ma meamen pan kadede me i Kristus a pan lokidokila sang nan sinakoke.

verses.name: John 9:23
verses.text: I me sam o in a indada kida: A malar, kainoma re a.

verses.name: John 9:24
verses.text: Irail ap eker aramas maskun kariapak indai ong i: Wauneki Kot, se asa, me aramas men et me dipan amen,

verses.name: John 9:25
verses.text: A sapeng ir indada: I sasa, ma i me dipan amen de so. I eta me i asa, me ngai me maskun mas o, i ap potoan ngaradar wasa.

verses.name: John 9:26
verses.text: Irail ap pil idok re a: Da me a wiai ong uk? Iaduen a kapad pasang mas om?

verses.name: John 9:27
verses.text: A sapeng irail: I indai ong komail er, a komail sota rong? Da me komail pil men rongki? Komail pil pan a tounpadak ala?

verses.name: John 9:28
verses.text: Irail kaurureki indada: A tounpadak amen koe, a kit tounpadak en Moses akan.

verses.name: John 9:29
verses.text: Kit asa, me Kot masani ong Moses. A lap o se sasa, wasa a ko sang ia.

verses.name: John 9:30
verses.text: Aramas o sapeng indang irail: Meid kapuriamui! I me kapad pasang mas ai kat, a komail sasa, wasa a koti sang ia.

verses.name: John 9:31
verses.text: Kitail asa, me Kot sota kin mangi me dipan akan. A meamen, me lan Kot, o dadaurata kupur a, iei me a kin kotin mangi.

verses.name: John 9:32
verses.text: Sang mas kokodo sota me rongadar, me meamen kapad pasang mas en me ipwiki wei maskun.

verses.name: John 9:33
verses.text: Ma men et sota me ren Kot, a sota pan kak wia meakot.

verses.name: John 9:34
verses.text: Irail sapeng indang i: Koe me ipwiki wei dip akan a koe ap padaki ong kit? Irail ari kasela i.

verses.name: John 9:35
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin mangidar, me re kasela i, a lao masani i, ap kotin masani ong i: Koe kin poson Nain Kot?

verses.name: John 9:36
verses.text: A sapeng potoan ong: Maing, is i pwe i en poson i?

verses.name: John 9:37
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Koe me kilang i. A iet i, me kasokasoi ong uk.

verses.name: John 9:38
verses.text: A sapeng i: Maing, i posonlar, i ari kaudok ong i.

verses.name: John 9:39
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: I kodon kadeik nan sappa et, pwe me so kilang wasa, en kilangada, a me kilang wasa, en maskunla.

verses.name: John 9:40
verses.text: A Parisär akan, me mi re a, rongadar a masan pukat, re ap peidok re a: Da, kit me pil maskun?

verses.name: John 9:41
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Ma komail maskun, sota pan dip omail. A komail indada: Se kilekilang wasa, iei me omail dip pan mimietaki.<div eID="gen2691" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.9"/>

verses.name: John 10:1
verses.text: MELEL, melel I indai ong komail, me so weid nan wanim, pedelong ong nan deun sip, a dauda wasa toror, iei men lipirap o men kuli.

verses.name: John 10:2
verses.text: A me kin pedelong pan wanim, iei silepan sip o.

verses.name: John 10:3
verses.text: Iei me silepan wanim o kin ritingada mo a; a sip akan kin rong ngil a; i me ekereki na sip akan ad arail, kare irail wei.

verses.name: John 10:4
verses.text: A kin kapedoi na sip akan, ap tiong mo ’rail, o sip akan kin idedauen i, pwe re anlar ngil a.

verses.name: John 10:5
verses.text: A re sota pan idauen, me re san, pwe re pan tang sang, pwe re san ngil arail.

verses.name: John 10:6
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail karaseras pot et, a irail sota weweki mepukat, me a kotin masani ong irail.

verses.name: John 10:7
verses.text: Iesus pil kotin masani ong irail: Melel, melel I indai ong komail: Ngai wanim en sip akan.

verses.name: John 10:8
verses.text: Karos, me pwarador mo i, iei lipirap o men kuli, o sip akan sota kin rong irail.

verses.name: John 10:9
verses.text: Ngai wanim o, a meamen pedelong re i, pan kamaurela o diar manga purepure.

verses.name: John 10:10
verses.text: Lipirap kin kodon pirapela, o kamela, o kaokaoe, a ngai kodo, pwe irail en ale maur, kakairida kokolata.

verses.name: John 10:11
verses.text: Ngai silepa mau; a silepa mau kin tonmeteki ong na sip akan maur i.

verses.name: John 10:12
verses.text: A me kin pwaipwai o me sota udan silepa, o me kaidin udan na sip oko, iei me ngingar kidi en wel kokodo, ap kasela sip oko, tangdaui, a kidi en wel saikidi sip oko, kamueit ir pasang.

verses.name: John 10:13
verses.text: Me pwaipwai o kin tangdaui, aki a pwaipwai, o sota insenoki sip oko.

verses.name: John 10:14
verses.text: Ngai silepa mau, o I asa nai kan, o nai kan pil asa ia.

verses.name: John 10:15
verses.text: Duen Sam o asa ia, iduen I asa Sam, o I tonmeteki ong sip akan maur i.

verses.name: John 10:16
verses.text: A pil akai nai sip, me so kisan nan kel wet, mepuko I pil pan wado, o re pan rong ngil ai, o a pan pwin taieu o silepa me ta men,

verses.name: John 10:17
verses.text: Iei me Sam pok ong ia, pwe I kidi maur i, pwe I en pur ong ale.

verses.name: John 10:18
verses.text: Sota me ki sang ia, pwe pein ngai kidi. I manaman ong kidi maur i, I pil manaman ong kapure dong ia. Kusoned pot et I aleer sang ren Sam ai.

verses.name: John 10:19
verses.text: Iei me Sus oko ap pil liak toror pasang pweki masan pukat.

verses.name: John 10:20
verses.text: Me toto re ’rail indada: A tanwar en tewil o iakalar. Menda komail rong i?

verses.name: John 10:21
verses.text: Akai me indada: Kaidik padak en tanwar en tewil pukat, da, tewil pan kak kapad pasang mas en me maskun amen?

verses.name: John 10:22
verses.text: A ran en isimas en im en kaudok wiaui nan Ierusalem, i ansaun kapau.

verses.name: John 10:23
verses.text: A Iesus kotikot sili nan im en kaudok, nan palang en Salomo.

verses.name: John 10:24
verses.text: Sus oko kapili pena i indang i: Arai da komui pan okioki sang kit? Ma komui Kristus, en kadede ong kit sansal!

verses.name: John 10:25
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: I indai ong komail er, a komail sota poson dodok kan, me I wiadar ni mar en Sam ai, iei me kin kadede ia.

verses.name: John 10:26
verses.text: A komail sota poson, pwe komail kaidik kisan nai sip, duen me I indai ong komail er.

verses.name: John 10:27
verses.text: Nai sip oko kin rong ngil ai, a I asa irail a re kin idauen ia.

verses.name: John 10:28
verses.text: A I ki ong irail maur soutuk, a re sota pan salongala kokolata, o sota, me pan ki sang irail nan pa i.

verses.name: John 10:29
verses.text: Sam ai, me ki ong ia irail, me lapa sang meakaros, o sota me pan kak ki sang irail ni lim en Sam ai.

verses.name: John 10:30
verses.text: Ngai o Sam me ta men.

verses.name: John 10:31
verses.text: Sus oko ap pil rik takai, pwen kasuk i.

verses.name: John 10:32
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail: Dodok mau toto, me I kasale ong komail er sang ren Sam o, a menia dodok ren mepukat, me komail kate kin ia?

verses.name: John 10:33
verses.text: Sus oko ap sapeng i: Kaidik dodok mau eu, me se kate kin komui, a pweki lalaue, o pweki aramas amen koe, me wia kin pein uk Kot,

verses.name: John 10:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail: A so intingidier nan omail kapung: I indada, komail kot akan,

verses.name: John 10:35
verses.text: Ari, ma a kin wia kin ir kot, me aleer masan en Kot, pwe kisin likau kan sota kak sapungala;

verses.name: John 10:36
verses.text: A komail kin inda kin i, me Sam a kasarauialar, o kadara dong sappa, koe lalaue, pweki ai indada: Sapwilim en Kot ngai?

verses.name: John 10:37
verses.text: Ma I so wiawia dodok kan en Sam ai, komail der kamelele ia.

verses.name: John 10:38
verses.text: A ma I kin wiawia, komail en posonki dodok kan, ma komail sota poson ia, pwe komail en asa o poson, me Sam ai podidi ong ia, o ngai podidi ong i.

verses.name: John 10:39
verses.text: Irail ap pil song saikidi i. I ari piti sang ni pa ’rail.

verses.name: John 10:40
verses.text: O kotin purelang palilan Iordan, wasa Ioanes kin wia paptais ia mas; I ari kotikot wasa o.

verses.name: John 10:41
verses.text: A me toto pokon dong i indada: Ioanes sota wiadar kilel eu; a melel eta karos, me Ioanes masanieki men et.

verses.name: John 10:42
verses.text: A me toto posonla i wasa o.<div eID="gen2692" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.10"/>

verses.name: John 11:1
verses.text: OL amen somaudar ad a Lasarus, men Petanien, kanim en Maria o ri a li Marta.

verses.name: John 11:2
verses.text: Iei Maria, me keieki potik Kaun o, o limwieki a pwilipeipei aluwilu a, me ri a ol Lasarus somaudar.

verses.name: John 11:3
verses.text: Ri a li ko ari kadar wong i kaireki wong i: Maing, kotin mangi, me re pok ong me somaudar.

verses.name: John 11:4
verses.text: Iesus lao mangi, ap kotin masani: Kaidik somau en mela eu met, a pweki lingan en Kot, pwe Nain Kot en kalingana kila.

verses.name: John 11:5
verses.text: Iesus kotin kupura Marta, o ri a li, o Lasarus.

verses.name: John 11:6
verses.text: A lao kotin mangier, me a somaudar, i ari kotikoteta wasa o pong ria pong.

verses.name: John 11:7
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan: Kitail pan purelang Iudäa.

verses.name: John 11:8
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan potoan ong i: Rapi, Sus oko apton men kasuk ir, a re pan kotin purelang ia?

verses.name: John 11:9
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: So auer eisokriau ni ran eu? Meamen alialu ni ran, sota pan dipikelekel, aki a ngingar marain en sappa.

verses.name: John 11:10
verses.text: A meamen alialu ni pong, a pan dipikelekel, aki marain sota mi re a.

verses.name: John 11:11
verses.text: A kotin kasoiada mepukat, ap masani ong irail: Kompoke patail Lasarus mairelar, a I kokolan kapirida i.

verses.name: John 11:12
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan indang i: Maing, ma a mairelar, a pan maureda.

verses.name: John 11:13
verses.text: Ari, Iesus kotin masanieda duen a melar, a irail kiki ong, me a masanieda duen a mair en kamol.

verses.name: John 11:14
verses.text: Iesus ap sansal masani ong irail: Lasarus melar,

verses.name: John 11:15
verses.text: A I peren kida, me I sota mi wasa o pweki komail, pwe komail en posonla. Ari, kitail en koko wei re a!

verses.name: John 11:16
verses.text: Tomas, me pil ad a Didimus, ap indai ong warok tei kan: Kitail en pil kokola, pwen iang i mela.

verses.name: John 11:17
verses.text: Iesus lao kotido, ap kotin diarada, me a mi nan sousou pong pa pong.

verses.name: John 11:18
verses.text: Petanien me koren iong Ierusalem impan mail riau.

verses.name: John 11:19
verses.text: A Sus oko me toto ko dong Marta o Maria, pwen kamait ira la pweki ri ara ol o.

verses.name: John 11:20
verses.text: Marta lao rongadar, me Iesus kotido, ap koieila tu ong i. A Maria momod nan im o.

verses.name: John 11:21
verses.text: Marta ap potoan ong Iesus: Maing, ma re kotikot met, ri ai ol sota pan mela.

verses.name: John 11:22
verses.text: Ari so, i asa meakot re pan kotin poeki ren Kot, Kot pan kotiki ong ir.

verses.name: John 11:23
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ri om ol pan maureda.

verses.name: John 11:24
verses.text: Marta potoan ong i: I asa, me a pan maureda ni ias en ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 11:25
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ngai kamaur o maur, me poson ia, pan memaureta pil murin a mela.

verses.name: John 11:26
verses.text: A meamen me maur o poson ia, sota pan mela kokolata; koe kamelele mepukat?

verses.name: John 11:27
verses.text: A potoan ong i: Ei Maing, i poson, me ir me Kristus Sapwilim en Kot, me udan pwara dong sappa.

verses.name: John 11:28
verses.text: A lao indada met, ap koieila ren Maria ri a li, monginki ong i: Saunpadak kotidor kainoma uk.

verses.name: John 11:29
verses.text: A lao rongadar, ap uda, madang wei re a,

verses.name: John 11:30
verses.text: A Iesus saikenta lel ong kanim o, pwe a kotikoteta wasa Marta tu ong i ia.

verses.name: John 11:31
verses.text: Sus oko, me mi re a nan im o, pwen kamait i ala, lao kilangada, me Maria madang uda tang wei, rap idauenla i, indinda: A pan ko ong ni sousou, pwen sangesang ia.

verses.name: John 11:32
verses.text: Maria lao lel wasa o, o kilang i, ap poridi ong ni aluwilu a indang i: Maing, ma re kotikot met, ri ai ol sota pan mela.

verses.name: John 11:33
verses.text: Iesus lao masani i sangesang, o Sus oko, me iang i kokodo pil sangesang, ap kupurola,

verses.name: John 11:34
verses.text: Masani: Komail pwilikidi ia i? Irail potoan ong i: Maing, kotido masani.

verses.name: John 11:35
verses.text: Iesus kotin tontonir.

verses.name: John 11:36
verses.text: Sus oko ap inda: Kilang duen a pok ong i!

verses.name: John 11:37
verses.text: A akai ir me indada: A so kak pan men et me kapad pasang mas en me maskun o, me ol men et ender mela?

verses.name: John 11:38
verses.text: Iesus pil kupurola koti dong sousou o. A por o ulong nan kisin dol o takai eu mi poa.

verses.name: John 11:39
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: Katapure wei takai en! A Marta, en me melar ri a li, indada: Maing, a matalar, pwe a mi met pong pa pong.

verses.name: John 11:40
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: I so indai ong uk, ma koe poson, koe pan kilangada lingan en Kot.

verses.name: John 11:41
verses.text: Irail ap katapure sang takai o. A Iesus kotin masanda masani: Sam, I danke komui, me komui mangi ia er.

verses.name: John 11:42
verses.text: A i asa, me komui kin mangi ia ansau karos, a pweki pokon o, me u sili, I indaki mepukat, pwe irail en poson, me komui, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 11:43
verses.text: A lao kotin masani met, ap kapitie laudeta masani: Lasarus, koieido!

verses.name: John 11:44
verses.text: A me melar o ap pedoido, likau en sousou kidim pena na o pa kan, o mas a me pirapinki pena lim en puto. A Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Lapwada kapitila i!

verses.name: John 11:45
verses.text: Men Sus toto, me ko dong Maria, o kilanger, me Iesus kotin wiadar, posonla i.

verses.name: John 11:46
verses.text: A akai ir kowei ren Parisär oko, kaire kin irail me Iesus kotin wiadar.

verses.name: John 11:47
verses.text: Samero lapalap o Parisär akan ap pokon pena kapung indada: Da me kitail en wiada? Pwe aramas men et kin wia kilel toto.

verses.name: John 11:48
verses.text: Ma kitail sota pan mokidi ong i, karos pan posonla i, o men Rom pan kodo, ki sang kitail wei o atail kainok.

verses.name: John 11:49
verses.text: A amen irail ad a Kaipas, me samoro lapalap ni par o, indang irail: Komail meid so lolekong.

verses.name: John 11:50
verses.text: O sota lamelame, me a mau ong komail, aramas ta men en kam kila aramas akan, pwe kainok pokon ender lokidokila.

verses.name: John 11:51
verses.text: A kaidik sang pein i, me a katitiki met, a i me samero lapalap ni par o, i ari kopada, me Iesus pan kamataki kainok o.

verses.name: John 11:52
verses.text: A kaidik kainok eta, pwe a pil pan kapokon pena seri en Kot akan, me muei pasang nin sap akan.

verses.name: John 11:53
verses.text: Sang ni ran o irail raparapaki en kamatala i.

verses.name: John 11:54
verses.text: Iesus ap solar kotikot sili sansal ren Sus oko, pwe a kotilang eu sap impan sap tan ni kanim eu ad a Epren, o kotikot ia iang sapwilim a tounpadak kan.

verses.name: John 11:55
verses.text: A pasa en Sus oko me korendor, o me toto koeie sang nan sap karos, kodalang Ierusalem mon pasa, pwen kamaui pein irail.

verses.name: John 11:56
verses.text: Irail ari raparapaki Iesus idedok nan pung arail, ni ar pokopokon nan im en kaudok: Da me komail lamelame, a sota pan ko dong kamadip o?

verses.name: John 11:57
verses.text: A samero lapalap o Parisär akan wiadar kusoned eu, meamen me asa wasa a kot ia, i en kasaleda, pwe ren saikidi i.<div eID="gen2693" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.11"/>

verses.name: John 12:1
verses.text: PONG wonu pong mon pasa Iesus kotilang Petanien, wasa Lasarus me melar, kauson ia, me Iesus kotin kamauredar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: John 12:2
verses.text: Irail ari kaonopada konot, pwe a en kotin kasipong re ’rail; Marta papa, a Lasarus amen irail me iang I kotikot ni tepel.

verses.name: John 12:3
verses.text: Maria ap wado paun en men kei eu, udan pil en narde, me kasampwalia, keiedi ong ni aluwilu en Iesus o limwieki a pwilipeipei aluwilu a; a im o me dir kila po en men kei.

verses.name: John 12:4
verses.text: Iudas Iskariot, amen ren sapwilim a tounpadak kan, nain Simon, me pan pangala i, ap indada:

verses.name: John 12:5
verses.text: Da men kei wet sota netilar, kareda denar silepuki, ap nek ong samama kan?

verses.name: John 12:6
verses.text: Kaidik a pok ong me samama kan, me a idokki met, a pweki lipirap amen i, o saunkanikid en moni, wewa moni, me aramas kidar.

verses.name: John 12:7
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani: Der mokidi ong i! Pwe a kaonopadang ran en ai pan saredi.

verses.name: John 12:8
verses.text: Pwe me samma kan kin potopot re omail, a ngai sota sota kin potopot re omail.

verses.name: John 12:9
verses.text: Sus oko me toto ari asaer, me a kot wasa o, irail ari kodo pweki Iesus o pil, pwen kilang Lasarus, me a kotin kamauredar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: John 12:10
verses.text: Samero lapalap akan pil raparapaki, en pil kamela Lasarus.

verses.name: John 12:11
verses.text: Pwe Sus oko toto kola o poson Iesus pweki i.

verses.name: John 12:12
verses.text: Mandan ran o aramas toto, me toun iang kamadip o, lao rong, me Iesus pan kotilang Ierusalem,

verses.name: John 12:13
verses.text: Ap paledi ran tuka kan o koieila tu ong i, ngisingisida: Osiana! Meid iasanai me kotido ni mar en Kaun o Nanmarki en Israel!

verses.name: John 12:14
verses.text: A Iesus lao kotin masani esel pul amen, ap kaipokedi poa, duen a intingidier:

verses.name: John 12:15
verses.text: Der masak nain Sion seripein! Kilang om Nanmarki kotido, kaipokedi pon nain esel amen.

verses.name: John 12:16
verses.text: A sapwilim a tounpadak kan sota madang weweki mepukat. A Iesus lao linganlar, irail ap tamanda mepukat, me indingidier duen i, o me ir wiai ong i mepukat.

verses.name: John 12:17
verses.text: A pokon o, me iang i ni a kotin molipei Lasarus sang nan sousou o, ni a kotin kamauredar i sang ren me melar akan, kadede i!

verses.name: John 12:18
verses.text: Iei me aramas kokiieilang i, pwe irail rongadar, me a kotin wiadar kilel wet.

verses.name: John 12:19
verses.text: Parisär oko ap indada nan pung ar: Komail kilang, me komail sota kak wia meakot. Kilang, toun sap akan idauenla i.

verses.name: John 12:20
verses.text: Akai men Krik iang irail, me koda dong kamadip o, pwen kaudok.

verses.name: John 12:21
verses.text: Mepukat ko dong Pilipus, men Petsaida en Kaliläa, poeki re a indada: Maing, se men udial Iesus.

verses.name: John 12:22
verses.text: Pilipus ap kodo kaireki Andreas, a Andreas o Pilipus kaireki Iesus.

verses.name: John 12:23
verses.text: A Iesus kotin sapeng irail masani: Ansau leler, me Nain aramas pan kalinganla.

verses.name: John 12:24
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, ma wan korn so moredi ong nan pwel o mela, a pan kelepata, a ma a pan mela, a pan kaparapar wa toto.

verses.name: John 12:25
verses.text: Me pokepoke maur i, pan salongala; a me tounmeteki maur i pali pa, pan diarada maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 12:26
verses.text: Meamen papa ia, i en idauen ia! A wasa I mi ia, i wasa me papa ia, pan pil mi ia. Ma meamen papa ia, i me Sam o pan kasapwilada.

verses.name: John 12:27
verses.text: I ap lol olar, a da me I en inda? Sam kamaio wei sang ia ansau wet, ari so, i me I koki dong ansau wet.

verses.name: John 12:28
verses.text: Sam, kalinganada mar omui! Ngil eu ap peidido sang nanlang indada: I kalinganadaer, o I pan pil kalinganada.

verses.name: John 12:29
verses.text: A aramas akan me u sili me rongadar, indada: A nansapwe. A akai indada: Tounlang amen me kasoia ong i.

verses.name: John 12:30
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani: Kaidik pweki ngai, me ngil wet wiauikier a pweki komail.

verses.name: John 12:31
verses.text: Met ansau en kadeik en sappa wet. Met kaun en sappa et pan lokidokila.

verses.name: John 12:32
verses.text: A ngai lao langada sang sappa, I pan kainonga dong ia karos.

verses.name: John 12:33
verses.text: I me a kotin kokop kidar duen a pan kamatala.

verses.name: John 12:34
verses.text: Aramas akan sapeng i: Se rongadar sang nan kapung o, me Kristus pan potopoteta, a iaduen, kom kasoiada, me Nain aramas en kakauda. Is Nain aramas men et?

verses.name: John 12:35
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Marain mi re omail ansau kis. Weweid, ni ansau marain mi re omail, pwe rotorot ender kono komail edi. Pwe me kin weweid nan rotorot, kin sasa wasa, me a ko ong ia.

verses.name: John 12:36
verses.text: Poson marain, ni a mimi re omail, pwe komail en seri en marainla. Iesus kotin masani mepukat, ap kotila karukila pein i sang irail.

verses.name: John 12:37
verses.text: A i me kotin wiadar kilel toto mo ’rail, ari so, irail sota poson i,

verses.name: John 12:38
verses.text: Pwe kokop en saukop Iesaia en pwaida, me a masani: Kaun o, is me poson at kasoi? O is me lim en Kaun kasansal ong?

verses.name: John 12:39
verses.text: Irail ari sota kak poson, pwe Iesaia pil katitiki:

verses.name: John 12:40
verses.text: A kotin karotongala mas arail o kakekaluakala mongiong arail, pwe ren so kilangki mas arail, o asaki mongiong arail, o wukila, o I en kakel ir ada.

verses.name: John 12:41
verses.text: Mepukat Iesaia masanier, ni a kilanger a lingan o katitiki i.

verses.name: John 12:42
verses.text: Ari ren saumas lapalap me toto, me poson i, a pweki Parisär akan re sota ponasa i, pwe ren der lokidokila sang nan sinakoke.

verses.name: John 12:43
verses.text: Pwe re mauki konekon ren aramas akan mon konekon ren Kot.

verses.name: John 12:44
verses.text: Iesus kotin kapitie laudeda masani: Me poson ia, kaidin ngai, me a kin poson, a me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 12:45
verses.text: A me kilang ia, a pil kilang, me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 12:46
verses.text: I kodon kamaraini sappa, pwe amen amen me poson ia, ender mimieta nan rotorot.

verses.name: John 12:47
verses.text: A ma meamen rong ai padak kan, ap sota apapwali, I sota kin kadeikada i, pwe I sota kodon kadeikada sappa, a pwen kamaurida sappa.

verses.name: John 12:48
verses.text: Me kase ia la o so oke ai padak kan, nan kadeikapa mia: Ai padak, me I kida, i me pan kadeikada i ni ran nik o.

verses.name: John 12:49
verses.text: Pwe I sota padaki wei sang pein ngai. A Sam, me kadar ia dor, i me ki ong ia er kusoned eu, me I en inda o padakieki.

verses.name: John 12:50
verses.text: O I asa, maur soutuk a kusoned o. Ari, karos me I padaki wei, I kin padaki duen Sam masani ong ia.<div eID="gen2694" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.12"/>

verses.name: John 13:1
verses.text: MON kamadip en pasa Iesus lao kotin mangier, me ansaun a pan kotila sang sappa, kotila ren Sam a korendor, duen a kotin kupuramauki sapwilim a kan, me mi sappa, iduen a kotin kupura irail lel imwi,

verses.name: John 13:2
verses.text: Ni ar kotin kasipong ansau me tewil ki ong er nan mongiong en Iudas Iskariot nain Simon, en pangala i.

verses.name: John 13:3
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin mangier, me Sam kotiki onger ni lim a kan meakaros, o me a kotido sang ren Kot, o me a pan kotila ren Kot,

verses.name: John 13:4
verses.text: Ap kotida sang ni kasipong, kotikidi sapwilim a likau en liki ap ale dauel eu pirakidi pein i,

verses.name: John 13:5
verses.text: A wutoki pil nan dal, ap pikikidi widen nä en sapwilim a tounpadak kan, o limwieki dauel, me a piraki pena.

verses.name: John 13:6
verses.text: A lao kotin lel Simon Petrus, a ap potoan ong i: Maing, re pan kotin widen nä i kat?

verses.name: John 13:7
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Koe kin sasa, me I wia metet, a mur koe pan asala.

verses.name: John 13:8
verses.text: Petrus potoan ong i: Re sota pan kotin widen nä i kat kokolata. Iesus kotin sapeng i: Ma I sota widen uk, nan sota pwais om re i.

verses.name: John 13:9
verses.text: Simon Petrus ap potoan ong i: Maing, kaidin nä eta, a pil pa o mong ai!

verses.name: John 13:10
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Me duduer, solar mau ong omiom o opinok, pwe a makelekeler, a nä eta, me pan wideut; komail me makelekel, a kaidin karos.

verses.name: John 13:11
verses.text: Pwe a kotin mangi, me pan pangala i; i me a kotin masanieki: Kaidin komail karos me makelelkel.

verses.name: John 13:12
verses.text: A lao kotin widener nä ar akan, a kotin pur ong sapwilim a likau en liki. A pil kaipokedi ni tepel masani ong irail: Komail asaer me I wiai ong komail er?

verses.name: John 13:13
verses.text: Komail kin adane kin ia Saunpadak o Kaun, ari me pung, pwe iei ngai.

verses.name: John 13:14
verses.text: Ari, ma ngai, Kaun o Saunpadak widen nä omail, komail ari pil widen nä omail pena.

verses.name: John 13:15
verses.text: Pwe I ki ong komail er sansal mau eu, pwe komail en kaalemongi ia, o wia, duen I wiai ong komail.

verses.name: John 13:16
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, ladu me sota laude sang a saumas, de me pakadarado me sota laude sang me kadarado i.

verses.name: John 13:17
verses.text: Ma komail asa mepukat, komail meid pai, ma komail wiada.

verses.name: John 13:18
verses.text: Kaidin komail karos, me I indinda. I asa, me I piladar. A pwe kisin likau en pwaida: Me iang ia kangkang prot, kin tiaki ia di.

verses.name: John 13:19
verses.text: Ansau wet I indai ong komail mepukat mon a pan wiaui, pwe a lao wiaui, komail en poson, me ngai i.

verses.name: John 13:20
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, meamen me kasamo, me I kadar wei, kin kasamo ia, a me kin kasamo ia, kin kasamo, me kadar ia do.

verses.name: John 13:21
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani wei mepukat, ap kupurola kadede masani: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, amen komail pan pang ia la.

verses.name: John 13:22
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan ap soupei pena o sasa, is i, me a kotin masanieki.

verses.name: John 13:23
verses.text: A amen sapwilim a tounpadak kan, me Iesus kotin kupura mauki, momod ni tepel impan Iesus.

verses.name: John 13:24
verses.text: Simon Petrus ap olol ong i, en idok, is i me a kotin masani.

verses.name: John 13:25
verses.text: I ap kai ong pan kupur en Iesus potoan ong i: Maing, is i?

verses.name: John 13:26
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Iei i, me I pan ki ong kisin prot i lao kaduedier nan dal o. A lao kotin kaduedier kisin prot o, a kotiki ong Iudas Iskariot nain Simon.

verses.name: John 13:27
verses.text: A lao tungole kisin prot o, Satan ap tilong lole. Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Wiada madang, me koe pan wiada!

verses.name: John 13:28
verses.text: A sota, ren me momod ni tepel, asa, da me a kotin masanieki ong i met.

verses.name: John 13:29
verses.text: Pwe akai kiki ong, me Iesus kotin masani ong i: Netie dong kitail kapwa en kamadip o, de a en ki ong me samama ko meakot, pwe a kin wewa ed en moni.

verses.name: John 13:30
verses.text: A lao tungoler kisin prot, ap madang pedoi wei, a wasa pongier.

verses.name: John 13:31
verses.text: A lao pedoi sanger, Iesus ap kotin masani: Nain aramas ari linganlar, o Kot me lingana kilar i.

verses.name: John 13:32
verses.text: Ma Kot lingan kilar i, Kot ap pan pil kalinganaki pein i. A pan madang kalinganada i.

verses.name: John 13:33
verses.text: Seri ko, I pan ieiang komail ansau kis, komail pan rapa kin ia, a duen I indai ong Sus akan: Wasa me I pan kola ia, komail sota pan kak ong. Iei duen I pil indai ong komail ansau wet.

verses.name: John 13:34
verses.text: I ki ong komail kusoned kap eu, pwe komail en poke pena, duen I pok ong komail er, iei duen komail en poke pena!

verses.name: John 13:35
verses.text: Pwe i me karos pan asaki, me komail ai tounpadak kan, ma komail limpok pena.

verses.name: John 13:36
verses.text: Simon Petrus potoan ong i: Maing, re pan kotila ia? Iesus kotin sapeng i: Wasa me I pan kola ia, koe sota kak idauen ia ansau wet, a koe pan idauen ia eu ran.

verses.name: John 13:37
verses.text: Petrus potoan ong i: Maing, da me i so kak idauen ir ki met? I pan kasela maur i pweki komui.

verses.name: John 13:38
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Koe pan kasela maur om pweki ngai? Melel, melel I indai ong uk, mon malek pan kakorot, koe pan kamam kin ia pan me sili pak.<div eID="gen2695" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.13"/>

verses.name: John 14:1
verses.text: MONGIONG omail der padau! Komail kin poson Kot; en pil poson ia!

verses.name: John 14:2
verses.text: Nan tanpas en Sam ai pera toto mia. Ma so I pan indai ong komail. Pwe I kokolan kaonopada deu ’mail,

verses.name: John 14:3
verses.text: Ma I kola kaonopada deu ’mail, I pan puredo, uk komail dong ia. Pwe wasa I kin mi ia, komail en pil mi ia.

verses.name: John 14:4
verses.text: A komail asa, wasa I kola ia, o komail asa al o.

verses.name: John 14:5
verses.text: Tomas potoan ong i: Maing, se sasa, wasa re pan kotila ia, o pala se pan asa al o?

verses.name: John 14:6
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ngai me al, o melel, o maur, sota me kak kodong Sam, ma so ngai.

verses.name: John 14:7
verses.text: Ma komail asa ia er, komail pil asa Sam ai. A komail asa i sang ansau wet kokolata o kilangadar i.

verses.name: John 14:8
verses.text: Pilipus potoan ong i: Maing, kotin kasale dong kit Sam, kit ap pan nenenla!

verses.name: John 14:9
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Pilipus, I ieiang komail er ansau warai, a koe so wewe kin ia? Me kilang ia er i me kilangadar Sam. A iaduen om indada: Kasale ong kit Sam?

verses.name: John 14:10
verses.text: Koe so kamelele, me ngai podidi ong Sam o Sam podidi ong ia? A padak kan, me I ki ong komail, kaidin pein ai, a en Sam, me mi re i, i me kin wiawia dodok pukat.

verses.name: John 14:11
verses.text: Kamelele ia, ngai podidi ong Sam, o Sam kin podidi ong ia; a ma so, komail kamelele ia pweki ai wiawia kan.

verses.name: John 14:12
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, meamen poson ia, a pil pan wiawia dodok kan me I kin wiawia, o a pan wiada, me lapa sang mepukat, pweki I kokola ren Sam.

verses.name: John 14:13
verses.text: A meakot komail pan poeki ni ad ai, iei me I pan wia, pwe Sam en lingana kida Na.

verses.name: John 14:14
verses.text: Ma komail pan poeki maekot ni ad ai, I pan wia.

verses.name: John 14:15
verses.text: Ma komail pok ong ia, en kapwaiada ai kusoned akan!

verses.name: John 14:16
verses.text: A I pan poeki ren Sam, a i me pan porone dong komail amen saunkamait, pwen mi re omail kokolata.

verses.name: John 14:17
verses.text: Ngen en melel, me sappa so kak ale, pwe re sota kilang i pil sota asa i. A komail asa i pwe a kin mi re omail, o a pan mi lol omail.

verses.name: John 14:18
verses.text: I sota pan mueid ong komail, en sapoupou, I pan ko dong komail.

verses.name: John 14:19
verses.text: Ansau kis sappa solar pan kilang ia, a komail kin kilang ia. Ngai me maur, o i me komail pil pan memaureki.

verses.name: John 14:20
verses.text: Ni ran o komail pan asa, me ngai podidi ong Sam ai o komail podidi ong ia o ngai ong komail.

verses.name: John 14:21
verses.text: Me aleer ai kusoned akan o kapwaiada, iei me kin pok ong ia, a me kin pok ong ia, kin konekon ren Sam ai, a I pan pok ong i, o kasansale ong i pein ngai.

verses.name: John 14:22
verses.text: Iudas, kaidik Iskariot, potoan ong i: Maing, iaduen re pan kotin kasansale ong kit pein ir, a ong sappa so?

verses.name: John 14:23
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng masani ong i: Ma meamen pok ong ia, a pan kapwaiada ai padak kan, a Sam ai pan pok ong i, a se pan ko ong re a kaukauson re a.

verses.name: John 14:24
verses.text: A me so pok ong ia, sota kin kapwaiada ai padak kan. A kaidik ai padak, me komail kin rong, a en Sam o, me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 14:25
verses.text: Mepukat I padaki ong komail er ni ai mi re omail.

verses.name: John 14:26
verses.text: A saunkamait, Ngen saraui, me Sam o pan poronedo ni ad ai, i me pan kawewe ong komail meakaros o kataman kin komail me I padaki ong komail er.

verses.name: John 14:27
verses.text: I mueid ong komail popol. Ai popol me I ki ong komail, kaidin duen sappa kikida, me I ki ong komail. Mongiong omail der patau, pil der masak.

verses.name: John 14:28
verses.text: Komail rongadar, me I indai ong komail er, I koko wei o pan pure dong komail. Ma komail pok ong ia, komail pan perenki, me I kokola ren Sam, pwe Sam o me lapa sang ia.

verses.name: John 14:29
verses.text: Ansau wet I indai ong komail er mepukat, mon a pan wiaui, pwe a lao wiaui, komail en poson.

verses.name: John 14:30
verses.text: I solar pan kasokasoi toto ong komail, pwe kaun en sappa o kokodo, a sota a meakot re i.

verses.name: John 14:31
verses.text: A pwe sappa en asa, me I kin pok ong Sam, o me I kin wiawia duen me Sam masani ong ia er, kitail en uda kokowei!<div eID="gen2696" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.14"/>

verses.name: John 15:1
verses.text: NGAI wain melel pot, a Sam ai saumat.

verses.name: John 15:2
verses.text: Ra karos, me podidi ong ia, ap sota wa, a kin lepuke sang, a karos me wa, a kin koko, pwen wa totola.

verses.name: John 15:3
verses.text: Komail ari makelekel kidar padak, me I ki ong komail er.

verses.name: John 15:4
verses.text: Komail podidi ong ia o ngai ong komail. Ra sota kak pein wa, ma a so podidi ong wain, iduen komail, ma komail so podidi ong ia.

verses.name: John 15:5
verses.text: Ngai wain pot, a ra kan komail. Me podidi ong ia o ngai ong i, iei i, me kin wawa toto; pwe komail sota kak wia meakot ma sota ngai.

verses.name: John 15:6
verses.text: Meamen so podidi ong ia, pan lokidokila dueta ra, ap mongedi; aramas kin wasa ir pena, kase ir ala nani iai, ir ari pan rongala.

verses.name: John 15:7
verses.text: Ma komail podidi ong ia, o ai padak kan podidi ong komail, komail pan poeki meakot, me komail mauki, a a pan pwai ong komail.

verses.name: John 15:8
verses.text: Nan i me Sam ai kalingana kila, omail wawa toto, o komail pan wiala ai tounpadak kan.

verses.name: John 15:9
verses.text: Due Sam o pok ong ia er, iduen I pil pok ong komail; komail podidi ong ai limpok!

verses.name: John 15:10
verses.text: Ma komail pan peiki ong ai kusoned akan, komail pan podidi ong ai limpok, duen I kin peiki ong en Sam ai kusoned akan, o podidi ong a limpok.

verses.name: John 15:11
verses.text: Mepukat I padaki ong komail er, pwe ai peren en podidi ong komail, o omail peren en unsokela.

verses.name: John 15:12
verses.text: Nan iet ai kusoned: Komail en poke pena, duen i pok ong komail er.

verses.name: John 15:13
verses.text: Sota me a limpok laude sang met, me pan mueid kila maur i kompokepa kan.

verses.name: John 15:14
verses.text: Komail me kompokepa i, ma komail wiawia, me I indai ong komail.

verses.name: John 15:15
verses.text: I solar kaadaneki komail ladu, pwe ladu sasa, me a saumas kin wia. A I kaadane kin komail kompokepa i kan, aki I kasale ong komail er karos, me I rongadar sang ren Sam ai.

verses.name: John 15:16
verses.text: Kaidin komail me pil ia dar, a ngai me piladar komail o kilele ong komail, en kokowei kapareda wa, o omail wa en mimieta, pwe karos, me komail pan poeki ren Sam ni ad ai, a pan kotiki ong komail.

verses.name: John 15:17
verses.text: A iet me I panaui kin komail, komail en poke pena!

verses.name: John 15:18
verses.text: Ma sappa kailong kin komail, komail en asa, me a kailong kin ia mo omail.

verses.name: John 15:19
verses.text: Ma kisan sappa komail, sappa pan pok ong me a; a komail kaidin kisan sappa, pwe I pil komail dar sang sappa, iei me sappa kailong kin komail.

verses.name: John 15:20
verses.text: Tamatamanda kasoi o, me I kasoia ong komail er: Ladu me sota laude sang a saumas ma re kame ia er, re pil pan kame komail. A ma irail pan kapwaiada ai padak, re pil pan kapwaiada omail.

verses.name: John 15:21
verses.text: A mepukat karos re pan wiai ong komail pweki ad ai, aki ar so asa me kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 15:22
verses.text: Ma I so kodo o padaki ong irail, nan sota pan dip arail, a met sota peikid pan dip arail.

verses.name: John 15:23
verses.text: Me kailong kin ia, pil kin kailongki Sam ai.

verses.name: John 15:24
verses.text: Ma I so wiadar dodok kan nan pung arail, me sota amen wiadar, nan sota pan dip arail. A met irail kilanger o kailong kin ia er o pil Sam ai.

verses.name: John 15:25
verses.text: A mepukat wiauier pwe masan o en pwaida, me intingidier nan arail kapung: Irail kailong kin ia, a sota karepa.

verses.name: John 15:26
verses.text: A saunkamait lao kodoer, me I pan kadarado sang ren Sam, iei Ngen en melel, me kin kodo sang ren Sam, i me pan kadede ngai.

verses.name: John 15:27
verses.text: A komail pil pan kadede, pwe komail iang ia er sang ni tapi o.<div eID="gen2697" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.15"/>

verses.name: John 16:1
verses.text: MEPUKAT I padaki ong komail er pwe komail der makarada.

verses.name: John 16:2
verses.text: Irail pan kase komail la sang nan sinakoke, a eu ansau kokodo, meamen kame komail la, pan kiki ong, me a papa Kot.

verses.name: John 16:3
verses.text: A mepukat re pan wiai ong komail, pweki ar sasa Sam o ngai.

verses.name: John 16:4
verses.text: A mepukat I padaki ong komail er, pwe ansau lao leler, komail en tamanda, me I indai ong komail er. A mepukat I sota indai ong komail er ni tapi o, pwe I ieiang komail.

verses.name: John 16:5
verses.text: A met I kola ren me kadar ia do, a sota amen komail kin idok re i: Ia wasa kom pan kola ia?

verses.name: John 16:6
verses.text: A pweki ai padaki ong komail mepukat, mongiong omail me dir en insensued.

verses.name: John 16:7
verses.text: Ari so, I kasoi ong komail melel, me mau ong komail I en kola. Pwe ma I so kola saunkamait sota pan pwara dong komail. A ma I kola, I pan kadara dong komail i.

verses.name: John 16:8
verses.text: A i lao kodo, a pan kasaui ong sappa dip, o pung, o kadeik.

verses.name: John 16:9
verses.text: Duen dip, pweki irail sota poson ia.

verses.name: John 16:10
verses.text: Duen pung, pweki I kola ren Sam, o komail solar pan kilang ia.

verses.name: John 16:11
verses.text: A duen kadeik o, pweki kaun en sappa wet me pakadeikadar.

verses.name: John 16:12
verses.text: I men padaki ong komail me toto, a met komail sota kak ong.

verses.name: John 16:13
verses.text: A Ngen en melel lao pwarado, a pan padaki ong komail melel akan karos. Pwe a sota pan padaki wei sang nan pein i, a meakot a pan rong, i me a pan indada. O a pan kasale ong komail meakan me pan wiaui.

verses.name: John 16:14
verses.text: A pan kalingana ia da, pwe a pan ale me ai o kasale ong komail.

verses.name: John 16:15
verses.text: Sapwilim en Sam meakaros, iei me pil udan ai. I me I indakier, me a pan ale me ai o kasale ong komail.

verses.name: John 16:16
verses.text: Murin ansau kis komail solar pan kilang ia; o pil murin ansau kis, a komail pan kilang ia, pwe I kola ren Sam.

verses.name: John 16:17
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kai ap indada nan pung ar: Dakot met, me a kotin masani ong kitail: Murin ansau kis komail solar pan kilang ia, o pil murin ansau kis, a komail pan kilang ia, pwe I kokola ren Sam?

verses.name: John 16:18
verses.text: Irail ap indada: Dakot murin ansau kis, me a kotin masanieki? Kitail sota weweki, me a kotin masani.

verses.name: John 16:19
verses.text: A Iesus kotin angi, me re men idok re a, ap kotin masani ong irail: Komail kakaaki nan pung omail, me I indada: Murin ansau kis komail solar pan kilang ia, o pil murin ansau kis, a komail pan kilang ia.

verses.name: John 16:20
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong komail, komail pan sangesang o mamaiei, a sappa pan pereperen; komail pan mamauk, a omail mauk pan wiki ong popol.

verses.name: John 16:21
verses.text: Li o ni a pan naitik kin insensued, aki a ansau leler; a a lao naitikidier seri o, a solar kin tamanda a insensued, aki a peren kida, me aramas amen ipwidi ong sappa.

verses.name: John 16:22
verses.text: Pil dueta komail kin insensued ansau wet. A I pil pan kilang komail o mongiong omail pan pereperen. A sota me pan atia sang komail omail peren.

verses.name: John 16:23
verses.text: A lao ni ran o komail sota pan idok re i meakot. Melel, melel I indai ong komail, ma komail pan poeki meakot ren Sam ni ad ai, a pan kotiki ong komail.

verses.name: John 16:24
verses.text: Sang mas kokodo komail sota poeki meakot ni ad ai. Poeki, a komail pan ale; pwe omail peren en unsokela.

verses.name: John 16:25
verses.text: Mepukat I padaki ong komail er ni karaseras akan. A eu ansau kokodo, me I solar pan padapadak ni karaseras, pwe I pan sansal padaki ong komail duen Sam.

verses.name: John 16:26
verses.text: Lao ran o komail pan poeki ni ad ai. A I sota indai ong komail, me I pan kapakapa kin komail ren Sam.

verses.name: John 16:27
verses.text: Pwe Sam pein pok ong komail, pweki komail pok ong ia er o kamelele, me I kodo sang ren Kot.

verses.name: John 16:28
verses.text: I kodo sang ren Sam o kodido sappa; I pil kokola sang nin sappa, kokola ren Sam.

verses.name: John 16:29
verses.text: Sapwilim a tounpadak kan potoan ong i: Masani, ansau wet re kin kotin sansal padaki ong kit o solar ni karaseras.

verses.name: John 16:30
verses.text: Kit ap asaer, me re kotin mangier meakaros, o re sota mau ong, amen en idok meakot re omui. I me se posonki, me re kotido sang ren Kot.

verses.name: John 16:31
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng irail: Komail posonlar met?

verses.name: John 16:32
verses.text: Kilang, ansau kokodo, ari a leler, me komail pan kamueit pasang, amen amen nan udan deu a o kase ia la. I ap pan kelep; ari so, I sota kin kelep, pwe Sam o ieiang ia.

verses.name: John 16:33
verses.text: Mepukat I padaki ong komail, pwe komail en popole kin ia. Nan sappa komail kin kalokolok, ari so, komail popol, pwe I kaloedier sappa.<div eID="gen2698" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.16"/>

verses.name: John 17:1
verses.text: IESUS kotin masani wei mepukat, ap kotin masanda nanlang masani: Sam ai, ansau o leler, en kalinganada sapwilim omui Ol, pwe sapwilim omui Ol en pil kalinganada komui.

verses.name: John 17:2
verses.text: Duen komui kotiki ong i er manaman, en poedi uduk karos, pwe a en ki ong karos, me komui ki ong i er, maur soutuk.

verses.name: John 17:3
verses.text: A iet maur soutuk: Ren asa komui la, me komui ta Kot melel, o Iesus Kristus, me komui kadarador.

verses.name: John 17:4
verses.text: I kalingana komui dar nin sappa, I kanikialar dodok, me komui kotiki dong ia, I en wiada.

verses.name: John 17:5
verses.text: A met Sam ai, kom kotin kalingana kin ia pein omui lingan, me I linganakier, ni ai mi re omui, ni sappa saikenta mia.

verses.name: John 17:6
verses.text: I kasansale ong aramas akan mar omui, me komui ki ong ia er sang nin sappa. Irail udan noumui, a komui ki ong ia er irail; a re kin kapwaiada omui masan.

verses.name: John 17:7
verses.text: A met re asalar, me karos, me komui ki ong ia er, pwili sang komui.

verses.name: John 17:8
verses.text: A masan akan, me komui ki ong ia er, i me I ki ong irail er, o irail aleer o wewekilar melel, me I pwarado sang komui, o re posonlar, me komui kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 17:9
verses.text: I kin kapakapa kin ir, I sota kin kapakapa kin sappa, a irail, me komui ki ong ia er, pwe noumui irail.

verses.name: John 17:10
verses.text: Pwe karos me ai, iei noumui; a karos me noumui, iei ai o I lingan kin irail lar.

verses.name: John 17:11
verses.text: I solar mi sappa, a mepukat mi sappa. I kola re omui. Sam ai saraui, kanikid irail ni mar omui, me komui ki ong ia er, pwe irail en me ta men dueta kita.

verses.name: John 17:12
verses.text: Ni ai mi re irail, I nikid irail er ni mar omui, me komui ki ong ia er; I nikid irail er; sota amen ir salongalar, seri salongala eta, pwe kisin likau en pwaida.

verses.name: John 17:13
