verses.text: A met I koko wei re omui. I padaki wei mepukat nan sappa, pwe ai peren unsok en mi re ’rail.

verses.name: John 17:14
verses.text: I ki ong irail er omui masan, o sappa kailong kin irail er, pwe irail kaidin kisan sappa, dueta, ngai kaidin kisan sappa.

verses.name: John 17:15
verses.text: I sota kin poeki, komui en wa irail sang nin sappa, a pwe komui en pera wei sang irail me sued.

verses.name: John 17:16
verses.text: Irail kaidin kisan sappa, dueta ngai kaidin kisan sappa.

verses.name: John 17:17
verses.text: Kasaraui kin ir ala melel, pwe me melel omui masan.

verses.name: John 17:18
verses.text: Duen komui kadar ia dong sappa, iduen I kadar ir alang sappa.

verses.name: John 17:19
verses.text: I kasarauila pein ngai pweki irail, pwe irail kasaraui kila melel.

verses.name: John 17:20
verses.text: A kaidin mepukat eta, me I kapakapaki, a pil irail, me pan poson ia pweki arail padak.

verses.name: John 17:21
verses.text: Pwe irail karos en me ta men, duen komui Sam podidi ong ia o ngai ong komui, pwe irail en pil me ta men re ata, pwe sappa en poson, me komui kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 17:22
verses.text: A lingan, me komui ki ong ia er, I ki ong irail er, pwe irail en me ta men, dueta kita me ta men.

verses.name: John 17:23
verses.text: Ngai ong irail, o komui ong ia, pwe re en song laieu, pwe sappa en asa, me komui kadar ia dor, o pok ong irail, dueta komui pok ong ia er.

verses.name: John 17:24
verses.text: Sam, I men, irail, me komui ki ong ia er, en pil mi wasa, me I kin mi ia, pwe ren ududial ai lingan, me komui ki ong ia er, pwe komui pok ong ia er mon sappa a tapidar.

verses.name: John 17:25
verses.text: Sam ai pung, sappa sasa komui, a ngai me asa komui, a mepukat asaer, me komui kadar ia dor.

verses.name: John 17:26
verses.text: O I kasale ong irail er mar omui. O I pan pil kasaleda i, pwe limpok ota, me komui poke kin ia er, en podidi ong ir o ngai ong irail.<div eID="gen2699" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.17"/>

verses.name: John 18:1
verses.text: IESUS lao kotin masanier mepukat, ap kotila palilan pil Kidron, o sapwilim a tounpadak kan iang i: Matuel eu mi wasa o, me i o sapwilim a tounpadak kan kotilong ong lole.

verses.name: John 18:2
verses.text: A Iudas me pangala i, pil asa wasa o, pwe Iesus o sapwilim a tounpadak kan kin purepure wasa o.

verses.name: John 18:3
verses.text: Iudas lao aleer pokon o papa kan sang ren samero lapalap o Parisär akan, ap kokiieila lamp, o ser akan, o kapwa en pei kan.

verses.name: John 18:4
verses.text: A Iesus me kotin mangier meakaros, me pan pit i, kotiei wong irail masani ong irail: Is me komail rapaki?

verses.name: John 18:5
verses.text: Re sapeng i: Iesus men Nasaret. Iesus kotin masani ong irail: Ngai i. A Iudas, me pangala i, pil u iang irail.

verses.name: John 18:6
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani ong irail: Ngai i, re ap puioki sang, pupodi ong nan pwel.

verses.name: John 18:7
verses.text: A pil kotin kainoma re irail. Is me komail rapaki? Irail inda: Iesus men Nasaret.

verses.name: John 18:8
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani: I indai ong komail er, me ngai i. Ari, ma komail rapakin ia, en purewei sang mepukat!

verses.name: John 18:9
verses.text: Pwe lepen masan en pwaida, me a kotin masanier: Sota amen irail, me komui ki ong ia er, me salongalar.

verses.name: John 18:10
verses.text: A Simon Petrus, me na kodlas mia, ap usa pasang, päleki en samero lapalap a ladu, päle pasang salong a pali maun. A ladu o me ad a Malkus.

verses.name: John 18:11
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong Petrus: Kapure ong om kodlas nan deu a! Da, dal o, me Sam o kotiki ong ia er, i ender nim?

verses.name: John 18:12
verses.text: Ari, pokon o, o ar kaun, o papa en men Sus akan saikidi Iesus o saliedi i.

verses.name: John 18:13
verses.text: O kalua mas ren Anas, pwe i sam en Kaipas a paud o samero lapalap ni par o.

verses.name: John 18:14
verses.text: Iei i Kaipas, me indai ong Sus oko: Me mau, aramas ta men en kam kila aramas akan.

verses.name: John 18:15
verses.text: A Simon Petrus o pil amen tounpadak idauenla Iesus. A tounpadak men et, me samero lapalap asaer, iang Iesus kotilong ong nan matuel en samero lapalap.

verses.name: John 18:16
verses.text: A Petrus u liki impan wanim o. Tounpadak teio, me samero lapalap asaer, pedoi sang kasokasoi ong me sinsila wanim o ukelong ong Petrus lole.

verses.name: John 18:17
verses.text: Seripein o, me sinsila wanim, ap indai ong Petrus: Kaidin amen ren tounpadak kan en aramas men et koe? A inda: Ngai so.

verses.name: John 18:18
verses.text: A ladu o papa kan u wasa o, saunda kisiniai, pwe a kapau; irail rangerang ia, a Petrus pil iang u rangerang.

verses.name: John 18:19
verses.text: Samero lalalap ap kalelapok ren Iesus duen sapwilim a tounpadak kan o duen a padak.

verses.name: John 18:20
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng i: I padapadak sansal ong sappa; ansau karos I kaukawewedar nan sinakoke o nan im en kaudok, wasa me Sus oko karos kin pokon pena ia; a sota man meakot, me I padak wasa rir.

verses.name: John 18:21
verses.text: Da me kom peidokki re i? Kalelapok ren me rong ia er, me I padaki ong irail er, kilang, re asa, me I indada.

verses.name: John 18:22
verses.text: Ni en Iesus a kotin masani met, amen sang ren papa ko, me uda impa, ap pikir silang en Iesus indada: Iduen om sapeng ong samero lapalap?

verses.name: John 18:23
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng i: Ma ai lokaia sued, koe ap kadede ki duen a sued, a ma me pung menda koe pikir ia?

verses.name: John 18:24
verses.text: A Anas ap kadar wong sensal ren samero lapalap Kaipas.

verses.name: John 18:25
verses.text: A Simon Petrus u, rangerang irail ap indai ong i: Ele koe pil amen a tounpadak kan? A kamamada indada: Ngai so.

verses.name: John 18:26
verses.text: Ladun samero lapalap amen, me sauneki ol o, me Petrus pale sang salong a, ap indada: Kaidin koe me i kilanger re a nan matuel o?

verses.name: John 18:27
verses.text: Petrus ap pil kamamada. Malek madang kakorotada,

verses.name: John 18:28
verses.text: Irail ap kalua sang Iesus ren Kaipas, walang nan im en kadeik. Ari, me sangkonai. A irail sota pedelong ong nan im en kadeik, pwe re de kasaminela pein irail, pwe re en kak ong tungole pasa.

verses.name: John 18:29
verses.text: Pilatus ap pedoi wong re irail indada: Da me komail karauneki aramas men et?

verses.name: John 18:30
verses.text: Irail sapeng indang i: Ma men et sota me sued amen, se sota pan pangalang komui i.

verses.name: John 18:31
verses.text: Pilatus ap masani ong irail: Pein komail ale i, kadeikada i duen omail kapung. Sus oko ap indai ong i: A sota muei ong kit, sen kamela amen.

verses.name: John 18:32
verses.text: Pwe masan en Iesus en pwaida, me a kotin masanieda, pwen kasaleda, duen a pan kamatala.

verses.name: John 18:33
verses.text: A Pilatus pur ong nan im en kadeik ekeredo Iesus, kalelapok re a: Komui Nanmarki en Sus akan?

verses.name: John 18:34
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng i: Kom indada mepukat sang nan pein omui pam? De akai indai ong komui duen ngai?

verses.name: John 18:35
verses.text: Pilatus sapeng: Da, men Sus amen ngai? Toun sap omui o samero lapalap akan panga dong ia komui; da me komui wiadar?

verses.name: John 18:36
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Ai wei kaidin men sappa et. Ma ai wei men sappa et, nan ai papa kan pan pepeita, pwe I ender pan pangalang Sus akan; a kaidin ai wei ansau wet,

verses.name: John 18:37
verses.text: Pilatus ap indai ong i: Ari, Nanmarki amen komui? Iesus kotin sapeng: Komui me inda, me Nanmarki amen ngai. I me I ipwikidier o pwara kidong sappa pwe I en kadede melel. Kisan melel akan kin rongerong ngil ai.

verses.name: John 18:38
verses.text: Pilatus indai ong i: Dakot melel? A lao indawei mepukat, ap pil pedoi ong ren men Sus indai ong irail: I sota man diar dip a.

verses.name: John 18:39
verses.text: A tiak eu mi re omail, i en lapwada meamen ni pasa. Komail so men, i en lapwadang komail Nanmarki en Sus akan?

verses.name: John 18:40
verses.text: Irail karos pil weriwereda indada: Kaidik men et, a Parapas! A Parapas me lolap amen.<div eID="gen2700" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.18"/>

verses.name: John 19:1
verses.text: PILATUS ap ale Iesus wokida i.

verses.name: John 19:2
verses.text: A saunpei ko irada el en tek eu, rap kidang pon kadokenmai o kapwataki i likau waitata.

verses.name: John 19:3
verses.text: Re ap kai dong i indada: Iong Nanmarki en Sus akan! O re pikir silang i.

verses.name: John 19:4
verses.text: Pilatus ap pil pedoi indai ong irail: Kilang, i wa dong komail i, pwe komail en asa, me i sota diaradar dip a.

verses.name: John 19:5
verses.text: Iesus ap kotieila, kapwataki el en tek o likau pup waitata. A indai ong irail: Kilang, song en aramas o!

verses.name: John 19:6
verses.text: Samero lapalap o papa ko lao udial i, irail ap weriwereda indada: Kalopuela i! Kalopuela i! Pilatus indai ong irail: Pein komail ale i kalopuela i! Pwe i sota diar dip a.

verses.name: John 19:7
verses.text: Sus oko sapeng i: At kapung mia, a duen at kapung a pan kamatala, pwe a wiaki sapwilim en Kot pein i.

verses.name: John 19:8
verses.text: Pilatus lao rongadar mepukat, ap masapwekadar kaualap,

verses.name: John 19:9
verses.text: O purelong ong nan im en kadeik o, kalelapok ren Iesus: Komui koti sang ia? A Iesus sota kotin sapeng i.

verses.name: John 19:10
verses.text: Pilatus ap indai ong i: Komui sota sapeng ia? Komui sota asa, me i manaman ong kapiti uk ala o pil manaman ong kalopue uk ala?

verses.name: John 19:11
verses.text: Iesus kotin sapeng: Sota man om manaman en kaoe ia, ma a so muei ong komui sang poa. Ari, dip en me panga ia dong komui er me lapa sang.

verses.name: John 19:12
verses.text: Ari, Pilatus ap song kapitila i, a Sus oko weriwer indada: Komui kaidin kompoke pan Sisa, ma komui pan kapitila men et. Meamen kasapwiladang nanmarki pein i kin palian Sisa.

verses.name: John 19:13
verses.text: Pilatus lao rongadar kasoi pukat ap kapwareda Iesus, kaipokedi pon deun kadeik, wasa me adaneki Pepment, a ni lokaia en Ipru: Kapata,

verses.name: John 19:14
verses.text: A i ran en onop ong pasa impan auer kawonu. I ari masani ong Sus oko: Kilang, omail Nanmarki!

verses.name: John 19:15
verses.text: A re weriwereda: Sikenewei! Sikenewei! Kalopuela i! Pilatus masani ong irail: Da, i en kamela omail Nanmarki? Samero lapalap akan sapeng: Sota at nanmarki, Sisa eta.

verses.name: John 19:16
verses.text: I ari pangalang irail i, pwen lopuela. Rap koledi Iesus kaluala.

verses.name: John 19:17
verses.text: A pein i kotin wa a lopu, kotilang wasa me adaneki wasan pondal, a ni lokaia en Ipru: Kolkata,

verses.name: John 19:18
verses.text: Wasa re kalopuela i iangaki riamen, amen ni pali maun, a amen ni pali maing, a Iesus nan pung ara.

verses.name: John 19:19
verses.text: Pilatus ap pil wiadar inting eu, kakonei ong pon lopu o. A iet inting: Iesus en Nasaret, Nanmarki en Sus akan.

verses.name: John 19:20
verses.text: Sus akan me toto, me wadokedi inting wet, pwe wasa Iesus kotin lopuela ia, me salong kanim o. A inting o wiauier ni lokaia en Ipru o Krik o Latain.

verses.name: John 19:21
verses.text: Ari, samero lapalap oko potoan ong Pilatus: Der intingiedi: Nanmarki en Sus akan, a me a indada: Ngai Nanmarki en Sus akan!

verses.name: John 19:22
verses.text: Pilatus sapeng: Me i intingiedier, i eta ai inting.

verses.name: John 19:23
verses.text: Saunpei ko lao kalopuela Iesus, rap ale sapwilim a likau kan, lepuk pasang, wiakida pakis paieu, pakis eu ong amen amen en saunpei ko o pil sapwilim a sakit, me so deidei pena, a pon ta sang poa lel pa.

verses.name: John 19:24
verses.text: Irail ap kasoi nan pung arail: Kitail ender ter pasang i, a kadoropwaki, me pan aneki, pwe kisin likau en pungala, me indinda: Irail nek pasang ai likau kan nan pung ar o kadoropwa ai sakit. Iei me saunpei ko wiakida mepukat.

verses.name: John 19:25
verses.text: A in en Iesus u ni tapin lopu en Iesus, o ri en in a Maria, en Kleopas a paud, o Maria men Makdala.

verses.name: John 19:26
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin masani in a o tounpadak men u imp a me a kotin kupura mauki, ap kotin masani ong in a: Li, kilang noum ol!

verses.name: John 19:27
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong tounpadak o: Kilang in om! Ari, sang ni auer ota tounpadak o apwali i.

verses.name: John 19:28
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin mangier, me meakaros nikier, ap kotin masanier: I men nim pilada, pwe kisin likau en pungala.

verses.name: John 19:29
verses.text: A kasak mi wasa o, me audeki pineka. Irail kaduedi lim eu nan pineka, ki ong ni alek apot, kidalang ni silang i.

verses.name: John 19:30
verses.text: Iesus lao kotin uraker pineka, ap kotin masani: A nikier. I ari kotin kamotauiedi kadokenmai, kadarala ngen e.

verses.name: John 19:31
verses.text: Sus oko ap poeki ren Pilatus, me nä arail en katipitip pasang o ren wisiki sang, pwe war arail ender langelang nin lopu ran en sapat. Pwe iei ran o ran en kaonop, pwe iei ran en sapat o me lapalap.

verses.name: John 19:32
verses.text: Saunpei ko ap kai ong, katip pasang nä en me pali et o en me teio, me iang lopuelar.

verses.name: John 19:33
verses.text: A re lao kai ong Iesus o diaradar, me a matalar, rap sota katip pasang aluwilu a kan.

verses.name: John 19:34
verses.text: A saunpei men dokoki katieu pot pangepang a; madang nta o pil kusekusewei.

verses.name: John 19:35
verses.text: A me udial mepukat, kin kadede o a kadede me melel, o a asa, me a kin kadede, iei me melel, pwe komail en pil poson.

verses.name: John 19:36
verses.text: Pwe mepukat wiauier, pwe kisin likau en pungala: Aluwilu a sota pan tip pasang.

verses.name: John 19:37
verses.text: O pil eu kisin likau kin inda: Irail pan kangkakil i, me re dokodi.

verses.name: John 19:38
verses.text: Murin mepukat Iosep men Arimatia, tounpadak en Iesus amen, ari me rir, pweki a masak Sus oko, ap poeki ren Pilatus, en mueid ong i kalep en Iesus. Pilatus ari mueid ong i. I ari waiki sang kalep en Iesus.

verses.name: John 19:39
verses.text: Nikodemus me poto dong Iesus ni pong, pil kodo, wado paun epuki en potik en mire o alos.

verses.name: John 19:40
verses.text: Irail ap ale kalep en Iesus, kidimki pena likau linen kai iangaki pomau kan, duen tiak en Sus akan, ni ar kin sarepedi.

verses.name: John 19:41
verses.text: A wasa me a kotin lopuela ia, matuel eu mia ia, a nan matuel sousou kap eu mia, me saikenta amen saredi ia.

verses.name: John 19:42
verses.text: I wasa me ira nekidala Iesus, pweki ran en kaonop en Sus akan, o sousou me koren.<div eID="gen2701" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.19"/>

verses.name: John 20:1
verses.text: NI ran kaieu en wik Maria men Makdala pwara dong sousou o nin soran, a saikenta ran pasang, ap diaradar, me takai o katapur sanger mon sousou o.

verses.name: John 20:2
verses.text: I ap tanga wei, ko dong Simon Petrus o tounpadak teio, me Iesus kotin kupura mauki, indai ong ira: Irail wa sanger Kaun o nan sousou o, a se sasa, wasa re kidi ong ia i.

verses.name: John 20:3
verses.text: Petrus ari koieila o tounpadak teio ap ko dong sousou o.

verses.name: John 20:4
verses.text: Ira wiaki eu tanga wei, a tounpadak teio me madang mon Petrus lel sousou mas.

verses.name: John 20:5
verses.text: A lao itiokidi, ap kilangada likau linen wonon, ap sota pedelong ong lole.

verses.name: John 20:6
verses.text: Simon Petrus ap kokodo idauen i, ap pedelong ong nan sousou o, diarada likau linen ko wonon.

verses.name: John 20:7
verses.text: O lim en pudo me pira a kadokenmai, me sota iang likau linen ko; a lim pena wasa toror.

verses.name: John 20:8
verses.text: A tounpadak teio me tiong dong sousou o, ap pil ko ong lole; i ari diarada o posonla.

verses.name: John 20:9
verses.text: Pwe ira kaikenta weweki kisin likau, me a en iasada sang a matala,

verses.name: John 20:10
verses.text: Tounpadak ko ap pur onger nan deu ’ra.

verses.name: John 20:11
verses.text: A Maria u liki sal ong sousou o sangesang. O ni a sangesang a poridi, kilanglong ong nan sousou o,

verses.name: John 20:12
verses.text: Kilangada tounlang riamen momod ia, kapwateki likau pwetepwet, amen liman kadokenmai a amen liman aluwilu a kan, wasa kalep en Iesus kotikot iaer,

verses.name: John 20:13
verses.text: Ira ari masani ong i: Li, da me koe sangesangki? A indai ong ira: Aki irail wa sanger ai Kaun, a i sasa, wasa re kidi ong ia i.

verses.name: John 20:14
verses.text: A lao indada met, ap soupei wei kilanger Iesus kotia u o sasa, me i Iesus.

verses.name: John 20:15
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Li, da me koe sangesangki? Is me koe kin raparapaki? A kiki ong, me i me saumat o, ap indang i: Maing, ma komui wa sanger i, indai ong ia, wasa komui kidi ong ia i, i ap pan wala sang i.

verses.name: John 20:16
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong i: Maria! I ari soupei ong, potoan ong i: Rapuni! Iet wewe: Saunpadak.

verses.name: John 20:17
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Der sair ia, pwe I kaikenta pwarala ren Sam ai, a kola ren ri ai kan, kaire kin irail, I kokodala ren Sam ai o Sam omail, ren ai Kot o omail Kot,

verses.name: John 20:18
verses.text: Maria men Makdala kodo kaireki tounpadak kan, me a kilangadar Kaun o, o me a kotin masani ong i mepukat.

verses.name: John 20:19
verses.text: Lao nin sautik en ran ota, ni ran kaieu en wik, ni wanim ko me ritidier, wasa tounpadak kan pokon pena ia, pweki ar masak Sus oko, Iesus ap kotido u nan pung arail, masani ong irail: Komail popol!

verses.name: John 20:20
verses.text: A lao masaniada met, ap kasale ong irail lim a kan o pangepang a. Tounpadak kan ap perenda ni ar kilangada Kaun o.

verses.name: John 20:21
verses.text: Iesus ap pil kotin masani ong irail: Komail popol! Duen Sam o kadar ia do, iduen I kadar komail la.

verses.name: John 20:22
verses.text: A lao masanier met, ap ngidi ong irail masani: Komail ale Ngen saraui!

verses.name: John 20:23
verses.text: Me komail pan lapwada dip ar akan, re lapwadar; o me komail katengedie dip ar akan, pan tengedier.

verses.name: John 20:24
verses.text: A Tomas amen ekriamen, me adaneki Didimos, sota iang irail, ni Iesus kotin pwarador.

verses.name: John 20:25
verses.text: Tounpadak teio ap indai ong i: Se kilanger Kaun o. A i me indai ong irail: Ma i sota pan kilang lip en mata nan lim a kan, o kilong ong nan lip en mata sondi en pa i, o kilong ong pa ni pangepang a, i sota pan poson.

verses.name: John 20:26
verses.text: Murin ran walu sapwilim a tounpadak kan pil pokon pena, o Tomas iang irail. Wanim ko lao ritidier, Iesus ap kotido, u nan pung arail masani: Komail popol!

verses.name: John 20:27
verses.text: Ap kotin masani ong Tomas: Kido sondin pa om o kilang pa i kat, o kido pa om, kilong ong nan pangepang ai, o der soposon, a poson ta!

verses.name: John 20:28
verses.text: A Tomas sapeng indang i: Ai Kaun o ai Kot!

verses.name: John 20:29
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Pweki om kilang ia er, koe poson kilar, a meid pai, me kaikenta kilang ap poson.

verses.name: John 20:30
verses.text: Kilel toto me so intingidier nan puk wet, me Iesus kotin wiadar nan pung en sapwilim a tounpadak kan.

verses.name: John 20:31
verses.text: A mepukat me intingidier, pwe komail en poson, me Iesus me Kristus sapwilim en Kot Ol. O komail en poson ap aneki maur pweki mar a.<div eID="gen2702" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.20"/>

verses.name: John 21:1
verses.text: A MURIN mepukat Iesus pil kasale ong tounpadak kan pein i pon le en Tiperias; a iet duen a kasaledar:

verses.name: John 21:2
verses.text: Simon Petrus o Tomas, me adaneki Didimos, o Natanael men Kana nan Kaliläa, o nain Sepedäus ol oko, o pil sapwilim a tounpadak riamen me pokon pena,

verses.name: John 21:3
verses.text: Simon Petrus indai ong irail: I pan kola laid. Irail indai ong i: Se pil pan iang uk. Irail ari koieila, kereda pon kisin sop pot. A ni pong o re sota saikidi meakot.

verses.name: John 21:4
verses.text: A lao wasa ranier, Iesus ap kotikot ni oror, a sapwilim a tounpadak kan sasa, me i Iesus.

verses.name: John 21:5
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Seri ko, sota kan omail? Re sapeng i: Sota.

verses.name: John 21:6
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Kaduedi uk o pali maun en sop o, a komail pan diarada. Irail ap kaduedi; re ap solar kak apiada pweki mam toto.

verses.name: John 21:7
verses.text: Tounpadak o, me Iesus kotin kupura mauki, ap indai ong Petrus: Iei Kaun o. Simon Petrus loa rongadar, me i Kaun o, ap pira ong a sakit en liki pwe a kiliso, ap lusedi ong nan le o.

verses.name: John 21:8
verses.text: A tounpadak tei kan seisei kodo nan kisin sop, pwe re so doo sang sap o, ele tipong en pa riepuki, urakido uk o mam oko.

verses.name: John 21:9
verses.text: Irail leler sap, rap diaradar kisiniai o mam oko mi poa o prot.

verses.name: John 21:10
verses.text: Iesus ap kotin masani ong irail: Wado kisan saik omail!

verses.name: John 21:11
verses.text: Simon Petrus ap koda waikelong dong nan sap uk o, me dir en mam kalaimun epuki limek silimen; mam me toto, ari so, uk sota olar.

verses.name: John 21:12
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong irail: U kodo manga! A sota amen ren tounpadak kan kak idok re a: Is komui? Pwe re asaer, me i Kaun o.

verses.name: John 21:13
verses.text: Iesus ap kotido limada prot, nek ong irail o pil mam oko.

verses.name: John 21:14
verses.text: A i me kasilepak en Iesus a kotin kasale ong sapwilim a tounpadak kan pein i, murin a iasada sang a matalar.

verses.name: John 21:15
verses.text: Irail lao mangaer. Iesus ap kotin masani ong Simon Petrus: Simon, nain Iona, koe kin pok ong ia mon mepukat? A i potoan ong i: Ei Maing, ir me mangi, me i kin pok ong ir. A kotin masani ong i: Apwali nai sippul akan!

verses.name: John 21:16
verses.text: A pil masani ong i kariapak: Simon, nain Iona, koe kin pok ong ia? A sapeng i: Ei Maing, ir me kotin mangi, me i kin pok ong ir. A kotin masani ong i: Apwali nai sip akan!

verses.name: John 21:17
verses.text: A kotin masani ong i kasilepak: Simon, nain Iona, koe kin pok ong ia? Petrus ap mamauki a peidok pan silepak: Koe pok ong ia? A potoan ong i: Maing, ir me kotin mangi meakaros, re kotin mangi, me i kin pok ong ir. Iesus kotin masani ong i: Apwali nai sip akan!

verses.name: John 21:18
verses.text: Melel, melel I indai ong uk, ni om manakap koe pein pirai uk pena, ap alu wei wasa, me koe mauki. A koe lao likailapala, koe nek kida wei pa om akan, a amen pan pirai uk edi o kalualang wasa, me koe kang kola ia.

verses.name: John 21:19
verses.text: I me a kotin kokop kidar, duen a pan kapingaki Kot a matala. A lao kotin masanier met, ap masani ong i: Idauen ia!

verses.name: John 21:20
verses.text: Petrus ap soupewei, kilang tounpadak o idauen ira, me Iesus kotin kupura mauki o me pil mi pan kupur a ni kamadip o kalelapok: Maing, is i, me pan pang komui la?

verses.name: John 21:21
verses.text: Petrus lao kilanger i, ap indai ong Iesus: Maing, menda men et?

verses.name: John 21:22
verses.text: Iesus kotin masani ong i: Ma I mauki, a en mimieta I lao puredo, menda re om? Koe en idauen ia!

verses.name: John 21:23
verses.text: Kasoi pot et ap loloki sili nan pung en saulang kan, me dene tounpadak o sota pan mela. A Iesus sota kotin masanier, me a sota pan mela, a: Ma I mauki, a en mimieta I lao puredo, menda re om?

verses.name: John 21:24
verses.text: Iet tounpadak, me kadele mepukat o intingiedier mepukat; a se asa, me a kadede me melel.

verses.name: John 21:25
verses.text: A song toto, me Iesus kotin wiadar a ma irail karos pan intingidi, i lamelame, me sappa sota itar ong koledi puk kan, me pan intingidi.<div eID="gen2703" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="John.21"/> <div eID="gen2682" osisID="John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Acts 1:1
verses.text: MAING Teopilus, i wiadar tapin kasoi duen meakan, me Iesus kotin tapiadar, duen a wiawia o kaukawewe karos.

verses.name: Acts 1:2
verses.text: Lao lel ran en a peukedala mon a kotin kakalik ong wanporon akan, me a kotin piladar ren Ngen saraui,

verses.name: Acts 1:3
verses.text: Me a pil kotin kasansale ong pein i ieias ki kilel melel toto murin a kalokolok o a pwara dong irail ran paeisok o kapakaparokeki duen tiak en wein Kot.

verses.name: Acts 1:4
verses.text: A ni a kotikot re ’rail, a kotin kakaliki ong irail, ren der kowei sang Ierusalem, a ren auiaui, inau en Sam lao pwaidar, me komail ronga sang ia er.

verses.name: Acts 1:5
verses.text: Pwe Ioanes wia paptais ki pil, a komail pan paptais kila Ngen saraui ni eu ran me koren.

verses.name: Acts 1:6
verses.text: Irail lao pokon penaer, rap kalelapok re a potoan ong: Maing, ansau wet re pan kotin kapure dong Israel wei o?

verses.name: Acts 1:7
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Menda re omail, en asa ansau de auer, me Sam okila nan pein a manaman?

verses.name: Acts 1:8
verses.text: A komail pan ale manaman en Ngen saraui, me pan di po omail; komail ap pan ai saunkadede kan nan Ierusalem, o Iudäa pon o Samaria, o lel wong irepan sappa.

verses.name: Acts 1:9
verses.text: A lao masanier mepukat, ap peukedalar ni ar kangkakil, pali en dapok pali idandalar i sang mon mas arail.

verses.name: Acts 1:10
verses.text: Ni ar kilekilang nanlang, ni ansaun a kotidala, kilang, ol riamen mi nan likau pwetepwet, kotikot re ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 1:11
verses.text: Me pil masani: Ol en Kaliläa komail, da me komail sarakidang nanlang? Iei Iesus, me peukedala nanlang sang komail, a pan kotin puredo, duen komail udialer a kotidalar.

verses.name: Acts 1:12
verses.text: Irail ap purelang Ierusalem sang dol o, me ad a Oliwe, me koren iong Ierusalem; a doo sang al en sapat pot.

verses.name: Acts 1:13
verses.text: Irail lao kotilong ong, ap kotidang nan pera poa, wasa re kin kotikoteta, irail karos: Petrus, o Ioanes, o Iakopus, o Andreas, o Pilipus, o Tomas, o Partolomäus, o Matäus, o Iakopus nain Alpäus, o Simon Selotes, o Iudas ri en Iakopus.

verses.name: Acts 1:14
verses.text: Mepukat karos wiaki eu podidi ong kapakap, li akai pil iang irail, o pil Maria in en Iesus o ri a ol akan.

verses.name: Acts 1:15
verses.text: Ni ran oko Petrus ap uda nan pung en saulang kan masani (irail me impan epukiriek):

verses.name: Acts 1:16
verses.text: Ri ai kan, kisin likau en pungala, me Ngen saraui kalokaia ki Dawid mas o iran Iudas, me karedo, me saikidi Iesus oko.

verses.name: Acts 1:17
verses.text: Pwe a pil wadawad ong kitail, er o aleer pwais a dodok wet.

verses.name: Acts 1:18
verses.text: Nan ol men et pwaine kidar pwain en a sapung sap eu, a ni a dikaudi, ap lop pasang o kanangan kaped a ap poie sang.

verses.name: Acts 1:19
verses.text: Toun Ierusalem karos asada met. Ari, sap o adanekila akeldama ni pein arail lokaia; iet wewe: Sap en nta.

verses.name: Acts 1:20
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier nan puk en psalm: Im a en liselipingala o solar, me pan kauson lole, a amen me pan ale a koa.

verses.name: Acts 1:21
verses.text: Ari, amen sang ren ol akan, me poden iang kitail er, ni ansau me Kaun Iesus kotikot re atail,

verses.name: Acts 1:22
verses.text: Sang ni muein paptais en Ioanes kokodo lel ni ran o, me a kotin peukada sang kitail er, pan iang kitail wiala saunkadede en a kotin iasada.

verses.name: Acts 1:23
verses.text: Irail ari kileledi riamen: Iosep iei Parsapas, me pil ad a Iostos o Matias.

verses.name: Acts 1:24
verses.text: Irail ap kapakap masani: Maing, ir me kotin mangi mongiong en amen amen, re kotin kasansaleda, is me re kotin pilada ren me riamen et,

verses.name: Acts 1:25
verses.text: Pwe i en ale pwais a dodok wet o koa en wanporon, me Iudas pupe sang, pwen kolang deu a.

verses.name: Acts 1:26
verses.text: Irail ap kadoropwada. A doropwa ko ong Matias; i ari iang wadawad ong wanporon ekamen oko.<div eID="gen2705" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.1"/>

verses.name: Acts 2:1
verses.text: RAN en pentikos lao leler, irail karos kot pena wasa ta kis.

verses.name: Acts 2:2
verses.text: A madang ngil laud eu likamata ngil en melimel peidido sang nanlang o kadirela im o wasa, re kot pena ia.

verses.name: Acts 2:3
verses.text: A lo sirangerang akai likamata kisiniai pwarado sokedi pon amen amen.

verses.name: Acts 2:4
verses.text: Irail karos ap dire kila Ngen saraui ap pikikidi padaki wei ni lokaia toror, duen Ngen kotin kamasan irail ada.

verses.name: Acts 2:5
verses.text: Men Sus, ol lelapok ko sang nan wei karos pan lang kaikairu Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 2:6
verses.text: Irail lao ronger duen mepukat karos, ap pokon penaer o puriamui kila, aki amen amen ronger udan a lokaia.

verses.name: Acts 2:7
verses.text: Irail karos poneponeki o puriamuiki indada: Kilang, kaidin mepukat karos men Kaliläa, me kin padapadak?

verses.name: Acts 2:8
verses.text: A daduen, kit kin rong irail amen amen ni udan ngil atail?

verses.name: Acts 2:9
verses.text: Men Partien, men Medien, men Elam, o toun Mesopotamien, o Iudäa, o Kapadosien, o Pontus, o Asien,

verses.name: Acts 2:10
verses.text: O Prikien, o Pampilien, o Äkipten, o liman Lipien; salong Kirene, o men Rom, me mi wasa et, karos Sus oko o Proselit oko,

verses.name: Acts 2:11
verses.text: Men Kreta o men Arapien, iaduen kitail kin rong kin irail udan ngil atail ar katitiki manaman en Kot akan?

verses.name: Acts 2:12
verses.text: Irail karos ari pingidar o ponepondar, indada nan pung arail: Dakot met?

verses.name: Acts 2:13
verses.text: Akai lalaue indada: Irail dire kila wain kap.

verses.name: Acts 2:14
verses.text: A Petrus iangaki ekamen oko ap kotida, kapitie laudeda masani ong irail: Ol en Iudäa kan o komail karos, me kauson Ierusalem, komail en asa duen met, o komail rong mas ai padak!

verses.name: Acts 2:15
verses.text: Pwe mepukat kaidin sakaular, duen omail kiki ong, pwe apton auer kasilu en ran wet;

verses.name: Acts 2:16
verses.text: Pwe iei mepukat, me lolok ren saukop Ioel:

verses.name: Acts 2:17
verses.text: Kot kotin masanier: Ieteten me pan wiaui ni imwilan ran akan: I pan kamoredi Ngen i pon uduk karos. Noumail ol o li akan ap pan deideikop, o noumail manakap akan pan kilekilang kaudial akan, o noumail di ma kan pan auramenda;

verses.name: Acts 2:18
verses.text: A ni ran oko I pil pan kamoredi Ngen i pon ai ladu o lidu kan, rap pan deideikop.

verses.name: Acts 2:19
verses.text: O I pan kapwareda manaman akai nanlang pali poa, o kilel akai nin sappa pali pa: Nta, o kisiniai, o adiniai;

verses.name: Acts 2:20
verses.text: A katipin pan wukila rotorotala, a saunipong pan wiala nta mon ran lapalap o lingan en Kaun o pan pwarado.

verses.name: Acts 2:21
verses.text: O a pan wiaui ma meamen likwir ong mar en Kaun o, a pan dorela.

verses.name: Acts 2:22
verses.text: Ari ol en Israel, komail rong kasoi pot et: Iesus men Nasaret Ol amen, me Kot kotin kilele kidar nan pung omail dodok kelail akan o manaman akan, o kilel akan, me Kot kotin wiaki i nan pung omail, duen me komail pein asa;

verses.name: Acts 2:23
verses.text: I lao pangalar duen kupur en Kot erpit, komail ap saikikidi pa en me sapung kan, ap pasuredi ong ni lopu o kamatalar.

verses.name: Acts 2:24
verses.text: I me Kot kotin kaiasadar, ni a kotin lapwada sal en a matala, pwe a sota kak ong, en kolekol i.

verses.name: Acts 2:25
verses.text: Pwe Dawid masanier duen i: I ngingar Kaun o potopot mo i; pwe a kotikot ni pali maun i, pwe i ender mokid.

verses.name: Acts 2:26
verses.text: I me mongiong i peren kida, o lo i popoleki; pil uduk ai pan kamoledi ni kaporopor.

verses.name: Acts 2:27
verses.text: Pwe re sota pan kotin likidmaliela ngen i nan wasan mela pil sota kotin mueid ong, me sapwilim ar Saraui o pan mor pasang.

verses.name: Acts 2:28
verses.text: Re kotin kasansale ong ia er al en maur akan; re pan kotin kadir kin ia la popol mon silang ar.

verses.name: Acts 2:29
verses.text: Ri ai kan mueid ong ia, en aima padaki ong komail duen sam atail Dawid, me pil matalar o saredier, o sapwilim a sousou mi re atail lao lel ran wet.

verses.name: Acts 2:30
verses.text: A saukop amen, ap mangi, me Kot kotin kaula inauki ong i, me kisan wa men pan kaipokedi pon mol a.

verses.name: Acts 2:31
verses.text: Ari, ni a mamangi duen en Iesus a iasada, ap kotin masani, me a sota likidmalielar nan wasan mela, o pil uduk a sota mor pasang.

verses.name: Acts 2:32
verses.text: I Iesus, me Kot kotin kaiasadar, kit karos saunkadede en mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 2:33
verses.text: A lao sapwilekidar pali maun en Kot, a kotin aleer sang ren Sam, en kapwaiada inau duen Ngen saraui, ap kotin kamoredi, me komail kin udial o rongerong.

verses.name: Acts 2:34
verses.text: Pwe kaidin Dawid, me kotidala nanlang kan, a pein i kotin masani: Kaun o kotin masani ong ai Kaun: Mondi ni pali maun i!

verses.name: Acts 2:35
verses.text: I lao wiaki om imwintiti utipan nä om akan.

verses.name: Acts 2:36
verses.text: Ari, men Israel karos en asa melel, me Kot kotin kasapwilada i, en Kaun o Kristus i Iesus me komail kalopuelar.

verses.name: Acts 2:37
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, ap lel ong nan mongiong arail, re ap indai ong Petrus o wanporon tei kan: Ri at oko, da me sen wiada?

verses.name: Acts 2:38
verses.text: Petrus ap masani ong irail: Komail kalula, o amen amen en paptais ong ni mar en Iesus Kristus, pwe dip omail akan en lapwada. A komail pan tungole Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 2:39
verses.text: Pwe nan inau wet ong komail o noumail seri kan, o ong irail karos men ilawei, me Kaun, atail Kot, pan kotin molipe.

verses.name: Acts 2:40
verses.text: O pil song en masan toto, me a kadede ong irail, o panaui kin irail, masani: Komail en dorela pein komail sang nan di sued wet!

verses.name: Acts 2:41
verses.text: Irail me duki ong a masan ap paptaisela; ari, ni ran o aramas impan silekid me saulangalar.

verses.name: Acts 2:42
verses.text: Irail dadaurata padak en wanporon akan, o ar minimin pena, o kamadip saraui, o kapakap akan.

verses.name: Acts 2:43
verses.text: Lomwi ap kipadi aramas karos o manaman o kilel akan toto wiauier ren wanporon akan.

verses.name: Acts 2:44
verses.text: O karos me posonla, kin pokopokon o aneki pena kapwa takis.

verses.name: Acts 2:45
verses.text: O netikila ar kapwa kan o nene ong irail karos, duen ar samama amen amen.

verses.name: Acts 2:46
verses.text: Irail ari kaukaule wia minimin eu nan im en kaudok o, o pilitiki pena prot nan im ar akan, o re mangamanga ni popol, o lolepot pena,

verses.name: Acts 2:47
verses.text: Kapikapinga Kot o konekon ren aramas karos. A Kaun o kotiki ong momodisou, me dorela kan ni ran karos.<div eID="gen2706" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.2"/>

verses.name: Acts 3:1
verses.text: A PETRUS o Ioanes wiaki eu kotidalang nan im en kaudok ni auer en kapakap, auer kaduau.

verses.name: Acts 3:2
verses.text: A ol amen me tikida nä a dangidang, me kin wisikedo pwiledi liman wanim en im en kaudok, me ad a lingan, ni ran karos, pwen wia poekipoeki ren me kin kolong ong nan im en kaudok.

verses.name: Acts 3:3
verses.text: A lao kilanger Petrus i Ioanes, ni ara pan kotilong ong nan im en kaudok, ap poeki, pwen ale meakot.

verses.name: Acts 3:4
verses.text: A Petrus i Ioanes masani i, ap masani ong: Saradang kit!

verses.name: Acts 3:5
verses.text: I ari saradang ira, kasikasiki, me a pan tungole meakot re ’ra.

verses.name: Acts 3:6
verses.text: Petrus ap kotin masani: Sota ai silper de kold, a meakot mi re i, me i pan ki ong uk: Ukida mar en Iesus Kristus en Nasaret o alu!

verses.name: Acts 3:7
verses.text: I ari koledi pa a maun o kauada i, a nä a o tikil en nä ap madang kelailadar.

verses.name: Acts 3:8
verses.text: Ap lusada o alu iang ira lang nan im en kaudok, masimasiok sili, kapikapinga Kot.

verses.name: Acts 3:9
verses.text: O aramas karos kilang a alialu sili o kapikapinga Kot.

verses.name: Acts 3:10
verses.text: A irail asa, me i, me kin poekipoeki liman wanim lingan en im en kaudok, irail pingkidar o poneponeki duen me wiaui ong i er.

verses.name: Acts 3:11
verses.text: A ni a iang Petrus, o Ioanes, aramas karos puriamuiki, ap tang penang irail nan palank, me ad a palank en Salomo.

verses.name: Acts 3:12
verses.text: Petrus lao masani mepukat, ap kotin masani ong pokon o: Ol en Israel, da me komail puriamui kila met? De da me komail kilekilang kin kit, likamata kit me kakelada i ni pein at kel de lelapok?

verses.name: Acts 3:13
verses.text: Kot en Apraam, o Isaak, o Iakop, Kot en sam atail akan kalinganada sapwilim a ladu Iesus, me komail pangala o likidmaliela ren Pilatus ni a kileledier, me a pan lapwada i.

verses.name: Acts 3:14
verses.text: A komail likidmaliela me Saraui o, o me Pung, ap poeki lolap amen, en lapwa dong komail.

verses.name: Acts 3:15
verses.text: A komail kamatalar tapin maur, me Kot kotin kaiasadar sang ren me melar akan, kit kin saunkadede en mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 3:16
verses.text: Aki poson mar a, mar a ap kakelada men et, me komail kin kilang o asa, o a poson kare ong i kelail melel wet mo omail karos.

verses.name: Acts 3:17
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, i asaer, me omail sasa, me komail wiaki met, pil dueta omail saumas akan.

verses.name: Acts 3:18
verses.text: A ni mepukat Kot kotin kapwaiadar, me a kotin masanier ren saukop akan karos, me Kristus pan kalokolok.

verses.name: Acts 3:19
verses.text: Komail ari kalula o wukila, pwe dip omail akan en soredi sang, pwe muein kamaur en pwaida sang wasailen Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 3:20
verses.text: A lao kotin poronedo, me loki ong komail er: Iesus Kristus,

verses.name: Acts 3:21
verses.text: Me pan kotikot nanlang lao lel ansau, me meakaros pan pungala, duen me Kot kotin masanier ren sapwilim a saukop saraui kan sang mas kokodo.

verses.name: Acts 3:22
verses.text: Pwe pil Moses kotin masanier: Kaun omail Kot pan kaipwi ong komail Saukop amen, ipwin ri omail akan dueta ngai, i me komail en ronga sang meakaros, me a pan kotin masani ong komail.

verses.name: Acts 3:23
verses.text: A iet me pan wiaui: Aramas karos, me kang peiki ong saukop o, pan kasapokela sang ren aramas.

verses.name: Acts 3:24
verses.text: A saukop karos irerokedo sang Samuel, karos me padapadak pil kokoper duen ran pukat.

verses.name: Acts 3:25
verses.text: Komail sapwilim en saukop akan o en inau, me Kot kotin wiai ong sam atail akan ni a kotin masani ong Apraam: Kainok karos nan sappa pan paieki amen kadaudok om.

verses.name: Acts 3:26
verses.text: Kot kotin porone dong komail sapwilim a ladu mas ni a kotin molipe i; pwen kapaia kida komail, en kawuki sang komail kuros dip omail akan.<div eID="gen2707" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.3"/>

verses.name: Acts 4:1
verses.text: A NI ara padapadaki ong aramas akan, samero kan, o saumas en im en kaudok, o sadusär akai, ap pokon dong ira;

verses.name: Acts 4:2
verses.text: Pwe re makaraki ara kawewe ong aramas akan o ar padapadaki, me Iesus pan kotin kaiasada me melar akan.

verses.name: Acts 4:3
verses.text: Irail ap kol ira di o kila ira nan imateng lao manda, pwe a wasa pongier.

verses.name: Acts 4:4
verses.text: A me toto, me iang rongadar masan o, posonlar; ari, toto en ol akan impan limekid.

verses.name: Acts 4:5
verses.text: A mandan ran o saumas, o monsap, o saunkawewe kan pokon pene nan Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 4:6
verses.text: A samero lapalap Anas, o Kaipas, o Ioanes, o Aleksander, o karos, me kisan kainok en samero lapalap,

verses.name: Acts 4:7
verses.text: Irail pwiliki ira di nan pung arail, ap kainoma re ’ra: Ni kel en is, de ni mar en is, me komail wiaki met?

verses.name: Acts 4:8
verses.text: Petrus me dir en Ngen saraui ap masani ong irail: Maing ko, saumas en wei o monsap en Israel komail,

verses.name: Acts 4:9
verses.text: Ma se pan pakadeikada, o komail kainoma re at ran wet, pweki dok mau ong aramas somau men, o da me a kelaile kida,

verses.name: Acts 4:10
verses.text: Komail o aramas en Israel karos en mangi, me mar en Iesus Kristus men Nasaret, me komail kalopuelar, me Kot kotin kaiasadar sang ren me melar akan, nan i eta, me men et uki o kelail kidar.

verses.name: Acts 4:11
verses.text: I takai o, me lokidokila ren komail sause kan, me id wiala takai en pukakaim.

verses.name: Acts 4:12
verses.text: O sota amen, me maur mi re a, pwe pil sota eu mar pan lang, me pakadara dong aramas, me kitail pan maur kida.

verses.name: Acts 4:13
verses.text: A ni ar kilekilanger en Petrus i Ioanes ara pereperen o so masak, rap puriamui kila, pwe re asaer, me ira aramas mal me sota iang skul, o sota non audaud, rap asaer, me ira ianger Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:14
verses.text: A ni ar kilanger aramas o, me kelailadar, uda imp ara, rap sasalar lokaia.

verses.name: Acts 4:15
verses.text: Irail lao kadar ira sang nan kapung, re ap kapukapung pena indada:

verses.name: Acts 4:16
verses.text: Da me kitail en wiai ong aramas pukat, pwe toun Ierusalem asaer, me ira wiadar kilel sansal eu, a kitail sota kak kalikama.

verses.name: Acts 4:17
verses.text: A pwe ede lolok sili nan pung en aramas akan, kitail en padik inapwi ira di, me ira de padaki ong aramas amen ni mar wet.

verses.name: Acts 4:18
verses.text: Irail lao eker ira do re ap inapwiedi me ira der pan padaki de kawewe ni mar en Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:19
verses.text: A Petrus o Ioanes sapeng masani ong irail: Iaduen, me pung pan kupur en Kot, sen pwili sang komail mon Kot? Pein komail kasaui!

verses.name: Acts 4:20
verses.text: Pwe se so kak so katitiki, me se kilanger o rongadar.

verses.name: Acts 4:21
verses.text: Irail ap kainapwi ira di kalaudela, re ap kadar ira la, pwe sota me re diaradar, me ira en kamekameki, pweki aramas akan, pwe karos, kapinga Kot, duen me wiauier.

verses.name: Acts 4:22
verses.text: Pwe aramas o, me manaman en kakelada wiaui ong, daulier saunpar paeisok.

verses.name: Acts 4:23
verses.text: Ira lao lapwadar, ap kola ren iang ara ko, kaireki meakan, me samero lapalap o saumas akan katiti ong ira.

verses.name: Acts 4:24
verses.text: A irail lao rongadar, rap wiaki eu potoan ong Kot: Maing ir me Kot, me kotin kapikadar lang o sappa, o madau o audepa ’ra karos.

verses.name: Acts 4:25
verses.text: Ir me kotin masani ren Dawid, sapwilim ar ladu: Da me men liki kan lingarangaraki, o da me wei kan lamelameki me mal akan?

verses.name: Acts 4:26
verses.text: O nanmarki en sappa kan kangudier o saumas akan pokon pena, en palian Kaun o sapwilim a Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 4:27
verses.text: Pwe melel nan kanim wet irail karos pokon penaer, iet akan: Erodes, o Pontius Pilatus, iangaki men liki kan, o men Israel akan pwen palian sapwilim ar ladu saraui Iesus, me re kotin keiedier,

verses.name: Acts 4:28
verses.text: Pwen kapwaiada meakan, me lim ar o kupur ar kileledier, en wiaui.

verses.name: Acts 4:29
verses.text: Ari Maing, re kotin mangi arail lingarangar, kotiki ong sapwilim ar ladu kan, en kaloki ar masan ni peren.

verses.name: Acts 4:30
verses.text: O kotin kapa wei lim ar, pwen kakelada, o kilel, o manaman akan en wiauiki mar en sapwilim ar ladu saraui Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 4:31
verses.text: Ar kapakap apton nikier, wasa me re kot pena ia, ap mokimokid. Irail karos ap direkila Ngen saraui, ap padapadaki masan en Kot ni pereperen.

verses.name: Acts 4:32
verses.text: A mongiong o ngen en ir karos me posonlar, kin lamalam ta pot, o sota me indada duen ar kapwa: Ai met, pwe re aneki pena kapwa takis.

verses.name: Acts 4:33
verses.text: A wanporon akan me kelail ni arail kadede me Kaun Iesus kotin iasadar, a mak lapalap iang irail karos.

verses.name: Acts 4:34
verses.text: O solar amen irail, me so a tungol, pwe karos, me sap de im arail mia, ap netikilar o wado pwain en me netilar akan.

verses.name: Acts 4:35
verses.text: O pwilikidi ni aluwilu en wanporon akan, o nek ong amen amen duen ar samama.

verses.name: Acts 4:36
verses.text: A Ioses me wanporon akan ki ong mar a Parnapas, (iet wewe: Nain kapol), kadaudok en Lewi amen, men Sipern,

verses.name: Acts 4:37
verses.text: Me sap we mia, ap netikilar o wado pwain a, pwilikidi ni aluwilu en wanporon akan.<div eID="gen2708" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.4"/>

verses.name: Acts 5:1
verses.text: A OL amen ad a Ananias o a paud Sapira netikila sap eu,

verses.name: Acts 5:2
verses.text: Ap okisang kisan pwain a, me a paud iang asa, o wado lu en moni, pwilikidi ni aluwilu en wanporon akan.

verses.name: Acts 5:3
verses.text: A Petrus masani: Ananias menda Satan kadirela mongiong om, pwen likam ong Ngen saraui o okisang kisan pwain en sap o?

verses.name: Acts 5:4
verses.text: Kaidin udan om, ma a sota pan netila? O kaidin insen om ni a netilar? A menda koe inauki ong nan pein mongiong om mepukat? Kaidin aramas, me koe likam ong, pwe ong Kot.

verses.name: Acts 5:5
verses.text: Ananias lao rongadar masan pukat, ap pupedi mela. A karos, me rongerong mepukat, masakadar kaualap.

verses.name: Acts 5:6
verses.text: A manakap oko ap udar, kidim pena i, wala sang, sarepedier.

verses.name: Acts 5:7
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin auer silu a paud pwarado, a sota asa, me wiauier.

verses.name: Acts 5:8
verses.text: Petrus ap masani ong i: Katitiki ong ia, ma koma netikila sap o ni pwain wet? A sapeng: Ei i eta.

verses.name: Acts 5:9
verses.text: Petrus ap masani ong i: Menda koma inauki pena, en kasongesong Ngen en Kaun o? Kilang, nä en me sarepedier om paud mier mon wanim o, o re pan wa uk ala.

verses.name: Acts 5:10
verses.text: I ap madang pupedi ni aluwilu a mela. A manakap oko lao pedelong ong, rap kilangada, me a melar, re ap wala sang o sarepedi i impan a paud.

verses.name: Acts 5:11
verses.text: Lomui kaualap kipadi momodisou karos, o karos me rongerong mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 5:12
verses.text: A kilel o manaman akan toto wiauiki lim en wanporon akan nan pung en aramas akan. Irail karos kot pena nan palank en Salomo ni lamalam ta pot.

verses.name: Acts 5:13
verses.text: A sota amen sang ren men liki kan kak pat ong irail, pwe karos waune kin irail.

verses.name: Acts 5:14
verses.text: A me toto, me posonlar wuki ong Kaun o irail me totoia, ol o li akan.

verses.name: Acts 5:15
verses.text: Irail wala me somau kan pon al akan, pwiliki irail edi pon pet o ro akan, pwe mot en Petrus en lel ong amen irail, a lau kotido.

verses.name: Acts 5:16
verses.text: A toun kanim akan, me mi impa, pwara dong Ierusalem, wado me somau o me kalokolokki ngen saut akai, irail karos ap kelailadar.

verses.name: Acts 5:17
verses.text: A samero lapalap o karos me iang i, me pwin en sadusär, ap uda makar kida kaualap,

verses.name: Acts 5:18
verses.text: Koledi wanporon akan o ki irail la nan imateng.

verses.name: Acts 5:19
verses.text: A tounlang en Kaun o kotin ritingada wanim en imateng oko ni pong, o kotin kalua irail la liki masani:

verses.name: Acts 5:20
verses.text: Komail kola sansal mon aramas, padaki ong irail nan im en kaudok duen masan kan karos en maur wet.

verses.name: Acts 5:21
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, rap sangkonai ong nan im en kaudok o kaweweda. A samero lapalap o iang oko ap kodo, eker pena kapung, o saumas en men Israel akan karos, o ilakwei ong imateng o, pwe irail en wisikedo.

verses.name: Acts 5:22
verses.text: A ladu kan lao pwarado, rap diaradar, me re solar mi nan imateng o, re ap purodo katitiki,

verses.name: Acts 5:23
verses.text: Indada: Se diaradar imateng a ritidier mau, o pwin silepa ar uda mon wanim oko, a se lao ritingadar, sota amen me se diar lole.

verses.name: Acts 5:24
verses.text: A kapin en im en kaudok, o samero lapalap akan lao rongada duen lokaia pukat, re ap ponepon kidar o sota asa, da imwin mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 5:25
verses.text: Amen ap pwarado kaire kin irail: Kilang, ol oko, me komail kilang nan imateng, u nan im en kaudok, padapadaki ong aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 5:26
verses.text: Kapin iangaki ladu kai ap koieila uk irail do, a re kadek ong irail, pwe re masak aramas akan, pwe re de kate irail.

verses.name: Acts 5:27
verses.text: Irail wa ir do, ap kidi ong mon kapung o, a samero lapalap idok re ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 5:28
verses.text: Masani: Kit so inapwi komail edi kaualap, me komail ender kawewe ni mar wet? A kilang, komail kadire kila Ierusalem omail lamalam o, o komail kin men kapokon ong kit ntan aramas men et.

verses.name: Acts 5:29
verses.text: Petrus o wanporon akan ap sapeng masani: Kitail en oke Kot mon aramas!

verses.name: Acts 5:30
verses.text: Kot en sam atail akan kaiasadar Iesus, me komail kamatalar, pwe komail pasuredier i ong ni lopu eu.

verses.name: Acts 5:31
verses.text: Nan i me Kot kotin kasapwila kidar pali maun a, pwen Kaun o Saunkamaur, pwen kotiki ong men Israel, en kalula o lapwa pan dip akan.

verses.name: Acts 5:32
verses.text: A kit me sapwilim a saunkadede ni mepukat, pil Ngen saraui me Kot kotiki onger ren me peiki ong i.

verses.name: Acts 5:33
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, re ap lingarangar kaualap o kapikapiki pena, en kame ir ala.

verses.name: Acts 5:34
verses.text: Amen ap uda nan kapung o, Parisär amen ad a Kamaliel, saunkawewe amen, me masamas ren aramas karos, me masani, ren kila liki ol oko ansau kis.

verses.name: Acts 5:35
verses.text: A masani ong irail: Ol en Israel komail, kalaka aramas pukat, me komail pan wia!

verses.name: Acts 5:36
verses.text: Pwe ni ran tei ko Teudas udar ponmasoki, me a me lapalap, a ol impan papuki iangala i, I ari kamelar o karos, me peiki ong i, muei pasang o soredier.

verses.name: Acts 5:37
verses.text: A murin ol o Iudas en Kaliläa ap uda ni ansaun wadawad o kaweid sapung aramas toto, ren tuki ong i. Ari, a pil melar o karos, me iang i, muei pasanger.

verses.name: Acts 5:38
verses.text: I ap panaui komail, en sopwei sang aramas pukat, o der doke irail, pwe ma lamalam o wiawia en me ren aramas, a pan soredi,

verses.name: Acts 5:39
verses.text: A ma ren Kot, komail sota kak kawe ir ala, pwe komail de kadiarokada, me kin palian Kot.

verses.name: Acts 5:40
verses.text: Irail ari peiki ong i. Re lao ekeredo wanporon akan o woki irail, re ap inapwiedi, ren der padak ni mar en Iesus, o kadar ir ala.

verses.name: Acts 5:41
verses.text: Irail ari koiei sang ni momod en kadeik o, o peren kida, me re war ong kamekameki mar a.

verses.name: Acts 5:42
verses.text: A ran karos re sota dukedi sang arail kawewe nan im en kaudok o nan deu arail akan, o re padapadaki me Iesus me Kristus.<div eID="gen2709" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.5"/>

verses.name: Acts 6:1
verses.text: A TOUNPADAK kan lao totolar ni ran pukat men Krik kai ap lipaned ong men Ipru, aki sota me apwali ar li odi kan ni ar dodok en ran akan.

verses.name: Acts 6:2
verses.text: Ekriamen oko ap molipe pena tounpadak kan masani: A sota mau ong, sen muei sang masan en Kot, pwen papa ni tepel.

verses.name: Acts 6:3
verses.text: Ari ri (at) akan, rapaki sang nan pung omail ol isimen, me kalok mau, me dir en Ngen (saraui) o lolekong, me sen kasapwiladang dok wet!

verses.name: Acts 6:4
verses.text: A kit pan apapwalita kapakap o dodok pan masan o.

verses.name: Acts 6:5
verses.text: Pokon o ari peren kida kaparok pot et. Re ap piladar Stepanus, ol amen, me dir en poson o Ngen saraui, pil Pilipus, o Prokorus, o Nikanor, o Timon, o Parmenas, o Nikolaus, proselite sang Antiokien amen.

verses.name: Acts 6:6
verses.text: Re kidang irail mon wanporon akan. Re lao kapakaper ap kidang po ’rail lim ar.

verses.name: Acts 6:7
verses.text: Masan en Kot ari pwaida kaualap, o tounpadak kan madang totolar nan Ierusalem, o samero toto pil iang lamalam o.

verses.name: Acts 6:8
verses.text: A Stepanus, me dir en poson o kelail, ap wiadar manaman o kilel laud kai nan pung en aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 6:9
verses.text: A akai me udar, me kisan sinakoke en Liperti o men Kirene, o men Aleksandrien, o men Silisia, o Asien akamai ong Stepanus.

verses.name: Acts 6:10
verses.text: A re sota kak palian en Stepanus a kupurokong o Ngen o, me audeda i.

verses.name: Acts 6:11
verses.text: Irail ari pwain ong ol akai, pwen katiti: Se ronger, me a lalaue moses o Kot.

verses.name: Acts 6:12
verses.text: Irail pil kamakarada aramas, o saumas akai, o saunkawewe, re ap saikidi i o koledi, re ap wa dong i mod en kadeik o,

verses.name: Acts 6:13
verses.text: O kapwareda saunkadede likam akai, me katitiki: Aramas men et sota kin dukedi sang a lalaue wasa saraui et o kapung.

verses.name: Acts 6:14
verses.text: Pwe se ronger, me a katitiki, me Iesus en Nasaret pan kawela wasa et o kawilianla lamalam kan, me Moses kotiki ong kitail er.

verses.name: Acts 6:15
verses.text: A karos, me iang mod ong kapung o, kangkakil i, kasauiada, me silang a dueta silang en tounlang amen.<div eID="gen2710" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.6"/>

verses.name: Acts 7:1
verses.text: SAMERO lapalap ap masani: Melel mepukat?

verses.name: Acts 7:2
verses.text: A masani: Ri ai o sam ai kan, komail rong, Kot en lingan kotin pwara dong sam atail Apraam ni a kotikot Mesopotamien, ni a saikenta kotikot Aran,

verses.name: Acts 7:3
verses.text: O kotin masani ong i: Kowei sang nan sap om o sang ren sau om, ko wong eu sap, me I pan kasale ong uk!

verses.name: Acts 7:4
verses.text: I ap lipa sang nan sap en Kaltäa o kotikot Aran. Sam a lao matalar, a kotin kalua wong i sap wet, wasa komail kotikot ansau wet.

verses.name: Acts 7:5
verses.text: I ari sota kotin mueid ong i, en sapaneki sap o, sota wasa, me laude ong pat en nä eu, ap kotin inauki ong i, ni ansau saikenta sapwilim a seri, me a pan kotiki ong i o kadaudok a, en sapaneki.

verses.name: Acts 7:6
verses.text: A iet duen me Kot kotin masani: Kadaudok a pan kakairu nan sap en men wai, o re pan lidula, o kanaudokala saunpar papuki.

verses.name: Acts 7:7
verses.text: O Kot kotin masani: I pan kadeikada toun wei o, me re kin liduliduwi. A murin met re pan lipa sang sap o, ap kaudok ong ia sap wet.

verses.name: Acts 7:8
verses.text: I ari kotiki ong irail inau en sirkomsais. A ap wiadar Isaak o sirkomsais i ni ran kawalu, a Isaak wiadar Iakop, a Iakop sam atail ekriamen oko.

verses.name: Acts 7:9
verses.text: A sam atail oko peirinki Iosep ap netikilang i Äkipten. A Kot me kotin apwali i,

verses.name: Acts 7:10
verses.text: O kotin dorela i sang ni a apwal akan karos, o kotiki ong i konekon ong kupurokong mon Parao, nanmarki en Äkipten. I ap kasapwilada i, en kaun en Äkipten o a dipisou karos.

verses.name: Acts 7:11
verses.text: Muein lek ap kipadi sap en Äkipten karos o Kanaan; i ansau o me apwal melel, o sam atail akan sota diaradar sak ar kisin sak.

verses.name: Acts 7:12
verses.text: A Iakop lao mangi, me manga mi Äkipten, ap kotin poronelar mas sam atail akan.

verses.name: Acts 7:13
verses.text: A lao kariapak Iosep ap diarokadar ren ri a ol akan, o sau en Iosep sansaledo ren Parao.

verses.name: Acts 7:14
verses.text: Iosep ap ilake dong sam a Iakop, pwen kotilang re a o sau i kan karos, irail me isiakan limen.

verses.name: Acts 7:15
verses.text: Iakop ap kotidilang Äkipten o matalar, i o sam atail akan.

verses.name: Acts 7:16
verses.text: Irail ari wisikelang Sikem o saredier nan sousou o, me Apraam netiekida moni kai sang ren nain Emor oko, sam en Sikem.

verses.name: Acts 7:17
verses.text: A ansau, me inau en Kot ong Apraam pan pwaida, lao korendor, men Israel ap kaparapar o totolar nan Äkipten.

verses.name: Acts 7:18
verses.text: A lao lel amen nanmarki kaunda Äkipten, me sasa Iosep,

verses.name: Acts 7:19
verses.text: I me widiwidinga kainok atail oko, o wia sued ong sam (atail) akan, pwe ren kasela nairail kisin seri kan, pwe re de memaurata.

verses.name: Acts 7:20
verses.text: I ansau me Moses ipwidier, me seri kaselel amen, ap apapwalieta nan im en sam a saunipong silu.

verses.name: Acts 7:21
verses.text: A lao lokidokilar, sapwilim en Parao seripein ap dorela i o kakairada dueta udan na.

verses.name: Acts 7:22
verses.text: Moses ari padakeda ni song en lolekong en men Äkipten karos; a i me manaman ni a masan o wiawia kan.

verses.name: Acts 7:23
verses.text: A lao saunpar paeisok dauer poa, ap lamedar, en tu ong ri a ol akan men Israel.

verses.name: Acts 7:24
verses.text: A lao masani amen, me kalokolok mal, ap sauasa i o depuk ong, me kaloke mal, ap kotin kamelar ol en Äkipten.

verses.name: Acts 7:25
verses.text: Pwe a kupura, me ri a ol akan pan dedeki, me Kot pan kotin kapiti kin ir sang lim a; a re sota dedeki,

verses.name: Acts 7:26
verses.text: A mandan ran o a kotila re ’rail ni ar akamai pena, ap men kotin kapol ira la, masani: Koma pirien eu, menda koma wia sapung nan pung oma?

verses.name: Acts 7:27
verses.text: A me wiada sapung ong men imp a o sikon wei i, inda: Is me kasapwil uk adar, pwen at saumas o saunkapung?

verses.name: Acts 7:28
verses.text: Koe pan kame ia la dueta koe kamela men Äkipten aio?

verses.name: Acts 7:29
verses.text: Moses ap tangki sang lokaia pot et o kakairu sili nan sap en Midian eu, wasa a kanaitikieda ol riamen.

verses.name: Acts 7:30
verses.text: Kadekadeo lao par paeisok dauer poa, tounlang amen ap pwara dong i ni nana Sinai nin tuka teketek umpumpul pot.

verses.name: Acts 7:31
verses.text: Moses lao masani, ap kotin puriamuiki kasansal o. A ni a koti ong, pwen masani, kapitie en Kaun o ap pei dong i:

verses.name: Acts 7:32
verses.text: Ngai Kot en sam om akan, Kot en Apraam, o Isaak, o Iakop. Moses ap kotin rerereda o masak udial i.

verses.name: Acts 7:33
verses.text: Kaun o ap kotin masani ong i: Ki sang sut ni nä om akan, pwe wasa koe u ia me saraui!

verses.name: Acts 7:34
verses.text: I kilanger kankangeranger en nai aramas akan, o I ronger ar sangesang, ap kodi dong kamaio wei ir ala. Ari kodo, I pan kadar uk alang Äkipten!

verses.name: Acts 7:35
verses.text: I Moses, me irail mamaleki ni ar indinda: Is me kasapwil uk ada, pwen at saumas o saunkapung? I me Kot kotin poronela, en saumas o saunkamaur ki lim en tounlang o, me kotin pwara dong i nan tuka teketek.

verses.name: Acts 7:36
verses.text: Iei i, me kalua ir sang o wiadar manaman o kilel akan nan sap Äkipten, o nan sed waitata, o nan sap tan saunpar paeisok.

verses.name: Acts 7:37
verses.text: I Moses, me masani ong men Israel: Kot pan kotiki ong komail saukop amen sang nan ipwin ri omail ol akan dueta ngai, i me komail en peiki ong!

verses.name: Acts 7:38
verses.text: Iei i, me mi nan momodisou nan sap tan ren tounlang o, me kotin mamasani ong i pon nana Sinai, o me kotin ieiang sam atail akan me kotin aleer masan en kamaur, pwen use dong kit.

verses.name: Acts 7:39
verses.text: Me sam atail akan kang peiki ong, ap siken wei sang irail i, o nan mongiong arail re men sapalang Äkipten,

verses.name: Acts 7:40
verses.text: Potoan ong Aron: Wiai ong kit at kot akan, me pan tiong mo at, pwe se sasa, da me wiaui ong Moses, me kalua kit sang nan Äkipten!

verses.name: Acts 7:41
verses.text: Irail ari wiadar dikedik en kaupul amen ni ran oko, o mairong ong kilel en ani mal o, o perenki, wiawia kan en pa arail.

verses.name: Acts 7:42
verses.text: Kot ap kotin saupei sang irail o kotin mueid ong irail ren kaudok ong usu pan lang akan duen a intingidier nan puk en saukop akan: Iaduen komail men Israel, komail mairongki ong ia man akan nan sap tan ni par paeisok?

verses.name: Acts 7:43
verses.text: Melel komail waroki ong mol ong en Molok, o usu en omail kot Rempan, dikedik kai, me komail wiadar, pwen pongi; a I pan kasapoke komail la palila sang Papilon.

verses.name: Acts 7:44
verses.text: Mol en kadede mi ren sam atail akan nan sap tan duen masan en i, me kotin mamasani ong Moses, me ren wiada duen kilel o, me a kotin udialer.

verses.name: Acts 7:45
verses.text: Me sam atail akan pil aleer, ap iang Iosua wala ni ar sapaneki sap en men liki kan me Kot kotin koko wei mon silang en sam atail akan lao lel muein Dawid.

verses.name: Acts 7:46
verses.text: Me konekon ren Kot o kotin anane kauadang Kot en Iakop mol eu.

verses.name: Acts 7:47
verses.text: A Salomo me kotin kauada tanpas eu.

verses.name: Acts 7:48
verses.text: A Wasa lapalap sota kin kotikot nan mol, me pa en aramas wiadar duen saukop o kin katitiki:

verses.name: Acts 7:49
verses.text: Nanlang deu i, o sappa utipa i, me Kaun o kotin masani. A im da, me komail men kauadang ia, de ia wasa, I en kamol ia?

verses.name: Acts 7:50
verses.text: Kaidin pa i, me wiadar mepukat karos?

verses.name: Acts 7:51
verses.text: Komail me katiwo o so sirkomsais nan mongiong o salong omail, komail kin kaokaoe Ngen saraui ansau karos, komail kin dueta sam omail akan.

verses.name: Acts 7:52
verses.text: Is ren saukop akan me sam omail akan sota kaloke? O re kamata ir ala, me kopador Pung men et, me komail pangalar o kamatalar.

verses.name: Acts 7:53
verses.text: Komail me aleer kapung ren tounlang kan, ap sota kapwaiada.

verses.name: Acts 7:54
verses.text: Irail rongadar mepukat, ap olar nan mongiong arail o re teterok ngi ong i.

verses.name: Acts 7:55
verses.text: A Stepanus dir en Ngen saraui kangkakil nanlang o udial en Kot a lingan o Iesus a kotikot ni pali maun en Kot,

verses.name: Acts 7:56
verses.text: Ap katitiki: Kilang, i ududial nanlang kan ar ritida, o Nain aramas a kotikot ni pali maun en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 7:57
verses.text: Irail ap weriwereda o pinale salong arail o wiaki eu tanga dong i.

verses.name: Acts 7:58
verses.text: Irail lao sikenewei sang nan kanim o, rap kate i. A saunkadede kan pwilikidier ar likau ni nä en manakap amen, me ad a Saulus.

verses.name: Acts 7:59
verses.text: Irail ari kate Stepanus ni a kapakap o inda: Maing Iesus, re kotin kasamo ngen i!

verses.name: Acts 7:60
verses.text: I ari kelepuki o ngil laudeda: Maing re der kapokon ong irail dip wet. A inda met, ap mairedi o ari.<div eID="gen2711" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.7"/>

verses.name: Acts 8:1
verses.text: A SAULUS pil peren kida a kamela. A ni ran ota ansaun kamekam en momodisou en Ierusalem tapida; karos ap muei pasang nan sap en Iudäa o Samaria, wanporon akan me so.

verses.name: Acts 8:2
verses.text: A ol lelapok kai sarepedi Stepanus o maieiki i kaualap.

verses.name: Acts 8:3
verses.text: A Saulus me kamueit pasang momodisou o kuli ong im karos, wala ol o li karos, kasedi ong irail nan imateng.

verses.name: Acts 8:4
verses.text: A irail me muei pasanger, kakan sili padapadak duen masan o.

verses.name: Acts 8:5
verses.text: Pilipus ap kotilang kanim en Samaria eu o padaki ong irail duen Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 8:6
verses.text: A aramas akan wiaki eu peiki ong meakan, me Pilipus padaki ong irail. Re rongerong i o kilang kilel akan me a wiadar.

verses.name: Acts 8:7
verses.text: Pwe ngen saut keredi sang ren me toto ni ar weriwer laud. O me kokon madak o nä dangidang toto me kelailadar.

verses.name: Acts 8:8
verses.text: O peren me lapalap nan kanim o.

verses.name: Acts 8:9
verses.text: A ol amen ad a Simon, me kin wun ani mas o, kotokotaue men Samaria, me inda duen pein i, me i me lapalap.

verses.name: Acts 8:10
verses.text: A irail karos peiki ong i, me tikitik o me lapalap akan katitiki: Men et iei manaman en Kot me lapalap.

verses.name: Acts 8:11
verses.text: A re kin peiki ong i, pweki a kin kotokotaue irail sang mas kokodo.

verses.name: Acts 8:12
verses.text: A re lao kamelele Pilipus, me padaki duen rongamau en wein Kot o duen mar en Iesus Kristus, rap paptaisela, ol o li akan.

verses.name: Acts 8:13
verses.text: Simon pil iang posonlar, I lao paptaiselar, ap waroki ong Pilipus. A lao udial kilel o manaman akan, me wiauier, ap puriamuiki.

verses.name: Acts 8:14
verses.text: Wanporon akan me kotikot Ierusalem lao mangi, me Samaria iang duki ong masan en Kot, rap poronelang irail Petrus o Ioanes.

verses.name: Acts 8:15
verses.text: Ira lao kotido, ap kapakapa kin irail, pwe re en tungole Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 8:16
verses.text: Pwe a saikenta moredi ong amen irail. Re paptaiselar eta ni mar en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 8:17
verses.text: Ira ari kotiki ong po ’rail lim ar akan, irail ap aleer Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 8:18
verses.text: Simon lao kilanger, me Ngen saraui kokido en wanporon oko ara pwil po ’rail lim ar akan, ap men ki ong ira kisin moni.

verses.name: Acts 8:19
verses.text: Indada: Koma pil kotiki dong ia manaman wet, pwe ma i pan pwil pon amen pa i kat, i en ale Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 8:20
verses.text: A Petrus masani ong i: Noum moni en iang uk lokidokila! Pweki om kiki ong, me mana en Kot kokido moni.

verses.name: Acts 8:21
verses.text: Nan sota pwais om de om tungol ni dodok wet, pwe mongiong om sota inen mon Kot.

verses.name: Acts 8:22
verses.text: Ari, kalukila om sued wet, o poeki ren Kaun o, ma a sota pan kotin makeki lamelam sued nan mongiong om.

verses.name: Acts 8:23
verses.text: Pwe i kilanger, me koe me dir en edi katik o tengiteng ni me sapung.

verses.name: Acts 8:24
verses.text: Simon ap sapeng indada: Koma kotin kapakapa kin ia ren Kaun o, pwe mepukat, me koma masani ong ia, ender pwai dong ia.

verses.name: Acts 8:25
verses.text: A ira lao katitiki o kotikida masan en Kaun o, ap purelang Ierusalem, o padak sili rongamau nan kisin kanim en Samaria toto.

verses.name: Acts 8:26
verses.text: A tounlang en Kaun o masani ong Pilipus: Uda kola pali air pon al o, me kodi sang Ierusalem, ko ong Kasa me tan!

verses.name: Acts 8:27
verses.text: I ari uda sapalewei. A kilang, ol en Etiopia, saumas manaman en Kandase, li nanmarki en Etiopia, me kokoaki a dipisou karos, me kotido, pwen kaudok nan Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 8:28
verses.text: A ni a purela sap we, a kotikot pon dakepa o dondoropwe saukop Iesaia.

verses.name: Acts 8:29
verses.text: Ngen o ap kotin masani ong Pilipus: Kai ong o iangala dakepa!

verses.name: Acts 8:30
verses.text: Pilipus ap tanga wong i, ap rongadar a dondoropwe saukop Iesaia masani: Komui weweki, me komui doropwe?

verses.name: Acts 8:31
verses.text: I ari masani: Pala i pan asa, ma sota, me pan kawewe ong ia? I ari poeki ren Pilipus en kereda mondi re a.

verses.name: Acts 8:32
verses.text: A iet wasa nan kisin likau o me a wadoker: Duen sip amen, me pakara wei, pwen kamela, o duen sippul, me kin nenenlata pan me kote sang wun a, iduen a sota kotin dauasa pasang silang i.

verses.name: Acts 8:33
verses.text: A ni a karakarak a solar pakadeikadar. A is me pan kak kaweweda duen sau i kan? Pwe a ieias wisike sanger sappa.

verses.name: Acts 8:34
verses.text: Saumas ap sapeng Pilipus masani: I men poeki re omui, is me saukop katitiki met? Duen pein i de duen amen?

verses.name: Acts 8:35
verses.text: Pilipus ap kotiki pasang au a, padaki ong i rongamau en Iesus, tapiada nan kisin likau wet.

verses.name: Acts 8:36
verses.text: A ni ara kokowei, ira lel ong pil apot, a saumas o masani: Kilang pil o, da me karompa, me i sota paptais ki?

verses.name: Acts 8:38
verses.text: I ap masani dakepa en udi. Ira karos ap kodi ong pil o, Pilipus o saumas o; i ari paptais i.

verses.name: Acts 8:39
verses.text: Ira lao kodado sang nan pil o, Ngen en Kaun o ap pokada sang Pilipus. Saumas o ap solar kilang i. I ari daulul kokowei popol.

verses.name: Acts 8:40
verses.text: Pilipus ap diarokadar Asdod; a dadaulular, padak sili rongamau nan kanim karos lao a lele dong Säsarea.<div eID="gen2712" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.8"/>

verses.name: Acts 9:1
verses.text: A SAULUS dadaurata a lingarangaraki tounpadak en Kaun akan, ap pan kame ir ala, o kola ren samero lapalap o,

verses.name: Acts 9:2
verses.text: Poeki re a kisin likau ong sinakoke en Damaskus akan, pwe ma a pan diar meamen, me iangala lamalam, ol de li i en sali irail edi o kalualang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 9:3
verses.text: A ni a sapasapal kokola koren iong Damaskus, marain eu kodido sang nanlang, sereda i.

verses.name: Acts 9:4
verses.text: Ni a pupedi nani pwel, ap rongada ngil eu, me masani ong i: Saul, Saul, da me koe kame kin ia?

verses.name: Acts 9:5
verses.text: A ap inda: Is komui Maing? A kotin masani: Ngai Iesus, me koe kin kame.

verses.name: Acts 9:6
verses.text: Paurida, kolang nan kanim en, nan a pan loki ong uk, me koe en wiada.

verses.name: Acts 9:7
verses.text: A ol oko, me iang i kokola, sapaimokid, pwe re rongadar ngil o, ap sota amen me re kilangadar.

verses.name: Acts 9:8
verses.text: Saulus paurida sang nan pwel, mas a papad eta, ap sota kilang meamen. A re kolokol pa a, kalualang i Damaskus.

verses.name: Acts 9:9
verses.text: I ari sota kilang wasa pong sili pong. A so kang de nim meakot.

verses.name: Acts 9:10
verses.text: A tounpadak amen mi Damaskus, ad a Ananias me Kaun o kotin masani ong ni kasansal eu: Ananias! I ari potoan ong: Iet ngai Maing!

verses.name: Acts 9:11
verses.text: Kaun o ap kotin masani ong i: Paurida kowei ong nani al o, me ad a Inen, ap idok nan im en Iudas amen, me mar a Saulus en Tarsus. Pwe kilang, a kapakap

verses.name: Acts 9:12
verses.text: A kilanger ol amen ni kasansal eu, me ad a Ananias, me ko dong i o pwil poa pa a kan, pwe a en kilangki wasa.

verses.name: Acts 9:13
verses.text: A Ananias potoan ong: Maing, i rongadar ren aramas toto duen ol men et, duen a kin kaokaoe sapwilim ar saraui kan, me mi Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 9:14
verses.text: O a aleer sang ren samero lapalap akan manaman, en saliedi karos, me kin likwir ong mar omui.

verses.name: Acts 9:15
verses.text: A Kaun o kotin masani ong i: U kowei, pwe iei ol o, me I piladar, en wala mar ai ren men liki o nanmarki kan o men Israel.

verses.name: Acts 9:16
verses.text: Pwe I pan kasansale ong i duen won a pan kamekameki mar ai.

verses.name: Acts 9:17
verses.text: Ananias ari kola, pedelong ong nan im o, pwil poa pa a pokon, indada: Ri (ai) Saul, Kaun o me kotin porone ia do; iei Iesus, me kotin pwara dong komui nani al o ni omui kokodo, pwe komui en kilangada wasa o dire kila Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 9:18
verses.text: A madang likamata un en mam akai, me pupedi sang ni mas a, i ari kilangadar wasa o udar paptaiselar.

verses.name: Acts 9:19
verses.text: I lao mangaer, ap kelailadar, ap mimieta ren tounpadak en Damaskus akan ran akai.

verses.name: Acts 9:20
verses.text: A madang padapadak nan sinakoke kan duen Iesus, me i sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 9:21
verses.text: A karos, me rongerong i, puriamui kila indada: Kaidin i, me kin kaokaoe ir, me kin likwir ong mar wet nan Ierusalem o kodo wasa et, pwen sali ir edi, kalua ren samero lapalap akan?

verses.name: Acts 9:22
verses.text: A Saulus me manaman kokoda o kapingada Sus oko, me kauson Damaskus ni a kawewedar, me i me Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 9:23
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin ran toto Sus oko kapung pena en kamela i.

verses.name: Acts 9:24
verses.text: A Saulus ronger, me re masamasan i; irail pil masamasan wanim akan ni ran o ni pong, pwen kamela i.

verses.name: Acts 9:25
verses.text: A tounpadak kan ale i ni pong apiekidi kopou eu sang pon kel o.

verses.name: Acts 9:26
verses.text: A Saulus lao pwara dong Ierusalem a sosong waroki ong tounpadak kan, irail karos masak i, pwe irail sota kamelele, me i tounpadak amen.

verses.name: Acts 9:27
verses.text: A Parnapas ale i o kare dong i ren wanporon akan, o katiti ong irail, duen a kilangadar Kaun o nani al o, o me a kotin masani ong i, o duen a so masak padapadaki ni mar en Iesus nan Damaskus.

verses.name: Acts 9:28
verses.text: I ari iang irail er kotin pedepedoi sang o pedepedelong ong nan Ierusalem o padaki aima ni mar en Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 9:29
verses.text: I o men Krik kai masan o akamai pena, a re song kamela i.

verses.name: Acts 9:30
verses.text: Saulang kan lao asaer, ap iang i kolang Säsarea, ap kadaralang i Taris.

verses.name: Acts 9:31
verses.text: A momodisou kan ap popol o pwaidar nan Iudäa, o Kaliläa, o Samaria, o re weweid ni masak en Kaun o, o toto kilar popol en Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 9:32
verses.text: A Petrus lao kakan sili nan sap akan, a pil kotila ren me saraui kan, me kaukauson Lida.

verses.name: Acts 9:33
verses.text: A diaradar aramas amen wasa o, me ad a Äneas, me wonon par walu, pwe me kokon dangidang.

verses.name: Acts 9:34
verses.text: Petrus ari masani ong i: Äneas. Iesus Kristus kakel uk ada. Paurida, pein lim pena ki om! I ari paurida madang.

verses.name: Acts 9:35
verses.text: A karos me kaukauson Lida o Saron, kilangada i, re ap wuki ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 9:36
verses.text: A tounpadak li amen mi Ioppe, me ad a Tapea (iet wewe: Torkas), i me dir en wiawia mau kan o kisakis wei.

verses.name: Acts 9:37
verses.text: A kadekadeo ni ran oko a somaudar o melar. Irail lao duper i, ap nekidala nan pera poa.

verses.name: Acts 9:38
verses.text: A Lida me koren iong Iope. Tounpadak kan lao ronger, me Petrus kotikot wasa o, rap kadarala ol riamen re a, poekipoeki: Kom der peikasal, koti dong kit!

verses.name: Acts 9:39
verses.text: Petrus ari kotida iang ir ala. I lao pwarado, re ap ukadala i pera poa, o li odi karos u impa, sangesang o kapwareda sakit o likau kan, me Torkas wiadar ni a mimi re ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 9:40
verses.text: A Petrus kiiei sang ir karos, ap kelepuki kapakap, ap saupei ong kalep o masani: Tapea, paurida! I ari pad pasang, kilangada Petrus, ap modadar.

verses.name: Acts 9:41
verses.text: I ari koledi pa a, kauada i. A lao eker pena me saraui o li odi kan, ap kasale ong irail i a maureda.

verses.name: Acts 9:42
verses.text: Ari a loki sili nan Iope, o me toto posonla Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 9:43
verses.text: I ari kotikoteta Iope ran toto ren saun me wiada kil en man amen, me ad a Simon.<div eID="gen2713" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.9"/>

verses.name: Acts 10:1
verses.text: OL amen mi Säsarea ad a Kornelius, me saumas en pwin en saunpei eu, me ad a men Italien,

verses.name: Acts 10:2
verses.text: Me lelapok o masak Kot iangaki toun im a karos, me poden kisakis ong aramas, o kapakap ong Kot ansau karos.

verses.name: Acts 10:3
verses.text: A masani ni kasansal eu tounlang en Kot amen, me pwara dong i ni klok silu, masani ong i: Kornelius!

verses.name: Acts 10:4
verses.text: A kangkakil i o masakadar, potoan ong: Maing, dakot? A kotin masani ong i: Om kapakap akan o koleir leler wasailen Kot.

verses.name: Acts 10:5
verses.text: Koe ari kadar wong Iope ol akai, ukedo Simon, me pil ad a Petrus,

verses.name: Acts 10:6
verses.text: Me kin kairu ren Simon saun wia kil en man, me im a sal ong sed;

verses.name: Acts 10:7
verses.text: A tounlang o, me kotin mamasani ong i, lao kotilar, ap ekeredo na ladu riamen o saunpei lelapok amen, me kin mi re a ansau karos.

verses.name: Acts 10:8
verses.text: A lao masani ong irail mepukat karos, ap kadar ir alang Iope.

verses.name: Acts 10:9
verses.text: A mandan ran o ni ar sapasapalwei o koren iong kanim o, Petrus ap kotila pon im o, pwen kapakap impan klok eisokriau.

verses.name: Acts 10:10
verses.text: Ap men sakadar o a pan sak. A ni ar kaonopadang i, ap masani kasansal eu:

verses.name: Acts 10:11
verses.text: A kilanger nanlang a ritidar o ed eu likamata tein pwainok kalaimun kokodi, me imwi kan pukopuk pena o pwilidi ong nani pwel.

verses.name: Acts 10:12
verses.text: Song en man en sappa karos mi lole, me kin aluki pa, o me laualo, o man korop kai, o manpir en pan lang.

verses.name: Acts 10:13
verses.text: O ngil eu peidi dong i masanier: Petrus, paurida, kamela o manga!

verses.name: Acts 10:14
verses.text: A Petrus potoan ong: Kaidin Maing, pwe i kaikenta manga me mal kot, de me samin.

verses.name: Acts 10:15
verses.text: A ngil o masani ong i kariapak: Meakot, me Kot kamakelekeladar koe der mamaleki!

verses.name: Acts 10:16
verses.text: Mepukat wiauier pan silepak! Ed o ap kapuredalang nanlang.

verses.name: Acts 10:17
verses.text: A Petrus ni a kotin ponepon kidar wewe en kasansal o, me a masanier, kilang, ol oko me pakadarado sang ren Kornelius, ap rapaki im en Simon o uda pan wanim o,

verses.name: Acts 10:18
verses.text: O likilikwir pepeidok, ma Simon, me pil mar a Petrus kotikot wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 10:19
verses.text: A Petrus ni a kotin madamadaua duen kasansal o, Ngen ap kotin masani ong i: Kilang ol silimen raparapa kin uk.

verses.name: Acts 10:20
verses.text: Uda o kodiwei iang irail o so peikasal, pwe Ngai me kadar irail do.

verses.name: Acts 10:21
verses.text: Petrus ap kodilang ren ol oko, masani: Kilang, iet ngai, me komail raparapaki. Da karepen omail kodo?

verses.name: Acts 10:22
verses.text: Irail inda: Kornelius saumas en saunpei amen, ol pung amen, me masak Kot, o kalok mau ren Sus akan karos, me mangier sang ren tounlang saraui en Kot amen, en poron dong komui, en kotido nan tanpas a, pwen mangi sang komui masan akan.

verses.name: Acts 10:23
verses.text: I ari kasamo ir long o kinte kin irail er. A mandan ran o a kotin iang ir wei; o saulang en Iope kai pil iang i.

verses.name: Acts 10:24
verses.text: A mandan ran o re leler Säsarea. A Kornelius kapokon pena sau i o kompokepa kan ap auiaui irail.

verses.name: Acts 10:25
verses.text: A Petrus lao pedelong ong, Kornelius ap tu ong i o pupedi ong ni aluwilu a o kaudok ong i.

verses.name: Acts 10:26
verses.text: A Petrus kauada i indada: Uda, pwe ngai pil aramas amen.

verses.name: Acts 10:27
verses.text: A ni ara masan pena, ap pedelong ong, diaradar me toto momod pena.

verses.name: Acts 10:28
verses.text: I ari masani ong irail: Komail asa, me a sota inen, ol en Sus amen en pat ong men liki amen de kola re a. A Kot kotin kasale ong ia, i ender mamaleki de sauteki amen aramas.

verses.name: Acts 10:29
verses.text: I me i koki do o so peikasal ni ar idok ia. Ari, i men kalelapok, da karep en omail eker ia do?

verses.name: Acts 10:30
verses.text: Kornelius ap masaniada: Mon pong pa pong ngai kaisesol lel auer wet. A ni klok duau i kapakap nan im ai. A kilang, ol amen me kot mo i, mi nan likau lingaling,

verses.name: Acts 10:31
verses.text: O masani: Kornelius, om kapakap me pwaida, o om koleir leler kupur en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 10:32
verses.text: Ari, ilakilang Iope, pwe Simon me pil ad a Petrus, en kodo. A kakairu nan im en Simon saun wia kil en man, me sal ong sed. A lao pwarado, a pan padapadaki uk.

verses.name: Acts 10:33
verses.text: Ngai ari pitipit ilakilang komui, a meid mau omui pwarador. Ari iet kit karos sansal mon Kot, pwe sen rong meakan, me Kot masani ong komui.

verses.name: Acts 10:34
verses.text: Petrus ap kotiki pasang silang i indada: Melel, i asaer, me Kot sota kin kotin lipilipiliki aramas,

verses.name: Acts 10:35
verses.text: A nan sap karos meamen masak i o wiawia me pung, nan i me konekon re a.

verses.name: Acts 10:36
verses.text: Masan o me a kotin kadara dong men Israel, en kaire kin irail popol ren Iesus Kristus. (Nan i me Kaun pan meakaros).

verses.name: Acts 10:37
verses.text: Komail asa masan me kalok sili me tapidar nan Kaliläa lel Iudäa pon murin paptais, me Ioanes wiada padak due.

verses.name: Acts 10:38
verses.text: Duen en Kot a kotin keiekier Iesus en Nasaret Ngen saraui o manaman, me kotin kakan sili wiawia mau o kakeladar me tanwar en tewil, pwe Kot kotin ieiang i.

verses.name: Acts 10:39
verses.text: A kit karos me saunkadede en meakaros, me a kotin wiadar nan sap en Sus akan o pil Ierusalem, me re pasuredi ong nin tuka o kamatalar.

verses.name: Acts 10:40
verses.text: Nan i me Kot kotin kaiasadar ni ran kasilu o kasaleda i.

verses.name: Acts 10:41
verses.text: Kaidin ong aramas karos, pwe ong saunkadede kai, me pilipildar ren Kot, kit me iang i sak o urak murin a iasadar sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Acts 10:42
verses.text: I ari masani ong kit, sen padapadak ong aramas o kadede melel, me i, me Kot kotin piladar, pwen Saunkapung pan me maur o me melar akan.

verses.name: Acts 10:43
verses.text: A saukop karos kin kadede duen i, me dip en ir karos, me poson i, pan lapwada pweki mar a.

verses.name: Acts 10:44
verses.text: A ni Petrus kotikida masan pukat Ngen saraui ap moredi pon karos, me rongerong padak o.

verses.name: Acts 10:45
verses.text: A me poson akan, kisan sirkomsais, karos me iang Petrus pwarador, puriamuiki, me Ngen saraui pil moredi pon men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 10:46
verses.text: Pwe re rongadar ar lokaia kida ngil toror kapinga Kot. Petrus ap masanier:

verses.name: Acts 10:47
verses.text: Is me pan inapwiedi pil, me mepukat ender paptaisela, pwe re aleer Ngen saraui dueta kitail?

verses.name: Acts 10:48
verses.text: I ari masani, me ren paptaisela ni mar en Iesus Kristus. Irail ap poeki, a en mimieta re ’rail ran akai.<div eID="gen2714" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.10"/>

verses.name: Acts 11:1
verses.text: WANPORON o saulang kan, me mi Iudäa, rongadar, me men liki kan pil aleer masan en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 11:2
verses.text: Petrus lao pwara dong Ierusalem, me kisan sirkomsais oko ap akamai ong i indada:

verses.name: Acts 11:3
verses.text: Kom pwarala ren ol akai me so sirkomsais oko o manga re ’rail.
