verses.name: Acts 11:4
verses.text: A Petrus pikikidi masani ong irail karos me wiauier irerokedo masani:

verses.name: Acts 11:5
verses.text: Ngai mi nan kanim Iope wia kapakap. O ni ai wukilar, i kilanger kasansal eu: Ed eu kodido sang nanlang likamata tein pwainok kalaimun eu, me imwi kan pukopuk pena o a kodido imp ai.

verses.name: Acts 11:6
verses.text: Ni ai kangkakil, i ap diar o kilanger man aluki pa en sappa kai, o man laoalo, o man korop, o manpir en pan lang.

verses.name: Acts 11:7
verses.text: Ngai ari rongadar ngil eu, me masani ong ia: Petrus, paurida, kamela o manga!

verses.name: Acts 11:8
verses.text: A ngai potoan ong: Kaidin Maing, pwe sota me mal kot, de me saut kin ko ong nan au ai.

verses.name: Acts 11:9
verses.text: A ngil kariapak sapeng sang nanlang: Meakot me Kot kamakelekeledar, koe der mamaleki!

verses.name: Acts 11:10
verses.text: Mepukat wiauier pan silepak, ap apdar nanlang.

verses.name: Acts 11:11
verses.text: A kilang, madang ol silimen kasinenda mon im, me i mi lole, me pakadara dong ia sang Säsarea.

verses.name: Acts 11:12
verses.text: A Ngen kotin masani ong ia, i en iang irail wei so peikasal; a saulang wonemen pukat pil iang ia. Kit ari pedelong ong nan im en ol o.

verses.name: Acts 11:13
verses.text: I ari kaire kin kit, duen a kilanger tounlang o kotikot nan im a, masani ong i: Kadara wong Iope ol akai, me pan ukedo Simon me pil ad a Petrus,

verses.name: Acts 11:14
verses.text: Me pan padaki ong uk, me koe o noumui kan karos pan maur kila.

verses.name: Acts 11:15
verses.text: Ni ai pikikidi padak, Ngen saraui ap moredi ong po ’rail, dueta a kotin moredi ong po ’tail ni tapi o.

verses.name: Acts 11:16
verses.text: Ngai ari tamanda masan en Kaun o, me a kotin masani: Melel, pil me Ioanes paptais kier, a komail pan paptais kila Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Acts 11:17
verses.text: Ari, ma Kot kotin kisakisa irail dueta a kotin kisakisa kitail er, kitail me posonlar Kaun Iesus Kristus, is ngai, pwe i en kak palian Kot?

verses.name: Acts 11:18
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar mepukat ap nenenla o kapinga Kot indada: Nan Kot pil kotiki ong men liki kan en kalula, pwen maurela.

verses.name: Acts 11:19
verses.text: A me muei pasang ni ansau en kamekam en Stepanus, kakan sili lel Pönisien, o Sipern, o Antiokien o sota padaki ong meamen pwe Sus akan eta.

verses.name: Acts 11:20
verses.text: A nan pung arail ol akai mia, men Sipern o Kirene, me pwara dong Antiokien, ap pil padaki ong men Krik rongamau en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 11:21
verses.text: A lim en Kaun o ieiang irail o me toto posonlar wuki ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 11:22
verses.text: Rong en mepukat ap peidong momodisou en Ierusalem. Ir ari poronelar Parnapas, pwen kokola lel Antiokien.

verses.name: Acts 11:23
verses.text: I lao pwarador o kilanger mak en Kot, ap peren kidar o panaui irail karos, ren kelail ni mongiong arail o podidi ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 11:24
verses.text: Pwe i me ol kelail o mau amen, me dir en Ngen saraui o poson. A aramas toto me wuki ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 11:25
verses.text: A ap kola Tarsus rapaki Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 11:26
verses.text: A lao diaradar i, ap ukedo i Antiokien. Ira ap mimi ren momodisou par eu o padapadaki ong me toto. A nan Antiokien tounpadak kan tapidar adaneki sapwilim en Kristus akan.

verses.name: Acts 11:27
verses.text: A ni ran pukat saukop akai ko dong Antiokien sang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 11:28
verses.text: A amen irail, me ad a Akapus me u kokopki Ngen, me muei lek lapalap pan kipadi sappa; ari, a pwaidar ni muein Klaudius.

verses.name: Acts 11:29
verses.text: A irail inauki pena, me re pan kisakisa saulang kan, me mi Ierusalem duen ar kapwapwa amen amen.

verses.name: Acts 11:30
verses.text: Mepukat re wiadar; re kadar wong saunkoa kan Parnapas o Paulus me wala.<div eID="gen2715" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.11"/>

verses.name: Acts 12:1
verses.text: I ANSAU nanmarki Erodes pikikidi kame akai nan momodisou.

verses.name: Acts 12:2
verses.text: I ari kamata kila kodlas Iakopus ri en Ioanes.

verses.name: Acts 12:3
verses.text: A lao kilanger, me Sus oko peren kidar, ap pil saikidi Petrus. Nan i ansaun prot somut.

verses.name: Acts 12:4
verses.text: A saikidi i o kilang i nan imateng, o kasilaki i pwin en saunpei paieu. Pamen me wia eu pwin, pwe murin pasa a men kasale ong pokon i.

verses.name: Acts 12:5
verses.text: Petrus ari sensal nan imateng a momodisou poden kapakapki i ren Kot.

verses.name: Acts 12:6
verses.text: Pongpong mon Erodes pan kasansaleda i, a saimokela nan pung en saunpei riamen, salikidi sal mata riapot. A silepa ko masamasan imateng mon wanim ko.

verses.name: Acts 12:7
verses.text: A kilang, amen tounlang en Kaun o pwarado o marain eu sarada nan imateng o. I ari pikir Petrus ni pangepang o kapaurida i masani: Paurida pitipit! Sal mata ko ap pupedi sang ni lim a kan.

verses.name: Acts 12:8
verses.text: A tounlang masani ong i: Pirapirada o suteda! I ari wiadar met. A ap masani ong i: Upupedi o idauen ia do!

verses.name: Acts 12:9
verses.text: I ari pedoido sang o idauenla i, o a sota dedeki, me melel en tounlang a wiawia. Pwe a kiki ong, me a auramandar.

verses.name: Acts 12:10
verses.text: Ira lao kotin daulier pwin en silepa kaieu, o kariau, ira ap lel ong wanim mata, me salong kanim, i me pein ritida mo ’ra. Ira ari kotila pon al apot. A tounlang ap madang kotin rir sang mo a.

verses.name: Acts 12:11
verses.text: A Petrus lao dedeki me wiauier, ap masaniada: I ap asa melel, me Kaun o kotin poronedo sapwilim a tounlang o kapit ia sang ni pa en Erodes o sang en Sus akan ar masamasan.

verses.name: Acts 12:12
verses.text: A ni a kotin madamadaua, ap lel ong im en Maria in en Ioanes, me pil ad a Markus, wasa me toto pokon ia wia kapakap.

verses.name: Acts 12:13
verses.text: A ni en Petrus a letelet ni wanim o, lidu men, ad a Rode, ap pwara dong rong.

verses.name: Acts 12:14
verses.text: A lao asa kapitie en Petrus, a sota ritingada wanim o pweki a peren. A a tanglong katitiki, me Petrus kot mon wanim o.

verses.name: Acts 12:15
verses.text: A irail indai ong i: Koe iakala. A i kelail indada, me melel. Re ap inda: Kaidin i, a sapwilim a tounlang o.

verses.name: Acts 12:16
verses.text: A Petrus wiawia leteleteta. Irail lao ritingada o kilanger i, re ap puriamui kilar.

verses.name: Acts 12:17
verses.text: A i olole irail, en nenenla. A ap masani ong irail duen Kaun o, me kotin kalua i sang nan imateng o, o pil masanier: Kaireki Iakopus o saulang kan mepukat! I ap kotiei sang kotilang ekis wasa.

verses.name: Acts 12:18
verses.text: A lao ran pasanger, saunpei kan ap puriamuiki kaualap en Petrus a pitilar.

verses.name: Acts 12:19
verses.text: A Erodes lao idok o so diaradar, ap itetokenkone silepa ko o masani, ren kamela. I ari kotilang Säsarea sang Ierusalem kaukauson ia.

verses.name: Acts 12:20
verses.text: A Erodes ongiongidar pan men Tirus o Sidon, re ap wiaki eu poto dong i kadekadeke Plastus saunkoa en nanmarki o poeki muei mau, pwe re kin memaureki sap en nanmarki.

verses.name: Acts 12:21
verses.text: A kadekadeo eu ran Erodes ap puriong likau en nanmarki, kaipokedi pon mol o kapakaparok ong irail.

verses.name: Acts 12:22
verses.text: A aramas akan ngisingis indada: Nan i kapitie en kot amen, a kaidin en aramas.

verses.name: Acts 12:23
verses.text: A madang amen tounlang en Kaun o poki i, pweki a so wauneki Kot. A maas akan me kangala i; i ari mela.

verses.name: Acts 12:24
verses.text: A masan en Kot pwaida o lok sili.

verses.name: Acts 12:25
verses.text: Parnapas i Paulus puredo sang Ierusalem, ira lao kanikielar ar dodok, o ira pil ukedo Ioanes, me ad a Markus.<div eID="gen2716" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.12"/>

verses.name: Acts 13:1
verses.text: NAN momodisou en Antiokien saukop o saunpadak kai mia. Iet akan: Parnapas, o Simeon me pil ad a Niker, o Lusius men Kirene, o Manaen, me iang monsap Erodes apwalidar, o Saulus.

verses.name: Acts 13:2
verses.text: A ni arail papa ong Kaun o, o kaisesol, Ngen saraui ap kotin masani: Katorore sang ong ia Parnapas o Saulus, pwen wia dok eu, me I ki ong ira er!

verses.name: Acts 13:3
verses.text: Irail ap kaisesol o kapakap o kidang po ’ra pa ar, re ap kadar ira wei.

verses.name: Acts 13:4
verses.text: Ira ari me pakadara kila Ngen saraui ap kotila Seloisia, wasa ira kereda pon sop pot tangalang Sipern.

verses.name: Acts 13:5
verses.text: Ira lao mi Salamis, ap padaki duen masan en Kot nan sinakoke en Sus akan. A Ioanes papa men pil iang ira.

verses.name: Acts 13:6
verses.text: Irail lao kakan sili nan dake lel kanim Papos, rap diaradar ol amen, me kin kati ani, saukop likam amen, kisan men Sus, ad a Par Iesus,

verses.name: Acts 13:7
verses.text: Me kin mi ren Serkius Paulus ol lelapok amen. I me ekere dong i Parnapas o Saulus, pwe a men rongerong masan en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 13:8
verses.text: A Elimas widingak (pwe i wewe en ad a) palian ira, pwen kapure sang saumas ni poson o.

verses.name: Acts 13:9
verses.text: Saulus, me pil adaneki Paulus, dir en Ngen saraui, kangkakil i,

verses.name: Acts 13:10
verses.text: Indada: Koe meid dir en widing o mesued, o nain tewil o me kailongki me pung karos. Koe sota pan dukedi sang palian al inen en Kaun akan.

verses.name: Acts 13:11
verses.text: A kilang met, lim en Kaun o mi po om. A koe pan maskun, ap solar kilang katipin ansau kis. Ari, a madang ediedelar o rotalar; i ap raparapaki sili men ale pa a, en kaweid i.

verses.name: Acts 13:12
verses.text: Saumas lao masani me wiauier, ap posonlar, pwe a puriamuiki padak en Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 13:13
verses.text: Paulus o a warok kai ap kotila sang Papos tangatang ko dong Perke nan wein Pampilia. A Ioanes muei sang ira, purelang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 13:14
verses.text: A ira masalewei sang Perke o kotilang Antiokien en Pisidien o kotilong ong nan sinakoke ni ran en sapat kaipokedi.

verses.name: Acts 13:15
verses.text: A lao nikier ar dondoropwe kapung o saukop akan saumas en sinakoke kai ap ilakilang ira masani: Ri (at) oko ma masan en panau pot ong aramas pukat mi re oma, koma ari kida!

verses.name: Acts 13:16
verses.text: Paulus ap kotida ololeki lim a masani: Ol en Israel komail o me kin masak Kot, komail en rong!

verses.name: Acts 13:17
verses.text: Kot en men Israel pukat, me kotin piladar sam atail akan o kapakapaiada aramas oko ni ar kakairu sili Äkipten, o lim a manaman, me a kotin kalua kin irail sang wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 13:18
verses.text: A impan saunpar paeisok a kotin apapwali irail nan sap tan.

verses.name: Acts 13:19
verses.text: Kadekadeo a lao kotin koko sang wei isu nan Kanaan, ap kotin nek ong irail sap arail.

verses.name: Acts 13:20
verses.text: O murin met a kotiki ong irail saunkapung kan irerokedo par papuki limeisok lel ong saukop Samuel.

verses.name: Acts 13:21
verses.text: A sang ni ansau o re inong iong nanmarki amen. Kot ap kotiki ong ir Saul nain Kis, ol en kadaudok en Peniamin amen, saunpar paeisok.

verses.name: Acts 13:22
verses.text: A lao kasapokelar, ap kotiki ong irail Dawid, pwen nanmarki, me a pil kotin kileledier masani: I diaradar Dawid nain Iese, ol amen duen inong en mongiong i, me pan wiada insen ai karos.

verses.name: Acts 13:23
verses.text: Sang nan kadaudok a Kot kotikido Iesus, pwen Saunkamaur pan men Israel, duen sapwilim a inau.

verses.name: Acts 13:24
verses.text: Murin Ioanes a kotin padaki ong men Israel karos duen paptais en kalula mon a kotido.

verses.name: Acts 13:25
verses.text: A Ioanes lao kapwaiada sapwilim a dodok, ap kotin masani: Is me komail lamelame me ngai? Kaidin ngai i. A kilang amen kotido, kisin sal en sapwilim a sut i sowar en lapwada.

verses.name: Acts 13:26
verses.text: Komail ol o ri ai kan, komail kadaudok en Apraam, o meamen me masak Kot re omail, padak en kamaur pot et pakadara dong komail.

verses.name: Acts 13:27
verses.text: Pwe me kaukauson Ierusalem o ar saumas akan kapwaiada kokop en saukop akan, me kin wadawad ni sapat akan karos ni ar kadeikada i, pweki re sasa i.

verses.name: Acts 13:28
verses.text: A sota me re diaradar, me a kak kamata kila. Ari so, re poeki ren Pilatus, me a en kamatala i.

verses.name: Acts 13:29
verses.text: Irail lao kapwaiada karos, me intingkidi i, re ap kidi sang i nin tuka o kidi i nan sousou o.

verses.name: Acts 13:30
verses.text: A Kot me kotin kaiasada i sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Acts 13:31
verses.text: O ran toto me a kotin pwara dong me iang i kotilang Ierusalem sang Kaliläa, me sapwilim a saunkadede ong aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 13:32
verses.text: A kit padaki ong komail rongamau duen inau ong sam atail akan,

verses.name: Acts 13:33
verses.text: Me Kot kotin kapwai ong kitail nairail seri kan, ni a kotin kaiasadar Iesus duen a intingidier nan psalm kariau: Koe nai Ol, I kanaitik uk adar ran wet.

verses.name: Acts 13:34
verses.text: A duen a kotin kaiasada i sang ren me melar akan, pwen der mor pasang, i me a kotin masanieki met: I pan ki ong komail pai melel en Dawid akan.

verses.name: Acts 13:35
verses.text: I me a pil masanieki ekis wasa: Re sota pan kotin mueid ong, sapwilim ar Saraui o pan mor pasang.

verses.name: Acts 13:36
verses.text: Pwe Dawid lao kapwaiada a papa ong kupur en Kot ni a ansau, ap saimokelar, a saredier impan sam a ko, ap mor pasang.

verses.name: Acts 13:37
verses.text: A i me Kot kotin kaiasadar, nan a sota kotin mor pasang.

verses.name: Acts 13:38
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, komail asa, me lapwa pan dip akan ren men et kin kaloki ong komail.

verses.name: Acts 13:39
verses.text: A me pan poson i, nan i me pungalar sang meakaros, me komail sota kak pung kila kapung en Moses.

verses.name: Acts 13:40
verses.text: Ari, komail kalaka, pwe a depa pwai ong komail, me saukop akan masanier:

verses.name: Acts 13:41
verses.text: Kilang, komail me kin lalaue, puriamuiki o soredi, pwe I pan wia dodok eu ni omail ansau, me komail sota pan kamelele, ma amen pan kasokasoi ong komail due.

verses.name: Acts 13:42
verses.text: Irail lao pedoi sang ap poekipoeki, kasoi pukat en kalok ong irail ni ran en sapat kokodo.

verses.name: Acts 13:43
verses.text: A saraui lao nikier, men Sus o Proselit lelapok toto idauenla Paulus o Parnapas, me mamasani ong irail o panaui irail, ren podidi ong mak en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 13:44
verses.text: A ni sapat kokodo karos toun kanim o pokon pena, pwen rong masan en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 13:45
verses.text: A Sus akan lao kilanger pokon o, ap pepeirinki o lidere meakan, me Paulus kaweweda; re palian o lalaue.

verses.name: Acts 13:46
verses.text: A Paulus o Parnapas ap so masak katitiki: Masan en Kot en loki dong komail mas, a pweki omail kase sang, o wia kin komail sowar ong maur soutuk, kilang, se sope wei ong men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 13:47
verses.text: Pwe iet duen me Kaun o kotin masani ong kit: Ngai me kasapwil uk adar, pwen marain pan men liki kan, pwe koe en kamaur sili lel sap karos.

verses.name: Acts 13:48
verses.text: Men liki kan lao rongadar met, ap peren kidar, o kapinga masan en Kot o karos, me kileledi ong maur soutuk, posonlar.

verses.name: Acts 13:49
verses.text: A masan en Kaun o lolok sili nan wei kan karos.

verses.name: Acts 13:50
verses.text: A Sus oko kamakarada li saupeidi lelapok o saumas en kanim kan, o kapei ong Paulus o Parnapas aramas o kasapoke ir sang nan sap arail,

verses.name: Acts 13:51
verses.text: A ira sipede sang ni aluwilu ar pwel, pwen kadede ong irail, ap kotilan Ikonien.

verses.name: Acts 13:52
verses.text: A tounpadak kan me dir kila peren o Ngen saraui.<div eID="gen2717" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.13"/>

verses.name: Acts 14:1
verses.text: A IET me wiauier nan Ikonien: Ira karos kotilong ong nan sinakoke en Sus oko, ap padapadak kelail, lao kisan men Sus o Krik toto posonla.

verses.name: Acts 14:2
verses.text: A Sus oko, me so poson, kamokimokid men liki kai o kalolap irail ong saulang kan.

verses.name: Acts 14:3
verses.text: A ira mimieta warai wasa o, o aima padapadak duen kupur en Kaun o, me kotin kapwaiada masan en kupur a, ni a kotin kasaleda kilel o manaman akan ki lim ara.

verses.name: Acts 14:4
verses.text: A toun kanim liak toror pasang. Akai me iang Sus oko, a akai iang wanporon akan.

verses.name: Acts 14:5
verses.text: A moromorong lao wiauier sang ren men liki kan o pil Sus oko iangaki ar saumas akan, pwen kame o kate ira,

verses.name: Acts 14:6
verses.text: Ira lao mangier, ap pitilang kanim Likaonien, o Listra, o Derpe, o sap me mi imp a,

verses.name: Acts 14:7
verses.text: Wasa o ira padapadak rongamau.

verses.name: Acts 14:8
verses.text: A ol amen momod Listra, me pat en nä luet o kokon dangidang sang ni a tikitik, me saikenta alu.

verses.name: Acts 14:9
verses.text: I me kin rongerong en Paulus a padak. A lao masani i, ap kotin kasauiada, me a poson itar ong en kakelailada,

verses.name: Acts 14:10
verses.text: Ap kotin kapitie laudeda masani: Ukida nä om! I ari masiokadar o aluwei.

verses.name: Acts 14:11
verses.text: Aramas lao kilanger, me Paulus kotin wiadar, rap ngilada kapitiki nin lokaia en Liakonien: Kot akan wia aramasala ap koti dong kitail.

verses.name: Acts 14:12
verses.text: Irail ari ki ong mar en Parnapas Iupiter, a Paulus Merkurius, pweki a kaunda kaparok.

verses.name: Acts 14:13
verses.text: A samero en Iupiter, me kin mi mon kanim o, ap wado kau ol o al en tuka kai mon kanim o, ap men iang pokon o wia mairong isis.

verses.name: Acts 14:14
verses.text: A wanporon oko Parnapas i Paulus lao mangi mepukat, ira ap ter pasang ara likau o tang wong nan pung en aramas akan likelikwir:

verses.name: Acts 14:15
verses.text: Maing ko, da me komail wiawiaki mepukat? Kit aramas dueta komail, ap padaki ong komail, pwe komail en wuki sang kot mal pukat, wuki ong Kot ieias, me kotin kapikadar lang, o sappa, o sed, o audepa ’rail karos.

verses.name: Acts 14:16
verses.text: Me kotin mueid ong toun sap karos en wia pein insen ar mas o.

verses.name: Acts 14:17
verses.text: Ari so, a sota kotin okila pein i, pwe a kotin wiawia mau o kotiki ong komail katau sang nanlang o rak o, o kadireki nan mongiong omail manga o peren.

verses.name: Acts 14:18
verses.text: Ira kotin masani mepukat, a ekis ta, ira sota kak katukiedi en pokon o ar pan mairong ong ira.

verses.name: Acts 14:19
verses.text: A Sus oko ap kodo sang Antiokien o Ikonien, kamakarada aramas. Ir ari kate Paulus o uradokilang likin kanim o, re ap kiki ong, me a matalar.

verses.name: Acts 14:20
verses.text: A ni en tounpadak kan ar kapil pena i, a kotida ap kolong ong nan kanim o, a manda a iang Parnapas koieila Derpe.

verses.name: Acts 14:21
verses.text: Ira lao padapadak rongamau nan kanim o, o kasaulangalar me toto, ira ap purela Listra, o Ikonien, o Antiokien.

verses.name: Acts 14:22
verses.text: Ira kakelada ngen en tounpadak kan o panaui irail, me ren dadaurata poson, o me kitail en leleki wein Kot kamekam toto.

verses.name: Acts 14:23
verses.text: Ira lao kasapwilada saunkoa kai nan momodisou karos, ap kapakap o kaisesol, ap kapakapa ki irail ren Kaun o me re posonlar.

verses.name: Acts 14:24
verses.text: Ira kakan sili Pisidien ap lel ong Pampilien.

verses.name: Acts 14:25
verses.text: Ira lao padaki duen masan o nan Perke, ap kotilang Atalien.

verses.name: Acts 14:26
verses.text: A sang ni wasa o ira tangalang Antiokien, wasa ira sapwile kidar mak en Kot ong dodok o me ira kapwaiadar.

verses.name: Acts 14:27
verses.text: Ira lao pwarador, ap kapokon pena momodisou, rap kotin kasoia ong irail duen en Kot a kotin wiaki ira, o duen a kotin ritingada wanim en poson en men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 14:28
verses.text: Ira ap kotikot warai ren tounpadak kan.<div eID="gen2718" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.14"/>

verses.name: Acts 15:1
verses.text: A AKAI me kodido sang Iudäa, ap padaki ong saulang kan: Ma komail sota sirkomsais duen tiak en Moses, komail sota pan kak maurela.

verses.name: Acts 15:2
verses.text: A irail lao liak toror pasang o akakamai ong Paulus o Parnapas, re ap inauki pena, me Paulus i Parnapas, o pil akai irail en kotidalang Ierusalem ren wanporon o saunkoa kan pweki mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 15:3
verses.text: Momodisou ap likid ir wei lao ekis wasa. Irail ap weweid nan Pönisien o Samaria o kasokasoiada duen en men liki ar wukila. Irail ari kaperenda melel saulang kan karos.

verses.name: Acts 15:4
verses.text: Irail lao lel Ierusalem, momodisou o wanporon, o saunkoa kan ap kasamo ir. Irail ap katitiki meakan, me Kot kotin wiaki irail er.

verses.name: Acts 15:5
verses.text: A akai kisan pwin en Parisär, me saulangalar, me uda indada: Me pung, en sirkomsais ir ala, o kapi ong irail, en wiawia kapung en Moses.

verses.name: Acts 15:6
verses.text: A wanporon o saunkoa kan pokon pena, pwen kaparok duen met.

verses.name: Acts 15:7
verses.text: Irail lao kapukapung pena warailar, Petrus ap kotida masani ong irail: Ri ai kan, komail asa, me mas o Kot kotin pil ia dar sang nan pung omail, pwe men liki kan en ronga sang nan au ai masan en rongamau o posonla.

verses.name: Acts 15:8
verses.text: A Kot me kotin ereki mongiong en aramas, kotin kadede irail o kotiki ong irail Ngen saraui dueta kitail,

verses.name: Acts 15:9
verses.text: O a sota kotin wiada irair eu nan pung en kitail o irail ni a kotin kamakel mongiong arail ki poson.

verses.name: Acts 15:10
verses.text: Ari, da me komail kasongesongki Kot, en kidang pon pop en tounpadak kan lopu eu, me sam atail akan o pil kitail sota kak wa.

verses.name: Acts 15:11
verses.text: A kitail kin kamekamelele, me kitail pan kamaureki mak en Kaun Iesus Kristus dueta irail.

verses.name: Acts 15:12
verses.text: A pokon o nenenlata o rongerong en Parnapas i Paulus ara katiti duen manaman oko o kilel kai, me Kot kotin wia kidar lim ara nan pung en men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 15:13
verses.text: Irail lao nenenlar, Iakopus ap kaparok masanida: Ri ai kan komail rong ia!

verses.name: Acts 15:14
verses.text: Simon me kasoiada duen en Kot a kotin pwara dong men liki kan ni tapi o pwen pili sang irail kainok eu ong mar a.

verses.name: Acts 15:15
verses.text: Pwe iduen masan en saukop akan duen a intingidi:

verses.name: Acts 15:16
verses.text: Murin mepukat I pan puredo o kawiliakapada im en Dawid, me rongki pasanger, o pur ong kauada wasa me olar.

verses.name: Acts 15:17
verses.text: Pwe luan aramas akan en raparapaki Kaun o, pil men liki kan, me wan ad ai, iei me Kaun o masaniadar, me kin kotin wiawia.

verses.name: Acts 15:18
verses.text: Mepukat me lolok sang ni tapi o.

verses.name: Acts 15:19
verses.text: Ari iet me i kasauiada, kitail ender katoutoui irail me wuki ong Kot sang ren men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 15:20
verses.text: A sen intinge wong irail, ren liki sang kasaut en kot mal akan, o nenek, o man mopelar akan, o nta.

verses.name: Acts 15:21
verses.text: Pwe sang mas kokodo saunkawewe en Moses kin mi nan kanim karos, pwe re kin padapadak duen i nan sinakoke kan ni ran en sapat akan karos.

verses.name: Acts 15:22
verses.text: Wanporon o saunkoa kan, o momodisou ap maukidar, en pilada ol akai sang ar pokon o porone ira wei iang Paulus i Parnapas, en kotila Antiokien: Iudas, me pil ad a Parnapas o Silas, ol pukat, me kaun pan saulang kan.

verses.name: Acts 15:23
verses.text: A iet eten, me re intingiedier ap kadar wong irail: Iet kit wanporon o saunkoa kan o saulang kan kadar wong komail, ri at akan, me ko sang ren men liki kan nan Antiokien, o Sirien, o Sisilia at ranamau.

verses.name: Acts 15:24
verses.text: Aki at ronger, me akai, me koiei sang re at, kin kaponepone kin ngen omail ar padak kan ni ar kasapunge komail lar indada: Komail en sirkomsais o kapwaiada kapung o; a se sota ki ong irail kusoned akan.

verses.name: Acts 15:25
verses.text: Kit ap wiaki eu ni at maukidar en piladar ol akai, ap kadar wong komail iangaki kompoke pat Parnapas o Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 15:26
verses.text: Ol oko me tonmeteki maur ara ong mar en Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 15:27
verses.text: Kit ari kadar wei Iudas o Silas, me pil pan kasoi ong komail mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 15:28
verses.text: Pwe Ngen saraui o kit kin kupukupura, me mau, se ender ki ong komail eu lopu; mepukat eta me kasampwal:

verses.name: Acts 15:29
verses.text: Komail liki sang uduk, me mairong ong kot likam, o nta, o man mopelar, o nenek. Ma komail liki sang mepukat, nan komail kin wiawia me mau. Ran kaselel!

verses.name: Acts 15:30
verses.text: Irail lao pakadarala, ap kotilang Antiokien, re ap kapokon ir pena, ki ong irail kisin likau o.

verses.name: Acts 15:31
verses.text: Irail lao wadoker, ap peren kidar kamait parail.

verses.name: Acts 15:32
verses.text: A Iudas i Silas, me pil saukop oko panaui kin saulang kan kasoi toto o pil katinai ir ada.

verses.name: Acts 15:33
verses.text: Irail mi wasa o lao ran akai, ap pakadarala popol sang ren saulang kan, pwe ren kola ren me kadar ira ala.

verses.name: Acts 15:35
verses.text: A Paulus i Parnapas kotikoteta Antiokien, kawewedar o padapadaki masan en Kaun o, o me toto pil iang.

verses.name: Acts 15:36
verses.text: Kadekadeo murin ran akai Paulus masani on Parnapas: Kita pan purela ren saulang kan, me mi kanim akan, wasa kita padakier duen masan en Kaun o, o kalekalelapok due ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 15:37
verses.text: A Parnapas men ukada Ioanes, me pil ad a Markus.

verses.name: Acts 15:38
verses.text: A Paulus kupura, me a sota mau, ira en ukada i, me muei sang ira nan Pampilien o solar iang ira kolang dodok.

verses.name: Acts 15:39
verses.text: Ira ari akamai pena lao ira muei pasang. Parnapas ari ukada Markus tanga wong Sipern.

verses.name: Acts 15:40
verses.text: Paulus piladar Silas ap kotila. A saulang kan mueidela ira ni mak en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 15:41
verses.text: I ari kakan sili nan Sirien o Silisia katinada momodisou kan.<div eID="gen2719" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.15"/>

verses.name: Acts 16:1
verses.text: PAULUS ari kotilang Derpe o Listra. A kilang tounpadak amen mi wasa o, me ad a Timoteus, nain li en Sus me poson amen, a sam a men Krik.

verses.name: Acts 16:2
verses.text: Nan i kalok mau sili ren saulang en Listra o Ikonien akan.

verses.name: Acts 16:3
verses.text: Paulus kotin men, i en waroki ong i. I ari uk i o sirkomsais i, pweki Sus oko, me mi wasa o, pwe irail asaer, me sam a men Krik amen.

verses.name: Acts 16:4
verses.text: A ni arail kotikot sili nan kanim akan, re padaki ong irail me ren kapwaiada kusoned oko, me wiauier ren wanporon o saunkoa kan nan Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 16:5
verses.text: Momodisou kan ari kelailada ni poson o re totolar ni ran karos.

verses.name: Acts 16:6
verses.text: A Ngen saraui kotin inapwiedi, me ren der padak duen masan nan Asien, re ap kakan sili Prikien o Kalatien.

verses.name: Acts 16:7
verses.text: Irail lao pwara dong Misien, re song daulul wei ong Pitinien, a Ngen en Iesus sota kotin mueid ong.

verses.name: Acts 16:8
verses.text: Irail lao daulul lar Misien, ap kodilang Troas.

verses.name: Acts 16:9
verses.text: A kasansal eu pwara dong Paulus ni pong: Ol en Masetonien amen me uda, poekipoeki i indada: Kom koti dong Masetonien, sauasa kit!

verses.name: Acts 16:10
verses.text: A lao udialer kasansal o, kit madang kolang Masetonien, pwe se asaer, me Kaun o kotin molipe kit, en kolan padaki ong irail rongamau.

verses.name: Acts 16:11
verses.text: Kit ari masel wei sang Troas o inen wong Samotrasien, a manda lel ong Neapolis,

verses.name: Acts 16:12
verses.text: O sang wasa o lel Pilipi, kanim lapalap ni apali en Masetonien, me kisan sap en men Rom. Kit ari mimieta nan kanim o ran akai.

verses.name: Acts 16:13
verses.text: Ni ran en sapat se koiei sang kanim o, kolang pon pilap pot, wasa re kin kapakap ia. Kit ari mondi o kawewe ong li akai, me kin pokopokon wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 16:14
verses.text: A li amen ad a Lidia, men saunet en likau waitata, men Tiatira amen, me kin kaudok ong Kot. Nan i me rongerong kit. A Kaun o kotin ritingada mongiong i, pwen apapwali meakan, me Paulus masanier.

verses.name: Acts 16:15
verses.text: I o a penainai lao paptaiselar, ap poeki re at indada: Ma komail kasau ia da, me i posonlar Kaun o, komail pan pedelong ong nan im ai o kotikot ia; i ari ngidingide kin kit.

verses.name: Acts 16:16
verses.text: Kadekadeo ni at kolan kapakap lidu amen, me kin wun ani, ap tu ong kit, me kin kare ong moni toto ren a saumas kan ki a wun ani.

verses.name: Acts 16:17
verses.text: I me idauen Paulus o kit weriwer indada: Aramas pukat me sapwilim en Kot lapalap ladu ko, me kin padaki ong komail duen al en maur.

verses.name: Acts 16:18
verses.text: A mepukat a wiadar ran toto. A Paulus kupurola kaualap ap kotin saupeila masani ong ngen o: Ni mar en Iesus Kristus me i indai ong uk, keredi sang i! I ap keredi sang ni auer ota.

verses.name: Acts 16:19
verses.text: A saumas akan lao diarada, me solar kaporopor en ar men wiaki moni, ap saikidi Paulus o Silas, wai ira long dong wasan net ren saumas akan.

verses.name: Acts 16:20
verses.text: O kalua ira wei ren saunkapung kan katitiki: Aramas pukat kisan men Sus kin kaokaoe atail kanim,

verses.name: Acts 16:21
verses.text: O padapadaki tiak me sota pung se en ale de wiada, pwe kitail men Rom.

verses.name: Acts 16:22
verses.text: Aramas karos ap uda por ong ira, o saunkapung ko dere sang ara likau kan o kapi, ren woki ira.

verses.name: Acts 16:23
verses.text: Irail wokiwoki ira pan pak toto, rap kase ira di nan imateng o kapiedi silepa o, en katengeteng ira di.

verses.name: Acts 16:24
verses.text: A lao aleer kusoned wet ap kase ira di ong nan warong, en imateng o saliedi aluwilu ’ra nin tuka kai.

verses.name: Acts 16:25
verses.text: A lao ni ailep en pong Paulus o Silas kapakap o melkaka ong Kot, o me salidi ko rongerong ira,

verses.name: Acts 16:26
verses.text: A sap o madang rerereda, kasukasuk en imateng mokidedar, wanim ko ap madang ritida o ar sal akan karos lapwadar.

verses.name: Acts 16:27
verses.text: A silepan imateng lao pirida sang a mair o kilang wanim ko ar ritidar, ap ngapekida a kodlas o, a pan kamela pein i, pwe a kiki ong, me salidi ko me pitila.

verses.name: Acts 16:28
verses.text: A Paulus kapitie laudeda masani: Kom der kame uk ala, pwe kit karos mia.

verses.name: Acts 16:29
verses.text: A ap idok lamp eu o tang rerer o dairukedi sang Paulus o Silas.

verses.name: Acts 16:30
verses.text: O wa ira wei sang indada: Maing ko, da me i en wiada, pwen kamaurela?

verses.name: Acts 16:31
verses.text: Ira ap masani: Poson Kaun Iesus, a koe o toun im om pan maurela.

verses.name: Acts 16:32
verses.text: Ira ari kawewe ong i o toun im a karos masan en Kaun o.

verses.name: Acts 16:33
verses.text: I ari uk ira ni auer ota ni pong o, widen ara pwal oko. I o na kan karos ap madang paptaiselar.

verses.name: Acts 16:34
verses.text: I ap kalua wong ira nan im a, ap kida mo ’ra kisin manga, o peren kidar a posonla Kot, i o iang a kan.

verses.name: Acts 16:35
verses.text: A lao ran pasang, saupeidi ko poronela papa ko indada: Lapwada aramas pukat!

verses.name: Acts 16:36
verses.text: Silepan imateng o ap kaireki Paulus masan pukat indada: Saupeidi ko me ilakido, koma en lapwada. Koma ari kotila popol

verses.name: Acts 16:37
verses.text: A Paulus kotin masani ong irail: Irail sansal kadeike kit adar o woki kit men Rom, ap kase kit ale nan imateng, a met re men kadar kit ala so sansal. A so, irail en pein kodo, wa kit wei.

verses.name: Acts 16:38
verses.text: A papa ko kaireki saupeidi kan masan pukat. Irail ap masakadar ni ar rongadar, me ira men Rom.

verses.name: Acts 16:39
verses.text: Irail ari kodo, poeki re ’ra o wa ira la sang, o ngidingideki ira, en sapal wei sang nan kanim o.

verses.name: Acts 16:40
verses.text: Ira ari pedoido sang nan imateng o, ap kotila ren Lidia. Ira lao tu ong saulang kan, ap panaui irail o sipale wei.<div eID="gen2720" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.16"/>

verses.name: Acts 17:1
verses.text: IRA kotin weid nan Ampipolis o Apolonia, ap pwara dong Tesalonik, wasa sinakoke en Sus oko mi ia.

verses.name: Acts 17:2
verses.text: Paulus ap kotilong ong re ’rail duen a kin wiawia o iang ir kapakaparok pena sang kisin likau kan ni ran en sapat silu.

verses.name: Acts 17:3
verses.text: A kotin padaki o kasaleda, me Kristus udan kalokolok o iasada sang ren me melar akan, o me Iesus men et, me i kawewe ong komail, me Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 17:4
verses.text: O akai irail me posonla ap waroki ong Paulus i Silas, o pil men Krik lelapok me toto, o li saupeidi me kaidin me malaulau.

verses.name: Acts 17:5
verses.text: A Sus oko pepeirindar, ap ukada ol sued kai, o kapokon irail pena o kapeida kanim o, o kapil pena im en Iason, pwen wa ira dong pokon o.

verses.name: Acts 17:6
verses.text: Irail lao so diar ira da re ap waikelong dong saumas akan en kanim o Iason o saulang kai indada: Mepukat kamokimokidadar sappa, nan ira pil pwara dor met.

verses.name: Acts 17:7
verses.text: A Iason kasamo ira er, o irail karos kin tiakedi masan en Sisa ni ar katitiki, me dene amen Nanmarki Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 17:8
verses.text: Irail ari kamakaradar aramas o saumas akan nan kanim o ni ar rongadar mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 17:9
verses.text: Irail lao aleer sang ren Iason o me tei kan ar kapwa, re ap kadar ira la.

verses.name: Acts 17:10
verses.text: A saulang kan madang kadarala Paulus i Silas ni pong Peröa. Irail lao pwarado, ap kotilong ong nan sinakoke en Sus oko.

verses.name: Acts 17:11
verses.text: Mepukat me mau sang irail nan Tesalonik, pwe re pitipit aleer masan o pereperen kalelapokki kisin likau ni ran karos, ma melel mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 17:12
verses.text: Ari, me toto irail posonlar, li o ol en Krik kan kisan saupeidi me toto iang.

verses.name: Acts 17:13
verses.text: A men Sus en Tesalonik ko lao ronger, me Paulus pil padapadak nan Peröa masan en Kot, irail ap kodo o kamakaradar aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 17:14
verses.text: A saulang kan madang kadarala Paulus, dene a pan kotidila ni oror. A Silas i Timoteus mimieta wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 17:15
verses.text: O me pelikid Paulus akan kalua i lel Aten. Irail lao aleer kusoned ong Silas o Timoteus, me ira en pitipit ko dong i, re ap samalar.

verses.name: Acts 17:16
verses.text: A ni en Paulus a kotin auiaui ira nan Aten kupura ap ola ni a masani nan kanim o dikedik en ani rok ia.

verses.name: Acts 17:17
verses.text: I ari kotin padaki ong Sus oko o me toun kaudok kan nan sinakoke pil wasan net, me a kotin padaki ong, me kin pokon pena wasa o ni ran akan karos.

verses.name: Acts 17:18
verses.text: A saunpadak en Epikurios o Stoik kai ap akamai ong i o akai indada: Da paupaulap men et men inda? O akai indada: Likamata i saunpadak en kot en wai akan aki a padaki ong irail rongamau en Iesus o en aramas ar pan maureda.

verses.name: Acts 17:19
verses.text: Irail ari ukada i o walang Areopak indada: Kit sota pan kak rong duen padak kap pot et, me koe kin kaweweda?

verses.name: Acts 17:20
verses.text: Pwe kasoi en wai pot, me kom wa dong kit, kit ari men weweki duen mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 17:21
verses.text: Pwe toun Aten o men wai kan, me mi wasa o, kin sopisokki ar kasokasoi o rongerong duen meakaros me kap.

verses.name: Acts 17:22
verses.text: A Paulus kotida pon dol en mars masani: Komail ol oko en Aten, i kasauiadar, me komail kin masak kaualap kot likam akan,

verses.name: Acts 17:23
verses.text: Pwe ni ai koko sili met, o kilekilanger omail saraui kan, i ap diaradar pei saraui eu, me intingidier poa: Sapwilim en kot me so diarokadar, me komail kin kaudoki ong ap sasa i, i me i kin padapadaki ong komail.

verses.name: Acts 17:24
verses.text: Kot me kotin wiadar sappa o audepa karos i me Kaun en nanlang o sappa, nan a sota kotikot nan im en kaudok kan me aramas wiadar.

verses.name: Acts 17:25
verses.text: O sota me kin upaki i pa en aramas likamata a kotin anane meakot; pwe pein i kin kotin nene ong karos maur, o asingok o meakaros.

verses.name: Acts 17:26
verses.text: O a kotin wiadar wein aramas en sappa karos kaparapar sang nta ta ieu, pwen kaukauson nan sap karos, o a kotin kileledier warai o wasan ar kauson.

verses.name: Acts 17:27
verses.text: Pwe ren raparapaki Kot, ma ir kak pam o diar i, pwe a sota kin doo sang amen amen kitail.

verses.name: Acts 17:28
verses.text: Pwe i me kitail kin memaureki, o mokideki, o mimiaki, duen akai omail saunkaul pil indadar: Pwe kis a kitail karos.

verses.name: Acts 17:29
verses.text: Ari, ma kitail kisan Kot, kitail ender lamelame, me Kot rasong kold, de silper, de takai, de dikedik eu, me aramas lolekong diaradar.

verses.name: Acts 17:30
verses.text: Ari, kot kotin kanongama ong kitail ni ansaun atail rotorot. A ansau wet a kotin masani ong aramas karos, ren kalula wasa karos.

verses.name: Acts 17:31
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kileledier ran eu, me a pan kotin kadeika kida sappa Ol amen, me a kotin katororedar ni tiak pung. A iet kilel, me a kotiki ong aramas karos: A kotin kaiasadar i sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Acts 17:32
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar duen mauredan me melar akan akai ap lalaue, a akai inda: Se men pur ong rong sang komui duen met.

verses.name: Acts 17:33
verses.text: Paulus ari kotila sang re ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 17:34
verses.text: A ol akai waroki ong i o posonlar. Amen ir Dionisius kisan saunkapung kan; a li amen, me ad a Damaris, o pil akai iang irail.<div eID="gen2721" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.17"/>

verses.name: Acts 18:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat a kotila sang Aten o kotilang Korint,

verses.name: Acts 18:2
verses.text: A lao diaradar Sus amen me ad a Akwila me ipwidier Pontus, me apton kodo sang Italien o a paud Prisila, aki Klaudius masani, me Sus oko karos en kokoke sang Rom, i ari kotilang re ’ra.

verses.name: Acts 18:3
verses.text: O kotikot re ’ra, iang dodok, pwe ira song ta ieu wiada im likau.

verses.name: Acts 18:4
verses.text: O ni ran en sapat karos a kin kotin padapadak nan sinakoke o kalekalolekonge men Sus o men Krik kan.

verses.name: Acts 18:5
verses.text: A Silas o Timoteus lao kodido sang Masetonien, Paulus kotin sopisokki kaualap padak o, pwe a kadede ong Sus akan, me Iesus me Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 18:6
verses.text: A irail lao akamai o lalaue, a ap sipededi sapwilim a likau masani ong irail: Dip omail en kapokon ong pein komail. Ngai me makelekel sang met, i pan kola ren men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 18:7
verses.text: I ari kotila sang wasa o ap kotilang nan im en amen me ad a Sust me kin kaudok ong Kot, me im a pat ong sinakoke.

verses.name: Acts 18:8
verses.text: A Krispus, saumas en sinakoke posonla Kaun o, iangaki karos toun im a; toun Korint me toto lao rongada, ap posonla o paptaisela.

verses.name: Acts 18:9
verses.text: Kaun o ap kotin masani ong Paulus ni a auramen ni pong: Der masak, padapadak ender nenenla!

verses.name: Acts 18:10
verses.text: Pwe Ngai iang uk, o sota me pan sair uk, pwen kame uk, pwe nai aramas me toto nan kanim wet.

verses.name: Acts 18:11
verses.text: I ari kotikot wasa o par eu o saunipong wonu kaweweda masan en Kot nan pung arail.

verses.name: Acts 18:12
verses.text: Ni muein Kalion kakaundar Akaia, Sus akan ap wiaki eu, saikidi Paulus o wa dong i mon mol en kadeik o,

verses.name: Acts 18:13
verses.text: Indada: Lap men et kin pitipiti aramas, ren kaudok ong Kot ap palian kapung.

verses.name: Acts 18:14
verses.text: Paulus lao men masanda, Kalion ap masani ong Sus oko: Komail Sus oko, ma sapung eu de me sued kot, i pan rong komail.

verses.name: Acts 18:15
verses.text: A ma akamai duen lamalam, o ad akan, o omail kapung, nan pein komail pan wia, pwe ngai sota men saunkapung pan mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 18:16
verses.text: I ari siken ir wei sang ni mol en kadeik o.

verses.name: Acts 18:17
verses.text: A karos ap saikidi Sostenes, saumas en sinakoke o woki i mon mol en kadeik o. A Kalion sota insenoki mepukat karos.

verses.name: Acts 18:18
verses.text: Paulus lao kotikot wasa o ran toto, ap kotin kamurimuri ong saulang kan o iangala sop pot kotilang Sirien; Prisila i Akwila iang i. Mas a kotin kotedar tapwi nan Kenkräa, pwe a inau mia.

verses.name: Acts 18:19
verses.text: I ari supi ong Episus, pwilikidi ong ira wasa o, a pein i kotilong ong nan sinakoke o kaparok ong Sus oko.

verses.name: Acts 18:20
verses.text: Irail poeki i, en mimieta re ’rail ansau warai, a sota kotin duki ong.

verses.name: Acts 18:21
verses.text: O a kotin kamurimuri ong irail masani: I udan iang kamadip kokodo nan Ierusalem. A ma Kot pan kotin mueid ong ia, i pan pure dong komail. A ap kotin masel sang Episus.

verses.name: Acts 18:22
verses.text: A lao kotin keredi Säsarea, ap kotidala ranamau ong momodisou ap kotilang Antiokien.

verses.name: Acts 18:23
verses.text: A kotikot wasa o ansau kis, ap kotila kakan sili nan wein Kalatia, o Prikien, kakelada tounpadak kan karos.

verses.name: Acts 18:24
verses.text: A men Sus amen, me ad a Apolus, me tikidar Aleksandrien, iei ol kadek lokaia, o me ereki kisin likau kan, a ko dong Episus.

verses.name: Acts 18:25
verses.text: Men et aleer padak ni al en Kaun o, o a kelail ni ngen e, a padapadak o kaweweda mau meakan duen Iesus; a paptais en Ioanes me a asa.

verses.name: Acts 18:26
verses.text: I ari tapiada aima padapadak nan sinakoke. A Akwila o Prisila lao rong i, ap uke dong ira i, kawewe ong i al en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 18:27
verses.text: A lao men kola Akaia, saulang kai ap inting wong tounpadak kan, poeki re ’rail, ren kasamo i. I lao pwarado, ap sauasa irail, me poson kilar mak en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 18:28
verses.text: Pwe a manaman ong Sus akan, kasale ong irail sang kisin likau kan me Iesus me Kristus.<div eID="gen2722" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.18"/>

verses.name: Acts 19:1
verses.text: A ni ansau Apolus mi Korint, Paulus kotin kakan sili sap en pali poa kan, ap lele dong Episus wasa a diarada tounpadak kai.

verses.name: Acts 19:2
verses.text: A kotin masani ong irail: Komail aleer Ngen saraui ni omail posonlar? Irail potoan ong i: Se sota man rong, me Ngen saraui mia.

verses.name: Acts 19:3
verses.text: A ap kotin masani: A is, me komail paptais ong? Irail inda: Ong paptais en Ioanes.

verses.name: Acts 19:4
verses.text: Paulus masani: Ioanes paptais ki paptais en kalula, ni a masani ong aramas akan, me ren poson i me pan pwarado mur i, i Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 19:5
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar met, re ap paptais ong mar en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 19:6
verses.text: Paulus lao kotin pwil po ’rail lim a kan, Ngen saraui ap kotidi po ’rail, irail ari lokaia ngil toror pasang o deideikop.

verses.name: Acts 19:7
verses.text: A ir ol oko me ekriamen.

verses.name: Acts 19:8
verses.text: I ari kotin purepure nan sinakoke o aima padapadak saunipong silu, kapakaparok o kawewedar meakan duen wein Kot.

verses.name: Acts 19:9
verses.text: A akai lao kapitakailar, o so poson, o lokelokaia sued ong aramas akan duen lamalam, a ap saupei sang irail o katorela tounpadak kan, o padapadaki ong irail nan im en padak en Tiranus

verses.name: Acts 19:10
verses.text: Mepukat wiauier saunpar riau; toun Asien karos ari rongada masan en Kaun o, men Sus o men Krik karos.

verses.name: Acts 19:11
verses.text: O Kot me kotin wia kida lim en Paulus manaman kapuriamui akan.

verses.name: Acts 19:12
verses.text: Re pil aleer lim en pudo o likau moa sang pali war a, pwilikidi ong me somau kan, somau o ap sare sang, o ngen sued akan keredi sang.

verses.name: Acts 19:13
verses.text: Men Sus widingok kai, me kin koko sili kati ani, ap song sakaraki dong irail, me tanwar en ngen sued kai, mar en Kaun Iesus, indada: Kit kaukilang komail Iesus, me Paulus kin padapadak due.

verses.name: Acts 19:14
verses.text: A ol isimen mia nain samaro lapalap Skepas, ol en Sus amen, me wiadar mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 19:15
verses.text: A ngen sued sapeng irail indada: I asa Iesus, o i asa duen Paulus, a komail, is komail?

verses.name: Acts 19:16
verses.text: A aramas o, me ngen sued mi poa, ap luse dong irail o kaloe irail edi. Ir ari tanga sang nan im o kiliso o kili olar.

verses.name: Acts 19:17
verses.text: A met lok sili ren men Sus o Krik akan, me kauson Episus. O masak kipa irail edi, o mar en Kaun Iesus me lomuinlar kaualap.

verses.name: Acts 19:18
verses.text: O me iang posonlar me toto kodo weokadar o kasaledar arail wiawia kan.

verses.name: Acts 19:19
verses.text: O pil me toto, me kati ani, wa pena nairail puk o isik ir ada mon karos; ir ari wadok pwain ar o diar, me a dok ong moni limenen.

verses.name: Acts 19:20
verses.text: Masan en Kaun ari pwaidar kaualap.

verses.name: Acts 19:21
verses.text: Murin mepukat Paulus ap kotin inong iong ni ngen e kakan sili wein Masetonien o Akaia, ap kotilang Ierusalem masanidar: I lao milar wasa o, i pil pan kilang Rom.

verses.name: Acts 19:22
verses.text: I ari kadarala Masetonien riamen, kisan me papa i: Timoteus o Erastus. A pein i kotikoteta mas nan Asien.

verses.name: Acts 19:23
verses.text: I ansau me moromorong laud wiauier pweki lamalam.

verses.name: Acts 19:24
verses.text: Pwe amen, me ad a Demetrius, saunmata amen, me kin wiada im en kaudok silper kan ong Diana, me kare ong irail, me kin wiawiada, moni toto.

verses.name: Acts 19:25
verses.text: I ap kapokon irail pena o toun dodok en song ota indada: Maing ko, komail asa, me dodok wet meid kadepa ong kitail, pwe i me kitail kapwapwaki.

verses.name: Acts 19:26
verses.text: A komail kilekilang o rongerong, me Paulus men et kin kaloedi o kawukila aramas toto a kaidin nan Episus eta, pwe pil koren iong nan Asien pon, ni a kin padaki ong aramas akan, me dene kaidin irail kot akan, me wiaui pan pa en aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 19:27
verses.text: Mepukat meid apwal ong kitail. Pwe kaidin atail dodok eta me pan kamala, pwe pil im kaudok en kot Diana lapalap o a lingan, me toun Asien o sappa karos kin kaudoki ong pan sorela.

verses.name: Acts 19:28
verses.text: Irail lao ronger mepukat, re ap makara kida kaualap o weriweradar indada: Meid lapalap Diana en men Episus!

verses.name: Acts 19:29
verses.text: A karos toun kanim o ap pingidar, wiaki eu, tangalang im en madong, tangaki Kaios o Aristarkus men Masetonien, me waroki ong Paulus oko.

verses.name: Acts 19:30
verses.text: A Paulus lao pan kotilong nan pokon o, tounpadak kan ap sota mueid ong i.

verses.name: Acts 19:31
verses.text: O saumas en Asien kai, me kompokepa kan, ilake dong i, panaui i, ender kotilang im en madong o.

verses.name: Acts 19:32
verses.text: Ari, akai wia eu song en lokaia, a akai eu, pwe pokon o pingidar. A me toto re ’rail sasa karep en ar pokon pena.

verses.name: Acts 19:33
verses.text: Irail sikon sang nan pokon o Aleksander; Sus oko me sikonla i. A Aleksander olol ong irail, ap men sapeng pokon o.

verses.name: Acts 19:34
verses.text: Irail lao asa, me i kisan Sus oko, re ap wiaki eu weriwerada auer riau: Meid lapalap Diana en men Episus!

verses.name: Acts 19:35
verses.text: A sauninting en kanim o lao kadukiedi pokon o, ap indada: Komail ol oko en Episus, is aramas, me sasa, me kanim en men Episus kin kaukaudoki ong Diana lapalap o dikedik, me pupedi sang nanlang?

verses.name: Acts 19:36
verses.text: A ma sota, me pan kak kalikame mepukat, komail en nenenla o der wiada me sapung!

verses.name: Acts 19:37
verses.text: Pwe komail ukedo ol pukat, me sota kin kuliada im en kaudok o, pil sota lalaue omail kot li.

verses.name: Acts 19:38
verses.text: A ma Demetrius o iang a kan mauki meakot ren amen, kapung ap pan wiaui, pwe saunkapung kai mia, ren kapukapung re ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 19:39
verses.text: A ma komail mauki eu song toror, i me pan kapungala nan kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 19:40
verses.text: Pwe kitail pan pukoki morong en ran wet, pwe sota karepen, me kitail en kapungki pokon wet ar tangatang pena.

verses.name: Acts 19:41
verses.text: A lao masani ong irail mepukat, ap kadar pasang pokon o.<div eID="gen2723" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.19"/>

verses.name: Acts 20:1
verses.text: MORONG lao dukedier, Paulus ap molipe pena tounpadak kan, ap kotin kamurimuri ong irail o kotila, pwen sailokelang Masetonien.

verses.name: Acts 20:2
verses.text: A lao kakan sili sap oko, o panapanaui irail kaualap, ap kotilang wein Krik.

verses.name: Acts 20:3
verses.text: A lao kotikot wasa o saunipong silu, ap men kotilang Sirien, ari so, a kotin pure dong Masetonien, pwe Sus oko masamasan i.

verses.name: Acts 20:4
verses.text: A iet akan, me likid i lel Asien: Sopater nain Pirus men Peröa, a Aristarkus o Sekundus men Tesalonik, a Kaius men Derpe, o Timoteus, o Tikikus, o Tropimus men Asien.

verses.name: Acts 20:5
verses.text: Mepukat tiong mas ap aui kit nan Troas.

verses.name: Acts 20:6
verses.text: Murin kamadip en prot somut se serok wei sang Pilipi, tangatangki ran limau kokola re ’rail Troas, wasa se mimi ia ran isu.

verses.name: Acts 20:7
verses.text: A ni ran kaieu en wik, ni at pokon pena, pwen pilitiki pena prot, Paulus ap kotin padaki ong irail. A mandan ran o a pan samala. A kotin kawarailar a padak lao lel ailep en pong.

verses.name: Acts 20:8
verses.text: A lamp toto mi nan kokon poa, wasa se pokon pena ia.

verses.name: Acts 20:9
verses.text: A manakap amen, me ad a Eutikus, me momod nan wanimtuk, me mair kalikala. A ni en Paulus a padak warai, i ari mair kalikala melel, ap pupedi sang ni kasilu en kokon poa, o re pokada, a melar.

verses.name: Acts 20:10
verses.text: A Paulus me kotidi kipedi ong poa o polodi i masani: Komail der mauk, pwe a memaur!

verses.name: Acts 20:11
verses.text: I lao kotidala o pilitiki pena prot, o konoter, o padapadak warai lao lel wasa ran, ap kotilar.

verses.name: Acts 20:12
verses.text: A irail wado manakap memaur ap pereperen kaualap.

verses.name: Acts 20:13
verses.text: A kit me madang iang sop o, tangatang kolang Asos, wasa se pan uk ia Paulus, pwe i me a kakalik ong kit. A pein i pan sapal.

verses.name: Acts 20:14
verses.text: A lao tu ong kit nan Asos, se ap uk i, tangalang Mitelene.

verses.name: Acts 20:15
verses.text: Kit tangatang kodo sang wasa o, a manda se lel ong likin Kios, o manda se lele dong Samos, o se mondi Trokilion, a manda se pwara dong Miletus.

verses.name: Acts 20:16
verses.text: Pwe Paulus kileledier en dauli Episus, pwe a der pwapwand nan Asien, pwe a kotin karawaru, ma a pan kak, a pan lel ong Ierusalem ni ran en Pentikos.

verses.name: Acts 20:17
verses.text: A sang Miletus a kotin ilakilang Episus molipe saunkoa en momodisou kan.

verses.name: Acts 20:18
verses.text: Irail lao pwara dong i, a kotin masani ong irail: Komail asa duen ai wiawia re omail ansau karos sang ni tapin ran o, me i lel Asien,

verses.name: Acts 20:19
verses.text: Duen i papa Kaun o ni aktikitik, o sangesang, o kamekam nan pung en Sus oko, ni ar rukiruki ia di.

verses.name: Acts 20:20
verses.text: O duen i sota oki sanger meakot me katepan, pwe i kaireki komail karos, o padapadaki komail sansal o nan im akan.

verses.name: Acts 20:21
verses.text: O i kadede ong men Sus o pil men Krik kalula ong Kot o poson atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 20:22
verses.text: A kilang, i ap kokodalang Ierusalem, ngen i salidi o i sasa, da me pan pid ia wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 20:23
verses.text: A Ngen saraui kin kotin kadede ong ia nan kanim karos, me sal akan o kamekam kin auiaui ia.

verses.name: Acts 20:24
verses.text: Ari so, i sota kin insenoki mepukat, i pil sota kasampwaleki maur i, pwe i en kaimwisokela ai koa dodok, me i aleer sang ren Kaun Iesus, en kadede rongamau en mak en Kot.

verses.name: Acts 20:25
verses.text: A kilang, i ap asaer, me komail karos, me i padapadaki onger wein Kot, pan solar udial mas ai.

verses.name: Acts 20:26
verses.text: I me i kadede ong komail ran wet, me i makelekel sang ntan komail karos.

verses.name: Acts 20:27
verses.text: Pwe i padaki ong komail duen kupur en Kot, o sota man meakot me i okisang komail.

verses.name: Acts 20:28
verses.text: Komail ari kalaka komail o momodisou karos wasa, me Ngen saraui kotin kasapwil komail dang silepa ko, pwen apapwali momodisou en Kot me a kotin pwainiki pein nta.

verses.name: Acts 20:29
verses.text: Pwe i asaer, me murin ai samalar kidi komad akai pan pwara dong komail, me sota pan kasampwaleki pwin o.

verses.name: Acts 20:30
verses.text: A ol akai pan uda sang nan pein komail, me pan padak sapung, pwen wiaki tounpadak kan pein ar warok kan.

verses.name: Acts 20:31
verses.text: Komail ari masamasan o tamanda, me i sota dukedi, panaui amen amen, sangesang ni ran ni pong saunpar silu.

verses.name: Acts 20:32
verses.text: Ari, i pan mueid ong komail Kot o masan en kupur a, me manaman ong kapwai komail ada, o kotiki ong komail soso eu ren me saraui kan.

verses.name: Acts 20:33
verses.text: I sota noroke en amen a silper, de kold, de likau.

verses.name: Acts 20:34
verses.text: Pein komail asa, me pa i kat kin papa ia o ai warok kan.

verses.name: Acts 20:35
verses.text: I kasale ong komail er meakan duen komail en dodok, pwen sauasa me luet akan o tamatamanda masan en Kaun Iesus akan, duen a pein kotin masani: Kiki wei me kaperen sang ale.

verses.name: Acts 20:36
verses.text: A lao kotin masanier mepukat, a kelepuki iang irail karos kapakap.

verses.name: Acts 20:37
verses.text: Irail ari sangesang kaualap o polodi tapin wor en Paulus o metik i.

verses.name: Acts 20:38
verses.text: Re insensuedekier kaualap a masan, me dene re solar pan udial silang i. Irail ari likid i koti ong pon sop o.<div eID="gen2724" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.20"/>

verses.name: Acts 21:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO kit lao maselwei sang murin at kamurimuri ong irail se tangatang inen wong Kus, a manda lel ong Rodus, a sang wasa o se tangalang Patara.

verses.name: Acts 21:2
verses.text: Kit lao diaradar sop pot, me pan kola Pönisien, se ap keredang poa maselwei.

verses.name: Acts 21:3
verses.text: Kit lao kilanger Sipern, se dauli ni pali maun, tangatang kolang Sirien ap supi ong Tirus, pwe i wasa audepan sop o pan pwilidi ia.

verses.name: Acts 21:4
verses.text: Se lao diaradar tounpadak kan, kit ap mimieta wasa o ran isu. Irail ap masanki Ngen, Paulus ender kodalang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 21:5
verses.text: Kadekadeo kit lao kaimwisokila ran oko, se ap masel kokola. Irail karos me likid kit lel likin kanim, li o seri kan pil iang; kit ap kelepuki ni oror, o kapakap.

verses.name: Acts 21:6
verses.text: Kit lao kamurimur pena, se ap kereda pon sop o, a irail purelang deu ’rail.

verses.name: Acts 21:7
verses.text: Kit tangatang kodo sang Tirus ap ko dong Ptolomais; kit ap ranamaui saulang kan o kairu re ’rail ran eu.

verses.name: Acts 21:8
verses.text: A mandan ran o se maseler, ap lel ong Säsarea, kit ap pedelong ong nan im en saunpadak Pilipus, me kisan isimen oko, o mimieta re a.

verses.name: Acts 21:9
verses.text: A men et na seripein makelekel pamen mia, me kin deideikop.

verses.name: Acts 21:10
verses.text: A ni at kaukauson wasa o ran toto, saukop amen ap kodido sang Iudäa, me ad a Akapus.

verses.name: Acts 21:11
verses.text: A lao pwara dong kit, ap ale sapwilim en Paulus pirapir pira pena pein pa a o nä a kan, katitiki: Iet me Ngen saraui kotin masani: Iet duen men Sus oko, me mi Ierusalem, pan saliedi ol o, me a pirapir wet, o pangalang i nan pa en men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 21:12
verses.text: Kit lao rongada mepukat, kit o pil irail karos toun wasa o ap poekipoeki a ender kotidalang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 21:13
verses.text: A Paulus kotin sapeng: Da me komail sangesangki o kawekila nan mongiong i? Pwe kaidin salidi eta, me i kak ong, pwe pil mela nan Ierusalem pweki mar en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: Acts 21:14
verses.text: A lao sota duki ong, kit ap nenenla indada: Kupur en Kaun o en pwaida.

verses.name: Acts 21:15
verses.text: Murin ran pukat se ki pena at kapwa kan o daululang Ierusalem.

verses.name: Acts 21:16
verses.text: A tounpadak en Säsarea kai pil iang kit, o re ukado Mnason men Sipern, tounpadak ma amen, me se pan kairu re a.

verses.name: Acts 21:17
verses.text: Kit lao lel Ierusalem, saulang kan kasamo kit popol.

verses.name: Acts 21:18
verses.text: A mandan ran o Paulus iang kit kotila ren Iakopus o saunkoa karos pokon pena wasa o.

verses.name: Acts 21:19
verses.text: A lao ranmaui irail, ap kotin kasokasoia meakan, me Kot kotin wiai ong men liki kan ki a dodok.

verses.name: Acts 21:20
verses.text: Irail lao rongadar mepukat, re ap kapingaki Kot indai ong i: Ri at, kilang men Sus me totoia me iang posonlar, o irail karos kin kasampwaleki kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 21:21
verses.text: Nan a loki ong irail duen komui, me dene komui kin kaukawewe men Sus, me dondole men liki kan, ren kasela Moses o padapadaki, re ender sirkomsais seri kan, o pil der dadaur tiak kan.

verses.name: Acts 21:22
verses.text: A iaduen, pokon pan wiaui, o re pan rongada, me komui samador.

verses.name: Acts 21:23
verses.text: Ari, komui pan wiada met, me se pan indai ong komui: Ol pamen mi re at, me ar inau mia.

verses.name: Acts 21:24
verses.text: Uk irail ada o kamakelekel komui da iangaki irail, o pwain irail pwe mong arail en seisei, o karos pan kilang, me likam pot, me re ronger duen komui, o me komui pil kin kapwaiada kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 21:25
verses.text: A duen me posonlar sang ren men liki kan, se intingiedier o kusoned edar, me ren der kapwaiada mepukat. A iet eta: Ren liki sang uduk me mairong ong kot likam, o nta, o man mopelar, o nenek.

verses.name: Acts 21:26
verses.text: Paulus ap kotin ukada ol oko, a manda a kamakelekelada pein i ap iang irail kotilong ong nan im en kaudok o kotin kasaledar ran en arail kamakelekel, lel mairong en amen amen wiauier.

verses.name: Acts 21:27
verses.text: A ran isu lao koren iong nikier, men Sus en Asien ap kilanger i nan im en kaudok o, rap kamoromoroda aramas karos o saikidi i,

verses.name: Acts 21:28
verses.text: Weriwerada indada: Ol en Israel, komail sauasa, iet aramas o me kin kaukawewe ong karos wasa karos, ren palian Sus akan, o kapung, o wasa kis et, o a pil kalua dong nan im en kaudok men Krik kai, o kasaminela wasa saraui wet.

verses.name: Acts 21:29
verses.text: Pwe mas o re kilangadar, me Tropimus men Episus iang i nan kanim o, re ap kiki ong, me Paulus kalualong ong i nan im en kaudok.

verses.name: Acts 21:30
verses.text: A kanim o moromorongada kaualap o aramas akan tang pena. Re ap saikidi Paulus o waike sang i nan im en kaudok o, a wanim ko ap madang ritidi.

verses.name: Acts 21:31
verses.text: Irail pan kamela i, a rong ap lel ong saumas en saunpei kan, me Ierusalem moromorongda.

verses.name: Acts 21:32
verses.text: I ari madang ukada saunpei o saumas akai ap tangadi wong irail. Ir lao kilang saumas o saunpei ko, re ap solar woki Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 21:33
verses.text: Saumas o ap kai ong, koledi i masani, i en salikidi sal mata riapot, o idok: Is i, o da me a wiadar?

verses.name: Acts 21:34
verses.text: A akai sang nan pokon o weriwer wiada eu song en lokaia a akai eu. A ni a sota kak weweki, me re moromorongki, ap masani, a en wisikelang nan im en saunpei.

verses.name: Acts 21:35
verses.text: A lao lel ong kandake o, saunpei ap wewa i, pweki pokon o koiden pena i.

verses.name: Acts 21:36
verses.text: Pwe pokon o, me idauen, weriwer indada: Siken wei i!

verses.name: Acts 21:37
verses.text: A ni en Paulus a pan wisikelong ong nan im en saunpei, a ap masani ong kaun lapalap o: A sota muei ong ia, en indang komui meakot? A ap masani: Komui asa lokaia en Krik?

verses.name: Acts 21:38
verses.text: Ari, kaidin komui ol en Äkipten, me kapeida aramas oko mon ran akai, ap kalualang sap tan ol lolap pakid?

verses.name: Acts 21:39
verses.text: A Paulus masani: Ngai ol en Sus amen, men Tarsus, kanim indand en Silisia eu, i men poeki re omui, en mueid ong ia, en kapakaparok ong aramas pukat.

verses.name: Acts 21:40
verses.text: I ari mueid ong i. Paulus ap kotida pon kandake o olol ong aramas akan. A lao molelar kaualap, Paulus ap kaparok ong irail ni ngor en Ipru masani:<div eID="gen2725" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.21"/>

verses.name: Acts 22:1
verses.text: RI ai ko, sam ai ko komail, rong mas ai sapeng komail.

verses.name: Acts 22:2
verses.text: Irail lao ronger, me a masani ong irail ni lokaia en Ipru, re ap nenenla kaualap. I ari kotin masani.

verses.name: Acts 22:3
verses.text: Ol en Sus amen ngai, me tikidar Tarsus en Silisia, a i kakairida nan kanim wet ni aluwilu en Kamaliel, padapadakki kapung en sam atail akan, o nantiong pongipongi Kot dueta komail kin wia ran wet.

verses.name: Acts 22:4
verses.text: O i kawelar al pot et lel ong kamelar aramas, ni ai saliedi o pangalang imateng ol o li akan.

verses.name: Acts 22:5
verses.text: Pwe iduen me samero lapalap o saumas akan kin kadede kin ia, pwe i aleer sang irail kisin likau, ong ri (atail) akan. I ap kolang Damaskus, pwen pil saliedi o wa dong Ierusalem, me mi wasa o, pwe ren kamekame.

verses.name: Acts 22:6
verses.text: A ni ai koko wei korendor Damaskus, nin sauas, marain eu kodido sang nanlang, sare ia da.

verses.name: Acts 22:7
verses.text: Ngai ari pupedi nani pwel o rongada ngil eu, me masani ong ia: Saul, Saul, da me koe kame kin ia?

verses.name: Acts 22:8
verses.text: Ngai ari potoan ong: Is komui Maing? A kotin masani ong ia: Ngai Iesus en Nasaret, me koe kin kame.

verses.name: Acts 22:9
verses.text: A me iang ia udialer marain o, ap masapwekadar, a re sota rong kapit en me masan dong ia.

verses.name: Acts 22:10
verses.text: Ngai potoan ong: Da me i en wiada Maing? Kaun o ap kotin masani ong ia: Paurida u kowei ong Damaskus, nan a pan kapare ong uk wasa o, me kaonop ong uk er, en wiada.

verses.name: Acts 22:11
verses.text: A i solar kak kilang wasa, aki lingan en marain o, i ap daululang Damaskus; me iang ia kalua kin ia pa i.

verses.name: Acts 22:12
verses.text: Ananias, ol lelapok amen duen kapung o, me kalok mau sili ren Sus akan karos, me kauson wasa o,

verses.name: Acts 22:13
verses.text: Ap ko dong ia kasikasinen imp ai indai ong ia: Ri ai Saulus, kilangada wasa! Ari, ni auer ota i saradang i.

verses.name: Acts 22:14
verses.text: I ari katitiki: Kot en sam atail akan, me pil uk adar, pwe koe en lolekongki a kupur, o udial me Pung o, o rong kapit en silang i.

verses.name: Acts 22:15
verses.text: Pwe koe pan sapwilim a saunkadede ong aramas karos, duen me koe kilangadar o rongadar.

verses.name: Acts 22:16
verses.text: Ari, da me koe auiaui? Paurida o paptaisela, pwe dip om akan en widen sang, o sakarkidang mar a.

verses.name: Acts 22:17
verses.text: A kadekadeo i lao pwara dong Ierusalem o kapakap nan im en kaudok o, i ap wukilar.

verses.name: Acts 22:18
verses.text: O i kilang i, me kotin masani ong ia: Kanangata, madanga wei sang Ierusalem, pwe irail sota pang duki ong om kadede kin ia.

verses.name: Acts 22:19
verses.text: Ngai ari potoan ong: Maing, pein irail asa, me i pangalang nan imateng o woki nan sinakoke kan me kin poson komui.

verses.name: Acts 22:20
verses.text: A ni sapwilim ar saunkadede Stepanus kamatalar, ngai pil u impa o peren kidar a kamatalar, nekinekid likau en me kamatalar i ko.

verses.name: Acts 22:21
verses.text: A ap kotin masani ong ia: U ko wei, pwe I pan kadar uk ala wasa doo ren men liki kan.

verses.name: Acts 22:22
verses.text: Irail rongerong i lel ong masan pot et, ap ngil laudeda indada: Siken wei sang sappa lap men et! Pwe a sota mau ong, i en memaureta!

verses.name: Acts 22:23
verses.text: A ni arail weriwerada, o kaselar ar likau, o kasadar pwel par,

verses.name: Acts 22:24
verses.text: Kaun lapalap o ap masani, i en wisikelang nan im en saunpei o masani, ren woki i, pwe i en lelapok kila, da me re weiweilokeki i.

verses.name: Acts 22:25
verses.text: Irail lao saliedi i, Paulus ap idok ren kaun o, me u impa: Me pung, en woki aramas en Rom amen, me kaikenta pakadeikadar?

verses.name: Acts 22:26
verses.text: Kaun o lao rongada met, ap kola ren kaun lapalap o indada: Da me kom pan wiada, pwe aramas men et men Rom amen.

verses.name: Acts 22:27
verses.text: Kaun lapalap o ap kodo indai ong i: Katitiki ong ia, ol en Rom amen komui? A sapeng: Ei.

verses.name: Acts 22:28
verses.text: Kaun lapalap o sapeng: Pwai laud me i saladok kilar. A Paulus masani: A ngai me tikidar saladok.

verses.name: Acts 22:29
verses.text: Me kodo kadeikada i, ap madang pure sang i, o kaun lapalap lao asadar, me i ol en Rom amen, a pil masakadar, pweki a saliedi i.

verses.name: Acts 22:30
verses.text: A mandan ran o a inong iong melel asa karep en Sus oko ar pangala i, ap lapwada i o kapokon pena samero lapalap o toun kapung o, ap wadila Paulus o kotikidi ong i mo ’rail.<div eID="gen2726" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.22"/>

verses.name: Acts 23:1
verses.text: A PAULUS kotin aupwil sili nan kapung o ap masani: Ri ai ko, i dadaurata me mau ong Kot lao lel ran wet.

verses.name: Acts 23:2
verses.text: A samero lapalap Ananias masani ong men impa, ren pikir au a.

verses.name: Acts 23:3
verses.text: Paulus ap masani ong i: Kot pan kotin pikir uk malaun men koe, pwe koe momod wasa en, en kadeik ia da duen kapung o, ap tiakedi kapung o ni om indada, ren pikir ia.

verses.name: Acts 23:4
verses.text: A men impa indada: Koe pan lalaue sapwilim en Kot a samero lapalap?

verses.name: Acts 23:5
verses.text: Paulus ap masanier: Ri ai ko, i sasa, me i samero lapalap o, pwe a intingidier: Koe der nan au sued duen omail kaun lapalap o!

verses.name: Acts 23:6
verses.text: A Paulus lao diaradar, me akai irail Sadusär, a akai Parisär, ap kapitie laud nan kapung o masani: Ri ai ko, ngai Parisär amen o nain Parisär amen, ai kaporopor en me melar akan ar pan maureda, i me i pan pakadeikada.

verses.name: Acts 23:7
verses.text: A lao masanier met, Parisär o Sadusär akan ap akamai pena; ari momod o muei pasang.

verses.name: Acts 23:8
verses.text: Pwe Sadusär kin inda, me dene sota me pan maureda, o pil dene sota tounlang, pil so ngen, a Parisär kin kamelele karos.

verses.name: Acts 23:9
verses.text: A weriwer laud wiauier. A saunkawewe kan, me kisan Parisär kasinenda kaparok katitiki: Sota me sued kot en aramas men et, me se diar. A ma ngen eu de tounlang amen masani ong i, kitail der palian Kot!

verses.name: Acts 23:10
verses.text: A lao moromorong kaualap, kaun lapalap o ap masak, me Paulus pan dapenok pasang, ap masani, me saunpei kai en kodilan koledi i, wado sang nan pung ar o wa dong nan im en saunpei.

verses.name: Acts 23:11
verses.text: A pong pena sang ran o kaun o kotikot re a masani: Kaporopor mau, pwe duen om kadede ia nan Ierusalem, iduen koe pil pan kadede ia nan Rom.

verses.name: Acts 23:12
verses.text: A lao ran pasang, Sus akai ap inauki pena o kaukila, me re pan solar kang o nim meakot, re lao kamelar Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 23:13
verses.text: A irail, me wiadar inau wet, me paek sama.

verses.name: Acts 23:14
verses.text: Irail kodo ren samero lapalap o saumas akan katitiki: Se inauki pena o kaukila, me se solar pan kang o nim meakot, se lao kamelar Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 23:15
verses.text: Komail o toun kapung ari poeki ren kaun lapalap o, a en kadara dong komail i. Dene komail pan raparapaki melel re a, a kit pan masamasan kamela i, mon a pan pwara dong komail.

verses.name: Acts 23:16
verses.text: A wawan Paulus seri amen lao ronger ar ruki i, ap pedelong ong im en saunpei kai kaireki Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 23:17
verses.text: Paulus ap ekeredo kaun amen, masani ong i: Kare wong manakap men et ren kaun lapalap o, pwe meakot mia, me a men kaireki i.

verses.name: Acts 23:18
verses.text: I ari ukada i kare wong i ren kaun lapalap o indada: Paulus me salidi, eker ia dong i o poeki re i, i en wa dong komui manakap men et, pwe meakot mia, me a men kaire kin komui.

verses.name: Acts 23:19
verses.text: Kaun lapalap ap koledi pa a o koieila wasa rir kalelapok: Da me koe men kaire kin ia?

verses.name: Acts 23:20
verses.text: I ari katitiki: Sus akai inauki pena, en poeki re omui, en kadara dong kapung Paulus lakap, dene komui men pur ong raparapaki mau due.

verses.name: Acts 23:21
verses.text: A komui der duki ong irail, pwe ol paek sama, me rukiruki i, me inauki pena o kaukilar, me re solar pan kang o nim re lao kamela i. A irail auiaui ansau wet, me komui en mueid ong irail i.

verses.name: Acts 23:22
verses.text: Kaun lapalap o ap kadarala manakap o masani ong i: Der indang meamen, me koe kaire kin ia met!

verses.name: Acts 23:23
verses.text: A lao ekeredor kaun riamen, ap masani: Kaonopada saunpei riepuki, pwen kola Säsarea, o pil me dake os isiakan, o me wa katieu riepuki sang ni klok duau en pongpong wet.

verses.name: Acts 23:24
verses.text: O pil kaonopada man akai, me re en kida poa Paulus, o ren kanakanai ong walang i ren kopina Peliks.

verses.name: Acts 23:25
verses.text: A pil intingiedier kisin likau duen met:

verses.name: Acts 23:26
verses.text: Ngai Klaudius Lisias kadar wong komui maing kopina Peliks ai ranamau.

verses.name: Acts 23:27
verses.text: Ol men et, me Sus oko saikidier, o metar kis a pan kamela re ’rail. A ngai ukada saunpei kei dorela i ni ai rongada, me i men Rom amen.

verses.name: Acts 23:28
verses.text: A ni ai men kalelapok, da me re weiweilokedi i, i ap wadila ren ar kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 23:29
verses.text: Ngai ari diaradar, me a pangpangala pweki peidok en ar kapung. A sota me i diar, me a pun kak kame kila de salikidi.

verses.name: Acts 23:30
verses.text: I lao asadar, me Sus oko rukiruki ol o, i ap madang kadar wong komui i, o i kakaliki ong me pangala i kai, en kaireki wong komui duen i. Ran kaselel!

verses.name: Acts 23:31
verses.text: Saunpei ko ap ukada Paulus kalua i Antipatris ni pong o duen a kawad kin irail.

verses.name: Acts 23:32
verses.text: Mandan ran o re ki ong me dake os akan, ren wala i, ap purelang im en saunpei.

verses.name: Acts 23:33
verses.text: Mepukat lao lel ong Säsarea, ap ki ong kisin likau ren kopina, o pil kasale ong i Paulus.

verses.name: Acts 23:34
verses.text: A lao wadoker o idok, menia i, o mangier, me a kisan men Silisia, ap masani:

verses.name: Acts 23:35
verses.text: I pan rong uk, lao me pang uk ala pil pwarador. I ari masani, i en nekinek nan tanpas en Erodes.<div eID="gen2727" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.23"/>

verses.name: Acts 24:1
verses.text: A MURIN ran limau samero lapalap Ananias kotido iangaki saumas akai, o saunlokaia men, me ad a Tertulus; irail weiweiloke Paulus ren kopina.

verses.name: Acts 24:2
verses.text: A lao wisikedo, Tertulus ap pikikidi weiweiloke i indada:

verses.name: Acts 24:3
verses.text: Kit asaer duen muein popol re omui o duen kamau toto kan ong toun wei wet, pweki omui kalangan maing Peliks. O i me se kapikapinga kin komui ansau o wasa karos.

verses.name: Acts 24:4
verses.text: A i sota men kapangai komui, iet eta me i poeki re omui: Komui en kotin mangi kit duen omui kalangan.

verses.name: Acts 24:5
verses.text: Pwe se diaradar, me ol men et me morsued o me kin kapeida Sus akan karos, me mi sappa, o i me saumas en pwin likam en Nasaret,

verses.name: Acts 24:6
verses.text: Me pil song kasaminela im en kaudok o, i me se koledi i, pwen kadeikada, duen at kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 24:7
verses.text: A monsap Lisias kotin pwarado, kotiki sang i nan pa at ki a manaman lapalap,

verses.name: Acts 24:8
verses.text: Masani ong me weiweiloke i, en poto dong re omui, a komui lao kalekalelapok re irail, kom pan pein mangi duen meakan, me se pang kila i.

verses.name: Acts 24:9
verses.text: A Sus oko pil weiweiloke Paulus indada: Mepukat melel!

verses.name: Acts 24:10
verses.text: A kopina lao olol ong Paulus, en kaparok, a ap kotin sapeng masani: Ni ai asaer, me komui saunkapung pan toun wei wet saunpar toto, i peren kida, ai pan indinda duen pein ngai.

verses.name: Acts 24:11
verses.text: Pwe komui pan mangi, me pong ngaul ria pong eta, me i kodalang Ierusalem pwen kaudok.

verses.name: Acts 24:12
verses.text: A irail sota diar ia da lokaia ong amen nan im en kaudok, de kapeida aramas oko nan sinakoke kan de nan kanim o.

verses.name: Acts 24:13
verses.text: O re pil sota kak kadede, me re pang kin ia la met.

verses.name: Acts 24:14
verses.text: A iet eta, me i men kadede ong komui, ni ai kin kamelele karos, me intingidier nan saukop akan o kapung o, i kin kaudoki ong Kot en sam ai kan duen tiak en ir, me re kaadaneki pwin likam.

verses.name: Acts 24:15
verses.text: O i kaporoporeki Kot me irail pil kamelele me melar akan pan maureda, me pung o me sapung kan.

verses.name: Acts 24:16
verses.text: A i me i kin sosongki pein ngai, pwe lol i en pung mon Kot o aramas akan.

verses.name: Acts 24:17
verses.text: A murin par toto i kodon wa dong toun sap wet kisakis eu o wiadar mairong.

verses.name: Acts 24:18
verses.text: I ansau, me re diar ia makelekeladar nan im en kaudok o sota weriwer de moromorong.

verses.name: Acts 24:19
verses.text: A ir pukat Sus akai nan Asien menda re sota mi met mo ’mui, kadede ngai, ma re diar me sued kot re i?

verses.name: Acts 24:20
verses.text: De mepukat en pein kasansaleda sapung da, me re diar re i ni ai mi mon kapung o.

verses.name: Acts 24:21
verses.text: A iet eta lepen lokaia, me i kida ni ai udar nan pung ar indada: En me melar akan ar pan maureda, i pan pakadeikki ran wet re omail.

verses.name: Acts 24:22
verses.text: A Peliks lao ereki mepukat, pwe a mangi mau duen al pot et, ap kasau ir wei masani: Kaun Lisias lao kotido, i ap pan kaimwisokela omail kapung.

verses.name: Acts 24:23
verses.text: I ap masani ong kaun en kolekol Paulus o kasaladokela i, o ender inapwiedi iang a kan, en kodon papa i.

verses.name: Acts 24:24
verses.text: A murin ran akai Peliks pwarado, a paud Drusila iang i, iei li en Sus amen, ap molipedo Paulus o karonge i duen lamalam en Kristus.

verses.name: Acts 24:25
verses.text: A ni a kapakaparok duen pung, o makelekel, o kadeik, me pan wiaui, Peliks ap masapwekadar o sapeng: U kowei ansau wet, i lao pisokalar, i pan eker uk do.

verses.name: Acts 24:26
verses.text: A pil kaporoporeki, me Paulus pan kotiki ong i moni, pwen lapwada i; i me a purepure ekeker kido i o kasokasoi ong i.

verses.name: Acts 24:27
verses.text: A murin par riau Porsius Pestus sapwiladar wiliandi Peliks. A Pelisk men konekon ren Sus oko, ap sota lapwada Paulus.<div eID="gen2728" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.24"/>

verses.name: Acts 25:1
verses.text: PESTUS lao pwarador nan wei, ap kotidalang Ierusalem sang Säsarea ni ran kasilu.

verses.name: Acts 25:2
verses.text: Samero lapalap o saumas akan en Sus oko ap pwara dong re a weiweiloke Paulus o poekipoeki re a,

verses.name: Acts 25:3
verses.text: O inong iong konekon re a, pwen palian Paulus, pwe a en wa dong Ierusalem i, a re masamasan i, pwen kamele ni a kotikot kodo.

verses.name: Acts 25:4
verses.text: A Pestus masani, me Paulus pan mimieta Säsarea, a pein i pan madang masel wei.

verses.name: Acts 25:5
verses.text: A me lapalap re omail pan kak iang ia kodila o kadede ol o, ma dip a mia.

verses.name: Acts 25:6
verses.text: A lao kotikot re ’rail pong walu pong de ngaul, ap kotidilang Säsarea o mandan ran o a kaipokedi pon mol en kadeik o masani, Paulus en wisikedo.

verses.name: Acts 25:7
verses.text: A lao pwarador, Sus oko, me kodido sang Ierusalem, ap kapil pena i o kadipe i kaualap, ap sota kak kadededa.

verses.name: Acts 25:8
verses.text: Pwe Paulus kotin sapen masani duen pein i: I sota wiadar dipi ong kapung en Sus oko, de ong im en kaudok o, de ong Sisa.

verses.name: Acts 25:9
verses.text: A Pestus men konekon ren Sus oko, ap sapeng Paulus masani: Koe men kodalang Ierusalem, pwen pakadeikada re i wasa o?

verses.name: Acts 25:10
verses.text: A Paulus kotin masani: I mi mon mol en kadeik en Sisa, wasa me mau ong, i en pakadeikada. Sota me sapung eu, me i wiai ong Sus oko, duen me pein komui mangi.

verses.name: Acts 25:11
verses.text: Ma i wiadar sapung eu de meakot me warong kamela, i sota pan kang mela. A ma so melel, me mepukat kine kin ia, sota me pan kak pang ia lang irail. I dorolang Sisa!

verses.name: Acts 25:12
verses.text: Pestus lao kalelapok ren momod en kadeik o, ap masani: Koe dorolang Sisa, ari koe pan pwarala ren Sisa.

verses.name: Acts 25:13
verses.text: Murin ran akai nanmarki Akripa o Pernise koti dong Säsarea, pwen ranamau ong Pestus.

verses.name: Acts 25:14
verses.text: Ira lao kotikot wasa o pong toto, Pestus ap kaireki nanmarki duen Paulus masani: Ol sensal amen mi met, me Peliks saliedi ap samalar.

verses.name: Acts 25:15
verses.text: A samero lapalap o saumas en Sus akan kaire kin ia duen i ni ai potopot Ierusalem inong iong i en kadeikada i.

verses.name: Acts 25:16
verses.text: A ngai sapeng irail: Kaidin duen tiak en men Rom, en pangala aramas amen, en kamela, mon me pangala i kan saikenta sansal mo a, o a muei ong i er, en sapeng duen me re pang kila i.

verses.name: Acts 25:17
verses.text: Irail lao pokon dong met, a mandan ran o i madang mondi pon mol en kadeik o inda, ol o en wisikedo.

verses.name: Acts 25:18
verses.text: A me pangala i kan lao pwarado, re sota katitiki mesued kot, duen i kiki ong.

verses.name: Acts 25:19
verses.text: A akai peipeidok mia duen pein arail lamalam o duen ol mela amen me ad a Iesus, me Paulus kin inda, me dene a memaureta.

verses.name: Acts 25:20
verses.text: Ngai ari poneponeki duen mepukat, i ap idok re a, ma a sota men kodalang Ierusalem, pwen pakadeikada wasa o duen mepukat.

verses.name: Acts 25:21
verses.text: A Paulus lao dorolang kadeik en Aukustus, ngai ap inda, ren koledi i, i lao kadarala i ren Sisa.

verses.name: Acts 25:22
verses.text: Akripa ap masani ong Pestus: I pil men rongerong aramas o. A masani: Lakap kom pan rong i.

verses.name: Acts 25:23
verses.text: A mandan ran o Akripa i Pernise lao kotin pwarado ni ar kapwat lingan kaualap o kotilong ong nan im en kapung, o ol lapalap akan iangaki kaun en kanim o, Pestus ap masani, Paulus en wisikedo.

verses.name: Acts 25:24
verses.text: A Pestus masani: Maing nanmarki Akripa o komail ol akan karos, me iang kit kotikot wasa et, komail masani, pweki men et, Sus akan karos kin poekipoeki re i nan Ierusalem o pil met; ni ar palian i indada, me dene a sowar ong memaureta.

verses.name: Acts 25:25
verses.text: A i lao diarada, me sota me a wiadar, me war ong kamela o pein i dorolang Aukustus, ngai ap kileledier me i pan kadarala i.

verses.name: Acts 25:26
verses.text: A sota me i asa, en intingiedi wong nai saupeidi. I me i waki dong komail i, mo ’mui ta maing nanmarki Akripa, pwe kapung lao nikier, i en asa, da me i en intingieki wei.

verses.name: Acts 25:27
verses.text: Pwe i lamelame, me sapung, en kadarala me salidi amen, ap sota kaireki duen karep en salidi.<div eID="gen2729" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Acts.25"/>

verses.name: Acts 26:1
verses.text: AKRIPA ap masani ong Paulus: Koe me saladoklar en kapakaparok ki pein uk. Paulus ap kapa wei lim a, kadededar pein i:

verses.name: Acts 26:2
verses.text: I ap peren kidar maing nanmarki Akripa, me i pan kapakaparok mo ’mui ran wet duen meakan, me Sus oko pang kin ia la,

verses.name: Acts 26:3
verses.text: Pwe komui me erekilar en Sus oko ar lamalam o peipeidok kan, i ap poeki re omui, en kotin kanongama mamangi ia.

verses.name: Acts 26:4
verses.text: Ai wiawia kan arain maur i, me tapida Ierusalem ren sau i kan, Sus akan karos asa due.

verses.name: Acts 26:5
verses.text: Irail me asa ia sang mas kokodo, ma re men kadede ia, me ngai kisan pwin kelail en at lamalam, me ad a Parisär.

verses.name: Acts 26:6
verses.text: Ngai ari mi mon kadeik, pweki ai kaporoporeki inau o, me Kot kotiki ong sam at akan.

verses.name: Acts 26:7
verses.text: Nan i inau o, me at kainok eisokriau kin kaporoporeki, me re pan pwaiki ong ar nantiong kaudok ong Kot ni ran o ni pong. Maing nanmarki Akripa iei kaporopor me i pang kila ren Sus oko.

verses.name: Acts 26:8
verses.text: Da me komail sota kamelele, me Kot kotin kaiasada me melar akan?

verses.name: Acts 26:9
verses.text: Mas o i kiki ong, me i en wiada meakan, me kaokaoe mar en Iesus en Nasaret.

verses.name: Acts 26:10
verses.text: I me i pil wiadar nan Ierusalem; o me saraui kan toto me i saliedier ong nan imateng murin ai aleer manaman sang ren samero lapalap akan o irail lao kamelar, ngai pil sauasa.

verses.name: Acts 26:11
verses.text: I kame irail pan pak toto nan sinakoke kan karos, o koidong ong irail, re en lalaue, o ngai lingarangar kaualap pa ’rail; i kin kame irail lel ong kanim en wai kan.

verses.name: Acts 26:12
