verses.name: I Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier: I pan tiakedi lolekong en me lolekong kan, o karotongala marain en me marain akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: Ia me lolekong o? O ia saunkawewe o? Ia me lolekong o en pali pa? Dadue, Kot sota wia lamponki me erpit en pali pa?

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: Aramas akan sota asa Kot pweki udan ar lolekong. Kot ap kupureda, en kamaur kida, me poson akan padak mongai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: Pwe Sus akan kin poeki kilel akan, a men Krik kin roporop lolekong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: A kit kin padaki Kristus me lopuedar, men kamakar ong Sus akan o ong men liki kan kasoi mal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: A ong me paeker akan, men Sus o pil men Krik, se kaweweda Kristus manaman en Kot o erpit en Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:25
verses.text: Pwe soerpit en Kot me sikida sang en aramas akan ar lolekong, o luet en Kot me kelail sang en aramas akan ar kelail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:26
verses.text: Ri ai kan, komail kilang duen omail paeker. Pwe kaidin me toto ren me lolekong en pali uduk kan. Pil kaidin me toto ren me poe kan, pil kaidin toto ren me masamas akan, me pilipildar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:27
verses.text: A Kot kotin piladar me so lolekong nin sappa, pwen kapouiala me lolekong kan; o Kot me kotin piladar me luet nin sappa kan, pwen kapouiala me kelail akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:28
verses.text: O me mal nin sappa, o me so konekon, i me Kot kotin piladar, o me sota meakot, pwen kawela me lapalap.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:29
verses.text: Pwe uduk der aksuaiki mon Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:30
verses.text: A komail tapi sang i ren Kristus Iesus, me wialar atail erpit sang ren Kot, o pung, o saraui, o maur patail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:31
verses.text: Pwe duen a intingidier: Me men suaiki, i en suaiki Kaun o.<div eID="gen2751" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.1"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: RI ai kan, ni ai pwara wong komail er, kaidin ni kadek lokaia de lolekong en aramas, me i padaki ong komail er kadede en Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: Pwe i sota wia kin ia, en asa meakot nan pung omail, Iesus Kristus eta o a kalopuela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: O ngai mimi re omail ni ai luet, o masak, o rerer toto.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: O ai kasoi o ai padak kaidin ni kadek lokaia en lolekong, a ni kadede en Ngen o manaman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: Pwe omail poson de pasoneki lolekong en aramas akan, a manaman en Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: Ari so, me kit kin padapadaki me lolekong ren me unsok kan, a kaidin lolekong en sappa et, o pil kaidin en saupeidi kan en sappa et, me pan sarodi,

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: A kit kin padaki duen erpit en Kot me rir, iei me so sansal, me Kot kotin kileledier ni en sappa saik mia, pwen kalinganada kitail,

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:8
verses.text: Me sota saupeidi en sappa men asadar, pwe ma re asaer i, re sota pan kalopuela Kaun en lingan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:9
verses.text: A duen a intingidier: Me sota mas eu udialer, o me sota salong eu rongadar, o me sota ko ong nan mongiong en aramas amen, iei me Kot kotin kaonop ong, me pok ong i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:10
verses.text: A Kot kotin kadiarok ong kitail ki Ngen e, pwe Ngen kin kotin rapaki meakaros, pil duen kupur en Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:11
verses.text: Pwe is aramas, me kin asa duen lol en aramas akan, pwe ngen en aramas eta me mi re a? Iduen Kot, sota me asa meakan me udan Kot, pwe Ngen en Kot eta.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:12
verses.text: A kaidin ngen en sappa, me kit aleer, a Ngen en Kot, pwe kit en asada meakan, me Kot kotiki ong kitail er.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:13
verses.text: I me kit pil kin padaki wei, kaidin ni lokaia o mangin pan lolekong en aramas, a ni masan akan, me Ngen kotin kaweweda, kareda dipisou ngenin akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:14
verses.text: A aramas ip pwel sota kin ale meakot ren Ngen en Kot, pwe me mal kot ong i, pwe a sota kak ong, pwe mepukat kin kasauiada ren Ngen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:15
verses.text: A me ngenin kin kasauiada meakaros, ap sota amen me pan kak kasauiada i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 2:16
verses.text: Pwe is me asa duen kupur en Kaun o, de is me pan kak padaki ong i meakot? A Ngen en Kristus kotikot lol atail.<div eID="gen2752" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.2"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: ARI ri ai kan i sota kak padaki ong komail dueta ong aramas ngenin, a ong me uduken o kisin seri en Kristus akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:2
verses.text: I kamanga kin komail pil en didi, a kaidin kisin manga, pwe komail saikenta kak ong, o komail pil sota kak ong ansau wet.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:3
verses.text: Pwe komail non uduken pwe iaduen, ma peirin o akamai, mi re omail, komail so uduken o weweid ni tiak en aramas akan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:4
verses.text: Pwe amen kin inda: Ngai nain Paulus amen, a amen: Ngai nain Apolos amen. Komail so kin mi nin tiak en aramas?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:5
verses.text: Pwe is Apolos? O is Paulus, kaidin papa kai, me komail asa sanger lamalam duen Kaun o kotin pang ong amen amen?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:6
verses.text: Ngai me padukedier, a Apolos me kalamu ir adar, a Kot me kotin kaparadar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:7
verses.text: Ari kaidin i meakot, me padukedi, pil kaidin i, me kalamu ir adar, a Kot eta, me kotikidar wa kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:8
verses.text: Ari, me kin padukedi o me kin kalamu ir adar, ira dupeneta, o amen pan katingki iran ara dodok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:9
verses.text: Pwe kit me sauas pan dodok en Kot, a komail sapasap en Kot, o sapwilim en Kot a kakau im.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:10
verses.text: Ngai me wiadar pason ki mak en Kot me i aleer duen sause lolekong amen, a amen usewei kakau poa, a amen amen en kalaka duen a kakau pon pason wet!

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:11
verses.text: Pwe sota me pan kak wia eu pason, me pan toror sang me wiauier, i eta: Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:12
verses.text: Ari, ma amen pan kauada pon pason wet kold, silper, takai, kasampwal, tuka, rä, pain kit akan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:13
verses.text: Nan wiawia en amen amen pan sansaleda, pwe ran o pan kapareda due, pwe a pan kadiarok kida kisiniai. Pwe kisiniai pan kasaleda wiawia en amen amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: Ma wiawia en amen, me a kauadar poa, pan mimieta, a pan kating.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:15
verses.text: A ma wiawia en amen pan rongala, a sota pan kating. A pein i pan dorela duen amen, me pitila sang nan kisiniai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: Komail sota asa, me komail tanpas en Kot, o Ngen en Kot kotikot lol omail?

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:17
verses.text: A ma amen kawela tanpas en Kot, nan Kot pan kawela i, pwe tanpas en Kot me saraui, ari iei komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: Sota amen en kotaue pein i! Ma amen nan pung omail lamelame ansau wet, me a lolekong, mak eta, en wiala ol pweipwei men, pwen wiala lolekong amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:19
verses.text: Pwe lolekong en sappa et me song en pweipwei ren Kot, pwe a intingidier: A kin kaloe kidi me aklolekong pein ar widiwiding.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:20
verses.text: Pil eu! Kaun o kotin mangi, lamalam en me aklolekong kan, me mal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:21
verses.text: Ari, sota amen en akkeleki aramas akan, pwe omail meakaros;

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:22
verses.text: Ma Paulus, de Apolos, de Kepas, de sappa, de memaur, de mela, de ma men met, de men mur, pwe karos me omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:23
verses.text: A komail sapwilim en Kristus, a Kristus sapwilim en Kot.<div eID="gen2753" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.3"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: ARAMAS akan en wia kin kit papa en Kristus o saunkoa pan me rir akan ren Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: A iaduen saunkoa kan? Amen amen en lelapok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: I sota insenoki, me komail de kapung en aramas kasaui ia da. Pein ngai pil sota kasaui ia da.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: Pwe sota me i pein asa, a kaidin met, me i pung kila, a Kaun o me kin kasaui ia da.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: Ari, komail depa kasaui okotme mon a ansau, a lao Kaun o pan kotido, me pan kasansale dang marain okiok en me rotorot akan o kadiarokada lamalam en nan mongioing akan, amen amen ap pan indandeki ren Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: Ri ai kan, mepukat i kin inda duen ngai o Apolos, pwe komail en ale sang kit, pwe amen ender lamelame, me a siki sang me intingidier, pwe komail ender aklapalapaki amen, ap palian me teio.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: Pwe is me mone kin uk? A sota, me mi re om, me koe sota aleer. A ma koe aleer meakaros, menda koe kin suaiki, likamata koe sota aleer?

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: Komail medier o kapwapwalar, o komail kin kaunda, ap sota ale sang kit. I men, komail en kaunda, pwe kit ap pil pan iang komail kaunda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: Pwe i lamelame, me Kot kotin wiai ong kit wanporon akan, en tikitik melel, me mau ong mela, pwe kit wialar men kapuriamui eu ni sappa mon tounlang o aramas akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: Kit me song en pweipwei pweki Kristus, a komail me lolekongki Kristus; kit me luet, a komail me kelail; komail me indand mau, a kit me indand sued.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: Kokodo lel auer met kit men mangadar, o pil men nim piladar, o kiliso, o se kin kalokolok, o sota deu at.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: O dodok ni pein pa at; kit me kalok sued, a se kin kapaiada, kit me kalokolok, a se kin nenenla; Ni at pakaraun mal, kit kin kapakap.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: Kit wialar tatan kid o kopataun aramas karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: I intingiedier mepukat kaidin pwen kanamenok komail, a pwen panaui komail nai seri kompok kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:15
verses.text: Pwe ma omail saunpadak pan Kristus me nen, nan sam omail akan me sota non toto, pwe ngai me kaipwi komail ren Kristus Iesus ki rongamau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: I ari poeki re omail komail en idauen ia do.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: Pwe i me i kadarki wong komail Timoteus nai seri kompoke o lelapok pan Kaun o pwen kataman kin komail duen al ai kan pan Kristus, duen me i kawewedar ni momodisou karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: Akai komail me aklapalap likomata i sota pan pwar wong komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:19
verses.text: A i pan pwar wong komail madang, ma Kaun o pan kotin kupura. I ap pan kilang kaidin padak en me aklapalap akan, a me manaman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:20
verses.text: Pwe wein Kot sota mi ni kasoi a ni manaman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:21
verses.text: Da me komail mauki? I en pwar wong komail wa sokon, de limpok o ngen en opampap?<div eID="gen2754" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.4"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: I PIL rongadar, me nenek kin wiaui nan pung omail. A eu song en nenek, me sota kin wiaui ren men liki kan; pwe dene amen paudeki en a papa a paud.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: A komail me aklapalap, ap sota insen suedeki o kasapokela sang komail, me wiadar met.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:3
verses.text: A ni ai doo sang komail ni pali war, ap koren iong komail ni pali ngen i iet me i kapungadar, dueta amen, me mi re omail,

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: Ni mar en atail Kaun Iesus, ni atail pokon pena re omail ni pali ngen atail, ki manaman en atail Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: Me wiadar met i pangalang Satan, pwen kawela uduk o, pwe ngen o en kamaurela ni ran en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:6
verses.text: Kaidin me mau omail suaiki. Komail sota asa, me kalap kis kin kamutala dolepa karos?

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:7
verses.text: Ari, kokowei sang kalap kitai, pwe komail en wiala plaua amas kap, pwe komail udan plaua amas kap, pwe atail pasa Kristus kamatalar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:8
verses.text: Kitail ari en wiada atail pasa, kaidin ni kalap kitai, pil kaidin ni kalap lemai de me sued, a ni plaua amas kap ni pung o melel.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: Ngai inting wong komail er nan kisin likau o, pwe komail ender waroki ong me nenek kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: Ari mepukat i sota kin inda duen me nenek ren men liki kan, de me norok kapwa, de me lolap akan, de me wun ani, pwe ma idue, komail en katoror wei sang sappa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: A met i inting wong komail er ender waroki ong amen, me adaneki saulang, ap nenek, de me norok kapwa, de kati ani mal, de lalaue amen, de kamom soko, de me lolap; komail ender iang i manga.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: Pwe menda re i men liki? Kaidin ai dodok en kadeik irail ada. Komail sota kin kadeikada nan pung omail?

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: A me mi liki ko, Kot pan kotin kasapoke wei sang re omail me sued o!<div eID="gen2755" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.5"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: A MA amen wia sapung ong amen, menda komail kapung pena mon men liki kan, a so mon me saraui kan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: De komail sota asa, me saraui kan pan kadeikada sappa? A ma sappa pan pakadeikeki komail, iaduen, komail sota itar ong kadeikada kisin dodok tikitik kan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: Komail sota asa, me kitail pan kadeikada tounlang kan? Nan melel kaualap pil kisin tiak tikitik en maur et.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: A ma komail kin kadeikeki tiak en maur et iaduen, komail kin kapukapung iangaki me sota indant mau ren momodisou?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: Mepukat i indai ong komail, pwen kanamenok komail. Pwe sota amen re omail, me lolekong? Sota amen me itar ong en wiada kapung nan pung en ri a kan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:6
verses.text: A amen kin akamai ong amen ri a mon me soposon akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: Ari, omail akamai nan pung omail pil udan sapung. Menda komail sota mueidala meakot? Menda komail sota kin nenenla?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: A komail kin sapung o kotaue ong ri omail akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: De komail sota asa, me sapung kan sota pan sosoki wein Kot? Kalaka pein komail! Pwe me nenek de me kati ani likam akan, de me kamal, de me dir en inong sued, de me madong saut ong ol oko.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: De men pirap, de me norok kapwa, de kamom soko, de kinekine mal, de kuli kapwa kan sota pan sosoki wein Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: Iduen akai komail mas o, a met komail wideudier, o kasarauialar, o pung kilar mar en Kaun Iesus o Ngen en atail Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: A muei ong ia meakaros, a kaidin karos me kin kamau ia la; a muei ong ia meakaros, a sota, me pan poe ia di.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: Melel, kisin manga me mau ong kaped o, o nan kapedi wasan kisin manga en ko ong ia. A Kot pan kotin kawe ira la karos. A pali war o wiaui ong Kaun o, a kaidin ong nenek, a Kaun kotin apapwali pali war o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: A Kot me kotin kaiasadar Kaun o, a pil pan kotin kaiasa kida kitail manaman.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: Komail sota asa, me war omail kokon en Kristus? A iaduen, i en ale kokon en Kristus, wia kin ir kokon en li nenek amen? O so!

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: De komail sota asa, meamen me waroki ong li nenek amen, me ira pan wiala war ta ieu? Pwe a kotin masanier: Ira pan wiala uduk ta ieu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: A me waroki ong Kaun o nan a pan ngen ta ieu re a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: Komail tange wei sang nenek, pwe dip karos, me aramas kin wia, kin wiaui likin war a, a me kin nenek, kin wiada dip ong pein war a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:19
verses.text: De komail so asa, me war omail tanpas en Ngen saraui me kotikot lol omail, me komail aleer sang ren Kot, a kaidin uta ’mail komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:20
verses.text: Pwe komail neti kidar pai eu, komail ari kalinganada Kot ki war omail.<div eID="gen2756" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.6"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: A IET duen me komail intingie dong ia, a mau ong aramas amen, a ender sair li amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: Ari so, amen amen en ale pein a warok li, o amen amen en ale pein a warok ol, pwen der dender.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: Ol o en wiai ong a warok li me inen, a pil dueta li ong a warok ol.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: Li o sota kak poedi pein war a, a a warok. Pil dueta ol o sota kak poedi pein war a, a a warok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: Der so oke amen amen, ma so, pweki inau ansau kis, pwen mot isesol rer ekis o kapakap, ap pur pena, pwe Satan de kasongesong komail omail so oke pena.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: Mepukat kaidin kusoned eu, pwe pein ai lamelam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: A i men aramas akan karos en dueta ngai. A amen amen aleer pein a pai en mak sang ren Kot duen amen amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: A ngai indai ong me so papaud o li odi kan, me mau irail en dadaur dueta ngai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: A ma irail sota kak ong, irail en papaud; me mau papaud sang dender.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: O ong me papaud akan ngai me ilaki wei, a kaidin ngai pwe Kaun o: Li papaud ender kamuei wei sang a warok!

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: A ma a muei wei sanger, i en dadaurata a kirip de kadeke a warok, o ol ender kasela a warok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: Kaidin Kaun o, pwe ngai men indang me tei kan: Ma ri atail ol amen mia, me a paud soposon amen, ap men mimieta re a, a ender kasela li o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: Pil dueta li amen, ma a warok soposon amen o a men mimieta re a, a ender kasela ol o,

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: Pwe ol soposon me kasaraui kilar li o, o li soposon kasaraui kilar ol o, pwe ma a so due met, noumail seri kan me samin, a met irail me saraui.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: A ma me soposon o pan muei wei sang, ari i en muei wei sang; ri ol de ri li sota kin kaupindi ni mepukat. A Kot me kotin molipe kitail, pwen popol pena.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: Pwe iaduen, koe li o, koe asa, me koe pan kak kamaurela ol o? De koe ol, koe pan kamaurela li o?

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:17
verses.text: A duen Kaun o pang ong amen amen, duen Kot molipe ong amen amen, iduen dadaurata; nan iduen ngai ilakilang momodisou akan karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:18
verses.text: Ma amen me paeker ni sirkomsais, i en dadaurata a sirkomsais, a ma amen me paeker ni sosirkomsais, i ender iang sirkomsais.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:19
verses.text: Pwe kaidin meakot sirkomsais, o pil kaidin meakot sosirkomsais, a wiawia kusoned en Kot akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:20
verses.text: Amen amen en dadaurata udan a koa ni a paeker.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:21
verses.text: Ma koe paeker ni om ladu, koe der insensuedeki, a ma koe pan kak maioda sang, ari pil me mau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:22
verses.text: Pwe ladu men, me paeker ong Kaun o, nan a maio ren Kaun o; o pil dueta me maio men paeker ap pan ladun Kristus men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:23
verses.text: Komail me neti kidar pai eu, der wiala ladun aramas akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:24
verses.text: Ri ai kan, amen amen dadaurata ut arail ren Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:25
verses.text: A duen peinekap akan, sota kusoned eu sang ren Kaun o; a pein ai lamelam mia, pwe i aleer mak en Kaun, pwen kak melel.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:26
verses.text: Iet me i lameda, me mau ong aramas sota papaud, pwe ni ansau apwal wet.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:27
verses.text: Ma koe kapapaud ong li amen, ender men muei sang, a ma so om paud mia, ender rapaki li amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:28
verses.text: A kaidin dip eu, ma koe pan papaud; o ma seripein amen pan papaud, kaidin dip. A a pan apwal ong mepukat ni pali uduk arail. A ngai sota men, me apwal kot en lel ong komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:29
verses.text: A ri ai kan, mepukat i indada, pweki ansau o me motomot. A pil eu: Me mau ong me ar warok mier, en wia dene sota ar warok;

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:30
verses.text: O me kin sangesang, dene sota sangesang; o me kin pereperen, dene sota ar peren; o me kin netinet, dene sota ar kapwa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:31
verses.text: O me dodokki sappa, ren kalaka, pwe eder wiaki me sued. Pwe mom en sappa et pan rosala.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:32
verses.text: A i men, komail ender lodi ong me apwal. Me sota papaud, kin apwali me sapwilim en Kaun o, duen a pan kaperenda Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:33
verses.text: A me papaud, kin lamelame, me kon ong sappa, duen a pan kaperenda a paud.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:34
verses.text: A nan pung en li papaud o peinekap me wuk pasang: Me sota papaud, kin apwali me sapwilim en Kaun o, pwen saraui ni pali war o pil ni pali ngen; a me papaud, kin inong iong me kisan sappa, duen a pan kak kaperenda a warok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:35
verses.text: Mepukat i inda wei, pwen kamaui komail, a kaidin pwen saliedi komail, a pwen sauasa komail, pwe karos en inen o pung re omail, o pwe komail en papa Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:36
verses.text: A ma amen lamelame, me sapung, ma a sota pan mueid ong na seripein, me mau ong papaud, en papaud; ari, a pan wia duen me a mauki, pwe kaidin dip, ma a pan mueid ong i en papaud.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:37
verses.text: A ma amen me kelail ni mongiong i, pil kelail ong kaunda, pein insen a, ap inauki ong nan mongiong i en kolekol na seripein, i me mau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:38
verses.text: Ari, ma amen pan papaud me mau, a ma amen sota pan papaud, me mau sang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:39
verses.text: Li papaud amen me kaupina kidi pung en papaud arain a warok memaur; a ol o lao mela, nan a maio ong kapapaud, me a mauki, i eta; a en wiaui ren Kaun.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:40
verses.text: Meid pai, ma a pan dadaurata a kirip duen me i lameda, A ngai asa, me Ngen en Kot pil kotikot re i.<div eID="gen2757" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.7"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:1
verses.text: A kitail asaer duen mairong ong ani mal, pwe kitail karos me lolekong. A lolekong eta kin kaaklapalapiela, a limpok kin kamauiela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:2
verses.text: A ma amen aklapalapaki a lolekong, nan a sota non dedeki duen me itar ong en asa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:3
verses.text: A ma amen pok ong Kot, nan Kot me mangi i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:4
verses.text: A kitail dedekier duen manga uduk en mairong ong ani mal akan, pwe ani mal amen sota katepa nin sappa, o sota amen Kot, pwe i me ta men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:5
verses.text: Pwe ma akai mia, me adaneki kot, me kin mimi nanlang de nin sappa, pwe kot toto o monsap toto mia;

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:6
verses.text: A atail Kot me ta men, me Sam, me dipisou karos tapi sang re a, o me kitail wiaui ong. O atail Kaun me ta men: Iesus Kristus, me wiadar meakaros, o me kitail pil wiaui kidar i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:7
verses.text: A kaidin karos me asa mepukat, pwe akai mia, me lamelame, me ani mal meakot, ap kangkang uduk en mairong ong ani mal, o iei insen luet arail kin samin kila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:8
verses.text: A kisin manga sota kin sauasa kitail ren Kot. Ma kitail sota pan manga, kitail sota pan sued kila, a ma kitail pan manga, kitail sota pan mau kila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:9
verses.text: A kalaka komail, pwe omail saladokalar ender kadipikelekel ong me luet akan!

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:10
verses.text: Pwe ma koe, me asa tiak, ap mangamanga nan im en ani mal o, a me luet amen pan kilang om mangamanga, ap aima kida nan insen a, ap iang mangamanga mairong en ani mal akan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:11
verses.text: Iduen ri atail luet amen, me Kristus mata kilar, pan mekila om saladok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:12
verses.text: A ma iduen omail dip iong ri atail akan, me kin kawela insen luet arail, nan komail kin wia dip iong Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 8:13
verses.text: Ari ma kisin manga kamakar ri ai, i solar pan manga uduk kokolata, pwe i de kamakar ri ai.<div eID="gen2758" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.8"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:1
verses.text: KAIDIN ngai maiodar? Kaidin wanporon amen ngai? I sota udialer Iesus atail Kaun? Kaidin ai wiawia pan Kaun o komail?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:2
verses.text: Ma i sota wanporon amen ong me tei ko, a ong komail; pwe komail kasale pan ai koa en wanporon pan Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:3
verses.text: Iduen i kin sapengki, ma meamen kin kalelapok re i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:4
verses.text: A sota muei ong kit er, en manga o nim?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:5
verses.text: A sota muei ong kit er, en paudeki li amen, me pan iang kit sailok sili, duen me wanporon tei kan, o ri en Kaun o, o Kepas kin wiada?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:6
verses.text: De ngai o Parnapas eta me a sota muei ong liki sang dodok en pa at?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:7
verses.text: Is me kin iang mauin ap pwain pein i? Is me wiada mat en wain eu, me sota kin kang kisan wa? Is me kin kamanga pwin man akan me sota kin kang pil en didi en man oko?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:8
verses.text: Mepukat i sota kin inda nin tiak en aramas akan, pwe kaidin kapung o me pil masanier due?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:9
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier nan kapung en Moses: Koe der pira pena au en kau ol amen, me kin tiaka pasang korn. Iaduen, Kot kin apapwali kau ol akan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:10
verses.text: De kaidin pweki kit, me a kotin masaniekier mepukat? Pwe me kin sapasap, en kaporoporeki a dodok; o me kin dolung en kaporoporeki, me a pan iang ale kisan wa.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:11
verses.text: Pwe ma kit wiai ong komail sapasap ngenin, a kaidin me kasampwal kot, me komail pan apwali kit ni pali uduk.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:12
verses.text: A ma a muei ong me tei kan, ale sang omail dipisou kan, nan kit me so mau ong sang irail? Ari so, kit sota kol ong kit tiak wet, a se men mia ni at apwal akan, pwe sen de karompwa rongamau en Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: Komail sota asa, me irail, me sopisokki saraui, pil mangamanga sang nan im en kaudok, o me irail, me kin papang pei saraui, pil aleki pwais ar sang pei saraui?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: Iduen Kaun o kotin masani, me irail, me padaki rongamau, pil pan mangaki rongamau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: A ngai sota kin kol ong ia eu ren mepukat, o i sota inting wei mepukat, pwe komail en kapwai ong ia mepukat, pwe a mau ong ia en mela, mon amen pan kawela mar ai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:16
verses.text: Pwe ma i padaki rongamau, sota me i en suaiki, pwe i en udan wiada; pwe sued ong ia, ma i sota padaki rongamau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:17
verses.text: Pwe ma i peren kida dodok wet, i pan ale kating, a ma i kang wiada, nan kusoned mia, i en wiada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:18
verses.text: Ari, ia kating pai ni ai padaki rongamau ap sota pwaipwai, pwe i ender akapwaipwaiki sang rongamau meakot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:19
verses.text: Pwe ngai me udan maiodar sang amen amen, ari so, i wia kin ia ladun amen amen, pwe i en kamaurela me toto duen i kak ong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:20
verses.text: I wia kin ia Sus amen ong Sus akan, pwen kamaurela Sus akan; o ong irail, me mi pan kapung, dueta pan kapung amen, pwen kamaur ir ala, me mi pan kapung; ari so, ngai solar mi pan kapung.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:21
verses.text: Ong irail me sota mi pan kapung, i wia kin ia me sota mi pan kapung amen; ari so, kaidin ngai me likin kapung mon Kot, pwe i kin mi pan kapung en Kristus, pwen kamaurela me sota mi pan kapung.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:22
verses.text: Ong me luet akan, i wia kin ia me luet amen, pwen kamaurela me luet akan. Ngai wiala song karos ong amen amen, pwen kamaurela akai wasa karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:23
verses.text: I me i kin wiawia pweki rongamau, pwe i en iang i pwaisaiski.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:24
verses.text: Komail sota asa, duen men weir en tang, irail karos kin tang, a amen ta, me pan ale pai? Komail ari en tang idipok, pwe komail en ale.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:25
verses.text: A amen amen me aktang idipok, kin isesol pokon. Irail kin wia me, pwen ale mar kamong a kitail, pwen ale me so kamong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:26
verses.text: Ngai ari aktang sopuiok; ngai kin pepei, a kaidin dueta me woki nan wäwä;

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:27
verses.text: Pwe i kin sok pon war ai, pwen katengedi, pwe i de padaki ong akai, ap pein lokidokila.<div eID="gen2759" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.9"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:1
verses.text: PWE ri ai kan, i men, komail en asa duen sam atail akan, me mi pan palin dapok eu o kotela madau o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:2
verses.text: Irail karos ap paptais ong Moses ni palin dapok o ni madau o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:3
verses.text: O karos tungoler sak ngenin,

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:4
verses.text: O karos nim sang pil ngenin; pwe irail nim sang paip ngenin, me kotikot re ’rail, iei paip o Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:5
verses.text: A me toto re ’rail, me Kot sota kak kupuramauki, pwe irail lokidokilar nan sap tan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:6
verses.text: A mepukat wiauier, pwe kitail de kaalemongi, pwe kitail ender inong iong me sued akan duen irail inong iong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:7
verses.text: Komail pil ender kati ani mal due irail, duen a intingidier: Aramas pukat mondi penang nam o nim ap uda madomadong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:8
verses.text: Kitail pil der wia nenek, duen me akai irail wiadar, ap rianen silekid mekilar ni ran ta ieu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:9
verses.text: Kitail pil der kasongesong Kristus, duen akai irail kasongesong i, ap mekilar serpent kai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:10
verses.text: Komail pil der lipaned, duen akai ir lipanededar, ap kame kilar men kamekam men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:11
verses.text: Mepukat karos wiaui ong irail men kaalemongi; ap intingidier, pwe men panaui kin kitail, pwe kitail leler imwin kaua.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:12
verses.text: Ari ma amen lamelame, me a kasinenda, en kalaka pein i, pwe a de pupedi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:13
verses.text: Sota songesong eu lel ong komail, i eta, me aramas itar ong, pwe Kot me melel, me sota kin mueid ong komail songesong eu, me komail sota itar ong. A ni songesong a pan kotin kaimwisokela, duen me pan kak pa omail

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:14
verses.text: Ari kompoke pai kan, komail tange sang kati ani mal!

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:15
verses.text: Mepukat i indai ong komail, pwe komail me lolekong; a pein komail kasauiada, me i inda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:16
verses.text: Dal en pai me kit kin kapaiada, kaidin i dal en atail saupena ren ntan Kristus? O prot me kit kin pilitiki pasang, kaidin i atail saupena en war en Kristus?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:17
verses.text: Pwe kitail me toto me lopon ta ieu, o war ta ieu, pwe kitail karos tungole sang lopon ta ieu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:18
verses.text: Komail kilang Israel pali uduk. Irail me kin kang sang mairong, kaidin irail pil minimini ong pei saraui?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:19
verses.text: A da me i en inda? I en inda me mairong ong ani mal meakot? De dikedik en ani mal meakot?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:20
verses.text: A karos me men liki kan mairongki, re kin mairongki ong tewil akan a kaidin ong Kot. A i sota mauki, komail en minimin ong tewil akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:21
verses.text: Komail sota kak nima sang dal en Kaun o pil sang dal en tewil akan; komail sota kak iang tepel en Kaun o pil tepel en tewil akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:22
verses.text: De kitail en palian Kaun o? Kitail me kelail sang i?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:23
verses.text: A muei onger meakaros, a kaidin karos me kin kamaula; a muei onger meakaros, a kaidin karos me kin kapungla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:24
verses.text: Sota amen me pan apwali pein a dipisou, a en amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:25
verses.text: Karos me kin netila nan wasan netikila uduk, komail kang, ap der kalelapok duen song ar, pwe komail der katoutouki insen omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:26
verses.text: Pwe sapwilim en Kaun sappa o audepa kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:27
verses.text: A ma amen, me soposon pan luke komail, en toun kapara kamadip, o ma komail men iang, ari, karos me pan nek ong komail, komail en kang, ap der kalelapok duen song a, pwe komail der katoutouki insen omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:28
verses.text: A ma amen pan indang komail: Met kisan mairong en ani mal, komail der kang pweki i, me kasaledar, pwe komail der kawela insen arail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:29
verses.text: A met i solar inda duen pein insen om a duen insen en amen. Pwe menda insen en amen pan kasauiada ai saladokelar?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:30
verses.text: Pwe ma i iang kang ki danke, menda i en kalok sued, pwe i tungole ni ai danke?

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:31
verses.text: Ari, ma komail kang de nim de wia meakot, komail en wia meakaros, pwen wauneki Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:32
verses.text: Komail der kadipikelekel men Sus, de men Krik, de momodisou en Kot,

verses.name: I Corinthians 10:33
verses.text: Duen i kin pok ong amen amen ni ai wiawia kan karos, o so moneki me pein ai, pwen sauasa me toto, pwe irail en dorela.<div eID="gen2760" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.10"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:1
verses.text: KOMAIL idauen ia do duen i kin idauen Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:2
verses.text: I kin kapingaki komail omail tamataman ia ni meakan karos, o dadaurata pung kan, duen i kakalikidi ong komail er.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:3
verses.text: A i men, komail en asadar, me Kristus tapwin ol akan, a ol me tapwin li, a Kot me tapwin Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:4
verses.text: A ma amen amen ren ol akan wia kapakap de kokop ap lisoropedi, a kin kasuedeki pein mong a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:5
verses.text: A ma li amen wia kapakap de kokop, ap sota lisoropedi, nan i kin kasuedeki pein mong a, pwe a rasong me pit en mong a seisei sang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:6
verses.text: Pwe ma li amen sota lisoropedi, en koteda, a ma a kanamenok li en kotedar o kotokot, i en pwaindi mong a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:7
verses.text: A ol o ender lisoropedi, pwe i me kasansal o lingan en Kot, a li o me lingan en ol o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:8
verses.text: Pwe ol so tapi sang li, a li sang ol o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:9
verses.text: Pwe ol sota wiaui ong li, a li wiaui ong ol o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:10
verses.text: I me li o en kida manaman eu pon mong a pweki tounlang kan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:11
verses.text: Ari so, li amen sota kak mia ma sota ol; o ol amen sota kak mia, ma sota li, a mepukat ren Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:12
verses.text: Pwe duen li o a tapi sang ol, iduen ol o wiaui kida li, a karos wiauier ren Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:13
verses.text: Komail en pein kasauiada, ma a sansal mau, ma li amen kapakap ong Kot, ap so lisoropedi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:14
verses.text: De pein komail asa, me kanamenok pan ol, ma a pwilipeipei.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: A lingan en li a pwilipeipei, pwe pid en mong a en ko ong i, en pwaindi i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: A ma amen re omail men akamai, a en asa, me kit sota kin wia due, momodisou en Kot akan pil so.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: A ni ai kusonededa mepukat i sota kin kapinga omail pokon pena, me sota kin kamaui a kasuedeki komail,

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: Pwe ni omail pokon pena nan momodisou, i rongadar, me komail kin liak toror pasang, o i mur kamelele.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: Pwe komail en liak toror pasang, pwe me pung kan en sansal kida re omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: Komail lao pokon pena wasa kis, kaidin i sak kamadip en Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: Pwe ni kamadip toun kapar kin amatang mas, a amen men mangadar, a amen sokolar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: Sota im omail, wasa en manga o nim? De komail kin mamaleki momodisou en Kot o kanamenok ir ala, me sota ar tungol? Da me i en inda? I en kaping komail? Ni mepukat i sota pan kapinga.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: Pwe i aleer sang ren Kaun o, me i pwiliki ong komail er, me Kaun Iesus pong ota en a pangala, a limada prot,

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: Murin a laolaoki, kamauieda, pilitiki pasang, masangi: Ale tungole war ai met et, me pilitiki ong komail, en wia, pwen katakataman kin ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: A murin sak, a pil kotin limada dal masani: Dal wet iei inau kap, me wiaui kidar nt’ ai. Pan pak en omail nima sang, komail wiaki men kataman kin ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: Pwe pan pak en omail kang prot wet o nima sang dal wet, komail kasansaleda en Kaun a matala, lao a kotido.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: Ari me kang prot wet o nim sang dal en Kaun o ap so war ong iei me dip iong war o ntan Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: Amen amen en kasauiada pein i, ap kang sang prot o nima sang dal o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: Pwe me kang o nim sowar, kin kang o nim kadeik ong pein i, pwe a sota kasampwaleki war o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:30
verses.text: Nan i me toto nan pung omail me luetalar o somaudar, o me toto mairedier.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: Pwe ma kitail kasauiada pein kitail, kitail sota pan pakadeikada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: A ma kitail pan pakadeikada, kitail pan kalokolok ren Kaun o, pwe kitail de iang men liki lokidokila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: Ari ri ai ol akan, komail lao pokon pena pwen sak, en papasan pena amen amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:34
verses.text: A ma amen men mangadar, i en manga mas nan im a; pwe komail de pokon penang kadeik o. A me lua kan i pan kapungala ni ai pwara wong.<div eID="gen2761" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.11"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: RI ai kan, i sota men, komail en sasa duen pwais ngenin akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: Komail asaer, me komail tikidar men liki, ap kakalua ren dikedik en ani loteng akan, duen komail kakaluaer.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: I me i men kaasa kin komail, sota amen, me lokaiaki Ngen en Kot, kak kariala Iesus. O sota amen me pan kak inda: Maing Iesus, ma so ren a Ngen saraui.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: A pai en mak akan me wuki pasang, a Ngen me ta men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: O song en dodok me toto, a kaun me ta men.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: O akai song en manaman mia, a Kot me ta men, me kotin wiawia meakaros ren amen amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: A pwais en Ngen saraui me pang ong amen amen, pwen men kamauiada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: Pwe amen ereki masan en erpit ren Ngen, a amen masan en kaparok ren Ngen ota.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: O ong amen, en poson, a ren Ngen ota, o ong amen pai kan, men kakelada me somau kan, a ren Ngen ota.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: O ong amen, en wiada manaman, o ong amen, en deideikop, o ong amen, en kasaui ngen akan, o ong amen, en lokaia ngil wuki pasang, o ong amen, en kawukila ngil akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: A mepukat karos wiawian Ngen ota, nene ong amen amen duen kupur a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: Pwe duen war eu ta ap kokon toto mia, a kokon en war karos wiala war ta ta ieu, iduen Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: Pwe Ngen ta ieu, me kitail paptaiseki ong war ta ieu, ma kitail men Sus de men Krik, ma ladu de me maioda, kitail karos me paptaiseki Ngen ta ieu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: Pwe war kaidin kokon ta ieu, pwe kokon toto.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: A ma pat en nä pan inda: Ngai kaidin kumut eu, o i me ngai sota kisan war; a iaduen, i me a sota pan kak kisan war o?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: A ma salong o pan inda: Kaidin ngai kisan war o, pwe kaidin por en mas eu ngai; a iaduen, i me a sota kisan war o?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: Ma war pokon por en mas eu, da me pan salong o? A ma war pokon pan salong o, da me pan tuma?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: Ari, Kot me kotin kokon penang war ta ieu kasong akan, duen a kotin kupureda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: A ma kokon karos wiala kokon ta ieu, ia pan war o?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: Ari, kokon akan me toto, a war o me ta ieu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: Por en mas eu sota kak indang kumut: Kaidin meakot re i koe; de pil tapwi sota kak indai ong pat en nä kan: Kaidin meakot re i koma.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:22
verses.text: Pwe kokon en war kai likamata re me luet, a so, pwe re me kasampwal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:23
verses.text: O kokon en war kai, me kitail kin lamelame, me re sota non mau, kitail kin apapwali sang me tei kan, o irail me sota non sansal mau, kitail kin kapwataki.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:24
verses.text: Pwe irail me sansal mau, sota kin mau ong en kapwataki. A Kot kotin kapad pena war o kapwataki me luet oko sang me tei kan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:25
verses.text: Pwe war de saparok pasang, a kokon akan en apapwali pena.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:26
verses.text: O ma kasang ta ieu matakada, kasang karos ap iang matakada; o ma kasang ta ieu pan kalinganada, kokon karos pan iang polauleki.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:27
verses.text: A komail war en Kristus o kokon akan amen amen duen pwais a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:28
verses.text: A iet akan, me Kot kotiki ong momodisou: Kaieu wanporon akan, ap saukop akan, a kasilu saunpadak kan, ap me wiada manaman akan, ap pai kan men kakelada me somau kan, ap men sauasa, o saumas akan, o song en lokaia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:29
verses.text: Iaduen irail karos me wanporon akan? Karos me saukop akan? Karos me saunpadak kan? Karos me men wia manaman akan?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:30
verses.text: Karos ar pai en mak kan, men kakelada me somau kan mi ren karos? Karos kin lokaia ngil pasang? Karos kin kasiriwuk lokaia?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:31
verses.text: A komail inong iong pai en mak lapalap akan, i ap pan kasale ong komail al apot, me mau sang mepukat karos.<div eID="gen2762" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.12"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: MA i asa lokaia en aramas akan o tounlang kan, ap sota limpok, nan i rasong ngil en mata mal de ngil en simpel.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: O ma i asa deideikop o ereki me rir akan karos, o tiak kan karos, o ngai dir en poson, me itar ong en kamokid wei nana kan, ap sota limpok nan sota meakot ngai.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: O ma i pan kisakisa wei ai dipisou karos, pwen katungoleki me samama kan, o ma i kida war ai, pwen karongala, ap sota limpok, nan sota katepa ong ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: Limpok kin kanongama o kadek, limpok sota kin peirin limpok sota kin akmomo o so keses.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: A sota kin aklemai, a sota kin roporop ong pein i, a so serkailong, a sota kin depuk ong en amen a sued.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: A sota kin peren me sapung, a a kin perenki me melel.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: A kin kak pa meakaros, o kin poson karos, a kaporoporeki karos, o lolin ong meakaros.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: Limpok sota pan tukedi, a deideikop akan pan tukedi, o lokaia kan pan sola, o lolekong pan kunla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: Pwe kitail me er pali ta, o kokop pali ta.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: A lao kaunsokala, me pali ta pan momela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: Ni ai seri i kin lokaia dueta seri amen o i lamelame dueta seri amen, o kasaui dueta seri amen, a i lao wiala ol amen, i muei sang tau en seri.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: Pwe ansau wet kitail kin irerong nan klas edied eu, a mur a pan sansal mau. Ansau wet i ekis lolekonglar, a mur i pan asa duen a asa ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: Ari song silu pukat: Poson, kaporopor o limpok pan mimieta, a me lapalap re ’rail limpok.<div eID="gen2763" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.13"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:1
verses.text: KOMAIL anane limpok, pil inong iong pai ngenin akan, a iet me kasampwal re ’rail, kokopada!

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:2
verses.text: Pwe me kin lokaia kida ngil en wai, kaidin aramas akan, me a kin lokaia ong, a ong Kot, pwe sota amen kin dedeki; ari so, ni ngen o a kin lokaia kida me rir akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:3
verses.text: A me kin kokop, kin padaki ong aramas akan, pwen kamaui, o panau o kamait ir ala.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:4
verses.text: A me lokaiaki ngil en wai, kin kamaui pein i, a me kin kokop, kin kamaui momodisou.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:5
verses.text: I men, komail karos en asa lokaia ki ngil toror, a mak eta, komail en kokopada, pwe me kin kokopada, me lapa sang me kin kaparok ki ngil toror, ma a so kak kasiriwukila, pwe momodisou en kamau kila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:6
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, ma i pwara wong komail, ap lokaia ki ngil toror, da katepa ong komail, ma i sota kaweweda de kasansaleda, de kokopada, de padak?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:7
verses.text: Iduen meakan, me kin lokolokaia ap sota memaur, ma men kwai de arp sota pan ngor pasang, is me pan kak dedeki, da me ira kauleki?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:8
verses.text: O ma koronete pan popeuk ping, is me pan onopadang mauin?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:9
verses.text: A iduen komail, ma komail pan lokaia ki ngil toror, ap sota kaweweda, is me pan dedeki? Pwe omail lokaia pan me mal kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:10
verses.text: Song en lokaia toto nan sappa, a sota eu me so puloi.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:11
verses.text: A ma i sasa wewe en lokaia eu, i pan rasong men wai men ong me kin kaparok, o me kin kaparok, pan rasong men wai men ong ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:12
verses.text: A pil dueta komail, pwe komail kin anane pai ngenin akan, komail ari pil ngongki kakairida ni mepukat, pwen kamauie kila momodisou.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:13
verses.text: A ma amen lokaia kida ngil en wai, i en kapakap ap pil kasiriwukila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:14
verses.text: Pwe ma i wia kapakap ki lokaia ngil en wai eu, ngen i kin kapakap ap sota katepa ong amen.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:15
verses.text: Ari, da me i pan wia? I pan kapakap ni ngen i ap pil pan kapakap ni ai lamelam; i pan kapinga ni ngen i ap pil kapinga ni ai lamelam.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:16
verses.text: A ma koe pan kapaiada ki ngen o, iaduen me sota dedeki pan kak inda amen murin om kapinga? Pwe a sasa me koe indinda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:17
verses.text: Ei me mau melel om kapikapinga, a sota kadepa ong me teio.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:18
verses.text: I kin danke Kot, pweki i kin lokaiaki ngil toror sang komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:19
verses.text: Ari so nan momodisou i men kida lep in lokaia limau, me pwili sang ai lamelam sang lep in lokaia nen ni ngil toror, pwen padaki ong me tei kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:20
verses.text: Ri ai kan, komail der wiala seri ni omail lamelam, a ni me sued komail en rasong kisin seri, a ni omail lamelam komail en unsokela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:21
verses.text: A intingidier nan kapung: Lokaia o kil en aua toror, me I pan lokaiaki ong kainok wet, a re pil sota pan duki ong ia, me Kaun o kotin masani.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:22
verses.text: Nan i me lokaia toror mia, pwen kileledi kaidin me poson akan, a me soposon akan; a deideikop kaidin ong me soposon akan, pwe ong me poson akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:23
verses.text: A ma momodisou pan pokon pena wasa kis, o ma karos pan lokaia ni ngil toror, a ma akai iang me sota dedeki, de akai me soposon, irail sota pan inda, me komail iakalar?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:24
verses.text: A ma karos kin kokop, o amen pan pwarado, me soposon, o me sota dedeki, karos pan kasansale ong i dip a, o a pan pakasaui ren karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:25
verses.text: Iduen a me rir akan nan mongiong i pan sansaleda, o a pan tairokedi ni mas a, kaudoki ong Kot, o pan inda, melel Kot kotikot re omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:26
verses.text: Ri ai kan, iaduen komail ni omail pokon pena, kaidin amen amen kin kida psalm eu? A amen kin kawewe, a amen ngil toror, a amen kasansal eu, a amen kin kasiriwukila; a karos en wiaui, en kamauiada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:27
verses.text: A ma amen pan wia ngil en wai, me ta riamen, de ma me toto, re pan silimen, a irail pan irok wei a amen en kasirawukila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:28
verses.text: A ma sota men kasiriwuk mia, i en nenenla nan momodisou; a en kasoi ong pein i o Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:29
verses.text: A riamen de silimen ren saukop akan pan kak kaparok, a me tei kan en kasauiada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:30
verses.text: A ma amen, ren me momod wasa o, pan diar kasansal eu, men mas ap pan nenenla.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:31
verses.text: A komail karos kak kokop, irok weida, pwe karos en padakki o kamaitala.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:32
verses.text: A ngen en saukop akan kin duki ong saukop akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:33
verses.text: Pwe kaidin komoan me ping men Kot, a en popol duen ni momodisou en saraui akan karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:34
verses.text: Omail li akan en nenenla nan momodisou kan, pwe a sota muei ong irail, en kaparok; a irail en papa, duen kapung me pil masani.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:35
verses.text: A ma irail men asa okotme, irail en kalelapok ren arail warok kan ni deu ’rail, pwe me kanamenok, li en kaparok nan momodisou.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:36
verses.text: De masan en Kot tapi sang komail? De a ko wong komail eta?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:37
verses.text: A ma amen lamelame, me a saukop amen, de me a ngenin, a en asa wewe en me i intingki wong komail, pwe mepukat kusoned en Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:38
verses.text: A ma amen lolepon, i en lolepon.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:39
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan en inong iong kokop, o ender kainapwi lokaia ngil toror.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:40
verses.text: A meakaros en wiaui nin tiak mau o pung.<div eID="gen2764" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.14"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:1
verses.text: RI ai kan i men kataman kin komail rongamau, me i padaki ong komail er, me komail pil aleer o pil tinain kidar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:2
verses.text: O me komail pil dore kila, ma komail pan dadaurata masan o, me i padaki ong komail er, ma komail so poson mal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:3
verses.text: Pwe i usaki ong komail er, me i pil aleer duen Kristus, me kamata kilar dip atail akan duen kisin likau kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:4
verses.text: O me a saredier o kaiasadar ni kasilu en ran duen kisin likau kan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:5
verses.text: O me a pwara wong Kepas, ap ong irail me ekriamen ko,

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:6
verses.text: Ap kotin pwara wong saulang limepuki sama ni ansau takis; kis arail me toto mimieta lel met, a akai mairedier.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:7
verses.text: Murin met a kotin pwara wong Iakopus, ap ong wanporon akan karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:8
verses.text: A ikmuri a kotin pwara dong ia mon ai ip sapal,

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:9
verses.text: Pwe pokindidi ren wanporon akan ngai, me sota war ong kaindinda wanporon amen, pweki ai pei ong momodisou en Kot.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:10
verses.text: A mak en Kot, me i wanporon kilar. A kaidin mak mal eu ong ia, pwe i dodok laud sang irail karos, ari kaidik ngai, pwe mak en Kot, me mi re i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:11
verses.text: Ari, ma ngai de irail, pwe iduen at padaki wei, o iduen komail posonlar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:12
verses.text: A ma i aude pan at padak, me Kristus iasadar sang ren me melar akan, a da me akai re omail kin inda, dene me melar akan solar pan mauredar?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:13
verses.text: A ma me melar akan sota pan maureda, nan Kristus pil sota iasadar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:14
verses.text: O ma Kristus sota iasadar, at padak me mal, o omail poson pil me mal.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:15
verses.text: O kitail pil pan diarokada, me se saunkadede likam ren Kot, aki at kadededar, me Kot kotin kaiasadar Kristus, me a so kaiasadar, ma me melar akan sota pan kamaureda.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:16
verses.text: Pwe ma me melar akan sota pan kamaureda, nan Kristus pil so kaiasadar.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:17
verses.text: A ma Kristus so kaiasadar, omail poson me mal, o komail mimieta ni dip omail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:18
verses.text: Iduen pil irail, me melar ren Kristus akan, lokidokila.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:19
verses.text: A ma kitail kaporoporeki Kristus nan maur et eta, nan kitail me sued sang aramas akan karos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:20
verses.text: A melel, Kristus kaiasadar sang ren me melar akan, ap wiala meseni nan pung en ir me mamair akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:21
verses.text: Pwe mela tapi sang aramas ta men, iduen maureda sang ren me melar akan tapi sang aramas ta men;

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:22
verses.text: Pwe duen karos me mela ki Adam, nan iduen karos pan kamaurela ren Kristus,

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:23
verses.text: A amen amen ni kakairokdo: Kristus mas ap me sapwilim en Kristus, ni a pan kotin pwarado;

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:24
verses.text: A murin mepukat pan imwi, a lao kotiki ong Kot o Sam a wei, a lao kaloedier kaun akan karos, o me poe kan, o manaman akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:25
verses.text: Pwe a pan kotin kaunda, lao a imwintiti karos lodi ong pan aluwilu a kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:26
verses.text: A ikmurin imwintiti iei mela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:27
verses.text: Pwe a kotin mueid ong meakaros pan aluwilu a. Ari ni a kotin masanier me karos lodier a sansaledar, me i sota iang me kotin kaloedi ong i meakaros.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:28
verses.text: A meakaros lao lodi ong i, Na ap pil pan upang i, me kotin kaloedi ong i meakaros, pwe Kot en kotin poedi meakan karusia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:29
verses.text: A ma me melar akan solar pan kamaureda, da me irail en wia, me kin paptaiseki ong me melar akan? Menda re paptaiseki ong irail?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:30
verses.text: O menda kit kin kalokolok ansau karos?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:31
verses.text: Pwe ran karos i kin mela, pweki kaping pa i, me i aleer ren Kristus Iesui atail Kaun.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:32
verses.text: A ma i pei ong man laualo nan Episus, duen aramas akan kin wiada, da kadepa ong ia, ma me melar akan sota pan kamaureda? Kitail en manga o nim, pwe lakap kitail pan mela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:33
verses.text: Der duki ong, me kasongesong komail! Kasoi sued kin kawela tiak mau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:34
verses.text: Komail ari pungala, o pirida o der wiada dip! Pwe akai sasa duen Kot. Mepukat i indai ong komail, pwen kanamenokki komail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:35
verses.text: A ele amen pan inda: Iaduen me melar akan ar pan kamaureda? O iaduen war ar, me re pan maur kida?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:36
verses.text: Pweipwei men koe! Pwe me koe kin kamoredi, sota pan maureda, ma a sota pan mela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:37
verses.text: O me koe kamoredi, kaidin war ota me pan para, pwe wan korn eu ta, ele wan wit de eu wa toror.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:38
verses.text: A Kot pan kotiki ong war a, duen a kotin kupura, o eu eu en war akan pan ale udan mom a.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:39
verses.text: Uduk karos kaidin song ta ieu, pwe eu song uduk en aramas akan, a eu song uduk en man akan, a eu song en manpir akan, a eu song en mam akan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:40
verses.text: A war lang o war pwel akan mia, a lingan en war lang eu song o lingan en war pwel eu song.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:41
verses.text: A eu song lingan en katipin, o eu lingan en maram, o eu lingan en usu kan, pwe nan usu kan me wuki pasang ki ar lingan eu eu.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:42
verses.text: Nan iduen en me melar akan ar pan maureda. A kin kamoremoredi ap mor pasang, o pan kamaureda so mor pasang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:43
verses.text: A kin kamoremoredi ni so lingan, o pan maureda ni lingan; a kin kamoremoredi ni luet, o pan maureda ni manaman;

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:44
verses.text: A pan kamoremoredi war pwel o pan kamaureda war ngenin; pwe ma war pwel mia, nan a pil pan war ngenin.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:45
verses.text: Duen a intingidier: Tapin aramas Adam wiauier, pwen ngen maur amen, a Adam tia mur, pwen ngen en kamaur.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:46
verses.text: A war ngenin kaidin i men mas pwe war pwel, a muri me ngenin.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:47
verses.text: Tapin aramas wiaui kida pwel, a aramas kariamen kotido sang nanlang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:48
verses.text: A duen tapin aramas wiauiki pwel, iduen karos me wiauiki pwel o duen men nanlang o, iduen men nanlang kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:49
verses.text: O duen kitail wa mom en pwel, iduen kitail pil pan wa mom en lang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:50
verses.text: Ri ai kan, iet me i men inda: Uduk o nta sota kak sosoki wein Kot; o me mor pasang kan sota pan sosoki me so mor pasang.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:51
verses.text: Kilang, ngai me kadiarok ong komail kaponepon eu: Kaidin kitail karos pan mela, a kitail karos pan nitwilida.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:52
verses.text: Madang ni marep ta ieu, koronete en muri lao popeuk. Pwe koronete pan popeuk, a me melar akan ap pan kamauredang somor pasang a kitail pan kawilikapada.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:53
verses.text: Pwe mor pasang wet pan kiawikilang so mor pasang; o mela wet kiawikilang somela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:54
verses.text: A mor pasang wet lao kiawikilang so mor pasang o mela wet kiawikilang somela, masan o ap pan pwaida, me intingidier: Maur kadalala mela.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:55
verses.text: Mela koe, ia om tata? Mela ia om poedi?

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:56
verses.text: Mana en mela dip, a manaman en dip kapung.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:57
verses.text: Danke ong Kot, pwe a kotiki ong kitail, en poediki atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: I Corinthians 15:58
verses.text: Ari ri ai kompok kan, komail kelail kaukaule o der wukiwuk sili, a kakairida ni omail wiawia en Kaun o, pwe komail asa, me omail dodok ong Kaun o kaidin dodok mal.<div eID="gen2765" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.15"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:1
verses.text: A DUEN kisakis ong saraui kan, me komail pan ki pena, i men, komail en wiada, duen i kakaliki ong momodisou en Kalesia kan.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:2
verses.text: Ni at en ran en wik kan amen amen re omail en nikidala ekis, o ki pena duen wan a kak ong pwe onop de wiaui, i lao pwara wong.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:3
verses.text: I lao pwara weilar, meakai, me komail pan kileledi, irail me i pan ilakewei, en walang Ierusalem omail kisakis iangaki kisin likau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:4
verses.text: O ma a kon ong, i en pil sailok wei; irail ap pan iang ia sailokala.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:5
verses.text: A i pan pwara wong komail ni ai dauli Masetonien, pwe i pan weid nan Masetonien.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:6
verses.text: Ele i pan mimieta re omail, ansaun kapau lao nikier, pwe komail en kalua ia la wasa, me i pan sailokala ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:7
verses.text: Pwe ansau wet i sota pan sup re omail, pwe i kaporoporeki, me i pan mimieta re omail ansau kis, ma Kaun pan kotin mueid ong ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:8
verses.text: A i pan mimieta Episus lao pentikos.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:9
verses.text: Pwe wanim tälap ritida mo i, me kareda wa toto; a imwintiti me toto.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:10
verses.text: A Timoteus lao pwara wong komail, apwali i, pwen sondi mau re omail, pwe a kin iang ia wiawia dodok en Kaun o.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:11
verses.text: Sota amen en mamaleki i, a kalua i dong ia popol, pwe ngai o ri atail akan kin auiaui i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:12
verses.text: A duen ri atail Apolos, ngai me poeki re a pan pak toto, en iang ri atail akan pwara wong komail, a a kang pwara wei ansau wet; a a pan pwara wei lao ansau mau.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:13
verses.text: Komail masamasan o dadaurata ni poson, komail wia duen ol melel, o komail en kelail.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:14
verses.text: Meakaros en wiaui ni limpok

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:15
verses.text: I ari panaui komail, ri ai kan, pwe komail asa penainai en Stepanas, me ir tapida saulang en Akaia, o me pein irail inong iong dodok ong saraui kan,

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:16
verses.text: Pwe komail en peiki ong irail, o ong irail karos me iang ni ar wiawia o dodok.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:17
verses.text: I peren kida en Stepanas, o Portunatus, o Akaius ar pwarador, pwe mekis, me komail so ki ong ia mepukat ki dong ia.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:18
verses.text: Irail kaperenda ngen i o pil ngen omail; komail ari wauneki me due met.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:19
verses.text: En momotisou en Asien akan ar ranamau wong komail. A Akwila o Prisila kin ranamau wong komail pan Kaun o momodisou nan im ara.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:20
verses.text: Ri atail ol akan karos kin ranamau wong komail. Komail ranamauki pena metik saraui.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:21
verses.text: Ngai Paulus me inting kilang komail ai ranamau ki pein pa i.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:22
verses.text: Ma amen sota kin pok ong Kaun Iesus Kristus, a pan anatema! Maranata! Iet wewe; A pan riala! Atail Kaun kotido.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:23
verses.text: Mak en Kaun Iesus Kristus en mimieta re omail!

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:24
verses.text: Ai limpok ong komail pan Kristus Iesus pan mimieta re omail! Amen.<div eID="gen2766" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Cor.16"/> <div eID="gen2750" osisID="1Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS wanporon en Iesus Kristus amen pan kupur en Kot o ri atail Timoteus ong momodisou en Kot, me mi Korint o saraui kan karos, me mi Akaia.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam atail o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:3
verses.text: Meid iasanai Kot o Sam en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, o Sam en kalangan, o Kot en kamait pokon,

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:4
verses.text: Me kin kamakamait kit ni at kamekam kan karos, pwe kit en pil kak kamait ir ala, me mi nan song en kamekam akan karos, ki kamait, me kit kamait kila ren Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:5
verses.text: Pwe duen Kristus a kamekam me muladok ong kit, iduen kamait ren Kristus pil itar penang kit.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: A ma kit pai olar, nan a kin wiaui, pwen kamait o kamaur komail la, mepukat kin wiaui ni omail kanongama ni kalokolok ota, me kit kin kalokolokki.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: O at kaporopor kin komail me tengeteng, pwe se asa, ma komail iang kamekam, komail pil pan iang kamaitala.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: Ri ai ol akan, se sota men, komail en sasa duen at kamekam nan Asien o at patau kaualap, lao solar kaporopor en maur at.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:9
verses.text: Ari, kit lamedar, me se pan mela. A mepukat wiauier, pwe sen der keleki pein kit, pwe Kot eta, me kin kaiasada me melar akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:10
verses.text: Me kotin dore kit ala sang mela wet, o a pil pan dore kit ala; o se kaporoporeki, me a pil pan kotin dore kit ala kokolata.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:11
verses.text: Komail pil sauasa kit ni omail ngidingid, pwe me toto en danke pweki at pai me se aleer.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:12
verses.text: Pwe iet kaping pat: Insen at kin kadede ong kit, me se weweideki karakarak o melel en Kot nin sappa o nan pung omail, kaidin ni lolekong en pali uduk, a ki mak en Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: At inting wong komail kaidin toror sang me komail kin wadok o kamelele. A i kaporoporeki me komail pan kamelele kit kokolata duen akai komail kamelele kit er.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:14
verses.text: Pwe kit me kaping pa omail, dueta komail me kaping pat ni ran en Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: A ni kaporopor wet, me i men pwar kilang komail mas o, pwe komail en pur ong pereperen.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: I ap pan daulul lang komail ni ai pan kolang Masetonien, ap pil puredo re omail sang Masetonien, a komail pan kalua ia lang Iudäa.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: A iaduen, ngai me sapung ni ai kileledier mepukat? De i (BEGIN MISSING SOURCE p259) kin kileledi mepukat ni tiak en pali uduk, pwen ei ei o so so tapi sang pein ngai?

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: A Kot me melel, pwe me se indang komail me sota ei o so.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: Pwe sapwilim en Kot Iesus Kristus, me kit padaki ong komail er, ngai, o Silwanus, o Timoteus, i kaidin ei o so, a ei eta re a,

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: Pwe inau en Kot akan karos me ei eta re a o me amen re a, pwe kit en kalinganada Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: A me kin katinai kit o komail pan Kristus o keie kitail er, iei Kot,

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: Me pil kotin kileledier kitail o kotiki ong kitail er komoan Ngen nan mongiong atail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: A i kin likwir ong Kot me saunkadede en ngen i, me i saikenta pwara wong komail nan Korint, pwe i de katoutoui komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: Kit sota men poedi omail poson, a kit men sauasa ta omail peren, pwe komail keleki poson.<div eID="gen2768" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.1"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: IET me pein ngai kileledier, i solar men pwar wong komail ni ai insensued.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: Pwe ma i kainsensuedi komail, is me pan kak kainsenemau ia la? Ma kaidin i eta, me kainsensuedelar re i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: Mepukat i inting wong komail er, pwe i ender insensuede kin irail, me i en peren kida, ni ai pan pwara wong komail. A i kamelele komail karos, me ai peren pil pan omail karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: Pwe ni lokolok o masak en nan mongiong i me lapalap, me i inting kilang sangesang, kaidin pwen kamauki komail, a pwe komail en asada, duen ai limpok ong komail kaualapia.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: A ma meamen wiada kainsensued eu, kaidin ngai eta, me a kainsensuedi, pwe i ender non kapung ong, a ele komail karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: A kalokolok sang ren me toto itar ong i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: Mak eta komail en maki ong i o kamaitala, pwe a de lodi ong insensued laud.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:8
verses.text: I ari panaui komail, komail en kasale ong i omail limpok.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:9
verses.text: I karepen ai inting wong komail, pwe i en asa, ma komail me pung o peiki ong ni meakaros.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:10
verses.text: A ma komail pan makeki ong meamen meakot, ngai pil pan maki ong i. A ma i makeki ong amen meakot, i makekier pweki komail wilianti Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:11
verses.text: Pwe Satan ender kotaue kitail, pwe kitail asaer duen a lamelam.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:12
verses.text: A ni ai pwaralanger Troas, pwen padaki rongamau en Kristus, o wanim eu me ritida mo i ong Kaun o,

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:13
verses.text: I sota insenemaula, ni ngen i, pweki ai sota diar ri ai Titus. I ap kamurimur ong irail daulul wong Masetonien.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:14
verses.text: A danke ong Kot, me kotin kaloe kitail di pan Kristus, ap kasansaleki kitail pomau en a erpit wasa karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:15
verses.text: Pwe kit me pomau en Kristus ong Kot ren me pan dorela o ren me pan lokidokila kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:16
verses.text: Ong iet akan po en mela ong kamela, a ong me tei kan po en maur ong kamaurela. A is me kon ong mepukat?

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:17
verses.text: Pwe kit so dueta me toto, me kin liliasosaki masan en Kot; a at padak me melel, o a pwili sang Kot, o kin wiaui mon Kot pan Kristus.<div eID="gen2769" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.2"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: A IADUEN kit pil kaindandeki pein kit? De ngai me mau ong kisin likau en kaping ong komail de sang komail?

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:2
verses.text: At kisin likau komail, me intingidi ong nan mongiong it, me aramas akan karos kin asa o wadok.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:3
verses.text: Pwe komail sansaleda, me komail kisin likau en Kristus, me wiauier re at ni at papa, me kaidin intingidier ki ingk, a Ngen en Kot ieias; pil kaidin pon slet takai, pwe slet uduken en mongiong akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:4
verses.text: Iei atail kaporoporeki Kristus mon Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:5
verses.text: Pwe kaidin udan at koiok, me se kak lamelameki meakot, me tapi sang pein kit, pwe at koiok tapi sang ren Kot,

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:6
verses.text: Me pil kotin kaiane kin kit, en papa en inau kap kaidin inau, me intingidier, a inau en ngen. Pwe inting kin kamela, a ngen kin kotin kamaureda.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:7
verses.text: A ma dodok en mela, me intingidier nan pali en takai, me lingan, pwe seri en Israel akan sota kak kilang silang en Moses, pweki lingan en silang i, a lingan wet eu, me pan soredi,

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:8
verses.text: Daduen, dodok en ngen a sota pan lingan sikida sang?

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:9
verses.text: Ari, ma dodok en kadeik o me lingan, nan melel kaualap, dodok en pung me lingan melel.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:10
verses.text: Pwe men moa me kalinganadar sota kak paroki ong lingan wet.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:11
verses.text: A ma lingan mia ren me pan sorela, iaduen wan lingan en me pan mimieta!

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:12
verses.text: Ni at kaporoporeki mepukat, kit kin aima melel.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:13
verses.text: O kaidin dueta Moses, me pera kila likau eu silang i, pwe seri en Israel akan ender kilang imwi en me pan nikila.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: A mongiong arail me kapitakailar. Pwe lao lel ran wet pera o mimieta ansaun ar wadawadok inau maring; ari, pera o me saroka sanger ren Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:15
verses.text: A lao lel ran wet ni arail wadawadok Moses, pera mimieta mon mongiong arail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: A ma re pan wuki ong Kaun o, pera o pan saroka san.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:17
verses.text: Kaun o iei Ngen, a wasa me Ngen en Kaun kotikot ia, nan i wasan maio.

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: A kitail karos, me mas atail so perapa, kin ududial lingan en Kaun o, ap wuki ong ni mom ota o kakairida ni lingan pweki Kaun iei Ngen.<div eID="gen2770" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.3"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: KIT sota kin pangada, pweki at koa dodok me se aleer ki mak o.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: Pwe kit muei sanger sued okiok kan o se sota weweideki widing o sota liasosa ki masan en Kot; pwe ni at kapwareda melel kit kin kamaui pein kit ong insen en aramas karos mon Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: A ma at rongamau me malar, nan a malang men lokidokila kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: Me kot en sappa wet karotongala nan mongiong en me soposon akan, pwe ren der kilang marain en rongamau duen lingan en Kristus me mom en Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: Pwe kit sota kin padaki duen pein kit, a duen Kristus Iesus, me i Kaun, a kit ladu ’mail pweki Iesus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: Pwe Kot me masanier, marain en pwarada sang ni rotorot, me kotin kamarainiedar nan mongiong it, pwe sen maraineki o dedeki lingan en Kot ni silang en Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: A kit kin kolekol pai wet ni dal pwel, pwe manaman en kaindinda Kot a so kit.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: At apwal akan me andere kit pena, a se sota kin masak; sota wasa, me se pan kak pitila ia ap sota lodi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: Pan kamekam, ap sota kamela; pan kalokolok, ap sota mela;

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: O kit kin wewa sili ni war at en Iesus a matala, pwe maur en Iesus en pil sansal ni war at.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: Pwe kit, me memaur, kin kilele ong mela ansau karos pweki Iesus, pwe maur en Iesus en pil sansaleda ni uduk atail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: Nan i mela kin kelail ong kit, a maur ong komail,

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: A kit aleer ngen en poson ota, duen a intingidier: Ngai me poson, i me i padaki wei. Kit me pil posonlar ap padapadaki.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: Se asaer, me i, me kotin kaiasadar Kaun Iesus, pan pil kotin kaiasada kitail iang Iesus, o pan kotin kasansaleda kitail o komail mo a.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:15
verses.text: Meakaros wiauier pweki komail, pwe mak o ni a laude kilar me toto, en kalaudela melel danke, pwen kalinganada Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: I me se sota kin pangada, a ma at pali liki en aramas pan soredi, pali lol it kin kokoda ni ran karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: Pwe atail ansau apwal me motomot o tikitik; ap kare ong kitail lingan soutuk eu me lapalap melel,

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: Pwe kitail sota kin kilekilang meakan me sansal, a meakan me so sansal. Pwe me sansal me katuk, a me so sansal me soutuk.<div eID="gen2771" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.4"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: PWE kitail asaer, impwal atail sappa a lao ola, kitail pan id imaneki im eu sang ren Kot, im eu me kaidin wiaui kida pa, pwe a me soutuk nanlang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: I me kitail kin sangesang o inong iong im sang nanlang en kalikau kitail da.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:3
verses.text: Pwe ma kitail likaudar, kitail solar pan kiliso.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: Pwe ni atail deula impwal wet kitail kin sangesang o patau, pwe kitail sota men pure sang atail likau, a se men kadupaledi, pwe maur en katalala mela.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: A me wia kin kitail ong mepukat, i Kot me pil kotiki ong kitail er komoan Ngen.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:6
verses.text: Kitail ari insenemau ansau karos o asaer, ni atail kauson ki war, kitail kin doo wei sang Kaun.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:7
verses.text: Pwe kitail kin weweid ni poson a kaidin ni kilang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:8
verses.text: Ari so, kitail kin insenemau o inong iong muei sang war atail, ap mimi nan deu atail ren Kaun o.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: Nan i me kitail kin nantiong kaperen i, ma ni deu ’tail de ni at doo wei sang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: Pwe kitail karos pan sansal mon mol en kadeik en Kristus, pwe amen amen en ale pwain en a wiawia arain a maur ni pali war, ma me mau de me sued.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: Kit asaer, me sen masak Kaun o, i me se kin kanekanai ong at dodok ong aramas akan, ap kin sansal ong Kot. A i pil kaporoporeki me se pil sansal ong nan insen omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: Pwe kit sota sapal suaiki pein kit ong komail, a se pang ong komail, en kaping pat, pwe peikite pamail en mia ong irail, me kin suaiki mas arail, a so mongiong arail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: Pwe ni at mi likin war at, a kin wiaui ong Kot, a ma so, se kin dodok ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:14
verses.text: Pwe iduen limpok en Kristus kangong kin kit, pwe se kasauiadar, me amen mata kila karos, i me irail karos mekilar.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:15
verses.text: A i mata kilang karos, pwe irail me memaur, der memaur ong pein irail, a ong i, me mata kin irail lar o me kaiasadar.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:16
verses.text: I me se solar asa amen ni pali uduk. Ei, mas o se asaer Kristus ni pali uduk eta, a met se solar asa i due.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:17
verses.text: Ari ma amen mi ren Kristus, nan a wilikapadar; men mas momelar, kilang, karos wilikapada.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:18
verses.text: A meakan karos sang ren Kot, me kotin kalolamaui ong pein i kitail ki Iesus Kristus, me kotiki ong kit at koa dodok, duen padak en kalolmau.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:19
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotikot ren Kristus o kotin kalokalolamau ong pein i sappa, o solar kapokon ong irail dip arail akan, o kotiki ong kitail masan en kalolamau.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:20
verses.text: Ari, kit men en kadar en Kristus, pwe Kot kin panaui ki kit. Kit wiliandi Kristus ap poekipoeki kin komail: Komail kalolamau pein komail ong Kot!

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:21
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotin kapokonki ong, me so dip a, dip atail, pwe kitail en pung kila pa ren Kot.<div eID="gen2772" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.5"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: KIT men sauasa kai, men panaui komail, pwe komail de ale mal mak en Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: Pwe a kotin masani: I rong uk er ni ansau mau, o ni ran en kamaur I katoi uk adar. Kilang ansau wet ansau mau; ansau wet ran en kamaur.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: Kit sota kadipikelekel ong meakot, pwe at koa dodok ede kalok sued.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: A ni meakaros kit kin wia sansal en papa en Kot akai: Ni kanongama melel, ni kamekam, ni paiio kan, ni kamasak kan,

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: Ni wokwok, nan imateng, ni moromorong, ni dodok, ni masamasan, ni isesol.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:6
verses.text: Ni makelekel, ni lolekong, ni lolin, ni kadek, ni Ngen saraui, ni limpok melel,
