verses.name: II Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: Ni masan melel, ni manaman en Kot, ki tatan mauin en pung pali maun o pali maing,

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: Ni kaka, o sokaka, ni kalok sued, o kalok mau, dene kaweid sapung, ari so, me melel,

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: Dene pasase, ari so, kit me indand; koren iong mela, a kilang kit memaureta; me kin kamekam, ap sota kamela,

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: Ni insensued, ap pereperen ansau karos, me samama, ap kakepwapwala me toto, sota at meakot, ap aneki meakaros.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: Men Korint, au at ritidang komail, o nan mongiong it me laudi ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: Kaidin me tikitik deu ’mail nan mongiong it, a mongiong omail me tikitik.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: I kin padaki ong komail dueta ong seri kan, pwe komail en pil wiai ong ia dueta, o kalaudela nan mongiong omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: Komail ender paroki ong me so poson akan, pwe iaduen, pung kak minimin ong sapung? De marain pan kak waroki ong rotorot?

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: De iaduen Kristus o Pelial ara kak parok pena? De da pwais en me poson ren me soposon?

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: De tanpas en Kot pan kak pat ong ani mal akan? Pwe tanpas en Kot ieias iei komail, duen Kot kotin masanier: I pan kauson re ’rail o daudaulole irail, o Ngai pan arail Kot, a irail pan nai aramas akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: Komail ari muei sang irail o katoror sang pein komail, me Kaun o kotin masani, o ender doke me kasaut kot, Ngai ap pan apwali komail,

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: O I pan Sam omail, o komail pan nai ol o li akan, me Kaun lapalap kotin masani.<div eID="gen2773" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.6"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: KOMPOKE pai kan, pweki inau pukat kitail en muei sang kasaut en uduk o ngen atail karos, o kitail en dadaurata atail kasarauila ni wauneki Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: Komail apwali kit, sota amen me se wia sapung ong, sota amen me kit kawelar, sota amen me kit kulia sang okotme.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: Mepukat i inda kaidin pwen kadeikada, pwe i apton indada, me deu omail nan mongiong it, pwen iang mela o iang memaur.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: Ngai ari aima ong komail, o ai kapinga komail me lapalap, o i direki kamait; ngai me peren kida melel ni at kalokolok karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: Pwe ni at leler Masetonien, uduk at sota diar kamol, pwe se kalokolok wasa karos: Pali liki pepei o pali lole masak.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: A Kot me kin kamaitala me karakarak kan, a kotin kamait kit ala ki en Titus a pwarador.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: A kaidin a pwarador eta, pwe pil kamait o, me pein a kamait kila komail, ni a kasansaledang kit omail anane, o omail sangesang o omail lolete kin ia; i me kalaudela ai peren.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: Pwe ma i kainsensuedi kin komail er kisin likau o, i sota kalula, a ma i kalular mas o, pwe i diaradar me kisin likau kainsensuede kidar komail ansau kis,

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: A met i peren kidar, kaidin pweki omail insensued, a pweki omail insensued ong kalula, pwe omail insensued duen kupur en Kot, pwe komail ender ale me sued kot re at.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: Pwe insensued duen kupur en Kot kareda kalula ong maur, me aramas sota pan kalu kila, a insensued en sappa kareda mela.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: Pwe kilang, omail insensued duen kupur en Kot, kare ong komail song toto: Porisok, o pukoki, o makar, o masak, o anane, o inong iong, o depuk! A komail kasansaledar ni song karos, me komail makelekel ni mepukat.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: I inting wong komail er, kaidin pweki i, me kainsensued, pil kaidin pweki i, me a kainsensued ong, a pweki at apapwali komail en sansal re omail mon Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: Kit ari kamaitalar; kit peren kida kaualap en Titus a peren, pwe ngen e dapwenda komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: Pwe ni ai kapingaki komail re a, i sota namenokki, pwe duen ai lokaia karos ong komail me melel, iduen at suaiki mon Titus pwaidar melel.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: O a kin pok ong komail melel ni a tamatamanda omail oke, duen omail kasamo i ni masak o rerer.

verses.name: II Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: I peren kida, me i kak kamelele komail ni song karos.<div eID="gen2774" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.7"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:1
verses.text: RI ai kan, se men padaki ong komail duen mak en Kot en momodisou en Masetonien akan, duen ar kikiwei;

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:2
verses.text: Pwe ar kalokolok meid laud, o irail pil meid samama, ari so, mepukat imwilang peren o mairong laud,

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:3
verses.text: Pwe ngai kadede irail, me re kida duen me re kak ong o laude sang.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:4
verses.text: Pein irail inong iong ap ngidengideki ong kit, en ale ar kisakis, o ar iang sauasa kisakis wet ong saraui kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:5
verses.text: O re wiadar mepukat, kaidin duen at kaporoporeki, a re ki ong Kaun o pein irail mas, ap pil ong kit pan kupur en Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:6
verses.text: Kit ari panaui Titus en kanikiela mak wet re omail duen a tapiadar mas o.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:7
verses.text: A duen omail kapwapwaki song karos: Ni poson o masan, o lolekong, o porisok, o omail limpok ong kit, iduen komail pil inong iong, en kapwapwa ni mak wet.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:8
verses.text: I indai ong komail met, kaidin kusoned eu, a pweki porisok en me tei kan, o i kin kasongesong omail limpok, ma a pung de so.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:9
verses.text: Pwe komail asaer mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, duen a kapwapwa, ap samamalar pweki komail, pwe komail en kapwapwa kila i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:10
verses.text: A iet ai lamelam me i men kasaleda, a meid katepa ong komail, pwe komail tapiadar inong iong ap pil kapwaiada dodok mau wet ni par samalar.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:11
verses.text: Komail ari kanikiela dodok wet, pwe duen omail men iang onop, iduen komail en wiada sang ni omail kapwapwa.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:12
verses.text: A ma amen inong iong, iang dodok wet, a pan konekonela duen me a pan kak ong, kaidin duen me a sota kak ong.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:13
verses.text: Pwe irail ender mararaki, a komail id toutouki; a karos en parok pena.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:14
verses.text: Pwe ansau wet omail kapwapwa en kaitar arail samama, a arail kapwapwa en kaitar omail samama, pwe karos en parok pena.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:15
verses.text: Duen a intingidier: Me rik penaer mo toto, a sota men nak, o me rik penaer me malaulau, a sota kin dupok.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:16
verses.text: Danke ong Kot, me kotin kainong iong mongiong en Titus;

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:17
verses.text: Pwe a duki ong at poeki, a pil pein i inong iong madang pwar wong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:18
verses.text: A kit pil kadar wei ri atail ol o iang i, me indandeki a padaki wei rongamau ni momodisou kan karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:19
verses.text: A kaidin i eta, pwe momodisou kan pil piladar i, en iang kit papaki mak wet, me kit kin apapwali ong kalinganada Kaun o kapinga omail inong iong mau.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:20
verses.text: Kanakanai ong, pwe amen de kasapunge kin kit at paki kisakis laud wet,

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:21
verses.text: Kit pil kin masamasan, pwe karos en inen, kaidin mon Kaun eta, pwe pil mon aramas akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:22
verses.text: A kit kadar ir wei iangaki ri atail o, me diarokadar ni song toto, me a porisok, a ansau wet a porisok sang mas ni a liki komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:23
verses.text: Ari, ma amen pan idok duen Titus, i ai warok o sauasa pai re omail; a duen ri atail akan, irail me men en kadar en momodisou kan o lingan en Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 8:24
verses.text: Komail ari kasansale ong irail mon momodisou kan omail limpok ni omail apapwali irail duen i kapinga kin komail.<div eID="gen2775" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.8"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:1
verses.text: A DUEN dodok ong me saraui kan, i solar pan inting wong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:2
verses.text: Pwe i asa, me omail inong iong me mau, me i kin suaiki ong men Masetonien, me men Akaia inong iong mepukat sang ni par samalar, a komail kainong iong me toto.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:3
verses.text: I ap ilakiawei ri atail akan, pwe at kaping pa omail ender mal la ni mepukat, pwe komail en onop duen me i inda.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:4
verses.text: Pwe ma men Masetonien kai pan iang ia, ap konodi komail ni omail so onop, kit, se sota men inda komail, ap pan namenok kila ni at liki wet.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:5
verses.text: Ari, i ap lamedar, en poeki ren ri atail akan, ren tiong mo at kolang komail, pwen kaonopada pai wet, me komail inaukidar mas o, pwen pai melel eu, a iermen norok sued.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:6
verses.text: A iet me i inda: Me kin kamorok tikitik, pan dolung tikitik, a me kin kamorok toto, pan dolung me toto.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:7
verses.text: Amen amen duen a kileledier nan mongiong i; der kisa kol, de akpatik, pwe Kot kotin pok ong me kin pein perenki kisakis.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:8
verses.text: A Kot me kotin manaman ong en kalaudelang komail song en mak kan karos, pwe komail en kapwapwa ni song karos o ansau karos, ap kak ong song en wiawia mau karos,

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:9
verses.text: Duen a intingidier: A kamoredier, a kisakisa wei ong me samama kan; a pung pan mimieta kokolata.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:10
verses.text: A me kin kotiki ong saumat kisin war akan, o prot men manga, a pan katotoela omail war akan, o a pan kotin kawosada omail wan pung kan,

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:11
verses.text: Pwe komail en kapwapwala ni song karos, pwen wiawia mau karos, me kin karedang kit, en danke Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:12
verses.text: Pwe wiawia pan dodok wet kaidin sauas pan saraui kan ta, pwe me toto kin danke Kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: Arail kapwaiada dodok wet kin kalinganada Kot pweki omail upai ong kadede en rongamau en Kristus, o omail sapan kisakis ong irail o ong karos,

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: O ni arail ngidingide kin komail, re kin anane komail pweki mak lapalap en Kot ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: Daken ong Kot pweki a pai lapalap!<div eID="gen2776" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.9"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:1
verses.text: ARI pein ngai Paulus men panaui komail nin tiak en opampap o limpok en Kristus; pwe ni ai mi nan pung omail, i kin aktikitik, a ni ai doo wei sang komail, i kin kelail ong komail

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:2
verses.text: A i kin kapakapeki, pwe i ender kelail ni ai pan korendo; pwe i kileledier o lamelame, me i pan kelail ong akai, me kin wia kin kit men kekeideki tiak en pali uduk.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:3
verses.text: Pwe melel, se kin mimita nan uduk, ap sota pepei ni tiak en uduk.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:4
verses.text: Pwe kapwa en at pei kaidin men ni pali uduk, pwe me manaman mon Kot, me mau ong kawela wasa tengeteng kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:5
verses.text: Ni at kin kawela me akapung o me aklapalap, me kin palian erpit en Kot; o kit kin saliedi song en lamelam karos, pwen oke Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:6
verses.text: O audaude ong kaloedi me katiwo karos, omail peik lao pwanokadar.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:7
verses.text: Komail kin kilekilang meakan me sansal? Ma amen lamelame, me pein i sapwilim en Kristus, i en pein lameda, me kit pil sapwilim en Kristus dueta i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:8
verses.text: Pwe ma i pan suaiki laude sang at manaman, me Kaun o kotiki ong kit, pwen kamaui a kaidin kawe komail la, i sota pan namenokki.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:9
verses.text: Pwe ender sansal duen amen me men kamasak kin komail ngai kisin likau kan,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:10
verses.text: Pwe irail me inda: Kisin likau kan me kasampwal o manaman, a sansal en pali war a me luet, o a padak me mal kot.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:11
verses.text: A me duen met, a en asa duen at kin inda nan kisin likau kan ni at doo wei sang komail, iduen pein kit ni at wiawia kan nan pung omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:12
verses.text: Pwe kit sota man mauki waroki ong me kin suaiki pein irail; a irail me sololekong, pweki ar sosong pein irail nan pung arail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:13
verses.text: A kit sota men suaiki me laud sang me kon ong, a duen men song eu, me Kot kotin pang ong kit, song eu, me itar lel ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:14
verses.text: Pwe kit sota inong iong, me sota kon ong, dene se sota pwar wong komail er, a se pil walang komail rongamau en Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:15
verses.text: Kit sota kin suaiki me laud sang me kon ong, dene se suaiki en amen a dodok. A se kaporoporeki omail poson lao kakairida, at dodok pil pan laud sang re omail,

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:16
verses.text: Pwen pil padaki rongamau nin sap akan palila sang komail, a kaidin wasan dodok en amen o sota suaiki me wiauier.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:17
verses.text: A ma amen men suaiki, i en suaiki Kaun o.

verses.name: II Corinthians 10:18
verses.text: Pwe kaidin i meakot, me kin kapinga pein i, pwe i eta, me Kaun o kin kapinga.<div eID="gen2777" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.10"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:1
verses.text: I mauki, komail en mueid ong ia kisin pweipwei, iei ta komail pan mueid ong ia.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:2
verses.text: Pwe ngai me per kin komail dueta Kot, pwe ngai me kileledier komail ong ol amen, pwe i en kasale komail ong Kristus duen seripein makelekel amen.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:3
verses.text: A i masak serpent widingok, me kotaue Ewa, ma a sota pan pil kawela omail lamelam sang ni opampap en Kristus.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:4
verses.text: Pwe ma amen pan pwarado, me kin padaki duen amen Iesus, me se sota padaki, de ma komail pan ale eu ngen, me komail sota aleer, de eu rongamau, me komail sota wuki ong, kaidin komail pan peren kida?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:5
verses.text: Pwe i lamelame, me ngai kaidin tikitik sang wanporon lapalap akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:6
verses.text: A ma i sota koiok ong lokaia a kaidin ni ai dedeki, pwe kit sansal ong komail ni song o wasa karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:7
verses.text: De ngai me wiadar dip eu ni ai akmalkila pein ngai? Pwe komail en indandala ki ai padaki ong komail rongamau en Kot so pwaipwai.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:8
verses.text: I atia sang momotisou tei kan ni ai aleer pwain en dodok, pwe i en kak dodok ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:9
verses.text: O ni ai mimi re omail o lao samamala, kaidin amen, me i uki pa meakot, pwe ni ai solar ai meakot, ri atail akan me kodo sang Masetonien me kisa dong ia; ngai ari sota katoutoui komail ni meakot, o i pil pan due!

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:10
verses.text: A duen melel en Kristus mimi lol i, iduen i sota pan mueid ong amen, en kawela kaping wet nan sap en Akaia kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:11
verses.text: Pwekida? Pweki ai so pok ong komail? Kot me kotin mangier.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:12
verses.text: A me i kin wia, i me i pan wiada, pwen kawela karep en akai me inong iong karep en ar suaiki dene irail dueta kit, sota lipilipil is i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:13
verses.text: Pwe wanporon likam pukat o toun dodok likam akan irail, kin kawukilang wanporon akan en Kristus pein irail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:14
verses.text: A kaidin kapuriamui eu, pwe iduen Satan kin kawukila pein i, wuki ong tounlang en marain amen.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: I me kaidin kapuriamui eu, ma nä papa kan pil pan wukilang papa en pung kan; a imwilar pan duen ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: I purong indada, sota amen en akpweipwei kin ia, a ma iei, komail ap maki ong ia ai pweipwei, pwe i en suai kin ia ekis.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: A me i inda, kaidin Kaun o me i pwili sang, pwe a tapi sang ni tiak en pweipwei, pwe i suaiki pein ngai;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: Pwe me toto kin suaiki ni pali uduk, i pil pan suaiki pein ngai.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: Pwe komail kin mauki me lolepon kan, pweki komail me lolekong.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: Pwe komail kin mueid ong amen, en wia kin komail ladu kan, de ma amen kaloke komail, de ma amen kuli komail edi, de ma amen aklapalap, de ma amen pikir komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: Mepukat i indang komail, pwen kanamenok ki komail, dene kit luetalar. A ma meamen aima, ngai pil aima, i kin lokaia nin tiak en pweipwei.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: Irail men Ipru, pil ngai; irail men Israel, pil ngai; irail kadaudok en Apraam, pil ngai;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: Irail me papan Kristus, i kin lokaia dueta me iak amen, ngai me lapa sang; ai dodok laud sang, i kalokolok laud sang; i salidier toto sang, i koren iong mela pan pak toto.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: Pan me limpak Sus oko ki ong ia wok paeisok, eu katoror sang,

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: A pan me silepak re woki kin ia sokon; pan mepak me i pakasuk; pan me silepak takepa i sop olar; pong o ran, me i pepe sili nan madau.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: Ai sailok me toto; i diar ai apwal nan pilap akan; i diar ai apwal ren lolap akan; i diar ai apwal ren ai kainok; i diar ai apwal nan sap tan; i diar ai apwal nan madau; i diar ai apwal ren saulang likam akan;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: Ni dodok apwal, ni songsongemas, ni men mangadar o men nim piladar, ni isesol pan pak toto, ni pou o so kidi pa;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: O me pil kin lel ong ia ni ran karos, o ai apapwali momodisou akan karos.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: Is me luet, a ngai sota pan luet? Is me kin kamakar, a ngai so?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:30
verses.text: Ma i en suaiki, i pan suaiki ai luet.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: Kot o Sam en Kaun Iesus, me iasanai kokolata, kin mangi, me i sota kin likam.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: Nan Damaskus nain nanmarki Aretas kopina amen sinsila kanim en men Damaskus ni a inong iong saik ia di.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: I ap apikidi kopou eu sang ni wanim tuk en kel o, ap piti sang ni pa a kan.<div eID="gen2778" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.11"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: ARI, ai suaiki sota katepa ong ia. Ari so, i pan kapareda kaudial akai o kadiarok kai ren Kaun o.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: I asa duen aramas amen ren Kristus, mon saunpar eisok paieu; i sasa, ma a mi nan war a, de ma a mi likin war a, i pil sasa, Kot me kotin mangi, i aramas o, me peukadala lel nanlang kasilu.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: O i asa, iei aramas o, ma a mi nan war a de likin war a, i sasa, Kot me kotin mangi.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: I me peukadalang paradis, wasa a rongadar kasoi kai, me sota muei ong aramas amen en inda.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: I me i pan suaiki; a pein ngai sota pan suaiki meakot, ai luet eta.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: A ma i men suaiki pein ngai, i sota pan pweipwei, pwe i pan lokaia melel. Ari so, i sota pan wia, pwe amen ender wia kin ia me lapa sang duen a kin kilang ia o duen a kin rong ia.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: A pwe i ende aklapalapaki kaudial kapuriamui kai, tuka teketek pot mi nan uduk ai, iei nain Satan, me kin dokodoko ia, pwe i ende aklapalap.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: Pan sile pak i ngidingid ong Kaun o, en kotiki sang ia me.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: I ari masani ong ia: Ai mak itar ong uk, pwe manaman ai kin sansal ren me luet akan. Nan i me i pan suaiki ai luet akan, pwe manaman en Kristus en kotikot re i.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: I me i perenki ai luet akan, o so konekon, o ansau apwal, o kamekam, o patau pweki Kristus, pwe ma i luet, ngai me kelail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: Ngai wialar pweipwei men, i me komail kare ong ia, mak eta, komail en kapinga kin ia, pwe i sota tikitik sang wanporon lapalap akan; ari so, sota meakot ngai.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: Pwe mangidi en wanporon wiauier nan pung omail ni kanongama melel o ni kilel akan, o ni men kapuriamui kan, o ni manaman akan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: Pwe nin da, me komail tikitikki sang momodisou tei kan, ele iet eta: I sota katoutoui kin komail meakot? Komail ari makeki ong ia sapung wet.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: Kilang, i onoper pwar wong komail kasilepak, o i sota pan kaponede komail, pwe i sota kin rapaki me noumail, a komail. Pwe kaidin seri kan en naka penang me wia ir ada, a me wia ir da ong seri kan.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: A i mauki melel kiki wei meakaros, pil pein ngai ong ngen omail, i sota insenoki, ma omail pok ong ia tikitik sang ai limpok lapalap ong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: Ari i eta, i sota kaponedeer komail; a pweki ai lolekong, i kaloedier komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: De iaduen, i adia sang amen komail ekis ren me i kadar wong komail er?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: I poeki ren Titus ap kadar wong komail pil ri atail iang i. Ari da, Titus pitia sang komail meakot? Kit so aluki ngen ota de ni lip ota?

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: Ansau warai me komail kiki ong me se pan pur ong, kapungala pein kit ong komail. Kit kin lokaia ki Kristus mon Kot. Kompok kan, mepukat karos kin wiaui, pwen kamauiada komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: Pwe i masak ni ai pan pwar wong komail, me i sota pan diar komail, duen me i mauki, o komail pil sota pan diar ia, duen me komail mauki. Ele kapei lokaia, o peirin, o makar, o akamai, o kawaikoto, o lidou mongin, o aklapalap, o moromorong mi re omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: Pwe ni ai pan pure wong komail, ele Kot pan kotin kanamenok kin ia komail, o i pan insensuedeki me toto, me wiadar dip mas o, ap sota kalukila ar samin, o nenek, o dodok sued, me re wiadar.<div eID="gen2779" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.12"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:1
verses.text: METET ai pwar wong komail kasilepak, karos ap pan pung kila saunkadede riamen de silimen.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:2
verses.text: A duen me i inda mas o o pil ni ai pwar wong komail er kariapak iduen i pil indang komail ansau wet, mon ai pan mi re omail, irail me wiadar dip mas o, o pil me tei kan karos, i lao pwar wong komail kasilepak, i sota pan dukedi, karos lao pungier.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:3
verses.text: Pwe komail kin rapaki kilel eu, duen me Kristus kotin kalokaia ia, me sota luet nan pung omail, a a kin manaman nan pung omail,

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:4
verses.text: Pwe a kamatala ni a luet, ap id ieiaski manaman en Kot, a ma kit iang i luet, kit ap pan iang i memaureki manaman en Kot nan pung omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:5
verses.text: Komail sosong pein komail, ma komail kin weweideki poson; komail kasaui pein komail; de komail so asa duen pein komail, me Iesus Kristus kotikot lol omail? A ma so, komail me sapung.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:6
verses.text: A i kaporoporeki, me komail pan dedeki, me kaidin kit me sapung.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:7
verses.text: A se kin kapakap ren Kot, komail ender wia me sued. Kaidin pweki kit en indand mau a pwe komail en wia me pung a kit en dueta me so katepa.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:8
verses.text: Pwe kit sota kak palian melel, a kapwaiada me melel.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:9
verses.text: Pwe kit peren, ma se me luet, a komail me kelail, o i me se men, komail en unsokala.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:10
verses.text: Ari, i me i intingki wei mepukat ni ai doo wei, pwe i de ngil patik ni ai koren, duen manaman, me Kaun o kotiki ong ia, pwen kamaui, a kaidin pwen kawela.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:11
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, komail en pereperen o unsokala, o insenemau pena, komail lol ta pot o popol! Kot en limpok o popol ap pan kotikot re omail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:12
verses.text: Komail ranamauki pena metik saraui. En saraui kan karos ar ranamau wong komail.

verses.name: II Corinthians 13:13
verses.text: Mak en Kaun Iesus Kristus, o limpok en Kot, o atail saupena ren Ngen saraui en kotikot re omail karos! Amen.<div eID="gen2780" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Cor.13"/> <div eID="gen2767" osisID="2Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: Galatians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS wanporon amen kaidin sang ren aramas akan, pil kaidin pan aramas akan, a pan Iesus Kristus o Kot Sam, me kotin kaiasadar i sang ren me melar akan,

verses.name: Galatians 1:2
verses.text: O ri atail akan karos, me mi re i, at ranamau ong momodisou en Kalesia kan:

verses.name: Galatians 1:3
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail;

verses.name: Galatians 1:4
verses.text: Me kotin sokonpaude ki pein i ki dip atail, pwen dore kitail sang ni me sued akan mi sappa, duen kupur en Kot o Sam atail.

verses.name: Galatians 1:5
verses.text: Lingan en ko ong i kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: Galatians 1:6
verses.text: I puriamuiki omail madang wuki sang i, me molipe komail pan mak en Kristus, ap wuki ong eu rongamau;

verses.name: Galatians 1:7
verses.text: A sota eu mia. Ari so, akai mia, me kin kapingada komail, o irail men kalikame rongamau en Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:8
verses.text: A ma kit de tounlang amen sang nanlang pan padaki ong komail eu rongamau, me toror sang rongamau, me se padaki ong komail er, i en riala.

verses.name: Galatians 1:9
verses.text: Duen me se indada mas o, iduen se pil purong inda: Ma amen pan padaki ong komail eu rongamau, me toror sang me komail aleer, i en riala.

verses.name: Galatians 1:10
verses.text: Iaduen, i kin men kaperenda aramas akan de Kot? De i kin rapaki konekon ren aramas akan? Ma i men konekon ren aramas akan, i ap sota ladun Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:11
verses.text: I katitiki ong komail ri ai kan, rongamau me i padakier, a sota tapi sang ren aramas.

verses.name: Galatians 1:12
verses.text: Pwe i sota ale sang ren aramas amen, o sota me padaki ong ia, a a koki dong ia kasale pan Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:13
verses.text: Pwe komail ronger duen ai wiawia en mas nan pung en men Sus akan, duen i kin morouo ong momodisou en Kot lapalapia o kawe ir ala.

verses.name: Galatians 1:14
verses.text: O i kakairida nin lamalam en Sus akan madang sang me toto, me kit ti ta ieu o toun sap ta ieu, o i nantiong kapwaiada padok en sam at akan.

verses.name: Galatians 1:15
verses.text: A Kot lao kupureda, me kotin kilele ia di sang ni kaped en in ai, o me kotin molipe ia ki a mak,

verses.name: Galatians 1:16
verses.text: En kasale ong ia sapwilim a Ol, pwe i en padaki ong men liki kan duen i, i ap pitipit wiada o sota kalelapok ren uduk o nta.

verses.name: Galatians 1:17
verses.text: O i pil so pwar lang Ierusalem ren irail, me wanporon akan mo i, a i kolang Arapien ap pil pure dong Damaskus.

verses.name: Galatians 1:18
verses.text: Ari, murin par silu i ap kodalang Ierusalem, pwen kilang Kepas. I ap mimieta re a ran eisoklimau.

verses.name: Galatians 1:19
verses.text: A sota amen ren wanporon akan, me i kilang, Iakopus ta, ri en Kaun o.

verses.name: Galatians 1:20
verses.text: A me i inting wong komail, Kot me kotin mangi, me i sota likam.

verses.name: Galatians 1:21
verses.text: Muri i ap kola nan wein Sirien o Silisia.

verses.name: Galatians 1:22
verses.text: A momodisou en Iudäa kan me mi pan kupur en Kristus sasa ia.

verses.name: Galatians 1:23
verses.text: A i eta, irail ronger, me i me kin morouo ong kit mas o, i me kin padaki poson ansau wet, me a kin kaokaoe mas o.

verses.name: Galatians 1:24
verses.text: Irail ap kalinganda Kot pweki ngai.<div eID="gen2782" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.1"/>

verses.name: Galatians 2:1
verses.text: KADEKADEO murin par eisok paieu ngai pil kodalang Ierusalem iang Parnapas o Titus pil iang ia.

verses.name: Galatians 2:2
verses.text: A i kokidala kasalepa eu; padaki ong irail duen rongamau, me i kin padaki ong men liki kan, ap katoror ong ir, me kalok mau, pwe i ender tang mal, ma met de mur.

verses.name: Galatians 2:3
verses.text: A pil Titus, me iang ia, men Krik amen, re sota kakaliki ong i, en sirkomsaisela,

verses.name: Galatians 2:4
verses.text: A pweki akai saulang likam, me wailong, pwen masamasan at saledokalar, me se aleer ren Kristus Iesus, pwen kalidui kit ala.

verses.name: Galatians 2:5
verses.text: A se sota man peiki ong irail, pwe melel en rongamau en mimieta re omail.

verses.name: Galatians 2:6
verses.text: A irail me kalok mau, i sota asa duen ar tiak en mas o, a pil menda re i, pwe Kot sota kin lipilipil aramas amen, irail me indand mau, sota ki ong ia eu padak toror.

verses.name: Galatians 2:7
verses.text: A irail lao kilanger, me i aleer ai koa, en padaki ong me sosirkomsais rongamau, dueta Petrus ong me sirkomsais.

verses.name: Galatians 2:8
verses.text: A me kamanada Petrus, pwen kapwaiada a koa en wanporon ren sirkomsais i me i pil keleki ni ai dodok ren men liki kan.

verses.name: Galatians 2:9
verses.text: A Iakopus, o Kepas, o Ioanes, me re wiaki ur oko, re lao kilanger mak o me i aleer, rap itipa ki ong ngai o Parnapas pali maun en pa, o kit karos wiaki eu, me kit en kola ren men liki kan, a irail ren sirkomsais.

verses.name: Galatians 2:10
verses.text: A re kakaliki ong kit, me sen apapwali me samama kan. Ngai ari nantiong kapwaiada.

verses.name: Galatians 2:11
verses.text: A Kepas lao pwaralang Antiokien, i ap palian i pwe kalok sued mi re a.

verses.name: Galatians 2:12
verses.text: Pwe mon akai pwarado sang ren Iakopus, a sakasak ren men liki kai, a ni ar pwarador, a puei sang katororela pein i, pwe a masak men sirkomsais.

verses.name: Galatians 2:13
verses.text: O pil Sus tei ko iang i malamalaundar, o Parnapas lodi ong pil wia malaun.

verses.name: Galatians 2:14
verses.text: A ni ai kilanger, me re sota inen weita, duen melel en rongamau, i ap indai ong Kepas mon irail karos; ma koe men Sus amen kin wia tiak en men liki kan, a so tiak en men Sus, menda koe kin kakaliki ong men liki kan, ren wiada tiak en men Sus?

verses.name: Galatians 2:15
verses.text: Kita udan men Sus a sota dipan dueta men liki kan,

verses.name: Galatians 2:16
verses.text: Ap asa, me aramas amen sota kak pung kila wiawia en kapung kan, pwe a poson Iesus Kristus eta i me kitail pil posoneki Kristus Iesus, pwe kitail en pung kila poson Kristus, a kaidin wiawia en kapung kan; pwe uduk sota kak pung kila wiawia en kapung kan.

verses.name: Galatians 2:17
verses.text: A ma kitail men pung kila Kristus, ap diarokada, me kitail me dipan, daduen, Kristus me papan dip? O so!

verses.name: Galatians 2:18
verses.text: Pwe ma i pan pur ong kauada, me i kawelar, nan i pan wia kin ia me dipan amen.

verses.name: Galatians 2:19
verses.text: Pwe i mekilar kapung, ap solar memauri ong kapung, pwen mauri ong Kot; ngai lopular iang Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 2:20
verses.text: Kaidin ngai me memaur, pwe Kristus kotin ieiasata lolei. Pwe arain ai maur en pali uduk, i kin memaureki poson Sapwilim en Kot, me kotin pok ong ia o sokonpaudeki ong ia pein i.

verses.name: Galatians 2:21
verses.text: I sota kasamal la mak en Kot; pwe ma aramas kak pung kila wiawia en kapung kan, Kristus ap matala mal.<div eID="gen2783" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.2"/>

verses.name: Galatians 3:1
verses.text: O komail men Kalesia pweipwei, is me kotaue komail? Pwe mom en Iesus Kristus a lopular wiauier mon mas omail.

verses.name: Galatians 3:2
verses.text: Iet eta me i men kalelapok re omail: Komail aleer Ngen ni wiawia en kapung kan, de ni padak en poson?

verses.name: Galatians 3:3
verses.text: Iduen omail lolepon? Komail tapia kidar Ngen, a komail men kaimwisok kilar uduk?

verses.name: Galatians 3:4
verses.text: Komail kalokolok laud, ap sota pan katepa? Ma idue met a sota kak wiaui.

verses.name: Galatians 3:5
verses.text: Me kotiki ong komail er Ngen, o wia manaman akan nan pung omail daduen, wiawian kapung kan me kareda, de padak en poson?

verses.name: Galatians 3:6
verses.text: Dueta Apraam me poson Kot, ap wadok ong i kapunga pa.

verses.name: Galatians 3:7
verses.text: Komail ap asa duen irail me kin poson, irail seri en Apraam.

verses.name: Galatians 3:8
verses.text: A kisin likau o asaer mas o, me Kot, pan kotin kapungala men liki kan ki poson, i me a padaki ong Apraam rongamau mas o: Wein sappa karos pan paie kin uk!

verses.name: Galatians 3:9
verses.text: Pwe karos me poson, pan iang Apraam poson kapaida.

verses.name: Galatians 3:10
verses.text: Pwe me kin kaporoporeki wiawia en kapung kan, pan kariala. Pwe a intingidier: Karos me riala, me sota pan dadaurata meakaros, me intingidier nan puk en kapung, pwen kapwaiada.

verses.name: Galatians 3:11
verses.text: A sansal, me sota amen kak pung kila kapung ren Kot; pwe me pung amen pan memaureki poson.

verses.name: Galatians 3:12
verses.text: A kapung sota tapi sang ni poson, pwe meamen kapwaiada mepukat, pan memaur kida.

verses.name: Galatians 3:13
verses.text: Kristus me kotin dore kitail sang ni karia pan kapung, ni a ria kin kitail lar; pwe a intingidier: Amen amen me langalong nin tuka o me riala.

verses.name: Galatians 3:14
verses.text: Pwe pai en Apraam, me tapi sang ren Kristus Iesus, en lel penang men liki kan; pwe kitail en ale inau en Ngen ki poson.

verses.name: Galatians 3:15
verses.text: Ri ai kan, i pan lokaia ni tiak en aramas akan. Iaduen inau en aramas eu me kileledier, sota amen me pan kawela de ekis, me a pan pouse ong.

verses.name: Galatians 3:16
verses.text: Ari, inau o wiauier ong Apraam o kadaudok a. A sota masanier: Kadaudok a toto, pwe duen me ta men: Kadaudok om me ta men, iei Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:17
verses.text: Iet me i inda: Inau me Kot kotin kileledier, a sota kak okila kapung o, me wiauier saunpar papuki sileisok murin inau o, pwe inau ede pwaida.

verses.name: Galatians 3:18
verses.text: Pwe ma soso tapi sang kapung, a sota kak tapi sang inau; a Kot kotiki ong Apraam ki inau.

verses.name: Galatians 3:19
verses.text: A menda kapung? A wiauier pweki sapung kan, kadaudok o lao pwarado, me inau wiaui ong, me wiauier ren tounlang kan ki pa en saunkapung.

verses.name: Galatians 3:20
verses.text: Ari, saunkapung sota kin kelep eta, a Kot me kelep eta.

verses.name: Galatians 3:21
verses.text: A iaduen, kapung o kin palian inau en Kot akan? O so! A ma kapung eu pan wiaui, me pan kak kamaurela, nan melel, pung ap pan tapi sang nan kapung.

verses.name: Galatians 3:22
verses.text: A kisin likau o me kol penang dip meakaros pwe inau en tapi sang ni poson Iesus Kristus, en pai ong irail, me poson.

verses.name: Galatians 3:23
verses.text: Ni ansau poson saikenta pwarado, kitail nikinik o salidier pan kapung, lao poson pan kasansaleda.

verses.name: Galatians 3:24
verses.text: Ari, kapung atail saunpadak, lao Kristus pwarado, pwe kitail en pung kila poson.

verses.name: Galatians 3:25
verses.text: A poson lao pwarador, kitail solar mi pan saunpadak o.

verses.name: Galatians 3:26
verses.text: Pwe komail karos seri en Kot, ki poson Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:27
verses.text: Pwe komail me paptaiser ong Kristus, komail likaui kidar Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:28
verses.text: Solar men Sus de Krik, solar ladu de me maioda, solar ol de li komail karos dupeneta ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Galatians 3:29
verses.text: A ma komail sapwilim en Kristus, nan komail pil kadaudok en Apraam, o seri soso duen inau o.<div eID="gen2784" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.3"/>

verses.name: Galatians 4:1
verses.text: A iet me i men inda: Soso men arain a seri, a so toror sang ladu men, ari so, a kaun en meakaros.

verses.name: Galatians 4:2
verses.text: A kin upa ong saunpadak o saunkoa kan lao lel ansau me sam a kileledier.

verses.name: Galatians 4:3
verses.text: Iduen kitail ni atail kisin seri, kitail kin upai ong padak en sappa kan.

verses.name: Galatians 4:4
verses.text: A ansau lao leler, Kot ap kotin poronedo sapwilim a Ol, me ipwidi sang ren li amen, ap mi pan kapung o.

verses.name: Galatians 4:5
verses.text: Pwen kasaledoka ir ala, me mi pan kapung, pwe kitail en wiala sapwilim a seri.

verses.name: Galatians 4:6
verses.text: Komail ari seri kan, i me Kot ap kotin poronedo Ngen en sapwilim a Ol nan mongiong atail, me kin likelikwir: Apa Sam!

verses.name: Galatians 4:7
verses.text: Ari, solar ladu men, pwe seri ta; a ma seri nan pil seri soso en Kot.

verses.name: Galatians 4:8
verses.text: A ni ansau o me komail sasa Kot, komail papaer me kaidin udan kot akan.

verses.name: Galatians 4:9
verses.text: A metet komail asalar Kot, o Kot me kotin mangi komail melel, menda komail pil sapal lang lamalam sued o sakanekan, me komail men pur ong papa?

verses.name: Galatians 4:10
verses.text: Komail kin kasarauiela ran akai, o saunipong kai, o ansau kai, o saunpar kai.

verses.name: Galatians 4:11
verses.text: I ngong kin komail, pwe ele ai dodok ong komail sota pan kadepa.

verses.name: Galatians 4:12
verses.text: Ri ai kan, i ngidingidi kin komail, en dueta ngai, pwe ngai kin dueta komail, pwe sota me sued kot, me komail wiai ong ia er.

verses.name: Galatians 4:13
verses.text: A komail asa due i mas o, me i padaki ong komail er rongamau ni ai luet en pali uduk.

verses.name: Galatians 4:14
verses.text: O komail sota mamaleki ai songesong ni uduk ai o tata kin ia; a komail apwali ia la dueta ngai tounlang en Kot amen, de dueta Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 4:15
verses.text: Iaduen wan omail pai ni ansau o! Pwe i kadede duen komail, ma a kak pa omail, komail pan pwadika sang por en mas omail ap ki ong ia.

verses.name: Galatians 4:16
verses.text: Iaduen, i wiala omail imwintiti, pweki ai lokaia melel ong komail.

verses.name: Galatians 4:17
verses.text: Arail nanantiong rapaki komail me sota mau; irail men kamueit kitail pasang, pwe komail en id idauen irail.

verses.name: Galatians 4:18
verses.text: Me mau ansau karos en nantiong me mau kan, a kaidin ta ni ai mi re omail.

verses.name: Galatians 4:19
verses.text: Nai seri kan! I naitik sapal komail ki madak, lao Kristus kawuk komail la ong pein mom a.

verses.name: Galatians 4:20
verses.text: I men mi re omail ansau wet o men kawukila ngil ai, pwe i sasalar ir omail.

verses.name: Galatians 4:21
verses.text: Komail, me kin men mi pan kapung o, indang ia, ma komail sota kin rong kapung o?

verses.name: Galatians 4:22
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier, me nain Apraam putak riamen mia, amen sang ren na lidu, a amen sang ren me maioda.

verses.name: Galatians 4:23
verses.text: A me song ren lidu ipwiki uduk, a me sang ren me maioda, ipwiki inau en Kot.

verses.name: Galatians 4:24
verses.text: Mepukat karasepa eu, pwe met inau riau, eu sang ni nana Sinai, me kin naitiki ong na kan papa, i me Akar.

verses.name: Galatians 4:25
verses.text: Pwe Akar nana Sinai nan Arapien, me rasong Ierusalem en met, o kin lidilidui iang na seri kan.

verses.name: Galatians 4:26
verses.text: A Ierusalem, me mi poa, me maioda iei in atail.

verses.name: Galatians 4:27
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier: Pereperen koe me li dapwan, me sota kin naitik, kadailong o werida koe, me so kaipwi ong, pwe nain li dapwan seri kan me toto sang me a warok mia.

verses.name: Galatians 4:28
verses.text: A komail ri ai ol akan, me rasong Isaak, me seri en inau kan.

verses.name: Galatians 4:29
verses.text: A duen mas o, me ipwiki uduk, me kailongki me ipwiki Ngen o, iduen ansau wet.

verses.name: Galatians 4:30
verses.text: A da me kisin likau o masani? Kasela li lidu o na putak! Pwe putak en lidu sota pan iang nain li me maioda sosoki.

verses.name: Galatians 4:31
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, kitail sota seri en lidu, pwe nain me maioda.<div eID="gen2785" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.4"/>

verses.name: Galatians 5:1
verses.text: KOMAIL ari dadaurata en Kristus a kotin kamaioda kitail, komail ari kalaka pein komail, pwe komail der pur ong ni omail kanaudok.

verses.name: Galatians 5:2
verses.text: Kilang, ngai Paulus indai ong komail, ma komail pan iang sirkomsais, nan Kristus sota pan katepai ong komail.

verses.name: Galatians 5:3
verses.text: I pil kadede ong aramas karos, me pan sirkomsaisela, i en kapwaiada kapung pokon.

verses.name: Galatians 5:4
verses.text: Komail, me men pung kila kapung o, muei sanger Kristus o pup wei sanger mak.

verses.name: Galatians 5:5
verses.text: A kit kin auiaui ren Ngen ki poson kaporopor en pung.

verses.name: Galatians 5:6
verses.text: Pwe ren Kristus Iesus sirkomsais de sosirkomsais sota meakot, pwe poson ta, me kin sansaleki dodok en limpok.

verses.name: Galatians 5:7
verses.text: Komail tanger mau, is me karompwa komail, pwe ender peiki ong melel?

verses.name: Galatians 5:8
verses.text: I song en kaweid sota kin tapi sang me molipe komail er.

verses.name: Galatians 5:9
verses.text: Kalap kis kin kamutala dolepa karos;

verses.name: Galatians 5:10
verses.text: I kaporoporeki ren Kaun o me komail sota pan wia eu lamalam toror. A me kin kaping komail da, pan lodi ong kapung o, sota lipilipil is i.

verses.name: Galatians 5:11
verses.text: A ngai, ri ai kan, ma i poden padaki duen sirkomsais, menda i kankangerangirla? Pwe ma iduen, a solar men kamakar pan lopu.

verses.name: Galatians 5:12
verses.text: I men irail me kin kawe komail la, ren pil kawela pein irail.

verses.name: Galatians 5:13
verses.text: A ri ai kan, komail paeker ong maio, komail der men maio, pwe tiak en pali uduk en pwaida, a komail papa amen amen ni limpok.

verses.name: Galatians 5:14
verses.text: Pwe kapung pon kapwai pan masan ta ieu: Koe en pok ong men imp om due pein uk.

verses.name: Galatians 5:15
verses.text: A ma komail pakolok kaokaoe amen o amen, kalaka, pwe komail de momela.

verses.name: Galatians 5:16
verses.text: A ngai inda: Aluki Ngen komail ap sota pan kapwaiada inong sued en uduk.

verses.name: Galatians 5:17
verses.text: Pwe uduk kin inong iong me toror sang Ngen, a Ngen kin kotin inong iong me toror sang uduk, a ira parongarong pena, iei me komail sota wia kida, me komail kin men wia.

verses.name: Galatians 5:18
verses.text: A ma Ngen pan kotin kalua komail, komail sota mimi pan kapung.

verses.name: Galatians 5:19
verses.text: Wiawia kan en uduk me sansal. Iet akan: Nenek, samin, monepil,

verses.name: Galatians 5:20
verses.text: Pongi ong ani mal, wun ani, kailuk, akatat, luak, makar, akamai, kamauouo, padak likam.

verses.name: Galatians 5:21
verses.text: Peirin, kamom soko, kaped en manga ape. Iran mepukat i padaki ong komail er mas o, me irail, me kin kapwaiada mepukat, sota pan sosoki wein Kot.

verses.name: Galatians 5:22
verses.text: A iet akan wa en Ngen: Limpok, peren, popol, kanongama, kadek, kamau, poson, opampap liki sang me sued.

verses.name: Galatians 5:23
verses.text: Sota kapung pan mepukat.

verses.name: Galatians 5:24
verses.text: A me sapwilim en Kristus, kalopuelar uduk iangaki tiak sued o inong sued akan.

verses.name: Galatians 5:25
verses.text: Ma kitail memaureki Ngen, kitail en pil alualuki Ngen o.

verses.name: Galatians 5:26
verses.text: Kitail der inong iong wau ren aramas, o der kamorongada ong amen amen, o der peipeirin amen amen.<div eID="gen2786" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.5"/>

verses.name: Galatians 6:1
verses.text: RI ai kan ma aramas amen pan lodi ong me sued kot, komail, me ngenin kasapaledo i ni ngen en opampap, ap masamasan pein uk, pwe koe ender pil lodi ong songesong.

verses.name: Galatians 6:2
verses.text: Pelikitki pena nan pung omail katoutou pamail, pwe iduen komail pan kapwaiada kapung en Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 6:3
verses.text: Pwe ma amen lamelame, me i meakot, nan a kin kotaue pein i, pwe sota i meakot.

verses.name: Galatians 6:4
verses.text: A amen amen en kasasong ong pein a wiawia, ap pan suaiki pein i, a kaidin amen aramas.

verses.name: Galatians 6:5
verses.text: Pwe amen amen en pein wa audepa.

verses.name: Galatians 6:6
verses.text: A me kin padakki masan o, en kida song en mau karos ong i, me kin padaki i.

verses.name: Galatians 6:7
verses.text: Komail der kiki ong, me komail pan kak piti Kot, pwe meakot aramas kin kamoredi ong, i me a pan dolung sang.

verses.name: Galatians 6:8
verses.text: Pwe me kin kamoredi ong ni uduk a, a pan dolung sang ni uduk a men soredi; a me kin kamoredi ong Ngen, a pan tungole sang ren Ngen maur soutuk.

verses.name: Galatians 6:9
verses.text: Kitail der pangaki atail wiawia mau kan, pwe ni ansau me kon ong, kitail pan dolung, ma kitail sota pan pangadar.

verses.name: Galatians 6:10
verses.text: Ma a kak pa atail, kitail en wia mau ong karos, a mas ong kisan me poson akan.

verses.name: Galatians 6:11
verses.text: Kilang duen kisin likau laud, me i inting wong komail er ki pein pa i.

verses.name: Galatians 6:12
verses.text: Ir me kin men lolok mau ni uduk, kin inong iong komail en sirkomsaiselar; pwe irail ender kamekame ki lopu en Kristus.

verses.name: Galatians 6:13
verses.text: Pwe pein irail me sirkomsaisela, sota kin kapwaiada kapung, a irail kin men, komail en sirkomsaisela, pwen suaiki uduk omail.

verses.name: Galatians 6:14
verses.text: A duen ngai, i sota man mauki suaiki, a iet eta iran lopu en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, pweki i sappa katia sang ia o ngai katia sang sappa.

verses.name: Galatians 6:15
verses.text: Pwe sirkomsais de sosirkomsais sota meakot, a me kawilikapadar.

verses.name: Galatians 6:16
verses.text: Irail karos me inen ki wei ta padak pot et, en popol o kalangan, o ong Israel en Kot.

verses.name: Galatians 6:17
verses.text: Sang met kokolata sota amen en morouo ong ia, pwe i wa sili ta nan war ai lip en Iesus akan.

verses.name: Galatians 6:18
verses.text: Mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en kotikot ren ngen omail ri ai kan! Amen.<div eID="gen2787" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Gal.6"/> <div eID="gen2781" osisID="Gal" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS wanporon en Iesus Kristus amen pan kupur en Kot ong me saraui o lelapok kan ren Kristus Iesus me mi Episus.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:2
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam atail o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail!

verses.name: Ephesians 1:3
verses.text: Meid iasanai Kot o Sam en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, me kapaia kin kitail lar song en pai ngenin karos sang nanlang ren Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:4
verses.text: A kotin pil kitail dar re a, mon sappa saikenta pasondier, pwe kitail en saraui o minla mo a ni limpok.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:5
verses.text: Me pil kileledier, me kitail, en wiala sapwilim a seri ki Iesus Kristus, duen a kotin kupura mauki.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:6
verses.text: Pwen kalinganada a mak lapalap, me a kotin make kin kitail ren Kompoke pa a,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:7
verses.text: Me kotin dore kin kitail la nta o lapwadan dip akan ki a mak lapalap.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:8
verses.text: Me a kotiki ong kitail ni song en lolekong o koiok karos,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:9
verses.text: Ni a kotin diarok ong kitail er me rir en kupur a duen a kotin kupuramauki o duen a kileledier ren pein i.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:10
verses.text: Pwen pwaida ansau lao leler en wisik penang tapwi ta ieu meakaros, ren Kristus, men nanlang kan o men sappa kan ong pein i.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:11
verses.text: Me pil kare ong kitail soso eu, kitail me kileledier duen kupur en i, me kin wiada meakan karos, duen a kotin kupura,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:12
verses.text: Pwe kitail en wiala men kalinganada i, kitail, me kaporoporeki Kristus,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:13
verses.text: Me komail pil kaporoporeki murin omail ronger masan en melel o rongamau en kamaur; me pil kilele komail kidier Ngen saraui en inau, ni omail posonlar.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:14
verses.text: Iei men kamelele en atail soso, lao lel ansau en atail konodi maur soutuk, pwen wiala sapwilim en Kot o men kapinga a lingan.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:15
verses.text: Ari, i lao rongadar duen omail poson Kaun Iesus o duen omail limpok ong saraui kan karos,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:16
verses.text: I sota kin dukedi sang ai danke pweki komail, o i kin tamatamanda komail ni ai kapakap akan;

verses.name: Ephesians 1:17
verses.text: Pwe Kot en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, Sam en lingan, en kotiki ong komail ngen en erpit o kaudial, pwen asada i,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:18
verses.text: O kotin kamaraini mas en mongiong omail, pwe komail en kak dedeki kaporopor en omail paeker, o lingan laud en soso, me onoper ong saraui kan,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:19
verses.text: O a manaman kaualap ong kitail, me posonlar, duen a dodok manaman,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:20
verses.text: Me a kotin kasansaledar ren Kristus ni a kotin kaiasada i sang ren me melar akan, ap kasapwiladang pali maun nanlang,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:21
verses.text: Ilela sang meakan karos, o manaman karos, o kelail o men poa kan o mar karos, kaidin ni muei wet eta, pwe pil ni muei kokodo.

verses.name: Ephesians 1:22
verses.text: O a kotiki ong meakaros pan aluwilu a kan, o kotin kasapwiladang tapwin meakaros ren momodisou,

verses.name: Ephesians 1:23
verses.text: Iei war a, iei kadir pan me kadirela meakaros.<div eID="gen2789" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.1"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 2:1
verses.text: PIL dueta komail ni omail melaki sapung o dip akan,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:2
verses.text: Me komail dadaureki mas duen tiak en sappa et, o duen wiawia en saupeidi o, me manaman pan lang, iei ngen o, me kin dodok ren seri sopeik kan ansau wet.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:3
verses.text: A kitail karos pil weweid nan pung arail mas o ni inong en uduk atail, o kapwaiada inong en uduk o lamelam, o kitail me udan seri en ongiong akan dueta me tei kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:4
verses.text: A Kot, me dir en kalangan, pweki a limpok me a kotin pok ong kitail lar,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:5
verses.text: Nin dokan atail melaki sapung kan, nan a kamauri kitail dar ki Kristus, pwe mak o, me komail dore kila,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:6
verses.text: O pil kotin kamaur kitail dar o kotin kasapwil kitail dang nanlang ren Kristus Iesus,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:7
verses.text: Pwe a en kotin kasansaleda a mak o kalangan lapalap ni muei kokodo ong kitail ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:8
verses.text: Pwe ni poson komail kamaur kilar mak; a kaidin pweki pein komail, a pai eu ren Kot,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:9
verses.text: Kaidin ki wiawia kan, pwe sota amen en aksuaiki.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:10
verses.text: Pwe sapwilim a dodok kitail, me wiauier ren Kristus Iesus ong wiawia mau kan, me Kot kotin kaonopadang kitail er, pwe kitail en dadaurata.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:11
verses.text: Komail ari tamatamanda, me komail men liki mas o, me aluki uduk pwel, men kaindinda sosirkomsais ren me sirkomsais, me kin wiaui ni uduk mangin pa.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:12
verses.text: Pwe ni ansau o komail likin Kristus, o likin pai en Israel, o likin inau en soso kan; i me sota omail kaporopor o sota omail Kot ni sappa wet.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:13
verses.text: A komail me doo wei sang mepukat mas o, a ansau wet komail me korendor o mi ren Kristus Iesus pweki ntan Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:14
verses.text: Pwe i atail popol, me wia kin ira eu, o me kotin kawela kel o, me mi nan pung ara,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:15
verses.text: Ni a kotiki sang imwintiti re ’ra ki pali uduk a. Iei kapung o me audekier kusoned akan, pwe en kotin wia kin ir ala aramas kap ta men ong pein i.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:16
verses.text: Pwen kalolamaui ong Kot ira ni war ta ieu pan lopu murin a kotin tiakedi imwintiti ki lopu.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:17
verses.text: O a kotidoer padaki popol ong komail, me doo wei sang, o popol ong me koren akan.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:18
verses.text: Nan pweki i kita karos kak tu ong Sam ki Ngen ta ieu.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:19
verses.text: Komail ari solar men liki o men wai, a me pweledan akan iangaki saraui kan o kisan penainai en Kot.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:20
verses.text: Me kakauda pon pason en wanporon o saukop akan, a pein Iesus Kristus me takain pukakaim.

verses.name: Ephesians 2:21
verses.text: I wasa kasukasuk kin koda sang ia, wiala tanpas saraui en Kaun o,

verses.name: Ephesians 2:22
verses.text: Me komail pil iang kokon penang mol en Kot ren Ngen.<div eID="gen2790" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.2"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 3:1
verses.text: I me ngai Paulus en Iesus Kristus a salidi men pweki komail men liki kan,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:2
verses.text: Due me komail rongadar iran ai koa dodok en mak en Kot, me i aleer pweki komail.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:3
verses.text: A kaudial eu, me kasansale ong ia, me rir akan, duen ai inting motomot ong komail er nin tapi o

verses.name: Ephesians 3:4
verses.text: Ari, ma komail pan wadok, komail ap pan diar, duen ai lolekong ni me rir akan ren Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:5
verses.text: Me sota kadiarok ong aramas akan ni muein mas o, ap kadiarok ong sapwilim a wanporon o saukop saraui kan ren Ngen:

verses.name: Ephesians 3:6
verses.text: Pwe men liki kan en iang soso o iang kisan war a, o iang a inau ren Kristus Iesus ki rongamau,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:7
verses.text: Me ngai wiala papa men duen ai pai en mak en Kot, me i aleer ki a manaman lapalap.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:8
verses.text: Ngai, me tikitik sang saraui kan karos, aleer mak wet, en padaki ong men liki kan duen kapwapwa lapalapia en Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:9
verses.text: O pwen kamaraini amen amen duen koa dodok en rir akan, me nekinek sang nin tapin kaua ren Kot, me kotin kapikadar meakan karos,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:10
verses.text: Pwe ansau wet men poa kan o me manaman akan, me kotikot nanlang, en ereki momodisou song en erpit en Kot karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:11
verses.text: Duen kupur a, me a kotin kileledier ni tapin kaua ren Kristus Iesus atail Kaun.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:12
verses.text: Pweki i me kitail pil kak aimaki tu ong Kot ni atail kaporopor o poson i.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:13
verses.text: Nan i me i men poeki, komail ender motot ki ai kamekam kin komail, pwe men kalinganada komail.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:14
verses.text: I me i kin kelepuki ong Sam en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:15
verses.text: Me mar en penainai pokon nanlang o sappa tapi sang ia.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:16
verses.text: Pwen kotiki ong komail manaman, duen a kapwapwa en a lingan, en kelaileki Ngen i nan pali lol en aramas,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:17
verses.text: Pwe Kristus en kotikot nan mongiong omail pweki omail poson, pwe komail en tengedi o sondi ni limpok,

verses.name: Ephesians 3:18
verses.text: Ap kak ong iang saraui kan karos dedekida tälap, o anged, o lol, o ile;

verses.name: Ephesians 3:19
verses.text: O en pil asada limpok en Kristus, me sikida sang erpit karos, pwe komail en direki kupur en Kot karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:20
verses.text: A i, me manaman ong wiada, me lapa sang atail poeki o lamelame duen o manaman o, me kin dodok lol atail.

verses.name: Ephesians 3:21
verses.text: Lingan en ko ong i ni momodisou pan Kristus Iesus kokolata soutuk. Amen.<div eID="gen2791" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.3"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 4:1
verses.text: NGAI en Kaun a salidi men, kin panaui komail, pwe komail en kekeid inenweita ni koa eu, me komail paeker ong,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:2
verses.text: Ni karakarak melel, o opampap, o kanongama, o limpok pena nan pung omail.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:3
verses.text: Angkelail ong wia minimin eu ni Ngen saupena ki sal en popol.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:4
verses.text: War ta ieu, o Ngen ta ieu, duen me komail paeker ong ni kaporopor ta ieu, en omail paeker ong.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:5
verses.text: Kaun ta men, poson ta ieu, paptais ta ieu,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:6
verses.text: Kot o Sam en karos me ta men me kotin poedi meakaros o daudaulole, o me kotikot lol atail karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:7
verses.text: A kitail karos aleer atail pai en mak duen song en kupur en Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:8
verses.text: I me a kotin masani: Ni a kotidalang poa, a kotin saliedi me salidi kan, o a kotiki ong aramas pai kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:9
verses.text: A iaduen, ma a kotidalang poa, kaidin a pil so kotidilar pa sed, wasa lolia mas o?

verses.name: Ephesians 4:10
verses.text: Me kotidila, i ota, me kotida wei ileila sang nanlang kan karos, pwen kadirela wasa karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:11
verses.text: O a kotin kasapwilada akai, en wanporon akan o akai en saukop akan, o akai en warongamau kan, o akai en silepa o saunpadak kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:12
verses.text: Pwen kapungala saraui kan ong wiawia dodok eu, me pan kauada war en Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:13
verses.text: Kitail karos lao lel ong poson ta ieu, o lolekong ki Sapwilim en Kot, o wiala ol melel, me paroki ong Kristus ni a unsokela,

verses.name: Ephesians 4:14
verses.text: Pwe kitail en solar tau en seri pwelel, me mokimokideki sili padak likam, me kin pwai kida kotaue en aramas akan o ar likam, o widiwiding me re kin wiada, pwen kaweid sapung.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:15
verses.text: A kitail en melel ni limpok, ap kakairida ni song karos ong Kristus, me tapwi o.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:16
verses.text: Me war pon kakauda sang o kokon akan karos katengeteng pena ia; a kokon pukat papa pena, duen dodok en kokon akan eu eu, duen ar itar ong, iduen war o kin kakairida o maular ni limpok.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:17
verses.text: I me i indai ong komail o kadede kila Kaun o, me komail ender weweid dueta men liki kan kin wia ni aklapalap en ngen ir.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:18
verses.text: Me ngen arail rotorotalar, o re sang maur en Kot, pweki ar sololekong me mi lol arail o pweki mongiong arail kapitakailar.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:19
verses.text: Me solar pam wasa, ap mueid ong pein irail, en dender o inong iong kapwaiada song en saut akan karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:20
verses.text: A kaidin iduen, me komail asadar ren Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:21
verses.text: Ma komail ronger duen i o padakki i, me tiak melel mi ren Iesus.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:22
verses.text: Komail ari muei sang tiak en mas o aramas maring, me kin kawe kila pein i inong sued.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:23
verses.text: A komail en kawilikapada ngen omail!

verses.name: Ephesians 4:24
verses.text: O danwar anekila aramas kap, me wiauier duen kupur en Kot, ni melel o pung o saraui.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:25
verses.text: I me komail en kasela likam amen amen ap lokaia melel ong men impa, pwe kitail sau ta ieu.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:26
verses.text: Ni makar komail der wia dip, o katipin der kirila mon omail insenemaula.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:27
verses.text: Ender duki ong tewil o!

verses.name: Ephesians 4:28
verses.text: Me pirap, ender pur ong pirap, a mak eta, en dodok, kadokeki pa kan dipisou mau, pwen kaonop da kisakis ong me samama kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:29
verses.text: Kasoi saut ender ko wei sang nan au omail, a men kamau, pwen papaki ong me karong akan me mau.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:30
verses.text: Komail der kamauke Ngen saraui en Kot, me komail kilelekier ong ran en kasapaledo!

verses.name: Ephesians 4:31
verses.text: A limelimek sued, o lingarangar, o makar, o men pei, o lalaue en doo wei sang komail, o pil song en sued karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 4:32
verses.text: A komail en kadek pena, o poka pena, o mak pena amen amen, dueta Kot kotin maki ong komail ren Kristus.<div eID="gen2792" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.4"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 5:1
verses.text: KOMAIL kaalemongi Kot dueta seri kompok kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:2
verses.text: O kekeid ni limpok dueta Kristus, me kotin, pok ong kitail, ap kotin sokonpaude kin kitail, pwen wiala kisakis o mairong eu, me kin pomau ong Kot.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:3
verses.text: A nenek, o song en saut karos, o norok kapwa ender man pwaida re omail, duen me kon ong saraui kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:4
verses.text: Pil der lokaia sued, o kaman, o lokaia mal, me sota kon ong, a iet: Komail en danke.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:5
verses.text: Mepukat komail en asa o dedeki, me sota me nenek, de samin, de me norok kapwa, me pongi ani tikitik, pan kak sosoki wein Kristus o Kot.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:6
verses.text: Sota amen en kotau ki komail lokaia mal, pwe mepukat kin kareda ongiong en Kot ong seri sopeik kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:7
verses.text: Komail ender kis arail.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:8
verses.text: Pwe mas o komail me rotorot, a met komail marainlar ren Kaun o; weweid wei duen seri en marain akan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:9
verses.text: Pwe wan marain mepukat: Kamau, o pung o melel.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:10
verses.text: O kasauiada, me kin kaperenda kupur en Kaun o.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:11
verses.text: O der waroki ong wiawia sued en me rotorot akan, a mak eta, en kapung ong irail.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:12
verses.text: Pwe me re kin wiada wasa rir, me sued o sota mau ong, en inda.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:13
verses.text: A karos me pan kasansaleda, pan kadiarok kida marain, pwe marain kin kasansaleda meakaros.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:14
verses.text: I me a kotin masani: Pirida koe me mamair, o paurida sang ren me melar akan, a Kristus pan kamarain uk ada.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:15
verses.text: Kalaka, pwe komail en keid ineneweita, kaidin duen me lolepon a duen me lolekong kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:16
verses.text: Audaud ansau mau, pweki ran akan me sued.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:17
verses.text: Komail ari ender lamponla, a en lolekong, pwe i duen kupur en Kaun.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:18
verses.text: Ender kamom wain, pwe a kin kareda tiak sued, a komail en direki Ngen.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:19
verses.text: O sauas pena ki psalm, o kaul en kaping, o kaul ngenin; komail kaul o kasang ong Kaun o nan mongiong omail.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:20
verses.text: Danke kaukaule Kot o Sam ni mar en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:21
verses.text: O papa komail pena amen amen ni masak dol en Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:22
verses.text: Komail li akan, udi ong pein omail warok kan dueta ong Kaun.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:23
verses.text: Pwe ol o me tapwin a paud, dueta Kristus me tapwin momodisou, o i me Saunkamaur pan war a.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:24
verses.text: A duen momodisou kin udi ong Kristus, iduen li akan en udi ong ar warok kan ni meakaros.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:25
verses.text: Komail ol akan pok ong pein omail warok kan, dueta Kristus kotin pok ong momodisou o kotiki dong i pein i.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:26
verses.text: Pwen kasarauiala i, o kamakelekeleda i ki pil o, iei a masan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:27
verses.text: Pwen kasansale dong pein i momodisou lingan, me sota topala o omrok ape, a me saraui o so kaopa kot.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:28
verses.text: Nan iduen ol akan en pok ong ar warok kan dueta pein war arail akan. Me kin pok ong a warok, kin pok ong pein i.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:29
verses.text: Sota amen kin suedeki pein uduk a; pwe a kin kamanga o kanainai eta, dueta Kristus kin kotin apwali momodisou.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:30
verses.text: Pwe kitail me kasang en war a, o uduk a, o a kokon akan.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:31
verses.text: I me aramas o pan muei sang sam a o in a, ap muei ong a paud, ira ari pan uduk ta ieu la.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:32
verses.text: Meid kaponepon lapalap eu; a ngai kaparokki duen Kristus a warokeki ong momodisou.

verses.name: Ephesians 5:33
verses.text: Pil dueta komail, amen amen komail en pok ong a warok dueta pein i, a li o en kakaki a warok.<div eID="gen2793" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.5"/>

verses.name: Ephesians 6:1
verses.text: KOMAIL seri kan peiki ong me wia komail ada pan Kaun o, pwe i me pung.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:2
verses.text: Kakaki sam om o in om, iei tapin kusoned, me inaupa mia,

verses.name: Ephesians 6:3
verses.text: Pwe koe en insenemau o pil maur warai nin sappa.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:4
verses.text: Komail sam akan der kamakar mal noumail seri kan, kakair irail ada ni kaian mau o panau ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:5
verses.text: Komail ladu kan en oke omail saumas akan ni pali uduk ni masak o rerer o pil ni tiak en karakarak en mongiong omail dueta ong Kristus.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:6
verses.text: Kaidin sansal mon aramas eta, pwen konekon re ’rail, a en dueta ladu en Kristus, me kin pereperen wiawia kupur en Kot sang mongiong omail.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:7
verses.text: O komail en papa mau, pwe ong Kaun o, a kaidin ong aramas akan.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:8
verses.text: Pwe komail asa, me mau kot, me amen pan wiada, Kaun pan katingi ong i sota lipilipil is i, ma ladu de me maioda amen.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:9
verses.text: O komail saumas akan en wia dueta ong irail, o der sakone irail, pwe komail asa, me arail o pil omail Saumas kotikot nanlang, o a sota kotin lipilipil aramas amen.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:10
verses.text: Ikmuri ri ai kan komail kelaileki Kaun o ni a manaman.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:11
verses.text: Puriong tatan mauin karos en Kot, pwe komail en kak kelail palian tewil a widiwiding kan.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:12
verses.text: Pwe kaidin uduk o nta, me kitail en pei ong, a ong saupeidi o manaman akan, o ong saumas en sappa kan, me kin kakaunda nan rotorot wet, o ong kaun ngenin en lang akan.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:13
verses.text: Ari, pweki mepukat komail en ale tatan mauin karos en Kot, pwe komail en kak kelail ni ran sued, o kasinenda murin omail kapwaiadar meakaros.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:14
verses.text: Komail ari kasinenda, luke pamail en katengetengki melel o pereki pere pan maramara me pung.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:15
verses.text: O nä omail en kitekit pena, pwen onop ong wa sili rongamau en popol.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:16
verses.text: A pil eu pan ko ong mepukat: Komail ale perepa en poson, pwen kakun kila katieu kisiniai en me sued o.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:17
verses.text: Komail pil ale lisorop en kamaur o kodlas en Ngen, me masan en Kot.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:18
verses.text: O podidi ong kapakap o wia poekipoeki. Ngidingidiki Ngen ni meakaros. O masamasan, o poden kapakapaki saraui kan karos.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:19
verses.text: O kapakapa kin ia, pwe i en ngil meledok o au ai en sara pasang ai aingar en kaweweda me rir en rongamau.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:20
verses.text: Me ngai saunpadakepa, me salidier, pwe i en kelail ong padapadaki, duen me kon ong.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:21
verses.text: A pwe komail en asa ir ai kan, o me i kin wiada, ri atail kompok Tikikus o papa lelapok en Kaun o, pan padaki ong komail meakaros.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:22
verses.text: I me i kadarala, pwe komail en asadar ir at akan, o pwe i en kamait mongiong omail.

verses.name: Ephesians 6:23
verses.text: Popol ong ri atail, o limpok iangaki poson sang ren Kot Sam o Kaun Iesus Kristus!

verses.name: Ephesians 6:24
verses.text: Mak en mimi ren karos, me kin pok ong atail Kaun Iesus Kristus kokolata!<div eID="gen2794" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Eph.6"/> <div eID="gen2788" osisID="Eph" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philippians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS o Timoteus ladun Iesus Kristus ong me saraui kan karos en Kristus Iesus o pisop o saunkoa kan nan Pilipi.

verses.name: Philippians 1:2
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam atail o Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail!

verses.name: Philippians 1:3
verses.text: I kin danke ai Kot ni ai tamatamanda komail.

verses.name: Philippians 1:4
verses.text: I me i kin wiada ni ai kapakap kin komail ansau karos, o i kin kapakap ni pereperen.

verses.name: Philippians 1:5
verses.text: Pweki omail dadaurata rongamau sang ni tapi o kokodo lel met.

verses.name: Philippians 1:6
verses.text: O i kamelele me i, me tapiadar wiawia mau eu re omail, pil pan kanikiela lao lel ran en Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 1:7
verses.text: Me pung i en kamelele mepukat duen komail karos, pwe i kin kolekol komail nan mongiong i ni ai salidi wet, wasa i kin kaweweda o kadededa rongamau; a komail karos kin iang ia kapwaiada mak wet.

verses.name: Philippians 1:8
verses.text: Pwe Kot ai saunkadede, duen i kin loleiteki komail pan kupur en Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Philippians 1:9
verses.text: O me i pil kapakapaki pwe omail limpok en lapalapala kakairida ni lolekong o lamalam akan.

verses.name: Philippians 1:10
verses.text: Pwe komail en kasauiada, da me mau sang karos, pwe komail en melel o pung lao lel ran en Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 1:11
verses.text: O direki wan pung kan, me kin wiaui ren Iesus Kristus men kalinganada o kapinga Kot.

verses.name: Philippians 1:12
verses.text: Ri ai kan, i men, komail en asa ir ai, me dialan kaindindar rongamau,

verses.name: Philippians 1:13
verses.text: Nan i ai salidi kan pweki Kristus, me pwarapwaradar nan im en monsap o wasa karos.

verses.name: Philippians 1:14
verses.text: O ri atail toto pan kupur en Kaun, me aingar kidar ai salidi kan, ap aima sang mas o, en padaki masan en Kot ap so masak.

verses.name: Philippians 1:15
verses.text: A akai kin padaki duen Kristus akpeirin, o akamai, o akai sang nan ar inong mau.

verses.name: Philippians 1:16
verses.text: A met akan ni limpok, pwe re asa, me ngai salidier, pwen kadede pan rongamau.

verses.name: Philippians 1:17
verses.text: Irail kin padaki duen Kristus kapei lokaia o so melel, re kiki ong, me re pan kalaudela ai salidi kan;

verses.name: Philippians 1:18
verses.text: A pil menda? Pwe Kristus kin lolok sili ni song karos, ma ni akamai de ni melel, i me i peren kida, ei i pan pereperen.

verses.name: Philippians 1:19
verses.text: Pwe i asa, mepukat pan kare ong ia maur soutuk ki omail kapakap o sauas pan Ngen en Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 1:20
verses.text: Duen ai inong iong, o auiaui, o kaporoporeki, me i sota pan namenokala ni eu song. A duen mas o, iduen ansau wet Kristus en kapingan laud ni war ai, ma ni ai pan memaurata de mela.

verses.name: Philippians 1:21
verses.text: Pwe Kristus, i maur i, o mela ai pai.

verses.name: Philippians 1:22
verses.text: A ma i pan memaurata ni pali uduk, ai wiawia kan pan kadepa; ari i ap sasa, da me i en pilada.

verses.name: Philippians 1:23
verses.text: Pwe i mauki ira karos: I inong iong mela, pwen mila ren Kristus, pwe i eta me mau.

verses.name: Philippians 1:24
verses.text: A ai mimieta ni pali uduk me mau song pweki komail.

verses.name: Philippians 1:25
verses.text: Ari, i ap asa, me i pan mimieta re omail karos, pwen sauasa omail peren o poson,

verses.name: Philippians 1:26
verses.text: Pwe omail kaping en lapalapala ren Kristus Iesus ki ai pwaralang komail.

verses.name: Philippians 1:27
verses.text: Ari, komail weweid duen me warong rongamau en Kristus, pwe ma i pwaralang komail, de ni ai doo, i en rong, me komail keleki ngen ta ieu, o komail lamalam ta pot, i iang kelail dodok ong rongamau ki poson.

verses.name: Philippians 1:28
verses.text: O komail ender waponki, me kin palian komail akan, pwe i kasansale pan arail pan lokidokila, a omail pan maurela; a mepukat sang ren Kot.

verses.name: Philippians 1:29
verses.text: Pwe a muei ong komail er pan kupur en Kristus, kaidin poson eta, pwen pil kalokolokeki i,

verses.name: Philippians 1:30
verses.text: Pwe komail kin wia pei ota, me komail kilanger re i, o me komail kin rong duen ngai.<div eID="gen2796" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Phil.1"/>

verses.name: Philippians 2:1
verses.text: MA panapanau eu ren Kristus mia, ma kamait en limpok, ma sau pena en Ngen, ma limpok melel, o kadek sang nan ngen omail,

verses.name: Philippians 2:2
verses.text: Komail ap kaunsokela ai peren ni omail lamalam ta pot, o limpok ta ieu, o min ta ieu, o inong iong song ta ieu,

verses.name: Philippians 2:3
verses.text: O der aklemai o der wia meakot ni aklapalap a ni karakarak, amen en kakaki amen mo a.

verses.name: Philippians 2:4
verses.text: Amen amen ender apwali pein a dipisou kan, a amen amen en apwali en akai ar dipisou.

verses.name: Philippians 2:5
verses.text: Pwe i tiak en mi re omail, me pil mi ren Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 2:6
verses.text: Me mom en Kot, ap sota men ale ong pein i en dueta Kot.

verses.name: Philippians 2:7
verses.text: Ap akamaleki pein i o wiala ladu men o song en aramas akan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:8
verses.text: O kotin sansaleda ni mom en aramas, o kasapwilidi pein i, o ni a kotin peiki ong lel mela, ei lel mela ni lopu.

verses.name: Philippians 2:9
verses.text: Nan i me Kot kotin kasapwilada i wasa ileile, o kotiki ong i mar eu, sikida sang mar karos.

verses.name: Philippians 2:10
verses.text: Pwe karos en kelepukidi ni mar en Iesus, me mi nanlang o nin sappa o pan sappa.

verses.name: Philippians 2:11
verses.text: O lo karos en kadedeki, me Iesus Kristus me Kaun pwen kalinganada Kot Sam.

verses.name: Philippians 2:12
verses.text: Ari kompoke pai kan, duen omail okoke kokodo, kaidin ni omail wokaren ia do, a me sikidar ansau wet ni ai doo, en pere ki, o lomwiniki kadokedoke kamaur pamail.

verses.name: Philippians 2:13
verses.text: Pwe Kot me kotin wiada karos nan lol omail: Inong o kapwaiada duen kupur a.

verses.name: Philippians 2:14
verses.text: Komail wiada meakaros so, lipanede o so peikasal.

verses.name: Philippians 2:15
verses.text: Pwe komail en pung o melel o seri en Kot akan, me so lol riapot nan pung en di sued o sapung, me komail ser sansal nan pung arail, dueta ser en sappa kan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:16
verses.text: Kasansaleda masan en maur, pwen kaping pa i ni ran en Kristus, pwe i ender tang mal de dodok mal.

verses.name: Philippians 2:17
verses.text: A ma i dueta mairong urak eu wudoki ong mairong o dodok en omail poson, i kin peren kida, o i pan iang komail karos pereperen.

verses.name: Philippians 2:18
verses.text: I me komail en pil perenki o komail en iang ia pereperen.

verses.name: Philippians 2:19
verses.text: A i kaporoporeki Kaun Iesus, me i pan madang kadar wong komail Timoteus, pwe i en pil insenemau, i lao asa ir omail.

verses.name: Philippians 2:20
verses.text: Pwe sota amen mi re i, me dueta i, me kin apwali komail melel.

verses.name: Philippians 2:21
verses.text: Pwe karos kin rapaki me pein ar, a kaidin me sapwilim en Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 2:22
verses.text: A komail asa, me a tiak me pung, pwe a sauasa ia ni rongamau dueta seri men ong a papa.

verses.name: Philippians 2:23
verses.text: I me i kaporoporeki, me i pan kadarala eden, i lao asa ir ai.

verses.name: Philippians 2:24
verses.text: A i liki Kaun o, me pein ngai pil pan pwara wei madang.

verses.name: Philippians 2:25
verses.text: A i lamedar, me mau en kadarlang komail ri ai Epaprotitus me ai warok ni ai dodok o ai peipei, iei omail men en kadar, o me papa ia ni ai samama.

verses.name: Philippians 2:26
verses.text: Pwe komail asa, a ngong kin komail melel, o a patauki melel omail rongadar, me a somau.

verses.name: Philippians 2:27
verses.text: Melel, a somau meid laud, koren iong mela. A Kot me kotin kupuredar i; a kaidin i eta, pwe pil ngai, pwe i de paiola pokon.

verses.name: Philippians 2:28
verses.text: A i madang kadarala i, pwe komail en kilang i, ap peren kida, o ai insensued en pil tikitikela.

verses.name: Philippians 2:29
verses.text: Komail ari kasamo i ni Kaun o popol, o wauneki me dueta i kan.

verses.name: Philippians 2:30
verses.text: Pweki wiawia en Kristus a koren iong mela, ni a sota kasampwaleki pein maur i, pwen sauasa ia wiliandi komail.<div eID="gen2797" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Phil.2"/>

verses.name: Philippians 3:1
verses.text: A PIL eu ri ai kan, komail en perenki Kaun o! I kin inting wong komail song ta ieu ansau karos, ari so, i me i sota insensuedeki, pwe a kin kakelaile kin komail.

verses.name: Philippians 3:2
verses.text: Kalaka kidi kan! Kalaka toun dodok sued akan! Kalaka song en sirkomsais sued!

verses.name: Philippians 3:3
verses.text: Pwe kitail, me kaudok ong Kot ki ngen o suaiki Kristus Iesus, o so kaporoporeki uduk, me sirkomsais.

verses.name: Philippians 3:4
verses.text: Ari so, men suaiki uduk pil, mi re i. O ma amen kin lamelame, me a kak suaiki uduk, a ngai kak laud sang.

verses.name: Philippians 3:5
verses.text: Pwe ngai sirkomsaiselar ni auel en ran, ngai kisan men Israel o kainok en Peniamin, o men Ipru amen me tapi sang men Ipru, a nin tiak en kapung Parisär amen.

verses.name: Philippians 3:6
verses.text: A ngai nantiong mepukat lao lel ong kaloke momodisou kan, o ni ai kapwaiada tiak en kapung, ngai me pung melel.

verses.name: Philippians 3:7
verses.text: A me pai ong ia, i mamaleki pweki Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 3:8
verses.text: Iei melel, i mamaleki meakaros pwe meid kasampwal en dedoki Kristus Iesus ai Kaun, i me i muei sang karos o wia pwel kilar, pwe i en anekila Kristus.

verses.name: Philippians 3:9
verses.text: O i en kadiarokada re a, me sota pein ai pung, me pwili sang kapung, a me pwili sang poson Kristus, iei pung, me Kot kotin wadok ong poson.

verses.name: Philippians 3:10
verses.text: Pwe i en dedeki i o manaman en a iasadar, o ai warok ki ong kalokolok pwe i en duela a matala.

verses.name: Philippians 3:11
verses.text: Pwe i en konodi maureda sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Philippians 3:12
verses.text: Kaidin likamata i konodier de ngai unsokelar; a i kin dadaurata, pwe i en konodi murin Kristus Iesus kotin kono ia dier.

verses.name: Philippians 3:13
verses.text: Ri ai kan i sota lamelame, me i konodier,

verses.name: Philippians 3:14
verses.text: A iet eu, me i kin wiada: I likidmaliela men likin sakeri, ap inong iong meakan, me mi moa, o i kilekilang ap tang wong kilel o, me mi moa, iei kating, me Kot kotin kileledi ong ia ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Philippians 3:15
verses.text: Ari karos me unsokelar, en lamelame due met. A ma komail wuki sang meakot ni lamalam, Kot pan kotin kadiarok ong komail.

verses.name: Philippians 3:16
verses.text: A me kitail konotier, kitail en inenki wei eta ni lip ota.

verses.name: Philippians 3:17
verses.text: Ri ai kan idauen ia do, o ale sang me kin kekeid wei duen me komail kilanger re at.

verses.name: Philippians 3:18
verses.text: Pwe pan pak toto i indang komail er duen me toto, me kin kekeid wei, a met i indang komail ki sangesang, me irail imwintiti pan lopu en Kristus,

verses.name: Philippians 3:19
verses.text: Me pan lokidokila ni imwi ’rail, me wia aniki kaped arail, me ar wau pan soredi, me kin paieki dipisou en sappa.

verses.name: Philippians 3:20
verses.text: A deu atail mi nanlang, wasa me se kin auiaui Kaun Iesus Kristus atail Saunkamaur pan pwarado sang ia.

verses.name: Philippians 3:21
verses.text: Me pan kotin kalinganada war atail pwel, pwen ras ong war a lingan ki manaman, me a pan kotin kaloe kidi meakan karos.<div eID="gen2798" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Phil.3"/>

verses.name: Philippians 4:1
verses.text: ARI ri ai kompok kan, ai peren o ai lingan komail, katengetengdi ren Kaun o kompoke pa i kan!

verses.name: Philippians 4:2
