verses.text: I panaui Ewodia o i panaui Sintike, pwe ira en minimin pena ren Kaun o.

verses.name: Philippians 4:3
verses.text: O i pil poeki re omui ai warok melel, sauasa ira, me iang ia er dodok ni rongamau, iangaki Klemens o ai warok tei kan, me arail mar akan mi nan puk en maur.

verses.name: Philippians 4:4
verses.text: Komail peren ki Kaun o ansau karos! I pil pan indada: Komail pereperen!

verses.name: Philippians 4:5
verses.text: Komail kadek ong aramas akan karos, Kaun o me kotin korendor.

verses.name: Philippians 4:6
verses.text: Komail der patauki meakot, a komail kasale ong Kot meakaros me komail inong iong ni omail kapakap o ngidingid ki danke.

verses.name: Philippians 4:7
verses.text: O popol en Kot, me lapa sang lolekong, pan apapwali mongiong omail o omail lamelam ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Philippians 4:8
verses.text: Pil eu ri ai kan, karos me melel, karos me kon ong, karos me pung, karos me min, karos me kaselel, karos me kalok mau, o ma pil eu tiak mau de men kaping, komail ap madamadaua due!

verses.name: Philippians 4:9
verses.text: Meakan, me komail padakkier o aleer, o rongadar, o kilanger re i, i me komail wia, a Kot en popol ap pan kotikot re omail.

verses.name: Philippians 4:10
verses.text: A ngai me perenki Kaun o kaualap, pweki ni ansau wet omail apwali ia me tapwendar; ari so, komail apwali ia ansau karos, a ansau kis komail sota kak ong.

verses.name: Philippians 4:11
verses.text: I sota inda mepukat pweki ai samamalar, pwe i kin insenemau ni ai samama o ni ai kapwapwa.

verses.name: Philippians 4:12
verses.text: I asada duen tiak en samama o duen tiak en kapwapwa. Ngai koiokki meakaros o song karos, i kak metier o men mangadar, o muei met o tutupok.

verses.name: Philippians 4:13
verses.text: I kak ong meakaros, pweki i, me katin ia da.

verses.name: Philippians 4:14
verses.text: Ari so, me mau omail apwali ia la ni ai paiolar akan.

verses.name: Philippians 4:15
verses.text: A komail men Pilipi pil asaer, me sota momodisou apapwali ia ni meakaros dueta komail sang ni tapin rongamau, ni ai ko wei sang Masetonien.

verses.name: Philippians 4:16
verses.text: Pwe komail kisakis dong ia pan riapak ni ai samamalar nan Tesalonik.

verses.name: Philippians 4:17
verses.text: Kaidin kisakis, me i kin rapaki, a i kin rapaki wa, pwen kalaudela noumail kisin likau.

verses.name: Philippians 4:18
verses.text: Pwe me mi re i itar ong ia, op il laud sang. Muei met mi re i, ni ai aleer omail kisakis ren Epaprotitus. Meakan ras ong pomau eu o mairong mau eu, me kon ong Kot.

verses.name: Philippians 4:19
verses.text: A ai Kot pan kotin kaitar omail samama duen a kapwapwa ni lingan ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Philippians 4:20
verses.text: A lingan en ko ong Kot o Sam atail kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: Philippians 4:21
verses.text: Ai ranamau ong saraui kan karos ren Kristus Iesus. Ri atail akan, me mi re i, kin ranamau wong komail.

verses.name: Philippians 4:22
verses.text: Saraui kan karos kin ranamau wong komail, pil toun im en Sisa mon karos.

verses.name: Philippians 4:23
verses.text: Mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi ren ngen omail! Amen.<div eID="gen2799" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Phil.4"/> <div eID="gen2795" osisID="Phil" type="book"/>

verses.name: Colossians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS wanporon en Kristus Iesus amen pan kupur en Kot o ri atail Timoteus,

verses.name: Colossians 1:2
verses.text: Ong ri at saraui o lelapok ren Krisus akan, me mi Kolose; mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam atail o Kaun Iesus Kristus!

verses.name: Colossians 1:3
verses.text: Kit kin danke Kot o Sam en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus o kapakapa kin komail kaukaule.

verses.name: Colossians 1:4
verses.text: Kit lao rongadar duen omail poson Kristus Iesus, o omail limpok ong saraui kan karos,

verses.name: Colossians 1:5
verses.text: Pweki kaporopor eu, me nekineki ong komail nanlang, duen me komail rongadar mas o ni padak melel en rongamau,

verses.name: Colossians 1:6
verses.text: Me lel wong komail o pil sap akan karos, o a kin wada o kakairida dueta re omail sang ni ran o, me komail rongadar o dedekier melel mak en Kot;

verses.name: Colossians 1:7
verses.text: Duen omail padakki sang ren Epapras at warok kompok amen, me papa lelapok en Kristus ong komail amen,

verses.name: Colossians 1:8
verses.text: Me pil kaireki dong kit duen omail limpok pena ni Ngen.

verses.name: Colossians 1:9
verses.text: I me se sota kin dukedi sang at kapakapa kin komail o poekipoeki sang ni ran en at rongadar, pwe komail en direki erpit en kupur a, o komail en lolekong o koiok ngenin,

verses.name: Colossians 1:10
verses.text: O kekeid wei duen me kon ong Kaun o, o kapareda wan wiawia mau karos, o kakairida ki asa Kot,

verses.name: Colossians 1:11
verses.text: O keleki kel karos duen manaman en a lingan pwen dadaurata o kanongama ki peren,

verses.name: Colossians 1:12
verses.text: Danke Sam o, me kotin kamau kitail lar, en iang pwaisaneki soso en me saraui kan nan marain.

verses.name: Colossians 1:13
verses.text: Me kotin kapiti sang kitail manaman en rotorot, ap kotin kasau kitail dong nan wein Na kompokepa,

verses.name: Colossians 1:14
verses.text: Me kotin dore kitail la iei lapwan dip atail,

verses.name: Colossians 1:15
verses.text: I me kasale pan Kot, me so sansal, me meseni en audepa karos.

verses.name: Colossians 1:16
verses.text: Pwe karos wiauiki i, karos me mi nanlang o sappa, me sansal o me so sansal, ma me poe kan, de saumas akan, de wei kan, de manaman akan, meakaros wiauiki i o ong i.

verses.name: Colossians 1:17
verses.text: O i me kotikot mon meakaros o meakaros memaureki i.

verses.name: Colossians 1:18
verses.text: O i tapwin war a, iei momodisou, o i me tapi o meseni en me iasadar sang ren me melar akan, pwe i en mon meakaros.

verses.name: Colossians 1:19
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotin kileledier me mau kan karos en mi re a.

verses.name: Colossians 1:20
verses.text: I ari kalolamau penang pein i meakan karos, ma ni sappa de nanlang, ni a kotin wiada muei mau ki ntan a lopu.

verses.name: Colossians 1:21
verses.text: O komail, me doo wei sang o imwintiti mas o ni omail lamelame o wiawia sued akan,

verses.name: Colossians 1:22
verses.text: A kotin kalolamau komail lar ki war a uduk ni a matala, pwen kapware kin komail da saraui o pung o so kadeik pa omail mo a.

verses.name: Colossians 1:23
verses.text: Ma komail dadaurata poson o tengeteng o so mokid wei sang ni kaporopor ki rongamau, me komail rongadar, o me lolok ong audepa karos me mi pan lang, me ngai Paulus wialar papa men.

verses.name: Colossians 1:24
verses.text: I ap perenki ai kalokolok ki komail o men kaimwisok kila uduk ai me luedi ni kamekam en Kristus, pweki war a, iei momodisou,

verses.name: Colossians 1:25
verses.text: Me i wialar papa men duen koa dodok en Kot, me i aleer pweki komail pwen usela masan en Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 1:26
verses.text: Iei me rir kot, me rir sang nin tapin kaua o men kaua, a met a kadiarok ong sapwilim a saraui kan,

verses.name: Colossians 1:27
verses.text: Me Kot men kasansaleda kapwapwa en lingan en rir wet ong men liki kan, iei Kristus me kotikot lol omail, i kaporopor en lingan.

verses.name: Colossians 1:28
verses.text: I me kit kin padaki o panepanaui aramas karos, o padapadaki aramas karos ni lolekong karos, pwe kit en kapwareda aramas karos ni unsoki ong Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 1:29
verses.text: I me i pil dodok kelail, duen wiawia en i me kin dodok kelail lol i.<div eID="gen2801" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Col.1"/>

verses.name: Colossians 2:1
verses.text: A I men, komail en asa iran ai pei laud pweki komail, o men Laodisäa, o irail karos, me sota kilang mas ai ni uduk o.

verses.name: Colossians 2:2
verses.text: Pwe mongiong arail en kamaitala o irail en warok pena ni limpok o irail en kakairida ni ar dedeki melel duen me rir en Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 2:3
verses.text: Pwe pai en erpit o dedeki, me okiok re a.

verses.name: Colossians 2:4
verses.text: I me i inda mepukat, pwe aramas amen ede kotau ki komail lokaia widing kan.

verses.name: Colossians 2:5
verses.text: A ni pali uduk o ngai me doo, a ni pali ngen i ngai mi re omail, i perenki o kilang omail sondi mau, o omail poson kelail Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 2:6
verses.text: A duen omail wuki ong Kristus Iesus Kaun o, iduen komail en weweideki i,

verses.name: Colossians 2:7
verses.text: O podidi ong i, o kakau kida i, o komail kelail ni poson, duen me komail padak kidar, o nantiong danke.

verses.name: Colossians 2:8
verses.text: Kalaka pwe amen ede sali kin komail padak mal o padok en kaua duen tiak en aramas akan en sappa, a kaidin tiak en Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 2:9
verses.text: Pwe aude pan me udan Kot karos kotikot re a, nan pein war a.

verses.name: Colossians 2:10
verses.text: O komail me unsok kilar i, me tapwin wei karos o manaman karos.

verses.name: Colossians 2:11
verses.text: Me komail pil sirkomsaiseki ong sirkomsais eu, me so mangin pa, a duen pwilikidi war en uduk ni sirkomsais eu, me ren Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 2:12
verses.text: Ni atail iang i serkidi paptais, o me komail pil maur kida poson manaman en Kot, me kaiasada i sang ren me melar akan.

verses.name: Colossians 2:13
verses.text: O ni ansaun omail mela ni dip o sosirkomsais en uduk omail, a kotin kamaur komail da iangaki i, ni a kotin maki ong kitail sapung kan karos.

verses.name: Colossians 2:14
verses.text: O a kotin iros wei sang inting o, me kapokon ong kitail, me audekier kusoned akan, ap palian kitail, i me a kotin kawelar ni a pasuredi ong i nin lopu.

verses.name: Colossians 2:15
verses.text: A lau kaloedier wei kan o manaman akan, ap kasansanle irail ada o wia kin ir kilel en kaperen eu.

verses.name: Colossians 2:16
verses.text: Sota amen en kadeik komail da pweki kisin manga, de pil nim, de ran a akai, de maram pul, de sapat akan.

verses.name: Colossians 2:17
verses.text: Pwe mepukat mot en me pan pwarado, a war o iei Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 2:18
verses.text: Sota me pan kataue sang komail kating pamail; pwe iei i me kin wiawia pein insen a ni a karakarak o pongi ong tounlang kan, me a sota kilanger o me aklapalap o perenki pein i ni tiak en uduk a.

verses.name: Colossians 2:19
verses.text: O a sota kin keleki tapwi, me war pon ale sang kisin manga ki kokon akan, iduen a pan kakairida ni kupur en Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 2:20
verses.text: A ma komail iang Kristus melar sang tiak en sappa, menda komail pil lodi ong tiak kan likamata komail memaureta nin sappa.

verses.name: Colossians 2:21
verses.text: Re kin inda: Koe der doke, koe der song, koe der sair!

verses.name: Colossians 2:22
verses.text: A mepukat karos pan okila kadokepa; ari kisin kusoned mal akan, me aramas akan ta wiadar.

verses.name: Colossians 2:23
verses.text: Me sansal en lolekong ni ar wiada pein ar kaudok o karakarak o ar kaloke pali war arail; a mepukat kin kapwaiada pali uduk eta.<div eID="gen2802" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Col.2"/>

verses.name: Colossians 3:1
verses.text: ARI, ma komail iang Kristus iasadar, en rapaki me pali poa kan, wasa Kristus kotikot ia ni pali maun en Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 3:2
verses.text: Inong iong me mi pali poa a kaidin me mi nin sappa.

verses.name: Colossians 3:3
verses.text: Pwe komail melar, o maur omail rirlong Kristus ren Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 3:4
verses.text: Kristus, iei maur atail, lao pwarado, kitail pan pil iang i pwarado ni lingan o.

verses.name: Colossians 3:5
verses.text: Komail ari kamela kokon omail, me mi sappa: Nenek, samin, tiak sued, inong sued, norok kapwa, pwe iei kaudok sued.

verses.name: Colossians 3:6
verses.text: Pweki mepukan ongiong en Kot kin lel ong seri sopeik kan.

verses.name: Colossians 3:7
verses.text: Me komail pil kekeideki mas o, ansaun omail akmemaurki.

verses.name: Colossians 3:8
verses.text: A metet komail pwilikidier meakaros: Makar, lingarangar, katantat, lalaue, kasoi kasaut nan au omail;

verses.name: Colossians 3:9
verses.text: Ender likam nan pung omail, pwe komail pwilikidier aramas maring iangaki a wiawia kan,

verses.name: Colossians 3:10
verses.text: Ap aleer me kap, me wilikapadang lolekong duen mom en me kausedar i.

verses.name: Colossians 3:11
verses.text: Wasan sota men Krik, sota Sus, sota sirkomsais, pil sota sosirkomsais, sota men liki, sota Site, sota ladu o sota me maioda men, a Kristus eta me kotikot ni karos.

verses.name: Colossians 3:12
verses.text: Pwil po omail duen en Kot a pilidar akan, me saraui o kompok, limpok en nan mongiong, o kadek, o karakarak, o opampap, o kanongama,

verses.name: Colossians 3:13
verses.text: Apwali amen amen, o mak pena, ma amen kainsensuedi amen, duen Kristus kotin mak ong komail er, iduen komail.

verses.name: Colossians 3:14
verses.text: O moneki limpok, me ora pena kamau pokon.

verses.name: Colossians 3:15
verses.text: O popol en Kristus en kaunda nan mongiong omail, me komail pil paeker pena ni war ta ieu, o komail danke.

verses.name: Colossians 3:16
verses.text: Komail nantiong dodokiki masan en Kristus nan pung omail ni lolekong karos; padapadaki o panapanaui komail pena, ki psalm, o kaul en kaping, o kaul ngenin, o kakaul ong Kot nan mongiong omail ki mak.

verses.name: Colossians 3:17
verses.text: O karos, me komail kin wia ni lokaia, o wiawia kan, en wiada ni mar en Kaun Iesus, o danke Kot o Sam pweki i.

verses.name: Colossians 3:18
verses.text: Komail li akan udi ong omail warok kan ni Kaun o, duen me kon ong.

verses.name: Colossians 3:19
verses.text: Komail ol akan, pok ong omail warok kan o der makar pa ’rail.

verses.name: Colossians 3:20
verses.text: Komail seri kan, peiki ong me wia komail da ni meakaros, pwe i me kon ong Kaun o.

verses.name: Colossians 3:21
verses.text: Komail sam akan, der kamakar mal noumail seri kan, pwe ren der sang komail la.

verses.name: Colossians 3:22
verses.text: Komail ladu kan, peiki ong omail saumas ni uduk ni meakaros kaidin ni dodok mon aramas, pwen konekon ren aramas, a ni impimpai en mongiong o, o lan Kaun o.

verses.name: Colossians 3:23
verses.text: O karos, me komail wiada en lolm ong wiada, dueta ong Kaun o a kaidin ong aramas akan.

verses.name: Colossians 3:24
verses.text: Ap asa, me komail pan ale kating en soso ren Kaun o, pwe komail kin papa Kaun Kristus.

verses.name: Colossians 3:25
verses.text: A me wia sapung, pan pein pukoki sapung me a wiadar pwe Kot sota kin lipilipil aramas amen.<div eID="gen2803" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Col.3"/>

verses.name: Colossians 4:1
verses.text: KOMAIL saumas akan, pwain ong omail ladu kan me pung o me mau, pwe komail asa, me pil omail Saumas kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Colossians 4:2
verses.text: Podidi ong kapakap o masamasan o danke.

verses.name: Colossians 4:3
verses.text: O pil kapakapa kin kit, pwe Kot en kotin ritingidang kit wanim en masan eu, en kaweweda en Kristus a me rir kot, me ngai sali kidier,

verses.name: Colossians 4:4
verses.text: Pwe i en kaparoki duen me pung.

verses.name: Colossians 4:5
verses.text: Kekeid lelapok wei mon men liki kan, kadokedoke ansau mau.

verses.name: Colossians 4:6
verses.text: Omail kasoi en wiaui ni mak o doleki sol ansau karos, pwe komail en asada, duen me komail pung sapengki amen amen.

verses.name: Colossians 4:7
verses.text: Ri atail kompok Tikikus o papa lelapok o ladu en Kaun amen pan kaire kin komail ir ai karos.

verses.name: Colossians 4:8
verses.text: Pwe i me i kadar wong komail er, pwen asa ir omail, o kamait mongiong omail,

verses.name: Colossians 4:9
verses.text: Onesimus pil iang i, i ri atail lelapok kompok amen, me kis omail. Ira pan kaire kin komail karos, me wiauier met.

verses.name: Colossians 4:10
verses.text: Aristarkus, me iang ia salidi, kin ranamau wong komail, o Markus nain ri en Parnapas pwe komail ale er kusoned akan duen i; a lao pwara wong komail, komail kasamo i;

verses.name: Colossians 4:11
verses.text: O Iesus, me ad a Iust, me kisan sirkomsais. Irail eta ai warok en dodok ni wein Kot; ira me kamait pa i.

verses.name: Colossians 4:12
verses.text: Epapras, me kis omail, o me ladun Kristus Iesus amen, kin ranamau wong komail, a ngidingide sauasa komail ni a kapakap akan kaukaule, pwe komail en dadaurata o unsokila o direki kupur en Kot.

verses.name: Colossians 4:13
verses.text: Ngai me kadede i, me a porisok melel ni a apapwali komail o irail nan Laodisea o Irapolis.

verses.name: Colossians 4:14
verses.text: En saunwini Lukas kompok o Demas ara ranamau wong komail.

verses.name: Colossians 4:15
verses.text: Ranamau wong ri atail akan en Laodisea o Nimpas o momodisou nan im a.

verses.name: Colossians 4:16
verses.text: A kisin likau kis et lao wadawader re omail, komail kanaiong, pwen pil wadawad ren momodisou en Laodisea, o komail pil pan wadok, me i kadaralang Laodisea.

verses.name: Colossians 4:17
verses.text: Komail indai ong Arkipus: Kanekanai ong dodok, me koe aleer sang ren Kaun o, pwe koe en kapwaiada.

verses.name: Colossians 4:18
verses.text: Iet ngai Paulus intingki pa i ai ranamau. Tamatamanda ai salidi. Mak en mimieta re omail!<div eID="gen2804" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Col.4"/> <div eID="gen2800" osisID="Col" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS, o Silwanus, o Timoteus ong momodisou en Tesalonik, me ren Kot Sam o Kaun Iesus Kristus. Mak o popol en mi re omail!

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: Se kin poden danke Kot ki komail karos o tamataman kin komail ni at kapakap akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: O se kin tamatamanda omail wiawia kan ni poson, o omail dodok ni limpok, o omail kanongama ni kaporoporeki atail Kaun Iesus Kristus sansal ong Kot o Sam atail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: Pwe ri ai kan o kompoke pan Kot akan, se asa duen omail lipilipil re a,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: Pwe at rongamau lel ong komail er, kaidin nin lokaia ta, a pil ni manaman o Ngen saraui, o ni kamelelepa kaualap, pwe komail asa song en aramas da kit re omail pweki komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: A komail ale sanger kit o sang Kaun o, ni omail aleer masan o ni kamekam kaualap o ni peren en Ngen saraui.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: Komail wialar kilel en saulang karos mi Masetonien o Akaia.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: Pwe sang re omail masan en Kaun o kaparaparalar, kaidin nan Masetonien o Akaia eta, pwe pil wasa karos omail poson Kot lokila ia; ari, solar me se pan inda.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: Pwe pein irail kaire kin kit, duen at pwaralang komail me pwaida, o duen omail wuki ong Kot sang dikedik en ani kan, pwen papang Kot, me udan maur o melel.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: O auiaui sapwilim a Ol sang nanlang, me a kotin kaiasada sang ren me melar akan, Iesus, me kotin dore kitail sang ni ongiong en Kot, me pan sansaldo.<div eID="gen2806" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Thess.1"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: PWE pein komail asa, ri ai kan, duen at pwaralang komail kaidin me so kadepa.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: A murin at kamekam nan Pilipi o at kalokolok wasa o, duen me komail asa, kit aimaki atail Kot padaki ong komail rongamau en Kot ni apwal laud.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Pwe at panapanaui komail sota wiaui ni kotaue, de samin, de widing.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: Pwe duen kit ale sang ren Kot en padaki rongamau, iduen at padak kin wiaui, kaidin pwen konekonlar ren aramas akan, a Kot me kotin kasauiada mongiong it.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: Sota eu ansau me se lingkapinga komail, duen me komail asa, de norok kapwa, Kot me saunkadede en mepukat.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: Se pil sota rapaki konekon ren aramas akan, ma re omail de ren akai. A se pan kak katoutoui komail, pwe kit wanporon en Kristiis akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: Ari so, kit kin materok nan pung omail dueta li en kamait amen, me kin apwali na seri kan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: Iduen at ngong kin komail melel, se mauki katungole kin komail rongamau en Kot, a kaidin i eta, a pein maur at, pwe komail wialar kompoke pat.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: Ri ai kan, komail kin tamanda duen at dodok o at apwal akan. Pwe se dodok ni ran o ni pong, pwen der katoutoui amen komail, o se padaki ong komail rongamau en Kot.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: Komail o Kot at saunkadede duen at makelekel, o pung, o inen re omail me poson akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: O duen komail asa, me kit panaui o kamekamait amen amen re omail dueta papa men wiai ong na seri kan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: O se padaki ong komail er, me komail en alu inen wei ta, duen me kon ong Kot, me kotin molipe komail ong pein a wei o pein a lingan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: I me se kin poden danke Kot, pwe ni omail aleer masan en Kot, komail aleer kaidin dueta padak en aramas akan, pwe dueta masan en Kot melel, me pil kin dodok nan lol omail me poson akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: Pwe ri ai kan, komail ale sanger momodisou en Kot akan nan Iudäa ren Kristus Iesus; pwe komail kamekame ren toun omail wei, dueta irail me kamekame ren Sus akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: Me pil kamatalar Kaun Iesus, o saukop akan, me re kaloke, o re sota konekon ren Kot, o re kin palian aramas akan karos.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: O re kainapwi sang kit, ender padak ong men liki kan, pwe ren der maurela, pwe re kin kadirela dip arail ansau karos, a ongiong mi po ’rail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: A kit ri ai kan ni at doo wei sang komail ansau kis ni pali war at, a kaidin ni mongiong it, se ap nantiong o inong iong melel kilang mas omail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:18
verses.text: I me se men pwar wong komail, ngai Paulus pan mepak o pan riapak, a Satan karompa kit.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:19
verses.text: Pwe is me kapore pat, de kaperen pat, de kapinga pat? Kaidin komail mon Kaun patail Iesus ni a kotido?

verses.name: I Thessalonians 2:20
verses.text: Pwe komail kalinga pat o kaperen pat.<div eID="gen2807" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Thess.2"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: I ME se solar kak nenen la, pwe se maukida kelepala nan Aten,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: Ap kadar wong komail Timoteus ri atail o papan Kot ni rongamau en Kristus, pwen katenge komail o kamait komail la iran omail poson.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: Pwe sota amen en luet kila kamekam wet, pwe pein komail asa, mepukat kileledier ong kitail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: Pwe ni at mimi re omail, se kokopki dong komail kamekam; duen a pwaidar o duen me komail asa.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: I me i solar kak nenenla, a i ilakila, pwe i en asa, duen omail poson, ma men kasongesong so kasongesong komail, o ma at dodok sota pan dodok mal.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: A metet ni en Timoteus pwara dong kin sang re omail, o padaki ong kit rong mau duen omail poson o limpok, o duen omail tamataman kit ansau karos, o duen komail men kilang kit, i dueta kit kin inong iong kilang komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: Ri ai kan, kit ap kamait kilar komail ni at kamekam o apwal akan ki omail poson.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: Pwe ansau wet kit maureda, ma komail poden tengedi ong Kaun o.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: Pwe ia danke me sen dankeki Kot pweki komail, me pan ras ong peren, me se peren kida mon Kot ki komail?

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: Se kin poden kapakapa kin komail ni pong ni ran o ngidingidiki, sen kilang mas omail o kaunsokala omail poson.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: Ari, pein Kot, o Sam atail, o atail Kaun Iesus en kotin kalua kit wong komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: A Kaun o en kotin kangedere komail la o kalaudela omail limpok nan pung omail o ong amen amen dueta kit ong komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: O kotin katengeteng mongiong omail pwen mau melel, ni saraui mon Kot o Sam atail ong ni ran en atail Kaun Iesus, me pan kotido o sapwilim a saraui kan karos iang i.<div eID="gen2808" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Thess.3"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:1
verses.text: ARI, ri ai kan, se pil poeki re omail o panaui kin komail Kaun Iesus, duen me komail aleer sang kit, o duen me komail en kekeideki wei, o kaperenda Kot, iduen omail kakairida.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:2
verses.text: Pwe komail asa duen kusoned akan, me se pang ong komail ren Kaun Iesus.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:3
verses.text: Pwe iet kupur en Kot, omail sarauila, pwe komail en liki sang nenek.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:4
verses.text: Amen amen en kanai ong pein war a, pwen saraui o wau o liki sang inong sued,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:5
verses.text: Kaidin ni dender ong inong sued duen men liki kan, me so asa Kot;

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:6
verses.text: O sota me pan piti de kasapungi ong ri a ni meakot, pwe Kaun o pan kotin iki ong i, duen me kit inda o kadede ong komail er mas o.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:7
verses.text: Pwe Kot sota molipei kitail ong samin, a pwen saraui.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:8
verses.text: A ma amen komail pan mamaleki mepukat, kaidin aramas me a pan mamaleki pwe Kot, me pil kotiki ong komail er sapwilim a Ngen saraui.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:9
verses.text: A duen limpok en saulang, menda i en intingki wong komail, pwe pein komail padakki sang ren Kot, me komail en poke pena.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:10
verses.text: Nan met komail kin wiai ong saulang karos, me mimi Masetonien pon. A se panaui kin komail ri at akan, komail en kakairida.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:11
verses.text: O komail nenenla o inong iong apwali pein omail dodok, kadokeki pein pa omail, duen me se padaki ong komail er,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:12
verses.text: Pwe komail en sansal mau mon me mi liki kan, o komail der mau ong amen en apwali komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:13
verses.text: Ri ai kan, se sota men oki sang komail duen me mairelar akan, pwe komail der insensued dueta irail, me sota ar kaporopor.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:14
verses.text: Pwe ma kitail kamelele, me Iesus matala ap iasadar, nan iduen me mairelar ren Iesus, Kot pil pan kalua ir ala re a.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:15
verses.text: Pwe ieteten me se indang komail ni masan en Kaun o, kit me memaureta lao Kaun o pan kotin pwarado, sota pan ko wei mon me mair akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:16
verses.text: Pwe pein Kaun o pan kotido sang nanlang ki masan laud, o kapiti en toulang lapalap amen, o koronete en Kot; me melar akan ren Kristus ap pan maureda mas.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:17
verses.text: Kit me memaureta luadi ap pan iang ir peukadala nan dapok kan, ko ong ren Kaun o nan wäwä, kitail ap pan mimieta ren Kaun o kokolata.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 4:18
verses.text: Komail ari kamaiteki komail la padak pot et.<div eID="gen2809" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Thess.4"/>

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:1
verses.text: A DUEN ansau o auer, ri ai kan, menda i en inting wong komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:2
verses.text: Pwe pein komail asa mau, me ran en Kaun o pan pwarado dueta lipirap amen ni pong.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:3
verses.text: Pwe irail lao pan inda: A muei mau, o sota apwal kot mia, i ansau kaupa pan lel ong irail dueta li lisean amen; a irail sota pan pitila.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:4
verses.text: A komail ri ai kan, solar mi ni rotorot, pwe ran o de konodi komail duen lipirap amen.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:5
verses.text: Komail karos seri en marain, o seri en ran. Kitail so kisan pong o rotorot.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:6
verses.text: Kitail ari ender mamair dueta me tei kan, a kitail en masamasan o daulikin.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:7
verses.text: Pwe me mair, kin mamair ni pong, o me sokolar, kin sokolar ni pong.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:8
verses.text: A kitail, me kisan ran, en liki sang, til wong nan pere pan marmar en poson o limpok, o lisoropeki kaporopor pan maur.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:9
verses.text: Pwe kaidin ongiong, me Kot kotin kileledi ong kitail, a sen konodi maur soutuk ki atail Kaun Iesus Kristus,

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:10
verses.text: Me mata kin kitail er, pwe ma kitail papat de mamair, en maur pena re a.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:11
verses.text: Komail ari panau o sauas pena nan pung omail duen me komail kin wia.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:12
verses.text: A se poeki re omail, ri ai kan, komail, en apwali me kin dodok nan pung omail, o me kaun komail da pan Kaun o, o me kin panaui komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:13
verses.text: Komail kaka kin ir kaualap ni limpok, pweki ar wiawia; o komail popol pena.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:14
verses.text: Se panaui kin komail, ri ai kan, komail en kapung ong me katiwo kan, o kamait, me ar poson tikitik, o apapwali me luet akan, o kanongama ong karos.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:15
verses.text: Komail masamasan, pwe amen ender depukki ong amen me sued me sued, a en inong iong me mau eta nan pung omail o ong amen amen.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:16
verses.text: Komail pereperen ansau karos.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:17
verses.text: Kapakapta soutuk.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:18
verses.text: Komail danke ni meakaros, pwe iduen kupur en Kot ren Kristus Iesus ong komail.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:19
verses.text: Der kakundi Ngen.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:20
verses.text: Der mamaleki deideikop akan.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:21
verses.text: Kasosong ong meakan karos, ap koledi me mau.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:22
verses.text: Liki sang song en sued karos.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:23
verses.text: A Kot en popol en kasaraui komail la kaualap, ngen omail, o mongiong omail, o war omail en nekinek mau ong en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus a pwarado.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:24
verses.text: Melel i, me kotin molipe komail er, me pan pil wiada.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:25
verses.text: Ri ai kan kapakapa kin kit.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:26
verses.text: Ranamauki ri at akan karos metik saraui.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:27
verses.text: I kauki ong Kaun, me komail pan wadok kisin likau kis et ong saulang saraui kan karos.

verses.name: I Thessalonians 5:28
verses.text: Mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail!<div eID="gen2810" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Thess.5"/> <div eID="gen2805" osisID="1Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS o Silwanus, o Timoteus ong momodisou en Tesalonik me ren Kot Sam atail, o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:2
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam atail o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail!

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:3
verses.text: Mak eta sen poden danke Kot pweki komail, ri ai kan, pwe omail poson kin laudela kaualap, o omail limpok pena pwaida kaualap.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:4
verses.text: I me kit suai kin komail ong momodisou en Kot akan pweki omail kanongama o poson ni omail kalokolok o kamekam, me lel ong komail.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:5
verses.text: Iei me kasansal pan kadeik pung en Kot, komail ap pan kon ong wein Kot, me komail kamekamki.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:6
verses.text: Pwe me pung ta ong Kot en depukki ong irail me moromorouo ong komail.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:7
verses.text: A komail, me kalokolok, pan iang kit meleileila, ni kasale pan Kaun Iesus sang nanlang iang sapwilim a tounlang manaman akan,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:8
verses.text: Sansaldo ni kisiniai umpumpul, kapukapung ong irail me poponsasa Kot, o ong irail, me so peiki ong rongamau en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:9
verses.text: O me pan lokidokilang kamekam soutuk sang mon silang en Kaun o sang mon a manaman lingan.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:10
verses.text: Ni a pan kotido o lingan kila sapwilim a saraui kan, ni ran o, o usun kin ir karos, me posonlar i, pwe komail kamelele atail kadede.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:11
verses.text: I me se kin pil poden kapakapa kin komail, pwe Kot en kotin kakonekon komail ong paeker o a kotin kaerela omail kapunglol o kapwaiada wiawia en poson ki manaman.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 1:12
verses.text: Pwe mar en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en kalinganada re omail, o komail en konekonla re a duen mak en atail Kot o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.<div eID="gen2812" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Thess.1"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:1
verses.text: SE men poeki re omail ri at akan iran atail Kaun Iesus Kristus a pan kotin pwarado, o atail pan peukedalang i,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:2
verses.text: Komail der wukiwuk sili o der wapon kida ngen eu, de kasoi pot, de kisin likau, me dene kit kadar wong komail, me dene ran en Kaun o mier.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:3
verses.text: Sota amen en kotau komail la ni meakot. Pwe ran o sota pan pwarado, lao wiawia en mas more wei sang, o aramas en dip sansal la, nain me sued.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:4
verses.text: Me pan palian meakaros o kasapwilada pein i, en ileila sang karos, me udan Kot de men kaudok kan, A pan mondi nan tanpas en Kot o mome ong pein i Kot.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:5
verses.text: Komail sota tamanda ni ai mimi re omail, i katiti ong komail mepukat?

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:6
verses.text: Ari met komail asaer, me meakot mia, me kin kapwandela a pan pwarado.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:7
verses.text: A rir en sapung kan ap mur pwaida met. Ari so, a mimieta me kin kapwandela, lao a pan poioki wei sang;

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:8
verses.text: I ansau me likin kapung o pan sansaleda, me Kaun Iesus pan kotin kame kila ang en silang i, o kawe kila lingan en a pan pwarado.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:9
verses.text: I me pan pwara kido mana en Satan, iangaki manaman o kilel akai o kapuriam ni likam kai.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:10
verses.text: O iangaki widing en sapung karos ong irail, me pan lokidokila, pwe re kang limpok ong melel, pwe ren dorela.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:11
verses.text: I me Kot kotin mueid ong irail ni manaman sued eu men kaping ir ada, pwe ren kamelele likam.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:12
verses.text: Pwe karos pan pakadeikada me so kamelele masan melel, a me mauki me sapung.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:13
verses.text: A mak eta, sen danke Kot ansau karos pweki komail, ri ai kompok kan, o pwe sang nin tapi o Kot me kotin pila kidar komail ong maur potopot ni saraui la pan Ngen o ni poson melel o.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:14
verses.text: Pwe ong mepukat a kotin molipei komail er pan at rongamau, pwe komail en pwais aneki lingan en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:15
verses.text: Ari ri at akan, tengedi ong o apwali padak, me komail padakkier, ma sang ni kasoi de at kisin likau.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:16
verses.text: A pein atail Kaun Iesus Kristus o Kot o Sam atail, me pok ong kitail o kupura dong kitail kamait soutuk o kapor mau pan mak,

verses.name: II Thessalonians 2:17
verses.text: I en kamaitala mongiong omail, o katingi komail ong ni wiawia mau karos o padak.<div eID="gen2813" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Thess.2"/>

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:1
verses.text: ARI ri at akan, komail kapakapa kin kit, pwe masan en Kaun o en pwaida o linganla duen a wiauier re omail.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:2
verses.text: O pwe kit en sapedokala sang aramas solelapok kan; pwe poson kaidin pwais en aramas karos.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:3
verses.text: A Kaun o me melel, me pan katenge komail o nikid sang ni me sued.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:4
verses.text: Se kaporoporeki Kaun o re omail, me komail kin dadaurata o pan wiada, me se kakaliki ong komail er.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:5
verses.text: A Kaun o en kotin wiawia mongiong omail, pwe komail en direki limpok en Kot o kanongama en Kristus.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:6
verses.text: Ri ai kan, se kakaliki ong komail ni mar en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, me komail en muei sang saulang karos, me kin dadaurata padak, me komail ronger sang kit.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:7
verses.text: Pwe komail asa duen idedauen kit, pwe kit sota wiadar sapung nan pung omail.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:8
verses.text: O se sota ale sang amen kan at manga, ap sota pwaipwai, pwe se dodok apwal ni pong o ni ran, pwe sen der katoutouki amen komail.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:9
verses.text: A kaidin pwe a sota muei ong kit, a pwe sen wia kin kit kilel en me komail en alale sang.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:10
verses.text: Pwe ni at mimi re omail, iet me se kakaliki ong komail, meamen me kang wia dodok, a pil sota pan manga.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:11
verses.text: Pwe se ronger, me akai mi re omail, me kin weweid ni mesued ni ar solar kin dodok, a re apwali kisin tiak mal.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:12
verses.text: Ari, irail me due met, se indai ong o panaui irail, pan Kaun Iesus Kristus, me irail en dodok, o nenenla o tungole pein kan ar manga.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:13
verses.text: A komail, ri ai kan, der pangki omail wiawia mau.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:14
verses.text: A ma amen kang oke at padak nan kisin likau et, i me komail en kileledi, o komail der apwali i, pwe i en namenokela.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:15
verses.text: A komail der wiaki i imwintiti amen, a sauasa i dueta ri omail amen.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:16
verses.text: A Kaun en popol en pein kotiti ong komail popol ansau karos o ni song karos! Kaun o en kotikot re omail karos!

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:17
verses.text: Ngai Paulus ranamau ni mangin pa i, me kisin likau karos kilelekidi, iduen ai inting.

verses.name: II Thessalonians 3:18
verses.text: Mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omail karos!<div eID="gen2814" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Thess.3"/> <div eID="gen2811" osisID="2Thess" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS wanporon en Iesus Kristus amen pan kusoned en Kot Saunkamaur patail o Kristus Iesus, me kitail kaporoporeki,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:2
verses.text: Ong Timoteus nai seri melel ni poson mak o limpok, o popol sang ren Kot Sam o Kristus Iesus atail Kaun.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:3
verses.text: Duen ai poeki re om, en mimieta Episus ni ai pan kola Masetonien, pwe koe en kapung ong akai, ren der wia padak toror.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:4
verses.text: Pil der kamelele kasoi mal o padok en di toto, me kareda akamai ap sota sauasa koa dodok en Kot, me tapi sang poson.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:5
verses.text: Pwe aude pan kusoned limpok sang nan mongiong makelekel, o insen mau, o poson melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:6
verses.text: Sang mepukat akai muei sanger, rap wuki ong poupoulap.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:7
verses.text: Re men wiala saunpadak en kapung, ap so weweki, me re inda, o me re kin men padaki kaualap.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:8
verses.text: A kitail asa, kapung me mau, ma amen so kasapunge.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:9
verses.text: O se asa, me sota kapung en wiaui ong me pung amen, a ong me sapung kan, o katiwo kan, o me doo sang Kot akan, o me dipan akan, o me so saraui kan, o me san Kot akan, o me kin kaloke sam ar in ar, o me kamela aramas akan.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:10
verses.text: O me nenek kan, o me madong saut ong ol oko, o me kin pirap aramas akan, o me likam kan, o me kaula likam akan, o ma pil meakot mia, me so kon ong padak en kamour.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:11
verses.text: Duen rongamau en lingan en Kot iasanai me pang dong ia.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:12
verses.text: I ap danke Kristus Iesus atail Kaun, me kotin kamana ia da o kamelel ia ni a kotin kasapwil ia dang dodok.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:13
verses.text: Pwe mas o ngai lalaue amen, o kaloke saulang kan, o lolap amen, ari so i diaradar mak o, pwe i wiadar mepukat ap sasa o ni ai soposon.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:14
verses.text: A mak en atail Kaun me lapalap alar kaualap ni poson o limpok, me mi ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:15
verses.text: Melel lepen kasoi lep, o me mau ong kamelele: Kristus Iesus pwara dong sappa, pwen dorela me dipan akan; a ngai me sued sang karos.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:16
verses.text: Ari so, i diaradar mak o, pwe Iesus Kristus en kotin kasaleda a kanongama lapalap re i, pwe men kaalemongi ong me pan poson, pwen maur soutuk.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:17
verses.text: A Nanmarki potopot, me so kak mor pasang, o so sansal, i Kot eta. Wau o lingan en ko ong i potopoteta! Amen.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:18
verses.text: Kusoned wet i men pang ong uk, nai seri Timoteus, duen deideikop akan, me wiaui ong uk er, pwe ren sauasu uk, en wia pei mau eu,

verses.name: I Timothy 1:19
verses.text: Ni om dadaurata poson o kanakanai ong insen om mau, me akai pein kase sang irail, ap peila sang nin poson.

verses.name: I Timothy 1:20
verses.text: Amen irail Imenäus o amen Aleksander, me pangalang Satan, pwe ren lelapok ki kalokolok, ap solar lalaue.<div eID="gen2816" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.1"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 2:1
verses.text: Iet me i men panaui mas: Komail ngidingideki o kapakapki, o poekipoeki aramas akan karos, o wia danke.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:2
verses.text: Kapakapaki nanmarki o saumas akan karos, pwe sen meleilei o insememau, wiawia me kon ong Kot o melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Pwe i me mau o kon ong atail Saunkamaur Kot,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:4
verses.text: Me kotin men, aramas akan karos en dorela o lolekong kila melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:5
verses.text: Pwe Kot me ta men o wilia patail me ta men nan pung en Kot o aramas akan, iet Aramas Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:6
verses.text: Me kotin wiala en aramas karos ar men pwaipwai, kadede en met, en lolok sili ni ansau me kon ong.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:7
verses.text: I me i wia kila saunkair o wanporon amen, i kin lokaia melel o so likam, o saunpadak ong men liki kan ni poson o melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:8
verses.text: I me i men, ol akan en kapakap ni wasa karos, ni ar pokada pa ar saraui, so makar o so peikasal.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:9
verses.text: Pil dueta li akan, ren kapwadeki likau makelekel o lelapok, o tiak mau, a kaidin ni ingid pit en monga, de kold, de manaman akan, de likau lingan,

verses.name: I Timothy 2:10
verses.text: A me kon ong li akan, me men kasaleda ar masak Kot ni ar wiawia mau kan.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:11
verses.text: Li akan en nenenla, ap padapadakki ni tiak en impimpai.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:12
verses.text: I sota mueid ong li amen, en wiada padak, de kaunda ol, a en nenenla.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:13
verses.text: Pwe Adam me wiauier mas, a muri Ewa.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:14
verses.text: A kaidin Adam, me katiamaula, a li o me katiamaular, ap pupedi ni me sapung.

verses.name: I Timothy 2:15
verses.text: A a pan dorela ni a naitik ma a pan podidi ong poson, o limpok, o saraui, o tiak mau.<div eID="gen2817" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.2"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 3:1
verses.text: MELEL kasoi pot et: Ma amen rapaki koa en pisop, a kin inong iong wiawia mau eu.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:2
verses.text: A pisop o en pung, o warok en li ta men, o so kowei kodo, a lelapok, o tiak mau, o apwali men kairu, o koiok ong padak;

verses.name: I Timothy 3:3
verses.text: A der kamom soko, o so pamara, a en materok, o der inong iong akamai, o der pok ong moni.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:4
verses.text: Me kin kaunda mau pein toun im a, o me na seri kan kin peiki ong ni tiak pung.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:5
verses.text: A ma amen, me sokoiok ong kaunda pein toun im a, iaduen a pan kak kaunda momodisou en Kot?

verses.name: I Timothy 3:6
verses.text: Pil kaidin saulang kap amen, pwe a ende aklapalap, ap lodi ong kadeik en tewil.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:7
verses.text: O en pil kalok mau ren me mi liki, pwe a de lodi ong kanamenok o katikatiamau pan tewil.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:8
verses.text: Pil dueta saunkoa kan en lelapok, so lo riapot, so kamom soko, so noroke moni.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:9
verses.text: Me kin kolekol nan insen arail makelekel rir en poson.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:10
verses.text: Mepukat en kasosongla mas, irail ap pan papa, ma irail me pung.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:11
verses.text: Pil dueta en saunkoa ar warok kan, ren wia me kon ong, o so likinekine, o so kowei kodo, o melel ni meakaros.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:12
verses.text: Saunkoa kan en warok en li ta men o ren kaunda mau nair seri kan o toun im arail.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:13
verses.text: A me papa mau, kin kalok maui pein irail, o re pan pereperenki melel poson me mi ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:14
verses.text: Mepukat i inting wong uk, o i kaporoporeki, me i pan pwarala re om madang.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:15
verses.text: A ma i pwapwand, koe en asa duen me koe pan wia nan tanpas en Kot, iei momodisou en Kot ieias, o ur o pason en melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 3:16
verses.text: Meid lapalap rir en pai ren Kot: Kot sansaleda ni uduk, ap diarokada me pung amen ren Ngen, ap pwaralang tounlang kan, ap lolok ong men liki kan, ap kamelel lar ren toun sappa, ap peukadalang wasa lingan.<div eID="gen2818" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.3"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 4:1
verses.text: A NGEN me kotin kokop melel, ni imwin kaua akai pan pupe wei sang poson, ap id wuki ong ngen widing o padak en tewil akan,

verses.name: I Timothy 4:2
verses.text: Me kin sansale mau ki liki, ap likilikam o insen arail kakaluakalar ki kisin mata karakar.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:3
verses.text: Re kin inapwiedi kapapaud, o dene ren liki sang song en manga, me Kot kotin wiadang irail, me danke, o poson, o dedekila melel o.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:4
verses.text: Pwe audepa karos, en Kot me mau, o sota meakot me mal, ma aramas pan tungole ap danke.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:5
verses.text: Pwe a pan kasaraui kila masan Kot o kapakap.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:6
verses.text: Ma koe pan padaki ong ri atail akan, koe ap pan papa en Kristus Iesus mau amen, me kin keleki masan en poson o padak mau, me koe dadaureta mau lel met.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:7
verses.text: A koe en kang kasoi likam en li laud akai o kaianeki pein uk me kon ong Kot.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Pwe kaiane kin uk pali war, a sota non katepa, a meid mau paieki Kot ni meakaros, pwe iei kaporopor en maur et o pil maur kokodo.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:9
verses.text: Nan melel kasoi pot et o a war ong kitail en apwaliela.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:10
verses.text: Pwe iet me se kin dodok ong o kalokolokki, at kaporoporeki Kot ieias, me Saunkamaur en aramas akan karos, a mas ong irail me poson.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Mepukat koe en katitiki o kaukaweweki.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:12
verses.text: Sota amen me pan mamaleki om manakap, a wiala men kaalemongi ong saulang kan, ni om lokaia o wiawia kan, o limpok, o poson, o makelekel.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:13
verses.text: O nantiong wadok, o panaui, o padak lao i pan pwar wei.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Der kasamal la pai en mak o, me koe aleer ki deideikop o ni en saunkoa kan ar pwil pa ar po om.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Koe en podidi o sopisokki mepukat, pwe om lolekong en sansal ong karos.

verses.name: I Timothy 4:16
verses.text: Kalaka pein uk o padak o, tengedi ong song pukat, pwe ma koe pan wiada due, koe ap pan dorela pein uk o pil, me kin rong uk.<div eID="gen2819" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.4"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 5:1
verses.text: KOE der lokaia kelail ong ol laud amen, a panaui i due sam amen, a me pulepul due ri om akan,

verses.name: I Timothy 5:2
verses.text: Li laud due in akan, a me pulepul due ri om li akan ni makelekel melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:3
verses.text: Kakaki li odi kan, me li odi melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:4
verses.text: A ma li odi na seri kan mia, de wa en na seri ko, re pan padakki mas apwali pein ar penainai, o depuk ong ar papa o nono, pwe i me mau o kon ong Kot.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:5
verses.text: A iet li odi melel amen, me kelep, me kin kaporoporeki Kot, o podidi ong ngidingid o kapakap akan ni pong o ni ran.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:6
verses.text: A me kin kapwaiada a inong sued nan i melar ni a memaur.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:7
verses.text: Mepukat padapadaki, pwe ren sota karaunepa.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:8
verses.text: A ma amen sota kin apwali na kan, a mas toun im a kan, i me kasela poson, o a sued sang me soposon amen.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:9
verses.text: Li odi men pan kileledi, ma a sota pulepul sang saunpar woneisok o ma a warok en ol ta men.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:10
verses.text: O me kalok mau ki a wiawia mau, o me wiada seri, o me apwali men kairu, o me widen nä en saraui kan, o me kadek ong me kamekame kan, o me kapwaiada song en wiawia mau karos.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:11
verses.text: A der tuki ong li odi pulepul akan, pwe irail lao inong wei sang Kristus, re men pur ong papaud.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:12
verses.text: A irail pan pakadeikada, pwe re muei sanger tapin poson.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:13
verses.text: A re pil ponkake o papang sili im akan, a kaidin ponkaka ta, pwe re pil poupou sili, o pil usa sili en amen a wiawia, o ar lokelokaia me sota mau.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:14
verses.text: A i men, li odi pulepul en papaud, o naitik, o apwali im ar, o der kare ong me sued o, en lalaue.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:15
verses.text: Pwe akai me wuki wei, wuki ong Satan.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:16
verses.text: A ma li odi men mi ren ol me poson amen de ren li me poson amen, a en pein apapwali i o der katoutoui momodisou, pwen itar ong me li odi melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:17
verses.text: Saunkoa kan me kin dodok mau, pan waunla melel, ir me kin sauasa ni padak o kawewe.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:18
verses.text: Pwe kisin likau o masani: Koe der penadi au en kau ol, me tiakedi wan wit. O toun dodok me war ong pwain en dodok.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:19
verses.text: Karaun pan saunkoa men der kamelele, ma so saunkadede riamen de silimen mia.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:20
verses.text: Ir me wia dip, kapung ong mon karos, pwe me tei kan en masakala.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:21
verses.text: I kakaliki ong uk mon Kot Kristus Iesus o tounlang lipilipil akan, koe en wiada mepukat, o so lipilipil, o so pwen konekon ren aramas.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:22
verses.text: Der madang pokadang pon amen pa om, o pil der dipane kila dip en amen kai, a pein koe en makelekel.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:23
verses.text: Koe der nim pil, a wain kis me kon ong kaped om o pweki om somau pan pak toto.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:24
verses.text: Dip en akai aramas me sansal ap mau ong kadeikada ansau wet, a dip en me tei kan pan sansal eu ran.

verses.name: I Timothy 5:25
verses.text: Pil dueta en akai ar wiawia mau me sansal metet, a me tei kan sota kak rirala.<div eID="gen2820" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.5"/>

verses.name: I Timothy 6:1
verses.text: LADU kan karos en wauneki melel ar saumas akan, pwe mar en Kot o lamalam der lalauela.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:2
verses.text: A irail me ar saumas akan kin poson ren der mamale kin ir aki ar saulang, a mak eta ren peiki ong irail, pweki ar lelapok o kompokelar. Mepukat padapadakiki o panauiki.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:3
verses.text: A ma amen kin wia eu padak toror, o a sota pan dadaurata masan mau en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus o lamalam, me kon ong Kot,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:4
verses.text: Nan a aklapalap o sota weweki meakot, a somauki akamai o lokaia sued, me kin kareda peirin, kapei lokaia, lalaue, o karaune mal.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:5
verses.text: O song en akamai en aramas akan, me kin suedela ni lol arail, re liki sang melel, re kiki ong, me pai ren Kot pan kareda kapwa.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:6
verses.text: A pai ren Kot o lolapot, iei me pai kasampwalia.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:7
verses.text: Pwe sota, me kitail wa dong sappa a sansal, me kitail pil sota pan wawei sang meakot.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:8
verses.text: A ma kan atail kisin manga o at likau mia, kitail en insenemauki.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:9
verses.text: A irail, me inong iong kapwapwala, pan lodi ong songesong, o kotauepa kan, o inong sued, o kamatok, me kakirdilang aramas akan, wasan kamekam o sued.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:10
verses.text: Pwe limpok ong moni me tapin song sued karos, me akai inong iong, rap salongala sang poson o kare ong pein irail kamadak toto.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:11
verses.text: A koe aramas en Kot amen, tang wei sang mepukat, a inong iong me pung o pai ren Kot, poson, limpok, kanongama, opampap en Ngen.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:12
verses.text: Wiada pei mau en poson, aneki maur soutuk, me koe pil paeker ong o kadededa kadede mau o mon saunkadede toto.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:13
verses.text: I kakaliki ong uk mon Kot, me kotin kamaureda meakaros o mon Kristus Iesus, me kotin kadededa mon Pontius Pilatus kadede mau o.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:14
verses.text: Koe en kanikid kusoned, o so samin, o so sapung, lao en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus a kotin pwarado,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:15
verses.text: Me Kaun iasanai pan kasansaleda ni a ansau, iei Nanmarki en nanmarki kan o Kaun en kaun akan,

verses.name: I Timothy 6:16
verses.text: Pwe i eta ieias soutuk, me kotikot nan marain, me sota meamen kak ong, me sota aramas kilanger, o so kak kilang, i en waunla manaman soutuk! Amen.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:17
verses.text: Koe en kapung ong me kapwapwaki dipisou en sappa et, me re der aklapalap o pil der kaporoporeki kapwa somelel, a Kot, me kupurai ong kitail sapan meakan karos, pwe kitail en paie kida.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:18
verses.text: Irail en dadaureta ni arail wiawia mau kan, o ren rokekila dok mau kan, o nek pasang, o sapan men sauasa.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:19
verses.text: Wiawia ong pein irail pason mau eu o ki pena ong ansau kokodo pwe irail en konodi maur melel.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:20
verses.text: O Timoteus, pereki pai, me pangalang re om, ni om liki sang poupou mal kai o padak likam en me aklolekong.

verses.name: I Timothy 6:21
verses.text: Me akai lodi ong ap salongala sang poson. Mak o en me re om!<div eID="gen2821" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Tim.6"/> <div eID="gen2815" osisID="1Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS, wanporon en Iesus Kristus pan kupur en Kot, duen inau en maur ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:2
verses.text: Ong Timoteus nai seri kompoke pai: Mak o kapunglol, o popol sang ren Kot Sam, o Kristus Iesus atail Kaun en mi re om.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:3
verses.text: I danke Kot, me i kin papaki insen ai min sang ren sam ai ko mas due i kin poden lamelame uk ni ai kapakap akan ni pong o nin ran.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:4
verses.text: O inong iong kilang uk ni ai tamatamanta duen om sangesang, pwe i en direki peren.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:5
verses.text: O ni ai tamanda poson melel, me mi re om, me mi mas ren in om liakalap Lois o in om Oinike o i asa, me a pil mi lol om.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:6
verses.text: Ari, i me i men kataman kin uk, koe en kamakamaur pai en Kot, me mi lol om ki pwil pa i kat po om,

verses.name: II Timothy 1:7
verses.text: Pwe Kot sota kotiki ong kitail ngen en masak, a en manaman, o limpok o lelapok.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:8
verses.text: Koe ari der namenokki om kadedeki atail Kaun, de ngai sapwilim a salidi men, a koe en iang ia kamekameki rongamau duen manaman en Kot.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:9
verses.text: Me kotin kamaur kitail da o woronge kin kitail worong saraui, kaidin iran atail wiawia kan, a pweki pein a kupur o mak me a kotin kupura ong kitail ren Kristus Iesus mon tapin kaua.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:10
verses.text: A masan wet a sansaleda ni en atail Saunkamaur Iesus Kristus, me kotin kapuiala mana en mela, ap kapwareda maur o so mor pasang ki rongamau.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:11
verses.text: I me i kasapwiladang, pwen saunkair o wanporon, o saunpadak en men liki kan.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:12
verses.text: I me i pil kin kalokolok ki. A i sota kin namenok kila, pwe i asa me i kin kamelele; o i asa, me a kak nekinekid ai pai, me i aleer, lao lei ran o.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:13
verses.text: Dadaurata song en padak en kamaur, me koe rong sang ia er, o poson o limpok ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:14
verses.text: Pai mau o me pwilidier re om, pera ki Ngen saraui, me kotikot lol atail.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:15
verses.text: Koe asa, me irail karos, me mi Asien, wuki sang ia; kisan ir Pikelus o Ermokenes.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:16
verses.text: Kaun o en kotin maki ong toun im en Onesiporus, pwe pan pak toto a kadek ong ia, o a sota namenok ki ai sal mata.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:17
verses.text: Pwe ni a mi Rom, a nantiong rapa kin ia, ap diar ia da.

verses.name: II Timothy 1:18
verses.text: Kaun o en kotin kupura ong i kalangan en Kaun o ni ran kokodo. A koe asa mau, duen a papa nan Episus.<div eID="gen2823" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Tim.1"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 2:1
verses.text: ARI nai seri keleki mak o, me mi ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:2
verses.text: O me koe ronger sang ia impan saunkadede toto, koe en usai ong aramas lelapok kan, me koiok ong padaki me tei kan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:3
verses.text: Koe iang ia kamekam duen saunpei en Kristus Iesus mau amen.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:4
verses.text: Saunpei amen sota kin kadoki pein kan a manga, pwen kon ong me ale i.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:5
verses.text: O ma amen pan weir, a sota pan ale kating, ma a sota weir mau.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:6
verses.text: A saumat amen, me kin sapasap en tungole mas wa kan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:7
verses.text: Madamadaue duen me i inda, pwe Kaun o pan kotin kalolekong kin uk ni meakaros.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:8
verses.text: Tamataman Iesus Kristus, me iasada sang ren me melar akan, kadaudok en Dawid duen ai rongamau,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:9
verses.text: Me i kamekameki o salikidi dueta me sued amen, a masan en Kot me so salidier.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:10
verses.text: Mepukat karos i kin kamekameki me piladar akan, pwe ren pil konodi maur soutuk ren Kristus Iesus iangaki a lingan soutuk

verses.name: II Timothy 2:11
verses.text: Meid melel, ma kitail iang matala, kitail pil pan iang ieiasata;

verses.name: II Timothy 2:12
verses.text: Ma kitail dadaurata, kitail pan iang kaunda; ma kitail ponsasa, a pil pan ponsasa kitail;

verses.name: II Timothy 2:13
verses.text: Ma kitail sota pan dadaurata, a pan kotin melel weita, pwe a so kak kalikame pein i.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:14
verses.text: Kataman kin irail mepukat, kadede ong irail mon Kaun o, ren der akamai ki sip en lokaia kan, me sota pan katepai ong meakot, pwe a pan kasapunge ir ala, me karong akan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:15
verses.text: Nantiong konekonela ren Kot dueta toun dodok amen, me so karepen namenokala mia, me kin padak weita pung masan melel.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:16
verses.text: A koe en kang poupou mal akan, pwe ar sapung pan lapalapala.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:17
verses.text: Arail padak me pan paraparada due kins. Kisan irail Imenäus o Piletus,

verses.name: II Timothy 2:18
verses.text: Me pirok sang melel ni a inda me dene mauredan aramas wiauier, rap kawela poson en akai.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:19
verses.text: A pason en Kot pan duedueta, a iet kilel: Kaun o kotin mangi sapwilim a kan, o: Karos, me asa mar en Kaun o, en muei sang me sapung.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:20
verses.text: Nan im lapalap kaidin dal kold o silper eta me mia, pwe pil dal tuka o dal pwel, akai men kalingan, o akai kaidin men kalingan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:21
verses.text: A ma amen pan muei sang song en aramas due met, a pan rasong dal men kalingan me kasarauiala, o katepa ong Kaun o mau ong song en wiawia mau karos.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:22
verses.text: Tang wei sang inong sued en manakap, ap tang wong pung, o poson o limpok, o popol iangaki karos, me kin kapakapaki ong Kaun o sang nan mongiong ar makelekel;

verses.name: II Timothy 2:23
verses.text: A padak mal o likam kan kang, pwe koe asa, me re pan naitikada akamai.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:24
verses.text: Ladu en Kaun men ender akamai, a en kadek ong karos, o koiok ong padak o kanongama ong me sued akan.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:25
verses.text: O opampap ni a kapung ong me katiwo kan, pwe ele Kot pan kotin sauasa ir, pwe ren wukilang lolekong en melel.

verses.name: II Timothy 2:26
verses.text: O ren pil piti sang ni insar en tewil, me a insara kin ir di ong insen a.<div eID="gen2824" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Tim.2"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 3:1
verses.text: A IET me koe en asa, ni imwi en ran akan ansau apwal pan pwaida.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:2
verses.text: Pwe aramas akan pan kasampwaleki pein irail, o norok moni, o ponmasu, o aklapalap, o lalaue, o sota peiki ong me wia ir adar, o so danke, o me sued.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:3
verses.text: O sempok, o sasa mak, o likinekine, o weit, o so kadek, so pok ong me mau kan,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:4
verses.text: O me kin pangala me saraui, o me katil la, o kala, o inong iong me sued mon Kot.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:5
verses.text: Me sansalki lelapok ap sasa a manaman; muei wei sang mepukat.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:6
verses.text: Pwe akai irail kin wailong ong nan im akan o kaloedi li akai, me toutouki dip, o me inong sued kin kaua ir sili.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:7
verses.text: Me kin sukusukul ansau karos, ap sota lolekong kila melel.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:8
verses.text: A duen Ianes o Iampres palian Moses, iduen mepukat kin palian melel, i song en aramas akan me suedelar ni lol arail, o me sota mau ong poson.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:9
verses.text: A re sota pan pwaida, pwe ar lolepon pan sansal ong karos dueta a wiauier ren irail.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:10
verses.text: A koe ale sang ai padak o ai tiak, o ai lamalam o poson, o dadaurata, o limpok, o kanongama,

verses.name: II Timothy 3:11
verses.text: O kamekam akan, o kalokolok kan, me lel ong ia nan Antiokien, o Ikonien, o Listra; song en kalokolok toto, me lel ong ia. A Kaun o kotin dore ia lar sang ir karos.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:12
verses.text: A karos me men dadaurata duen me kon ong Kot ren Kristus Iesus, pan kamekameki.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:13
verses.text: A aramas sued o malaun akan pan kakairida ni ar sued, irail pan kotaue aramas akan o re pan kotaue irail.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:14
verses.text: A koe dadaurata, me koe padakkier pwe koe asaer, me koe padakki sang er.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:15
verses.text: O koe asa kisin likau saraui kan sang ni om seri, me kak kalolekongi uk ong maur potopot ki poson me mi ren Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:16
verses.text: Pwe masan en kisin likau kan karos tapi sang ren Ngen en Kot, me mau ong padak, o kapung, o kamau, o kainene ong me pung.

verses.name: II Timothy 3:17
verses.text: Pwe aramas en Kot en unsokela o koiok ong wiawia mau karos.<div eID="gen2825" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Tim.3"/>

verses.name: II Timothy 4:1
verses.text: I KAKALIKI ong uk melel mon Kot o Kristus Iesus, me pan kadeikada me maur o me melar akan ni a pan kotido ni a wei,

verses.name: II Timothy 4:2
verses.text: Padaki masan nantiong eta ni ansau mau o ni ansau me sued kasaleda dip, o kapungada, o panaui ni kanongama, o kaukawewe.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:3
verses.text: Pwe eu ansau kokodo re sota pan mauki padak en kamaur, a duen pein arail inong kasapwilada saunpadak kai, me pan wiada padak duen me re mauki.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:4
verses.text: O re pan kawuki sang melel salong arail, ap kawuki ong kasoi mal akan.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:5
verses.text: A koe en masamasan ni meakaros. Peren ki kamekam, kapwaiada wiawia en wanporon amen. Kapwaiada mau om koa.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:6
verses.text: Metet ngai kamekamela o ansau en ai mela leler.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:7
verses.text: I wiadar pei mau eu, i kanikielar ai weir en tang, i dadaurata poson.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:8
verses.text: Ari, nin en me pung nekinek ong ia, me Kaun o pan kotiki ong ia ni ran o, iei saunkapung pung, a kaidin ong ngai ta, pwe ong karos, me anane a pwarado.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:9
verses.text: Kaporisokki uk, pwen madang kodo re i.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:10
verses.text: Pwe Demas me kase ia lar pwe a pok ong sappa et, ap samalanger Tesalonik, Kresens Kalesia, Titus Dalmatien,

verses.name: II Timothy 4:11
verses.text: Lukas eta mi re i, ukada Markus, pwen iang kodo met, pwe a katepa ong ia ni ai dodok.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:12
verses.text: A Tikikus i kadaralang Episus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:13
verses.text: Likau pup, me i pwilikidier Troas ren Karpus, wado ni om pan pwarado, o puk kan o kisin likau kan.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:14
verses.text: Aleksander saunmata wia ong ia me sued toto, Kaun o en kotin depuk ong i duen a wiawia kan!

verses.name: II Timothy 4:15
verses.text: Koe pil kalaka i, pwe a kin nantiong palian at padak.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:16
verses.text: Ni tapin ai pan pakadeikada, sota amen me sauasa, pwe karos tang sang ia, mepukat ender pwaipwai ong irail.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:17
verses.text: A Kaun o kotin ieiang ia o kamana ia da, pwe i en kak kanikiela ai padapadak o men liki kan karos en rong. I dorelar sang au en laien.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:18
verses.text: A Kaun o pan kotin kapit ia la sang ni wiawia sued karos, o kotin kalua wong ia wein nanlang, i en lingan kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:19
verses.text: Ranamau, wong Priska o Akwila o toun im en Onesiporus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:20
verses.text: Erastus mondi Korint, a Tropimus somaudar, i ap pwilikidi Miletus.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:21
verses.text: Kaporisokki uk, pwen kodo mon ansaun kapau. En Eupulus a ranamau wong uk, o pil en Pudens, o Linus, o Klaudia, o ri atail karos.

verses.name: II Timothy 4:22
verses.text: Kaun o en kotikot ni ngen om! Mak en mi re omail!<div eID="gen2826" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Tim.4"/> <div eID="gen2822" osisID="2Tim" type="book"/>

verses.name: Titus 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS ladun Kot o wanporon en Iesus Kristus amen, duen poson en me pilipildar en Kot akan o duen erpit en melel ong pai ren Kot;

verses.name: Titus 1:2
verses.text: O kaporoporeki maur soutuk, me Kot so likam inaukidar mon tapin kaua.

verses.name: Titus 1:3
verses.text: A ni a ansau a kotin kasansaledar a masan ki padak, me ko ong ia, duen kusoned en Kot atail Saunkamaur.

verses.name: Titus 1:4
verses.text: Ong Titus nai seri melel ni ata poson ta ieu: Mak o popol sang ren Kot Sam o Kristus Iesus atail Saunkamaur en mi re om!

verses.name: Titus 1:5
verses.text: Iet karepen ai kamodang uk edi Kreta, pwe koe en kapwaiada, me kaikenta wiauier o kasapwilada saunkoa kan ni kanim karos, due i kakaliki ong uk.

verses.name: Titus 1:6
verses.text: Saunkoa amen en indand mau, o warok en li ta men, o me na seri kan posonla, o so kaindandeki, me re kamom de sopeik.

verses.name: Titus 1:7
verses.text: Pwe pisop en pungla, duen saunkoa en Kot amen, der katiwo, der purianikom, der kamom wain, der pamara, der norok moni.

verses.name: Titus 1:8
verses.text: A ren apwali men kairu o pok ong me mau, o kanongama, o pung, o saraui, o makelekel.

verses.name: Titus 1:9
verses.text: Kolekoleta masan, me udan pung o koiok ong padak, pwen kak ong panauiki padak en kamaur o kapung ong me katiwo kan.

verses.name: Titus 1:10
verses.text: Pwe ir me toto me malaun o kapei lokaia o me kaweid sapung, iet eten, kisan men sirkomsais.

verses.name: Titus 1:11
verses.text: Me mau ong au ar en pinapinla, pwe re kin kawukila toun im toto, o me kin padapadaki, me sota mau, pweki moni.

verses.name: Titus 1:12
verses.text: Amen irail, pein arail saukop amen inda: Men Kreta me kalap likam, man sued o laualo, nain manga.

verses.name: Titus 1:13
verses.text: Kadede pot et me melel. Ari, i me koe en kapung kelail ong irail, pwe ren kelailada ni poson.

verses.name: Titus 1:14
verses.text: O ren der insenoki en Sus oko ar kasoi mal akan o kusoned en aramas akan, me muei sang melel.

verses.name: Titus 1:15
verses.text: Karos me kon ong makelekel akan, a sota me kon ong me samin o so poson akan, pwe arail lamelame o pil insen arail me samin.

verses.name: Titus 1:16
verses.text: Re kin inda, me re asa Kot, a ni ar wiawia kan re kin ponsasa i. Irail meid sued, o sopeik, o so koiok ong song en wiawia mau karos.<div eID="gen2828" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Titus.1"/>

verses.name: Titus 2:1
verses.text: A KOE en padapadakeki duen me kon ong lamalam en kamaur.

verses.name: Titus 2:2
verses.text: Padaki ong ol ma kan, ren der wukiwuk sili, a ren indand mau o ngenin, o kelail ni poson, o ni limpok, o ni kanongama.

verses.name: Titus 2:3
verses.text: Pil dueta li ma kan, ren wiawia duen me kon ong saraui kan, ren der likinekine der lidun wain, a ren saunpadak en me mau,

verses.name: Titus 2:4
verses.text: Pwe ren panaui li pulepul akan, en apapwali ar paud o pok ong nair seri kan.

verses.name: Titus 2:5
verses.text: Ren lelapok, min, apwali nan im ar akan, kadek, peiki ong ar warok kan, pwe masan en Kot ender lalauela.

verses.name: Titus 2:6
verses.text: Pil dueta manakap akan, panaui ir, ren lelapok.

verses.name: Titus 2:7
verses.text: Ni wiawia mau kan karos koe kasaleda pein uk kaalemongi mau amen, ni om padak melel o lelapok.

verses.name: Titus 2:8
verses.text: Kida padak en kamaur o namenokala, pwe me palian kitail en namenokala, o sota diar me sued kot men karaune kitail.

verses.name: Titus 2:9
verses.text: Padaki ong ladu kan, me ren peiki ong ar saumas ni meakaros ren kaperen ir ada, o ren der katiwo.

verses.name: Titus 2:10
verses.text: Ren der pirap, a irail en mau o melel ong irail, pwe ren kalinganada lamalam en Kot atail Saunkamaur ni meakaros.

verses.name: Titus 2:11
verses.text: Pwe mak en Kot pwarado kamaureda aramas akan karos.

verses.name: Titus 2:12
verses.text: O padapadaki ong kitail, me kitail en muei sang meakan me doo sang Kot o inong sued en sappa, ap lelapok, o pung, o dadaureta me kon ong ni sappa et.

verses.name: Titus 2:13
verses.text: O auiauiki kapor mau, o sansal lingan en atail Kot lapalap o atail Saunkamaur Kristus Iesus.

verses.name: Titus 2:14
verses.text: Me sokonpaudeki pein i ki kitail, pwen dore sang kitail sapung karos, o kamakelekel ong pein i aramas, me a pan sapwilim aneki, me kin nantiong wiawia mau karos.

verses.name: Titus 2:15
verses.text: Mepukat padake kida, o panauiki, o kapung kelail ong; sota amen me pan mamale kin uk.<div eID="gen2829" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Titus.2"/>

verses.name: Titus 3:1
verses.text: KATAMAN kin irail ren peiki ong monsap o me manaman akan, o ren apwali wiawia mau karos.

verses.name: Titus 3:2
verses.text: Der lalaue amen, der akamai, a en kamantik, o opampap ong aramas akan karos.

verses.name: Titus 3:3
verses.text: Pwe kitail pil pweipwei mas o, o sopeik, o salongala, o papa song en inong o madong sued akan, kokoa me sued, o peirin, pakailok, o kailongki amen amen.

verses.name: Titus 3:4
verses.text: A kalangan o limpok en Kot atail Saundor lao pwarado,

verses.name: Titus 3:5
verses.text: A kotin dore kitail la kaidin pweki pein atail wiawia pung, a pein a kupur ki paptais en kaipwi kap o kawilia kap ren Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Titus 3:6
verses.text: Me a kotin kupura dong kitail kaualap ren Iesus Kristus atail Saundor.

verses.name: Titus 3:7
verses.text: Pwe kitail en pung kila a mak, pwen sosoki maur soutuk duen at kaporopor.

verses.name: Titus 3:8
verses.text: Melel padak pot et o i men, koe en nantiong kaweweda, pwe irail, me posonla Kot, en kadoke kin ir wiawia mau, mepukat me mau o kon ong aramas akan.

verses.name: Titus 3:9
verses.text: A liki sang peidok mal akan, o padok en tiak kan, o akamai, o akamai ki kapung, pwe mepukat sota kadepa o me mal.

verses.name: Titus 3:10
verses.text: Aramas likin panau amen, panaui pan mepak de riapak ap muei sang i.

verses.name: Titus 3:11
verses.text: Pwe koe asa, me i me sapung o kin wia dip, a kadeikada pein i.

verses.name: Titus 3:12
verses.text: I lao kadar wong uk Artemas de Tikikus, koe madang dong ia, Nikopolis, pwe i kileledier me i pan kauson wasa o ni ansaun kapau.

verses.name: Titus 3:13
verses.text: Saunkawewe Senas o Apolos kadara dong ia madang. Sauasa ira, pwe ira de anane meakot.

verses.name: Titus 3:14
verses.text: O naitail akan en porisok o koiokki ong wiawia mau, pwe ren der so wa ’rail.

verses.name: Titus 3:15
verses.text: Karos, me mi re i, kin ranamau wong uk. Ranamau wong karos, me kin pok ong kit ni poson. Mak o en mi re omail karos!<div eID="gen2830" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Titus.3"/> <div eID="gen2827" osisID="Titus" type="book"/>

verses.name: Philemon 1:1
verses.text: PAULUS salidi en Kristus Iesus amen, o ri atail Timoteus ong Pilemon kompoke pat o at warok ni dodok kan.

verses.name: Philemon 1:2
verses.text: O ri atail li Apia, o sauas pat Arkipus, o momodisou, me mi nan tanpas omui;

verses.name: Philemon 1:3
verses.text: Mak o popol sang ren Kot sam atail o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi re omui!

verses.name: Philemon 1:4
verses.text: I kin danke ai Kot ni ai kapakap kin komui ansau karos.

verses.name: Philemon 1:5
verses.text: Pwe i ronger duen omui limpok o poson ong Kaun Iesus o ong saraui kan karos.

verses.name: Philemon 1:6
verses.text: Pwe poson o me mi re ’tail en kakairida re omui, ni omui dedeki duen me mau kan karos, me mi reatail sang ren Kristus.

verses.name: Philemon 1:7
verses.text: Kit peren kidar o kamait kilar omui limpok, pwe mongiong en saraui kan en kelail kilar komui, ri ai.

verses.name: Philemon 1:8
verses.text: I me i aimaki ren Kristus kusoned eki ong komui duen me pan wiaui.

verses.name: Philemon 1:9
verses.text: Ari so, pweki ai limpok ong komui i men poeki ta re omui, pwe ngai Paulus likailapalar o salidi en Kristus amen.

verses.name: Philemon 1:10
verses.text: I poeki re omui nai seri Onesimus, me i wiadar ni ai salidi,

verses.name: Philemon 1:11
verses.text: Me so katepa ong komui mas o, a met a katepa ong komui o ngai.

verses.name: Philemon 1:12
verses.text: I me i kapure ong komui, komui ari apwali i, dueta pein mongiong i.

verses.name: Philemon 1:13
verses.text: Pwe i mauki a en mimieta re i, pwen papa ia ni ai saliekidi rongamau, wiliandi komui,

verses.name: Philemon 1:14
verses.text: A i sota men wia meakot, me sota pwili sang kupur omui, pwe omui wia mau ender mansairen a somansairen.

verses.name: Philemon 1:15
verses.text: Ele a tang sang re omui ansau kis, pwe komui en pur ong naineki i kokolata.

verses.name: Philemon 1:16
verses.text: Kaidin due ladu amen, a mau sang ladu amen, pwe due ri omui kompok amen; iduen re i, a re omui pan laud sang ni pali uduk a o ni pali en Kaun.

verses.name: Philemon 1:17
verses.text: Ma komui akawarok kin ia, apwali i dueta pein ngai.

verses.name: Philemon 1:18
verses.text: A ma a wia sapung ong komui er, de pwaipwand ong komui, i pan kapungala.

verses.name: Philemon 1:19
verses.text: Met ngai Paulus intingkier pein pa i, i pan pwain, ari so, i so pan inda, me komui pwaipwand ki ong ia pein komui.

verses.name: Philemon 1:20
verses.text: Ei ri ai, i men paiekin komui ren Kaun o, kainsenemauda mongiong i ren Kristus.

verses.name: Philemon 1:21
verses.text: I kaporoporeki om peik, ap inting wong komui. A i asa, me komui pan wia laud sang, me inda.

verses.name: Philemon 1:22
verses.text: I men, komui en kaonopada deu i, pwe i kaporoporeki, me i pan lapwadang komail ki omail kapakap.

verses.name: Philemon 1:23
verses.text: En Epapras, ai warok ni ai salidi pan Kristus Iesus, a ranamau wong komui.

verses.name: Philemon 1:24
verses.text: O Markus, o Aristarkus, o Demas, o Lukas ai warok en dodok kan.

verses.name: Philemon 1:25
verses.text: Mak en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus kin iang ngen omail! Amen.<div eID="gen2832" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Phlm.1"/> <div eID="gen2831" osisID="Phlm" type="book"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 1:1
verses.text: MURIN masan toto, me Kot kotin kadedeki saukop akan ni tapin kaua ong sam atail akan,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:2
verses.text: A ni imwin kaua o ran pukat, a kotin masan kidong kitail Na, me a kotin kasapwilada, pwen sosoki meakan karos, o me a kotin wia kida wei pokon,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:3
verses.text: Me kisan a lingan o wewe mau ong mom a, o kotin kaun kida meakaros a masan manaman, a lao kotin kamakelekele ki sang dip atail ki pein i, ap kaipokedi ni pali maun en Kaun lapalap poa.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:4
verses.text: I me a lapalapalar kaulap sang tounlang kan, pwe a aleer mar eu, me lap sang mar arail.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:5
verses.text: Pwe is ren tounlang kan, me a kotin masani ong: Koe nai Ol, ran wet I kaipwi ukadar? O pil eu: I pan wiala Sam a, o a pan wiala nai Ol?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:6
verses.text: O pil eu: A lao pan pil kare dong sappa Meseni o, a kotin masani: Tounlang en Kot karos pan pongi i.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:7
verses.text: A duen tounlang kan a kotin masani: A wiaki sapwilim a tounlang kan man en kadar o a papa kan umpul en kisiniai.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:8
verses.text: A duen Sapwilim a a kotin masani: Mol omui, Maing Kot, pan potopot eta. O sokon en pung, iei sokon en wei omui.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:9
verses.text: Komui pok onger me pung, ap kailongki tiak sapung; iei me omui Kot keie kin komui Maing Kot, potik kaperen, pwen lapa sang nanmarki kan karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:10
verses.text: O pil eu: Komui Maing pasonedier sappa nin tapi o, o lang akan wiawia en lim omui kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:11
verses.text: Irail pan momela, a komui pan kotikot eta, o irail karos pan maringalar dueta likau eu,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:12
verses.text: Komui pan kotin wilitik ir pena dueta likau eu, o irail pan wukila, dueta likau eu; a komui pan duedueta o omui par akan sota pan rosela.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:13
verses.text: A is ren tounlang kan, me a kotin masani ong: Mondi ong ni pali maun i, I lao kaloedi om imwintiti kan pan nä om?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:14
verses.text: Kaidin irail karos ngen en men papa me kin pakadarala pwen papa irail, me pan sosoki maur soutuk?<div eID="gen2834" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.1"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 2:1
verses.text: I ME kitail en nantiong madamadaua, duen me kitail rongadar, pwe kitail ender so konoti.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:2
verses.text: Pwe ma masan o, me pousa sang ren tounlang kan, me inen o kaopa karos o katiwo karos kalokoloker duen kapung o,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:3
verses.text: Iaduen atail pan kak pitila, ma kitail mamaleki kamaurpa lapalap wet, me tapida ni a kalok sang ren Kaun o ap pil sang ren me rongorong i kan!

verses.name: Hebrews 2:4
verses.text: A pil Kot, me kotin kadedeki ni kilel akan, o manaman akan, o song en wiawia kelail akan, o kisakis en Ngen saraui, duen pein kupur a.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:5
verses.text: Pwe a sota kotiki ong tounlang kan, en koaki sappa kokodo, duen me se indinda.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:6
verses.text: A amen me kadede o inda ekis wasa: Dakot aramas o, pwe komui kin kotin kupura i, de nain aramas amen, pwe komui kotin apwali i?

verses.name: Hebrews 2:7
verses.text: Komui kotin kasapwilidi i ansau kis pan tounlang kan, ap kotin nine kin i lingan o wau.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:8
verses.text: Kom kotin kaloedier karos pan aluwilu a kan. A ni a kotin kaloedi ong i meakaros, solar, me sota lodi ong i. A met kitail saikenta kilang, me karos lodi ong i.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:9
