verses.text: A kitail kilang Iesus, me kasapwilidi ansau kis pan tounlang kan, pweki a kalokolok ong kamatala, ap nine kida lingan o wau, pwen mata kila amen amen duen mak en Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:10
verses.text: Pwe me mau ong i, me dipisou kan karos wiaui onger o wiaui kidar, ni a kotin kalua wong lingan seri toto, en kaunsokala Tapin maur arail ki kamekam,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:11
verses.text: Pwe i, me kin kasaraui, o irail, me pan kasarauila, karos tapi sang me ta men, i me a sota kotin namenokki riane kin irail,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:12
verses.text: Duen a kotin masani: I pan padaki ong ri ai kan mar omui, o nan pung en momodisou i pan kaul kaping ong komui.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:13
verses.text: O pil eu: I pan liki i. O pil eu: Masani, iet ngai o seri kan, me Kot kotiki ong ia er.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:14
verses.text: A duen seri kan, me kisan pali nta o uduk, i me a pil kotin ale ong pein i mepukat, pwe ni a matala i en kaloedi i, me kaun en mela, iei tewil o,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:15
verses.text: O kotin lapwada irail karos, me lodi ong masak mela, ap lidulidu arain arail maur.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:16
verses.text: Pwe kaidin tounlang kan, me a kotin apapwali, pwe a kotin apapwali kadaudok en Apraam.

verses.name: Hebrews 2:17
verses.text: I me a kotin udan duela ri a kan ni meakaros, pwen kalangan o wiala samero lapalap melel amen, mon Kot, pwen tomki dip en aramas akan,

verses.name: Hebrews 2:18
verses.text: Pwe duen pein i kanaudokalar o songesong, a kotin mangi duen sauasa irail, me songesonger.<div eID="gen2835" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.2"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 3:1
verses.text: I ME, ri ai saraui kan, komail me pwaisanekier en lang a eker, komail madamadaua duen wanporon o samero lapalap en atail lamalam: Iesus.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:2
verses.text: Me melel ong i me kasapwilada i, dueta Moses me melel wasa karos nan tanpas en Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:3
verses.text: Pwe lingan en Ol men et me lapa sang lingan en Moses, dueta aramas amen, me wiadar im eu, me kaka sang im o.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:4
verses.text: Pwe im karos wiauieda ren aramas amen, a me wiadar meakan karos, iei Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:5
verses.text: A Moses me melel ni a koaki tanpas en Kot, dueta papa amen, pwen saunkadede en meakan me pan lokido.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:6
verses.text: A Kristus me udan Na, ap melel nan pein tanpas a. A tanpas a iei kitail, ma kitail kolekoleta poson o peren en kaporopor lao lel imwi.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:7
verses.text: I me Ngen saraui kotin masani: Ran wet, ma komail pan rong kapitie,

verses.name: Hebrews 3:8
verses.text: Komail der kapitakaila mongiong omail, due ni ansau en kaongiong ni ran en songesong nan sap tan.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:9
verses.text: Wasa me sam omail akan kakaudud o kasosong ia o irail kilanger ai wiawia kan saunpar paeisok.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:10
verses.text: Iei me I makaraki pan ti o, ap inda: Mongiong arail kin poden sapungla. A irail solelapokki ai al akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:11
verses.text: Iei me I kaukila ni ai makar: Irail sota pan konodi ai moleilei.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:12
verses.text: Kalaka ri ai kan, pwe mongiong en amen de suedela, ap so poson o muei wei sang Kot ieias.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:13
verses.text: A komail panau pena ran karos arain omail kak inda: Ran wet; pwe amen de kapitakai kila widing en dip.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:14
verses.text: Pwe kitail wialar kisan Kristus, ma kitail kolekoleta tapin atail liki lao imwisokela.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:15
verses.text: Duen a lokido: Ran wet, ma komail pan rong kapitie, komail de kapitakaila mongiong omail, due ni ansau en kaongiong.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:16
verses.text: A is irail, me kaudud ong i ni ar rongadar? Kaidin irail karos, me ko wei sang Äkipten ren Moses?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:17
verses.text: A is irail, me a kotin ongiong kidar par paeisok? Kaidin irail, me wiadar dip, me war arail pupedi nan sap tan?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:18
verses.text: A is irail, me a kotin kaukila, me re sota pan konodi a moleilei? Kaidin irail eta, me sota peiki ong i.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:19
verses.text: Ari, kitail diarada, me re sota kak, konodi, aki ar so poson.<div eID="gen2836" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.3"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:1
verses.text: KITAIL ari kanakanaiong pein kitail, pwe inau pan pedelong ong nan a moleilei mimieta, pwe amen re omail ender diarokada duen amen, me sota konodier.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:2
verses.text: Pwe rongamau pil lolok dong kitail er dueta ong irail; a arail rong masan o sota kadepa ong irail, aki a sota doleki poson ren me rongadar akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:3
verses.text: A kitail me posonlar, pan pedelong ong nan moleilei o, duen a kotin masanier: I kaular ni ai makar: Re sota pan pedelong ong nan ai moleilei. Ari so, wiawia kan unsokalar ni a kotin kapikadar sappa,

verses.name: Hebrews 4:4
verses.text: Pwe ekis wasa a kotin masanier duen ran kaisu: Kot kotin moleilei sang a wiawia kan karos ni ran kaisu.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:5
verses.text: O wasa et a pil kotin masani: Irail sota pan pedelong ong nan ai moleilei.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:6
verses.text: Ari, a kak ren akai en pedelong ong nan moleilei o; a irail, me aleer rongamau mas o, sota pedelong ong, pweki ar sopeik.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:7
verses.text: Kot ap pil kotin kileledier ran eu: Ran wet! Ni a kotin masanier ren Dawid murin ansau warai, duen a masan moa: Ran wet, ma komail pan rong kapitie, komail der kapitakaila mongiong omail.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:8
verses.text: Pwe ma Iosua kamoleilei ir ala, a sota pan kotin katitiki duen eu ran.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:9
verses.text: Ari kamol en sapat pan sapwilim en Kot akan mia.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:10
verses.text: Pwe i, me pedelong ong nan a moleilei, a pein pil moleileila sang a wiawia kan, dueta Kot sang sapwilim a kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:11
verses.text: Kitail ari kaporisoki pein kitail, en pedelong ong nan moleilei o, pwe amen ender lodi ong song en sopeik ota.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:12
verses.text: Pwe masan en Kot me maur, o manaman, o kong sang kodlas au riau, o kin til wong, lao a kasare pasang maur o ngen, pil kokon akan o kanang en ti o; o kadeikada lamelam o inong en mongiong o,

verses.name: Hebrews 4:13
verses.text: O sota man me maur kot me rir sang i, pwe meakaros me sansal o kadiarokada mon silang i. Kitail en kapungala pein kitail re a.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:14
verses.text: Ari, pweki atail samero lapalap kasampwal Iesus, Sapwilim en Kot, me kotidala nanlang, kitail en dadaurata lamalam.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:15
verses.text: Pwe atail samero lapalap kaidin i amen, me sota kin kotin pam atail luet akan. A i amen me songesong ni song karos dueta kitail ap sota dip a.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:16
verses.text: Iei me kitail en aima ko dong mol en mak, pwe kitail en tungole kalangan o mak, pwen sauas patail ni ansau me mau ong.<div eID="gen2837" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.4"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 5:1
verses.text: PWE samero lapalap karos, me pilipildar sang ren aramas akan, pan kasapwilada, pwen sauasa aramas akan ren Kot, pwen wiada kisakis o mairong pweki dip;

verses.name: Hebrews 5:2
verses.text: Me kak pamada duen me sapung o salongala kan, pwe i pil me lued.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:3
verses.text: I me a udan kida mairong pein dip a, dueta a kin tomeki dip en aramas akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:4
verses.text: O sota amen, me kin kasapwilada pein i, pwe a pan kasapwilada sang ren Kot dueta Aron.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:5
verses.text: Pil dueta Kristus, me sota kalinganada pein i, pwen wiala samero lapalap, a i me wiadar me masani ong i: Koe nai Ol, ran wet I kaipwi uk adar.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:6
verses.text: Duen a pil kotin masani ekis wasa: Koe samero duen al en Melkisedek kokolata.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:7
verses.text: O ni ran akan, me a kotikot ni pali uduk, a kotin mairongki laolao, o ngidingid, o kaukauwet, o tontonir ong i, me pan kak dorela i sang a pan matala, o pweki a wauneki Kot, a laolao pil pwaidar.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:8
verses.text: I me Sapwilim a, ari so, a kotin padakki peik ni a kalokolok.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:9
verses.text: O ni a unsokalar a kotin wialar kamaur pan maur soutuk ong irail karos, me kin oke i.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:10
verses.text: O Kot pil kotin kamare kin i samero lapalap duen al en Melkisedek.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:11
verses.text: Iran mepukat kasoi toto mi re at, a me apwal en kaweweda, aki omail sota dedeki.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:12
verses.text: Nan a daulier ansau, me komail en wiala saunpadak, ari so, komail me pil mau ong, amen en kawewe ong komail tapin lamalam en masan en Kot, wialar song dueta irail, me kin tungole pil en didi, a kaidin kisin manga.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:13
verses.text: Pwe amen amen me kin tungole pil en didi, me man salongpon ni masan en pung, pwe a rasong seri pwelel.

verses.name: Hebrews 5:14
verses.text: A me unsokalar akan me mau ong kisin manga, pwe irail me anlar lamalam pweki ar laudelar, ap asa duen me mau o me sued.<div eID="gen2838" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.5"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 6:1
verses.text: I me kitail pan muei sang tapin padak en Kristus, ap kakairida o unsokela, a kaidin pur ong wia pason ni at kalukila wiawia en mela kan, de poson Kot,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:2
verses.text: De padak duen paptais, o pokada pa kan poa, o duen en me melar akan ar pan maureda, o duen kadeik soutuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:3
verses.text: A i me kitail pan wiada, ma Kot pan kotin mueid ong.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:4
verses.text: Pwe a so kak pa ’rail, me marainlar, o me wewekier kisakis sang lang, o audaudkier Ngen saraui,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:5
verses.text: O lolekong kilar masan en Kot mau, o manaman en muei mau kokodo,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:6
verses.text: Ma irail pan pup wei sang, re solar pan kak pur ong kalula, pwe irail pein kalopuela Sapwilim en Kot o kanamenokalar i.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:7
verses.text: Pwe sap me lamelamur ki katau, me kin purepure moredi ong, o me kawosadang irail, me kin wia sapasap kapwa mau, iei sap o me kin ale pai ren Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:8
verses.text: A ma a kin kawosada tuka teketek o dip, iei me sued o mau ong kariala o ni imwi a pan karongala.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:9
verses.text: A kompoke pat akan, se asa, me komail sota kin duota ni meakan me kareda maur, ari so, iduen at kin padapadak.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:10
verses.text: Pwe Kot sota sapung, o a sota kak maliela omail wiawia kan o omail dodok limpok, me komail kasansale ong mar a ni omail papaer me saraui kan, o ni omail kin papa.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:11
verses.text: A kit kin inong iong, amen amen komail en nantiong duedueta kasansaleda kaporo por melel lao lel imwi.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:12
verses.text: Pwe komail der tangangala, a komail alale sang irail, me poson o kanongama ap sosoki inau kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:13
verses.text: Pwe ni en Kot a kotin inauki ong Apraam, a kotin kaukila pein i, pwe sota me lap sang en kau kila,

verses.name: Hebrews 6:14
verses.text: Masani: Melel I pan kapai uk ala o kangeder uk ala.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:15
verses.text: I ari auiauieta ni kanongama ap pwaida inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:16
verses.text: Pwe aramas akan kin kaukila me lapa sang ir, o kaula kin kaimwisokala akamai karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:17
verses.text: I me Kot pil kotin kaukila, pwen kasale ong irail, me pan sosoki pai en a inau o, me a inau sota kak wukila.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:18
verses.text: Pwe song riau me so kak wuk, pwe Kot sota kak likam, en kamait kit ala melel, pwe kitail en tang wong kaporopor, me mi mo atail.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:19
verses.text: Kaporopor wet me rasong paipong en ngen atail, me melel o teng, me kak lel wong nan pera saraui.

verses.name: Hebrews 6:20
verses.text: Iei wasa atail saunkair kotila ia pweki kitail, Iesus, me wiala samero lapalap ni al en Melkisedek kokolata.<div eID="gen2839" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.6"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 7:1
verses.text: IEI Melkisedek nanmarki en Salem o samero en Kot lapalap amen, me kotilan tu ong Apraam, ni a pure do sang a kaloedi nanmarki kai, ap kapaida i;

verses.name: Hebrews 7:2
verses.text: Me Apraam pil kotiki ong eisok kis eu sang ni a dipisou karos. Iet wewe kaieu en mar a: Nanmarki en pung; ap pil: Nanmarki en Salem, iet wewe: Nanmarki en popol;

verses.name: Hebrews 7:3
verses.text: Me sota sam a, sota in a, sota a kainok, sota tapin a ran akan, pil sota imwin maur. A a ras ong Sapwilim en Kot, o a pan samero kokolata.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:4
verses.text: Komail kilang ol lapalap men et, me sam atail Apraam kotiki ong eisok kis eu en a dipisou, me lodier.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:5
verses.text: Melel eta kadaudok en Lewi, me kasapwiladang dodok en samero, arail kusoned mia, me ren ale sang ren aramas akan, iei ri arail akan, eisok kis eu, duen kapung, a ir pil kisan kadaudok en Apraam.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:6
verses.text: A i, me sota kisan irail, ale eisok kis eu sang ren Apraam o kapaiada i, me aleer inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:7
verses.text: Nan melel kaualap me tikitik o kin paida sang ren me lapalap.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:8
verses.text: Ari met, aramas akan me udan mela, kin ale eisok kis eu, a mo amen, me kadedepa mia, duen a ieiasata.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:9
verses.text: Ari melel, pil kadaudok en Lewi me kin ale eisok kis eu, kida eisok kis eu ong (Melkisedek) ki Apraam.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:10
verses.text: Pwe a mimieta nan longelong en sam a, ni ansau Melkisedek kotilan tu ong i.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:11
verses.text: Ari, ma dodok en samero Lewi unsokela — pwe i ansau irail aleer kapung o — da katepan amen samero en pwarado ni al en Melkisedek, a kaidin ni al en Aron?

verses.name: Hebrews 7:12
verses.text: Pwe ma dodok en samero wukila, nan kapung pan pil wukila.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:13
verses.text: A i, me se indinda, i kisan eu kainok, a sota amen sang nan kadaudok wet apwalier pei saraui.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:14
verses.text: Pwe meid sansal, me Kaun patail tapi sang Iuda. Ari, iran sau wet Moses sota katitiki meakot duen samero.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:15
verses.text: Mepukat sansal melel, ma amen samero pan kotido ni al en Melkisedek,

verses.name: Hebrews 7:16
verses.text: Me sota kasapwiladar pan tiak en kusoned uduken, pwe pan manaman en maur soutuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:17
verses.text: Pwe iet kadedepa: Komui samero soutuk amen duen al en Melkisedek.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:18
verses.text: Pwe i me kusoned en mas nikier, pwe me luet o sota katepa,

verses.name: Hebrews 7:19
verses.text: Pwe kapung sota kak kaunsokala meakot, a kaporopor me mau sang men mas, pan id pwarado, me kitail kak tuki ong Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:20
verses.text: O iet pil eu kasampwal: Pwe a kasapwil kida kaula — a irail wiala samero ni sota kaula.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:21
verses.text: A men et sapwilikida kaula ren i, me kotin masani ong i: Kaun o kaular, a ap sota pan kalu kila: Komui samero soutuk amen duen al en Melkisedek.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:22
verses.text: Iei me Iesus pil wiala kapung pan inau, me mau sang men mas.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:23
verses.text: A irail me toto, me wialar samero, pweki ar matalar, kareda, me irail sota kak mimieta.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:24
verses.text: A i me potopoteta, pwe a kotin aleer dodok en samero soutuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:25
verses.text: Ari, i me a kotin kak kamaureda melel ir karos, me kai ki ong Kot i, pwe a kotin ieiasata, pwen laolao kin ir.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:26
verses.text: Pwe iduen samero lapalap me mau ong kitail, me saraui, o so sapung, o so samin, o me liki sang me dipan akan, o ileila sang nanlang.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:27
verses.text: Me sota rasong samero lapalap akan, me kin kida mas mairong pweki pein dip arail ap pweki en aramas akan ni ran karos. Pwe i me a kotin wiadar pan pak ta ieu, ni a kotin mueid ong Kot pein i.

verses.name: Hebrews 7:28
verses.text: Pwe kapung kin kasapwiladang samero aramas luet akan, a masan en kaula, me wiauier murin kapung, kasapwiladar Sapwilim a, me unsokalar soutuk.<div eID="gen2840" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.7"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 8:1
verses.text: A iet orlepan me se indinda: Atail samero lapalap, me kotikot ni pali maun en mol en Kaun lapalap nanlang.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:2
verses.text: Iei papa en pera saraui o im likau melel, me Kaun kotin kauada, kaidin aramas amen;

verses.name: Hebrews 8:3
verses.text: Pwe samero lapalap karos pan kasapwilada, en kida kisakis o mairong kan. I me udan pung men et en pil kida meakot, me a pan kotin mairongki.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:4
verses.text: Ma a kotikot sappa, a sota pan kak samero, pwe samero kan mia, me kin kidang kisakis duen kapung o,

verses.name: Hebrews 8:5
verses.text: Me kin alale sang meakai mi lang, duen Moses, me Kot kotin kalolekongla, ni a pan kauada im likau. Pwe a kotin masani ong i: Kanai ong, o wiada meakaros, duen me kasansale ong uk er nin nana!

verses.name: Hebrews 8:6
verses.text: A i me aleer papa eu, me mau sang arail, pwe i kapwai pan inau, me mau sang men mas, pwe a tapi sang masan en inau, me mau sang men mas o.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:7
verses.text: Pwe ma inau en mas o unsokalar, sota me pan rapaki wasa en eu inau.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:8
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kupur sued kin irail masani: Kilang, ni ran oko, me pan kodo, I pan ki ong men Israel o kainok en Iuda inau kap eu; iei me Kaun o kotin masani.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:9
verses.text: Kaidin dueta inau o, me I ki ong sam ar akan, ni ran o, me I koledi pa arail, pwen kalua irail do sang nan sap en Äkipten, pwe re sota podidi ong ai inau; ari, I ap sota inseno kin irail, me Kaun o kotin masani.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:10
verses.text: A iet inau o, me I pan wiai ong men Israel murin ran oko, me Kaun o kotin masani: I pan audeki ngen arail ai kapung, o intingiedi nan mongiong arail, I pan wiala arail Kot, o re pan wiala nai aramas.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:11
verses.text: Sota amen me pan padaki ong men imp a, o ri a indinda: Lelapokki Kaun! Pwe amen amen pan lelapok kin ia sang ren me tikitik o lel ong me lapalap re ’rail.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:12
verses.text: Pwe I pan makeki ong ir ar sapung kan, o dip arail I solar pan tamanda.

verses.name: Hebrews 8:13
verses.text: Ni a kotin masani: Inau kap, a kotin kamaringala men mas o. A me maringalar o malar, me mau ong lokidokila.<div eID="gen2841" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.8"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 9:1
verses.text: A inau kaieu pil a kusoned en wia saraui mia, o pera saraui me sansal.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:2
verses.text: Pwe im likau eu wiauier, a ni pali liki lamp mia, o tepel, o prot en kasansal; iei wasa, me adaneki wasa saraui;

verses.name: Hebrews 9:3
verses.text: A palila sang pera, ilolong, i wasa me adaneki wasa saraui melel.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:4
verses.text: Iei wasan pei saraui kold en kisiniai o kopa en inau, me kitimeki pena kold wasa karos, a dal kold iangaki mana, o en Aron a sokon, me masel pasang, o slet en inau.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:5
verses.text: A ponangin kopa o Kerupin en lingan mia, me kompwaledi wasan tom. A ansau wet i sota pan padaki ong komail due.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:6
verses.text: A mepukat karos lao onoper, samero kan kin pedelong ong nan im likau moa kapwaiada dodok ong Kot ansau karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:7
verses.text: A nan im likau kariau samero lapalap eta kotilong ong kelep pan me pak nan par eu iangaki nta, me a tom kida pein dip a o dip en aramas akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:8
verses.text: I me Ngen saraui kotin kasansale kida, me al en nan pera saraui melel saikenta wiauier, arain im likau moa mia.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:9
verses.text: Mepukat karasepa eu en ansau wet, pwe kisakis o mairong en wiaui lole, a re sota kak kapungala nan insen en i, me kin kapwaiada dodok ong Kot wet.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:10
verses.text: Pwe met akan wiauita, pwen pil iang manga o nim, o song en kamakelekel akan, o tiak en kamaui pali uduk, me pan wiaui, lao lel ansau me mau song.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:11
verses.text: A Kristus me kotido, pwen samero lapalap en dipisou en mur, ap kotin weid nan im likau eu, me lapa sang o mau sang men mas o, me kaidin wiaui kidar pa, o me sota udan pali pa et,

verses.name: Hebrews 9:12
verses.text: Pil sota kotikilong ntan kut ol de kau pul a pein nta pan mepak, me a kotikilong nan pera saraui melel, pwen lapwapan dip soutuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:13
verses.text: Pwe ma ntan kut o kau ol o pas en kau li usupeki me samin kan ap kaminela o kasarauiala pali uduk o,

verses.name: Hebrews 9:14
verses.text: Daduen ntan Kristus so mau sang kaualap, me tonmeteki pein ong Kot ren Ngen soutuk, me sota me suet kot pit, pwen kamakelekel insen atail sang ni wiawia mela kan, pwen papa Kot ieias!

verses.name: Hebrews 9:15
verses.text: I me a kotin wiala sauntom en inau kap; a matala wiauier, pwen lapwada sapung kan, me wiauier pan inau kaieu, pwe irail me paeker akan en ale inau en soso soutuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:16
verses.text: Pwe ma inau en soso en pwaida, i me wiadar inau o, pan mela mas.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:17
verses.text: Pwe inau en soso kak pwaida murin aramas a mela, ma so, a sota pan kareda meakot, arain maur en i, me wiadar inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:18
verses.text: I me inau kaieu sota pan pwaida, ma nta so iang.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:19
verses.text: Pwe kusoned en kapung karos lao loki ong aramas karos ren Moses, a ap ale ntan kau o kut iangaki pil o wunen man waitata o isop, ap usupeki puk o aramas akan karos, masani:

verses.name: Hebrews 9:20
verses.text: Iet ntan inau, me Kot kotiki ong komail er.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:21
verses.text: A pil usupeki nta im likau o kapwa en papa kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:22
verses.text: O koren iong karos pan makelekele kida nta duen kapung o, a ma so nta, nan sota dip me pan lapwada.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:23
verses.text: I me a mau ong mom en dipisou en nanlang kan en kamakelekele kida mepukat. A dipisou en nanlang en kamakele kida mairong eu, me mau sang mepukat.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:24
verses.text: Pwe Kristus sota kotilong ong nan pera saraui, me pa wiaui kida pwe i mom en me melel, a a kotilong ong nan nanlang, pwen pwaralang mon silang en Kot pweki kitail.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:25
verses.text: A sota kotilong ong, pwen tomki pein i pan pak toto dueta samero lapalap, me kin pedelong ong nan pera saraui ni par karos iangaki ntan man oko.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:26
verses.text: Ma iduen, nan a pan matala pan pak toto sang nin tapin aramas akan, a met ni imwin ansau kan, a kotin pwarado pan mepak, pwen lapwada dip akan ki pein a mairong.

verses.name: Hebrews 9:27
verses.text: A duen a kileledier ong aramas akan, en mela pan mepak, a muri kadeik o,

verses.name: Hebrews 9:28
verses.text: Iduen Kristus me matalar pan mepak, pwen lapwada dip en me toto. A ni a pan kotin puredo, a pan pwara dong ir, me kin auiaui i, a kaidin pweki dip, a pwen kamaur ir ala.<div eID="gen2842" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.9"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 10:1
verses.text: PWE kapung o iei motan dipisou en mur, a kaidin pein mom en dipisou, a sota kak kaunsok kilar mairong ota irail, me kin wia ir ada ni par karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:2
verses.text: A ma iei, arail mairong pan dukedi, pwe solar kataman pan dip en irail, me apwali mairong;

verses.name: Hebrews 10:3
verses.text: Pwe mepukat kin wiaui, pwen katamanda dip ni par karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:4
verses.text: Pwe ntan kau ol o kut sota kak wa sang dip akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:5
verses.text: Ari, ni a kotin pwara dong sappa, masani: Mairong o kisakis komui sota kotin mauki, a komui kotiki ong ia er pali war ai.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:6
verses.text: Kom sota peren kida mairong isis o mairong men tom.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:7
verses.text: I ap inda: Kilang, I kokodo, nan puk o me intingidier duen ngai, pwen kapwaiada kupur omui, Maing Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:8
verses.text: Mas a masanier: Mairong, o kisakis, o mairong isis, o mairong men tom, kom sota kotin mauki, o kom sota kupur peren ki mepukat, me wiauier duen kapung o.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:9
verses.text: Ap pil masanier: Kilang, I pwara don kapwaiada kupur omui. A kotiki sang men mas, pwen kapwaiada men mur.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:10
verses.text: Ni kupur wet kitail kasarauilar ki mairong en war en Iesus Kristus pan me pak.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:11
verses.text: Samero karos me kasapwiladar, pwen apwali dodok ni ran karos o purepure mairong ota, me so kak lapwada dip akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:12
verses.text: A men et, me kotin mairongki pan mepak dip akan, ap kaipokedi ni pali maun en Kot kokolata.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:13
verses.text: O a kotin auiaui, lao a imwintiti pan wiala utipan aluwilu a kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:14
verses.text: Pwe a kotin kaunsokila tom ta ieu karos, me pan kasarauila.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:15
verses.text: Ngen saraui pil kotin kadede ong kitail duen mepukat, pwe murin a kotin masanier:

verses.name: Hebrews 10:16
verses.text: Iet inau, me I pan wiai ong irail murin ran pukat, me Kaun o kotin masanier: I pan ki ong mongiong arail ai kapung, o I pan intingiedi ong nan ngen arail.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:17
verses.text: Dip arail, o arail sapung kan I solar pan tamanda.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:18
verses.text: A ma re lapwadar, ap solar mairong en dip pan wiaui.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:19
verses.text: Ari ri ai kan, ma a muei ong kitail er, en pedelong ong nan pera saraui ki ntan Iesus,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:20
verses.text: Pwe a kotin wiai ong kitail er al en maur kap pot et lel pali lan likau ki uduk a.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:21
verses.text: A ma atail samero kasampwal en tanpas en Kot mia.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:22
verses.text: Kitail ap pan pwaralang i ni melel en mongiong atail, o poson melel, o usupeki mongiong atail, o maio sang insen sued, o widenki pil makelekel war atail,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:23
verses.text: O kitail en tengedi ong atail kadede en kaporopor o der wukiwuk sili, pwe i me melel, me kotikida inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:24
verses.text: O kitail en apwali nan pung atail ni atail kainong iong limpok o wiawia mau kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:25
verses.text: O kitail ender dukedi sang atail mod ong kaudok pena, duen me kin wiaui ren akai. A kitail en nantiong panau pena, pwe komail kilang, me ran o me korendor.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:26
verses.text: Pwe ma kitail inong iong wia dip, murin atail marainiki melel, solar mairong men tom ki dip atail,

verses.name: Hebrews 10:27
verses.text: A kitail pan mimieta ni atail masak kadeik apwalia o ongiong en kisiniai, me pan karosela imwintiti kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:28
verses.text: Ma amen pan tiakedi kapung en Moses, a sota pan diar mak, pwe a pan kamela, ma saunkadede riamen de silimen mia.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:29
verses.text: Ari, da me komail lamelame, duen me pan tiakedi Sapwilim en Kot, o kasaminela ntan inau kap, me a kasarauilar o lalaue Ngen en mak, a so pan kalokolok laud sang irail?

verses.name: Hebrews 10:30
verses.text: Pwe kitail asa i, me masanier: Ikepa ai dok, I pan depuki ong. O pil eu: Kaun o pan kotin kapung ong sapwilim a aramas akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:31
verses.text: Nan meid kalom, en lodi ong ni lim en Kot ieias.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:32
verses.text: A komail tamanda ran en mas oko murin omail marainlar, ap dadaurata ni omail kalokolok laud.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:33
verses.text: Ni omail kenkaurur sansal o pan kidau o kamekam, o ni omail riane kin ir, me pil lel mesued.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:34
verses.text: Pwe komail iangaki me salidi kan ni ar kalokolok, o komail pil pereperen ni omail kapwa kan kulia wei sang, pwe komail asa, me komail aneki dipisou en lang, me mau sang o me sota pan sorela.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:35
verses.text: Komail ari der kasela omail liki, me pan kareda katingpa lapalap.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:36
verses.text: Pwe kanongama me mau ong komai, pwen kapwaiada kupur en Kot o konodi inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:37
verses.text: Ansau tar kis, me onoper pan pwarado, a sota pan pwand.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:38
verses.text: A me pung o pan maureki poson, a ngen i sota pan peren kida, ma a pan pure wei sang.

verses.name: Hebrews 10:39
verses.text: A kitail sota kisan ir, me pure wei sang, ap lokidokila, a kisan irail, me kin poson ap kamaur ngen arail.<div eID="gen2843" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.10"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 11:1
verses.text: POSON me pason en me kitail kin kaporoporeki o kadede pan me so sansal.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:2
verses.text: Pwe i me men kaua aleer kadede parail.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:3
verses.text: Ni poson kitail asa, me lang o sappa wiauikier masan en Kot, iei me dipisou kan, me kitail kin kilang, so wiauiki meakai me sansal.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:4
verses.text: Ni poson Apel mairongiki ong Kot me mau sang Kain, ap dedekilar, me i me pung, pwe Kot kotin kupukupura a kisakis. O i me a kin padapadaki murin a melar lao lel met.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:5
verses.text: Ni poson Enok peukadala, pwen der kilang mela, ari, a soer diarokada, pwe Kot kotin ukadala i, a mon a peukadala kadedepa mia, duen a kon ong Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:6
verses.text: A ma so poson, sota me pan kak kon ong Kot. Pwe me men tu ong Kot, en poson, me a kotin mia, o me a pan kotin katingi ong ir, me rapaki i.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:7
verses.text: Ni poson Noa masakadar, ni a kauada war im, pwen kamaureda toun im a, ni a aleer masan en Kot, duen me saikenta sansal, o i me a kadeikada sappa, o sosoki pung, me pwili sang poson.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:8
verses.text: Ni poson Apraam peiki ong Kot, ni a paeker, en lipalang eu sap, me a pan sosoki; i ari lipalang o sota asa, wasa me a pan kotila ia.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:9
verses.text: Ni poson a wiala men wai amen nan sap en inau, o kotikot nan im likau kai, a Isaak o Iakop, me pan pil ale soso en inau ota, iang i,

verses.name: Hebrews 11:10
verses.text: Pwe a auiaui kanim eu, me a pason mia, me wiauieda ren Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:11
verses.text: Pil Sara keleki poson ni a pan liseanda, ap naitikada seri amen, ni a li dapwan, pwe a asa, me i melel amen, me kotiki ong i inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:12
verses.text: I me sang me ta men, me rasong mela amen, me toto tapida sang, due usu en lang me totoia, o me rasong pik en ni oror, me sota kak wadawad.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:13
verses.text: Mepukat karos matalar nin poson o kaikenta paieki inau o, a re kilanger sang ni wasa doo, ap peren kidar o kadededar, me re men kairu o men wai nin sappa.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:14
verses.text: A ni ar wia due met, re kin kasaleda, me re rapaki udan sap arail.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:15
verses.text: A ma irail ngongki sap o, me re ko sanger, irail pan kak purelang.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:16
verses.text: A so, pwe re inong iong eu sap, me mau sang sappa, me mi nanlang, i me Kot sota kotin namenokki wiala arail Kot, pwe a kotin kaonop ong irail er kanim eu.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:17
verses.text: Ni poson Apraam mairongki Isaak, ni a kasongesong o mueidala na ieros, murin a aleer inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:18
verses.text: Iran i a lokido: Sang Isaak kadaudok om me pan irerok wei.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:19
verses.text: Pwe a asa, me Kot pil kotin kak kamaurada i sang ren me melar akan, i me a pil pur ong naine kin i, pwen wia karasepa eu.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:20
verses.text: Ni poson Isaak kapaiadang Iakop o Esau meakan me pan wiaui.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:21
verses.text: Ni poson Iakop kapaiada nain Iosep putak riamen, ni a pan matala, o a pairukila pon a sokon.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:22
verses.text: Ni poson Iosep, ni a pan matala, a kokopada duen kadaudok en Israel ar pan lipala, o a kakalik ong ir duen ti a kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:23
verses.text: Ni poson Moses, ni a ipwidier, okiokilar ren sam a in a saunipong silu, pwe ira kilanger, me a seri kaselel amen, o ira sota masak en nanmarki a kusoned.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:24
verses.text: Ni poson Moses lao laudala, kang inaneki nain Parao seripein.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:25
verses.text: O a piladar en iang sapwilim en Kot aramas akan kamekam, sang peren mal en dip me motomot.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:26
verses.text: O a kasampwaleki kanamenok en Kristus sang kapwa en Äkipten, pwe a kupukupura katingpa.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:27
verses.text: Ni poson a lipa sang Äkipten, sota lomwiki ongiong en nanmarki, pwe a kotin kaporoporeki, me a sota kilanger, dueta a kilang i.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:28
verses.text: Ni poson a wia pasa o usup en nta, pwe me pan kamela meseni kan, ender kai ong ir.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:29
verses.text: Ni poson irail kotela sed waitata, likamata nan sap madekong, me men Äkipten oko pil song, rap mopelar.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:30
verses.text: Ni poson kel en kanim Ieriko rongki pasang murin ar pidaki ran isu.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:31
verses.text: Ni poson Raap, li sued amen, sota iang ir, me soposon, kamela, pweki a popol apwali liparok kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:32
verses.text: O da me i en pil kasoiada? Pwe ansau me tikitik en wia kasoi duen Kideon, o Parak, o Simson, o Iepta, o Dawid, o Samuel, o saukop akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:33
verses.text: Duen ar kaloekidi wei kan poson, kapwaiada lamalam pung, paieki inau kan, kaku pena au en laien,

verses.name: Hebrews 11:34
verses.text: Kakunla kel en kisiniai, piti sang au en kodlas, luetalar rap kelail lar, komad ni mauin, kaloedier saunpei en wai kan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:35
verses.text: Li akai pil aleer nair me melar akan, pwen mauredar. A akai kalokoloker o kang maiolar, pwe re men konodi maureda sang ren me melar akan me mau melel.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:36
verses.text: Pil akai wewelokelar, o wokiwok, o pil salidi, o lodi ong nan imateng.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:37
verses.text: Irail pakasuk, de rasaras pasang, de kame kila kodlas; re sansarawaru sili, likauiki kil en sip o kut, samamalar, kaankamekam, o apwal akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:38
verses.text: A men liki sota war ong mepukat. Irail koko sili nan sap tan, nin nana kan, pan paip o por kai.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:39
verses.text: Mepukat karos lok mau kilar ar poson, a sota paieki inau o.

verses.name: Hebrews 11:40
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotin kaonopadang kitail me mau sang arail pai, pwe irail ender unsokalar mo atail.<div eID="gen2844" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.11"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 12:1
verses.text: ARI, pweki saunkadede pukat, me ras ong dapok kalaimun eu, me kapil pena kitail, kitail en meui sang katoutou patail o dip, me kin kolekole kitail, ap dadaurata tang ni weir, me mi mo ’tail.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:2
verses.text: Ududial Iesus, me tapi pan o kaimwisoke pan atail poson, me sota kotin kupukupure peren me moa, ap kotin kanongama ni lopu, mamaleki kanamenokpa, ap kotidi ni pali maun en mol en Kot.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:3
verses.text: Komail tamanda i, me wonewei ni kaupa ren me dipan akan, pwe komail ender pangada o ngen omail ender luetala.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:4
verses.text: Pwe komail saikenta kelail ong en palian dip, me kareda kamela.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:5
verses.text: O komail monokelar kamait pa ’mail, me padaki ong komail ni tiak en seri: Nai ol, koe der rongarongan soreki kapung en Kaun o, o der luetalar ni a pan kotin kapung uk ala.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:6
verses.text: Pwe Kaun o kin kotin kame, me a kin pok ong o kin kaloke seri karos, me a pan sapwilimaneki.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:7
verses.text: A ma komail pan kanongama ong kalokolok, nan Kot kin kotin wiai ong komail duen ong sapwilim a kan. Pwe ia seri men, me sam a sota kin kaloke?

verses.name: Hebrews 12:8
verses.text: A ma komail sota pan kalokolok dueta irail karos, nan kaidin komail seri, pwe sota sam omail.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:9
verses.text: A ma sam atail en pali uduk kaloke kitail er, o kitail masak irail, iaduen, kitail sota pan peik kaualap ong Sam en ngen akan, pwen memaur kila?

verses.name: Hebrews 12:10
verses.text: Pwe irail kaloke kitail ran me malaulau, duen insen arail, a i pwen kamaui kitail la, pwe kitail en tungole kisan a saraui.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:11
verses.text: A kalokolok karos kaidin likamata peren, ni a pan lel ong kitail, pwe insensued, a mur a pan kareda wan pung o popol ong ir me anlar.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:12
verses.text: Komail ari kakelada pa o pukie omail luet akan.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:13
verses.text: O kakeki wei nä omail, pwe me sikilikil ender pirokala sang al o, a ren kelailada.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:14
verses.text: Nantiong popol ong amen amen o saraui; a ma so, sota me pan kak kilang Kaun o.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:15
verses.text: O kalaka, pwe amen depa sota konodi mak en Kot, pwe karepen me sued ende pwaida, kawe komail, o me toto pan samin kila.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:16
verses.text: Pwe sota me pan nenek, de me sued amen due Esau, me netikila a soso ni kisin manga ta ieu.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:17
verses.text: Pwe komail asa, duen muri, ni a men ale pai, a lokidokilar, pwe a sota kak diar ansaun kalula, me a roporopeki pil en mas a.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:18
verses.text: Pwe komail sota lel nana, me aramas kak doke, o me ingkingkon, o pil sota lel wasa rotorot, o wasa pong, o melimel.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:19
verses.text: Pil sota lel ngil laud en koronete, de maod en lokaia, me irail, me rongadar, poeki, ender pur ong.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:20
verses.text: Pwe re sota kak ong rong: O pil man amen, ma a pan sair nana o, a pan pakasuk.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:21
verses.text: Iduen kasansal a kamasak melel, pwe Moses masanier: I ap lomwineki o rerer.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:22
verses.text: A komail leler nana Sion, o kanim en Kot ieias, Ierusalem en lang, o pokon en tounlang ngederenia,

verses.name: Hebrews 12:23
verses.text: O momodisou meseni, me mar arail kileledier nanlang, o ren Kot saunkapung en karos, o ren ngen en me pung kan me unsokelar.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:24
verses.text: O ren Iesus sauntom en inau kap o ntan usup, me mau sang en Apel.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:25
verses.text: Komail kalaka, pwe komail depa sikinwei, me kin mamasani. Pwe ma irail sota kak pitila, me sikin wei i, me kotin padapadak ong irail nin sappa, nan melel, kitail sota pan kak pitila, ma kitail pan sikin wei i, me masan dong kitail sang nanlang.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:26
verses.text: I ansau o kapitie kamokidada sappa. A met a kotin inauki masani: I pan pil kamokidada kaidin sappa eta, pwe pil nanlang.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:27
verses.text: A iet wewe en: I pan pil: Me mokidadar pan kawukila, pwe iei dipisou me wiauier, pwen ir, me sota kamokidada, en mimieta.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:28
verses.text: Kitail pan ale wei eu, me sota pan kak mokidada, i me kitail en dodok ong Kot duen me kon ong i, ni makelekel o masak.

verses.name: Hebrews 12:29
verses.text: Pwe atail Kot kisiniai ngkon.<div eID="gen2845" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.12"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 13:1
verses.text: KOMAIL tengedi ong limpok en saulang!

verses.name: Hebrews 13:2
verses.text: Komail der monokela, en apwali men kairu kan. Pwe i me akai kasamoki tounlang kai, ap sasa.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:3
verses.text: Komail tamanda me salidi kan, due pein komail salidier, o irail me kaankamekam, due pein komail, me memaureki pali war.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:4
verses.text: Karos en wauneki inau en papaud o los en sosamin, a me nenek o kamal akan Kot me pan kotin kadeik ong irada.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:5
verses.text: Komail der norok moni, a komail insenemauki me mi re omail. Pwe a kotin masanier: I sota pan muei sang uk de kase uk ala.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:6
verses.text: Ari, kitail ap aima ong indinda: Kaun o sauas pa i, i sota pan masak, pwe da me aramas amen pan kak wiai ong ia?

verses.name: Hebrews 13:7
verses.text: Tamatamanda omail saunpadak kan, me kawewe ong komail er masan en Kot, alale sang arail poson, o madamadaua imwin arail wiawia.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:8
verses.text: Iesus Kristus me duedueta, aio, ran wet, o kokolata.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:9
verses.text: Komail ender wukiwukki sili padak likam akai; pwe pai kasampwal eu, mongiong atail en tengetengela, me kin wiauiki mak, a kaidin ni kisin manga, me so kadepa ong, me kin apapwali.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:10
verses.text: Atail pei saraui mia, me sota mau ong, irail en tungole sang, me kin papa nan im likau.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:11
verses.text: Pwe war en man akan, me ntar wisikilong ong nan pera saraui ren samero lapalap aki dip, isiser likin kanim.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:12
verses.text: Iduen Iesus, pwen kasarauiala aramas akan ki nta, kamekamela likin kanim.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:13
verses.text: Kitail ari en koie lang re a likin kanim o iang i kankaururla.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:14
verses.text: Pwe sota atail kanim potopot met, a kitail raparapaki eu, me mi mo ’tail.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:15
verses.text: Kitail ari poden mairongki kaping ong Kot ren (Iesus); iei wan kilin aua, me kadededa mar a.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:16
verses.text: Wiawia mau o kisakis, komail der monokela, pwe i mairong me Kot kotin kupura.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:17
verses.text: Peiki ong omail kaun akan o duki ong irail! Pwe re kin tauli kin ngen omail, duen me pan pakasaui ren Kot, pwe ren wiawia mepukat ni peren, a so ni insensued, pwe i me sapai ong komail.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:18
verses.text: Kapakapa kin kit. Se kin peren kida atail insen mau, o se kin nantiong wiawia mau ren aramas karos.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:19
verses.text: I panaui komail en porisok wia met, pwe i en kak pitipit pwaralang komail.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:20
verses.text: A Kot en popol, me kotin kaiasadar Silepan sip lapalap, iei atail Kaun Iesus sang ren me melar akan, ki ntan inau soutuk,

verses.name: Hebrews 13:21
verses.text: I en kotin kamaui komail en kapwaiada kupur a o song en wiawia mau ren Iesus Kristus. I me udan lingan kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:22
verses.text: Ri ai kan, i panaui komail, peiki ong ai panau wet. Pwe i inting wong komail er motomot.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:23
verses.text: Komail asa, ri atail Timoteus saladokelar; ma a pan madang dong ia, i pan iang i kilang komail.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:24
verses.text: Ranamau ong omail kaun akan karos o me saraui kan karos. Men Italien kan ar ranamau wong komail.

verses.name: Hebrews 13:25
verses.text: Mak en mi re omail karos!<div eID="gen2846" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Heb.13"/> <div eID="gen2833" osisID="Heb" type="book"/>

verses.name: James 1:1
verses.text: IET ngai Iakopus ladu en Kot o Kaun Iesus Kristus ong kainok eisok riau, me pakasar pasanger; komail perenda!

verses.name: James 1:2
verses.text: Ri ai ko, komail perenki ma komail lel ong kasongesong.

verses.name: James 1:3
verses.text: O asa, ma omail poson me pung, a pan kareda kanongama.

verses.name: James 1:4
verses.text: A kanongama pan duedueta lao lel imwi, pwe komail en anla o unsok, o solar anane meakot.

verses.name: James 1:5
verses.text: A ma amen re omail sota a lolekong, i en poeki ren Kot, me kin kotiki ong amen amen ni so kidaue, ari, a pan ale.

verses.name: James 1:6
verses.text: A i en poeki ni poson, der peikasal, pwe me kin peikasal, me rasong iluk en madau, me ang kin ipir wei pukepuk.

verses.name: James 1:7
verses.text: Pwe i aramas ender lamelame, me a pan tungole meakot sang ren Kaun o.

verses.name: James 1:8
verses.text: A ol amen me peikasal, kin koweikodo ni a dodok karos.

verses.name: James 1:9
verses.text: A ri atail amen, me samama, en suaiki a kapwapwa.

verses.name: James 1:10
verses.text: A me kapwapwa en suaiki a samama, pwe duen masal en rä a pan mongedi.

verses.name: James 1:11
verses.text: Pwe katipin dakada, ap karakar, ap kamongedi rä kan o masal en rä pupedier, o mom a kaselel olar, iduen me kapwapwa o pan sora sang ni a wiawia kan.

verses.name: James 1:12
verses.text: Meid pai ol o, me wonweita ni songapa, pwe murin a poedi, a pan ale nin in maur, me Kot kotin inauki ong me pok ong i.

verses.name: James 1:13
verses.text: Ma amen pan songesong, a depa inda, me a songesong ren Kot. Pwe Kot sota kak mi pan songesong en mesued, o a pil sota kin kasongesong amen.

verses.name: James 1:14
verses.text: A amen amen kin songesong ni a inong sued.

verses.name: James 1:15
verses.text: A inong sued lao wiauier, ap naitikadar dip; a dip, ni a unsokelar, kin naitikada mela.

verses.name: James 1:16
verses.text: Ri ai kompok kan, komail der ponepon kida.

verses.name: James 1:17
verses.text: Kisakis mau karos o a sapan kodido sang poa, sang ren Sam en marain akan, me sota man song toror o sota man wukila.

verses.name: James 1:18
verses.text: A kotin kanaitik kida kitail masan melel, pwe kitail en wiala meseni en sapwilim a kan.

verses.name: James 1:19
verses.text: Ri ai kompok kan, komail asa, aramas karos en madang rong, a pwand en lokaia, o pwand en makar.

verses.name: James 1:20
verses.text: Pwe makar en ol o sota kin kapwareda pung en Kot.

verses.name: James 1:21
verses.text: I me komail en kasela pwel karos o me sued karos, ap ale ong komail masan o, me padedier lol omail nin tiak en karakarak, i me kak ong kamaureda ngen omail.

verses.name: James 1:22
verses.text: A komail en kapwaiada masan o kaidin rong eta, a ma iduen, komail kin kotaue pein komail.

verses.name: James 1:23
verses.text: Pwe ma meamen kin rong masan o, ap sota kapwaiada, nan a ras ong ol amen, me kin kilekilang mas en pali war a nan klas,

verses.name: James 1:24
verses.text: Pwe murin a kilekilanger duen pein i, a koie la o pitipit monokela duen a sansal.

verses.name: James 1:25
verses.text: A me kin kilekilang melel nan kapung unsok o kasaledok, o kapwaiada, o ma a sota pan monokela, me a ronger, a kapwaiada, nan i pan pai kida a wiawia kan.

verses.name: James 1:26
verses.text: Ma amen lamelame, me a kin papa Kot, ap sota kaineneda lo a, o ma a piti pein mongiong i, nan a dodok ong Kot me mal kot.

verses.name: James 1:27
verses.text: A dodok min o pung mon Kot o Sam me wet: En apapwali sapoupou o li odi kan ni ar apwal akan, o pera ki pein i sang sappa.<div eID="gen2848" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jas.1"/>

verses.name: James 2:1
verses.text: RI ai ko, komail poson atail Kaun Iesus Kriitus en lingan, der lipiliki aramas amen.

verses.name: James 2:2
verses.text: Pwe ma ol amen pan iang omail saraui, me kapwateki ring kold likau lingan, o pil samama amen, me a tuken likau o sakanekan pan pedelong,

verses.name: James 2:3
verses.text: A ma komail pan kilekilang me mi nan likau lingan, o komail pan indang i: Re kotido kaipokedi met, wasa mau, ap indang me samama: Koe en uda mo, de met impan utipa!

verses.name: James 2:4
verses.text: Iaduen komail lipilipil nan pung omail, o komail wiala saunkapung kan ni omail lamalam sued?

verses.name: James 2:5
verses.text: Ri ai kompok kan, komail rong! Kot sota kotin piladar me samama nan sappa et, me kapwapwaki poson, o me pan sosoki wei, me a kotin inauki ong irail, me pok ong i?

verses.name: James 2:6
verses.text: A komail mamaleki me samama o. Kaidin me kapwapwa kan kin wia sued ong komail o pangalang komail mol en kadeik kan?

verses.name: James 2:7
verses.text: Irail sota kin lalaue mar isou, me komail maranekier?

verses.name: James 2:8
verses.text: Ma komail kapwaiada kapung isou duen masan o: Koe en pok ong men imp om dueta pein uk, nan komail wia me mau.

verses.name: James 2:9
verses.text: A ma komail pan lipilipiliki aramas, komail kin wia dip, o kapung pan kadiarok ong komail, me komail me dipan.

verses.name: James 2:10
verses.text: Pwe meamen kapwaiada kapung pon, ap kawela kusoned eu, nan i me tiakedi karos.

verses.name: James 2:11
verses.text: Pwe me kotin masanier: Koe der kamal, i me pil masanier: Koe der kamela aramas! Ari, ma koe sota kamal, a ma koe kamela aramas, nan koe me tiakedier kapung o.

verses.name: James 2:12
verses.text: Komail ari lokaia o wiawia duen irail, me pan pakadeikada ren kapung en kamaio.

verses.name: James 2:13
verses.text: A me sota kin kadek, pan lodi ong kadeik apwal, a me kadek, kin suaiki kadeik o.

verses.name: James 2:14
verses.text: Ri ai ko, da katepan aramas amen, me pan inda, me a poson mia, ap sota a wiawia mau kan? Iaduen poson pan kak dorela i?

verses.name: James 2:15
verses.text: Ma ri atail ol de li amen mia, me solar a likau, o solar kan ar kisin manga kaukaule,

verses.name: James 2:16
verses.text: A ma amen komail pan indang i: Kola popol rangerang o mangamanga! Ap sota, me komail pan ki ong i, me mau ong pali war a, da katepa?

verses.name: James 2:17
verses.text: Iduen poson, ma a kelep o sota wiawia iang, nan a melar.

verses.name: James 2:18
verses.text: A ele amen pan inda: Om poson mia, a ai wiawia kan mia; kasale ong ia om poson, me sota wiawia kan mia, a ngai pan kasale ong uk ai poson ni ai wiawia kan.

verses.name: James 2:19
verses.text: Koe kamelele me Kot me ta men mia, me mau, nan tewil akan pil kin kamelele ap masakada.

verses.name: James 2:20
verses.text: A koe aramas aklapalap, ma koe men dedeki, me poson me mal kot, ma sota wiawia kan iang?

verses.name: James 2:21
verses.text: Iaduen sam atail Apraam? A sota pung kila a wiawia kan, ni a pan mairongki sapwilim a kisin putak Isaak pon pei saraui?

verses.name: James 2:22
verses.text: I me koe kilang, me poson sauasa a wiawia kan, o poson unsok kilar a wiawia kan.

verses.name: James 2:23
verses.text: Ari masan o pwaidar: Apraam poson Kot, o i me a pung kilar o a maraneki: Kompoke pan Kot.

verses.name: James 2:24
verses.text: Komail ari kilanger, me aramas amen pan pung kila a wiawia kan a kaidin poson ta.

verses.name: James 2:25
verses.text: Pil dueta Raap, li sued amen, kaidin a wiawia kan, me a pung kilar, ni a kasamo men en kadar, o kadar ir ala ni apot al toror?

verses.name: James 2:26
verses.text: Pwe duen pali war mela, ma sota ngen, iduen poson a mela, ma sota wiawia kan iang.<div eID="gen2849" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jas.2"/>

verses.name: James 3:1
verses.text: RI ai ko, me sota mau, ma komail me toto inong iong saunpadakala, pwe komail asa, me kitail pan lel ong kadeik laud.

verses.name: James 3:2
verses.text: Pwe pan pak toto kitail kin sapung, a ma amen sota kin sapungki lokaia kis, nan i ol melel amen, o a kak koaki pali war a pokon.

verses.name: James 3:3
verses.text: Kilang, kitail kin ki ong nan au en os kisin mata, pwe ren peiki ong kitail, o kitail kin kawuk sili war arail pokon.

verses.name: James 3:4
verses.text: Kilang, pil sop akan! Irail me kalaimun o ang kin ipir wei, ari so, men ilil tikitik kak kawuki ong wasa, me kaptin kin inong iong ia.

verses.name: James 3:5
verses.text: Iduen lo me kokon tikitik eu, a a suaisuai lapalap. Kilang, duen kisiniai tikitik kin isikada nana kalaimun!

verses.name: James 3:6
verses.text: Iduen lo en aramas, a rasong kisiniai o aude pan sapung karos. Lo o kisan kokon atail, ap kasaminela war pon, a kin isikada wiawia en nan maur atail karos, a pein i isis sang nan pweleko.

verses.name: James 3:7
verses.text: Pwe song en man laualo karos, o manpir, o me karop, o man akan, me kin memaur nan sed, kin kamandala o kaloedi ren aramas akan.

verses.name: James 3:8
verses.text: A lo o sota aramas amen me kak kaloedi, nan me sued kot, me dir en men kamela.

verses.name: James 3:9
verses.text: I me kitail kapingaki Kaun o Sam, o kitail kariaki i aramas akan, me wiauier ni mom en Kot.

verses.name: James 3:10
verses.text: Song ni au ota kapai o karia kin tapi sang ia. Ri ai ko, me sota pung, mepukat en wiaui due.

verses.name: James 3:11
verses.text: Daduen utun pil pot, a kin ki wei pil iau o sadik sang ni por ta ieu?

verses.name: James 3:12
verses.text: Ri ai ko, pik pot pil kak wa wan le, de wain pan kak wan pik? Pil dueta parer sol eu sota kak kida pil.

verses.name: James 3:13
verses.text: Is me lolekong re omail, o erekila padak? I en kasaleda ni lamalam mau a wiawia kan ni impai o lolekong.

verses.name: James 3:14
verses.text: A ma peirin o akamai mier nan mongiong omail, komail der suaiki palian melel o der kalikame me melel.

verses.name: James 3:15
verses.text: Pwe lolekong wet, me sota tapi sang poa a udan pa et, pali uduk, pali tewil.

verses.name: James 3:16
verses.text: Pwe wasa peirin o akamai mia, nan i wasan saminimin o dodok sued karos kin wiauiaui ia.

verses.name: James 3:17
verses.text: A lolekong, me tapi sang ni pali poa, mas a kin makelekel, ap pil kaminimin, o kampai, o matarok, o dir en kadek, o wa mau, o so peikasal, o so malaun.

verses.name: James 3:18
verses.text: A wan pung pan kamoremoredi ni popol ren ir, me kin tom pena.<div eID="gen2850" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jas.3"/>

verses.name: James 4:1
verses.text: IA wasa akamai o pei nan pung omail kin tapi sang ia? Kaidin sang nan omail inong sued akan, me kin pepei nan omail kokon akan?

verses.name: James 4:2
verses.text: Komail kin inong iong, ap sota aneki, komail kin kamela o kailongki, ap sota, me komail pan ale; komail kin akamai o mauin. A sota omail meakot, pwe komail sota kin poeki.

verses.name: James 4:3
verses.text: Komail kin poeki, ap sota pwaida, pwe komail kin poeki sapung, pwe komail kin kapwaia kida omail inong sued akan.

verses.name: James 4:4
verses.text: Komail kamal akan, komail sota asa me waroki ong sappa et, kin imwintiti ong Kot? Ari meamen, me men kompoke pan sappa, nan i imwintiti en Kot amen.

verses.name: James 4:5
verses.text: De komail kiki ong, me puk saraui masani mal: Ngen o me kotikot lol omail, kin inong iong o nantiong dodok ong Kot.

verses.name: James 4:6
verses.text: A meid laud a mak ong kitail. I me a kotin masanieki: Kot kin kotin palian me aklapalap, ap maki ong me opampap akan.

verses.name: James 4:7
verses.text: Komail ari duki ong Kot a palian tewil, a ap pan tang wei sang komail.

verses.name: James 4:8
verses.text: Kakondak mongiong ong Kot, a ap pan kupukupura komail, kamakelekel pa omail, komail me dipan; o kaminela mongiong omail, komail me lol riapot.

verses.name: James 4:9
verses.text: Kainsino, o maiei, o sangesang; omail kaukaurur en wuki ong me mauk, o omail peren ong insensued.

verses.name: James 4:10
verses.text: Akitikitik ki pein komail mon Kaun o, a ap pan kasapwil komail da.

verses.name: James 4:11
verses.text: Ri ai ko komail de lokaia sued nan pung omail. Pwe me kin lokaia sued duen ri a, de kadeikada ri a, a kin lokaia sued ong kapung o kin kadeikada kapung o. A ma koe kadeikada kapung, pwe saunkapung amen koe.

verses.name: James 4:12
verses.text: Amen ta saunkapung o saunkadeik, me kak ong kamaurela o kariala. A is koe, me kin kadeikada men imp a?

verses.name: James 4:13
verses.text: Iet pil eu, komail me kin inda: Ran wet de lakap se pan kolang kanim wet o kauson wasa o par eu, o netinet ap kapwapwala.

verses.name: James 4:14
verses.text: A komail kin sasa, da me pan wiaui lakap, pwe da omail maur? Pwe komail kin ras ong tokoi, me kin mi ansau kis, ap mokonaidi.

verses.name: James 4:15
verses.text: Mak eta komail en inda: Ma Kaun o kotin kupura, o ma kitail memaureta, kitail pan wiada met de mo.

verses.name: James 4:16
verses.text: A so, komail kin perenki omail susuai, nan susuai due met me sued.

verses.name: James 4:17
verses.text: Ari, melel ta, meamen me lelapok ki me mau, ap sota wia, nan i me dip ong i.<div eID="gen2851" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jas.4"/>

verses.name: James 5:1
verses.text: A KOMAIL kapwapwa kan, sangesangki o weriwereki, kampamail pan lel ong komail!

verses.name: James 5:2
verses.text: Omail kapwa kan olar, o man en mot kangalar omail likau kan.

verses.name: James 5:3
verses.text: Omail kold o silper mirelar, ari, ar mir me pan kadede ong komail, o pan ngar pasang uduk omail due kisiniai. Nan komail nakier kapwa ni imwin ran akan.

verses.name: James 5:4
verses.text: Komail ngar, pwain en toun dodok, me kop penaer dipisou en sap omail, me komail kulia sanger, kin weriwer; o likwir en saundolung akan lel ong karonga en Kaun Sepaot.

verses.name: James 5:5
verses.text: Komail ipuepuarok kier me sued nin sappa, dender ong, komail kamue matier mongiong omail rasong man wi, me pan kamela.

verses.name: James 5:6
verses.text: Komail kadeikada o kamela me pung o, a a sota palian komail er.

verses.name: James 5:7
verses.text: Ari ri ai ko, komail kanongama lao lel en atail Kaun a pan kotin pwarado. Kilang, saumat amen kin auiaui wa mau en sap o, o a kin kanongama lao katau en mas o mur moredier.

verses.name: James 5:8
verses.text: Komail ari pil kanongama eta, katenge mongiong omail, pwe en atail Kaun a pwarado me korendor.

verses.name: James 5:9
verses.text: Ri ai ko, komail der pilipil en pan moli ki amen amen, pwe komail ender pakadeikada. Kilang, saunkadeik o mi pan wanim.

verses.name: James 5:10
verses.text: Ri ai ko, ni omail kalokolok o kanongama komail alale sang saukop akan, me kokopeki ni mar en Kaun o.

verses.name: James 5:11
verses.text: Kilang, kitail kin kapinga me dadauratar. Komail ronger duen kanongama en Iop, o kilanger imwin Kaun O, pwe Kaun o kin kupukupura o kapunglol kaualap.

verses.name: James 5:12
verses.text: Ri ai ko, komail kalaka, pwe komail der kaula; der kaukila lang de sappa, o der wia eu song en kaula; a omail sapeng en ei ta, o omail so en so, pwe komail de lodi ong kadeik o.

verses.name: James 5:13
verses.text: Ma amen re omail kamekam, a en kapakap, a ma amen insenemau, a en kauleki psalm.

verses.name: James 5:14
verses.text: Ma amen mi re omail me somau, en ukado saunkoa en momodisou kan, pwe irail en kapakapa kin i, murin ar keie kin i le ni mar en Kaun o.

verses.name: James 5:15
verses.text: Ari, kapakap poson pan kamaureda me somau o, o Kaun o pan kakelada i, o ma a wiaer dip kai, re pan sapedokalar sang.

verses.name: James 5:16
verses.text: I me komail en weok pena dip omail o kapakapaki amen amen, pwe komail en kelail la. Kapakap melel en me pung amen kin kareda me toto.

verses.name: James 5:17
verses.text: Elias aramas amen dueta kitail, a kapakapaki katau ender moredi, ari solar katau moredi ong sappa ni par silu o saunipong wonu.

verses.name: James 5:18
verses.text: O a kotin pur ong kapakap, nanlang ap kamoredier katau, o sap kapareda wa kan.

verses.name: James 5:19
verses.text: Ri ai ko, meamen mi re omail, me salongala ni melel, o amen kasapaledo i,

verses.name: James 5:20
verses.text: I en asa, me kasapaledo me dipan amen sang ni a salongala, a kamaureda sang mela ngen eu, me a pan pwain kidi dip toto.<div eID="gen2852" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jas.5"/> <div eID="gen2847" osisID="Jas" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Peter 1:1
verses.text: IET ngai Petrus wanporon en Iesus Kristus amen ong me pilipildar ren me kaikairu pakasar lang Pontus, Kalesia, Kapadosien, Asien o Pitinien.

verses.name: I Peter 1:2
verses.text: Me pilipildar pan kupur en Kot Sam, ap kasaraui kila Ngen, pwen peik o makelekeleda pan ntan Iesus Kristus. Mak o popol en rok re omail!

verses.name: I Peter 1:3
verses.text: Kaping ong Kot, o Sam en Kaun patail Iesus Kristus, me kotin kaipwi kap kitail ong kaporopor maur, pweki a kalangan lapalap pan Iesus Kristus a iasadar sang ren me melar akan,

verses.name: I Peter 1:4
verses.text: Ong soso eu, me sota pan dukedi o so samin, o so mongedi, me nekinekid ong komail nanlang.

verses.name: I Peter 1:5
verses.text: Komail me pakolekoleki mana en Kot ni poson ong maur potopot, me pan sansaldo ni imwin ran akan.

verses.name: I Peter 1:6
verses.text: Iran met komail kin peren kida, murin omail insensuedeki songesong kai ansau motomot, ma i duen kupur a.

verses.name: I Peter 1:7
verses.text: Pwe omail poson en diarokada ni pung o, pan kasampwal sang kold sor, a me kin diarok kida kisiniai, men kaping, o lingan, o wau, ni en Iesus Kristus a pan sansaleda.

verses.name: I Peter 1:8
verses.text: Me komail sota kilanger, ari so, komail kin pok ong i, o komail kin poson i, me komail sota kin kilang ansau wet, a i me komail kin peren kida peren laud kaualapia.

verses.name: I Peter 1:9
verses.text: I me pan kare ong komail imwin omail poson, iei dorelan ngen omail.

verses.name: I Peter 1:10
verses.text: Iei maur o, me saukop oko raparapaki o kalekalelapok, me kokop kida mak, me pan pwara dong komail.

verses.name: I Peter 1:11
verses.text: O re raparapaki, iad ansau o duen ansau me Ngen en Kristus me kotikot re ’rail, kotin kasaledar, o me kotin kokopkido kamekam en Kristus o a lingan, me mi muri.

verses.name: I Peter 1:12
verses.text: A pakair pwara dong irail, kaidin pwen papa pein irail, a komail, rap kalok ong komail er sang ren me padaki ong komail rongamau ki Ngen saraui, me pakadarado sang nanlang, me pil tounlang kan inong iong kilang.

verses.name: I Peter 1:13
verses.text: I me komail en katengedi longelonge en ngen omail. Komail masamasan o kaporoporeki melel mak en Kot, me pan wisike dong komail ni en Iesus Kristus a pan sansaleda.

verses.name: I Peter 1:14
verses.text: Komail dueta seri en peik kan, komail der paroki ong inong sued en mas o, me mi re omail ni ansaun omail rotorot.

verses.name: I Peter 1:15
verses.text: A duen i, me kotin molipe komail er, me saraui, iduen komail en pil saraui ni song en wiawia karos.

verses.name: I Peter 1:16
verses.text: Pwe a intingidier: Komail en saraui, pwe ngai me saraui.

verses.name: I Peter 1:17
verses.text: O ma komail pan kapakap ong Sam, me sota kotin lipilipil aramas amen, pwe a pan kotin kadeikada duen dodok en amen amen, komail ari kekeide ki ni masak arain omail kaikairu nin sappa et.

verses.name: I Peter 1:18
verses.text: Pwe komail asa, kaidin kapwa sor: Silper de kold, me komail kamaio kila sang omail dadaurata kaudok o, me men kaua padokedi ong komail,

verses.name: I Peter 1:19
verses.text: A ki ntan Kristus kasampwal dueta sippul amen, me so samin o so muaimuai.

verses.name: I Peter 1:20
verses.text: Me kileledier mon sappa pasonedier, ap sansaleda ni imwin ran akan pweki komail.

verses.name: I Peter 1:21
verses.text: Komail me poson Kot ki i, me Kot kotin kaiasadar sang ren me melar akan, ap kotin kalinganada i, pwe komail en poson o kaporoporeki Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 1:22
verses.text: O komail kamakelekeleki ngen omail ni peik o melel, pwen pokepoke melel ri omail akan. Komail ari tengeteng limpok pena sang mongiong omail makelekel.

verses.name: I Peter 1:23
verses.text: Dueta ir, me ip sapal, kaidin sang ni wa mor, a sang ni me somor, iet: Sang nan masan maur en Kot, me pan duedueta.

verses.name: I Peter 1:24
verses.text: Pwe uduk karos me rasong rä, o ar lingan karos me rasong masal en wan rä. Rä o mongidier o masal en wan rä moredier.

verses.name: I Peter 1:25
verses.text: A masan en atail Kaun pan potopoteta kokolata, i masan o, me kalok ong komail ni rongamau.<div eID="gen2854" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Pet.1"/>

verses.name: I Peter 2:1
verses.text: KOMAIL ari muei sang song en sued karos o widing karos, o malaun, o peirin, o karaun mal karos.

verses.name: I Peter 2:2
verses.text: A komail en dueta seri pwelel, me apton ipwidier, ap inong iong pil en didi mau o melel, pwe komail en kakairi kida i,

verses.name: I Peter 2:3
verses.text: Ma komail diaradar, me Kaun o me kalangan.

verses.name: I Peter 2:4
verses.text: Komail waroki ong i me rasong takai maur, me aramas akan kaselar, ap lipilipiler o kasampwal ren Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 2:5
verses.text: O pein komail en kakauda duen takai memaur, wiala im ngenin o pwin en samero saraui, pwen kida mairong, me pwili sang Ngen o, me Kot kotin kupura ki Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: I Peter 2:6
verses.text: I me intingidier nan puk saraui: Kilang, I kidi ong nan Sion takai en pukakaim, me lipilipil o kasampwal, o me poson i, sota pan namenokala.

verses.name: I Peter 2:7
verses.text: Komail ari, me liki i, pan ale pai kasampwal o; a ren me soposon akan, a rasong takai eu, me men kau im akan kaselar; ari so, a wialar takai en pukakaim,

verses.name: I Peter 2:8
verses.text: O takai en kapupedi, o paip en kamakar, irail kin dipikelekel, aki re sota peik iong masan o, i me pil kileledi ong irail.

verses.name: I Peter 2:9
verses.text: A komail sau lipilipil eu, samero isou kan, pokon saraui, aramas me netier, pwen kapara sili manaman akan en me kotin molipedo komail sang nan rotorot ong a marain kapuriamui.

verses.name: I Peter 2:10
verses.text: Mas komail sota wei eu, a met komail wein Kot; o mas komail sota konekonela, a met, komail konekonelar.

verses.name: I Peter 2:11
verses.text: Kompok kan, i panaui komail pwe komail men kairu o men wai, komail muei sang inong sued en uduk, me kin palian ngen.

verses.name: I Peter 2:12
verses.text: Omail wiawia kan nan pung en men liki kan en pung, pwe ni ar kine likam ong komail, dene komail me sued kai, ir lao kilang omail wiawia me mau, ren kapinga Kot ni ran en kasansal.

verses.name: I Peter 2:13
verses.text: Komail ari duki ong kaun pan aramas akan karos pweki Kaun: Ma nanmarki, pwe i ta kaun lapalap.

verses.name: I Peter 2:14
verses.text: A ma saumas akan, me pakadarado sang re a, pwen depuk ong me sapung kan, ap kapinga me kin wiawia mau.

verses.name: I Peter 2:15
verses.text: Pwe iet eten duen kupur en Kot: Komail en kadukie kidi omail wiawia mau dodok en aramas pweipwei kan.

verses.name: I Peter 2:16
verses.text: Duen me saladokalar, ap sota wia kin arail saladok, men pwaindi dip arail, a duen ladun Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 2:17
verses.text: Kakaki amen amen, pok ong saulang kan, lan Kot, wauneki nanmarki!

verses.name: I Peter 2:18
verses.text: Komail papa kan, upai ong omail kaun akan ni masak, kaidin ong me mau o kalangan eta, a pil ong me kin kowei kodo.

verses.name: I Peter 2:19
verses.text: Pwe mak eta, amen en kamekameki a pung ren Kot, o kanongama pan me sued.

verses.name: I Peter 2:20
verses.text: Pwe da kadepa, ma komail pan pukoki pein dip omail? A ni omail wiawia me mau, ap kamekam ki o kanongama, nan i me mak ren Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 2:21
verses.text: Pwe i me komail paeker kido, pwe pil Kristus kamekam kin komail, wiala kilel pa ’mail, pwe komail en idauen wei lip a.

verses.name: I Peter 2:22
verses.text: Me sota wia dip, pil sota widing diarok nin silang i.

verses.name: I Peter 2:23
verses.text: Kasuedi, a so suedeki, kaankamekam, ap sota akdepuk, a a meuid ong i, me kin kadiekada pung.

verses.name: I Peter 2:24
verses.text: Pein i tomki dip atail nan war a nin tuka o, pwe kitail en mela sang dip atail akan, ap pan maur iong me pung, me moun lip a komail kelail kidar.

verses.name: I Peter 2:25
verses.text: Pwe komail rasong sip, me salongalar, a met komail sapale dong silepa ’mail o Kaun pan ngen omail.<div eID="gen2855" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Pet.2"/>

verses.name: I Peter 3:1
verses.text: PIL dueta komail li akan, udi ong pein omail warok kan, pwe irail me so poson masan o, en pil dore kila wiawia mau en li akan o arail nenenla.

verses.name: I Peter 3:2
verses.text: Ni arail kilekilang omail wiawia min iangaki lan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:3
verses.text: Arail kapwat ender ni pali liki ni arail ingid pena pit en monga de kapwat ki kold, de diliong nan likau lingan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:4
verses.text: A kapwat me so sansal mi nan mongiong en aramas, me so sor, impai, opampap, iei me kasampwal ren Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 3:5
verses.text: Pwe iduen kapwat en li saraui en kaua kan, me kaporoporeki Kot o duki ong pein arail warok kan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:6
verses.text: Duen Sara, me peiki ong Apraam o kamare kin i: Ai kaun; a komail wiala na seri kan, ma komail pan wiawia mau o sota masak.

verses.name: I Peter 3:7
verses.text: Pil dueta komail ol akan, lelapoki ong omail warok kan, kaka kin irail, pwe koma sosoki pena mak en maur, pwe omail kapakap ender poula.

verses.name: I Peter 3:8
verses.text: A iet imwin mepukat: Komail karos en lamalam ta pot, o pokepok pena, o pok ong ri omail akan, o kadek, o aktikitik.

verses.name: I Peter 3:9
verses.text: Komail der depukki me sued me sued, de lokaia sued lokaia sued, a kapaiada, ap asa, me a kilele ong komail, en sosoki pai kan.

verses.name: I Peter 3:10
verses.text: Pwe me men pok ong maur o inong iong ran mau akan, i en pera sang sued lo a, o kil en au a, pwe re depa kotaue.

verses.name: I Peter 3:11
verses.text: A en muei sang me sued, ap wia me mau, en rapaki popol, ap dadaurata.

verses.name: I Peter 3:12
verses.text: Pwe silang in Kaun o kin pera me pung kan, o karong a me mangi ar kapakap. A silang in Kaun o kin palian irail me wia sued.

verses.name: I Peter 3:13
verses.text: Is i me pan kaokaoe komail, ma komail dadaurata me mau?

verses.name: I Peter 3:14
verses.text: A ma komail kamekameki me pung, komail meid pai; komail der masak irail o der waponda.

verses.name: I Peter 3:15
verses.text: A komail en kasarauiki nan mongiong omail Kaun Kristus. Ansau karos komail en kak sapeng ong amen amen me kalelapok re omail duen kaporopor o, me mi lol omail.

verses.name: I Peter 3:16
verses.text: A mepukat en wiaui nin tiak en opampap, o masak, o insen makelekel, pwe irail, me kinekine likam ong komail ni omail wiawia mau ren Kristus, ren namenokala ni ar karaun kin komail likam.

verses.name: I Peter 3:17
verses.text: Me mau, ma i kupur en Kot, komail kamekameki me mau, sang omail kamekameki me sued.

verses.name: I Peter 3:18
verses.text: Pwe pil Kristus kamekame ki dip pan mepak, me Pung wiliandi me sapung kan; pwen kalua kitail dong Kot. Pali uduk kamekamelar ap kaiasa kida Ngen.

verses.name: I Peter 3:19
verses.text: I me a kotidilang wasa tengeteng, pwen padaki ong ngen akan,

verses.name: I Peter 3:20
verses.text: Me sota peik mas o, ni ansau me Kot kotin auiaui o kanongama ong ir ni muein Noa, ni ansau, me war im wiauier, me malaulau, ir me walemen, maure kila pil o.

verses.name: I Peter 3:21
verses.text: I me pil kin kamaur komail la ansau wet ni paptais a kaidin kaminela pali uduk, pwe inau en insen mau ong Kot eu, ki en Iesus Kristus a iasadar.

verses.name: I Peter 3:22
verses.text: A kotidalang nanlang, kotikot ni pali maun en Kot. Tounlang kan, o lapalap akan, o manaman akan upai ong i.<div eID="gen2856" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Pet.3"/>

verses.name: I Peter 4:1
verses.text: ARI, pweki Kristus kamekame ki kitail ni pali uduk a, i me komail en pil ale ong komail lamelam ota, pwe me kin kamekame ni pali uduk, muei sanger dip.

verses.name: I Peter 4:2
verses.text: Pwe a der poden dadaurata inong sued en aramas akan, a dadaurata kupur en Kot arain a memaur ni uduk.

verses.name: I Peter 4:3
verses.text: Pwe a itarer, omail wiawia en mas duen lamalam en men liki kan, ni omail kekeid ni tiak sued, o inong sued, o sokolar, o kaped en manga, o kamom soko, o kaudoki ong ani sakanekan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:4
verses.text: I me re puriamuiki, me komail solar kin iang irail ni ar wia sued o kaped en manga, o lalaue.

verses.name: I Peter 4:5
verses.text: A re pan weokadang i, me pan kadeikada me maur o me melar akan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:6
verses.text: Pwe i me rongamau pil loloki ong me melar akan, pwe irail en maurela. Ari so, ni pali war arail re lodi onger kadeik o duen a kin wiaui ren aramas akan, a ni pali ngen arail re memaur duen kupur en Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 4:7
verses.text: A imwin meakaros me korendor, komail ari masamasan o nantiong kapakap.

verses.name: I Peter 4:8
verses.text: A met eta, komail dadaurata omail poke pena, pwe limpok kin pwaindi dip toto.

verses.name: I Peter 4:9
verses.text: Komail apapwali men kairu o der lipalipaned.

verses.name: I Peter 4:10
verses.text: Duen omail aleer omail pai en mak kan, iduen omail papa pena duen saunkoa mau en mak en Kot.

verses.name: I Peter 4:11
verses.text: Ma amen pan wiada padak, a en wiada duen masan en Kot, o ma amen kin papa, a en papa duen Kot kotin kupurai ong i a mana, pwe kaping en ko ong Kot ni meakan karos, ren Iesus Kristus, me wau o manaman en ko ong kokolata soutuk! Amen.

verses.name: I Peter 4:12
verses.text: Kompok kan, komail der puriamuiki songapa ’mail karakar, me pan lel ong komail, pwen kasongesong komail, der lamelame, me komail ta lel ong mepukat.

verses.name: I Peter 4:13
verses.text: A komail peren kida, pwe komail pwaisaneki en Kristus a kamekam, pwe ni a lingan sansaldo, komail pil pan perenda kaualapia.

verses.name: I Peter 4:14
verses.text: Komail meid pai, ma aramas pan kaurur kin komail pweki mar en Kristus! Pwe Ngen en lingan o en Kot kotikot re omail.

verses.name: I Peter 4:15
verses.text: A sota amen re omail en kamekameki kamela aramas, de lipirap, de me wia sued, de kauntenkoma en aramas a wiawia kan.

verses.name: I Peter 4:16
verses.text: A ma a kamekameki a saulang, a ender namenokki; a en kapinga Kot ni mepukat.

verses.name: I Peter 4:17
verses.text: Pwe a leler ansaun kamekam, me pan tapida sang ni tanpas en Kot; a ma a tapida re ’tail, ia pan imwi en me sota poson rongamau en Kot?

verses.name: I Peter 4:18
verses.text: A ma me apwal, en kamaureda me pung o, a ia wasa, me san Kot o me dipan akan pan pwaralang ia?

verses.name: I Peter 4:19
verses.text: Ari, irail me kamekam pan kupur en Kot, ren liki ong Kot melel ngen arail, ni arail wiawia mau.<div eID="gen2857" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Pet.4"/>

verses.name: I Peter 5:1
verses.text: I panaui saunkoa kan, me mi nan pung omail, pwe ngai pil kisan saunkoa kan o saunkadede en kamekam en Kristus, o pil iang pwaisaneki lingan, me pan kasansaleda.

verses.name: I Peter 5:2
verses.text: Komail kamanga pwin isou en Kot, me mi re omail, a kaidin mansairen, pwe ni insenemau ni omail ariri Kot, kaidin pweki moni, a ni peren o limpok.

verses.name: I Peter 5:3
verses.text: O kaidin akasaupeidi ong momodisou, a men kaalemongi, pwe pwin isou en ale sang.

verses.name: I Peter 5:4
verses.text: Ari, ni en silepa lapalap a pan pwarado, komail pan ale mar en lingan, me sota pan mongela.

verses.name: I Peter 5:5
verses.text: Pil dueta komail me pulepul akan, peiki ong me laud akan. Komail karos upa pena o tengedi ong opampap. Pwe Kot kin kotin palian me aklapalap akan, ap kotin maki ong me karakarak kan.

verses.name: I Peter 5:6
verses.text: Komail ari karakarak pan lim en Kot manaman, pwe a en kotin kasapwil komail ada, ni eu ansau me kon ong.

verses.name: I Peter 5:7
verses.text: Kadakadar ong i omail inong karos, pwe a kin kotin kupuro kin komail.

verses.name: I Peter 5:8
verses.text: Komail lelapok o masamasan, pwe omail imwintiti tewil koko sili dueta laien weriwer amen o raparapaki, me a pan katalala.

verses.name: I Peter 5:9
verses.text: Komail ari kelail palian i o tengeteng ni poson, o asa, me kamekam ota kin lel ong ri omail akan nin sappa,

verses.name: I Peter 5:10
verses.text: A Kot en mak karos, me kotin molipe komail wong a lingan soutuk, ren Kristus, pan kotin kaunsokala, o kakelada, o kamanada, o pasonedi, me pan kalokolok ansau motomot.

verses.name: I Peter 5:11
verses.text: I me udan manaman potopoteta! Amen.

verses.name: I Peter 5:12
verses.text: I inting wong komail kisin likau kis et ren Silwanus ri omail melel, duen me i kin lamelame, pwe i men panaui komail o katiti ong komail, me i eta mak melel en Kot, me komail en keleki.

verses.name: I Peter 5:13
verses.text: Irail, me iang komail pilipildar nan Papilon o nai ol Markus ara ranamau wong komail.

verses.name: I Peter 5:14
verses.text: Komail ranamauiki pena metik en limpok. Popol en mi re omail karos, me warok ki ong er Kristus! Amen.<div eID="gen2858" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1Pet.5"/> <div eID="gen2853" osisID="1Pet" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Peter 1:1
verses.text: IET ngai Simon Petrus ladu o wanporon en Iesus Kristus ong irail, me paikier poson kasampwal ota dueta kit, me kitail aleer ki pung en atail Kot o Saunkamaur Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Peter 1:2
verses.text: Mak o popol en roklang komail ki erpit en Kot o Iesus atail Kaun.

verses.name: II Peter 1:3
verses.text: Song en manaman en Kot karos, me itar ong maur o lelapok, kisakis dong kitail er, ki kupurkong en i, me kotin molipe kitail ki pein a lingan o manaman.

verses.name: II Peter 1:4
verses.text: Ni mepukat a kotin kisakis ki dong kitail inau lapalapia o kasampwalia kan, pwen kare ong komail maur en Kot, o tang wei sanger me sued akan, me mi sappa ki inong sued.

verses.name: II Peter 1:5
verses.text: Komail ari nantiong eta, kida sar mau ni omail poson, o ni sar mau lolekong.

verses.name: II Peter 1:6
verses.text: O ni lolekong koton, o ni koton kanongama, o ni kanongama lelapok.

verses.name: II Peter 1:7
verses.text: O ni lelapok limpok ong saulang kan, o ni limpok ong saulang kan limpok ong amen amen.

verses.name: II Peter 1:8
verses.text: Pwe ma mepukat mi re omail, o pwaida re omail, komail ap sota pan tanganga de so wa ni lolekongki atail Kaun Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Peter 1:9
verses.text: A me sota pwaisaneki mepukat, nan i maskun, o a kin dedam sili wasa, aki a monokela a wideud sang ni dip a dip en mas.

verses.name: II Peter 1:10
verses.text: Ri ai ko, i me komail nantiong katengedi omail paeker o pilipil, pwe ma komail pan wiada mepukat, komail sota pan pupedi.

verses.name: II Peter 1:11
verses.text: Pwe i me komail pan pedelongki peren nan wei soutuk en atail Kaun o Saunkamaur Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: II Peter 1:12
verses.text: I me i pan kataman kin komail ansau karos, menda ma komail asa mepukat, o komail keleki melel.

verses.name: II Peter 1:13
verses.text: I lamelame, a pung, i en kataman kin komail o kamanga komail da, arain ai pan mimieta nan im pwal wet.

verses.name: II Peter 1:14
verses.text: Pwe i asa, eten i pan pwilikidi war ai duen atail Kaun Iesus Kristus kotin masani ong ia er.

verses.name: II Peter 1:15
verses.text: A i pan nantiong, pwe komail en poden tamatamanda mepukat murin ai samala.

verses.name: II Peter 1:16
verses.text: Pwe se so idauenda kasoi widing ni at padaki ong komail duen manaman en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, o a kotin pan sapaledo, a pein kit kilanger a lingan.

verses.name: II Peter 1:17
verses.text: Pwe ni a kotin aleer wau o lingan sang ren Kot Sam ni ansau ngil eu peidido sang nan lingan lapalap katitiki: Iet nai Ol kompok, me I kin peren kida.

verses.name: II Peter 1:18
verses.text: Ngil wet, me peidido sang nanlang, se ronger ni at iang i mimieda pon dol saraui.

verses.name: II Peter 1:19
verses.text: Ari masan en kokop me pung melel re atail, o meid mau, komail en kasampwaleki dueta marain eu, me kin dakareda wasa rotorot lao ran pasang o usu ran pan pwara dang mongiong omail.

verses.name: II Peter 1:20
verses.text: Iet me komail en asa mas: Sota kokop nan puk saraui me tapida sang ren aramas.

verses.name: II Peter 1:21
verses.text: Pwe sota man kokop pwili sang ni insen en aramas amen, pwe aramas saraui en Kot akan kokopada mokimokidedi Ngen saraui.<div eID="gen2860" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Pet.1"/>

verses.name: II Peter 2:1
verses.text: A ren men Israel saukop likam kai pil mia, duen saunpadak likam me pan mi re omail, me pan kawailong do pwin sued kai, o re kin kamamki Kaun o, me dore ir ala, a i me re pan kare ong pein irail kaopar madang.

verses.name: II Peter 2:2
verses.text: O me toto pan idauen ar padak sapung, i me lamalam melel me pan kaankaururla.

verses.name: II Peter 2:3
verses.text: O pweki ar nonorok ni lokaia widing re pan paie kin komail; ari, kadeik par duen men mas sota pan pwand, o ar pakamekam sota kin moleilei.

verses.name: II Peter 2:4
verses.text: Pwe, ma Kot sota kotin kupura tounlang ko, me wiadar dip, a a kotin kase ir di lang nan pweleko, ap salie kidi sal mata en rotorot, nekineki ong ran en kadeik,

verses.name: II Peter 2:5
verses.text: O ma a sota kupura men kaua kan, a kamaureda Noa, saunpadak en lamalam pung, iangaki pil isimen, ni a kotiki ong toun sappa sued nolik lapalap.

verses.name: II Peter 2:6
verses.text: O a kotin wia kila pas kanim Sodom o Komora, o wukidedi, o kadeik ira da en ola, o wia kin ira kilel eu ong me san Kot akan, me pan pwarado mur.

verses.name: II Peter 2:7
verses.text: O a kotin kapitala Lot pung amen, me aramas sued wiai ong song en me sued karos ni ar tiak sued.

verses.name: II Peter 2:8
verses.text: Pwe i ol pung o kaukauson nan pung arail, kilekilang o rongerong ar wiawia, kupur a pung ap lokelokki ar wiawia sapung kaukaule.

verses.name: II Peter 2:9
