verses.text: A Kaun o kotin kak ong kamaiola sang ni songapan lelapok kan o nekinekid ong ran en kadeik me sapung kan, pwe ren kalokolok.

verses.name: II Peter 2:10
verses.text: A irail eta, me weweid ni inong samin en pali uduk, o mamaleki monsap akan, o laumaum, o katiwo, o somasak, o lalaue me lingan akan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:11
verses.text: A tounlang kan, me lapalap o kelail sang irail, sota kin lalaue o kadeik irail da mon Kaun o.

verses.name: II Peter 2:12
verses.text: A mepukat rasong man akan, me sota ar lamelam, me udan kileledier ong salidi o kamela, pwe re lalaue, me re sasa, o re pan mekila ar wiawia sued.

verses.name: II Peter 2:13
verses.text: Re pan ale kating en ar sapung. Re kin kasampwaleki kaped en manga ni ran o. Irail men kasamin, o kanamenok, o kin ponmasuki omail mairong, o sokraui omail kapwa.

verses.name: II Peter 2:14
verses.text: O por en mas arail me dir en kamal, o re sota kak dukedi sang wia dip, kotakotaue ir, me mongiong ar so teng, o mongiong arail nonorok, iei seri en rialar akan.

verses.name: II Peter 2:15
verses.text: Me kasela al inen, ap salongala, idedauen al en Pileam, nain Peor, me pok ong pwain en me sapung.

verses.name: II Peter 2:16
verses.text: A a pokoki dip a, man as lotong lokelokaia ki ngil en aramas, kapueoki sang saukop o ni a wiawia sapung.

verses.name: II Peter 2:17
verses.text: Irail me rasong utun pil matada, o dapok me melimel kin iririp sili; nan rotorot lapalap me nekinekid ong irail.

verses.name: II Peter 2:18
verses.text: Pwe re kin kida padak aklapalap, me sota kadepa, o ni ar wiawia samin, re kin kainong iong inong sued en uduk, irail me apton muei sang me sapungki padak likam.

verses.name: II Peter 2:19
verses.text: Re inauki ong irail, ren saledokala, a pein irail ladu en kasuedpar. Pwe melel, me amen lodi onger, i me a kin liduie kila.

verses.name: II Peter 2:20
verses.text: Pwe ma re pitila sang nan pwel en sappa, ki ar asaer Kaun o Saunkamaur Iesus Kristus, rap pur ong liseleping kila o lodi ong i nan ar wiawia en mur me sued sang men mas.

verses.name: II Peter 2:21
verses.text: Mak eta, ma re sota asa duen al en pung, sang ar asa, ap wuki wei sang kusoned saraui, me re aleer.

verses.name: II Peter 2:22
verses.text: Pwe, karaseras o pwaida re ’rail, me inda: Kiti men kin pur ong kang a mus, o pwik, me duduer, pur ong uledok nan pwel.<div eID="gen2861" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Pet.2"/>

verses.name: II Peter 3:1
verses.text: IET kisin likau kariau, me i inting wong komail, kompok kan, pwen kataman kin komail o kapirada ngen omail makelekel.

verses.name: II Peter 3:2
verses.text: Pwe komail en tamanda masan en saukop saraui kan, kusoned en Kaun o Saunkamaur, me wanporon oko, me pakadar wong komail, wa dong komail.

verses.name: II Peter 3:3
verses.text: O iet eta komail en asa, ni imwin ran akan aramas lalaue pan pwarado, me pan weweid ni pein ar inong sued.

verses.name: II Peter 3:4
verses.text: Indada: Ia kilel en a pan kotido? Pwe sang ni ran o, sam akan melar kokodo lel met, meakaros kin dueta nin tapi o.

verses.name: II Peter 3:5
verses.text: Pwe irail kin men ponsasa, me masia lang akan o sappa eu mia nan pil o, ap pwarada sang nan pil ki masan en Kot.

verses.name: II Peter 3:6
verses.text: I me sappa en mas o okilar nolik lapalap.

verses.name: II Peter 3:7
verses.text: Pil dueta lang akan o sappa en met nekinek kita masan ota ong kisiniai ni ran en kadeik o kampan aramas me san Kot akan.

verses.name: II Peter 3:8
verses.text: Kompok kan, iet eta komail en asa, me ran ta ieu o par kid ras pena ta ren Kaun o, o par kid o ran eu dupeneta.

verses.name: II Peter 3:9
verses.text: Kaun o sota kotin kapwandela inau o, duen akai kin kiki ong, pwe a kotin kanongama ong komail, pwe a sota kotin mauki, akai en lokidokila, pwe karos en wilikapala.

verses.name: II Peter 3:10
verses.text: A ran en Kaun o pan pwarado dueta lipirap amen. I dokan lang akan pan mor pasang ni morong lapalap o tapipa kan pan pei pasang ki kisiniai kel, o sappa o a dipisou kan pan rongala.

verses.name: II Peter 3:11
verses.text: Ari, ma mepukat karos pan ola, iaduen a pan re omail ni omail wiawia mau o lelapok,

verses.name: II Peter 3:12
verses.text: Pwe komail kin auiaui o inong iong ran en Kot, me lang akan pan rong kila kisiniai, o tapipa kan pei pasang, pwe karakar muletok.

verses.name: II Peter 3:13
verses.text: A kitail kin auiaui lang kap akan o sappa kap, wasa me lamalam pung pan wiaui, duen a kotin inaukidar.

verses.name: II Peter 3:14
verses.text: Kompok kan, pweki omail auiaui mepukat, komail en nantiong, pwe komail en diarokada re a so samin, o so sapung ni popol.

verses.name: II Peter 3:15
verses.text: Pwe komail asa duen kanongama en atail Kaun, pwe i kamaur pa ’mail, duen ri atail Paulus kompok inting wong komail er ni lolekong, me ko ong i.

verses.name: II Peter 3:16
verses.text: Duen a kasokasoi nan a kisin likau karos, a akai wasa me apwal en dedeki, me sololekong o so lolin akan kin kawukila, dueta ar pil kawukila masan tei kan, me pan kare ong irail pein ar lokidokila.

verses.name: II Peter 3:17
verses.text: Kompok kan, pweki omail asa mepukat, komail kalaka, pwe komail der sapung kila padak en me sued akan, ap pupedi sang katengeteng komail.

verses.name: II Peter 3:18
verses.text: A komail kairida ni mak o lolekongki padak en atail Kaun o Saunkamaur Iesus Kristus. I me kon ong en ale wau metet o kokolata lel ong ni ran soutuk.<div eID="gen2862" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2Pet.3"/> <div eID="gen2859" osisID="2Pet" type="book"/>

verses.name: I John 1:1
verses.text: ME kin mia sang ni tapi o, me se rongadar, me se kilang kier pein mas at, me se ududialer, o me pa at dokeer, iei masan en maur;

verses.name: I John 1:2
verses.text: O maur sansaledar, o se kilanger, o kadede, o padaki ong komail maur soutuk, me kotikot ren Sam, a ap sansal dong kitail.

verses.name: I John 1:3
verses.text: Me se kilanger, o ronger, iei me se pil katitiki ong komail, pwe komail en pil waroki ong kit. A kitail waroki ong Sam o Sapwilim a Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: I John 1:4
verses.text: Mepukat se intingiedi, pwe at peren en unsokala.

verses.name: I John 1:5
verses.text: A ietet padak, me se rong sang i, ap katitiki ong komail: Kot marain eu, o sota man rotorot mi re a.

verses.name: I John 1:6
verses.text: Ma kitail inda, me kitail waroki ong i ap weweid ni rotorot, kitail kin likam, ap sota wia melel.

verses.name: I John 1:7
verses.text: A ma kitail weweid ni marain, dueta i me kotikot ni marain, kitail warok penaer, o ntan Iesus Kristus sapwilim a Ol kamakele kitail sang ni dip karos.

verses.name: I John 1:8
verses.text: Ma kitail inda: Sota dip atail, kitail piti pein kitail, o melel sota mi re atail.

verses.name: I John 1:9
verses.text: A ma kitail weokada dip atail, i me melel o pung, en makeki ong kitail dip atail o kamine sang me sapung karos.

verses.name: I John 1:10
verses.text: Ma kitail inda: Kitail sota wiadar dip, kitail kalikame i, o a masan sota mi re atail.<div eID="gen2864" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1John.1"/>

verses.name: I John 2:1
verses.text: SAMA ko, mepukat i inting wong komail, pwe komail de wia dip, a ma amen wia dip, sauasa patail mia ren Sam, Iesus Kristus, me pung.

verses.name: I John 2:2
verses.text: Iei me tom en dip atail, a kaidin atail ta, pwe pil en toun sappa karos.

verses.name: I John 2:3
verses.text: I me kitail dedeki, me kitail asaer i, ma kitail kapwaiada kusoned akan.

verses.name: I John 2:4
verses.text: Me inda: I asa i, ap sota kapwaiada a kusoned akan, i me likam amen, melel sota mi re a.

verses.name: I John 2:5
verses.text: A me kapwaiada a masan, i me limpok en Kot unsokelar re a, i me kitail asaki, me kitail udan sapwilim a.

verses.name: I John 2:6
verses.text: Me kin inda: I potopot re a, mak eta, i en weweid wei dueta a kotin weweidier.

verses.name: I John 2:7
verses.text: Kompok kan, kaidin kusoned kap eu, me i inting wong komail, a kusoned en mas o, me mi re omail sang ni tapi o. Kusoned en mas, iei masan o, me komail ronger.

verses.name: I John 2:8
verses.text: Pil eu kusoned kap, me i inting wong komail, me melel re a o re omail, pwe rotorot mur tikitikla, a marain melel ap dakadar.

verses.name: I John 2:9
verses.text: Me inda, me a mi ni marain, ap kailong kin ri a, nan a mimieta ni rotorot lel met.

verses.name: I John 2:10
verses.text: Me kin pok ong ri a, pan mimieta ni marain, ap solar men kamakar mi re a.

verses.name: I John 2:11
verses.text: A me kin tataki ri a, mier ni rotorot, o weweid ni rotorot, ap kin sasa, wasa a kin ko ong ia, pwe rotorot karotongala mas a kan.

verses.name: I John 2:12
verses.text: I inting wong komail, sama ko, pwe dip omail lapwadar ki mar a.

verses.name: I John 2:13
verses.text: I inting wong komail, sam akan, pwe komail asa i, me kotikot eta sang ni tapi o. I inting wong komail manakap akan, pwe komail kaloedier me sued o. I inting wong komail er, sama ko, pwe komail asaer Sam.

verses.name: I John 2:14
verses.text: I inting wong komail er, sam akan, pwe komail asa i, me kotikot sang ni tapi o. I inting wong komail er, manakap akan, pwe komail me kelail, o masan en Kot en mimieta re omail, o komail kaloedier me sued o.

verses.name: I John 2:15
verses.text: Der pok ong sappa, de dipisou mimi sappa. Ma amen pok ong sappa, limpok en Sam me sota mi re a.

verses.name: I John 2:16
verses.text: Pwe meakaros mi sappa, inong en ni uduk, o inong en ni mas oko, o lingan mal en maur, a sota tapida sang ren Sam, a sang ni sappa.

verses.name: I John 2:17
verses.text: A sappa pan sorola o a me sued akan, a me wia kupur en Kot, pan mimieta kokolata.

verses.name: I John 2:18
verses.text: Sama ko, metet imwin auer o, o duen omail ronger, me kristus likam pan pwarado, nan ansau wet kristus likam me toto, me pwaradar, i me kitail asaki, met imwin auer leler.

verses.name: I John 2:19
verses.text: Irail me kola sang kitail, a kaidin kis atail, pwe ma irail kis atail, re pan mimieta re atail. A irail kola sang kitail, pwen sansal, me kaidin irail karos kis atail.

verses.name: I John 2:20
verses.text: A komail keidier ren me saraui, o komail asaer meakaros.

verses.name: I John 2:21
verses.text: I sota inting wong komail er, dene sota asa duen melel, a pwe komail asa, o likam so tapida sang ni melel.

verses.name: I John 2:22
verses.text: Is me likam amen? Kaidin i, me kamamada me Iesus udan Kristus. I me kristus likam, me kamama kida Sam o Na.

verses.name: I John 2:23
verses.text: Amen amen, me kamam kida Na, nan Sam pil sota mi re a, a me ponasa Na, i me pil sapwilim en Sam.

verses.name: I John 2:24
verses.text: Me komail ronger sang ni tapi o, en potopoteta re omail. Ma a pan mimi re omail, me komail ronger sang ni tapi o, komail ap pil pan potopot ren Na o Sam.

verses.name: I John 2:25
verses.text: A iet inau o, me a kotin inauki ong kitail er: Maur soutuk.

verses.name: I John 2:26
verses.text: Mepukat me i inting wong komail er duen irail, me kasapunge komail.

verses.name: I John 2:27
verses.text: A omail kei, me komail aleer re a, pan mimieta re omail. Komail ap solar mau ong, amen en padaki ong komail. A duen kei wet kin padaki ong komail meakaros, iduen me melel, a kaidin likam pot, o duen a padaki ong komail er, iduen komail en dadaurata.

verses.name: I John 2:28
verses.text: Ari sama ko, podidi ong i, pwe ni a pan kotin pwarado, kitail en aima, a so namenok mo a, ni a kotin pwarado.

verses.name: I John 2:29
verses.text: Ma komail asa, me i me pung, komail en pil asa, meamen, me wia me pung, me ipwi sang i er.<div eID="gen2865" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1John.2"/>

verses.name: I John 3:1
verses.text: KILANG song en limpok lapalap, me Sam kotiki dong kitail er, pwe kitail en adane kila seri en Kot, ari, iei kitail. I me sappa sasa kin kitail, pwe re kin sasa i.

verses.name: I John 3:2
verses.text: Kompok kan, kitail ari seri en Kot, ap saikenta sansal, da me kitail pan wiala. Ari so, kitail asa, ni a pwarado, kitail pan duäla i, pwe kitail pan kilang i ni udan mom a.

verses.name: I John 3:3
verses.text: O amen amen, me kaporopor due met, a en kamakelekele pein i duen i me makelekel.

verses.name: I John 3:4
verses.text: Amen amen me kin wia dip, pil kin palian kapung, pwe iei dip palian kapung.

verses.name: I John 3:5
verses.text: O komail asa, i me a pwarado, pwen lapwada dip akan. A dip sota kin mi re a.

verses.name: I John 3:6
verses.text: Meamen, me pot re a, sota kin wia dip; meamen wia dip, sota kilang i o sota dedeki.

verses.name: I John 3:7
verses.text: Sama ko, kalaka, pwe amen de kasapunga komail. Me kin wia pung, nan i me pung amen, due i me pung.

verses.name: I John 3:8
verses.text: Me kin wia dip, i nain tewil, pwe tewil me wia dip sang ni tapi o. I me Sapwilim en Kot kotin pwarado, pwen kawela wiawia en tewil.

verses.name: I John 3:9
verses.text: Meamen me ipwi sang Kot, sota kin wia dip, pwe war a mi re a, o a so kak wia dip, pwe a ipwi sang ren Kot.

verses.name: I John 3:10
verses.text: I me seri en Kot o seri en tewil sansale kida, me so wia me pung, i me so sang ren Kot, o me so pok ong ri a.

verses.name: I John 3:11
verses.text: Pwe iet padak, me komail ronger sang ni tapi o, kitail en pokepoke pena.

verses.name: I John 3:12
verses.text: Kaidin due Kain, me udan me sued amen, ap kamela ri a. Ari, menda a kamela i? Aki a wiawia me sued, a en ri a me pung.

verses.name: I John 3:13
verses.text: Ri ai ko, der puriamuiki, ma men sappa kin tata kin komail.

verses.name: I John 3:14
verses.text: Kitail asa, me kitail daulier mela, ap ko ong maur, pwe kitail kin pok ong ri atail akan. Ari, me so limpok, pan mimieta nan mela.

verses.name: I John 3:15
verses.text: Meamen, me kin tata ki ri a, nan i me kamela men. A komail asa, maur soutuk sota kin mi ren me kamela men.

verses.name: I John 3:16
verses.text: I me kitail diar kida limpok. A kotiki wei maur pweki kitail; kitail ari pwaipwandeki maur atail ong ri atail akan.

verses.name: I John 3:17
verses.text: Meamen me muei met ap kilang ri a dupokala, ap sota sauasa i, iaduen limpok en Kot pan kak mi re a?

verses.name: I John 3:18
verses.text: Sama ko, kitail der pok pena ni lokaia ta o lo, a ni wiawia o melel pot.

verses.name: I John 3:19
verses.text: I me kitail pan asaki, me kitail kisan melel, o kainsenemauiela mongiong atail re a,

verses.name: I John 3:20
verses.text: Pwe ma mongiong atail kadeikada kitail, nan Kot me lapa sang mongiong atail o lelapokki meakan karos.

verses.name: I John 3:21
verses.text: Kompok kan, ma mongiong atail so kadeikada kitail, nan kitail aima ong Kot.

verses.name: I John 3:22
verses.text: O meakot kitail poeki re a, kitail pan tungole sang i, pwe kitail nekinekid a kusoned akan, o wiada meakan, me a kin pole kila.

verses.name: I John 3:23
verses.text: Ietet a kusoned: Kitail en poson mar en sapwilim a Ol Iesus Kristus, o poke pena, duen a kotiki ong kitail kusoned o.

verses.name: I John 3:24
verses.text: A me kin nekinekid a kusoned akan, pan pot re a, o i pan kotikot re a; o iet me kitail asaki, a kotikot re atail: Ngen o, me a kupurai dong kitail er.<div eID="gen2866" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1John.3"/>

verses.name: I John 4:1
verses.text: KOMPOK kan, komail der poson ngen karos, a kasaui song en ngen akan, ma re tapida sang ren Kot. Pwe saukop likam me toto kaparapar sili sappa.

verses.name: I John 4:2
verses.text: Iet me komail asaki Ngen en Kot: Ngen karos, me kadede, me Iesus Kristus koti dong uduk, nan i me tapida sang ren Kot.

verses.name: I John 4:3
verses.text: O ngen karos, me so kadede, Iesus a sota tapida sang ren Kot, Nan i kristus likam, duen me komail ronger, me a pan pwarado, nan a mier sappa metet.

verses.name: I John 4:4
verses.text: Sama ko, komail tapi sang ren Kot o kaloe irail edi, pwe i, me kotikot re omail, me lapa sang i, me mi ni sappa.

verses.name: I John 4:5
verses.text: Irail me udan sappa, iei me irail lokaiaki sappa, o sappa kin rong irail.

verses.name: I John 4:6
verses.text: Kitail tapi sanger ren Kot, me asa Kot, kin rong kitail. A me so sang ren Kot, sota kin rong kitail. Iei me kitail asaki Ngen en melel, o me udan likam.

verses.name: I John 4:7
verses.text: Kompok kan, kitail kin poke pena, pwe limpok tapi sang ren Kot, A amen amen, me kin limpok, ipwi sang ren Kot, o a asa Kot.

verses.name: I John 4:8
verses.text: Me so kin limpok, sasa Kot, pwe Kot udan limpok.

verses.name: I John 4:9
verses.text: Ni met limpok en Kot sansal dong kitail: Kot kotin porone dong sappa sapwilim a Ieros eu, pwe kitail en maur ki i.

verses.name: I John 4:10
verses.text: Ietet pason en limpok, kaidin kitail me tapin limpok ong Kot, pwe a tapin pok ong kitail, o poronedo sapwilim a Ol, wiala sauntom pan dip atail.

verses.name: I John 4:11
verses.text: Kompok kan, ma Kot kin limpoki ong kitail due met, kitail en pil limpok pena.

verses.name: I John 4:12
verses.text: Sota me kilanger Kot ni ansau eu. Ma kitail limpok pena, nan Kot pan kotikot re atail, o a limpok me unsokelar re atail.

verses.name: I John 4:13
verses.text: I me kitail asaki, me kitail mimieta re a, o a kotikot re atail, pwe a kotin kupurai dong kitail er Ngen i.

verses.name: I John 4:14
verses.text: O se kilanger o kadededa, me Sam poronedo sapwilim a Ol, en wiala Saunkamaur pan sappa.

verses.name: I John 4:15
verses.text: Meamen me ponasa Iesus, me Sapwilim en Kot, nan Kot me kotikot re a, o i ren Kot.

verses.name: I John 4:16
verses.text: O kitail dedekier o kamelele limpok, me Kot kotin wiai ong kitail. Kot me limpok, o me kin potopot ni limpok, kin potopot ren Kot, o Kot kotikot re a.

verses.name: I John 4:17
verses.text: Iet unsok en atail limpok: Kitail pan aima ni ran en kadeik, pwe duen i, iduen kitail nin sappa et.

verses.name: I John 4:18
verses.text: Sota masak ni limpok, pwe limpok melel kin kausa sang masak, pwe masak kin kareda kamekam. Ari, me kin masak, nan a limpok saikenta unsokala.

verses.name: I John 4:19
verses.text: Kitail kin limpok, pwe i me kotin tapiadar pok ong kitail.

verses.name: I John 4:20
verses.text: Ma amen kin inda: I kin pok ong Kot, ap kin sempok ong ri a, nan i me likam amen, pwe me kin sempok ong ri a, me a kilanger, da a pan kak pok ong Kot, me a sota kilanger?

verses.name: I John 4:21
verses.text: A kusoned pot et kitail aleer sang re a, me i, me pok ong Kot, en pil pok ong ri a.<div eID="gen2867" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1John.4"/>

verses.name: I John 5:1
verses.text: MEAMEN me kamelele, me Iesus me Kristus, nan i me ipwi sang ren Kot, o me kin pok ong me kaipwidi i, kin pil pok ong, me ipwi sanger.

verses.name: I John 5:2
verses.text: I me kitail asaki, me kitail pok ong seri en Kot akan, ni atail pok ong Kot o oke a kusoned akan.

verses.name: I John 5:3
verses.text: Iet limpok ong Kot, atail kapwaiada a kusoned akan, a a kusoned akan me sota apwal.

verses.name: I John 5:4
verses.text: Pwe meamen, me ipwi sang ren Kot, kin kaloedi sappa. Iet pai en pei, me kaloedier sappa, atail poson.

verses.name: I John 5:5
verses.text: Is me kaloedi sappa, kaidin i eta, me kamelele, me Iesus Sapwilim en Kot?

verses.name: I John 5:6
verses.text: I met, me kokido pil o nta, Iesus Kristus; kaidin pil eta, pwe pil o nta. Ngen me kadedeki, pwe Ngen melel.

verses.name: I John 5:7
verses.text: Irail me silimen me kadede:

verses.name: I John 5:8
verses.text: Ngen, o pil, o nta; irail kin minimin pena.

verses.name: I John 5:9
verses.text: Ma kitail kamelele kadede en aramas akan, nan kadede en Kot me lap sang, pwe i en Kot a kadede me a kotin kadedeki sapwilim a Ol.

verses.name: I John 5:10
verses.text: Me kamelele Sapwilim en Kot, a men kadede mi lole, me so kin kamelele Kot, kin kalikame i, pwe a sota kamelele kadede en Kot duen sapwilim a Ol,

verses.name: I John 5:11
verses.text: A iet kadede o: Kot me kotiki ong kitail er maur soutuk; a i song en maur mi ren sapwilim a Ol.

verses.name: I John 5:12
verses.text: Me aneki Na, i me aneki maur, a me sota aneki Sapwilim en Kot, a pil sota aneki maur.

verses.name: I John 5:13
verses.text: Mepukat i inting wong komail er, pwe komail en asa, me maur soutuk mi re omail, a komail, me poson mar en Sapwilim en Kot.

verses.name: I John 5:14
verses.text: O iet at kaporopor kaperen: Meakot kitail poeki re a duen kupur a, a kotin mangi kitail.

verses.name: I John 5:15
verses.text: A ma kitail asa, me a kotin mangi kitail, iran meakot kitail poeki re a, kitail ap asa, me kitail pwais anekier, me kitail kapakapaki.

verses.name: I John 5:16
verses.text: Meamen me kilangada ri a wia dip, me so imwilang mela, i en kapakapaki, Kot ap pan kotiki ong i maur, ong ir, me so wia dip, me udan mela. A eu song en dip mia, me imwilang mela, duen song en i sota inda, meamen en kapakapaki.

verses.name: I John 5:17
verses.text: Sapung karos me dip, a song en dip mia, me sota imwilang mela.

verses.name: I John 5:18
verses.text: Kitail asa, meamen me ipwi sang ren Kot, sota kin wia dip; a me ipwi sang ren Kot, apapwali pein i, a men sued o sota pan doke i.

verses.name: I John 5:19
verses.text: Kitail asa, me kitail tapi sang ren Kot, a sappa karos mi ni me sued.

verses.name: I John 5:20
verses.text: A kitail asa, me Sapwilim en Kot pwarador, kalolekong kitail er, pwe kitail en asa i me melel, o kitail kisan i me melel, iei sapwilim a Iesus Kristus. I me Kot melel o maur soutuk.

verses.name: I John 5:21
verses.text: Sama ko, kalaka pein komail sang dikedik en ani kan!<div eID="gen2868" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="1John.5"/> <div eID="gen2863" osisID="1John" type="book"/>

verses.name: II John 1:1
verses.text: IET ngai me laud o ranamau wong li lipilipil o na seri kan, me i kin pokepoke melel; a kaidin ngai ta, pwe pil irail karos, me asa melel,

verses.name: II John 1:2
verses.text: Pweki melel o, me mi re atail, o a pan mi re atail kokolata.

verses.name: II John 1:3
verses.text: Mak o kalangan, o popol pan mi re atail sang ren Kot Sam, o sang ren Iesus Kristus, me Sapwilim en Sam ni melel o limpok.

verses.name: II John 1:4
verses.text: I ap peren kida kaualap, pwe i diaradar, me akai noum seri kan alialu wei ta ni melel, duen atail aleer kusoned sang ren Sam.

verses.name: II John 1:5
verses.text: Ari, i poeki re omui, Maing, kaidin kusoned kap pot, me i inting wong komui, a me kitail aleer sang ni tapi o kitail en pololol pena.

verses.name: II John 1:6
verses.text: A iet limpok, pwe sen alu weita duen a kusoned akan. A met kusoned o, duen komail ronger sang ni tapi, sen alialuta ia.

verses.name: II John 1:7
verses.text: Men kotaue me toto pwara dong sappa, me sota kin kadede, me Iesus Kristus wia uduk ala, i men kotaue o kristus likam o.

verses.name: II John 1:8
verses.text: Komail kalaka pein komail, pwe omail pai, me komail dodok ong er, de salongala a komail en ale pwaipwai pokon.

verses.name: II John 1:9
verses.text: Meamen me dauli mepukat, o me sota tengedi ong padak en Kristus, a sota paieki Kot; a me tengedi ong padak o, i me paiekier karos, Sam o sapwilim a Ol.

verses.name: II John 1:10
verses.text: Ma amen ko dong komail, me sota wado padak et, der kasamo long ong nan im omail, o der ranamaui i.

verses.name: II John 1:11
verses.text: Pwe me kin ranamaui i, a pan pwaisaneki a wiawia sued.

verses.name: II John 1:12
verses.text: Kasoi me toto mi re i, me i men inting wong komail, a i sota pan wiaki ki kisin likau o ink, pwe i kaporoporeki, me i pan pwara wong komail, kitail ap pan kasoi pena, pwe atail peren en unsokela.

verses.name: II John 1:13
verses.text: Ari, nain ri om li lipilipil seriko me ranamau wong komui. Amen.<div eID="gen2870" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="2John.1"/> <div eID="gen2869" osisID="2John" type="book"/>

verses.name: III John 1:1
verses.text: IET ngai me laud o ranamau wong Kaius kompok, me i kin pokopoke melel.

verses.name: III John 1:2
verses.text: Kompoke pa i, i kin men, koe en pwaida o roson ni wiawia karos duen ngen om me pwaida.

verses.name: III John 1:3
verses.text: Pwe i peren kida kaualap, ri atail oko lao pwarado, katitiki ong ia duen om melel o duen om kin alialu wei ta ni melel.

verses.name: III John 1:4
verses.text: Sota ai peren me lapa sang met, ni ai rong duen nai seri kan, me kin alu wei ta ni melel.

verses.name: III John 1:5
verses.text: Kompoke pa i, me mau, me koe kin wiai ong ri atail o pil men kairu kan,

verses.name: III John 1:6
verses.text: Me katitiki ong momodisou duen om limpok; me mau, ma koe pan sauasa irail, duen me kon ong Kot.

verses.name: III John 1:7
verses.text: Pweki mar a re kin koko wei ta, sota tungole meakot ren men liki kan.

verses.name: III John 1:8
verses.text: I me kitail en sauasa song due met, pwe kitail en wia sauas pan melel.

verses.name: III John 1:9
verses.text: Meakot i intingki wonger momodisou, a Diotrepes me akasaumas ong irail, sota duki ong kit.

verses.name: III John 1:10
verses.text: Ari, i lao pwara wei, i pan katamanki i a wiawia kan, me a kin wiada, pwe a kin lokaia sued duen kit. A kaidin i eta, pwe pein i sota kin kasamo ri atail ko, ap pil inapwiedi, me kin men apwali ir, o kasapok ir ala sang nan momodisou.

verses.name: III John 1:11
verses.text: Kompoke pa i, der idauen me sued a me mau. Me kin wia me mau, me sang ren Kot, a me kin wia me sued, sota kilanger Kot.

verses.name: III John 1:12
verses.text: Demetrius indand ren amen amen o pil ni melel. O kit pil kadededa, a koe asa, me at kadede me melel.

verses.name: III John 1:13
verses.text: Kasoi toto me mi re i, me i kak inting wong uk, a i sota men intingki ink o men inting.

verses.name: III John 1:14
verses.text: A i kaporoporeki, me koren, me i pan kilang uk, kita ap pan kasokasoi pena.

verses.name: III John 1:15
verses.text: Popol en mi re om. Kompok kan kin ranamau wong uk. Ranamauieki kompok kan mar arail.<div eID="gen2872" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="3John.1"/> <div eID="gen2871" osisID="3John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:1
verses.text: IUDAS, ladu en Iesus Kristus amen, o ri en Iakopus, ranamau wong irail, me pilipildar o me kompoke pan Kot Sam, o me nekinek ren Iesus Kristus.

verses.name: Jude 1:2
verses.text: Kalangan, o popol, o limpok en rokalang komail!

verses.name: Jude 1:3
verses.text: Kompok kan, ni ai ngongki kaualap, inting wong komail ekis, duen atail dorela ni lamalam ta pot, i men inting wong komail o panaui komail, en upaliki poson, me udan pangalang saraui kan.

verses.name: Jude 1:4
verses.text: Pwe aramas akai wailong ong, me ar pakadeik mia sang mas o: Irail me doo sang Kot, o re kawukila mak en Kot, ong kapwaiada inong sued en uduk, o re kamameki Kot o atail Kaun Iesus Kristus, me iei eta Kaun.

verses.name: Jude 1:5
verses.text: Komail asaer meakaros, ari so, i men kataman kin komail, me Kaun o kotin sauasa sapwilim a aramas akan ren men Äkipten, a mur a kotin kame ir ala, me sota poson.

verses.name: Jude 1:6
verses.text: O tounlang kai, me sota kasampwaleki arail koa, ap muei sang udan deu arail, a kotin nekid kin arail sal mata soutik ni wasa rotorot ong ran en kadeik lapalap.

verses.name: Jude 1:7
verses.text: Dueta Sodom, O Komora, o kanim akan, me mi imp ara, me pil nenenek nin tiak ota, dueta ira, o inong iong uduk toror, ap wiala kilel eu, ni ar kamekameki kisiniai soutik.

verses.name: Jude 1:8
verses.text: I dueta mepukat, me kalap auramen, kin kasaminela uduk, o sota duki ong kaun o, lalaue me lingan akan.

verses.name: Jude 1:9
verses.text: A Mikael, tounlang lapalap amen, ni a akamai ong tewil, akakamaiki kalep en Moses, a sota kotin aingar ong lalaue o kadeikada i, pwe a kotin masanier: Kaun en kotin kapung ong uk!

verses.name: Jude 1:10
verses.text: A mepukat kin lalaue, me re sasa; a meakan me re udan asa, dueta man akan, me sota ar lamalam, kawela pein irail.

verses.name: Jude 1:11
verses.text: Suedi ong irail! Irail weweid kier al en Kain, o re lodi ong pakotaue en Pileam pweki moni, o ni ar kangudi dueta Kora, re mekilar,

verses.name: Jude 1:12
verses.text: Ir pukat me kaopan omail kamadip limpok kan, ni ar sokrau somasak o kamanga pein irail. Re rasong dapok madekong kan, me ang kin wewa sili, o rasong tuka, me so ta o so wa kan mia, me melar pan riapak, o solar due ’rail.

verses.name: Jude 1:13
verses.text: Re rasong iluk en matau, me pungpung potpoteta, kapwereda pein ar kanamenok kan, rasong moal en usu, ap nekinek ong rotorot soutuk.

verses.name: Jude 1:14
verses.text: Enok kaisimen murin Adam pil kokop duen irail masanier: Kilang, Kaun o kotido iang sapwilim a saraui kan, me kid ngeder.

verses.name: Jude 1:15
verses.text: Pwen kadeikada karos, o kapungada me sang Kot akan karos, pweki ar dodok o wiawia sued akan, me re wiadar ni ar doo sang Kot, o pil ar lokaia sued, me irail dipan akan wiai ong i.

verses.name: Jude 1:16
verses.text: Mepukat kin lipaned o pilipil en pan moli ansau karos, aki ar kapwaiada ar inong sued, o irail aklapalap ni ar lokaia, o lipilipil sansal en aramas pweki moni.

verses.name: Jude 1:17
verses.text: A komail, kompok kan, tamanda masan akan, me wanporon en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus akan masanier mas o,

verses.name: Jude 1:18
verses.text: Ni ar masani ong komail, me aramas lalaue pan pwarado ni imwin ansau, me san Kot, ap kekeideki pein ar inong sued.

verses.name: Jude 1:19
verses.text: Ir pukat kin kamueit pasang saulang kan, irail me pali uduk eta, a sota ngen arail.

verses.name: Jude 1:20
verses.text: A komail kompok kan, kaua kida pein komail omail poson melel, o saraui, o kapakapaki Ngen saraui.

verses.name: Jude 1:21
verses.text: Nekinek pein komail ni limpok en Kot, o kaporoporeki kalangan en atail Kaun Iesus Kristus ong maur soutuk.

verses.name: Jude 1:22
verses.text: O akai irail me peikasal, komail kadek ong,

verses.name: Jude 1:23
verses.text: Saro kin ir wei sang nan kisiniai o dore ir ala. O kadek ong me tei kan ni masak. O komail pil suedeki likau samin en pali uduk.

verses.name: Jude 1:24
verses.text: A i me kak pera komail, sang omail pan depikelekel, o kamotan di ong komail mon a lingan, makelekel, o pereperen,

verses.name: Jude 1:25
verses.text: I Kot eta Saunkamaur patail, ren Iesus Kristus atail Kaun lingan, lomin, o wiawia, o manaman en ko ong, met o potopot eta kokolata! Amen.<div eID="gen2874" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Jude.1"/> <div eID="gen2873" osisID="Jude" type="book"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:1
verses.text: IET kasale pan Iesus Kristus, me Kot kotiki ong i, en kasale ong sapwilim a ladu kan meakai, me pan wiaui met koren. A kotin poronela sapwilim a tounlang, me a kotin kasaleki ong sapwilim a ladu Ioanes.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:2
verses.text: Me kadedeki masan en Kot, o kadede pan Iesus Kristus karos, me a kilanger.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:3
verses.text: Meid pai, me wadokedi o ir, me rong masan en kokop akan, o nekinekid me intingidier lole, pwe ansau me koren.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:4
verses.text: Iet ngai Ioanes, ong momodisou isu nan Asien: Mak o popol ong komail sang ren i, me kotikot met, o me kotikot mas o, o me pan kotido, o sang ren Ngen isu, me kotikot mon mol a,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:5
verses.text: O sang ren Iesus Kristus, me saunkadede melel, me meseni ren me iasadar sang ren me melar akan, o Kaun en nanmarki en sappa kan, me kotin kupura kitail o widen sang kitail dip atail ki nta,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:6
verses.text: O kotin wia kin kitail er samero ong Kot o Sam a. Lingan o manaman en mi re a kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:7
verses.text: Kilang, a kotido nan dapok kan, o mas karos pan kilang i, o irail me doke i, o kainok en sappa karos pan sangesangki i. Melel, Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:8
verses.text: Ngai Alpa o Omeka, me Kaun Kot kotin masani, me kotikot eta, o me kotikot mas o, o me pan kotido, iei Dinkel amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:9
verses.text: Ngai Ioanes, ri omail, o omail warok ni kamekam, o ni wei, o ni atail auiaui Iesus, i lel dong nin dake o, me ad a Patmos, ki masan en Kot o kadede pan Iesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:10
verses.text: Ngen saraui kotikot po i ni ran en Kaun, i ap rongadar mur i ngil laud eu, me rasong ngil en koronete masani:

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:11
verses.text: Me koe kilang, intingiedi nan puk eu, ap kadar wong momodisou isu en Episus, o Smirna, o Perkamus, o Tiatira, o Sardes, o Piladelpia, o Laodisea.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:12
verses.text: I ap soupei ong, en kilang ngil o, me kasoi ong ia. A i lao soupeilar, i kilang lamp kold isu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:13
verses.text: O nan pung en lamp akan amen mia, me rasong Nain aramas, likauie kida likau eu, me leldi ong aluwilu a, o lukom kida ni maramar waiwai kold eu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:14
verses.text: A kadokenmai o pit en peipei puetepueteta wun en sip puetepuet, o rasong sno, o silang i rasong umpul en kisiniai,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:15
verses.text: O aluwilu a rasong pras lingan likamata a lingaling nan kisiniai, o kapitie rasong ngirsok en pil toto.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:16
verses.text: O ni lim a pali maun usu isu mia, o sang nan silang i kodlas kong o au a riau u wei sang, o silang i rasong katipin, sirang kelailia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:17
verses.text: A ni ai kilang i, i ap pupedi ni aluwilu a dueta mela amen. O a kotikidang po i lim a pali maun mamasani: Ender masak, ngai men mas o men mur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:18
verses.text: O me maur men, o ai melar amen, ari kilang, i memaureta kokolata, o men kapir en mela o wasan mela mi re i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:19
verses.text: Koe ari intingiedi meakan, me koe kilanger, o me mier, o me pan wiaui mur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:20
verses.text: Wewe en usu isu, me koe kilanger nan pa i pali maun, o lamp kold isu. Usu isu, iei tounlang en momodisou isu, o lamp isu, iei momodisou isu.<div eID="gen2876" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.1"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:1
verses.text: INTING wong tounlang en momodisou en Episus: Iet masan en i, me kolekoleta ni lim a pali maun usu isu, o me kin weweid nan pung en lamp kold isu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:2
verses.text: I asa om wiawia kan, o om dodok, o om dadaurata, o duen om sota kin mauki me sued akan, o koe kasaui ir adar, me akawanporon, a me so, ap diar ir ada me likam.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:3
verses.text: O koe kin kanongama ong o kadokeki mar ai, ap sota pangadar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:4
verses.text: A iet me I suedeki re om: Koe muei sanger tapin om limpok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:5
verses.text: Koe ari tamanda, me koe pupe wei sanger, o kalula, o kapwaiada wiawia en mas o; a ma so, I pan ko dong uk, kasau wei sang om lamp sang ni deu a, ma koe sota kalula.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:6
verses.text: A iet me koe kin wia, koe kin suedeki wiawia en nain Nikolaus akan, me I pil kin suedeki.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:7
verses.text: Me salong a mia, i en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan! Me dadaurata, I pan ki ong i, en tungole sang tuka en kamaur, me mi nan paradis en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:8
verses.text: Inting wong tounlang en momodisou en Smirna: Iet masan en men mas o men mur, me melar ap mauredar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:9
verses.text: I asa om kamekam, o om samama ari so, koe me kapwapwa, o lalaue en ir, me kin inda, dene irail men Sus, a kaidin irail men Sus, pwe pwin en Satan eu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:10
verses.text: Koe der masak, me koe pan kalokolokki. Kilang, tewil o pan kaselong ong nan imateng akai komail, pwe komail en kasongesong, o komail pan kalokolok ran eisok. Dadaurata lel mela. I ap pan ki ong uk mar en maur soutuk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:11
verses.text: Me salong a mia, i en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan! Me dadaurata, sota pan kamekam kila mela kariau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:12
verses.text: Inting wong tounlang en momodisou en Perkamus: Iet masan en me na kodlas kong o au riau mia:

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:13
verses.text: I asa, wasa koe kauson ia, ni wasan mol en Satan, o koe kin podidi ong mar ai, o koe sota kamama kida om poson ia pil so ni ran oko, me Antipas, ai saunkadede melel men, kamekamelar nan pung omail, wasa Satan kin kauson ia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:14
verses.text: A ekis tikitik ta, me I suedeki re om: Akai mi re om, me kin apwali lamalam en Pileam, me padaki ong Palak, en kasedi ong mon kadaudok en Israel kasapung par, ren tungole kisin man, me olu onger dikedik en ani kan, o ren nenek.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:15
verses.text: O pil akai mi re om, me pil apwali lamalam en nain Nikolaus akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:16
verses.text: Ari, kalula! A ma so, I pan madang wong uk o pepei ong irail ki kodlas en au ai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:17
verses.text: Me salong a mia, i en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan! Me dadaurata, I pan ki ong i mana sosansal, o I pan ki ong i takai puetepuet eu o nan takai mar kap intingidier, sota amen me dedeki, i eta, me pan ale.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:18
verses.text: Inting wong tounlang en momodisou en Tiatira: Iet masan en me Sapwilim en Kot, me silang i rasong umpul en kisiniai o aluwilu a rasong pras lingan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:19
verses.text: I asa om wiawia kan, o om limpok, o om poson, o om papa, o om kanongama, o duen om wiawia men mur, me toto sang men mas.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:20
verses.text: A iet me I suedeki re om: Koe kin mueid ong li Isepel, me kin inda duen pein i, dene i saukop amen, me kin padaki o kotaue nai ladu kan, ren nenek, o ren tungole, me olu ong dikedik en ani.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:21
verses.text: O I ki ong i er ansau en kalula, a a kang kalukila a nenek.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:22
verses.text: Kilang, I pan kasedi i nan los, o irail me kin kamal re a, nan kamekam lapalap, ma re sota pan kalukila wiawia en Isepel akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:23
verses.text: O I pan kamekila na seri kan kamekam eu. Ari, momodisou karos pan asaki, me ngai i, me kin irerong nan mudilik o mongiong kan, o I pan ki ong amen amen komail iran omail wiawia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:24
verses.text: A I indai ong komail tei kan, me mi Tiatira, karos me sota apwali lamalam wet, me so dedeki widing en Satan, duen ar lokaia. I sota pan ki ong komail eu katoutou pa ’mail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:25
verses.text: A me mi re omail, kolekoleta, I lao pwarado.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:26
verses.text: O me dadaurata o me kanekid ai wiawia kan lel imwi, i me I pan kasapwilada pon wei kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:27
verses.text: A pan kaun kida ir sokon mata, due dal en saupal kin ola kaualap, o due I pil aleer mana sang ren Sam ai,

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:28
verses.text: I ap pan ki ong i usu ran.

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:29
verses.text: Me salong a mia, i en rong me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan!<div eID="gen2877" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.2"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:1
verses.text: INTING wong tounlang en momodisou en Sardes: Iet masan en me Ngen en Kot isu o usu isu mi re a: I asa om wiawia kan, o me mar en maur mi re om, a so, koe melar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:2
verses.text: Pirida, katenge me lua, me nok mela, pwe I sota diaradar, me om wiawia kan unsokela ren ai Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:3
verses.text: I me koe en tamanda, duen koe tungoler, o ronger, o kanekid, o kalula. Ma koe sota pan pirida, I pan pwarado due lipirap amen, o koe pan sasa auer, me I pan pwara dong uk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:4
verses.text: A mar malaulau mi re om nan Sardes, me sota kapwelepwel lar ar likau kan, re pan alialu re i nan likau puetepuet, pwe re kon ong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:5
verses.text: Me dadaurata, pan kapwad kida likau puetepuet, o I sota pan irise sang nan puk en maur mar a. O I pan kadede mar a mon Sam ai o mon na tounlang kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:6
verses.text: Me salong a mia en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:7
verses.text: Inting wong tounlang en momodisou en Piladelpia: Iet masan en me saraui, me melel, me men kapir en Dawid mi re a, me kin ritingida, o sota amen, me kak ritingidi, o me kin ritingidi, o sota amen, me kak ritingida.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:8
verses.text: I asa om wiawia kan. Kilang, I ki ong uk er wanim ritidar eu o sota amen, me kak ritingidi, pwe om kel me tikitik, o koe kin kanekid ai masan, o koe sota kamam kidar mar ai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:9
verses.text: Kilang, I kanain kin uk akai, me udan pwin en Satan, kisan irail, me akasus, a so, re likam. Kilang, I pan kainong ir do, en pongi ni nä om, o ren asa, me I kin pok ong uk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:10
verses.text: Aki om kanekid ai masan en kanongama, I pil pan kanekid uk ni auer en kasongesong, me pan udong toun sappa karos, en kasongesong irail, me kauson sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:11
verses.text: I pan pwarado madang. Kolekol, me koe anekier, pwe sota amen en kulia sang mar om.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:12
verses.text: Me dadaurata, I pan wiaki i ur eu nan tanpas en ai Kot, o a solar pan pedoi sang kokolata. I pan inting po a mar en ai Kot, o ad en kanim en ai Kot, Ierusalem kap, me peidido sang ai Kot nanlang o mar ai kap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:13
verses.text: Me salong a mia, en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:14
verses.text: Inting wong tounlang en momodisou en Laodisea: Iet masan en me maraneki Amen, me saunkadede lelapok melel, me tapin dodok en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:15
verses.text: I asa om wiawia kan, koe sota karakar o pil sota lamelamur. I men, koe en lamelamur de karakar!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:16
verses.text: Ari, koe me lou, a kaidin karakar de lamelamur, I ap pan mus kin uk wei sang nan au ai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:17
verses.text: Pwe koe inda: Ngai kapwapwa, i anekier kapwa kan, o i sota kin anane meakot, ap sasa, me koe sakanekan, o so konekon, o samama, o maskun, o kiliso.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:18
verses.text: I panaui uk, koe en neti sang ia kold lingan, aki kisiniai, pwe koe en kapwapwala, o likau puetepuet, pwe koe en likauie uk, o kanamenok pan om kiliso der sansal, o wini en mas o, men elieliki mas om, en kilang wasa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:19
verses.text: I kin kapung ong o kaloke karos, me I pokepoke. Koe nantiong kalula!

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:20
verses.text: Kilang, I kin u pan wanim o letelet. Meamen pan rong ngil ai, ap ritingida wanim o, I pan pedelong re a, ap iang i mot ong ras saraui, o a iang ia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:21
verses.text: Me dadaurata, I pan ki ong i, en iang, ia mondi pon mol ai, dueta ngai pil dadaurata, ap iang Sam ai mondi pon mol a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:22
verses.text: Me salong a mia, i en rong, me Ngen o masani ong momodisou kan!<div eID="gen2878" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.3"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat i kilanger kasansal eu: Kilang, wanim eu ritidar nanlang, o ngil, me i ronger mas, dueta koronete eu kasokasoi ong ia: Koda dong met! I pan kasale ong uk, me pan wiaui mur en mepukat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:2
verses.text: Ngai pitipit katia Ngen. A kilang, mol eu mi nanlang, o amen kotidi pon mol o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:3
verses.text: A sansal en me kotidi poa rasong takai Iaspis o Sardis o aia me liteui mol o, me sansal dueta takai smarakd.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:4
verses.text: O mol o kapilki pena mol rieisok paieu, o lapalap riek pamen kotikot poa, likau kida likau puetepuet o nin kida nin kold.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:5
verses.text: O sang ni mol o liol, o ngil akai, o nansapwe kai use wei sang, o lamp isu umpumpul mon mol o, iei Ngen isu en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:6
verses.text: O mon mol o dueta sed eu, me rasong klas o kristal, o nan warong en mol o, o impan mol o man maur pamen, me rok ki por en mas mo ar o mur ir.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:7
verses.text: Man en mas me rasong laien amen, o man kariamen rasong kau ol amen, o man kasilimen kar i rasong aramas, o man kapamen rasong manpir ikel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:8
verses.text: O man maur pamen ko pa en pir wonu mi ren amen amen, me rokki por en mas ni kaila o lole, o re sota nenenla ni ran o ni pong, indinda: Me saraui, me saraui, me saraui, Kaun Kot, Kaun en meakaros, me kotikot mas, o me kotikot met, o me pan kotin pwarado.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:9
verses.text: Ari man maur oko, lao pan kalinganada, o kakaki, o danke i me kotidi pon mol o, me ieias soutuk,

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:10
verses.text: Me lapalap riek pamen ap pan poridi ong i, me kotidi pon mol o, o re pan pongi i, me ieiasata kokolata, o re pan pwilikidi mar ar mon mol o, indada:

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:11
verses.text: Komui Maing, at Kaun, o at Kot, me kon ong, en linganla, o kakala, o manaman, pwe ir me kotin kapikadar meakan karos o pweki kupur omui re mia kier o wiaui kidar.<div eID="gen2879" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.4"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:1
verses.text: O i kilanger nan lim pali maun, en me kotidi pon mol o, puk eu, intingidier lole o liki o katengeki pena men kateng isu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:2
verses.text: O i kilang tounlang kelail amen, pepeidokki ngil laud: Is me kon ong pak pasang puk o, o lapwada a men kateng kan?

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:3
verses.text: A sota amen, me mi nanlang de nin sappa, de pan sappa, me kak ong pak pasang puk, o udial i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:4
verses.text: Ari, i ap sangesang kaualap, aki sota amen, me diarokadar, me kon ong, en pak pasang puk o, de udial i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:5
verses.text: O amen ren me lapalap akan masani ong ia: Koe der sangesang! Kilang, Laien, me udan kainok en Iuda, tapin Dawid, me pwaidar ni a peipei, pwen kon ong, pak pasang puk o, o lapwa sang men kateng isu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:6
verses.text: O i kilang nan warong en mol o nan pung en man pamen o nan pung en lapalap akan Sippul amen u due kamekamelar, me ose isu o por en mas a isu mia, iei Ngen en Kot isu me pakadaralang dol en sappa karos.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:7
verses.text: A kotido, ap kotiki sang puk o ni lim a maun en me kaipokedi pon mol o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:8
verses.text: A ni a kotin aleer puk o, man maur pamen, o lapalap riek pamen poridi ong mon Sippul o. Amen amen re irail kolekol a arp o dal kold, me dir en potik en isis, iei kapakap en saraui kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:9
verses.text: Irail kauleki kaul kap pot indinda: Ir me kotin kon ong, kotikida puk o, o lapwada a men kateng ko, pwe komui kamatalar o neti ki ong Kot nt’ omui sang ni kainok karos, o lokaia karos, o men liki karos, o wei karos.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:10
verses.text: O kotin wia kin irail la wei eu ong atail Kot, pwen samero kan, o re pan nanmarki nin sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:11
verses.text: O i kilanger o i ronger ngil en tounlang toto impan mol o, o man maur ko, o lapalap oko; irail me ngederenia nen nen o kid kid,

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:12
verses.text: Irail indinda ni ngil laud: Sippul o me kamekamelar, me kon ong aineki manaman, o kapwa, o erpit, o kel, o kaka, o lingan, o pai kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:13
verses.text: Ir karusia nanlang, o sappa, o pan sappa, o pon madau, o aude pan arail karos, i ronger me re indinda: Me kotidi pon mol o, o Sippul en kapinganla, o kakala, o kalinganada o manaman kokolata.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:14
verses.text: Man maur pamen masani: Amen, O lapalap akan poridi ong pongi i.<div eID="gen2880" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.5"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:1
verses.text: I kilang ni en Sippul a lauad pasang eu ren kateng isu, o i ronger amen ren man pamen masanieki ngil me rasong nansapwe: Kodo!

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:2
verses.text: I ap kilanger os puetepuet amen, o me mondi poa kasik katieu mi re a, o mar eu ko ong i, i ari koti wei, pwen kalokaloedi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:3
verses.text: Ni a lauad pasang kateng kariau, i ap ronger man kariamen masanier: Kodo!

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:4
verses.text: Amen os me waitata ap pwarado, a me mondi poa a muei ong i, en kawela muei mau nin sappa, o tou a kan pakamekam pena, a kodlas kalaimun me pangalang i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:5
verses.text: Ni a lauad pasang kateng kasilu, i ronger man kasilimen masani: Kodo! I ap kilanger os tontol amen, o me mondi poa, men tenok mi ni lim a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:6
verses.text: O i ronger ngil eu nan pung en man pamen indinda: Song en wit eu denar eu, o song en korn silu denar eu, a le o wain der kawela!

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:7
verses.text: A ni a lauad pasang kateng kapaieu, i ronger ngil en man kapamen masani: Kodo!

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:8
verses.text: I ap kilanger os pasas, o me mondi poa, mar a Mela, o wasan mela me idauen i. A kapi ong i en kaunda pakis eu en sappa, en kamekila kodlas, o isesol, o mela, o ren man laualo en sappa kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:9
verses.text: A ni a lauad pasang kateng kalimau, i kilanger pan pei saraui ngen en me kamekila masan en Kot, o ar kadede, me re wia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:10
verses.text: Irail likelikwirki ngil laud indinda: Arai da, Maing, Kaun saraui o melel, komui so kadeikada o iki kin nt’ at ong irail, me kauson sappa?

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:11
verses.text: Likau puetepuet me pangalang irail karos, o a kotin masani ong irail, ren moleilei mas ekis, a lao iang ar o ri ar akan unsokelar, me pan kamekamela dueta pein irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:12
verses.text: O i kilanger ni a lauad pasang kateng kawonu, rerer en sappa lapalap ap wiaui, katipin rotala dueta likau tontol, wunen eu o maram waitatala dueta nta.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:13
verses.text: O usu en lang akan pupedi ong sappa, due tuka pik pot kasedi wa kan me pul, ni a tuälok ki ang ma,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:14
verses.text: O lang kasaula dueta kisin likau ni a limlim pena, o nana karos o dake karos torak sang deu ar,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:15
verses.text: O nanmarki en sappa kan, o monsap, o saumas akan, o kapwapwa kan, o me kelail, o ladu kan karos, o maio kan rukila nan por o pan paip en nana kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:16
verses.text: Ap indang nana o paip akan: Pupedi po at o pwain kidi sang mon silang en i me kotidi pon mol o, o sang ni ongiong en Sippul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:17
verses.text: Pwe a leler ran lapalap en a ongiong; o is me pan kak pwaida?<div eID="gen2881" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.6"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:1
verses.text: MURIN met i kilanger tounlang pamen uda ni kaim en sappa paieu kolekol ang paieu en sappa, pwe ang ender ipuip dong sappa, de pon sed, de nin tuka pot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:2
verses.text: O i kilanger amen tounlang pwarada sang ni mas en lang, kilelekidi kilel en Kot ieias. A likwirki ngil laud ong tounlang pamen, me udan kawela sap o sed,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:3
verses.text: Indinda: Der kawela sappa de madau, de tuka kan, a lao kileledier ladu en at Kot akan ni tam ar!

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:4
verses.text: Ngai ari rongadar arail wadok me kileledier me lop panen pakid sang nin kainok en Israel akan karos.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:5
verses.text: Sang ni kainok en Iuda nen riakid kileledier, sang ni kainok en Rupen nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Kat nen riakid,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:6
verses.text: Sang ni kainok en Aser nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Naptali nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Manase nen riakid,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:7
verses.text: Sang ni kainok en Simeon nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Lewi nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Isasar nen riakid,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:8
verses.text: Sang ni kainok en Sepulon nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Iosep nen riakid, sang ni kainok en Peniamin nen riakid.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:9
verses.text: Murin mepukat i kilanger pokon kalaimunia, sota amen me kak wadokedi sang ni wei karos, o kainok karos, o men liki karos, o lokaia karos, o mon mol o, o mon Sippul likau kida likau puetepuet o paini ni lim ar,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:10
verses.text: O re ngil laudeda indinda: Kot kamaur pat, me kaipokedi pon mol o o Sippul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:11
verses.text: Tounlang karos u kapil pena mol o, o lapalap akan, o man pamen, irail pori kidi mas ar mon mol o, pongi Kot,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:12
verses.text: Indinda: Amen! Pai, o lingan, o erpit, o danke, o wau, o roson, o manaman ong atail Kot kokolata! Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:13
verses.text: O amen ren me lapalap akan sapeng masani ong ia: Is irail me likau kida likau puetepuet, o irail kodo sang ia?

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:14
verses.text: I ap potoan ong i: Maing, komui mangier. A sapeng ia: Ir me pwaida sang ni kaankamekam, o re lope ar likau, o kapwad kida ntan Sippul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:15
verses.text: I me re mikier mon mol en Kot, o papa i ni ran o ni pong nan sapwilim a im en kaudok, o me kaipokedi pon mol o, pan apapwali irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:16
verses.text: Irail solar pan men manga potopoteta, o solar men nim pilada, o katipin solar pan daker ir, de eu song en karakar pan lel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:17
verses.text: Pwe Sippul ni warong en mol o pan kotin wia sile parail, o a pan kalua ir wong ni pil en maur, o Kot pan lim wei sang pil en mas arail.<div eID="gen2882" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.7"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:1
verses.text: NI a lauad pasang kateng kaisu, kaporamen wiaui nanlang alep en auer.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:2
verses.text: O i kilanger tounlang isimen, me uda mon Kot, o koronete isu pangalang irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:3
verses.text: Amen tounlang me kotido u pon pei saraui, dal kold, men isik potik, mi re a; potik isis toto pangalang re a, pwen kamanada kapakap en saulang kan, me mi mon mol o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:4
verses.text: Ad in isik iangaki kapakap en me saraui kan adidalang Kot sang ni lim en tounlang o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:5
verses.text: Tounlang ari aleda dal en potik o, ap aude kida kisiniai en pei saraui, ap kasedi ong sappa; ari, nansapwe, o ngil akan, o liol, o rerer en sappa wiauier.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:6
verses.text: A tounlang isimen, me ar koronete isu mia, kaonopadang pepeuk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:7
verses.text: Men mas pepeuk koronete, akel o kisiniai iangaki nta ap wiauier o pisikindi lang sappa; a silekis eu en sappa rongala, o silekis eu en tuka rongala, o rä karos rongala.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:8
verses.text: O tounlang kariamen pepeuk koronete ap likamata nana lapalap eu isisiki kisiniai ap pisikindi lang madau; a silekis eu en madau ap wialar nta.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:9
verses.text: O silekis eu en tou a maur melar nan sed, o silekis eu en sop akan olar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:10
verses.text: A tounlang kasilimen pepeuk koronete, usu lapalap ap pupedi sang nanlang likamata ser umpumpul eu pupedi pon silekis eu en pilap akan o utun pil akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:11
verses.text: Ad en usu o Sadik; silekis eu en pil akan ap sadikalar, o aramas toto mekilar pil aki ar sadik.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:12
verses.text: A tounlang kapamen pepeuk koronete, silekis eu en katipin, o silekis eu en maram, o silekis eu en usu kan ap olar. Silekis eu ari rotongala o ran solar marain ni a silekis eu o pil dueta pong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:13
verses.text: O i kilanger o ronger ikel amen pipir nan warong en lang, indindaki ngil laud: Apwal, apwal, apwal ong irail, me kaukausonta sappa, pweki ngil en koronete en tounlang silimen, me pan pepeuk mur.<div eID="gen2883" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.8"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:1
verses.text: TOUNLANG kalimen pepeuk koronete, i ap kilang usu en lang eu, me pupedi ong sappa, o ki en wasa lol me pangalang i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:2
verses.text: A ritingida au en wasa lol, adiniai ap adida sang nan wasa lol o, dueta adiniai en um kalaimun, o katipin o pan lang rotorotala, pweki adiniai en wasa lol.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:3
verses.text: O mansiek kan me pwarado sang nan adiniai, rap paraparalang sappa, o manaman pangalang irail dueta skorpion en sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:4
verses.text: A masani ong irail, ren der kawela rä nan sap, de tuka ta tontol, o pil so tuka laud, a aramas akan ta, me so kileleki kilel en Kot ni tam arail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:5
verses.text: A so muei ong irail, en kame ir ala, a ren kaloke irail saunipong limau; o ar wairok me laud dueta lip en skorpion, ma a pan ke aramas amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:6
verses.text: Ni ran puko aramas pan rapaki mela, ap sota pan diarada; o re pan inong iong mela, a mela pan tang wei sang irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:7
verses.text: Mom en mansiek kan dueta os, me onoper mauin, o pon mong arail meakot, me rasong mar kold, o mas ar dueta mas en aramas.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:8
verses.text: Pit en mong arail rasong pit en mong en li, o ngi arail dueta ngi en laien.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:9
verses.text: Pere me mi re ’rail dueta pere mata, o ngirsok en pa arail dueta ngirsok en war, me os toto me tangaki wong nan mauin.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:10
verses.text: O iki ’rail dueta skorpion, o ose ar mia, o re keleki iki ’rail, o re kin kame aramas saunipong limau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:11
verses.text: O arail nanmarki ani en kadar en wasa lol, ad a ni lokaia en Ipru Apadon, a ad a ni lokaia en Krik Apolion.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:12
verses.text: Ari, tapin apwal akan daulier, a kilang, pil riau pan pwarado mur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:13
verses.text: Tounlang kawonemen pepeuk koronete, i ap rong ngil eu, me tapida sang nan ose paieu en pei saraui, me mi mon Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:14
verses.text: Amen indang tounlang kawonemen, me a koronete mia: Lapwada tounlang pamen, me salidier ni kailan pilap Oiprat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:15
verses.text: Ari, tounlang pamen oko sapdokalar, me onoper ong auer, o ran, o saunipong, o par, pwe ren kamela silekis eu en aramas akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:16
verses.text: Wadawad en tounpei, me dake os riasap; o i ronger duen toto ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:17
verses.text: Iduen ai kilanger os akan ni kasansal o, o irail, me mod po arail, pere pras arail dueta kisiniai, me meimei o dueta swepel, o mong en os oko dueta mong en laien; o sang ni au arail kisiniai, o ad, o swepel kin adewei.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:18
verses.text: Kariapa silu pukat silekis eu en aramas akan, me kamekilar, kisiniai, o ad, o swepel, me adewei sang ni au arail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:19
verses.text: Kelail en os akan mi nan au ar, o ni padaik arail, pwe padaik arail dueta serpent kan, o mong ar mia, o re kamekamki ir padaik ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:20
verses.text: A luan aramas akan, me so kamekilar kamekam pukat, kang kaluki wiawia en pa arail, pwe ender pongi ong tewil akan o dikedik en ani, me wiaki kold, o silper, o pras, o takai, o tuka, me so kak ngar wasa, o so rong wasa, o so alialu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:21
verses.text: Irail sota kaluki ar kamela, o ar wun ani, o ar nenek, o ar lipirap.<div eID="gen2884" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.9"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:1
verses.text: O I kilanger amen tounlang kelail, me kotidido sang nanlang, me likauida dapok eu, o aia mi pon kadokenmai, o silang i dueta katipin, o aluwilu a dueta ur kisiniai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:2
verses.text: Ni lim a kisin puk mia, me papak pasang, o aluwilu a pali maun sokedi pon madau, a pali maing pon sappa,

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:3
verses.text: O a kotin molipe kida ngil laud, due laien amen ni a weriwer, o ni a molipeer, nansapwe isu ap ngiringir.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:4
verses.text: A nansapwe isu ngiringiridar, i men inting, i ap rong ngil eu sang nanlang masani: Katenge meakan, me nansapwe isu masanier, der inting ir edi!

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:5
verses.text: Tounlang o, me i kilanger u pon madau o sappa, puekada lim a pali maun,

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:6
verses.text: Ap kauki i, me ieiasata soutuk, me kotin kapikadar lang o meakan mi lole, o sappa o meakan mi lole, o madau o meakan mi lole, me solar pan ansau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:7
verses.text: A ni dokan ngil en tounlang kaisimen ni a pan pepeuk, iei ansau karir pan Kot kaunsokalar, duen a kotin kokop ong sapwilim a ladu saukop akan rongamau o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: Ngil o, me i ronger sang nanlang, a pil masani ong ia er masani: U ko wei, aleda kisin puk, me papak pasanger, ni lim en tounlang, me uda pon madau o pon sappa!

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: Ari, i ap ko wong tounlang o, potoan ong i, en ki dong ia kisin puk o. A masani ong ia: Ale, ap kangala, a pan kasadikala kaped om, a ni au om a pan iau dueta onik.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: I ap aleer kisin puk o sang ni lim en tounlang ap kangalar. Ari, nan au i me iau due onik, a murin i kanger, kaped i ap sadikalar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: A masani ong ia: Koe nok pil kokopada iran men liki kan, o aramas akan, o lokaia kan, o nanmarki toto.<div eID="gen2885" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.10"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: O MEN song dueta sokon pot pang dong ia. Amen inda: Uda, song im en kaudok en Kot, o pei saraui, o irail me kaukaudok lole!

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: A kapil penan im en kaudok kasela liki o der song, pwe a pangalanger men liki kan o kanim saraui re pan kakaue saunipong paeisok riau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: O I pan kamanada nai saunkadede riamen, o ira pan kokop wei ran kid riepuki woneisok, likau kida likau tol.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: Ira tuka olip riapot o lamp riau, me mimi mon Kaun en sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: Ma amen men kame ira, kisiniai pan lus wei sang nan au ara, ap karongala naira imwintiti kan. O ma amen men kame ira, a pan kamela.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: Ira manaman ong en pinala lang, pwe ede katau arain ara kokopada, o ira kaun en pil, ira kak kawuk ong nta pil akan o kame ki sappa song en kamekam karos, due ira inong iong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: Ira lao kanikiela ara kadede, man o, me pan pwarada sang wasa lol, pan pei ong ira, kaloe ira di, kame ira la.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: O kalep ara pan wonon nani al en kanim lapalap, me ad a ni karaseras Sodom o Äkipten, wasa ar Kaun pil kalopular.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
verses.text: Ari, me toto sang ren men liki kan, o kainok, o lokaia, o aramas akan pan kilang kalep ara ran silu alep, o irail sota pan mueid ong, me ara kalep pan saredi nan sousou.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: O irail, me kaukauson sappa, kaneket kin ira o pereperen, re pan pakisakis pena, pwe saukop riamen et kin kaloke irail, me kaukauson sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: A murin ran silu alep maur sang ren Kot pil til wong lol ara, rap u ni nä ara, a irail, me kilang ira, masakada kaualap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: O i ronger ngil laud eu sang lang mamasani ong ira: Koma koda dong met! Ira ap kokidalang dapok, o imwintiti ara kilang ira.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: Ni auer ota sappa rerer kaualap, eisokkis eu en kanim olar ni rerer, o mar isekid en aramas mekilar, me tei kan masakalar, rap landar Kot en lang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: Kamekam kariau wiauier. Kilang kamekam kasilu me pan pitipit wiaui.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: Tounlang kaisimen pepeuk koronete. Ngil laud ap wiauier nanlang indinda: Wein sappa id wialar wein atail Kaun o sapwilim a Kristus. A pan kotin kaunda kokolata.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: A lapalap riek pamen, me ariri Kot pon mol arail, rap pupedi ni silang ir pongi Kot masani:

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: Se danke komui, Maing Kot, Kaun en meakaros, me kotikot metet, o me kotikot mas o, pwe re kotin aleer ar manaman lapalap, o kotin Nanmarki lar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: O wei kan makaradar, a ar ongiong leler, o a leler ansaun melar akan pakadeik, o a leler ansau en katingi sapwilim omui ladu saukop akan o saraui kan; irail, me lomwineki mar ar, tikitik kan o lapalap akan, o en kawe irail, me kin kawela sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: Im en kaudok en Kot, mi nanlang, ritidar, o kopa en inau pingngar nan im en kaudok o; a liol, o ngil akan, o nansapwe kan, o rerer en sappa, o akel lapalap wiauiedar.<div eID="gen2886" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.11"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: KILEL lapalap eu pingngar nanlang: Li amen linganeki katipin, o maram pan nä a, o a mareda usu eisokriau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: A liseanlar, a weriwer en naitik, waiwairok en sapedokla sang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: Pil eu kilel pingngar nanlang: Kilang, drake lapalap waitata, monga me isu, o salong a eisok, o mar isu pon mong a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: O a padaik urakiwei silekis eu en usu en lang, ap sipedi ir ong sappa. O drake uda mon li o, me pan naitik, pwe lao a naitiker, a en katalala na seri.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: Ari, a naitikadar na seri ol, me pan kaun kida kainok karos sokon mata; ari, na seri peukadalang Kot ong mol a,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: Li o tang wong sap tan, me deu a onoper ren Kot, iei wasa o re kin kamanga i ran kid riepuki woneisok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: Mauin pwaidar nanlang. Mikael o sapwilim a tounlang kan mauini ong drake o, o drake o na kan mauini ong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: A re so pwaida o solar deu ar nanlang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: O drake lapalap pisikindila, iei serpent, me ad a Tewil o Satan, katiamau pan sappa karos, i me pisikindi lang sappa, o na kan iang i pisikindila.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: O i ronger ngil lapalap eu nanlang indinda: Metet me pwaidar kamauapan, o wiauipan, o wei en atail Kot, o manaman en sapwilim a Kristus, pwe karaune pan ri atail pisikindila, me kin karaun kin irail mon Kot ni ran o ni pong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: A re kaloedi i aki ntan Sippul o, o pweki masan en ar kadededa lamalam; o re so pok ong maur arail lao lel ong mela.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: I me lang en perenda, o komail me kaukauson lole! A mesued ong sappa o madau, pwe tewil me kodilang komail, makarada kaualap, pwe a asa, me a ansau me motomot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: Drake o ni a kilanger, me a pisikindier sappa, a kansore li, me naitiker seri ol.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: Pa riau en manpir ikel lapalap, me pangalang li o, pwen pirlang deu a nan sap tan, wasa o a pan nekinek ia ansau eu, o ansau kan, o alep en ansau, doo sang mas en serpent o, wasa a pan kamanga ia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: A serpent o kusepoke wei sang nan au a ong li o pil, dueta pilap pot, pwen kapwiliki wei li o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: A sappa puporki li o, o sappa sara pasang au a nimala pilap o, me drake o kusepoke wei sang nan au a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: O drake makar pan li o, ap kola, en mauini ong luan kadaudok a, me kin nekidala kusoned en Kot akan o koledi kadede pan Iesus. A ngai uda pon pik en oror.<div eID="gen2887" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.12"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: I AP kasinenda pon pik en oror o kilanger man amen pwaradar sang nan madau, me a ose ek o monga isu mia, o mar eisok mier pon ose kan, o ni monga ad en lalaue kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: Man o, me i kilanger, dueta parder amen, o nä a dueta nä en pär amen, o au a rasong au en laien. O drake ki ong i a kelail, o mol a, o a manaman lapalap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: O i kilanger monga eu dueta kamekamelar, ari so, a kamekam motier, a toun sappa karos puriamuiki man o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: Irail ari pongi ong drake, pwe a kapieki man o a kelail, o re pongi ong man o indinda: Is me rasong man o? O is me pan kak mauini ong i?

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: O a pang ong i au en suai lapalap, o en lalau eu, o a pang ong i, en mimieta saungipong paeisok riau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: Ari, a sara pasang au a, en lalaue Kot, en laue mar a o tanpas a saraui, o irail me kotikot nanlang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: O a kapieki i, en mauini ong saraui kan o kaloe irail edi; o a kapieki i, en kaunda wei karos, o men liki kan, o lokaia, o kainok kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: O irail karos, me kaukauson sappa, pan pongi ong i karos, me mar arail sota intingidier nan puk en maur en Sippul, me kamekamelar sang nin tapin sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: Meamen salong a mia, en rong.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: Ma amen pan kaloedi, nan pein i pan lodila; o ma amen pan kamekila, kodlas, nan a pan kamekila kodlas. Nan iet en saraui kan ar konongama o ar poson.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: O i kilanger, amen man pwarado sang nan pwel, ose riau mia, rasong sippul amen, o a kasoi dueta drake amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: O man o kin wia manaman akan karos dueta men mas mon por en mas a. O a wiada, me toun sappa en pongi ong man o, me kelailadar sang a kamekam.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: A wiadar kilel lapalap, kamoredi sang lang kisiniai pon sappa mon aramas akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: O a kotaue kin ir, me kaukauson sappa a kilel akan, me kapi ong i, en wiada mon man o, indai ong irail, me kausonta sappa, ren wiai ong man o, me a lop en kodlas mier, ap mauredar, dikedik eu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: O a kapi ong i, en kamaureda dikedik en man o, pwe dikedik en man o en pil lokaia, o en wiai ong irail, me kang pongi dikedik en man, en kamekamela.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: O wiai ong karos, me tik o me lap akan, o kapwapwa kan, o samama kan, o me maio, o ladu kan, ren wia kilel eu ni pa ar pali maun de ni tam ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: Pwe sota amen en kak net de netikila, pwe ir eta, me kileledier, kilelekidi mar en man de wad en mar a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: Iet lolekong. Me lolekong kan en wadokdi mar en man o, pwe a rasong wad en aramas amen; iet a wad: Wonepuki woneisok wonu.<div eID="gen2888" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.13"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: O I kilanger Sippul o kotikot pon dol en Sion o me iang i lop panen pakid, o mar a o mar en Sam a intingidier ni tam ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: O i ronger ngil eu sang nanlang dueta pungupung en pil toto o dueta ngirngir lapalap en nansapwe; ngil o, me i rongadar, dueta ngil en saunkaul pikipikir ar arp akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: Irail kauleki kaul kap pot mon mol o, o mon man pamen o lapalap akan; o sota amen me kak koledi kaul o, irail lop panen pakid eta, irail me net sapal sang nin sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: Iei irail, me so samin kila li, pwe irail me makelekel. Iei irail me idedauen Sippul o, wasa a kin kotila ia. Mepukat net sapal sang ren aramas akan, me meseni ong Kot o Sippul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: O nan au ar sota likam me diarokadar, nan sota ar samin.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: O i kilanger amen tounlang, pipir ni warong en lang, rongamau soutuk mi re a, pwen padaki ong irail, me kauson sappa, o ong wei karos, o kainok karos, o lokaia o aramas akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: A masani ki ngil laud: Landa Kot, o waui i, pwe auer en a pan kotin kadeikada me pwarer; o pongi i, me kotin wiadar lang, o sappa, o madau, o utun pil akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: O amen tounlang, kariamen, idauen i masani: A rongkilar, a rongkilar, Papilon lapalap, me kare ong kainok karos kamekam, aki ar nenek re a!

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: O amen tounlang, kasilimen, me idauen ir katitiki ngil laud: Ma amen pongi man o kilel en man, o ale kilel ni tam a o ni pa a,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: A pan tungole en Kot a ongiong, me wiauier sokadolepa dal en ongiong en Kot, o a pan kalokeki kisiniai o swepel mon tounlang saraui kan o mon Sippul o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: O adiniai en ar lokolok peipeidala potopoteta, re so moleilei ni ran de ni pong, irail me pongi man o o a kilel, o irail me kilelekidar mar a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: Iet en saraui kan ar kanongama, me kin nekinekid kusoned en Kot akan o poson ong Iesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: O i rong ngil eu sang lang masani: Intingiedi: Meid pai irail me mela ren Kaun o, met o kokolata! Iei, Ngen o me kotin masani, irail en moleilei sang ar wiawia kan, pwe ar wiawia kan iang irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: O i kilanger dapok puetepuet eu, o Amen kotikot pon dapok o, me rasong Nain aramas, marakier mar kold, o ni lim a naip kong apot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: O amen tounlang pedoi wei sang nan im en kaudok, ekekerki ngil laud ong i, me kotidi pon dapok o: Komui kadar om naip paledi, pwe a leler auer en paledi, pwe rak en sappa mater kaualap!

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: Me kotidi pon dapok kasadi sappa a naip, rak kiri sang sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: O amen tounlang pedoi wei sang nan im en kaudok, me mi nanlang, pil naip kong apot mi re a.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: O amen tounlang me pwarado sang impan pei saraui, me kin kakaun kisiniai, likwir ong i, me a naip kong mia, masani: Paledi! Tolunga sang wan wain en sappa, pwe wa me matier.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: Ari, tounlang o paleki sappa naip, o tolung sang wan wain en sappa, o kasedi ong nan kopa laud en ongiong en Kot eu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: Irail tiakedi nan kopa en wain likin kanim, a nta kusewei sang nan kopa o lel ong sal en os, lel lang stadien kid wonepuki.<div eID="gen2889" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.14"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: O I kilanger pil kilel eu nanlang, me lap o kalom: Tounlang isimen, a kalokolok isu mi re ’rail, pwe ongiong en Kot kaimwisokki ir la.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: O i kilanger sed klas eu, me doleki kisiniai o irail me kaloedi man o dikedik en man, o wadawad en mar a, uda ni kailan sed o, o arp en Kot mi re ’rail,

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: O irail kauleki kaul en Moses ladu en Kot amen, o kaul en Sippul indinda: Omui wiawia kan me lapalap o kalom. Maing Kot, me pung o melel omui wiawia kan, komui Nanmarki en wei kan, Kaun en meakaros.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: Is me so pan landa komui, Maing, o wauneki mar omui? Pwe komui ta me saraui, pwe wei karos pan pwarado pongi komui, pwe omui wiawia pung me sansaleda.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: Murin mepukat i kilanger nan im en kaudok kadedepa mi nanlang me ritida.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: O tounlang isimen pedoi wei sang nan im en kaudok kalokolok isu re ’rail, kapwateki likau min o puetepuet, o ir piraki ni pan ati waiwai kold.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: O amen ren man pamen pangalang tounlang isimen dal kold isu, direki ongiong en Kot, me ieiasata soutuk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: O im en kaudok me topkila adiniai tapida sang lingan en Kot o a manaman; o sota amen me kak pedelong ong nan im en kaudok o lao kalokolok isu en tounlang isimen wiauier.<div eID="gen2890" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.15"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: O I ronger ngil laud eu sang nan im en kaudok o, mamasani ong tounlang isimen: Komail kowei, wudokedi ong sappa dal isu, me audekier ongiong en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: Men mas ap kotiwei wudokila ong sappa a dal, ap wiala kins sued ong aramas akan, me kilelekidi kilel en man o, o me pongi a kilel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: O kariamen wudokila a dal ong nan madau ap wiala nta due nt’ en melar amen, ari me maur karos nan madau ap melar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: O kasilimen wudokila a dal pon pilap o utun pil akan, rap ntalar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: I ronger tounlang en pil akan masani: Komui me pung, me kotikot, o me kotikot mas, me saraui, pwe komui kadeikada due met.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: Pwe irail kieledier ntan me saraui o saukop akan, ari, kom kotin katungole kin ir nta; ari, me mau ong irail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: I ronger me pei saraui o masani: Ei, Maing Kot, Kaun en meakaros, melel o me pung omui kadeik kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: A kapamen wudokila a dal pon katipin, a kapi ong i, en isiki kisiniai aramas akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: Ari, aramas rongkila karakar kaualap, o re lalaue mar en Kot, me Kaun pan kamekam pukat; a re sota kalukila, pwen wauneki i.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: O tounlang kalimen wudokila a dal pon mol en man o; ari a wei rotorotala; o re ke pasang lo arail pweki motakan madak.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: O irail lalaue Kot en lang, aki ar madak o ar kins akan, o re sota kalukila ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: O tounlang kawonemen wudokila a dal pon pilap Oiprat, a pil ap ngalengaledi, pwen kaonopada al mon nanmarki, me kotido sang ni pali mas en lang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: O i kilanger, me sang nan au en drake, o sang nan au en man o, o sang nan au en saukop likam ngen samin silu dueta pros kai koda sang.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: Ir ngen en tewil kai, wiawia kilel kai, me kin pwaralang nanmarki en sappa kan, en kapokon ir penang mauin en ran lapalap en Kot manaman.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: Kilang, I pwarado dueta lipirap amen; meid pai, me kin masamasan, nekinekid a likau kan, pwe a de kilisola, rap kilang a kanamenok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: O re kapokon ir penang wasa, me ad a ni lokaia en Ipru Armakedon.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
