verses.text: O tounlang kaisimen wudokila a dal nin wäwä, ngil laud ap pwaradar sang im en kaudok nanlang, sang ni mol o mamasani: A wiauier.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: Ari, liol o ngil kai o nansapwe wiauier, o sappa rerer kaualap, sota due sang tapin aramas mi sappa, pwe me lapalap o mulatok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: Ari, kanim lapalap pal pasang wiala silekis silu, o kanim en sap akan rongk pasang, o Kot kotin tamanda kanim Papilon, pwen kotiki ong i dal en wain en a ongiong lapalap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: O dake karos mokid wei sang o nana kan solar sansal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: O akel lapalap, toutouki paun epuki, me moredi sang lang lel aramas akan, o aramas lalaue Kot pweki kamekam akel, pwe iei kamekam me lapalapia.<div eID="gen2891" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.16"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: TOUNLANG amen, kisan isimen me ar dal isu mia, pwara do, masani ong ia: Kodo, i pan kasale ong uk en li sued, me kaunda pil toto, a pan kalokolok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: Me nanmarki en sappa kan nenekier, o me kaukauson sappa pweipweikier wain en a nenek.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: Ari, a uke ia lang nan sap tan ren ngen. I ap kilanger li amen, mondi pon man waitata amen, ad a laue toto mia, monga isu o a ose eisok mia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: Li o likau kida likau tontol o waitata, o kapwat kida kold o takai kasampwal, o manaman kai, o ni pa a dal kold eu mia, me dir kila me samin o me saut en a nenek.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: O ni tam a mar eu intingidier, iet: Okiok pot, Papilon lapalap in en me nenek kan o saut akan en sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: O i kilang li o a pweipweiki nt’ en saraui kan o nt’ en saunkadede en Iesus akan. Ari, ni ai kilanger i, i ap puriamui kaualap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: A tounlang o masani ong ia: Menda koe waponki? I pan kasale ong uk karasepan om waponki li o, o man o, o me a kin dake, me a monga isu o a ose eisok mia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: Man o, me koe kilanger, a mia mas ap soer mia, a nok pwaradado sang wasa lol, ap pan kolang wasan kamekam; o irail, me kaukauson sappa, pan wapon ki irail, me mar arail so intingidier nan puk en maur sang nin tapin sappa, ni ar kilang man o, due a mier mas, ap soer mia, ap nok pwarado.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: Ari, iet lolekong: Monga isu rasong nana isu, me li o mondi poa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: O irail nanmarki isimen. Limen nikilar, me ta men mia, a amen kaikenta pwarado, a a lao pwarado, a pan sapwilada ansau kis.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: A man o men mas, ap soer mia, i kawalemen, kisan isimen, ap pan kalokolok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: A ose eisok, me koe kilanger, rasong nanmarki ek, me kaikenta ar wei, a re aleer manaman dueta nanmarki kan, pwen sapwileda auer ta ieu ren man o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: Ir pukat kin wia insen ta ieu, o re pan ki ong man o ar manaman paki i ar angiangin o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: Ir pan mauini ong Sippul, a Sippul pan kaloe ir edi; pwe i ta Kaun en kaun akan o Nanmarki en nanmarki kan. O me iang i, me paeker, o pilier, o melel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: A masani ong ia: Pil oko, me koe kilanger, wasa me li sued o mondi ia, iei irail men liki, o kainok kan, o aramas akan, o lokaia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: O ose eisok, me koe kilanger, o man o, irail me pan tataki li sued o, o kasamaliala i, o kakilisauia ta, o re pan kangala uduk a, karongki i kisiniai.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: Pwe Kot kotin kainongada mongiong ar, en wia kupur a, o en wia lamalam ta pot o en upai man o, a lao masan en Kot pwaida.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: Li o, me koe kilanger, iei kanim lapalap, me kakaun nanmarki kan nan sappa.<div eID="gen2892" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.17"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat i kilanger amen tounlang kodido sang lang, me manaman kaualap, o sappa marain kila a lingan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: A kotin molipeki kapitie laud masani: A rongk pasang, o rongk pasang, Papilon lapalap, ap id wiala deun tewil akan, o deun ngen saut karos, o deun manpir samin, o katantat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: Pwe wei karos nim sang wain makar en a nenek, o nanmarki en sappa neneker re a, o saunet en sappa kapwapwakier a kapwa kasampwal akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: O i ronger eu ngil sang lang masani: Ko wei sang i nai aramas akan, pwe komail der ainekida dip ar kan, pwe komail der pukoki kompar akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: Pwe dip a kan lel onger lang, o Kot kotin tamanda a sued akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: Depuk ong i, duen pein i wiadar! O depuk ong i pan riapak, duen a mau ong a wiawia kan; dal o, me a audedar, i dal ota komail aude ong i pan riapak!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: Duen a kin kalinganda pein i, o kamuei matier, iei due ki ong i kalokepa o kasonglolpa, pwe a mongeloleki: Ngai nanmarki li amen, o i so pan li odi, o i sota pan kilang mesued kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: I me kompa kan pan lel ong i ni rang ota: Mela, o maiei, o lek, o a pan rong kila kisiniai, pwe Kaun Kot me manaman, me kadeikada i;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: O nanmarki en sappa kan, me nenek re a, o muei mat sang i, re pan maieiki, o weriwereki i ni ar kilang adiniai en a rongala.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: O re pan u wasa doo waponki a kamekam indada: Apwal, apwal Papilon, kanim lapalap, Papilon kanim kelail! Ni aur ta ieu kadeik paom pwaida.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: O saunet en sappa kan maiei o sangesangki i, pwe sota amen me neti ar kapwa kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: Kapwa kold, o silper, o takai kasampwal akan, o manaman akan, o likau linen kaselel, o likau tol, o likau silk, o likau waitata, o song en tuka pomau karos, o song en dal karos, me wia kidar ngi en elepant, o dal akan, wia kidar tuka kasampwal, o mata pras, o mata, o marmor,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: O simet, o potik, o men isis, o me pomau, o pomau en isis, o wain, o le, o plaua kasampwal, o wan wit, o man akan, o man sip, o os akan, o dake pan os, o ladu kan, o ngen en aramas akan,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: O wan tuka kan, me kaped om kin iauki, rose sang uk er, o dipisou lingan o kaselel rose sang uk er, a solar pan diarokada kokolata.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: Saunet en mepukat, me kapwapwadar re a, me pan u wasa doo, wapon kida a kamekam sangesang o mamaiei.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: Indinda: Apwal, apwal kanim lapalap, me kapwadeki likau ankotitik, o tol, o waitata, o kapwadeki kold, o takai kasampwal, o manaman!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: Pwe ni auer ta ieu kapwa toto pukat olar. O saupal en sop, o ir, me toun sop, o seler akan, o saunet en nan madau, ir uda wasa doo.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: O weriwereda, ni ar kilanger adiniai en a isis, indinda: Ia kanim, me rasong kanim lapalap wet!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: Irail tukatuk en mong wereda, sangesang, mamaiei, indinda: Apwal apwal kanim lapalap! Tou a, me ar sop akan mi nan madau, kapwapwalar, pwe a neti re a mulatokia. Ni auer ta ieu a mokonaidier.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: Kaneketeki i lang, o saraui kan, o wanporon kan, o saukop akan, pwe Kot me kotin iki ong i komail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: Tounlang roson amen pokada takai due takai lap men iris plaua, ap kasedi ong madau, masani: Iduen Papilon kanim lap pan karongk pasang, ap pan solar mia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: Ngil en me wia arp akan o kakaul akan, o me peuk kasang plöte, o me peuk koronete, pan solar me pan rong re a, o solar saupal, me pan diarok lol om, o ngirsok en takai iris plaua solar me pan rong lol om.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: O marain en lamp pan solar senser lol om, o ngil en ol kamod o li kamod solar me pan rong lol om, pwe noum saunet akan, saumas en sappa, kainok karos pakotaue kilar om widing kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: O ntan saukop o saraui kan me diarokadar lol om, o ntan karos, me kamekamelar sappa.<div eID="gen2893" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.18"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: MURIN mepukat i ronger likamada morong en pokon kalaimun nanlang, masani: Aleluia, kamaur, o lingan, o manaman udan atail Kot!

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: Pwe melel o me pung ar kadeik kan; pwe a kotin kadeikadar li sued lapalap, me kasuedie kilar toun sappa a nenek kan o a ikier ntan na ladu kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: Pil kariapak re inda: Aleluia! A adiniai adidala kokolata.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: O lapalap riekpamen o man pamen rap poridi pongi ong Kot, me kaipokedi pon mol a, masani: Amen Aleluia!

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: O ngil, me peido sang mol o masani: Kapinga atail Kot, komail sapwilim a ladu kan, komail, me lan i, me tikitik o me lapalap akan!

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: O i ronger morong en pokon kalaimun, o due ngil en pil toto, o due ngiringir en nansapwe kan indinda: Aleluia, pwe Kaun atail Kot, me Kaun en meakaros a wialar Nanmarki.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: Kitail en insenemau, o pereperen, o wauneki i, pwe a leler en Sippul a kapapaud, o li kamod onopadar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: O a muei ong i, en likauwia kida likau linen, me min o makelekel; pwe likau linen makelekel iei kadeik pung en me wiaui pweki saraui kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: A masani ong ia: Intingiedi: Re meid pai, me luke dong kamadip en kapapaud en Sippul o. O a masani ong ia: Mepukat masan melel akan en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: I ap pupedi ni aluwilu a, en pongi i. A masani ong ia: Koe der, ngai sau om, o ri om, me aneki kadede pan Iesus; pongi Kot. A ngen en kokop iei kadede pan Iesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: O i kilanger lang a ritidar o os puetepuet amen, o me kaipokedi poa, me oroneki Pung o Melel; a kadeikada o mauinda ni me pung.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: Por en silang i me rasong umpul en kisiniai, o mar a toto mia ni tapwi, a mar eu intingidier, me sota amen me asa, pein i ta.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: A likau kida likau eu, me kadueki nta, o mar a oroneki: Masan en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: O karis en saunpei en nanlang idauen i pon os puetepuet akan, likau kida linen puetepuet o min.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: O sang nan silang i kodlas kong lus da sang, men kamekameki wein sappa. A pan kotin kaun kida sokon mata pot; o a tiakedi kopa en wain, me ongiong en Kot, Kaun en meakaros.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: Ni a likau o ni langelange a mar a intingidier: Nanmarki en nanmarki o Kaun en kaun akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
verses.text: O i kilanger tounlang amen uda nan katipin; a molipeiki ngil laud masani ong manpir akan, me pipir nan warong en lang: Kodo, pokon dong kamadip lapalap en Kot.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: Pwe komail en kang uduk en nanmarki kan, o uduk en kaun akan, o uduk en manaman akan, o uduk en os akan, o me mondi po arail, o uduk en me maio ko o ladu kan, me tikitik o me lapalap akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: O i kilanger man o, o nanmarki en sappa kan, o nair karis akan pokon penang mauini ong i, me kaipokedi pon os o na karis akan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: Man o lodi ong iangaki saukop likam, me wia kilel kai mo a, me a kotaue kida irail, me kilele kidi kilel en man o, o ir me pongi a kilel. Ira karos lokidokilang nan le en kisiniai, me rongerongki swepel ni ara memaur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: Me lu akan kamekame kila kodlas en i, me kaipokedi pon os o, iei kodlas, me lusa sang nan silang i; ari manpir akan muei mat kilar uduk arail.<div eID="gen2894" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.19"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: I kilanger tounlang amen kotido sang lang, ki en wasa lol mi re a nan lim a o sal mata lapalap.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: A saikidi drake o serpent en kaua, iei Tewil o Satan, ap saliedi i par kid.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: O kasedi ong nan wasa lol so kapi, ritingiedi o kileledi poa, pwe ender katikatiamau toun sappa, a lao par kid imwisokala. Muri a nok sapadokala ansau kis.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: O i kilanger mol akan, o ir me kaipokedi poa, kadeikada; o i kilanger ngen en ir, me mong ar lepuki sanger pweki kadedepan Iesus o masan en Kot, o ir, me so pongi man o, o a kilel, o so kilelekida a kilel ni tam ar o ni pa ar. Irail mauredar ap iang Kristus kakaun par kid.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: A me melar tei kan sota maureda lao par kid imwisokala, iei iasada kaieu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: A meid pai o saraui, me pan konodi ias kaieu; mela kariau so kokoa irail, pwe irail wiala samero en Kot o en Kristus akan, o re pan iang i kakaun par kid.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: Par kid lao imwisokela, Satan ap pan sapedokla sang a im en kateng.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: A ap pan parwei katikatiamau toun sap akan, me mi ni kaim paieu en sappa, Kok o Makok, kapokon ir penang mauin; ir me ngederenia rasong pik en oror.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: Irail paraparalang nan sappa, rap kapil pena pokon en saraui kan, o kanim kapai; kisiniai ap moredi sang lang, karong ir ala.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: O tewil, me kotaue ir, lokidokila nan le en kisiniai o swepel, wasa me man o saukop likam mia ia, o re pan kalokolok ni ran o ni pong kokolata soutuk.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: O i kilanger mol puetepuet lapalap eu, o i me kaipokedi poa sappa o lang tang wei sang mon silang i, ap solar deu ara me diarokadar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: O i kilanger melar akan tikitik o lapalap akan u mon mol o, o puk kan pak pasanger, o pil eu puk me pak pasanger, me puk en kamaur. Melar akan ap pakadeik kidar meakan, me intingkier nan puk kan duen ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: O madau kapeida melar akan, me mimi lole, o mela o wasan mela kidaer, me mi lol ir. Ir karos pakadeikadar iran ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: Mela o wasan mela me pisikindi lang le en kisiniai; iei mela kariau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: O meamen, me so intingidier nan puk en kamaur, a pisikindi lang le en kisiniai.<div eID="gen2895" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.20"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: O I kilanger lang kap o sappa kap, pwe lang mas o sappa mas solar mia, o solar madau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: O i kilanger kanim isou, Ierusalem kap, peidido sang lang ren Kot, kapwater due li kamod kapwater ong a paud ol.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: O i ronger ngil laud sang mol o masani: Kilang, tanpas en Kot mi ren aramas akan, o a pan kotikot re ’rail, o irail pan wia sapwilim a aramas ala, o pein Kot pan kotikot re ’rail.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: O a pan kotin limwi sang pil en mas ar karos; o mela pan solar, pil solar maiei, o solar sangesang, madak kokolata, pwe men mas solar mia.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: O me kaipokedi pon mol o masani: Kilang, I pan kawilikapada meakan karos. O a kotin masani: Intingiedi; pwe masan pukat me pung o melel!

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: A kotin masani ong ia: A pwaidar. Ngai Alpa o Omeka, Tapi o Imwi. I pan ki ong, me men nim pil adar, en nim sang utun pil en maur sapan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: Me pan dadaurata, a pan sosoki mepukat, o I pan wia na Kot la, o a pan wiala nai seri.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: A me masak, o sokamelele, o saut akan o men kamela kan, o nenek kan, o wun ani kan, o me pongi dikedik en ani kan, o likam kan karos deu ar nan le, me rongerongki kisiniai o swepel, iei mela kariau.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: O tounlang amen, kisan isimen, me dal en kalokolok isu en kaimwisokela mi re a, pwarado masani ong ia: Ko dong met, i pan kasale ong uk li kamod, warok en Sippul o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: Ari a kotin kalua kin ia la ren ngen pon nana lapalap eu o ileile, ap kasale ong ia kanim isou Ierusalem, peipeidido sang lang ren Kot;

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: Linganeki lingan en Kot; a marain me rasong takai kasampwal, rasong iaspis lingan eu,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: A kel lapalap ileile mia, o wanim eisokriau, o tounlang ekriamen mi ni wanim ko, o mar akan intingidier, me mar en nain Israel ekriamen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: Ni mas en lang wanim silu, o ni apong wanim silu, o ni air wanim silu, o ni kapi wanim silu.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: Pason en kel en kanim o me eisokriau, o mar en wanporon en Sippul o ekriamen intingidier po ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: Me masani ong ia mepukat, men song sokon kold mi re a, pwen song kanim o, o a wanim akan o a kel o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: Pali en kanim pali paieu, o anget a dueta tälap a; a songki kanim men song o, me anget a stadien nenriakid. Anget a o tälap o ileile duepeneta.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: A sosong kel o, ari me tipong en pa epuki paeisok paieu, duen men song en aramas o, me mi ren tounlang o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: A kel o wia kidar iaspis, a kanim o wia kidar kold eta, me rasong klas makelekel.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: Pason en kel en kanim o usunakier song en takai kasampwalia karos. Tapin pason takai iaspis, a kariau sapir, a kasilu kalsedonia, a kapaieu smarakd,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: A kalimau sardoniks, a kawonu sardis, a kaisu krisolit, a kawalu peril, a katuau topas, a kaeisok krisopras, a kaeisokeu iasint, a kaeisokriau ametist.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: O wanim eisokriau manaman eisokriau; ari, wanim eu iei manaman eu; o al en kanim o me kold makelekel, lingan due klas.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: O i sota kilanger im en kaudok lole, pwe Kaun Kot, Kaun en meakaros o Sippul iei ar im en kaudok.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: O kanim sota mau ong katipin de maram, pwen dakedaker, pwe lingan en Kot kamaraini i, o Sippul iei arail lamp.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: O wei kan pan weid wei ni a lingan; o nanmarki en sappa kan pan walang i ar lingan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: O a wanim akan sota pan ritidi ni ran, pwe solar pong wasa o.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: O irail pan wa dong i lingan o wau en wei kan,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: Sota me pan pedelong ong me samin, de me kin wia saut, de likam, a irail eta, me mar arail intingidier nan puk en maur en Sippul.<div eID="gen2896" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.21"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: O A kotin kasale ong ia pilap en kamaur pot, makelekel due kristal, me u wei sang ni mol en Kot o Sippul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: Ni kailan pilap pali karos tukan kamaur mia, me kin wa song en wa eisokriau, me wa saunipong kaukaule; o tan tuka kan men kamaur toun sappa.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: O solar men kariala kokolata; a mol en Kot o Sippul me mi lole; o sapwilim a ladu kan pan upa i,

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: O re pan kilang silang i, o mar a pan mi ni tam ar.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: O solar pong ni wasa o kokolata; re solar anane marain en lamp, pil solar marain en katipin, pwe Kaun Kot pan kotin kamaraini ir, o re pan nanmarki kokolata.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: A masani ong ia: Masan me pung o melel, o Kaun Kot en ngen en saukop akan poronedo sapwilim a tounlang, en kasale ong sapwilim a ladu kan, me pan wiaui ni ansau koren.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: Kilang, I pan madang pwarado, meid pai, me kanekid masan akan en kokop en puk wet!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: Ngai Ioanes, me ronger o kilanger mepukat, o ni ai ronger o kilanger, i ap poridier pongi mon aluwilu en tounlang, me kasale ong ia mepukat.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: O a masani ong ia: Koe der, ngai pil iang uk papa amen o iang ri om saukop akan, o iang ir, me kanekid masan en puk wet, pongi Kot!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: O a masani ong ia: Koe der katenge masan en kokop en puk wet, pwe ansau o korendor.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: Me so pung, en sapesapungeta, o me samin, en samisamineta, o me pung, en pungepungeta, o me saraui en saraui ta.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: Kilang, i madang pwarado o ai pwain mi re i, en pwain ong amen amen duen ar wiawia kan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: Ngai Alpa o Omeka, men Mas o Men mur, Tapi o Imwi.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: Re meid pai, me lope ar likau, pwe ren kon ong tuka en kamaur, o pedelong ong nan wanim en kanim akan!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: Liki kiti kan mia, o widingok kan, o nenek kan, o kamela kan, o me pongi dikedik en ani, o amen amen me mauki o me wiada likam.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: Ngai Iesus kadar doer nai tounlang, en kadede ong komail mepukat, mon momodisou kan. Ngai tapin kadaudok en Dawid, usu ran umpumpul.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: Ngen o li kamod masani: Kodo! O me pan rong, en inda: Kodo! O me men nim, en kodo, meamen me inong iong, en tungole pil en kamaur sapan.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: I kadede ong amen amen me rong masan en kokop en puk wet, ma amen pan usai ong, Kot pan kotiki ong i kampa kan, me intingidier nan puk wet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: O ma amen pan kase song ekis masan en kokop wet, Kot pan kotiki sang pwais a nin tukan kamaur o kanim isou, me intingidier nan puk wet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: Me kin kadede mepukat, masanier: Iei I pan madang pwarado. Amen, kotido Maing Iesus!

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: Mak en Kaun Iesus Kristus en mi ren saraui kan karos! Amen.<div eID="gen2897" type="x-p"/><chapter eID="Rev.22"/> <div eID="gen2875" osisID="Rev" type="book"/>
